name: Challenge.tensor_bigrading
statement:
theorem tensor_bigrading
    {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] [Module.Finite ℚ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] [Module.Finite ℚ W] {n m : ℤ}
    (H : ℤ × ℤ → Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) (K : ℤ × ℤ → Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W))
    (hsuppH : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ n → H pq = ⊥)
    (hintH : DirectSum.IsInternal H)
    (hconjH : ∀ p q : ℤ, (H (p, q)).map (σ V) = H (q, p))
    (hsuppK : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ m → K pq = ⊥)
    (hintK : DirectSum.IsInternal K)
    (hconjK : ∀ p q : ℤ, (K (p, q)).map (σ W) = K (q, p)) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (tensorPieces H K) ∧
      (∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ n + m → tensorPieces H K pq = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, (tensorPieces H K (p, q)).map (σ (V ⊗[ℚ] W)) =
        tensorPieces H K (q, p))
proof:
:= by
  let h : HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure n V := ⟨H, hsuppH, hintH, hconjH⟩
  let k : HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure m W := ⟨K, hsuppK, hintK, hconjK⟩
  exact ⟨HodgePilot.isInternal_tensorPiece h k,
    fun pq hpq => HodgePilot.tensorPiece_supported h k pq hpq,
    fun p q => HodgePilot.tensorPiece_conj_symm h k p q⟩

name: Challenge.sub_isCompl_orthogonal
statement:
theorem sub_isCompl_orthogonal
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] [Module.Finite ℚ V] {n : ℤ}
    (H : ℤ × ℤ → Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
    (hsupp : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ n → H pq = ⊥)
    (hint : DirectSum.IsInternal H)
    (hconj : ∀ p q : ℤ, (H (p, q)).map (σ V) = H (q, p))
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (hsymm : ∀ x y, B x y = (-1) ^ n * B y x)
    (horth : ∀ p q p' q' : ℤ, (p', q') ≠ (q, p) →
      ∀ x ∈ H (p, q), ∀ y ∈ H (p', q'), B.baseChange ℂ x y = 0)
    (hherm : ∀ p q : ℤ, p + q = n → ∀ x ∈ H (p, q),
      (Iexp (p - q) * B.baseChange ℂ x (σ V x)).im = 0)
    (hpos : ∀ p q : ℤ, p + q = n → ∀ x ∈ H (p, q), x ≠ 0 →
      0 < (Iexp (p - q) * B.baseChange ℂ x (σ V x)).re)
    (N : Submodule ℚ V)
    (hN : N.baseChange ℂ = ⨆ pq : ℤ × ℤ, (N.baseChange ℂ ⊓ H pq)) :
    IsCompl N (B.orthogonal N)
proof:
:= by
  let h : HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure n V := ⟨H, hsupp, hint, hconj⟩
  let P : HodgePilot.Polarization h := ⟨B, hsymm, horth, hherm, hpos⟩
  exact P.isCompl_orthogonal (HodgePilot.SubHodge.ofBiSup h N hN)

name: HodgePilot.krullDimLE_one_quotient
statement:
theorem krullDimLE_one_quotient {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime]
    (hcov : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, q ≤ p.asIdeal →
      p.asIdeal = q ∨ p.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (R ⧸ q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff, ringKrullDim_quotient]
  have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) := by norm_cast
  rw [h1, Order.krullDim_le_one_iff]
  rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hqp : q ≤ p.asIdeal := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus] at hp
    exact hp
  rcases hcov p hqp with h | h
  · left
    rintro ⟨p', hp'⟩ _
    rw [Subtype.mk_le_mk, ← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_le_asIdeal, h]
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus] at hp'
    exact hp'
  · right
    rintro ⟨p', hp'⟩ _
    rw [Subtype.mk_le_mk, ← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_le_asIdeal, h]
    exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p'.asIdeal

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.fromSpecStalk_generizationPt
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fromSpecStalk_generizationPt {x w : X} (h : w ⤳ x) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x (generizationPt h) = w
proof:
:= by
  have hc := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (X := X) h
  calc X.fromSpecStalk x (generizationPt h)
      = (Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x)
          (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk w)) :=
        (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
    _ = X.fromSpecStalk w (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk w)) := by rw [hc]
    _ = w := Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.le_fromSpecStalk_apply
statement:
lemma le_fromSpecStalk_apply {x : X} (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    x ≤ X.fromSpecStalk x p
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
  have h1 : p ⤳ IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    IsLocalRing.specializes_closedPoint p
  have h2 := h1.map (X.fromSpecStalk x).continuous
  rwa [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint] at h2

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.fromSpecStalk_apply_le
statement:
lemma fromSpecStalk_apply_le {x w : X} (h : w ⤳ x) (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hp : (generizationPt h).asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x p ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes, ← fromSpecStalk_generizationPt h]
  exact ((X.fromSpecStalk x).isEmbedding.toIsInducing.specializes_iff).mpr
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp
      ((PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_le_asIdeal _ _).mpr hp))

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.eq_generizationPt_or_eq_closedPoint
statement:
lemma eq_generizationPt_or_eq_closedPoint {x w : X} (h : x ⋖ w)
    (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hp : (generizationPt (specializes_of_covby h)).asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    p = generizationPt (specializes_of_covby h) ∨
      p = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (X.fromSpecStalk x) :=
    (X.fromSpecStalk x).isEmbedding.injective
  have hxy : x ≤ X.fromSpecStalk x p := le_fromSpecStalk_apply p
  have hyw : X.fromSpecStalk x p ≤ w :=
    fromSpecStalk_apply_le (specializes_of_covby h) p hp
  by_cases hyx : X.fromSpecStalk x p ≤ x
  · right
    apply hinj
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]
    exact point_le_antisymm hyx hxy
  · left
    apply hinj
    rw [fromSpecStalk_generizationPt]
    have hlt : x < X.fromSpecStalk x p := lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hxy, hyx⟩
    have hnlt : ¬ X.fromSpecStalk x p < w := h.2 hlt
    rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, not_and, not_not] at hnlt
    exact point_le_antisymm hyw (hnlt hyw)

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.krullDimLE_one_stalkQuotient
statement:
theorem krullDimLE_one_stalkQuotient {x w : X} (h : x ⋖ w) :
    Ring.KrullDimLE 1
      (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ (generizationPt (specializes_of_covby h)).asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  apply krullDimLE_one_quotient
  intro p hp
  rcases eq_generizationPt_or_eq_closedPoint h p hp with h' | h'
  · left; rw [h']
  · right; rw [h']; rfl

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_surjectiveOnStalks
statement:
lemma _root_.HodgePilot.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_surjectiveOnStalks
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [SurjectiveOnStalks f] (p : X) :
    Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (f.residueFieldMap p).hom.injective
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := X.residue_surjective p y
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := f.stalkMap_surjective p a
    refine ⟨Y.residue (f p) b, ?_⟩
    have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residue_residueFieldMap (f := f) (x := p))
    rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h2
    have h3 := RingHom.congr_fun h2 b
    simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h3
    rw [← ha, ← hb]
    exact h3

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.divFun_ne_zero_iff
proof:
:= by

  constructor
  · intro hne h1

  · intro hne hlog
    exact hne (by rw [← WithZero.exp_log (ordAt_ne_zero h hf), hlog, WithZero.exp_zero])

    (h2 : (Function.support (divFun w g)).Finite) :
    (Function.support (divFun w (f * g))).Finite

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.finite_support_divFun_div
statement:
lemma finite_support_divFun_div {w : X} {f g : X.residueField w}

proof:

  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  apply finite_support_divFun_mul hf (inv_ne_zero hg) h1
  rw [divFun_inv]
  exact h2.subset fun x hx => by
    simp only [Function.mem_support, Pi.neg_apply, ne_eq, neg_eq_zero] at hx

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.freeYonedaHomOfSection_comp
proof:
:= by
  ext V : 2
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  refine FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ (fun g : V.unop ⟶ U => ?_)
  show ((freeYonedaHomOfSection s ≫ f).app V) (FreeAbelianGroup.of g) =
    (freeYonedaHomOfSection (f.app (op U) s)).app V (FreeAbelianGroup.of g)
  rw [NatTrans.comp_app, CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
    freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of, freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of]
  have hnat := congrArg
    (fun (h : P.obj (op U) ⟶ P'.obj V) => h s)
    (f.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U) : op U ⟶ V))
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.sheafHomOfSection_comp
statement:
theorem sheafHomOfSection_comp {F F' : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : F ⟶ F')
    {U : C} (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    sheafHomOfSection F U s ≫ f = sheafHomOfSection F' U (f.hom.app (op U) s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : freeYonedaHomOfSection (P := (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F) s ≫
      (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f =
      freeYonedaHomOfSection (P := (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F')
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f).app (op U) s) :=
    freeYonedaHomOfSection_comp ((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f) s
  have h2 := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
    (adj := sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (freeYonedaHomOfSection (P := (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F) s) f
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.sheafHomOfSection_zero
statement:
theorem sheafHomOfSection_zero (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (U : C) :
    sheafHomOfSection F U (0 : F.obj.obj (op U)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_zero (h0SectionsEquiv F U).symm
  rw [h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply] at h
  refine (Ext.mk₀_bijective (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F).injective ?_
  rw [h, Ext.mk₀_zero]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection
statement:
theorem freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {V U : C} (i : V ⟶ U) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i ≫ sheafHomOfSection F U s =
      sheafHomOfSection F V (F.obj.map i.op s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_natural (J := J) F i s
  rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at h
  exact ((Ext.mk₀_bijective (freeYonedaSheaf J V) F).injective h).symm

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.freeYonedaSheafMap_id
statement:
theorem freeYonedaSheafMap_id (U : C) :
    freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) (𝟙 U) = 𝟙 (freeYonedaSheaf J U)
proof:
:= by
  show (presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      (Functor.whiskerRight (yoneda.map (𝟙 U)) AddCommGrpCat.free) = _
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  have h : Functor.whiskerRight (𝟙 (yoneda.obj U)) AddCommGrpCat.free =
      𝟙 (freeYonedaPresheaf (C := C) U) := by
    ext V : 2
    show AddCommGrpCat.free.map (NatTrans.app (𝟙 (yoneda.obj U)) V) =
      NatTrans.app (𝟙 (freeYonedaPresheaf (C := C) U)) V
    rw [NatTrans.id_app, NatTrans.id_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  rw [h, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.freeYonedaSheafMap_eqToHom
statement:
theorem freeYonedaSheafMap_eqToHom {V U : C} (h : V = U) :
    freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) (eqToHom h) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf J) h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, freeYonedaSheafMap_id]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_up_one
statement:
theorem uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_up_one (G : AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (h : AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ) ⟶ G) :
    AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv G h = h (ULift.up 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : uliftZMultiplesHom (G : Type u)
        (AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv G h) =
      AddCommGrpCat.homAddEquiv h :=
    (uliftZMultiplesHom (G : Type u)).apply_symm_apply (AddCommGrpCat.homAddEquiv h)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun (t : ULift.{u} ℤ →+ (G : Type u)) => t (ULift.up (1 : ℤ))) h1
  rw [uliftZMultiplesHom_apply_apply] at h2
  rw [show (AddEquiv.ulift (ULift.up (1 : ℤ)) : ℤ) = 1 from rfl, one_smul] at h2
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.hEquiv₀_mk₀_anchor
statement:
theorem hEquiv₀_mk₀_anchor (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {T : C}
    (hT : IsTerminal T) (s : F.obj.obj (op T)) :
    Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F hT
      (Ext.mk₀ ((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := J) T hT).inv ≫
        sheafHomOfSection F T s)) = s
proof:
:= by
  set g : (constantSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ F :=
    (freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := J) T hT).inv ≫ sheafHomOfSection F T s with hg
  have h1 : Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F hT (Ext.mk₀ g) =
      AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
        ((constantSheafAdj J AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).homEquiv _ F g) := by
    show AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
        ((constantSheafAdj J AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).homAddEquiv _ F
          (Ext.addEquiv₀ (Ext.mk₀ g))) = _
    rw [addEquiv₀_mk₀]
    rfl
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (constantSheafAdj J AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).homEquiv _ F g =
      (constantPresheafAdj AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).homEquiv _ _
        ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _ g) := by
    show ((constantPresheafAdj AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).comp
        (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u})).homEquiv _ _ g = _
    rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
    rfl
  have h3 : (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _ g =
      (freeYonedaTopIso T hT).inv ≫
        ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _
          (sheafHomOfSection F T s)) := by
    rw [hg]
    rw [show (freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := J) T hT).inv =
        (presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (freeYonedaTopIso T hT).inv from rfl]
    exact Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left _ _ _
  have h4 : (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _
      (sheafHomOfSection F T s) = freeYonedaHomOfSection s := by
    show (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _
        (((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
          (freeYonedaPresheaf T) F).symm (freeYonedaHomOfSection s)) = _
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  rw [h2, h3, h4, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_up_one]
  show (((freeYonedaTopIso T hT).inv ≫ freeYonedaHomOfSection s).app (op T))
      (((constantPresheafAdj AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).unit.app
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (ULift.up (1 : ℤ))) = s
  rw [show ((constantPresheafAdj AddCommGrpCat.{u} hT).unit.app
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (ULift.up (1 : ℤ)) = ULift.up (1 : ℤ) from rfl]
  show ((freeYonedaHomOfSection s).app (op T))
      (((freeYonedaTopIso T hT).inv.app (op T)) (ULift.up (1 : ℤ))) = s
  have hι : ((freeYonedaTopIso T hT).inv.app (op T)) (ULift.up (1 : ℤ)) =
      FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 T) := by
    have hcomp := freeYonedaTopComponent_hom_of T hT T (𝟙 T)
    have hback := congrArg (fun z => (freeYonedaTopComponent T hT T).inv z) hcomp
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply] at hback
    show ((freeYonedaTopComponent T hT T).inv) (ULift.up (1 : ℤ)) =
      FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 T)
    exact hback.symm
  rw [hι, freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of]
  show F.obj.map ((𝟙 T).op) s = s
  rw [op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.hEquiv₀_symm_eq
statement:
theorem hEquiv₀_symm_eq (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {T : C}
    (hT : IsTerminal T) (s : F.obj.obj (op T)) :
    (Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F hT).symm s =
      Ext.mk₀ ((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := J) T hT).inv ≫
        sheafHomOfSection F T s)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F hT).injective
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hEquiv₀_mk₀_anchor]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.zSectionK_res_f₁₂
statement:
theorem zSectionK_res_f₁₂ :
    (KUnitsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op
        (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) =
      zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U01
proof:
:= by
  rw [← kSec_zElt genericPoint_mem_U0, ← kSec_zElt genericPoint_mem_U01]
  exact kSec_restrict zeltK _ genericPoint_mem_U0 genericPoint_mem_U01

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.unitsToK_overlapUnitAb
statement:
theorem unitsToK_overlapUnitAb :
    (unitsToK p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb =
      zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U01
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitsToK_app_of_mem p1 (U := op (U0 ⊓ U1)) genericPoint_mem_U01]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.tau_comm₁₂
statement:
theorem tau_comm₁₂ :
    tauOne ≫ (cartierSC p1).f =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex.f ≫ tauTwo
proof:
:= by
  show sheafHomOfSection (unitsAb p1) (U0 ⊓ U1) overlapUnitAb ≫ unitsToK p1 =
    biprod.lift
        (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)))
        (-(freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)))) ≫
      biprod.desc (sheafHomOfSection (KUnitsAb p1) U0 (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) 0
  rw [biprod.lift_desc, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero]
  rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection, zSectionK_res_f₁₂]
  rw [sheafHomOfSection_comp, unitsToK_overlapUnitAb]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.tau_comm₂₃
statement:
theorem tau_comm₂₃ :
    tauTwo ≫ (cartierSC p1).g =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex.g ≫ tauThree
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext'
  · show biprod.inl ≫
        (biprod.desc (sheafHomOfSection (KUnitsAb p1) U0
          (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) 0 ≫ divisorsπ p1) =
      biprod.inl ≫
        (biprod.desc
          (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U0 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1)))
          (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (le_sup_right : U1 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1))) ≫
        sheafHomOfSection (divisorsAb p1) (U0 ⊔ U1)
          (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1))))
    rw [biprod.inl_desc_assoc, biprod.inl_desc_assoc]
    rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection, sheafHomOfSection_comp]
    have hL : (divisorsAb p1).obj.map
        (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U0 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1)).op
        (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1))) =
        (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) :=
      dinfGlued_restrict_left
    exact congrArg (fun s => sheafHomOfSection (divisorsAb p1) U0 s) hL.symm
  · show biprod.inr ≫
        (biprod.desc (sheafHomOfSection (KUnitsAb p1) U0
          (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) 0 ≫ divisorsπ p1) =
      biprod.inr ≫
        (biprod.desc
          (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U0 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1)))
          (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE (le_sup_right : U1 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1))) ≫
        sheafHomOfSection (divisorsAb p1) (U0 ⊔ U1)
          (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1))))
    rw [biprod.inr_desc_assoc, biprod.inr_desc_assoc, Limits.zero_comp]
    rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection]
    have hR : (divisorsAb p1).obj.map
        (homOfLE (le_sup_right : U1 ≤ U0 ⊔ U1)).op
        (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1))) =
        (0 : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op U1)) :=
      dinfGlued_restrict_right
    rw [hR, sheafHomOfSection_zero]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.mv_extClass_natural
statement:
theorem mv_extClass_natural :
    ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex_shortExact.extClass).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ tauOne) (add_zero 1) =
      (Ext.mk₀ tauThree).comp (cartierδ p1) (zero_add 1)
proof:
:=
  ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass_naturality
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex_shortExact
    (cartierSC_shortExact p1) mvToCartier

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.mvδ_apply
statement:
theorem mvδ_apply (F : Sheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0})
    (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 (U0 ⊓ U1)) F 0) :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).δ F 0 1 rfl x =
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex_shortExact.extClass).comp x
        (add_zero 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.dinf_eq_mk₀
statement:
theorem dinf_eq_mk₀ :
    dinf = Ext.mk₀
      ((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JP1) (⊤ : p1.Opens) (opensTopIsTerminal p1)).inv ≫
        (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge) ≫ tauThree))
proof:
:= by
  show (cdivSectionsEquiv p1).symm dinfTopSection = _
  have h1 : freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge) ≫ tauThree =
      sheafHomOfSection (divisorsAb p1) (⊤ : p1.Opens) dinfTopSection := by
    show freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge) ≫
      sheafHomOfSection (divisorsAb p1) (U0 ⊔ U1)
        (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1))) = _
    rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_comp_sheafHomOfSection]
    rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact hEquiv₀_symm_eq (divisorsAb p1) (opensTopIsTerminal p1) dinfTopSection

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.freeYonedaSheafMap_sup
statement:
theorem freeYonedaSheafMap_sup :
    freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JP1) U0_sup_U1)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge : (⊤ : p1.Opens) ⟶ U0 ⊔ U1) =
      eqToHom U0_sup_U1.symm from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
  rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_eqToHom, eqToIso.inv]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.dlogSpace_hom
statement:
theorem dlogSpace_hom :
    dlogSpace.hom =
      dlogOpens ProjectiveLineGraded.φC ≫ ProjectiveLineGraded.secComparison
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.dlogSheaf_unit_eq
statement:
theorem dlogSheaf_unit_eq :
    dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
          (deRhamSheafAb ProjectiveLineGraded.φC 1) =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map dlogSpace
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun W => ?_)
  show (dlogSite ProjectiveLineGraded.φC).app W ≫
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
        (deRhamSheafAb ProjectiveLineGraded.φC 1)).hom.app W =
    (dlogOpens ProjectiveLineGraded.φC ≫ ProjectiveLineGraded.secComparison).app
      ((Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor p1).op.obj W)
  rw [NatTrans.comp_app]
  rw [show ProjectiveLineGraded.secComparison.app
      ((Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor p1).op.obj W) =
      ProjectiveLineGraded.unitRestrictionIso.hom.app W from
    secComparison_app_site W.unop]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.functor_map_dlogSheaf
statement:
theorem functor_map_dlogSheaf :
    (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
        (dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC) =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app (unitsAb p1) ≫
        dlogSpace
proof:
:= by
  apply (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map_injective
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  haveI : IsIso ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
      (unitsAffine p1)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso
      (((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.app (unitsAffine p1)).hom))
  rw [← cancel_epi ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
    (unitsAffine p1))]
  have hL : (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app (unitsAffine p1) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map
        ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
          (dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC)) =
      dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
          (deRhamSheafAb ProjectiveLineGraded.φC 1) :=
    ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.naturality
      (dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC)).symm
  rw [hL, dlogSheaf_unit_eq, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [show (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app (unitsAffine p1) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map
        ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app (unitsAb p1)) =
      𝟙 _ from (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unit_inverse_comp (unitsAb p1)]
  rw [Category.id_comp]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.counitInv_dlogSpace
statement:
theorem counitInv_dlogSpace :
    (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app (unitsAb p1) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
        (dlogSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.φC) = dlogSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [functor_map_dlogSheaf, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Category.id_comp]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.cartierδ_roundTrip
statement:
theorem cartierδ_roundTrip :
    (cartierδAffine p1).mapExactFunctor (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor =
      (Ext.mk₀ ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (divisorsAb p1))).comp
        ((cartierδ p1).comp
          (Ext.mk₀ ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app
            (unitsAb p1)))
          (add_zero 1))
        (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (cartierδAffine p1).mapExactFunctor
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor =
      ((cartierSCAffine_shortExact p1).map_of_exact
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor).extClass := by
    rw [show cartierδAffine p1 = (cartierSCAffine_shortExact p1).extClass from rfl]
    exact Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass _ (cartierSCAffine_shortExact p1)
  have hnat := ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass_naturality
    ((cartierSCAffine_shortExact p1).map_of_exact
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor)
    (cartierSC_shortExact p1) cartierCounit
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun t => t.comp
      (Ext.mk₀ ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app (unitsAb p1)))
      (add_zero 1)) hnat
  beta_reduce at h2
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at h2
  rw [show cartierCounit.τ₁ =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app (unitsAb p1) from rfl,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_app] at h2
  rw [show (𝟙 (((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse ⋙
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor).obj (unitsAb p1))) =
      (𝟙 (((cartierSCAffine p1).map
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor).X₁)) from rfl,
    Ext.comp_mk₀_id, Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero] at h2
  rw [hmap]
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.anchor_legs
statement:
theorem anchor_legs :
    (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) =
      𝟙 (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat)))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
        (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1)) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom := by
    show ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.mapIso
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).symm ≪≫
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.app
        (Hyper.zConstSheaf
          (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))).symm).inv = _
    rw [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.symm_inv]
    rfl
  rw [ha, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hb : (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).inverse.map
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
        (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
        ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.obj
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))) ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom :=
    (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.naturality
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom
  rw [hb]
  
  
  have hfin : (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
        ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))) ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.obj
            (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))) ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom =
      𝟙 (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) := by
    have htri := (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor_unit_comp
      (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))
    exact ((congrArg (fun t => (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫ t)
        (Category.assoc
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
            ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).unitIso.hom.app
              (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))))
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
            ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.obj
              (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))))
          (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom)).symm).trans
      ((congrArg (fun t => (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫ t ≫
          (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom) htri).trans
        ((congrArg (fun t => (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫ t)
          (Category.id_comp (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).hom)).trans
          (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv_hom_id))
  exact hfin

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.bridge_collapse
statement:
theorem bridge_collapse :
    ProjectiveLineDetection.truncationBridge ProjectiveLineDetection.dinfCycleClassTrunc =
      dinf.comp ((cartierδ p1).comp (Ext.mk₀ dlogSpace) (add_zero 1)) (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectiveLineDetection.truncationBridge_dinfCycleClassTrunc,
    omegaSiteToSpace_apply, Sheaf.H.map_apply, unitsHSiteEquiv_apply]
  
  have h₀ : dinfClass = (Ext.mk₀ (Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf)).comp (cartierδ p1) (zero_add 1) := by
    rw [Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h₀]
  
  rw [Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp,
    Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀,
    cartierδAffine_eq_siteMove]
  
  
  rw [Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, cartierδ_roundTrip]
  
  have hw : (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).symm.functor.map (Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf)) =
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
        Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app (divisorsAb p1) := by
    exact (Iso.eq_comp_inv
        ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.app (divisorsAb p1))).mpr
      ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.naturality
        (Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf))
  rw [hw]
  
  simp only [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
  
  rw [show (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv ≫
      (((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
        Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf) ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app (divisorsAb p1)) ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app (divisorsAb p1) =
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
        Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf from
    congrArg (fun t => (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map
        (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv ≫ t)
      ((Category.assoc
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
              (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
            Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf)
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.inv.app (divisorsAb p1))
          ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
            (divisorsAb p1))).trans
        ((congrArg (fun t =>
            ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
                (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
              Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf) ≫ t)
          (Iso.inv_hom_id_app (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso
            (divisorsAb p1))).trans
          (Category.comp_id _)))]
  
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero,
    Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, counitInv_dlogSpace]
  
  rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
  rw [show (DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫
      (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) ≫
        Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf = Ext.addEquiv₀ dinf from by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
    rw [show ((DeRhamSpaceAgree.zConstSheafSpaceIso p1).inv ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).functor.map (zConstSiteAnchorIso p1).inv) ≫
        (DeRhamSpaceAgree.siteToSpaceEquiv p1).counitIso.hom.app
          (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (p1 : TopCat))) =
        𝟙 _ from by rw [Category.assoc]; exact anchor_legs]
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    rfl]
  exact congrArg
    (fun t => Ext.comp t ((cartierδ p1).comp (Ext.mk₀ dlogSpace) (add_zero 1)) (zero_add 1))
    (Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply dinf)

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.tauOne_dlogSpace
statement:
theorem tauOne_dlogSpace :
    tauOne ≫ dlogSpace =
      sheafHomOfSection ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)
        ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaSec
proof:
:= by
  show sheafHomOfSection (unitsAb p1) (U0 ⊓ U1) overlapUnitAb ≫ dlogSpace = _
  rw [sheafHomOfSection_comp]
  congr 1
  show (ProjectiveLineGraded.secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)))
      ((dlogOpens ProjectiveLineGraded.φC).app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb) =
    ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaSec
  have hval : (dlogOpens ProjectiveLineGraded.φC).app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb =
      ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaRing := by
    show dlogHom ℂ (DeRhamPresheaf.Sec ProjectiveLineGraded.φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb =
      ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaRing
    rw [dlogHom_apply, ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaRing_receipt, DLog.map_dlog]
    have hunit : Units.map ((ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom :
          LaurentPolynomial ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] DeRhamPresheaf.Sec ProjectiveLineGraded.φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) :
          LaurentPolynomial ℂ →* DeRhamPresheaf.Sec ProjectiveLineGraded.φC (U0 ⊓ U1))
        (ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ) =
        Additive.toMul overlapUnitAb := by
      apply Units.ext
      show ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom
        ((ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ : (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)ˣ) : LaurentPolynomial ℂ) = _
      rw [ContentAnchor.tUnit_val]
      exact ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom_T
    rw [hunit]
    rfl
  rw [hval]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.edgeClassH_expand
statement:
theorem edgeClassH_expand :
    ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassH =
      (Ext.mk₀
        ((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JP1) (⊤ : p1.Opens)
            (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)).inv ≫
          (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JP1) U0_sup_U1)).inv)).comp
        (((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex_shortExact.extClass).comp
          ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaH (add_zero 1))
        (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  show CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
      (freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JP1) (⊤ : p1.Opens)
        (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)) 1
      (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
        (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JP1) U0_sup_U1)) 1
        ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassGraded) = _
  rw [CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft_apply, CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft_apply,
    Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
  rw [show ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassGraded =
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).shortComplex_shortExact.extClass).comp
        ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaH (add_zero 1) from
    mvδ_apply ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaSheaf ProjectiveLineGraded.omegaH]

name: HodgePilot.GradedEdgeProof.truncationBridge_dinfCycleClassTrunc_eq_edgeClassH
statement:
theorem truncationBridge_dinfCycleClassTrunc_eq_edgeClassH :
    ProjectiveLineDetection.truncationBridge ProjectiveLineDetection.dinfCycleClassTrunc =
      ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassH
proof:
:= by
  rw [bridge_collapse, dinf_eq_mk₀, edgeClassH_expand]
  
  rw [show ((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JP1) (⊤ : p1.Opens)
        (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)).inv ≫
      (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge) ≫ tauThree)) =
      (((freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JP1) (⊤ : p1.Opens)
        (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)).inv ≫
        freeYonedaSheafMap (J := JP1) (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge)) ≫ tauThree) from by
    rw [Category.assoc]]
  rw [← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
  
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero]
  rw [← Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, ← mv_extClass_natural,
    Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, tauOne_dlogSpace,
    ← omegaH_receipt]
  
  rw [freeYonedaSheafMap_sup]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.mono_toLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem mono_toLinearMap_injective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [Mono f] : Function.Injective f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  have hk : kernelι f = 0 :=
    (cancel_mono f).mp ((kernelι_comp f).trans zero_comp.symm)
  have h0 : (kernelι f).toLinearMap = 0 := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap hk
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : (kernelι f).toLinearMap ⟨x, hx⟩ = 0 := by rw [h0]; rfl
  exact hx0

proof:

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.isSplitMono_of_mono
statement:
theorem Polarization.isSplitMono_of_mono {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (P : Polarization X.str) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Mono f] : IsSplitMono f
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective f.toLinearMap :=
    HodgeStructCat.mono_toLinearMap_injective f
  refine IsSplitMono.mk'
    ⟨(P.splitIso' (SubHodge.ofImage f)).inv ≫ P.splitFst (SubHodge.ofImage f)
        ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
            (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv, ?_⟩
  have key : f ≫ (P.splitIso' (SubHodge.ofImage f)).inv
      = HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f ≫ P.splitInl (SubHodge.ofImage f) := by
    rw [Iso.comp_inv_eq, Category.assoc, ← P.splitInl_comp_splitIso_hom]
    exact (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_comp_inclHom f).symm
  calc f ≫ (P.splitIso' (SubHodge.ofImage f)).inv
          ≫ P.splitFst (SubHodge.ofImage f)
          ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
              (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv
      = (f ≫ (P.splitIso' (SubHodge.ofImage f)).inv)
          ≫ P.splitFst (SubHodge.ofImage f)
          ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
              (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f ≫ P.splitInl (SubHodge.ofImage f))
          ≫ P.splitFst (SubHodge.ofImage f)
          ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
              (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv := by
        rw [key]
    _ = HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f
          ≫ (P.splitInl (SubHodge.ofImage f) ≫ P.splitFst (SubHodge.ofImage f))
          ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
              (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f
          ≫ (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
              (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).inv := by
        rw [Polarization.splitInl_comp_splitFst, Category.id_comp]
    _ = 𝟙 Y :=
        (HodgeStructCat.isoOfBijective (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict f)
          (HodgeStructCat.imageCorestrict_bijective f hinj)).hom_inv_id

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.simple_of_subHodge_trivial
statement:
theorem HodgeStructCat.simple_of_subHodge_trivial {X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (hnt : Nontrivial X.carrier)
    (htriv : ∀ N : SubHodge X.str, N.toSubmodule = ⊥ ∨ N.toSubmodule = ⊤) :
    Simple X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Y f hm
  constructor
  · intro hiso h0
    subst h0
    have h1 : CategoryTheory.inv (0 : Y ⟶ X) ≫ (0 : Y ⟶ X) = 𝟙 X :=
      IsIso.inv_hom_id _
    rw [comp_zero] at h1
    have h2 : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).toLinearMap = 0 := by rw [← h1]; rfl
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := hnt
    apply hxy
    have hx : x = 0 := by simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h2 x
    have hy : y = 0 := by simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h2 y
    rw [hx, hy]
  · intro hne
    have hinj : Function.Injective f.toLinearMap :=
      mono_toLinearMap_injective f
    rcases htriv (SubHodge.ofImage f) with hbot | htop
    · exfalso
      apply hne
      apply hom_ext
      have h0 : LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap = ⊥ := hbot
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot] at h0
      rw [h0]
      rfl
    · refine isIso_of_bijective f ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
      have h1 : LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap = ⊤ := htop
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top] at h1
      exact h1

name: HodgePilot.SubHodge.top_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem SubHodge.top_toSubmodule {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]

    (SubHodge.top h).toSubmodule = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.exists_simple_sub
statement:
theorem HodgeStructCat.exists_simple_sub {X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (hnt : Nontrivial X.carrier) :
    ∃ N : SubHodge X.str, N.toSubmodule ≠ ⊥ ∧
      Simple (HodgeStructCat.of ↥N.toSubmodule (X.str.sub N))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ d : ℕ, ∃ N : SubHodge X.str, N.toSubmodule ≠ ⊥
      ∧ Module.finrank ℚ ↥N.toSubmodule = d := by
    refine ⟨_, SubHodge.top X.str, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hbot
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := hnt
    have hx := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot x Submodule.mem_top
    have hy := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot y Submodule.mem_top
    exact hxy (hx.trans hy.symm)
  obtain ⟨N, hNne, hNrank⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine ⟨N, hNne, HodgeStructCat.simple_of_subHodge_trivial
    (Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hNne) ?_⟩
  intro M
  by_cases hMbot : M.toSubmodule = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hMbot
  refine Or.inr ?_
  by_contra hMtop
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (N.incl.comp M.incl).toLinearMap := by
    rw [HodgeHom.comp_toLinearMap, LinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact (Submodule.injective_subtype _).comp (Submodule.injective_subtype _)
  have hne' : (SubHodge.ofImage (N.incl.comp M.incl)).toSubmodule ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot'
    apply hMbot
    have h0 : (N.incl.comp M.incl).toLinearMap = 0 :=
      LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hbot'
    rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
    intro m hm
    have hval := LinearMap.congr_fun h0 ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hcoe : N.toSubmodule.subtype m = 0 := hval
    exact Subtype.ext hcoe
  have hle : Nat.find hex
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ ↥(SubHodge.ofImage (N.incl.comp M.incl)).toSubmodule :=
    Nat.find_min' hex ⟨SubHodge.ofImage (N.incl.comp M.incl), hne', rfl⟩
  have heq : Module.finrank ℚ
        ↥(SubHodge.ofImage (N.incl.comp M.incl)).toSubmodule
      = Module.finrank ℚ ↥M.toSubmodule :=
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj
  have hlt : Module.finrank ℚ ↥M.toSubmodule
      < Module.finrank ℚ ↥N.toSubmodule :=
    Submodule.finrank_lt hMtop
  rw [heq] at hle
  rw [hNrank] at hlt
  exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hlt) (lt_irrefl _)

name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isZero_biproduct_of_isEmpty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun g => ?_⟩
    exact biproduct.hom_ext' _ _ fun j => isEmptyElim j
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun g => ?_⟩
    exact biproduct.hom_ext _ _ fun j => isEmptyElim j

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem HodgeStructCat.isZero_of_subsingleton {X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (h : Subsingleton X.carrier) : IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun f => ?_⟩
    apply hom_ext
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0]
    simp
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun f => ?_⟩
    apply hom_ext
    exact LinearMap.ext fun x => Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.exists_simple_biproduct_decomposition_of_finrank
statement:
theorem Polarization.exists_simple_biproduct_decomposition_of_finrank
    (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ (X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n) (_ : Polarization X.str),
      Module.finrank ℚ X.carrier = d →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (S : Fin k → HodgeStructCat.{u} n),
        (∀ i, Simple (S i)) ∧ Nonempty ((⨁ S) ≅ X)
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ d ih =>
    intro X P hd
    by_cases hnt : Nontrivial X.carrier
    · by_cases hex : ∃ N : SubHodge X.str,
          N.toSubmodule ≠ ⊥ ∧ N.toSubmodule ≠ ⊤
      · 
        obtain ⟨N, hNbot, hNtop⟩ := hex
        have hcompl := P.isCompl_orthogonal N
        have hOtop : (P.orthoComplement N).toSubmodule ≠ ⊤ := by
          rw [Polarization.orthoComplement_toSubmodule]
          intro htop
          have hdisj := hcompl.disjoint
          rw [htop] at hdisj
          exact hNbot (disjoint_top.mp hdisj)
        have hdA : Module.finrank ℚ ↥N.toSubmodule < d := by
          rw [← hd]
          exact Submodule.finrank_lt hNtop
        have hdB : Module.finrank ℚ ↥(P.orthoComplement N).toSubmodule < d := by
          rw [← hd]
          exact Submodule.finrank_lt hOtop
        obtain ⟨k₁, S₁, hS₁, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := ih _ hdA
          (HodgeStructCat.of ↥N.toSubmodule (X.str.sub N)) (P.restrict N) rfl
        obtain ⟨k₂, S₂, hS₂, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := ih _ hdB
          (HodgeStructCat.of ↥(P.orthoComplement N).toSubmodule
            (X.str.sub (P.orthoComplement N)))
          (P.restrictOrtho N) rfl
        refine ⟨k₁ + k₂, Sum.elim S₁ S₂ ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
        · intro i
          rcases hcase : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | j
          · show Simple (Sum.elim S₁ S₂ (finSumFinEquiv.symm i))
            rw [hcase]
            exact hS₁ j
          · show Simple (Sum.elim S₁ S₂ (finSumFinEquiv.symm i))
            rw [hcase]
            exact hS₂ j
        · exact (biproduct.whiskerEquiv finSumFinEquiv.symm
              fun _ => Iso.refl _)
            ≪≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproductSumIso (Sum.elim S₁ S₂)
            ≪≫ biprod.mapIso
              (biproduct.whiskerEquiv (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => Iso.refl _)
              (biproduct.whiskerEquiv (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => Iso.refl _)
            ≪≫ biprod.mapIso e₁ e₂
            ≪≫ (HodgeStructCat.prodIsoBiprod
                  (HodgeStructCat.of ↥N.toSubmodule (X.str.sub N))
                  (HodgeStructCat.of ↥(P.orthoComplement N).toSubmodule
                    (X.str.sub (P.orthoComplement N)))).symm
            ≪≫ P.splitIso' N
      · 
        have htriv : ∀ N : SubHodge X.str,
            N.toSubmodule = ⊥ ∨ N.toSubmodule = ⊤ := by
          intro N
          by_cases hb : N.toSubmodule = ⊥
          · exact Or.inl hb
          · exact Or.inr (by_contra fun ht => hex ⟨N, hb, ht⟩)
        have hsimple : Simple X :=
          HodgeStructCat.simple_of_subHodge_trivial hnt htriv
        exact ⟨1, fun _ => X, fun _ => hsimple,
          ⟨biproductUniqueIso (fun _ : Fin 1 => X)⟩⟩
    · 
      refine ⟨0, Fin.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, ⟨?_⟩⟩
      exact (CategoryTheory.Limits.isZero_biproduct_of_isEmpty _).iso
        (HodgeStructCat.isZero_of_subsingleton
          (not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hnt))

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.exists_simple_biproduct_decomposition
statement:
theorem Polarization.exists_simple_biproduct_decomposition
    {X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (P : Polarization X.str) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (S : Fin k → HodgeStructCat.{u} n),
      (∀ i, Simple (S i)) ∧ Nonempty ((⨁ S) ≅ X)
proof:
:=
  Polarization.exists_simple_biproduct_decomposition_of_finrank
    (Module.finrank ℚ X.carrier) X P rfl

name: HodgePilot.JunctionEvaluation.isHodgeClassProper_bettiEdge_zsmul_of_junctionEvaluation
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassProper_bettiEdge_zsmul_of_junctionEvaluation
    (heval : PredicateAcceptance.DinfJunctionEvaluation) (k : ℤ) :
    IsHodgeClassProper ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 1
      (k • PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace ∈
      dRSpaceFiltrationC ProjectiveLine.structMor ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        ((2 * 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    AcceptanceReceipts.dinfSpaceFiltration
  show analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1)
      (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
        (k • PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)) ∈ _
  refine AddSubgroup.mem_map.mpr
    ⟨k • PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace, zsmul_mem hmem k, ?_⟩
  refine (map_zsmul (deRhamJunction (cRingHom ProjectiveLine.structMor)
      (sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor)
      (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ ProjectiveLine.structMor 1)
      (formsInputProper ProjectiveLine.structMor 1) ((2 * 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) k
      PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t => k • t) heval).trans ?_
  refine (map_zsmul (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1))
      k (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
        PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1))
    (map_zsmul (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor))
      (2 * 1)) k PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass).symm

name: HodgePilot.matrixCoeff_emptyWord
statement:
theorem matrixCoeff_emptyWord
    (g : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj ((0, 0) : WordCat V)))
    (w : (wordFiber V).obj ((0, 0) : WordCat V)) :
    matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) ((0, 0) : WordCat V) (g ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) =
      g w • mtUnit V
proof:
:= by
  have hbd : wordUnitBasis V default = wordUnitVec V :=
    (wordMulData V).unitBasis_default
  have hbc : ∀ x, (wordUnitBasis V).coord default x = wordUnitFunc V x :=
    (wordMulData V).unitBasis_coord
  have hfv : wordUnitFunc V (wordUnitVec V) = 1 :=
    (wordMulData V).unitFunc_unitVec
  
  have hw : wordUnitFunc V w • wordUnitVec V = w := by
    have h := (wordUnitBasis V).sum_repr w
    rwa [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, ← Basis.coord_apply, hbc,
      hbd] at h
  
  have hg : g = g (wordUnitVec V) • wordUnitFunc V := by
    refine Basis.ext (wordUnitBasis V) fun i => ?_
    have hi : wordUnitBasis V i = wordUnitVec V := by
      rw [show i = default from Subsingleton.elim i default, hbd]
    rw [hi, LinearMap.smul_apply, hfv, smul_eq_mul, _root_.mul_one]
  have hone : matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) ((0, 0) : WordCat V)
      (wordUnitFunc V ⊗ₜ[ℚ] wordUnitVec V) = mtUnit V := rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [hg, ← hw]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul,
    hone, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  conv_rhs => rw [← hw]
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.matrixCoeff_unitWord
statement:
theorem matrixCoeff_unitWord (p : WordCat unitHodgeObj)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber unitHodgeObj).obj p))
    (v : (wordFiber unitHodgeObj).obj p) :
    matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = f v • mtUnit unitHodgeObj
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  have hcomp : (f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      (unitWordIso p).hom.toLinearMap = f :=
    LinearMap.ext fun x =>
      congrArg f (HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_apply (unitWordIso p) x)
  have key := matrixCoeff_word_naturality unitHodgeObj (unitWordIso p).hom
    (f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap) v
  have hempty : matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) ((0, 0) : WordCat unitHodgeObj)
      ((f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
        (unitWordIso p).hom.toLinearMap v) =
      (f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap)
        ((unitWordIso p).hom.toLinearMap v) • mtUnit unitHodgeObj :=
    matrixCoeff_emptyWord unitHodgeObj _ _
  have hval : (f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap)
      ((unitWordIso p).hom.toLinearMap v) = f v :=
    congrArg f (HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_apply (unitWordIso p) v)
  have h1 : matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) p
      (((f ∘ₗ (unitWordIso p).inv.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
        (unitWordIso p).hom.toLinearMap) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) =
      matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) :=
    congrArg (fun g : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber unitHodgeObj).obj p) =>
      matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) p (g ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)) hcomp
  exact h1.symm.trans (key.trans (hempty.trans
    (congrArg (fun c : ℚ => c • mtUnit unitHodgeObj) hval)))

name: HodgePilot.unit_counit_smul_one
statement:
theorem unit_counit_smul_one (x : mtCoalgebra unitHodgeObj) :
    coeffCounit (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) x • (1 : mtCoalgebra unitHodgeObj) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℚ (mtCoalgebra unitHodgeObj) 1 ∘ₗ
      coeffCounit (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
    intro p
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro f v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    rw [coeffCounit_matrixCoeff]
    have hcol : matrixCoeff (wordFiber unitHodgeObj) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) =
        f v • mtUnit unitHodgeObj := matrixCoeff_unitWord p f v
    rw [hcol, mtCoalgebra_one_def]
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using hx

name: HodgePilot.algHom_laurent_T_zpow
statement:
theorem algHom_laurent_T_zpow (φ : LaurentPolynomial R →ₐ[R] B) (n : ℤ) :
    φ (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = ((laurentUnit φ) ^ n).val
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, map_one, zpow_zero, Units.val_one]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_add, map_mul, ih, zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul]
      rfl
  | pred k ih =>
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_sub, map_mul, ih, zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul]
      rfl

proof:
:= by
  have hu : laurentUnit φ = laurentUnit ψ := Units.ext h
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.algHom_ext fun n => by
    show φ (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = ψ (LaurentPolynomial.T n)
    rw [algHom_laurent_T_zpow, algHom_laurent_T_zpow, hu]

proof:

    (godementPresheaf F)).mpr
    (TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_of_iso (godementCompForgetIso F)
      (TopCat.Presheaf.toTypes_isSheaf X _))

theorem toGodementSheaf_app_injective (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)

proof:

statement:
theorem godementEmbedFlasque (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :
    ∃ (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) (m : F ⟶ G),
      Mono m ∧ G.IsFlasque
proof:
:=
  ⟨godementSheaf F, toGodementSheaf F, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: HodgePilot.FlasqueEmbed.isFlasque_of_retract
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun {U V} i => ?_⟩
  refine (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr fun s => ?_
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective (G.1.map i)).mp inferInstance
      (ι.hom.app V s)
  refine ⟨r.hom.app U t, ?_⟩
  have hnat : F.1.map i (r.hom.app U t) = r.hom.app V (G.1.map i t) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      r.hom.naturality]
  rw [hnat, ht]
  calc r.hom.app V (ι.hom.app V s)
      = (ι ≫ r).hom.app V s := (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ s).symm
    _ = (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).hom.app V s := by rw [hri]
    _ = s := rfl

name: HodgePilot.FlasqueEmbed.isFlasque_of_injective_of_monoIntoFlasque

    [Mono m] [G.IsFlasque] : I.IsFlasque
proof:
:=
  isFlasque_of_retract m (Injective.factorThru (𝟙 I) m)
    (Injective.comp_factorThru _ _)

name: HodgePilot.FlasqueEmbed.isFlasque_sheafPullback

name: HodgePilot.lof_cast_eq
statement:
theorem lof_cast_eq {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {N : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (N i)] [∀ i, Module R (N i)]
    {i j : ι} (h : i = j) {x : N i} {y : N j} (hxy : HEq x y) :
    DirectSum.lof R ι N i x = DirectSum.lof R ι N j y
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eq_of_heq hxy]

name: HodgePilot.heq_tmul_right
statement:
theorem heq_tmul_right {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℚ A]
    {C : ℤ → Type u} [∀ m, AddCommGroup (C m)] [∀ m, Module ℚ (C m)]
    {m m' : ℤ} (h : m = m') (a : A) {b : C m} {b' : C m'} (hb : HEq b b') :
    HEq (a ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b) (a ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eq_of_heq hb]

name: HodgePilot.heq_tmul_left
statement:
theorem heq_tmul_left {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℚ A]
    {C : ℤ → Type u} [∀ m, AddCommGroup (C m)] [∀ m, Module ℚ (C m)]
    {m m' : ℤ} (h : m = m') {b : C m} {b' : C m'} (hb : HEq b b') (a : A) :
    HEq (b ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a) (b' ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eq_of_heq hb]

name: HodgePilot.heq_lof_conv
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  obtain rfl : p = p' := Subtype.ext hp
  rw [eq_of_heq hxy]

name: HodgePilot.heq_lof_conv₂
statement:
theorem heq_lof_conv₂ {D : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → Type u}
    [∀ a b c, AddCommMonoid (D a b c)] [∀ a b c, Module ℚ (D a b c)]
    {v v' c c' : ℤ} (hv : v = v') (hc : c = c')
    {r : ConvIndex v} {r' : ConvIndex v'} (hr : r.val = r'.val)
    {x : D r.val.1 r.val.2 c} {y : D r'.val.1 r'.val.2 c'} (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex v) (fun r => D r.val.1 r.val.2 c) r x)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex v') (fun r => D r.val.1 r.val.2 c') r' y)
proof:
:= by
  subst hv
  subst hc
  obtain rfl : r = r' := Subtype.ext hr
  rw [eq_of_heq hxy]

name: HodgePilot.heq_lof_conv₂'
statement:
theorem heq_lof_conv₂' {D : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → Type u}
    [∀ a b c, AddCommMonoid (D a b c)] [∀ a b c, Module ℚ (D a b c)]
    {a a' v v' : ℤ} (ha : a = a') (hv : v = v')
    {t : ConvIndex v} {t' : ConvIndex v'} (ht : t.val = t'.val)
    {x : D a t.val.1 t.val.2} {y : D a' t'.val.1 t'.val.2} (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex v) (fun t => D a t.val.1 t.val.2) t x)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex v') (fun t => D a' t.val.1 t.val.2) t' y)
proof:
:= by
  subst ha
  subst hv
  obtain rfl : t = t' := Subtype.ext ht
  rw [eq_of_heq hxy]

name: HodgePilot.lof_bijective_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem lof_bijective_of_subsingleton {N : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (N i)] [∀ i, Module ℚ (N i)] (i₀ : ι)
    (hsub : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → Subsingleton (N i)) :
    Function.Bijective (DirectSum.lof ℚ ι N i₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨lof_injective i₀, ?_⟩
  intro x
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | of j m =>
      by_cases hj : j = i₀
      · subst hj
        exact ⟨m, (DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ ι N j m).symm ▸ rfl⟩
      · haveI := hsub j hj
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        rw [map_zero, Subsingleton.elim m 0, map_zero]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨va, hva⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨vb, hvb⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨va + vb, by rw [map_add, hva, hvb]⟩

name: HodgePilot.lequivOfComponents_lof
statement:
theorem lequivOfComponents_lof {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    {β₁ β₂ : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (β₁ i)] [∀ i, Module R (β₁ i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (β₂ i)] [∀ i, Module R (β₂ i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, β₁ i ≃ₗ[R] β₂ i) (i : ι) (x : β₁ i) :
    lequivOfComponents φ (DirectSum.lof R ι β₁ i x) =
      DirectSum.lof R ι β₂ i (φ i x)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.lmap (fun i => (φ i).toLinearMap)
    (DirectSum.lof R ι β₁ i x) = _
  rw [DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_lof_eq
statement:
theorem baseChange_lof_eq (i : ι) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) :
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ι M i).baseChange ℂ x =
      (directSumBaseChange M).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c m => rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.directSumBaseChange_baseChange_lmap
statement:
theorem directSumBaseChange_baseChange_lmap (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[ℚ] M' i)
    (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ⨁ i, M i) :
    directSumBaseChange M' ((DirectSum.lmap φ).baseChange ℂ x) =
      DirectSum.lmap (fun i => (φ i).baseChange ℂ) (directSumBaseChange M x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
      | of j m =>
          rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
            DirectSum.lmap_lof, directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof,
            directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof, DirectSum.lmap_lof,
            LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
      | add v w hv hw =>
          rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hw,
            map_add]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.convCarrier_support_finite
statement:
theorem convCarrier_support_finite (n : ℤ) :
    {p : ConvIndex n | ¬ Subsingleton (convCarrier X Y n p)}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hXY : ({a : ℤ | ¬ Subsingleton (X.component a).carrier} ×ˢ
      {b : ℤ | ¬ Subsingleton (Y.component b).carrier}).Finite :=
    X.finite_support.prod Y.finite_support
  refine (hXY.preimage
    (Set.injOn_of_injective Subtype.val_injective)).subset ?_
  intro p hp
  refine Set.mem_preimage.mpr (Set.mem_prod.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · intro hs
    exact hp (by haveI := hs; infer_instance)
  · intro hs
    exact hp (by haveI := hs; infer_instance)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.convStrTotal_H
statement:
theorem convStrTotal_H (n : ℤ) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (convStrTotal X Y n).H pq =
      (directSumPiece (fun p => (convStr X Y n p).H) pq).map
        (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y n)).symm.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensorObj_finite_support
statement:
theorem tensorObj_finite_support :
    {n : ℤ | ¬ Subsingleton (⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p)}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_conv_support X.finite_support Y.finite_support).subset ?_
  intro n hn
  by_contra hcon
  refine hn ?_
  haveI : ∀ p : ConvIndex n, Subsingleton (convCarrier X Y n p) := by
    intro p
    rcases not_and_or.mp
        (fun h : ¬ Subsingleton (X.component p.val.1).carrier ∧
            ¬ Subsingleton (Y.component (n - p.val.1)).carrier =>
          hcon ⟨p.val.1, h.1, h.2⟩) with h | h
    · haveI : Subsingleton (X.component p.val.1).carrier := not_not.mp h
      infer_instance
    · haveI : Subsingleton (Y.component (n - p.val.1)).carrier := not_not.mp h
      have h2 : p.val.2 = n - p.val.1 := by
        have := p.property
        omega
      show Subsingleton
        ((X.component p.val.1).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component p.val.2).carrier)
      rw [h2]
      infer_instance
  exact subsingleton_directSum _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensorObj_component
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_component (n : ℤ) :
    (tensorObj X Y).component n =
      HodgeStructCat.of (⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p)
        (convStrTotal X Y n)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.convHom_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem convHom_toLinearMap (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n) :
    (convHom f g n p).toLinearMap =
      TensorProduct.map (f p.val.1).toLinearMap (g p.val.2).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensorHom_apply_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem tensorHom_apply_toLinearMap (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℤ) :
    (tensorHom f g n).toLinearMap =
      DirectSum.lmap fun p => (convHom f g n p).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensor_id
statement:
theorem tensor_id (X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}) :
    tensorHom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 Y) = 𝟙 (tensorObj X Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  show (DirectSum.lmap fun p => (convHom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 Y) n p).toLinearMap) =
    LinearMap.id
  have h : (fun p : ConvIndex n => (convHom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 Y) n p).toLinearMap) =
      fun p : ConvIndex n => LinearMap.id (M := convCarrier X Y n p) := by
    funext p
    rw [convHom_toLinearMap,
      show ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) p.val.1).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id from rfl,
      show ((𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y) p.val.2).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id from rfl,
      TensorProduct.map_id]
  rw [h, DirectSum.lmap_id]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensor_comp
statement:
theorem tensor_comp (f : X ⟶ X') (f' : X' ⟶ X'') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (g' : Y' ⟶ Y'') :
    tensorHom (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g') = tensorHom f g ≫ tensorHom f' g'
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  show (DirectSum.lmap fun p => (convHom (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g') n p).toLinearMap) =
    (DirectSum.lmap fun p => (convHom f' g' n p).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      (DirectSum.lmap fun p => (convHom f g n p).toLinearMap)
  rw [← DirectSum.lmap_comp]
  congr 1
  funext p
  rw [convHom_toLinearMap, convHom_toLinearMap, convHom_toLinearMap,
    show ((f ≫ f') p.val.1).toLinearMap =
      (f' p.val.1).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (f p.val.1).toLinearMap from rfl,
    show ((g ≫ g') p.val.2).toLinearMap =
      (g' p.val.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (g p.val.2).toLinearMap from rfl,
    TensorProduct.map_comp]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.unitη_bijective
statement: theorem unitη_bijective : Function.Bijective unitη.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h := HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective
    (eqToIso (singleObj_component_self (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit)).symm)
  rwa [eqToIso.hom] at h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.unit_component_subsingleton
statement:
theorem unit_component_subsingleton {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Subsingleton (unitObj.component m).carrier
proof:
:= by
  show Subsingleton
    (((singleObj 0 (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit)).component m).carrier)
  rw [singleObj_component_of_ne _ hm]
  exact inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton PUnit)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.one_tmul_unitGen_mem
statement:
theorem one_tmul_unitGen_mem :
    (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] unitGen ∈ (unitObj.component 0).str.H (0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)) ∈ hodgeUnit.H ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) := by
    rw [hodgeUnit_H, if_pos rfl]
    trivial
  have h2 := unitη.maps_pieces ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h1)
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensorHom_apply_lof
statement:
theorem tensorHom_apply_lof (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n)
    (v : convCarrier X Y n p) :
    (tensorHom f g n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X' Y' n) p
        ((convHom f g n p).toLinearMap v)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.lmap (fun p => (convHom f g n p).toLinearMap)
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v) = _
  rw [DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.convCarrier_unit_left_subsingleton
statement:
theorem convCarrier_unit_left_subsingleton {n : ℤ} (p : ConvIndex n)
    (hp : p ≠ leftUnitIdx n) : Subsingleton (convCarrier unitObj X n p)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : p.val.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine hp (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h0 ?_))
    show p.val.2 = n
    have := p.property
    omega
  haveI := unit_component_subsingleton h0
  infer_instance

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitorInvLin_apply
statement:
theorem leftUnitorInvLin_apply (n : ℤ) (v : (X.component n).carrier) :
    leftUnitorInvLin X n v =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier unitObj X n) (leftUnitIdx n)
        (unitGen ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitorInvLin_baseChange
statement:
theorem leftUnitorInvLin_baseChange (n : ℤ)
    (h : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (X.component n).carrier) :
    (leftUnitorInvLin X n).baseChange ℂ h =
      (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier unitObj X n)).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier unitObj X n p) (leftUnitIdx n)
          (tensorEquiv (unitObj.component 0).carrier (X.component n).carrier
            (((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] unitGen) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] h)))
proof:
:= by
  induction h using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | tmul c v =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, leftUnitorInvLin_apply, tensorEquiv_tmul,
        directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul, mul_one]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      rw [map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitorInvLin_bijective
statement:
theorem leftUnitorInvLin_bijective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (leftUnitorInvLin X n)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Function.Bijective (TensorProduct.map unitη.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.id (M := (X.component n).carrier))) :=
    (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.ofBijective unitη.toLinearMap unitη_bijective)
      (LinearEquiv.refl ℚ (X.component n).carrier)).bijective
  have h3 : Function.Bijective (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (convCarrier unitObj X n) (leftUnitIdx n)) :=
    lof_bijective_of_subsingleton _
      (fun p hp => convCarrier_unit_left_subsingleton X p hp)
  have hcoe : ⇑(leftUnitorInvLin X n) =
      ⇑(DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier unitObj X n) (leftUnitIdx n)) ∘
        (⇑(TensorProduct.map unitη.toLinearMap
            (LinearMap.id (M := (X.component n).carrier))) ∘
          ⇑(TensorProduct.lid ℚ (X.component n).carrier).symm) :=
    funext fun v => rfl
  rw [hcoe]
  exact h3.comp (h2.comp
    (TensorProduct.lid ℚ (X.component n).carrier).symm.bijective)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitor_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv : (leftUnitor X).inv = leftUnitorInv X
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.convCarrier_unit_right_subsingleton
statement:
theorem convCarrier_unit_right_subsingleton {n : ℤ} (p : ConvIndex n)
    (hp : p ≠ rightUnitIdx n) : Subsingleton (convCarrier X unitObj n p)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : p.val.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine hp (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ?_ h0))
    show p.val.1 = n
    have := p.property
    omega
  haveI := unit_component_subsingleton h0
  infer_instance

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitorInvLin_apply
statement:
theorem rightUnitorInvLin_apply (n : ℤ) (v : (X.component n).carrier) :
    rightUnitorInvLin X n v =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X unitObj n) (rightUnitIdx n)
        (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] unitGen)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitorInvLin_baseChange
statement:
theorem rightUnitorInvLin_baseChange (n : ℤ)
    (h : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (X.component n).carrier) :
    (rightUnitorInvLin X n).baseChange ℂ h =
      (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X unitObj n)).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X unitObj n p) (rightUnitIdx n)
          (tensorEquiv (X.component n).carrier (unitObj.component 0).carrier
            (h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] unitGen))))
proof:
:= by
  induction h using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  | tmul c v =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, rightUnitorInvLin_apply, tensorEquiv_tmul,
        directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul, one_mul]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      rw [map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitorInvLin_bijective
statement:
theorem rightUnitorInvLin_bijective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (rightUnitorInvLin X n)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Function.Bijective (TensorProduct.map
      (LinearMap.id (M := (X.component n).carrier)) unitη.toLinearMap) :=
    (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℚ (X.component n).carrier)
      (LinearEquiv.ofBijective unitη.toLinearMap unitη_bijective)).bijective
  have h3 : Function.Bijective (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (convCarrier X unitObj n) (rightUnitIdx n)) :=
    lof_bijective_of_subsingleton _
      (fun p hp => convCarrier_unit_right_subsingleton X p hp)
  have hcoe : ⇑(rightUnitorInvLin X n) =
      ⇑(DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X unitObj n) (rightUnitIdx n)) ∘
        (⇑(TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (M := (X.component n).carrier))
            unitη.toLinearMap) ∘
          ⇑(TensorProduct.rid ℚ (X.component n).carrier).symm) :=
    funext fun v => rfl
  rw [hcoe]
  exact h3.comp (h2.comp
    (TensorProduct.rid ℚ (X.component n).carrier).symm.bijective)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitor_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv : (rightUnitor X).inv = rightUnitorInv X
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitorInv_naturality
statement:
theorem leftUnitorInv_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f ≫ leftUnitorInv Y = leftUnitorInv X ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 unitObj) f
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
  show leftUnitorInvLin Y n ((f n).toLinearMap v) =
    DirectSum.lmap (fun p => (convHom (𝟙 unitObj) f n p).toLinearMap)
      (leftUnitorInvLin X n v)
  rw [leftUnitorInvLin_apply, leftUnitorInvLin_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitorInv_naturality
statement:
theorem rightUnitorInv_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f ≫ rightUnitorInv Y = rightUnitorInv X ≫ tensorHom f (𝟙 unitObj)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
  show rightUnitorInvLin Y n ((f n).toLinearMap v) =
    DirectSum.lmap (fun p => (convHom f (𝟙 unitObj) n p).toLinearMap)
      (rightUnitorInvLin X n v)
  rw [rightUnitorInvLin_apply, rightUnitorInvLin_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.leftUnitor_naturality
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    tensorHom (𝟙 unitObj) f ≫ (leftUnitor Y).hom = (leftUnitor X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (leftUnitor X).inv, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  have h : (leftUnitor X).inv ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 unitObj) f =
      f ≫ (leftUnitor Y).inv := by
    rw [leftUnitor_inv, leftUnitor_inv]
    exact (leftUnitorInv_naturality f).symm
  rw [h, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.rightUnitor_naturality
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    tensorHom f (𝟙 unitObj) ≫ (rightUnitor Y).hom = (rightUnitor X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (rightUnitor X).inv, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  have h : (rightUnitor X).inv ≫ tensorHom f (𝟙 unitObj) =
      f ≫ (rightUnitor Y).inv := by
    rw [rightUnitor_inv, rightUnitor_inv]
    exact (rightUnitorInv_naturality f).symm
  rw [h, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocRegroupHom_lof
statement:
theorem assocRegroupHom_lof (n : ℤ) (q : ConvIndex n) (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
    (v : assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) :
    assocRegroupHom X Y Z n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun q => ⨁ r : ConvIndex q.val.1,
            assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) q
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
            (fun r => assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) r v)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun s => ⨁ t : ConvIndex s.val.2,
          assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) (assocIdxFst q r)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
          (fun t => assocMid X Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2)
          (assocIdxSnd q r) v)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ConvIndex n) _ _
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (fun q => ⨁ r : ConvIndex q.val.1,
        assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) q
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
        (fun r => assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) r v)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocRegroupInv_lof
statement:
theorem assocRegroupInv_lof (n : ℤ) (s : ConvIndex n) (t : ConvIndex s.val.2)
    (w : assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) :
    assocRegroupInv X Y Z n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun s => ⨁ t : ConvIndex s.val.2,
            assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) s
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2)
            (fun t => assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) t w)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun q => ⨁ r : ConvIndex q.val.1,
          assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) (assocIdxFstInv s t)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1)
          (fun r => assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.2)
          (assocIdxSndInv s t) w)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ConvIndex n) _ _
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (fun s => ⨁ t : ConvIndex s.val.2,
        assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) s
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2)
        (fun t => assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) t w)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocRegroupInv_comp_assocRegroupHom
statement:
theorem assocRegroupInv_comp_assocRegroupHom (n : ℤ) :
    (assocRegroupInv X Y Z n) ∘ₗ (assocRegroupHom X Y Z n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun q => ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun r => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  show assocRegroupInv X Y Z n (assocRegroupHom X Y Z n
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun q => ⨁ r : ConvIndex q.val.1,
          assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) q
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
          (fun r => assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) r v))) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (fun q => ⨁ r : ConvIndex q.val.1,
        assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) q
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
        (fun r => assocMid X Y Z r.val.1 r.val.2 q.val.2) r v)
  rw [assocRegroupHom_lof, assocRegroupInv_lof]
  refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
  · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext r.property rfl)
  · exact heq_lof_conv₂ (D := assocMid X Y Z) r.property rfl rfl HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocRegroupHom_comp_assocRegroupInv
statement:
theorem assocRegroupHom_comp_assocRegroupInv (n : ℤ) :
    (assocRegroupHom X Y Z n) ∘ₗ (assocRegroupInv X Y Z n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun s => ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun t => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  show assocRegroupHom X Y Z n (assocRegroupInv X Y Z n
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun s => ⨁ t : ConvIndex s.val.2,
          assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) s
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2)
          (fun t => assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) t w))) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
      (fun s => ⨁ t : ConvIndex s.val.2,
        assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) s
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2)
        (fun t => assocMid X Y Z s.val.1 t.val.1 t.val.2) t w)
  rw [assocRegroupInv_lof, assocRegroupHom_lof]
  refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
  · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl t.property)
  · exact heq_lof_conv₂' (D := assocMid X Y Z) rfl t.property rfl HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocCarrierEquiv_lof
statement:
theorem assocCarrierEquiv_lof (n : ℤ) (q : ConvIndex n) (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
    (x : (X.component r.val.1).carrier) (y : (Y.component r.val.2).carrier)
    (z : (Z.component q.val.2).carrier) :
    assocCarrierEquiv X Y Z n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n)
        (assocIdxFst q r)
        (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
          (convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2) (assocIdxSnd q r)
          (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocCarrierEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    lequivOfComponents_lof, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    TensorProduct.directSumLeft_tmul_lof, lequivOfComponents_lof,
    TensorProduct.assoc_tmul, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_apply, assocRegroupHom_lof,
    lequivOfComponents_lof, TensorProduct.directSumRight_symm_lof_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assoc_baseChange_generator
statement:
theorem assoc_baseChange_generator (n : ℤ) (q : ConvIndex n)
    (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
    (a : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (X.component r.val.1).carrier)
    (b : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component r.val.2).carrier)
    (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Z.component q.val.2).carrier) :
    (assocCarrierEquiv X Y Z n).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        ((directSumBaseChange (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n)).symm
          (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
