            (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n p) q
            (tensorEquiv ((tensorObj X Y).component q.val.1).carrier
              (Z.component q.val.2).carrier
              (((directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y q.val.1)).symm
                (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
                  (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X Y q.val.1 p) r
                  (tensorEquiv (X.component r.val.1).carrier
                    (Y.component r.val.2).carrier (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)))) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)))) =
      (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n)).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n p) (assocIdxFst q r)
          (tensorEquiv (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).carrier
            ((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).carrier
            (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
              ((directSumBaseChange
                  (convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)).symm
                (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
                  (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2 p)
                  (assocIdxSnd q r)
                  (tensorEquiv (Y.component r.val.2).carrier
                    (Z.component q.val.2).carrier (b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)))))))
proof:
:= by
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
      rw [h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c₁ x =>
      induction b using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
      | add b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
          rw [h₁, h₂]
      | tmul c₂ y =>
          induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
          | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
          | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ =>
              simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
              rw [h₁, h₂]
          | tmul c₃ w =>
              simp only [tensorEquiv_tmul, directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul,
                LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
              rw [assocCarrierEquiv_lof, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.assocCarrierEquiv_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem assocCarrierEquiv_maps_pieces (n : ℤ) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ((convStrTotal (tensorObj X Y) Z n).H pq).map
        ((assocCarrierEquiv X Y Z n).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ)
      ≤ (convStrTotal X (tensorObj Y Z) n).H pq
proof:
:= by
  rw [convStrTotal_H (tensorObj X Y) Z n pq, directSumPiece_def]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
  refine iSup_le fun q => ?_
  rw [show (convStr (tensorObj X Y) Z n q).H pq =
      tensorPiece ((tensorObj X Y).component q.val.1).str
        (Z.component q.val.2).str pq from rfl,
    tensorPiece_def]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
  refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨w1, hw1, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw
  obtain ⟨w2, hw2, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw1
  obtain ⟨w3, hw3, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw2
  obtain ⟨w4, hw4, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw3
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hw4
  clear hw hw1 hw2 hw3 hw4
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | tmul s z =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      have hkey : (((tensorObj X Y).component q.val.1).str.H x.1) ≤
          Submodule.comap
            (((assocCarrierEquiv X Y Z n).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ∘ₗ
              (directSumBaseChange
                (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
              (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
                (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n p) q) ∘ₗ
              (tensorEquiv ((tensorObj X Y).component q.val.1).carrier
                (Z.component q.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
              ((TensorProduct.mk ℂ
                (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ((tensorObj X Y).component q.val.1).carrier)
                (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Z.component q.val.2).carrier)).flip
                (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Z.component q.val.2).carrier)))
            ((convStrTotal X (tensorObj Y Z) n).H pq) := by
        show ((directSumPiece (fun r => (convStr X Y q.val.1 r).H) x.1).map
          (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y q.val.1)).symm.toLinearMap) ≤ _
        rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, directSumPiece_def]
        refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
        rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        rw [show (convStr X Y q.val.1 r).H x.1 =
            tensorPiece (X.component r.val.1).str (Y.component r.val.2).str x.1
          from rfl, tensorPiece_def]
        refine iSup₂_le fun x' hx' => ?_
        rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        intro w' hw'
        obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hw'
        clear hw'
        induction u' using TensorProduct.induction_on with
        | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
            simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
        | tmul a b =>
            simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
              Submodule.coe_subtype]
            simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.comp_apply,
              LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.flip_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
            rw [assoc_baseChange_generator X Y Z n q r]
            rw [convStrTotal_H X (tensorObj Y Z) n pq]
            refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
            rw [directSumPiece_def]
            refine (le_iSup (fun p => ((convStr X (tensorObj Y Z) n p).H pq).map
                (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
                  (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n p) p))
              (assocIdxFst q r)) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_)
            have hw2' : (directSumBaseChange
                  (convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)).symm
                (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
                  (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2 p)
                  (assocIdxSnd q r)
                  (tensorEquiv (Y.component r.val.2).carrier
                    (Z.component q.val.2).carrier
                    ((b : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component r.val.2).carrier) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
                      (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (Z.component q.val.2).carrier)))) ∈
                ((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str.H
                  (x'.2 + x.2) := by
              show _ ∈ (convStrTotal Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).H (x'.2 + x.2)
              rw [convStrTotal_H Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2 (x'.2 + x.2)]
              refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
              rw [directSumPiece_def]
              refine (le_iSup (fun t =>
                  ((convStr Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2 t).H (x'.2 + x.2)).map
                    (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
                      (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ]
                        convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2 p) t))
                (assocIdxSnd q r)) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_)
              show tensorEquiv (Y.component r.val.2).carrier
                  (Z.component q.val.2).carrier _ ∈
                tensorPiece (Y.component r.val.2).str (Z.component q.val.2).str
                  (x'.2 + x.2)
              have hle3 : (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
                    ((Y.component r.val.2).str.H x'.2)
                    ((Z.component q.val.2).str.H x.2))).map
                  (tensorEquiv (Y.component r.val.2).carrier
                    (Z.component q.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap ≤
                  tensorPiece (Y.component r.val.2).str (Z.component q.val.2).str
                    (x'.2 + x.2) :=
                le_iSup₂ (f := fun (yy : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
                    (_ : yy.1 + yy.2 = x'.2 + x.2) =>
                  (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
                    ((Y.component r.val.2).str.H yy.1)
                    ((Z.component q.val.2).str.H yy.2))).map
                    (tensorEquiv (Y.component r.val.2).carrier
                      (Z.component q.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap)
                  ((x'.2, x.2)) rfl
              exact hle3 (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
                ⟨b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z, rfl⟩))
            show tensorEquiv (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).carrier
                ((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).carrier _ ∈
              tensorPiece (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).str
                ((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str pq
            have hle' : (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
                  ((X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).str.H x'.1)
                  (((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str.H
                    (x'.2 + x.2)))).map
                (tensorEquiv (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).carrier
                  ((tensorObj Y Z).component
                    (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).carrier).toLinearMap ≤
                tensorPiece (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).str
                  ((tensorObj Y Z).component (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str pq :=
              le_iSup₂ (f := fun (yy : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : yy.1 + yy.2 = pq) =>
                (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
                  ((X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).str.H yy.1)
                  (((tensorObj Y Z).component
                    (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str.H yy.2))).map
                  (tensorEquiv (X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).carrier
                    ((tensorObj Y Z).component
                      (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).carrier).toLinearMap)
                ((x'.1, x'.2 + x.2)) (by
                  have e1 : x'.1.1 + x'.2.1 = x.1.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hx'
                  have e2 : x'.1.2 + x'.2.2 = x.1.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hx'
                  have e3 : x.1.1 + x.2.1 = pq.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hx
                  have e4 : x.1.2 + x.2.2 = pq.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hx
                  exact Prod.ext
                    (by show x'.1.1 + (x'.2.1 + x.2.1) = pq.1; omega)
                    (by show x'.1.2 + (x'.2.2 + x.2.2) = pq.2; omega))
            exact hle' (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
              ⟨(⟨(a : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (X.component r.val.1).carrier), a.2⟩ :
                  ((X.component (assocIdxFst q r).val.1).str.H x'.1)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
                (⟨_, hw2'⟩ : (((tensorObj Y Z).component
                  (assocIdxFst q r).val.2).str.H (x'.2 + x.2))), rfl⟩))
      have hmem := hkey s.2
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at hmem
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
        TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using hmem

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.associatorHom_bijective
statement:
theorem associatorHom_bijective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective ((associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap)
proof:
:=
  (assocCarrierEquiv X Y Z n).bijective

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom :
    (associator X Y Z).hom = associatorHom X Y Z
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.associatorHom_apply
statement:
theorem associatorHom_apply (n : ℤ) (q : ConvIndex n) (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
    (x : (X.component r.val.1).carrier) (y : (Y.component r.val.2).carrier)
    (z : (Z.component q.val.2).carrier) :
    (associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n)
        (assocIdxFst q r)
        (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFst q r).val.2)
          (convCarrier Y Z (assocIdxFst q r).val.2) (assocIdxSnd q r)
          (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
proof:
:=
  assocCarrierEquiv_lof X Y Z n q r x y z

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensor_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_ext {n : ℤ} {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T]
    {F G : (⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) →ₗ[ℚ] T}
    (h : ∀ (p : ConvIndex n) (x : (X.component p.val.1).carrier)
      (y : (Y.component p.val.2).carrier),
      F (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) =
        G (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun p => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => ?_
  exact h p x y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensor_left_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_left_ext {n : ℤ} {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T]
    {F G : (⨁ q : ConvIndex n, convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n q) →ₗ[ℚ] T}
    (h : ∀ (q : ConvIndex n) (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
      (x : (X.component r.val.1).carrier) (y : (Y.component r.val.2).carrier)
      (z : (Z.component q.val.2).carrier),
      F (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) =
        G (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun q => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun r => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
  exact h q r x y z

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensor_left_left_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_left_left_ext {n : ℤ} {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T]
    {F G : (⨁ q : ConvIndex n,
      convCarrier (tensorObj (tensorObj W X) Y) Z n q) →ₗ[ℚ] T}
    (h : ∀ (q : ConvIndex n) (r : ConvIndex q.val.1)
      (p : ConvIndex r.val.1)
      (w : (W.component p.val.1).carrier) (x : (X.component p.val.2).carrier)
      (y : (Y.component r.val.2).carrier) (z : (Z.component q.val.2).carrier),
      F (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
          (convCarrier (tensorObj (tensorObj W X) Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
            (convCarrier (tensorObj W X) Y q.val.1) r
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex r.val.1)
              (convCarrier W X r.val.1) p (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) =
        G (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
          (convCarrier (tensorObj (tensorObj W X) Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
            (convCarrier (tensorObj W X) Y q.val.1) r
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex r.val.1)
              (convCarrier W X r.val.1) p (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun q => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun r => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun p => ?_
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun w x => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
  exact h q r p w x y z

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℤ)
    (p : ConvIndex n) (x : (X.component p.val.1).carrier)
    (y : (Y.component p.val.2).carrier) :
    (tensorHom f g n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X' Y' n) p
        ((f p.val.1).toLinearMap x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (g p.val.2).toLinearMap y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.associator_naturality
statement:
theorem associator_naturality (f₁ : X ⟶ X') (f₂ : Y ⟶ Y') (f₃ : Z ⟶ Z') :
    tensorHom (tensorHom f₁ f₂) f₃ ≫ associatorHom X' Y' Z' =
      associatorHom X Y Z ≫ tensorHom f₁ (tensorHom f₂ f₃)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_left_ext X Y Z (fun q r x y z => ?_)
  show (associatorHom X' Y' Z' n).toLinearMap
      ((tensorHom (tensorHom f₁ f₂) f₃ n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) =
    (tensorHom f₁ (tensorHom f₂ f₃) n).toLinearMap
      ((associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
            (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, associatorHom_apply,
    associatorHom_apply, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.pentagon_aux
statement:
theorem pentagon_aux (W X Y Z : HodgeFamily.{u}) :
    tensorHom (associatorHom W X Y) (𝟙 Z) ≫
        associatorHom W (tensorObj X Y) Z ≫
          tensorHom (𝟙 W) (associatorHom X Y Z) =
      associatorHom (tensorObj W X) Y Z ≫
        associatorHom W X (tensorObj Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_left_left_ext X Y Z W (fun q r p w x y z => ?_)
  show (tensorHom (𝟙 W) (associatorHom X Y Z) n).toLinearMap
      ((associatorHom W (tensorObj X Y) Z n).toLinearMap
        ((tensorHom (associatorHom W X Y) (𝟙 Z) n).toLinearMap
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
            (convCarrier (tensorObj (tensorObj W X) Y) Z n) q
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
              (convCarrier (tensorObj W X) Y q.val.1) r
              ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex r.val.1)
                (convCarrier W X r.val.1) p (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))) =
    (associatorHom W X (tensorObj Y Z) n).toLinearMap
      ((associatorHom (tensorObj W X) Y Z n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
          (convCarrier (tensorObj (tensorObj W X) Y) Z n) q
          ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1)
            (convCarrier (tensorObj W X) Y q.val.1) r
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex r.val.1)
              (convCarrier W X r.val.1) p (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, associatorHom_apply, associatorHom_apply,
    associatorHom_apply, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, associatorHom_apply,
    associatorHom_apply]
  refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
  · refine Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
    show p.val.2 + r.val.2 + q.val.2 = p.val.2 + (r.val.2 + q.val.2)
    omega
  · refine heq_tmul_right
      (C := fun m => ⨁ t : ConvIndex m, convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) m t)
      (show p.val.2 + r.val.2 + q.val.2 = p.val.2 + (r.val.2 + q.val.2) by omega)
      _ ?_
    exact heq_lof_conv (N := convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z))
      (show p.val.2 + r.val.2 + q.val.2 = p.val.2 + (r.val.2 + q.val.2) by omega)
      rfl HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.triangle_aux
statement:
theorem triangle_aux (X Y : HodgeFamily.{0}) :
    tensorHom (rightUnitorInv X) (𝟙 Y) ≫ associatorHom X unitObj Y =
      tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitorInv Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_ext X Y (fun p x y => ?_)
  show (associatorHom X unitObj Y n).toLinearMap
      ((tensorHom (rightUnitorInv X) (𝟙 Y) n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))) =
    (tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitorInv Y) n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul,
    show ((rightUnitorInv X) p.val.1).toLinearMap x =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex p.val.1) (convCarrier X unitObj p.val.1)
        (rightUnitIdx p.val.1) (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] unitGen) from rfl,
    associatorHom_apply,
    show ((leftUnitorInv Y) p.val.2).toLinearMap y =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex p.val.2) (convCarrier unitObj Y p.val.2)
        (leftUnitIdx p.val.2) (unitGen ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) from rfl]
  refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
  · exact Subtype.ext
      (Prod.ext rfl (by show (0 : ℤ) + p.val.2 = p.val.2; omega))
  · refine heq_tmul_right
      (C := fun m => ⨁ t : ConvIndex m, convCarrier unitObj Y m t)
      (show (0 : ℤ) + p.val.2 = p.val.2 by omega) x ?_
    exact heq_lof_conv (N := convCarrier unitObj Y)
      (show (0 : ℤ) + p.val.2 = p.val.2 by omega) rfl HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.triangle_hom
statement:
theorem triangle_hom (X Y : HodgeFamily.{0}) :
    (associator X unitObj Y).hom ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom =
      tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) ≫
      tensorHom (rightUnitor X).inv (𝟙 Y) =
      𝟙 (tensorObj (tensorObj X unitObj) Y) := by
    rw [← tensor_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp, tensor_id]
  have hc2 : tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).inv ≫
      tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom = 𝟙 (tensorObj X Y) := by
    rw [← tensor_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp, tensor_id]
  have hT1 := triangle_aux X Y
  rw [← rightUnitor_inv X, ← leftUnitor_inv Y] at hT1
  calc (associator X unitObj Y).hom ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom
      = (tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) ≫
          tensorHom (rightUnitor X).inv (𝟙 Y)) ≫
          (associator X unitObj Y).hom ≫
            tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom := by
        rw [hc1, Category.id_comp]
    _ = tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) ≫
          (tensorHom (rightUnitor X).inv (𝟙 Y) ≫
            (associator X unitObj Y).hom) ≫
          tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) ≫
          tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).inv ≫
            tensorHom (𝟙 X) (leftUnitor Y).hom := by
        rw [associator_hom, hT1]
    _ = tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) ≫ 𝟙 (tensorObj X Y) := by
        rw [hc2]
    _ = tensorHom (rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) := Category.comp_id _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braidLin_lof
statement:
theorem braidLin_lof (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n) (v : convCarrier X Y n p) :
    braidLin X Y n (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier Y X n) (swapIdx p)
        ((TensorProduct.comm ℚ (X.component p.val.1).carrier
          (Y.component p.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap v)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ConvIndex n) _ _
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braidLin_lof_tmul
statement:
theorem braidLin_lof_tmul (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n)
    (x : (X.component p.val.1).carrier) (y : (Y.component p.val.2).carrier) :
    braidLin X Y n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier Y X n) (swapIdx p)
        (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidLin_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braid_baseChange_lof
statement:
theorem braid_baseChange_lof (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n)
    (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X Y n p) :
    (braidLin X Y n).baseChange ℂ
        ((directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y n)).symm
          (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
            (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X Y n p) p w)) =
      (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier Y X n)).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier Y X n p) (swapIdx p)
          ((TensorProduct.comm ℚ (X.component p.val.1).carrier
            (Y.component p.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c v =>
      rw [directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
        braidLin_lof, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
        directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      simp only [map_add]
      rw [ha, hb]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braidLin_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem braidLin_maps_pieces (n : ℤ) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ((convStrTotal X Y n).H pq).map ((braidLin X Y n).baseChange ℂ) ≤
      (convStrTotal Y X n).H pq
proof:
:= by
  rw [convStrTotal_H X Y n pq, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap,
    Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, directSumPiece_def]
  refine iSup_le fun p => ?_
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hv
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  rw [show (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y n)).symm.toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X Y n p) p u) =
    (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier X Y n)).symm
      (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X Y n p) p u) from rfl,
    braid_baseChange_lof, convStrTotal_H Y X n pq]
  refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [directSumPiece_def]
  refine (le_iSup (fun p' => ((convStr Y X n p').H pq).map
      (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex n)
        (fun p' => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier Y X n p') p')) (swapIdx p))
    (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_)
  show (TensorProduct.comm ℚ (X.component p.val.1).carrier
      (Y.component p.val.2).carrier).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u ∈
    tensorPiece (Y.component p.val.2).str (X.component p.val.1).str pq
  rw [← map_baseChange_comm_tensorPiece (X.component p.val.1).str
    (Y.component p.val.2).str pq]
  exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hu

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul
statement:
theorem braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n)
    (x : (X.component p.val.1).carrier) (y : (Y.component p.val.2).carrier) :
    (braidingHom X Y n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier Y X n) (swapIdx p)
        (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
proof:
:=
  braidLin_lof_tmul X Y n p x y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braid_braid
statement: theorem braid_braid : braidingHom X Y ≫ braidingHom Y X = 𝟙 (tensorObj X Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_ext X Y (fun p x y => ?_)
  show (braidingHom Y X n).toLinearMap ((braidingHom X Y n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)
  rw [braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braiding_hom
statement: @[simp] theorem braiding_hom : (braiding X Y).hom = braidingHom X Y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braiding_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem braiding_inv : (braiding X Y).inv = braidingHom Y X
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braiding_naturality_right
statement:
theorem braiding_naturality_right (X : HodgeFamily.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    tensorHom (𝟙 X) f ≫ braidingHom X Z = braidingHom X Y ≫ tensorHom f (𝟙 X)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_ext X Y (fun p x y => ?_)
  show (braidingHom X Z n).toLinearMap ((tensorHom (𝟙 X) f n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))) =
    (tensorHom f (𝟙 X) n).toLinearMap ((braidingHom X Y n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)))
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul,
    braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.braiding_naturality_left
statement:
theorem braiding_naturality_left (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : HodgeFamily.{u}) :
    tensorHom f (𝟙 Z) ≫ braidingHom Y Z = braidingHom X Z ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 Z) f
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_ext X Z (fun p x z => ?_)
  show (braidingHom Y Z n).toLinearMap ((tensorHom f (𝟙 Z) n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Z n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) =
    (tensorHom (𝟙 Z) f n).toLinearMap ((braidingHom X Z n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Z n) p (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
  rw [tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul,
    braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.hexagon_forward_aux
statement:
theorem hexagon_forward_aux (X Y Z : HodgeFamily.{u}) :
    associatorHom X Y Z ≫ braidingHom X (tensorObj Y Z) ≫ associatorHom Y Z X =
      tensorHom (braidingHom X Y) (𝟙 Z) ≫ associatorHom Y X Z ≫
        tensorHom (𝟙 Y) (braidingHom X Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext ?_
  refine tensor_left_ext X Y Z (fun q r x y z => ?_)
  show (associatorHom Y Z X n).toLinearMap
      ((braidingHom X (tensorObj Y Z) n).toLinearMap
        ((associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
              (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))) =
    (tensorHom (𝟙 Y) (braidingHom X Z) n).toLinearMap
      ((associatorHom Y X Z n).toLinearMap
        ((tensorHom (braidingHom X Y) (𝟙 Z) n).toLinearMap
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n) q
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex q.val.1) (convCarrier X Y q.val.1) r
              (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))))
  rw [associatorHom_apply, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul, associatorHom_apply,
    tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul, associatorHom_apply,
    tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, braidingHom_apply_lof_tmul]
  refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
  · refine Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
    show q.val.2 + r.val.1 = r.val.1 + q.val.2
    omega
  · refine heq_tmul_right
      (C := fun m => ⨁ t : ConvIndex m, convCarrier Z X m t)
      (show q.val.2 + r.val.1 = r.val.1 + q.val.2 by omega) y ?_
    exact heq_lof_conv (N := convCarrier Z X)
      (show q.val.2 + r.val.1 = r.val.1 + q.val.2 by omega) rfl HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mk_single_eq_smul_gen
statement:
theorem mk_single_eq_smul_gen {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s) : DR A B n) = s • gen A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mem_rel_add
statement:
theorem mem_rel_add (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    single (update t i x) 1 + single (update t i y) 1
      - single (update t i (x + y)) 1 ∈ rel A B n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.subset_span ?_
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact Or.inl ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mem_rel_mul
statement:
theorem mem_rel_mul (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    x • single (update t i y) 1 + y • single (update t i x) 1
      - single (update t i (x * y)) 1 ∈ rel A B n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.subset_span ?_
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨t, i, x, y, ?_⟩)
  simp

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mem_rel_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mem_rel_algebraMap (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (a : A) :
    single (update t i (algebraMap A B a)) 1 ∈ rel A B n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.subset_span ?_
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mem_rel_alternate
statement:
theorem mem_rel_alternate {t : Fin n → B} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (htij : t i = t j) : single t (1 : B) ∈ rel A B n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.subset_span ?_
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_update_add
statement:
theorem gen_update_add (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    gen A B (update t i (x + y)) = gen A B (update t i x) + gen A B (update t i y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, gen, gen, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, eq_comm, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  exact mem_rel_add A B t i x y

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_update_mul
statement:
theorem gen_update_mul (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    gen A B (update t i (x * y)) =
      x • gen A B (update t i y) + y • gen A B (update t i x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, gen, gen, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
    ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, eq_comm, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  exact mem_rel_mul A B t i x y

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_update_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gen_update_algebraMap (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (a : A) :
    gen A B (update t i (algebraMap A B a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact mem_rel_algebraMap A B t i a

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gen_eq_zero {t : Fin n → B} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (htij : t i = t j) : gen A B t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact mem_rel_alternate A B hij htij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_update_swap
statement:
theorem gen_update_swap (t : Fin n → B) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) (x y : B) :
    gen A B (update (update t i x) j y) = - gen A B (update (update t i y) j x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : gen A B (update (update t i (x + y)) j (x + y)) = 0 :=
    gen_eq_zero A B hij (by simp [Function.update_of_ne hij])
  rw [gen_update_add] at key
  rw [update_comm hij (x + y) x t, update_comm hij (x + y) y t] at key
  rw [gen_update_add, gen_update_add] at key
  have h1 : gen A B (update (update t j x) i x) = 0 :=
    gen_eq_zero A B hij (by simp [Function.update_of_ne hij.symm])
  have h4 : gen A B (update (update t j y) i y) = 0 :=
    gen_eq_zero A B hij (by simp [Function.update_of_ne hij.symm])
  rw [h1, h4, zero_add, add_zero, add_comm] at key
  rw [update_comm hij x y t, update_comm hij y x t]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left key

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_add
statement:
theorem gen_cons_add (s s' : B) (t : Fin n → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons (s + s') t) = gen A B (Fin.cons s t) + gen A B (Fin.cons s' t)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Fin.update_cons_zero] using gen_update_add A B (Fin.cons s t) 0 s s'

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_mul
statement:
theorem gen_cons_mul (x y : B) (t : Fin n → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons (x * y) t) =
      x • gen A B (Fin.cons y t) + y • gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Fin.update_cons_zero] using gen_update_mul A B (Fin.cons x t) 0 x y

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gen_cons_algebraMap (a : A) (t : Fin n → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons (algebraMap A B a) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Fin.update_cons_zero] using gen_update_algebraMap A B (Fin.cons 1 t) 0 a

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_one
statement: theorem gen_cons_one (t : Fin n → B) : gen A B (Fin.cons (1 : B) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using gen_cons_algebraMap A B 1 t

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_smul
statement:
theorem gen_cons_smul (a : A) (s : B) (t : Fin n → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons (a • s) t) = a • gen A B (Fin.cons s t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, gen_cons_mul, gen_cons_algebraMap, smul_zero, add_zero,
    algebraMap_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_cons_swap
statement:
theorem gen_cons_cons_swap (x y : B) (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons x (update t i y)) + gen A B (Fin.cons y (update t i x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_swap A B (Fin.cons x t) 0 i.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm x y
  rw [Fin.update_cons_zero, Fin.update_cons_zero, ← Fin.cons_update, ← Fin.cons_update] at h
  rw [h, neg_add_cancel]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.preD_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem preD_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    preD A B n (single t s) = gen A B (Fin.cons s t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preD, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_killer
statement: theorem rel_le_killer (n : ℕ) : rel A B n ≤ killer A B n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw <;> intro b
  · 
    simp only [smul_add, smul_sub, map_add, map_sub, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, preD_single]
    rw [Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, gen_update_add]
    exact sub_self _
  · 
    simp only [smul_add, smul_sub, map_add, map_sub, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, preD_single]
    have h3 : gen A B (Fin.cons b (update t i (x * y))) =
        x • gen A B (Fin.cons b (update t i y)) + y • gen A B (Fin.cons b (update t i x)) := by
      rw [Fin.cons_update, gen_update_mul, ← Fin.cons_update, ← Fin.cons_update]
    have h2 : gen A B (Fin.cons x (update t i y)) = - gen A B (Fin.cons y (update t i x)) :=
      eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (gen_cons_cons_swap A B x y t i)
    rw [gen_cons_mul A B b x (update t i y), gen_cons_mul A B b y (update t i x), h3, h2]
    module
  · 
    simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, preD_single]
    rw [Fin.cons_update]
    exact gen_update_algebraMap A B _ i.succ a
  · 
    simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, preD_single]
    exact gen_eq_zero A B (i := i.succ) (j := j.succ)
      (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ h)) (by simp [Fin.cons_succ, htij])

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.preD_eq_zero_of_mem_rel
statement:
theorem preD_eq_zero_of_mem_rel {n : ℕ} (x : DRFree B n) (hx : x ∈ rel A B n) :
    preD A B n x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rel_le_killer A B n hx 1

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem d_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    d A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = gen A B (Fin.cons s t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [d, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk, Submodule.liftQ_apply, preD_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_gen
statement:
theorem d_gen {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) :
    d A B n (gen A B t) = gen A B (Fin.cons 1 t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, d_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_d_apply_mk
statement:
theorem d_d_apply_mk {n : ℕ} (y : DRFree B n) :
    d A B (n + 1) (d A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, hf, hg, add_zero]
  | single t s =>
      rw [d_mk_single, gen, d_mk_single]
      exact gen_cons_one A B _

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_comp_d
statement: theorem d_comp_d (n : ℕ) : (d A B (n + 1)).comp (d A B n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  simpa using d_d_apply_mk A B y

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.update_fin_one_apply
statement:
theorem update_fin_one_apply (t : Fin 1 → B) (i : Fin 1) (x : B) (j : Fin 1) :
    update t i x j = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim j i, Function.update_self]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_zero_eq_bot
statement: theorem rel_zero_eq_bot : rel A B 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
  intro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, -⟩ | ⟨t, i, -⟩ | ⟨t, i, -⟩ | ⟨t, i, -⟩ := hw <;> exact i.elim0

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem drZeroEquiv_mk_single (t : Fin 0 → B) (s : B) :
    drZeroEquiv A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [drZeroEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot_apply_mk,
    Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply,
    show (default : Fin 0 → B) = t from Subsingleton.elim _ _, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drFreeOneEquiv_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem drFreeOneEquiv_single (t : Fin 1 → B) (s : B) :
    drFreeOneEquiv B (single t s) = single (t 0) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [drFreeOneEquiv, Finsupp.domLCongr_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.map_rel_one
statement:
theorem map_rel_one :
    (rel A B 1).map (drFreeOneEquiv B : DRFree B 1 →ₗ[B] B →₀ B) = kerTotal A B
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [rel, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro w ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv
    obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hv
    · exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨(x, y), by
        simp [map_add, map_sub, update_fin_one_apply]⟩))
    · exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(x, y), by
        simp [map_add, map_sub, update_fin_one_apply]⟩))
    · exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨a, by simp [update_fin_one_apply]⟩)
    · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij
  · rw [kerTotal, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro w ((⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
    · exact Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, mem_rel_add A B (fun _ => 1) 0 x y, by
        simp [map_add, map_sub]⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, mem_rel_mul A B (fun _ => 1) 0 x y, by
        simp [map_add, map_sub]⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, mem_rel_algebraMap A B (fun _ => 1) 0 a, by
        simp⟩

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drOneEquiv_mk_single
statement:
theorem drOneEquiv_mk_single (t : Fin 1 → B) (s : B) :
    drOneEquiv A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = s • D A B (t 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Submodule.Quotient.equiv (rel A B 1) (kerTotal A B) (drFreeOneEquiv B)
      (map_rel_one A B)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (t 0) s) := by
    show (rel A B 1).mapQ (kerTotal A B)
      (drFreeOneEquiv B : DRFree B 1 →ₗ[B] B →₀ B)
      (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (map_rel_one A B).le)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = _
    rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, drFreeOneEquiv_single]
  have h2 : quotKerTotalEquiv A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (t 0) s)) =
      s • D A B (t 0) := by
    show (Finsupp.linearCombination B (D A B)) (single (t 0) s) = s • D A B (t 0)
    simp
  rw [drOneEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, h1, h2]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drOneEquiv_d
statement:
theorem drOneEquiv_d (x : DR A B 0) :
    drOneEquiv A B (d A B 0 x) = D A B (drZeroEquiv A B x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single t s =>
      rw [d_mk_single, gen, drOneEquiv_mk_single, Fin.cons_zero, one_smul,
        drZeroEquiv_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mapFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapFree_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    mapFree φ n (single t s) = single (φ ∘ t) (φ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapFree, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mapFree_smul
statement:
theorem mapFree_smul (n : ℕ) (b : B) (x : DRFree B n) :
    mapFree φ n (b • x) = φ b • mapFree φ n x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [smul_add, map_add, hf, hg, map_add, smul_add]
  | single t s => simp [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mapFree_mem_rel
statement:
theorem mapFree_mem_rel {n : ℕ} {w : DRFree B n} (hw : w ∈ relSet A B n) :
    mapFree φ n w ∈ rel A B' n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simpa [map_add, map_sub, Function.comp_update] using
      mem_rel_add A B' (φ ∘ t) i (φ x) (φ y)
  · simpa [map_add, map_sub, Function.comp_update, Finsupp.smul_single'] using
      mem_rel_mul A B' (φ ∘ t) i (φ x) (φ y)
  · simpa [Function.comp_update] using mem_rel_algebraMap A B' (φ ∘ t) i a
  · simpa using mem_rel_alternate A B' (t := φ ∘ t) hij
      (show (φ ∘ t) i = (φ ∘ t) j from congrArg φ htij)

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mapFree_mem_rel_of_mem
statement:
theorem mapFree_mem_rel_of_mem {n : ℕ} {x : DRFree B n} (hx : x ∈ rel A B n) :
    mapFree φ n x ∈ rel A B' n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw => exact mapFree_mem_rel φ hw
  | zero => simp
  | add u v _ _ hu' hv' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu' hv'
  | smul b u _ hu' => rw [mapFree_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hu'

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.map_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    map φ n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (φ ∘ t) (φ s))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk, Submodule.liftQ_apply,
    LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, mapFree_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_comp_map
statement:
theorem d_comp_map (n : ℕ) :
    (d A B' n).comp (map φ n) = (map φ (n + 1)).comp (d A B n)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hf hg ⊢
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single t s =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_mk_single, d_mk_single, gen,
        Fin.comp_cons, map_one]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.map_id
statement: theorem map_id (n : ℕ) : map (AlgHom.id A B) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single t s => simp [map_mk_single, AlgHom.coe_id]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (φ : B →ₐ[A] B') (ψ : B' →ₐ[A] B'') (n : ℕ) :
    map (ψ.comp φ) n = (map ψ n).comp (map φ n)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hf hg ⊢
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single t s =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_mk_single, AlgHom.coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.deRhamComplex_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem deRhamComplex_X (n : ℕ) :
    (deRhamComplex A B).X n = ModuleCat.of A (DR A B n)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.deRhamComplex_d
statement:
@[simp] theorem deRhamComplex_d (n : ℕ) :
    (deRhamComplex A B).d n (n + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (d A B n)
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.of_d (fun n => ModuleCat.of A (DR A B n))
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (d A B n)) n

name: HodgePilot.deRhamMap_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem deRhamMap_f (φ : B →ₐ[A] B') (n : ℕ) :
    (deRhamMap φ).f n = ModuleCat.ofHom (DeRham.map φ n)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.deRhamMap_id
statement: theorem deRhamMap_id : deRhamMap (AlgHom.id A B) = 𝟙 (deRhamComplex A B)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro i
  refine ModuleCat.hom_ext ?_
  exact DeRham.map_id i

name: HodgePilot.deRhamMap_comp
statement:
theorem deRhamMap_comp (φ : B →ₐ[A] B') (ψ : B' →ₐ[A] B'') :
    deRhamMap (ψ.comp φ) = deRhamMap φ ≫ deRhamMap ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro i
  refine ModuleCat.hom_ext ?_
  exact DeRham.map_comp φ ψ i

name: HodgePilot.deRhamCohomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem deRhamCohomologyMap_id (n : ℕ) :
    deRhamCohomologyMap (AlgHom.id A B) n = 𝟙 (deRhamCohomology A B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deRhamCohomologyMap, deRhamMap_id, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_id]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.deRhamCohomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem deRhamCohomologyMap_comp (φ : B →ₐ[A] B') (ψ : B' →ₐ[A] B'') (n : ℕ) :
    deRhamCohomologyMap (ψ.comp φ) n =
      deRhamCohomologyMap φ n ≫ deRhamCohomologyMap ψ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [deRhamCohomologyMap, deRhamMap_comp, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.deRhamComplex_sc'_f
statement: theorem deRhamComplex_sc'_f : ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 0 1).f = 0
proof:
:=
  (deRhamComplex A B).shape 0 0 (by simp)

name: HodgePilot.deRhamComplex_sc'_g
statement:
theorem deRhamComplex_sc'_g :
    ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 0 1).g = ModuleCat.ofHom (DeRham.d A B 0)
proof:
:=
  deRhamComplex_d A B 0

name: HodgePilot.h0_toCycles_range_eq_bot
statement:
theorem h0_toCycles_range_eq_bot :
    LinearMap.range ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 0 1).moduleCatToCycles = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => Subtype.ext ?_
  show ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 0 1).f.hom x = 0
  rw [deRhamComplex_sc'_f, ModuleCat.hom_zero]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.map_ker_drZero
statement:
theorem map_ker_drZero :
    (LinearMap.ker (DeRham.d A B 0)).map
        ((drZeroEquiv A B).restrictScalars A : DR A B 0 →ₗ[A] B) =
      LinearMap.ker (D A B).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [Submodule.mem_map_equiv, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker,
    ← (drOneEquiv A B).map_eq_zero_iff, drOneEquiv_d,
    show ((drZeroEquiv A B).restrictScalars A).symm b = (drZeroEquiv A B).symm b from rfl,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.h0_ker_g_eq
statement:
theorem h0_ker_g_eq :
    LinearMap.ker ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 0 1).g.hom =
      LinearMap.ker (DeRham.d A B 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deRhamComplex_sc'_g]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.mem_two
statement:
theorem mem_two (ω η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.ι B ω * ExteriorAlgebra.ι B η ∈ ⋀[B]^2 (Ω[B⁄A])
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ ξ : Ω[B⁄A], ExteriorAlgebra.ι B ξ ∈ ⋀[B]^1 (Ω[B⁄A]) := fun ξ => by
    have : ExteriorAlgebra.ι B ξ ∈
        (LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι B (M := Ω[B⁄A]))) ^ 1 := by
      rw [pow_one]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
    exact this
  exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded (h1 ω) (h1 η)

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_coe
statement:
theorem wedge_coe (ω η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    (wedge A B ω η : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A])) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι B ω * ExteriorAlgebra.ι B η
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_add_left
statement:
theorem wedge_add_left (ω ω' η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    wedge A B (ω + ω') η = wedge A B ω η + wedge A B ω' η
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe, map_add, add_mul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_smul_left
statement:
theorem wedge_smul_left (b : B) (ω η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    wedge A B (b • ω) η = b • wedge A B ω η
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe, map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_add_right
statement:
theorem wedge_add_right (ω η η' : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    wedge A B ω (η + η') = wedge A B ω η + wedge A B ω η'
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe, map_add, mul_add]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_smul_right
statement:
theorem wedge_smul_right (b : B) (ω η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    wedge A B ω (b • η) = b • wedge A B ω η
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe, map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_add_swap
statement:
theorem wedge_add_swap (ω η : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    wedge A B ω η + wedge A B η ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [wedge_coe]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_zero_left
statement: theorem wedge_zero_left (η : Ω[B⁄A]) : wedge A B 0 η = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedge_self
statement: theorem wedge_self (ω : Ω[B⁄A]) : wedge A B ω ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.tupleWedge_update_add
statement:
theorem tupleWedge_update_add (t : Fin 2 → B) (i : Fin 2) (x y : B) :
    tupleWedge A B (update t i (x + y)) =
      tupleWedge A B (update t i x) + tupleWedge A B (update t i y)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_self,
        Function.update_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide)]
      rw [map_add, wedge_add_left]
  | succ i' =>
      obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero (0 : Fin 1)).symm,
        show (1 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 1).succ from rfl, Function.update_self]
      rw [map_add, wedge_add_right]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.tupleWedge_update_mul
statement:
theorem tupleWedge_update_mul (t : Fin 2 → B) (i : Fin 2) (x y : B) :
    tupleWedge A B (update t i (x * y)) =
      x • tupleWedge A B (update t i y) + y • tupleWedge A B (update t i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_self,
        Function.update_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide)]
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, wedge_add_left, wedge_smul_left, wedge_smul_left]
  | succ i' =>
      obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero (0 : Fin 1)).symm,
        show (1 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 1).succ from rfl, Function.update_self]
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, wedge_add_right, wedge_smul_right, wedge_smul_right]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.tupleWedge_update_algebraMap
statement:
theorem tupleWedge_update_algebraMap (t : Fin 2 → B) (i : Fin 2) (a : A) :
    tupleWedge A B (update t i (algebraMap A B a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_self,
        Function.update_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide)]
      rw [Derivation.map_algebraMap, wedge_zero_left]
  | succ i' =>
      obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [tupleWedge, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero (0 : Fin 1)).symm,
        show (1 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 1).succ from rfl, Function.update_self]
      rw [Derivation.map_algebraMap]
      apply Subtype.ext; simp [wedge_coe]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.apply_eq_of_fin_two
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_fin_two {α : Type*} {t : Fin 2 → α} {i j : Fin 2}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (htij : t i = t j) : t 0 = t 1
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd rfl hij
      | succ j' =>
          obtain rfl : j' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
          exact htij
  | succ i' =>
      obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact htij.symm
      | succ j' =>
          obtain rfl : j' = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
          exact absurd rfl hij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.tupleWedge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tupleWedge_eq_zero {t : Fin 2 → B} {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (htij : t i = t j) : tupleWedge A B t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleWedge, apply_eq_of_fin_two hij htij, wedge_self]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExtFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem toExtFree_single (t : Fin 2 → B) (s : B) :
    toExtFree A B (single t s) = s • tupleWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [toExtFree, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_toExtFree
statement: theorem rel_le_ker_toExtFree : rel A B 2 ≤ LinearMap.ker (toExtFree A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, toExtFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [tupleWedge_update_add]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, toExtFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [tupleWedge_update_mul]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [toExtFree_single, one_smul]
    exact tupleWedge_update_algebraMap A B t i a
  · simp only [toExtFree_single, one_smul]
    exact tupleWedge_eq_zero A B hij htij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExt_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem toExt_mk_single (t : Fin 2 → B) (s : B) :
    toExt A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = s • tupleWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [toExt, Submodule.liftQ_apply, toExtFree_single]

name: HodgePilot.Betti.toComplexCoeffs_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toComplexCoeffs_zero (n : ℕ) : toComplexCoeffs X n 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero _

name: HodgePilot.Betti.toComplexCoeffs_add
statement:
lemma toComplexCoeffs_add (n : ℕ) (x y : bettiQ X n) :
    toComplexCoeffs X n (x + y) = toComplexCoeffs X n x + toComplexCoeffs X n y
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.kernelLift_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem HodgeHom.kernelLift_toLinearMap (f : HodgeHom hV hW)
    (g : HodgeHom hP hV) (hg : f.toLinearMap.comp g.toLinearMap = 0) :
    (f.kernelLift g hg).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap) g.toLinearMap
          (fun p => LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (LinearMap.congr_fun hg p))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.kernelIncl_comp_kernelLift
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.kernelIncl_comp_kernelLift (f : HodgeHom hV hW)
    (g : HodgeHom hP hV) (hg : f.toLinearMap.comp g.toLinearMap = 0) :
    f.kernelIncl.comp (f.kernelLift g hg) = g
proof:
:=
  HodgeHom.ext (LinearMap.subtype_comp_codRestrict _ _ _)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.kernelLift_unique
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.kernelLift_unique (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (g : HodgeHom hP hV)
    (hg : f.toLinearMap.comp g.toLinearMap = 0) (m : HodgeHom hP f.kernel)
    (hm : f.kernelIncl.comp m = g) : m = f.kernelLift g hg
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap).subtype.comp m.toLinearMap
      = g.toLinearMap := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap hm
  apply HodgeHom.ext
  refine LinearMap.ext fun p => Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [HodgeHom.kernelLift_toLinearMap, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h1 p

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_toLinearMap (f : HodgeHom hV hW)
    (g : HodgeHom hW hP) (hg : g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = 0) :
    (f.cokernelDesc g hg).toLinearMap
      = (LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).liftQ g.toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.mpr hg)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_comp_cokernelProj
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_comp_cokernelProj (f : HodgeHom hV hW)
    (g : HodgeHom hW hP) (hg : g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = 0) :
    (f.cokernelDesc g hg).comp f.cokernelProj = g
proof:
:=
  HodgeHom.ext
    (Submodule.liftQ_mkQ _ g.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.mpr hg))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_unique
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_unique (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (g : HodgeHom hW hP)
    (hg : g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = 0) (m : HodgeHom f.cokernel hP)
    (hm : m.comp f.cokernelProj = g) : m = f.cokernelDesc g hg
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : m.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).mkQ
      = g.toLinearMap := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap hm
  apply HodgeHom.ext
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ ?_
  rw [h1, HodgeHom.cokernelDesc_toLinearMap, Submodule.liftQ_mkQ]

name: HodgePilot.bijective_of_factorization
statement:
theorem bijective_of_factorization {π : M₀ →ₗ[R] M₁} {φ : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂}
    {ι : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃} {g : M₀ →ₗ[R] M₃} (hfac : (ι.comp φ).comp π = g)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker π = LinearMap.ker g)
    (hrange : LinearMap.range ι = LinearMap.range g) :
    Function.Bijective φ
proof:
:= by
  have hfac' : ∀ a, ι (φ (π a)) = g a := fun a => LinearMap.congr_fun hfac a
  constructor
  · intro b b' hb
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hπ b
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hπ b'
    have hg0 : g (a - a') = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, ← hfac' a, ← hfac' a', hb, sub_self]
    have hmem : a - a' ∈ LinearMap.ker π := by
      rw [hker]
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hg0
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · intro c
    have hc : ι c ∈ LinearMap.range g := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self ι c
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hc
    refine ⟨π a, hι ?_⟩
    rw [hfac' a]
    exact ha

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.toLinearMap_congr
statement:
theorem toLinearMap_congr {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : f = g) : f.toLinearMap = g.toLinearMap
proof: := by rw [h]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.kernelι_comp
statement:
theorem kernelι_comp {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    kernelι f ≫ f = 0
proof:
:=
  hodgeHom_ext f.toLinearMap_comp_kernelIncl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.comp_cokernelπ
statement:
theorem comp_cokernelπ {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f ≫ cokernelπ f = 0
proof:
:=
  hodgeHom_ext f.cokernelProj_comp_toLinearMap

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective
statement:
theorem iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (I : X ≅ Y) : Function.Bijective I.hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : I.inv.toLinearMap.comp I.hom.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap I.hom_inv_id
  have h2 : I.hom.toLinearMap.comp I.inv.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap I.inv_hom_id
  exact Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨⇑I.inv.toLinearMap, fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun h1 x,
      fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun h2 x⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_toLinearMap_bijective
statement:
theorem iso_inv_toLinearMap_bijective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (I : X ≅ Y) : Function.Bijective I.inv.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective I.symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isIso_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_of_bijective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f.toLinearMap) : IsIso f
proof:
:=
  (isoOfBijective f hf).isIso_hom

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isIso_iff_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_iff_bijective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsIso f ↔ Function.Bijective f.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective (asIso f),
    fun hf => isIso_of_bijective f hf⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.kernelι_toLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem kernelι_toLinearMap_injective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : Function.Injective (kernelι f).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Submodule.injective_subtype _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.range_kernelι_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem range_kernelι_toLinearMap {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LinearMap.range (kernelι f).toLinearMap = LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Submodule.range_subtype _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι
statement:
theorem kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (kernelIso f).hom ≫ kernelι f = kernel.ι f
proof:
:=
  limit.isoLimitCone_hom_π ⟨kernelFork f, kernelForkIsLimit f⟩
    WalkingParallelPair.zero

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.kernel_ι_toLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem kernel_ι_toLinearMap_injective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : Function.Injective (kernel.ι f).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (kernelι f).toLinearMap.comp (kernelIso f).hom.toLinearMap
      = (kernel.ι f).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι f)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact (kernelι_toLinearMap_injective f).comp
    (iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective (kernelIso f)).injective

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.range_kernel_ι_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem range_kernel_ι_toLinearMap {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LinearMap.range (kernel.ι f).toLinearMap = LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (kernelι f).toLinearMap.comp (kernelIso f).hom.toLinearMap
      = (kernel.ι f).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι f)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr
      (iso_hom_toLinearMap_bijective (kernelIso f)).surjective)]
  exact range_kernelι_toLinearMap f

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.cokernelπ_toLinearMap_surjective
statement:
theorem cokernelπ_toLinearMap_surjective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : Function.Surjective (cokernelπ f).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.ker_cokernelπ_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem ker_cokernelπ_toLinearMap {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LinearMap.ker (cokernelπ f).toLinearMap = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ker_mkQ _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv
statement:
theorem cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : cokernelπ f ≫ (cokernelIso f).inv = cokernel.π f
proof:
:=
  colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_inv ⟨cokernelCofork f, cokernelCoforkIsColimit f⟩
    WalkingParallelPair.one

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.cokernel_π_toLinearMap_surjective
statement:
theorem cokernel_π_toLinearMap_surjective {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : Function.Surjective (cokernel.π f).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (cokernelIso f).inv.toLinearMap.comp (cokernelπ f).toLinearMap
      = (cokernel.π f).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv f)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact (iso_inv_toLinearMap_bijective (cokernelIso f)).surjective.comp
    (cokernelπ_toLinearMap_surjective f)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.ker_cokernel_π_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem ker_cokernel_π_toLinearMap {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LinearMap.ker (cokernel.π f).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (cokernelIso f).inv.toLinearMap.comp (cokernelπ f).toLinearMap
      = (cokernel.π f).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv f)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.ker_comp,
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
      (iso_inv_toLinearMap_bijective (cokernelIso f)).injective,
    Submodule.comap_bot]
  exact ker_cokernelπ_toLinearMap f

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.coimageImageComparison_toLinearMap_bijective
statement:
theorem coimageImageComparison_toLinearMap_bijective
    {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Function.Bijective (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  bijective_of_factorization
    (π := (Abelian.coimage.π f).toLinearMap)
    (φ := (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f).toLinearMap)
    (ι := (Abelian.image.ι f).toLinearMap)
    (g := f.toLinearMap)
    (congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (Abelian.coimage_image_factorisation f))
    (cokernel_π_toLinearMap_surjective (kernel.ι f))
    (kernel_ι_toLinearMap_injective (cokernel.π f))
    ((ker_cokernel_π_toLinearMap (kernel.ι f)).trans
      (range_kernel_ι_toLinearMap f))
    ((range_kernel_ι_toLinearMap (cokernel.π f)).trans
      (ker_cokernel_π_toLinearMap f))

name: HodgePilot.pairRight_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairRight_tmul (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) (s : ℂ) (v : M) :
    pairRight f (s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = f v • s
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairRight]

name: HodgePilot.pairRight_add
statement:
theorem pairRight_add (f g : Module.Dual ℚ M) (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M) :
    pairRight (f + g) w = pairRight f w + pairRight g w
proof:
:= by
  have h : pairRight (f + g) = pairRight f + pairRight g := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun s v => ?_
    simp [add_smul]
  rw [h, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: HodgePilot.pairRight_smul
statement:
theorem pairRight_smul (c : ℚ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M) :
    pairRight (c • f) w = c • pairRight f w
proof:
:= by
  have h : pairRight (c • f) = c • pairRight f := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun s v => ?_
    simp [smul_smul]
  rw [h, LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: HodgePilot.pairRight_comp_apply
statement:
theorem pairRight_comp_apply (f : Module.Dual ℚ N) (g : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M) :
    pairRight (f ∘ₗ g) w = pairRight f (LinearMap.lTensor ℂ g w)
proof:
:= by
  have h : pairRight (f ∘ₗ g) = pairRight f ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor ℂ g := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun s v => ?_
    simp
  rw [h, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: HodgePilot.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul (s : ℂ) (m : M) :
    s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] m = s • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.sum_pairRight_coord_smul
statement:
theorem sum_pairRight_coord_smul {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι ℚ M)
    (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M) :
    ∑ i, pairRight (b.coord i) w • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b i) = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul s v =>
      have hstep : ∀ i : ι,
          pairRight (b.coord i) (s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b i)
            = s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (b.coord i v • b i) := fun i => by
        rw [pairRight_tmul, smul_assoc, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
          mul_one, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
      have hv : (∑ i, b.coord i v • b i) = v := by
        simp only [Basis.coord_apply]
        exact b.sum_repr v
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hstep i, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
        hv]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hx, hy]

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pieceProj_apply (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) (ab : ℤ × ℤ)
    (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier) :
    pieceProj X ab w
      = ((X.str.isInternal.proj ab w : X.str.H ab) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_mem
statement:
theorem pieceProj_mem (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) (ab : ℤ × ℤ)
    (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier) : pieceProj X ab w ∈ X.str.H ab
proof:
:= by
  rw [pieceProj_apply]
  exact Submodule.coe_mem _

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_of_mem
statement:
theorem pieceProj_of_mem {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} {ab : ℤ × ℤ}
    {w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier} (hw : w ∈ X.str.H ab) : pieceProj X ab w = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [pieceProj_apply, X.str.isInternal.proj_of_mem hw]

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_of_mem_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [pieceProj_apply, X.str.isInternal.proj_of_mem_ne hne hw]
  simp

name: HodgePilot.pieceMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pieceMap_apply (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) (ab : ℤ × ℤ)
    (v : X.carrier) :
    pieceMap X ab v = pieceProj X ab ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.pieceMap_mem
statement:
theorem pieceMap_mem (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) (ab : ℤ × ℤ)
    (v : X.carrier) : pieceMap X ab v ∈ X.str.H ab
proof:
:= by
  rw [pieceMap_apply]
  exact pieceProj_mem X ab _

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_naturality
statement:
theorem pieceProj_naturality {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (ab : ℤ × ℤ) :
    pieceProj Y ab ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
      = g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ∘ₗ pieceProj X ab
proof:
:= by
  have hker : ∀ cd : ℤ × ℤ, X.str.H cd ≤ LinearMap.ker
      (pieceProj Y ab ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        - g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ∘ₗ pieceProj X ab) := by
    intro cd w hw
    have hgw : g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ w ∈ Y.str.H cd :=
      g.maps_pieces cd (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hw)
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply]
    by_cases hcd : cd = ab
    · subst hcd
      rw [pieceProj_of_mem hgw, pieceProj_of_mem hw, sub_self]
    · rw [pieceProj_of_mem_ne hcd hgw, pieceProj_of_mem_ne hcd hw, map_zero,
        sub_zero]
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier)) ≤ LinearMap.ker
      (pieceProj Y ab ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        - g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ∘ₗ pieceProj X ab) := by
    rw [← X.str.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
    exact iSup_le hker
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  have h0 := htop (Submodule.mem_top (x := w))
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

name: HodgePilot.pieceProj_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem pieceProj_naturality_apply {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier) :
    pieceProj Y ab (g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ w)
      = g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ (pieceProj X ab w)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (pieceProj_naturality g ab) w

name: HodgePilot.pieceMap_naturality
statement:
theorem pieceMap_naturality {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (v : X.carrier) :
    pieceMap Y ab (g.toLinearMap v)
      = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ g.toLinearMap (pieceMap X ab v)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] g.toLinearMap v
      = g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) := by
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  rw [pieceMap_apply, pieceMap_apply, h1, pieceProj_naturality_apply]
  exact congrFun (LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor _) _

name: HodgePilot.mixLeft_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mixLeft_tmul (ℓ : A →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) (m : M) (c : A) :
    mixLeft ℓ (m ⊗ₜ[ℚ] c) = ℓ c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] m
proof:
:= by
  simp [mixLeft]

name: HodgePilot.mixLeft_rTensor
statement:
theorem mixLeft_rTensor (ℓ : A →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) (ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) :
    mixLeft (M := N) ℓ ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor A ψ
      = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ ψ ∘ₗ mixLeft (M := M) ℓ
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m c => ?_
  simp

name: HodgePilot.pieceLegMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem pieceLegMap_tmul (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (p : WordCat V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((word V p).carrier)) (v : (word V p).carrier) :
    pieceLegMap V ab p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
      = pairRight f (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pieceLegMap]

name: HodgePilot.pieceLeg_dinatural
statement:
theorem pieceLeg_dinatural (ab : ℤ × ℤ) ⦃p q : WordCat V⦄ (u : p ⟶ q) :
    ((coeffDiagram (wordFiber V)).map u.op).app p ≫ pieceLeg V ab p =
      ((coeffDiagram (wordFiber V)).obj (op q)).map u ≫ pieceLeg V ab q
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun f v => ?_
  show pairRight (f ∘ₗ u.hom.toLinearMap) (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
      = pairRight f (pieceMap (word V q) ab (u.hom.toLinearMap v))
  calc pairRight (f ∘ₗ u.hom.toLinearMap) (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
      = pairRight f
          (LinearMap.lTensor ℂ u.hom.toLinearMap (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)) :=
        pairRight_comp_apply f u.hom.toLinearMap _
    _ = pairRight f (pieceMap (word V q) ab (u.hom.toLinearMap v)) :=
        congrArg (pairRight f) (pieceMap_naturality u.hom ab v).symm

name: HodgePilot.pieceFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem pieceFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (p : WordCat V) :
    pieceFunctional V ab ∘ₗ matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
      = pieceLegMap V ab p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (coend.ι_desc (fun p => pieceLeg V ab p) (pieceLeg_dinatural V ab) p)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.pieceFunctional_matrixCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pieceFunctional_matrixCoeff (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (p : WordCat V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    pieceFunctional V ab (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))
      = pairRight f (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (pieceFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff V ab p)
    (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  exact h.trans (pieceLegMap_tmul V ab p f v)

name: HodgePilot.mixLeft_pieceFunctional_wordCoaction
statement:
theorem mixLeft_pieceFunctional_wordCoaction (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (p : WordCat V)
    (v : (word V p).carrier) :
    mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) (wordCoaction V p v)
      = pieceMap (word V p) ab v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) (wordCoaction V p v)
      = ∑ i, mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) (coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
            ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)) := by
    rw [show wordCoaction V p v = ∑ i, coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
        matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
          ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
      from coeffCoaction_apply (wordFiber V) p v]
    exact map_sum _ _ _
  have h2 : ∀ i, mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab)
        (coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
          ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))
      = pairRight ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i)
          (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
          • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i) := fun i =>
    (mixLeft_tmul _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun s : ℂ => s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i)
          (pieceFunctional_matrixCoeff V ab p
            ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i) v)).trans
        (tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul _ _))
  refine h1.trans ((Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => h2 i).trans ?_)
  exact sum_pairRight_coord_smul (coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p)
    (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)

name: HodgePilot.pieceMap_intertwiner
statement:
theorem pieceMap_intertwiner {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ψ : (word V p).carrier →ₗ[ℚ] (word V q).carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ wordCoaction V p
      = wordCoaction V q ∘ₗ ψ) (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (v : (word V p).carrier) :
    pieceMap (word V q) ab (ψ v)
      = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ ψ (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : wordCoaction V q (ψ v)
      = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ (wordCoaction V p v) :=
    (LinearMap.congr_fun hψ v).symm
  calc pieceMap (word V q) ab (ψ v)
      = mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) (wordCoaction V q (ψ v)) :=
        (mixLeft_pieceFunctional_wordCoaction V ab q (ψ v)).symm
    _ = mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab)
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ (wordCoaction V p v)) := by
        rw [h0]
    _ = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ ψ
          (mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) (wordCoaction V p v)) := by
        have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun
          (mixLeft_rTensor (pieceFunctional V ab) ψ) (wordCoaction V p v)
        simpa using h2
    _ = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ ψ (pieceMap (word V p) ab v) := by
        rw [mixLeft_pieceFunctional_wordCoaction]

name: HodgePilot.intertwiner_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem intertwiner_maps_pieces {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ψ : (word V p).carrier →ₗ[ℚ] (word V q).carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ wordCoaction V p
      = wordCoaction V q ∘ₗ ψ) (ab : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ((word V p).str.H ab).map (ψ.baseChange ℂ) ≤ (word V q).str.H ab
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : ∀ w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (word V p).carrier,
      ψ.baseChange ℂ (pieceProj (word V p) ab w) ∈ (word V q).str.H ab := by
    intro w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero =>
        simp only [map_zero]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | tmul s v =>
        have h1 : s ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v = s • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul]
        refine Submodule.smul_mem _ s ?_
        have h2 : pieceProj (word V p) ab ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
            = pieceMap (word V p) ab v := rfl
        have h3 : ψ.baseChange ℂ (pieceMap (word V p) ab v)
            = LinearMap.lTensor ℂ ψ (pieceMap (word V p) ab v) :=
          congrFun (LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor _) _
        rw [h2, h3, ← pieceMap_intertwiner V ψ hψ ab v]
        exact pieceMap_mem (word V q) ab (ψ v)
    | add x y hx hy =>
        rw [map_add, map_add]
        exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hz' : pieceProj (word V p) ab z = z := pieceProj_of_mem hz
  have h4 := hgen z
  rwa [hz'] at h4

name: HodgePilot.homOfIntertwiner_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem homOfIntertwiner_toLinearMap {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ψ : (word V p).carrier →ₗ[ℚ] (word V q).carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ wordCoaction V p
      = wordCoaction V q ∘ₗ ψ) :
    (homOfIntertwiner V ψ hψ).toLinearMap = ψ
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.rTensor_coaction_toWord
statement:
theorem rTensor_coaction_toWord {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (π : WordPresentation V X) {r : ℕ × ℕ} (h : X ⟶ word V r) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) h.toLinearMap ∘ₗ π.coaction
      = wordCoaction V r ∘ₗ h.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := WordPresentation.coaction_naturality π
    (Classical.choice (generatedBy_iff_nonempty.mp (word_mem V r))) h
  rwa [WordPresentation.coaction_word r] at hnat

name: HodgePilot.component_intertwines
statement:
theorem component_intertwines {X Y : GeneratedSub V}
    (ψ : X.obj.carrier →ₗ[ℚ] Y.obj.carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ (thePresentation V X).coaction
      = (thePresentation V Y).coaction ∘ₗ ψ)
    (j : Fin (thePresentation V X).k) (i : Fin (thePresentation V Y).k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
        (((thePresentation V Y).proj i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ ψ ∘ₗ
          ((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      wordCoaction V ((thePresentation V X).w j)
    = wordCoaction V ((thePresentation V Y).w i) ∘ₗ
        (((thePresentation V Y).proj i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ ψ ∘ₗ
          ((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply]
  rw [← WordPresentation.coaction_comp_word_apply (thePresentation V X)
