    ((thePresentation V X).inj j) m]
  rw [show LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ
        ((thePresentation V X).coaction
          (((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap m))
      = (thePresentation V Y).coaction
          (ψ (((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap m)) from
    LinearMap.congr_fun hψ _]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (rTensor_coaction_toWord V (thePresentation V Y)
    ((thePresentation V Y).proj i)) _

name: HodgePilot.compHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem compHom_toLinearMap {X Y : GeneratedSub V}
    (ψ : X.obj.carrier →ₗ[ℚ] Y.obj.carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ (thePresentation V X).coaction
      = (thePresentation V Y).coaction ∘ₗ ψ)
    (j : Fin (thePresentation V X).k) (i : Fin (thePresentation V Y).k) :
    (compHom V ψ hψ j i).toLinearMap
      = ((thePresentation V Y).proj i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ ψ ∘ₗ
          ((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.toComod_full
statement:
theorem toComod_full (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)
    (X Y : GeneratedSub V) (φ : (toComod V).obj X ⟶ (toComod V).obj Y) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, (toComod V).map f = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψeq⟩ : ∃ ψ : X.obj.carrier →ₗ[ℚ] Y.obj.carrier,
      (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ (thePresentation V X).coaction
        = (thePresentation V Y).coaction ∘ₗ ψ)
      ∧ ψ = φ.hom.toComodHom.toLinearMap :=
    ⟨φ.hom.toComodHom.toLinearMap, φ.hom.toComodHom.coaction_comm, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ObjectProperty.homMk (∑ j, ∑ i, (thePresentation V X).proj j ≫
    compHom V ψ hψ j i ≫ (thePresentation V Y).inj i), ?_⟩
  have hlin : (∑ j, ∑ i, (thePresentation V X).proj j ≫ compHom V ψ hψ j i ≫
        (thePresentation V Y).inj i).toLinearMap
      = ∑ j, ∑ i, ((thePresentation V X).proj j ≫ compHom V ψ hψ j i ≫
          (thePresentation V Y).inj i).toLinearMap := by
    refine (map_sum (toLinearMapAddHom X.obj Y.obj) _ _).trans ?_
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
      map_sum (toLinearMapAddHom X.obj Y.obj) _ _
  have hmain : (∑ j, ∑ i, (thePresentation V X).proj j ≫ compHom V ψ hψ j i ≫
        (thePresentation V Y).inj i).toLinearMap = ψ := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    rw [hlin]
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, HodgeStructCat.comp_toLinearMap,
      compHom_toLinearMap, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (thePresentation V Y).total_apply
      (ψ (((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap
        (((thePresentation V X).proj j).toLinearMap x)))).trans ?_
    refine (map_sum ψ _ _).symm.trans ?_
    exact congrArg ψ ((thePresentation V X).total_apply x)
  exact ObjectProperty.hom_ext _ (ComodCat.hom_ext _ _ (ComodHom.ext fun x =>
    LinearMap.congr_fun (hmain.trans hψeq) x))

name: HodgePilot.toComodFullAtPolarizableWords
statement:
theorem toComodFullAtPolarizableWords (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    ToComodFullAtPolarizableWords V
proof:
:= by
  intro _ X Y φ
  exact toComod_full V X Y φ

name: HodgePilot.toComod_full_of_polarizable
statement:
theorem toComod_full_of_polarizable (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)
    (hV : V.Polarizable) (X Y : GeneratedSub V)
    (φ : (toComod V).obj X ⟶ (toComod V).obj Y) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, (toComod V).map f = φ
proof:
:=
  toComodFullAtPolarizableWords V (forall_word_polarizable V hV) X Y φ

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.exists_mul_pow_eq
statement:
lemma exists_mul_pow_eq (r : S) (x : Localization.Away r) :
    ∃ (a : S) (n : ℕ),
      x * algebraMap S (Localization.Away r) (r ^ n)
        = algebraMap S (Localization.Away r) a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, w⟩, hw⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := Submonoid.powers r) x
  dsimp only at hw
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := w.2
  refine ⟨a, n, ?_⟩
  rw [show r ^ n = ↑w from hn]
  exact hw

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.awayLift_apply_eq_mul_inv
statement:
lemma awayLift_apply_eq_mul_inv (r : S) {x : Localization.Away r} {a : S} {n : ℕ}
    (hx : x * algebraMap S (Localization.Away r) (r ^ n)
      = algebraMap S (Localization.Away r) a)
    (ψ : CPoints S) (hψ : ψ r ≠ 0) :
    awayLift r (Localization.Away r) ψ hψ x = ψ a * (ψ r ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq₀ (pow_ne_zero n hψ), ← map_pow]
  have h1 := congrArg (awayLift r (Localization.Away r) ψ hψ) hx
  rw [map_mul, awayLift_algebraMap, awayLift_algebraMap] at h1
  exact h1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.exists_mem_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mem_ne_zero {s : Set S} (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤) (φ : CPoints S) :
    ∃ t ∈ s, φ t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  have hsub : s ⊆ ↑(RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom) := fun t ht => by
    by_cases h0 : φ t = 0
    · simpa [RingHom.mem_ker] using h0
    · exact absurd ⟨t, ht, h0⟩ hcon
  have hle := Ideal.span_le.mpr hsub
  rw [hs] at hle
  have h1 : φ 1 = 0 := hle Submodule.mem_top
  rw [map_one] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.reindexHomeomorph_symm_apply
statement:
lemma reindexHomeomorph_symm_apply (y : Fin d → ℂ)
    (k : Kappa Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation) :
    (reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y k = y (e k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reindexHomeomorph, Homeomorph.piCongrLeft_symm_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.reindexHomeomorph_apply_symm_index
statement:
lemma reindexHomeomorph_apply_symm_index
    (x : Kappa Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation → ℂ) (i : Fin d) :
    reindexHomeomorph Q e x i = x (e.symm i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Homeomorph.piCongrLeft_apply_apply (Y := fun _ => ℂ) e x (e.symm i)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1
  exact h1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.analyticAt_reindexHomeomorph_symm
statement:
lemma analyticAt_reindexHomeomorph_symm (y₀ : Fin d → ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y : Fin d → ℂ => (reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y) y₀
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ⇑(reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm
      = fun (y : Fin d → ℂ) (k : Kappa Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation) => y (e k) := by
    funext y k
    exact reindexHomeomorph_symm_apply Q e y k
  rw [h1]
  exact AnalyticAt.pi fun k =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (e k) : (Fin d → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).analyticAt y₀

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.analyticAt_finChart_symm_apply
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := mem_finChart_target Q e φ₀ hy₀
  have houter : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun y' => (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).symm y' x)
      ((reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y₀) := by
    refine analyticAt_sliceChartOfSubmersive_symm_apply Q φ₀ x ?_
    rw [sliceChartOfSubmersive_def, sliceChart_target]
    exact hmem
  have hcomp := houter.comp (analyticAt_reindexHomeomorph_symm Q e y₀)
  refine hcomp.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
  show (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).symm ((reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y) x
      = (finChart Q e φ₀).symm y x
  rw [finChart_symm_apply, sliceChartOfSubmersive_def, sliceChart_symm_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.Patch.ofIsStandardSmooth_r
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Patch.ofIsStandardSmooth_r (r : S)
    (h : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d ℂ (Localization.Away r)) :
    (Patch.ofIsStandardSmooth r h).r = r
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchEmb_apply
statement: lemma patchEmb_apply : ⇑(patchEmb p φ₀ h₀) = awayRes S p.Loc
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints p.Loc) := ⟨awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀⟩
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchEmb_source
statement: lemma patchEmb_source : (patchEmb p φ₀ h₀).source = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints p.Loc) := ⟨awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀⟩
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchEmb_target
statement:
lemma patchEmb_target :
    (patchEmb p φ₀ h₀).target = {ψ : CPoints S | ψ p.r ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints p.Loc) := ⟨awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀⟩
  have h1 : (patchEmb p φ₀ h₀).target = Set.range (awayRes S p.Loc) :=
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target _ _
  rw [h1, range_awayRes p.r p.Loc]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchEmb_symm_apply
statement:
lemma patchEmb_symm_apply (ψ : CPoints S) (hψ : ψ p.r ≠ 0) :
    (patchEmb p φ₀ h₀).symm ψ = awayLift p.r p.Loc ψ hψ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints p.Loc) := ⟨awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← awayRes_awayLift p.r p.Loc ψ hψ]
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_left_inv _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchChart_eq_trans
statement:
lemma patchChart_eq_trans :
    patchChart p φ₀ h₀
      = (patchEmb p φ₀ h₀).symm.trans
          (finChart p.pres p.kappaEquiv (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchChart_source_subset
statement:
lemma patchChart_source_subset :
    (patchChart p φ₀ h₀).source ⊆ {ψ : CPoints S | ψ p.r ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_eq_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source, patchEmb_target]
  exact Set.inter_subset_left

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.mem_patchChart_source
statement: lemma mem_patchChart_source : φ₀ ∈ (patchChart p φ₀ h₀).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_eq_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source, patchEmb_target]
    exact h₀
  · rw [Set.mem_preimage, patchEmb_symm_apply p φ₀ h₀ φ₀ h₀]
    exact mem_finChart_source p.pres p.kappaEquiv _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchChart_apply
statement:
lemma patchChart_apply (ψ : CPoints S) (hψ : ψ p.r ≠ 0) :
    patchChart p φ₀ h₀ ψ
      = finChart p.pres p.kappaEquiv (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀)
          (awayLift p.r p.Loc ψ hψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_eq_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply,
    patchEmb_symm_apply p φ₀ h₀ ψ hψ]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchChart_symm_apply
statement:
lemma patchChart_symm_apply (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (patchChart p φ₀ h₀).symm y
      = awayRes S p.Loc
          ((finChart p.pres p.kappaEquiv (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀)).symm y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_eq_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans_symm,
    Function.comp_apply, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_symm, patchEmb_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.patchChart_target
statement:
lemma patchChart_target :
    (patchChart p φ₀ h₀).target
      = (finChart p.pres p.kappaEquiv (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀)).target
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_eq_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_target, patchEmb_source, Set.preimage_univ,
    Set.inter_univ]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.analyticAt_patchChart_symm_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchChart_target] at hy₀
  have h1 := analyticAt_finChart_symm_apply p.pres p.kappaEquiv
    (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀) (algebraMap S p.Loc x) hy₀
  refine h1.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
  show (finChart p.pres p.kappaEquiv (awayLift p.r p.Loc φ₀ h₀)).symm y
        (algebraMap S p.Loc x)
      = (patchChart p φ₀ h₀).symm y x
  rw [patchChart_symm_apply]
  exact (awayRes_apply p.Loc _ x).symm

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.analyticAt_patchChart_trans
statement:
theorem analyticAt_patchChart_trans (p q : Patch S d) (φ₁ φ₂ : CPoints S)
    (h₁ : φ₁ p.r ≠ 0) (h₂ : φ₂ q.r ≠ 0) {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm.trans (patchChart q φ₂ h₂)).source) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (⇑(patchChart q φ₂ h₂) ∘ ⇑(patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm) y₀
proof:
:= by
  have hy₀' := hy₀
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]
    at hy₀'
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := hy₀'
  rw [Set.mem_preimage] at hy₂
  
  choose a n ha using fun i : Fin d =>
    exists_mul_pow_eq q.r (q.pres.val ((q.kappaEquiv.symm i).val))
  
  have hbase : ∀ x : S,
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y x) y₀ := fun x =>
    analyticAt_patchChart_symm_apply p φ₁ h₁ x hy₁
  have hr0 : (patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y₀ q.r ≠ 0 :=
    patchChart_source_subset q φ₂ h₂ hy₂
  
  have hg : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun y (i : Fin d) => (patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y (a i)
        * ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y q.r ^ n i)⁻¹) y₀ :=
    AnalyticAt.pi fun i => (hbase (a i)).mul
      (((hbase q.r).pow (n i)).inv (pow_ne_zero _ hr0))
  refine hg.congr ?_
  have hopen := ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm.trans (patchChart q φ₂ h₂)).open_source
  filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hy₀] with y hy
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]
    at hy
  obtain ⟨-, hz₂⟩ := hy
  rw [Set.mem_preimage] at hz₂
  have hzr : (patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y q.r ≠ 0 :=
    patchChart_source_subset q φ₂ h₂ hz₂
  
  rw [Function.comp_apply,
    patchChart_apply q φ₂ h₂ ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y) hzr]
  funext i
  rw [finChart_apply, reindexHomeomorph_apply_symm_index, chartFun_apply,
    awayLift_apply_eq_mul_inv q.r (ha i) ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm y) hzr]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.isManifold_smoothAffine
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartedSpaceSmoothAffine D
  refine isManifold_of_contDiffOn 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω (CPoints S) ?_
  rintro c₁ c₂ ⟨p, φ₁, h₁, rfl⟩ ⟨q, φ₂, h₂, rfl⟩
  simp only [modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm,
    Function.comp_id, Function.id_comp, Set.preimage_id, Set.range_id,
    Set.inter_univ]
  rw [contDiffOn_omega_iff_analyticOn
      ((patchChart p φ₁ h₁).symm.trans (patchChart q φ₂ h₂)).open_source.uniqueDiffOn,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans]
  intro y hy
  exact (analyticAt_patchChart_trans p q φ₁ φ₂ h₁ h₂ hy).analyticWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.exists_cover_of_locally
statement:
theorem exists_cover_of_locally
    (h : RingHom.Locally (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d)
      (algebraMap ℂ S)) :
    ∃ (s : Set S) (_ : Ideal.span s = ⊤), ∀ t ∈ s,
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d ℂ (Localization.Away t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, H⟩ := h
  refine ⟨s, hs, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have h1 := H t ht
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq ℂ S (Localization.Away t)] at h1
  exact (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap d).mp h1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.locally_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem locally_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
    [h : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d ℂ S] :
    RingHom.Locally (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d)
      (algebraMap ℂ S)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.locally_of
    (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso (n := d)) _
    ((RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap d).mpr h)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.exists_chartedSpace_isManifold_of_locally
statement:
theorem exists_chartedSpace_isManifold_of_locally
    (h : RingHom.Locally (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d)
      (algebraMap ℂ S)) :
    ∃ cs : ChartedSpace (Fin d → ℂ) (CPoints S),
      @IsManifold ℂ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω
        (CPoints S) _ cs
proof:
:=
  ⟨chartedSpaceSmoothAffine (patchAssignmentOfLocally h),
    isManifold_smoothAffine (patchAssignmentOfLocally h)⟩

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.locally_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem locally_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (structMor S)] :
    RingHom.Locally (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d)
      (algebraMap ℂ S)
proof:
:= by
  have h : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ S))) := ‹_›
  have h2 := (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff
    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension d)
    (φ := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ S))).mp h
  simpa using h2

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.isManifold_smoothAffineScheme
statement:
theorem isManifold_smoothAffineScheme
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (structMor S)] :
    @IsManifold ℂ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω (CPoints S) _
      (chartedSpaceSmoothAffineScheme S d)
proof:
:=
  isManifold_smoothAffine
    (patchAssignmentOfLocally (locally_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension S d))

name: HodgePilot.ChartsSmoothAffine.exists_chartedSpace_isManifold_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem exists_chartedSpace_isManifold_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (structMor S)] :
    ∃ cs : ChartedSpace (Fin d → ℂ) (CPoints S),
      @IsManifold ℂ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ _ (Fin d → ℂ) _ 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω
        (CPoints S) _ cs
proof:
:=
  ⟨chartedSpaceSmoothAffineScheme S d, isManifold_smoothAffineScheme S d⟩

name: HodgePilot.ComoduleStruct.ext
statement:
theorem ComoduleStruct.ext {inst₁ inst₂ : ComoduleStruct R A M}
    (h : inst₁.coaction = inst₂.coaction) : inst₁ = inst₂
proof:
:= by
  cases inst₁; cases inst₂; congr 1

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.ext
statement:
theorem Comodule.ext {inst₁ inst₂ : Comodule R A M}
    (h : inst₁.coaction = inst₂.coaction) : inst₁ = inst₂
proof:
:= by
  cases inst₁; cases inst₂
  obtain rfl := ComoduleStruct.ext h
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.coaction_counit_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coaction_counit_apply (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.rid R M
      (LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := A))
        (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m)) = m
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (coaction_counit (R := R) (A := A) (M := M)) m

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.lTensor_counit_coaction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lTensor_counit_coaction (m : M) :
    LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := A))
      (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m) = m ⊗ₜ[R] 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply]
  exact coaction_counit_apply m

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.coaction_coassoc_apply
statement:
theorem coaction_coassoc_apply (m : M) :
    LinearMap.rTensor A (coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M))
        (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m) =
      (TensorProduct.assoc R M A A).symm
        (LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A))
          (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m))
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (coaction_coassoc (R := R) (A := A) (M := M)) m

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.assoc_rTensor_coaction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assoc_rTensor_coaction (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R M A A
        (LinearMap.rTensor A (coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M))
          (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m)) =
      LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A))
        (coaction (R := R) (A := A) m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coaction_coassoc_apply]
  exact (TensorProduct.assoc R M A A).apply_symm_apply _

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.coaction_coassoc'
statement:
theorem coaction_coassoc' :
    (TensorProduct.assoc R M A A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor A (coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M)) ∘ₗ coaction =
      LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A)) ∘ₗ coaction
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun m => assoc_rTensor_coaction m

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.sum_counit_smul
statement:
lemma sum_counit_smul (repr : Comodule.Repr R A m ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (repr.right i) • repr.left i = m
proof:
:= by
  have h := coaction_counit_apply (R := R) (A := A) m
  rw [← repr.eq] at h
  simpa [map_sum] using h

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.sum_tmul_counit_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_tmul_counit_eq (repr : Comodule.Repr R A m ι) :

      m ⊗ₜ[R] 1
proof:

name: HodgePilot.Comodule.sum_tmul_tmul_eq

    (m₁ : (i : ι) → Comodule.Repr R A (repr.left i) (κ i))
    (a₂ : (i : ι) → Coalgebra.Repr R (repr.right i) (Λ i)) :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (m₁ i).index,
      (m₁ i).left j ⊗ₜ[R] ((m₁ i).right j ⊗ₜ[R] repr.right i)
      = ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (a₂ i).index,
      repr.left i ⊗ₜ[R] ((a₂ i).left j ⊗ₜ[R] (a₂ i).right j)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [(a₂ _).eq, ← (m₁ _).eq, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum, TensorProduct.sum_tmul,
    ← repr.eq] using assoc_rTensor_coaction (R := R) (A := A) m

name: HodgePilot.ComodHom.isCoactionInvariant_ker
statement:
theorem ComodHom.isCoactionInvariant_ker [Module.Flat R A] (φ : ComodHom R A M N) :
    IsCoactionInvariant A (LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← rTensor_mkQ A (LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap), LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (LinearMap.rTensor A
        ((LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).liftQ φ.toLinearMap le_rfl)) :=
    Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ le_rfl le_rfl))
  apply hinj
  have hφ : LinearMap.rTensor A
        ((LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).liftQ φ.toLinearMap le_rfl) ∘ₗ
      LinearMap.rTensor A (LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).mkQ =
        LinearMap.rTensor A φ.toLinearMap := by
    rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, Submodule.liftQ_mkQ]
  calc LinearMap.rTensor A ((LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).liftQ φ.toLinearMap le_rfl)
        (LinearMap.rTensor A (LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).mkQ
          (ComoduleStruct.coaction (R := R) (A := A) x))
      = LinearMap.rTensor A φ.toLinearMap
          (ComoduleStruct.coaction (R := R) (A := A) x) := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ _
    _ = ComoduleStruct.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (φ.toLinearMap x) :=
        LinearMap.congr_fun φ.coaction_comm x
    _ = 0 := by rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor A
          ((LinearMap.ker φ.toLinearMap).liftQ φ.toLinearMap le_rfl) 0 :=
        (map_zero _).symm

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.zModValueIso_naturality
statement:
theorem zModValueIso_naturality {A B : AddCommGrpCat.{0}} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse.map f ≫ (zModValueIso B).hom =
      (zModValueIso A).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom f.hom.toIntLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).functor.map_injective
  have h1 : (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).functor.map ((zModValueIso B).hom) =
      ((zModAbEquivalence.{0}).counitIso.app B).hom :=
    (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).fullyFaithfulFunctor.map_preimage _
  have h2 : (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).functor.map ((zModValueIso A).hom) =
      ((zModAbEquivalence.{0}).counitIso.app A).hom :=
    (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).fullyFaithfulFunctor.map_preimage _
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, h1, h2]
  have h3 : (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).functor.map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom f.hom.toIntLinearMap) = f := by
    ext x
    rfl
  rw [h3]
  exact (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).counit.naturality f

:= by
  have hδ : dAbSite φ 1 = (drComplexAbSite φ).d 1 2 := by
    rw [drComplexAbSite_d]
    rfl
  rw [hδ]
  exact dlogSite_comp_d φ

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.drSiteValueIso_comp_d
statement:
theorem drSiteValueIso_comp_d (p : ℕ) :
    (drSiteValueIso φ p).hom ≫ dPresheafZ φ p =
      Functor.whiskerRight (dAbSite φ p) (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse ≫
        (drSiteValueIso φ (p + 1)).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  exact (zModValueIso_naturality ((dAbSite φ p).app U)).symm

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.dlogMod_comp_d
statement: theorem dlogMod_comp_d : dlogMod φ ≫ dPresheafZ φ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dlogMod, Category.assoc, drSiteValueIso_comp_d φ 1, ← Category.assoc]
  have hz : Functor.whiskerRight (dlogSite φ) (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (dAbSite φ 1) (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse = 0 := by
    refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
    show (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse.map ((dlogSite φ).app U) ≫
        (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse.map ((dAbSite φ 1).app U) = 0
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← NatTrans.comp_app, dlogSite_comp_dAbSite φ]
    show (zModAbEquivalence.{0}).inverse.map 0 = 0
    exact Functor.map_zero _ _ _
  rw [hz, Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.dlogWedgePresheaf_comp_d
statement:
theorem dlogWedgePresheaf_comp_d :
    dlogWedgePresheaf φ ≫ dPresheafZ φ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  show ((dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ dlogMod φ) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ 1 1) ≫
    dPresheafZ φ (1 + 1) = 0
  rw [Category.assoc, wedgePresheafZ_d φ 1 1, Preadditive.comp_add,
    Preadditive.comp_zsmul]
  have h1 : (dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ dlogMod φ) ≫
      ((dPresheafZ φ 1 ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (presheafZ φ 1)) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ (1 + 1) 1 ≫
        (presheafZCongr φ (Nat.add_right_comm 1 1 1)).hom) = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, dlogMod_comp_d,
      Category.comp_id, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_tensor, Limits.zero_comp]
  have h2 : (dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ dlogMod φ) ≫
      ((𝟙 (presheafZ φ 1) ⊗ₘ dPresheafZ φ 1) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ 1 (1 + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, dlogMod_comp_d,
      Category.comp_id, MonoidalPreadditive.tensor_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  rw [h1, h2, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.dlogWedgeRestricted_comp_d
statement:
theorem dlogWedgeRestricted_comp_d :
    dlogWedgeRestricted φ ≫ dPresheafZ φ 2 = 0
proof:
:=
  dlogWedgePresheaf_comp_d φ

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedTargetWedge_comp_d
statement:
theorem pairedTargetWedge_comp_d :
    pairedTargetWedge φ ≫ dSheafZ φ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairedTargetWedge, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc
    ((presheafToSheaf _ _).map (dlogWedgeRestricted φ)), map_comp_counit]
  have hw : dlogWedgeRestricted φ ≫ (dSheafZ φ 2).hom = 0 :=
    dlogWedgeRestricted_comp_d φ
  rw [hw, Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedTargetWedge_comp_complex_d
statement:
theorem pairedTargetWedge_comp_complex_d :
    pairedTargetWedge φ ≫ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ).d 2 3 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ).d 2 3 = dSheafZ φ 2 :=
    deRhamSheafZComplexN_d φ 2
  rw [hd]
  exact pairedTargetWedge_comp_d φ

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedIntoFull_apply
statement:
theorem pairedIntoFull_apply (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)
    (e₂ : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    pairedIntoFull φ x e₂ =
      affineZHyperHMap X (pairAnchorAffine X)
        (ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 2) 4
        (pairedIntoTrunc φ x e₂)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedIntoFull_mem
statement:
theorem pairedIntoFull_mem (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)
    (e₂ : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    pairedIntoFull φ x e₂ ∈
      affineZHodgeFiltration X (pairAnchorAffine X)
        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 2 4
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨pairedIntoTrunc φ x e₂, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedClassInto_coe
statement:
theorem pairedClassInto_coe (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)
    (e₂ : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    (pairedClassInto φ x e₂ :
      affineZHyperH X (pairAnchorAffine X) (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 4) =
      pairedIntoFull φ x e₂
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedClassInto_zero_right
statement:
theorem pairedClassInto_zero_right (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X) :
    pairedClassInto φ x (0 : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero _

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedClassInto_principal_left
statement:
theorem pairedClassInto_principal_left (y : pairAnchor X ⟶ (cartierSCMod X).X₂)
    (e₂ : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    pairedClassInto φ (y ≫ (cartierSCMod X).g) e₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [pairedClassInto_coe, pairedIntoFull_apply]
  have h0 : pairedIntoTrunc φ (y ≫ (cartierSCMod X).g) e₂ = 0 := by
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ))
    show (chernShapeTwo (pairAnchorAffine X) (pairedTargetAffine X)
        (brutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 2) (pairedSingleTwo φ))
        (((toAffineSite X).mapExtAddHom (pairAnchor X) (pairedTarget X) 2)
          (pairedClassHom X (y ≫ (cartierSCMod X).g) e₂)) = 0
    rw [pairedClassHom_apply, pairedClass_principal_left X y e₂, map_zero,
      map_zero]
  rw [h0, map_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CyclePairing.pairedClassInto_divOf_left
statement:
theorem pairedClassInto_divOf_left (f : Additive (X.functionField)ˣ)
    (e₂ : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    pairedClassInto φ (pairData X (divOf X f)) e₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairData_divOf_factors]
  exact pairedClassInto_principal_left φ _ e₂

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMapFree_mem_rel
statement:
theorem locMapFree_mem_rel {n : ℕ} {x : DRFree B n} (hx : x ∈ rel A B n) :
    locMapFree A B f n x = 0
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.Quotient.mk _ = 0
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact mapFree_mem_rel_of_mem _ hx

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem locMap_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    locMap A B f n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single
        (fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t i))
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [locMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply]
  show Submodule.Quotient.mk _ = _
  rw [mapFree_single]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_gen
statement:
theorem locMap_gen {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) :
    locMap A B f n (gen A B t) =
      gen A (Localization.Away f) (fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, locMap_mk_single, map_one, gen]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_eq_map
statement:
theorem locMap_eq_map {n : ℕ} (x : DR A B n) :
    locMap A B f n x =
      map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B (Localization.Away f)) n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | single t s =>
      rw [locMap_mk_single, map_mk_single]
      simp only [IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']
      rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_locMap
statement:
theorem d_locMap (n : ℕ) (x : DR A B n) :
    d A (Localization.Away f) n (locMap A B f n x) =
      locMap A B f (n + 1) (d A B n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [locMap_eq_map, locMap_eq_map]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun
    (d_comp_map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B (Localization.Away f)) n) x

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.isUnit_powers_end
statement:
theorem isUnit_powers_end (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module B M]
    [Module (Localization.Away f) M] [IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away f) M]
    (s : Submonoid.powers f) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap B (Module.End B M) (s : B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : IsUnit (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B)) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units _ s
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    simp only [Module.algebraMap_end_apply] at hxy
    have h2 : (u : Localization.Away f) • x = (u : Localization.Away f) • y := by
      rw [hu, algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul]
      exact hxy
    have h3 := congrArg (fun z => ((u⁻¹ : (Localization.Away f)ˣ) :
      Localization.Away f) • z) h2
    simpa only [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] using h3
  · intro y
    refine ⟨((u⁻¹ : (Localization.Away f)ˣ) : Localization.Away f) • y, ?_⟩
    rw [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : B), ← hu,
      smul_smul, Units.mul_inv, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drOneEquiv_symm_D
statement:
theorem drOneEquiv_symm_D (x : B) :
    (drOneEquiv A B).symm (D A B x) = gen A B (fun _ => x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, gen, drOneEquiv_mk_single, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.fin_one_tuple_eq
statement:
theorem fin_one_tuple_eq {α M : Type*} (g : α → M) (t : Fin 1 → α) :
    (fun i => g (t i)) = (fun _ : Fin 1 => g (t 0))
proof:
:=
  funext fun i => by rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_one_eq
statement:
theorem locMap_one_eq :
    locMap A B f 1 =
      (((drOneEquiv A (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars B).symm.toLinearMap.comp
        (KaehlerDifferential.map A A B (Localization.Away f))).comp
        ((drOneEquiv A B).restrictScalars B).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  have e1 : ((drOneEquiv A B).restrictScalars B) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      s • D A B (t 0) := drOneEquiv_mk_single A B t s
  have e2 : ((drOneEquiv A (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars B).symm
      (s • D A (Localization.Away f) (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t 0))) =
      s • gen A (Localization.Away f)
        (fun _ => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t 0)) := by
    rw [map_smul]
    exact congrArg (s • ·) (drOneEquiv_symm_D A (Localization.Away f) _)
  rw [e1, map_smul, KaehlerDifferential.map_D, e2, locMap_mk_single,
    mk_single_eq_smul_gen, fin_one_tuple_eq (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f)) t,
    algebraMap_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_mem_imageSpan_aux
statement:
theorem gen_mem_imageSpan_aux (n m : ℕ) :
    ∀ t : Fin n → Localization.Away f,
      (∀ j : Fin n, m ≤ (j : ℕ) →
        t j ∈ Set.range (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f))) →
      gen A (Localization.Away f) t ∈ imageSpan A B f n
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro t ht
      choose t0 ht0 using fun j => ht j (Nat.zero_le _)
      have htt : t = fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t0 i) := by
        funext i
        rw [ht0 i]
      rw [htt]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨t0, rfl⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      intro t ht
      by_cases hm : m < n
      · set i : Fin n := ⟨m, hm⟩ with hi
        obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, hbs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers f) (t i)
        have h1 : gen A (Localization.Away f)
            (update t i (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b)) ∈ imageSpan A B f n := by
          refine ih _ fun j hj => ?_
          rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
          · rw [Function.update_self]
            exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
            refine ht j ?_
            have hne' : (j : ℕ) ≠ m := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
            omega
        have h2 : gen A (Localization.Away f)
            (update t i (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B))) ∈
            imageSpan A B f n := by
          refine ih _ fun j hj => ?_
          rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
          · rw [Function.update_self]
            exact ⟨(s : B), rfl⟩
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
            refine ht j ?_
            have hne' : (j : ℕ) ≠ m := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
            omega
        have key : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B) •
            gen A (Localization.Away f) t =
            gen A (Localization.Away f)
              (update t i (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b)) -
            t i • gen A (Localization.Away f)
              (update t i (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B))) := by
          have hmul := gen_update_mul A (Localization.Away f) t i
            (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B)) (t i)
          rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hmul
          have harg : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B) * t i =
              algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b := by
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact hbs
          rw [harg] at hmul
          rw [hmul]
          abel
        have hin : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B) •
            gen A (Localization.Away f) t ∈ imageSpan A B f n := by
          rw [key]
          exact Submodule.sub_mem _ h1 (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away f) s
        have hfin := Submodule.smul_mem (imageSpan A B f n)
          ((u⁻¹ : (Localization.Away f)ˣ) : Localization.Away f) hin
        rwa [← hu, smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] at hfin
      · exact ih t fun j hj => absurd hj (by have := j.isLt; omega)

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_mem_imageSpan
statement:
theorem gen_mem_imageSpan {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f) :
    gen A (Localization.Away f) t ∈ imageSpan A B f n
proof:
:=
  gen_mem_imageSpan_aux A B f n n t
    (fun j hj => absurd hj (by have := j.isLt; omega))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.imageSpan_eq_top
statement: theorem imageSpan_eq_top (n : ℕ) : imageSpan A B f n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | single t s =>
      rw [mk_single_eq_smul_gen]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ s (gen_mem_imageSpan A B f t)

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.exists_smul_eq_locMap
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_locMap {n : ℕ} (y : DR A (Localization.Away f) n)
    (hy : y ∈ imageSpan A B f n) :
    ∃ (z : DR A B n) (s : Submonoid.powers f), s • y = locMap A B f n z
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨gen A B t, 1, by rw [one_smul, locMap_gen]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 1, by rw [smul_zero, map_zero]⟩
  | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
      obtain ⟨zu, su, hu⟩ := hu
      obtain ⟨zv, sv, hv⟩ := hv
      rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hu hv
      refine ⟨(sv : B) • zu + (su : B) • zv, su * sv, ?_⟩
      have key : (((su * sv : Submonoid.powers f) : B)) • (u + v) =
          (sv : B) • ((su : B) • u) + (su : B) • ((sv : B) • v) := by
        rw [Submonoid.coe_mul]
        module
      rw [Submonoid.smul_def, key, hu, hv, ← LinearMap.map_smul, ← LinearMap.map_smul,
        ← map_add]
  | smul c y _ hy =>
      obtain ⟨z, s, hs⟩ := hy
      rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
      have hs2 : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B) • y = locMap A B f n z := by
        rw [algebraMap_smul]
        exact hs
      obtain ⟨⟨b, u⟩, hbu⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers f) c
      dsimp only at hbu
      refine ⟨b • z, u * s, ?_⟩
      rw [Submonoid.smul_def, ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f)
        (((u * s : Submonoid.powers f) : B)) (c • y), Submonoid.coe_mul, map_mul,
        smul_smul]
      rw [show (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (u : B) *
            algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B)) * c =
          algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b *
            algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (s : B) by
        rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, hbu]]
      rw [← smul_smul, hs2, algebraMap_smul, ← LinearMap.map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_surj
statement:
theorem locMap_surj (n : ℕ) (y : DR A (Localization.Away f) n) :
    ∃ p : DR A B n × Submonoid.powers f, p.2 • y = locMap A B f n p.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, s, h⟩ := exists_smul_eq_locMap A B f y
    (by rw [imageSpan_eq_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top)
  exact ⟨(z, s), h⟩

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeInnerFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem wedgeInnerFree_single (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    wedgeInnerFree A B n x (single t s) = s • gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeInnerFree, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_wedgeInnerFree
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_wedgeInnerFree (x : B) :
    rel A B n ≤ LinearMap.ker (wedgeInnerFree A B n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, x', y', rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x', y', rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, wedgeInnerFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, gen_update_add]
    abel
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, wedgeInnerFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, Fin.cons_update, gen_update_mul]
    abel
  · simp only [wedgeInnerFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [Fin.cons_update]
    exact gen_update_algebraMap A B _ i.succ a
  · simp only [wedgeInnerFree_single, one_smul]
    exact gen_eq_zero A B (i := i.succ) (j := j.succ)
      (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ h)) (by simp [Fin.cons_succ, htij])

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeInner_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem wedgeInner_mk_single (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    wedgeInner A B n x (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      s • gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeInner, Submodule.liftQ_apply, wedgeInnerFree_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeInner_add
statement:
theorem wedgeInner_add (x y : B) :
    wedgeInner A B n (x + y) = wedgeInner A B n x + wedgeInner A B n y
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply,
    LinearMap.add_apply, wedgeInner_mk_single, gen_cons_add, smul_add]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeInner_mul
statement:
theorem wedgeInner_mul (x y : B) :
    wedgeInner A B n (x * y) = x • wedgeInner A B n y + y • wedgeInner A B n x
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, wedgeInner_mk_single, gen_cons_mul]
  module

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeInner_algebraMap
statement:
theorem wedgeInner_algebraMap (a : A) :
    wedgeInner A B n (algebraMap A B a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_comp, wedgeInner_mk_single,
    gen_cons_algebraMap, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem wedgeFree_single (t1 : Fin 1 → B) (s : B) :
    wedgeFree A B n (single t1 s) = s • wedgeInner A B n (t1 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeFree, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_wedgeFree
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_wedgeFree :
    rel A B 1 ≤ LinearMap.ker (wedgeFree A B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, x', y', rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x', y', rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, wedgeFree_single, one_smul, update_fin_one_apply]
    rw [wedgeInner_add]
    abel
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, wedgeFree_single, one_smul, update_fin_one_apply]
    rw [wedgeInner_mul]
    abel
  · simp only [wedgeFree_single, one_smul, update_fin_one_apply]
    exact wedgeInner_algebraMap A B n a
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem wedgeP_mk_single (t1 : Fin 1 → B) (s1 : B) (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    wedgeP A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t1 s1))
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      (s1 * s) • gen A B (Fin.cons (t1 0) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeP, Submodule.liftQ_apply, wedgeFree_single, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    wedgeInner_mk_single, smul_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_gen
statement:
theorem wedgeP_gen (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) :
    wedgeP A B n (gen A B (fun _ => x)) (gen A B t) = gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, gen, wedgeP_mk_single, mul_one, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.fin_one_update_eq
statement:
theorem fin_one_update_eq {α : Type v} (t t' : Fin 1 → α) :
    update t 0 (t' 0) = t'
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [update_fin_one_apply (B := α), Subsingleton.elim j 0]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_one_flip
statement:
theorem wedgeP_one_flip :
    (wedgeP A B 1).flip = - wedgeP A B 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t2 => LinearMap.ext fun s2 => ?_)
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t1 => LinearMap.ext fun s1 => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.neg_comp, wedgeP_mk_single]
  have hswap := gen_cons_cons_swap A B (t1 0) (t2 0) t1 0
  rw [fin_one_update_eq t1 t2, fin_one_update_eq t1 t1] at hswap
  rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hswap]
  module

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_one_swap
statement:
theorem wedgeP_one_swap (ω η : DR A B 1) :
    wedgeP A B 1 η ω = - wedgeP A B 1 ω η
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun (wedgeP_one_flip A B) ω) η
  simpa only [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply] using h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_one_self
statement: theorem wedgeP_one_self (ω : DR A B 1) : wedgeP A B 1 ω ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ω
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
        LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂,
        wedgeP_one_swap A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk w₁) (Submodule.Quotient.mk w₂)]
      abel
  | single t s =>
      rw [wedgeP_mk_single]
      have hz : gen A B (Fin.cons (t 0) t) = 0 :=
        gen_eq_zero A B (i := (0 : Fin 2)) (j := (1 : Fin 2)) (by decide)
          (by rw [Fin.cons_zero, show (1 : Fin 2) = Fin.succ 0 from rfl, Fin.cons_succ])
      rw [hz, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_cons_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gen_cons_cons_add_eq_zero {m : ℕ} (x y : B) (s : Fin m → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons x (Fin.cons y s)) + gen A B (Fin.cons y (Fin.cons x s)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_cons_cons_swap A B x y (Fin.cons y s) 0
  rwa [Fin.update_cons_zero, Fin.update_cons_zero] at h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_cons_self
statement:
theorem gen_cons_cons_self {m : ℕ} (x : B) (s : Fin m → B) :
    gen A B (Fin.cons x (Fin.cons x s)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine gen_eq_zero A B (i := (0 : Fin (m + 2))) (j := (1 : Fin (m + 2)))
    (fun h => absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp)) ?_
  rw [Fin.cons_zero, ← Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_wedgeP_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wedgeP_wedgeP_add_eq_zero (m : ℕ) (ξ η : DR A B 1) (ω : DR A B m) :
    wedgeP A B (m + 1) ξ (wedgeP A B m η ω) +
      wedgeP A B (m + 1) η (wedgeP A B m ξ ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ω
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add]
      rw [add_add_add_comm, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  | single t s =>
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ξ
      induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
          rw [add_add_add_comm, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
      | single u su =>
          obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ η
          induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
          | zero => simp
          | add v₁ v₂ h₁ h₂ =>
              simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
              rw [add_add_add_comm, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
          | single v sv =>
              simp only [wedgeP_mk_single, map_smul]
              rw [gen, gen]
              simp only [wedgeP_mk_single, mul_one]
              rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
                (gen_cons_cons_add_eq_zero A B (v 0) (u 0) t)]
              module

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeP_wedgeP_self
statement:
theorem wedgeP_wedgeP_self (m : ℕ) (ξ : DR A B 1) (ω : DR A B m) :
    wedgeP A B (m + 1) ξ (wedgeP A B m ξ ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ξ
  induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [h₁, h₂, zero_add, add_zero]
      exact wedgeP_wedgeP_add_eq_zero A B m (Submodule.Quotient.mk u₂)
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk u₁) ω
  | single u su =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ω
      induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add]
          rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]
      | single t s =>
          simp only [wedgeP_mk_single, map_smul]
          rw [gen]
          simp only [wedgeP_mk_single, mul_one]
          rw [gen_cons_cons_self, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.smul_cancel_of_unit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away f) s
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun z => ((u⁻¹ : (Localization.Away f)ˣ) : Localization.Away f) • z) h
  simp only [← hu, smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul, smul_zero] at h2
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.update_fin_one_const
statement:
theorem update_fin_one_const {α : Type v} (t : Fin 1 → α) (v : α) :
    update t 0 v = fun _ : Fin 1 => v
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [update_fin_one_apply (B := α)]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen1f_add
statement:
theorem gen1f_add (x y : Localization.Away f) :
    gen1f A B f (x + y) = gen1f A B f x + gen1f A B f y
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_add A (Localization.Away f) (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) 0 x y
  simp only [update_fin_one_const] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen1f_mul
statement:
theorem gen1f_mul (x y : Localization.Away f) :
    gen1f A B f (x * y) = x • gen1f A B f y + y • gen1f A B f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_mul A (Localization.Away f) (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) 0 x y
  simp only [update_fin_one_const] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen1f_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gen1f_algebraMap (a : A) :
    gen1f A B f (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f) a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : Localization.Away f)) 0 a
  simp only [update_fin_one_const] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_gen_one
statement:
theorem locMap_gen_one (x : B) :
    locMap A B f 1 (gen A B (fun _ => x)) =
      gen1f A B f (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [locMap_gen]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeLocMixed_locMap
statement:
theorem wedgeLocMixed_locMap (n : ℕ) (w : DR A B 1) (z : DR A B n) :
    wedgeLocMixed A B f n (locMap A B f 1 w)
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n) z) =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B (n + 1))
        (wedgeP A B n w z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : wedgeLocMixed A B f n (locMap A B f 1 w) =
      wedgeLocMixedHom A B f n (wedgeP A B n w) := by
    show wedgeLocMixed0 A B f n (locMap A B f 1 w) = _
    rw [wedgeLocMixed0, IsLocalizedModule.lift_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [h1]
  simp only [wedgeLocMixedHom, IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars_apply_apply,
    IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeLocMixed_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wedgeLocMixed_add_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (p q : DR A (Localization.Away f) 1)
    (z : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)) :
    wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n q z) +
      wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) q (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨wp, sp⟩, hp⟩ := locMap_surj A B f 1 p
  obtain ⟨⟨wq, sq⟩, hq⟩ := locMap_surj A B f 1 q
  obtain ⟨⟨zz, sz⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers f)
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)) z
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hp hq hz
  have hp' : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p = locMap A B f 1 wp := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hp
  have hq' : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) • q = locMap A B f 1 wq := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hq
  have hz' : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) • z =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n) zz := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hz
  have e1 : wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p)
      (wedgeLocMixed A B f n (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) • q)
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) • z)) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) •
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) •
          (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
            wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n q z))) := by
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  have e2 : wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) • q)
      (wedgeLocMixed A B f n (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p)
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) • z)) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) •
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
          (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) •
            wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) q (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z))) := by
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  have key : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) •
      (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B) •
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
          (wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n q z) +
            wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) q (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z)))) = 0 := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_add, smul_add,
      smul_comm (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sq : B))
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B))
        (wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) q (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z)),
      ← e1, ← e2, hp', hq', hz']
    simp only [wedgeLocMixed_locMap]
    rw [← map_add, wedgeP_wedgeP_add_eq_zero, map_zero]
  exact smul_cancel_of_unit B f sp
    (smul_cancel_of_unit B f sq (smul_cancel_of_unit B f sz key))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.wedgeLocMixed_self
statement:
theorem wedgeLocMixed_self (n : ℕ) (p : DR A (Localization.Away f) 1)
    (z : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)) :
    wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨wp, sp⟩, hp⟩ := locMap_surj A B f 1 p
  obtain ⟨⟨zz, sz⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers f)
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)) z
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hp hz
  have hp' : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p = locMap A B f 1 wp := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hp
  have hz' : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) • z =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n) zz := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hz
  have e : wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p)
      (wedgeLocMixed A B f n (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) • p)
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) • z)) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) •
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
          (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
            wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z))) := by
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  have key : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sz : B) •
      (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (sp : B) •
          wedgeLocMixed A B f (n + 1) p (wedgeLocMixed A B f n p z))) = 0 := by
    rw [← e, hp', hz', wedgeLocMixed_locMap, wedgeLocMixed_locMap,
      wedgeP_wedgeP_self, map_zero]
  exact smul_cancel_of_unit B f sp
    (smul_cancel_of_unit B f sp (smul_cancel_of_unit B f sz key))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_zero
statement:
theorem retractVal_zero (t : Fin 0 → Localization.Away f) :
    retractVal A B f 0 t = LocalizedModule.mk (gen A B Fin.elim0) 1
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_succ
statement:
theorem retractVal_succ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → Localization.Away f) :
    retractVal A B f (n + 1) t =
      wedgeLocMixed A B f n (gen1f A B f (t 0))
        (retractVal A B f n (Fin.tail t))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_update_add
statement:
theorem retractVal_update_add (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f) (i : Fin n) (x y : Localization.Away f),
      retractVal A B f n (update t i (x + y)) =
        retractVal A B f n (update t i x) + retractVal A B f n (update t i y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun t i => i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro t i x y
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Function.update_self, Fin.tail_update_zero]
        rw [gen1f_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Fin.tail_update_succ,
          Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i').symm]
        rw [ih (Fin.tail t) i' x y, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_update_mul
statement:
theorem retractVal_update_mul (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f) (i : Fin n) (x y : Localization.Away f),
      retractVal A B f n (update t i (x * y)) =
        x • retractVal A B f n (update t i y) +
          y • retractVal A B f n (update t i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun t i => i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro t i x y
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Function.update_self, Fin.tail_update_zero]
        rw [gen1f_mul, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
          LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Fin.tail_update_succ,
          Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i').symm]
        rw [ih (Fin.tail t) i' x y, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_update_algebraMap
statement:
theorem retractVal_update_algebraMap (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f) (i : Fin n) (a : A),
      retractVal A B f n (update t i (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f) a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun t i => i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro t i a
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Function.update_self, Fin.tail_update_zero]
        rw [gen1f_algebraMap, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      · simp only [retractVal_succ, Fin.tail_update_succ,
          Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i').symm]
        rw [ih (Fin.tail t) i' a, map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_wedge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem retractVal_wedge_eq_zero (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (s : Fin n → Localization.Away f) (j : Fin n),
      wedgeLocMixed A B f n (gen1f A B f (s j)) (retractVal A B f n s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun s j => j.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro s j
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
      · rw [retractVal_succ]
        exact wedgeLocMixed_self A B f n (gen1f A B f (s 0))
          (retractVal A B f n (Fin.tail s))
      · rw [retractVal_succ]
        have hswap := wedgeLocMixed_add_eq_zero A B f n (gen1f A B f (s j'.succ))
          (gen1f A B f (s 0)) (retractVal A B f n (Fin.tail s))
        have hin : wedgeLocMixed A B f n (gen1f A B f (s j'.succ))
            (retractVal A B f n (Fin.tail s)) = 0 := ih (Fin.tail s) j'
        rw [hin, map_zero, add_zero] at hswap
        exact hswap

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem retractVal_eq_zero (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {t : Fin n → Localization.Away f} {i j : Fin n}, i ≠ j → t i = t j →
      retractVal A B f n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro t i j hij htij; exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro t i j hij htij
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
      · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
        · exact absurd rfl hij
        · rw [retractVal_succ, show t 0 = Fin.tail t j' from htij]
          exact retractVal_wedge_eq_zero A B f n (Fin.tail t) j'
      · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
        · rw [retractVal_succ, show t 0 = Fin.tail t i' from htij.symm]
          exact retractVal_wedge_eq_zero A B f n (Fin.tail t) i'
        · rw [retractVal_succ,
            ih (fun h => hij (congrArg Fin.succ h))
              (show Fin.tail t i' = Fin.tail t j' from htij),
            map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractVal_algebraMap_tuple
statement:
theorem retractVal_algebraMap_tuple (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ t : Fin n → B,
      retractVal A B f n (fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t i)) =
        LocalizedModule.mk (gen A B t) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro t
      rw [retractVal_zero, Subsingleton.elim Fin.elim0 t]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro t
      simp only [retractVal_succ]
      have htail : Fin.tail (fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (t i)) =
          fun i => algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (Fin.tail t i) := rfl
      rw [htail, ih (Fin.tail t),
        show (LocalizedModule.mk (gen A B (Fin.tail t)) 1 :
            LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)) =
          LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)
            (gen A B (Fin.tail t)) from rfl,
        ← locMap_gen_one, wedgeLocMixed_locMap, wedgeP_gen, Fin.cons_self_tail]
      rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retractFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem retractFree_single (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f)
    (s : Localization.Away f) :
    retractFree A B f n (single t s) = s • retractVal A B f n t
proof:
:= by
  rw [retractFree, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_retractFree
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_retractFree (n : ℕ) :
    rel A (Localization.Away f) n ≤ LinearMap.ker (retractFree A B f n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, retractFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [retractVal_update_add A B f n]
    abel
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, retractFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [retractVal_update_mul A B f n]
    abel
  · simp only [retractFree_single, one_smul]
    exact retractVal_update_algebraMap A B f n t i a
  · simp only [retractFree_single, one_smul]
    exact retractVal_eq_zero A B f n hij htij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retract_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem retract_mk_single (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → Localization.Away f)
    (s : Localization.Away f) :
    retract A B f n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      s • retractVal A B f n t
proof:
:= by
  rw [retract, Submodule.liftQ_apply, retractFree_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.retract_comp
statement:
theorem retract_comp (n : ℕ) :
    (retract A B f n).restrictScalars B ∘ₗ locMap A B f n =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (DR A B n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply,
    LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars]
  rw [locMap_mk_single, retract_mk_single, retractVal_algebraMap_tuple A B f n t,
    mk_single_eq_smul_gen, map_smul, algebraMap_smul, LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.locMap_exists_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg (retract A B f n) h
  have e₁ := LinearMap.congr_fun (retract_comp A B f n) x₁
  have e₂ := LinearMap.congr_fun (retract_comp A B f n) x₂
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars] at e₁ e₂
  rw [e₁, e₂, LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap_apply, LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap_apply,
    LocalizedModule.mk_eq] at h2
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h2
  exact ⟨u, by simpa only [one_smul] using hu⟩

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drLocEquiv_mk_one
statement:
theorem drLocEquiv_mk_one (n : ℕ) (z : DR A B n) :
    drLocEquiv A B f n (LocalizedModule.mk z 1) = locMap A B f n z
proof:
:= by
  show IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers f) (locMap A B f n)
    (LocalizedModule.mk z 1) = _
  exact IsLocalizedModule.iso_mk_one (Submonoid.powers f) (locMap A B f n) z

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.constructionDegree_le

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.constructionDegree_zero

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.succ_le_constructionDegree_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf₂ fun e (he : y ∈ F e) => ?_
  have hlt : d < e := by
    by_contra hle
    exact h (hF (not_lt.mp hle) he)
  exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.exclusionDegree_le_constructionDegree
statement:
theorem exclusionDegree_le_constructionDegree {F : ℕ → AddSubgroup M}
    (hF : Monotone F) (y : M) : exclusionDegree F y ≤ constructionDegree F y
proof:
:= by
  refine iSup₂_le fun d (hd : y ∉ F d) => le_iInf₂ fun e (he : y ∈ F e) => ?_
  have hlt : d < e := by by_contra hle; exact hd (hF (not_lt.mp hle) he)
  exact_mod_cast hlt.le

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.constructionDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem constructionDegree_eq_one {F : ℕ → AddSubgroup M} (hF : Monotone F) {y : M}
    (h0 : y ∉ F 0) (h1 : y ∈ F 1) : constructionDegree F y = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simpa using constructionDegree_le h1
  · have := succ_le_constructionDegree_of_notMem hF h0
    simpa using this

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionDegree.spliceP1_exclusionDegree_collapses
statement:
theorem spliceP1_exclusionDegree_collapses
    (y : ↥(affineZHodgeFiltration p1 (pairAnchorAffine p1)
      (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor)))
      ((1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 * ((1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) :
    exclusionDegree spliceP1LevelOneFamily y = ⊥
proof:

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.topology_eq_iInf
statement:
lemma topology_eq_iInf :

proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isInducing_evalGen
statement:
theorem isInducing_evalGen {ι : Type v} (g : ι → A)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range g) = ⊤) :
    IsInducing (fun (φ : CPoints A) (i : ι) => φ (g i))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rw [induced_to_pi, topology_eq_iInf]
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i => iInf_le _ (g i)) (le_iInf fun a => ?_)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (AlgHom.mem_range _).mp
    (show a ∈ (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℂ) g).range by
      rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_range, hg]; exact Algebra.mem_top)
  have hev : (fun φ : CPoints A => φ a) =
      (fun v : ι → ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval v p) ∘ (fun (φ : CPoints A) (i : ι) => φ (g i)) := by
    funext φ
    have h1 : φ a = MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => φ (g i)) p := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hp]
      exact MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply ..
    rw [h1, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self, MvPolynomial.eval₂_id]
    rfl
  calc ⨅ i, TopologicalSpace.induced (fun φ : CPoints A => φ (g i)) inferInstance
      = TopologicalSpace.induced (fun (φ : CPoints A) (i : ι) => φ (g i)) Pi.topologicalSpace :=
        (induced_to_pi _).symm
    _ ≤ TopologicalSpace.induced (fun (φ : CPoints A) (i : ι) => φ (g i))
          (TopologicalSpace.induced (fun v : ι → ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval v p) inferInstance) :=
        induced_mono (continuous_iff_le_induced.mp (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval p))
    _ = TopologicalSpace.induced (fun φ : CPoints A => φ a) inferInstance := by
        rw [induced_compose, ← hev]

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.injective_evalGen
statement:
theorem injective_evalGen {ι : Type v} (g : ι → A)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range g) = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (fun (φ : CPoints A) (i : ι) => φ (g i))
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ h
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range g) ≤ AlgHom.equalizer φ ψ :=
    Algebra.adjoin_le (by rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact congrFun h i)
  exact AlgHom.ext fun a => hle (by rw [hg]; exact Algebra.mem_top)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isEmbedding_evalGen

proof:

  ⟨isInducing_evalGen g hg, injective_evalGen g hg⟩

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.comap_comp
statement:
theorem comap_comp {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {C : Type w} [CommRing C] [Algebra ℂ C] (f : A →ₐ[ℂ] B) (g : B →ₐ[ℂ] C) :
    comap (g.comp f) = comap (A := A) f ∘ comap (A := B) g
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isClosedEmbedding_comap
statement:
theorem isClosedEmbedding_comap {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (f : A →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    IsClosedEmbedding (comap (A := A) f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [topology_eq_iInf (A := B), topology_eq_iInf (A := A), induced_iInf]
    simp only [induced_compose, Function.comp_def, comap, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    exact (hf.iInf_comp _).symm
  · intro ψ₁ ψ₂ h
    refine AlgHom.ext fun b => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hf b
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun h a
  · have hrange : Set.range (comap (A := A) f) =
        ⋂ a ∈ RingHom.ker f, {φ : CPoints A | φ a = 0} := by
      ext φ
      simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ a ha
        have hfa : f a = 0 := ha
        simp [comap, hfa]
      · intro hker
        refine ⟨(Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (RingHom.ker f) φ hker).comp
          (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).symm.toAlgHom, ?_⟩
        refine AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_
        have hmk : (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).symm (f a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker f) a := by
          rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
          exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk hf a).symm
        simp [comap, hmk]
    rw [hrange]
    refine isClosed_biInter fun a _ => ?_
    exact isClosed_eq (continuous_ev a) continuous_const

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_toZariski
statement: theorem continuous_toZariski : Continuous (toZariski (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  refine PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.continuous_iff.mpr ?_
  rintro s ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have h : toZariski ⁻¹' (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a : Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) =
      (fun φ : CPoints A => φ a) ⁻¹' ({(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
    ext φ
    simp [toZariski, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen, RingHom.mem_ker]
  rw [h]
  exact isOpen_compl_singleton.preimage (continuous_ev a)

private theorem rid_naturality {P Q : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    [AddCommMonoid Q] [Module R Q] (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R Q).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor R f =
      f ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid R P).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun p r => by simp

name: HodgePilot.rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm
statement:
private theorem rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm {P Q : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P]
    [Module R P] [AddCommMonoid Q] [Module R Q] (j : P →ₗ[R] Q) :
    LinearMap.rTensor A (LinearMap.rTensor A j) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc R P A A).symm.toLinearMap =
      (TensorProduct.assoc R Q A A).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (A ⊗[R] A) j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← LinearMap.rTensor_def, TensorProduct.map_id,
    LinearMap.rTensor_id] using
    TensorProduct.map_map_comp_assoc_symm_eq j (LinearMap.id (M := A))
      (LinearMap.id (M := A))

name: HodgePilot.coassoc_component
statement:
private theorem coassoc_component {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    (j : M →ₗ[R] P) :
    LinearMap.rTensor A
        (LinearMap.rTensor A j ∘ₗ Comodule.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M)) ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M) =
      (TensorProduct.assoc R P A A).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor P (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A)) ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor A j ∘ₗ Comodule.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc, Comodule.coaction_coassoc,
    ← LinearMap.comp_assoc
      (LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A)) ∘ₗ
        Comodule.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M))
      (TensorProduct.assoc R M A A).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.rTensor A (LinearMap.rTensor A j)),
    rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    ← LinearMap.comp_assoc (Comodule.coaction (R := R) (A := A) (M := M))
      (LinearMap.lTensor M (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := A)))
      (LinearMap.rTensor (A ⊗[R] A) j),
    LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor, ← LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc]

proof:
:= ⟨⟨⟨(0 : M ⟶ Y)⟩, fun f => hom_ext f _ (ComodHom.ext fun m => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim m 0]
    simp)⟩⟩
  unique_from Y := ⟨⟨⟨(0 : Y ⟶ M)⟩, fun f => hom_ext f _ (ComodHom.ext fun _ =>
    Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩⟩

name: HodgePilot.rTensor_pairLeft_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem rTensor_pairLeft_assoc_symm (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) :
    LinearMap.rTensor A' (pairLeft f) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ M A A').symm.toLinearMap =
      pairLeft (A := A ⊗[ℚ] A') f
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m w => ?_
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a a' =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, pairLeft_tmul,
        TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [hx, hy]

name: HodgePilot.pairLeft_lTensor
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.sum_tmul_pairLeft
statement:
theorem sum_tmul_pairLeft {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι ℚ M)
    (w : M ⊗[ℚ] A) :
    ∑ i, b i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] pairLeft (b.coord i) w = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m a =>
      have hstep : ∀ i : ι,
          b i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] pairLeft (b.coord i) (m ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a)
            = (b.coord i m • b i) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a := fun i => by
        rw [pairLeft_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      have hm : (∑ i, b.coord i m • b i) = m := by
        simp only [Basis.coord_apply]
        exact b.sum_repr m
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hstep i, ← TensorProduct.sum_tmul,
        hm]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hx,
        hy]

name: HodgePilot.iSup_range_matrixCoeffComodHom_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_range_matrixCoeffComodHom_eq_top :
    (⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
      LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S : Submodule ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) :=
    ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
      LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap with hSdef
  have hq : S.mkQ = (0 : mtCoalgebra V →ₗ[ℚ] mtCoalgebra V ⧸ S) := by
    apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
    intro p
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun f v => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    have hmem : matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
        ∈ LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap :=
      ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem p (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem f hmem)
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro x
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hq x
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hx
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero S).mp hx

name: HodgePilot.coactionCoordHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coactionCoordHom_apply (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) (m : M) :
