      = pairLeft f (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := A) m)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.coaction_eq_sum_coordHom
statement:
theorem coaction_eq_sum_coordHom {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι ℚ M)
    (m : M) :
    Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := A) m
      = ∑ i, b i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coactionCoordHom (A := A) (b.coord i) m
proof:
:=
  (sum_tmul_pairLeft b (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := A) m)).symm

name: HodgePilot.eq_zero_of_forall_coactionCoordHom_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Comodule.coaction_counit_apply (R := ℚ) (A := A) m
  rw [coaction_eq_sum_coordHom b m] at hm
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul] at hm
  have hterm : ∀ i : ι,
      TensorProduct.rid ℚ M
          (b i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := A)
            (coactionCoordHom (A := A) (b.coord i) m)) = 0 := fun i => by
    rw [h i, map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hm
  exact hm.symm

name: HodgePilot.exists_mono_biproduct_regular
statement:
theorem exists_mono_biproduct_regular (M : FComodCat ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ)
      (φ : (ObjectProperty.ι (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))).obj M ⟶
        ⨁ (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))),
      Mono φ
proof:
:= by
  set b := Module.finBasis ℚ M.carrier with hb
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℚ M.carrier,
    biproduct.lift (fun i =>
      (⟨coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i)⟩ :
        (ObjectProperty.ι (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))).obj M ⟶
          ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))), ?_⟩
  constructor
  intro Z g h w
  refine ComodCat.hom_ext _ _ (ComodHom.ext fun z => ?_)
  set gx : M.carrier := g.toComodHom z with hgx
  set hx : M.carrier := h.toComodHom z with hhx
  have key : ∀ i, coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) gx
      = coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) hx := by
    intro i
    have hw := congrArg
      (fun t : Z ⟶ ⨁ (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank ℚ M.carrier) =>
        ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) => t ≫ biproduct.π _ i) w
    simp only [Category.assoc, biproduct.lift_π] at hw
    exact congrArg
      (fun t : Z ⟶ ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) =>
        t.toComodHom z) hw
  have hsub : ∀ i, coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i)
      (gx - hx) = 0 := fun i => by
    rw [map_sub, key i, sub_self]
  have h0 := eq_zero_of_forall_coactionCoordHom_eq_zero b hsub
  show gx = hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

name: HodgePilot.mixLeft_pieceFunctional_memberCoaction
statement:
theorem mixLeft_pieceFunctional_memberCoaction (ab : ℤ × ℤ)
    (X : GeneratedSub V) (x : X.obj.carrier) :
    mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) ((thePresentation V X).coaction x)
      = pieceMap X.obj ab x
proof:
:= by
  rw [(thePresentation V X).coaction_apply, map_sum]
  have hj : ∀ j, mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab)
      (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
        ((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap
        (wordCoaction V ((thePresentation V X).w j)
          (((thePresentation V X).proj j).toLinearMap x)))
      = pieceMap X.obj ab
          (((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap
            (((thePresentation V X).proj j).toLinearMap x)) := by
    intro j
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (mixLeft_rTensor (pieceFunctional V ab)
        ((thePresentation V X).inj j).toLinearMap)
      (wordCoaction V ((thePresentation V X).w j)
        (((thePresentation V X).proj j).toLinearMap x))
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h1
    rw [h1, mixLeft_pieceFunctional_wordCoaction]
    exact (pieceMap_naturality ((thePresentation V X).inj j) ab _).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hj j, ← map_sum]
  exact congrArg (pieceMap X.obj ab) ((thePresentation V X).total_apply x)

name: HodgePilot.ker_rTensor_eq_range_rTensor_subtype
statement:
theorem ker_rTensor_eq_range_rTensor_subtype (f : M₁ →ₗ[ℚ] M₂) :
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.rTensor Q f)
      = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor Q (LinearMap.ker f).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : Function.Exact ((LinearMap.ker f).subtype) f.rangeRestrict := by
    rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict,
      Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hT := rTensor_exact (R := ℚ) Q hex (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f)
  have hcomp : LinearMap.rTensor Q f
      = LinearMap.rTensor Q
          ((LinearMap.range f).subtype ∘ₗ f.rangeRestrict) := by
    rw [subtype_comp_rangeRestrict]
  rw [hcomp, LinearMap.rTensor_comp]
  refine (LinearMap.ker_comp_of_ker_eq_bot _ ?_).trans hT.linearMap_ker_eq
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  exact Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _
    (Submodule.injective_subtype _)

name: HodgePilot.pieceMap_mem_of_comodHom
statement:
theorem pieceMap_mem_of_comodHom (X : GeneratedSub V)
    (g : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) X.obj.carrier T) (S : Submodule ℚ T)
    (hS : ∀ t ∈ S, Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) t
      ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) S.subtype))
    (ab : ℤ × ℤ) {x : X.obj.carrier}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap)) :
    pieceMap X.obj ab x ∈ LinearMap.range
      ((LinearMap.ker (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap)).subtype.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  set N := LinearMap.ker (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap) with hN
  have hgx : g.toLinearMap x ∈ S := by
    have hx' := hx
    rw [hN, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx'
    exact hx'
  have hker : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap)
      ((thePresentation V X).coaction x) = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hg := LinearMap.congr_fun g.coaction_comm x
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hg
    rw [memberComodule_coaction] at hg
    rw [hg]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hS _ hgx
    rw [← hu, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply]
    have hz : S.mkQ ∘ₗ S.subtype = 0 := by
      refine LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact s.2
    rw [hz, LinearMap.rTensor_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hmem : (thePresentation V X).coaction x
      ∈ LinearMap.ker
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap)) :=
    hker
  rw [ker_rTensor_eq_range_rTensor_subtype] at hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hmem
  rw [← mixLeft_pieceFunctional_memberCoaction V ab X x, ← hw]
  have hmix := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (mixLeft_rTensor (pieceFunctional V ab) N.subtype) w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hmix
  rw [hmix]
  refine ⟨mixLeft (pieceFunctional V ab) w, ?_⟩
  exact congrFun (LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor _) _

name: HodgePilot.mem_comapSubHodge_iff
statement:
theorem mem_comapSubHodge_iff (X : GeneratedSub V)
    (g : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) X.obj.carrier T) (S : Submodule ℚ T)
    (hS : ∀ t ∈ S, Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) t
      ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) S.subtype))
    {x : X.obj.carrier} :
    x ∈ (comapSubHodge V X g S hS).toSubmodule ↔ g.toLinearMap x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  show x ∈ LinearMap.ker (S.mkQ ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap) ↔ _
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]

name: HodgePilot.coveredSub_mono
statement:
theorem coveredSub_mono {S₁ S₂ : Submodule ℚ T} (h : S₁ ≤ S₂)
    (hc : CoveredSub V S₂) : CoveredSub V S₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, P, g, hg⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨X, P, g, le_trans h hg⟩

name: HodgePilot.coveredSub_bot
statement:
theorem coveredSub_bot (P₀ : Polarization V.str) :
    CoveredSub V (⊥ : Submodule ℚ T)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(wordIncl V).obj ((0, 0) : WordCat V), wordPolarization P₀ (0, 0), 0,
    bot_le⟩

name: HodgePilot.coveredSub_sup
statement:
theorem coveredSub_sup {S₁ S₂ : Submodule ℚ T} (h₁ : CoveredSub V S₁)
    (h₂ : CoveredSub V S₂) : CoveredSub V (S₁ ⊔ S₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, P, g, hg⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨Y, Q, k, hk⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨prodMember V X Y, P.prod Q,
    g.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberFst V X Y)) +
      k.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberSnd V X Y)), sup_le ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg ht
    refine ⟨((x, 0) : X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier), ?_⟩
    show (g.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberFst V X Y)) +
        k.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberSnd V X Y))) (x, 0)
      = g.toLinearMap x
    have hf : (memberComodHom (prodMemberFst V X Y)) ((x, 0) :
        X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier) = x := rfl
    have hs : (memberComodHom (prodMemberSnd V X Y)) ((x, 0) :
        X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier) = 0 := rfl
    rw [ComodHom.add_apply, ComodHom.comp_apply, ComodHom.comp_apply, hf, hs,
      map_zero, add_zero]
    rfl
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hk ht
    refine ⟨((0, y) : X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier), ?_⟩
    show (g.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberFst V X Y)) +
        k.comp (memberComodHom (prodMemberSnd V X Y))) (0, y)
      = k.toLinearMap y
    have hf : (memberComodHom (prodMemberFst V X Y)) ((0, y) :
        X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier) = 0 := rfl
    have hs : (memberComodHom (prodMemberSnd V X Y)) ((0, y) :
        X.obj.carrier × Y.obj.carrier) = y := rfl
    rw [ComodHom.add_apply, ComodHom.comp_apply, ComodHom.comp_apply, hf, hs,
      map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl

name: HodgePilot.coveredSub_biSup
statement:
theorem coveredSub_biSup {ι : Type} (P₀ : Polarization V.str) (s : Finset ι)
    (Q : ι → Submodule ℚ T) (hQ : ∀ i, CoveredSub V (Q i)) :
    CoveredSub V (⨆ i ∈ s, Q i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have hempty : (⨆ i ∈ (∅ : Finset ι), Q i) = (⊥ : Submodule ℚ T) := by
        simp
      rw [hempty]
      exact coveredSub_bot V P₀
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.iSup_insert]
      exact coveredSub_sup V (hQ a) ih

name: HodgePilot.bot_coaction_stable
statement:
theorem bot_coaction_stable : ∀ t ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℚ T),
    Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) t
      ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (⊥ : Submodule ℚ T).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at ht
  rw [ht, map_zero]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: HodgePilot.exists_comodHom_range_eq
statement:
theorem exists_comodHom_range_eq (X : GeneratedSub V)
    (P : Polarization X.obj.str)
    (g : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) X.obj.carrier T) (S : Submodule ℚ T)
    (hS : ∀ t ∈ S, Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) t
      ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) S.subtype))
    (hle : S ≤ LinearMap.range g.toLinearMap) :
    ∃ (Y : GeneratedSub V) (_ : Polarization Y.obj.str)
      (u : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) Y.obj.carrier T),
      LinearMap.range u.toLinearMap = S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨subMember V X P (comapSubHodge V X g S hS),
    P.restrict (comapSubHodge V X g S hS),
    g.comp (memberComodHom (subMemberIncl V X P (comapSubHodge V X g S hS))),
    le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rintro t ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_comapSubHodge_iff V X g S hS).mp (Submodule.coe_mem y)
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hle ht
    have hxN : x ∈ (comapSubHodge V X g S hS).toSubmodule :=
      (mem_comapSubHodge_iff V X g S hS).mpr (by rw [hx]; exact ht)
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxN⟩, hx⟩

name: HodgePilot.exists_injective_comodHom_range_eq
statement:
theorem exists_injective_comodHom_range_eq (Y : GeneratedSub V)
    (PY : Polarization Y.obj.str)
    (u : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) Y.obj.carrier T) :
    ∃ (Z : GeneratedSub V)
      (v : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) Z.obj.carrier T),
      Function.Injective v.toLinearMap ∧
        LinearMap.range v.toLinearMap = LinearMap.range u.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K : SubHodge Y.obj.str := comapSubHodge V Y u ⊥ (bot_coaction_stable V)
    with hKdef
  set W : SubHodge Y.obj.str := PY.orthoComplement K with hWdef
  refine ⟨subMember V Y PY W,
    u.comp (memberComodHom (subMemberIncl V Y PY W)), ?_, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hker0 : ∀ z : (subMember V Y PY W).obj.carrier,
        (u.comp (memberComodHom (subMemberIncl V Y PY W))).toLinearMap z = 0
          → z = 0 := by
      intro z hz0
      have hmemK : W.toSubmodule.subtype z ∈ K.toSubmodule :=
        (mem_comapSubHodge_iff V Y u ⊥ (bot_coaction_stable V)).mpr
          ((Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).mpr hz0)
      have hmemW : W.toSubmodule.subtype z
          ∈ PY.form.orthogonal K.toSubmodule := z.2
      have h0 : W.toSubmodule.subtype z = 0 :=
        Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (PY.isCompl_orthogonal K).disjoint _
          hmemK hmemW
      exact Subtype.ext h0
    intro a b hab
    have h0 := hker0 (a - b) (by rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
  · 
    rintro t ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨W.toSubmodule.subtype z, rfl⟩
  · 
    rintro t ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hsup2 : K.toSubmodule ⊔ W.toSubmodule = ⊤ :=
      (PY.isCompl_orthogonal K).sup_eq_top
    have hsup : y ∈ K.toSubmodule ⊔ W.toSubmodule := by
      rw [hsup2]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨k, hk, w, hw, hkw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hsup
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    have huk : u.toLinearMap k = 0 :=
      (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).mp
        ((mem_comapSubHodge_iff V Y u ⊥ (bot_coaction_stable V)).mp hk)
    have hvw : (u.comp (memberComodHom (subMemberIncl V Y PY W))).toLinearMap
        (⟨w, hw⟩ : ↥W.toSubmodule) = u.toLinearMap w := rfl
    have hadd := map_add u.toLinearMap k w
    have hw2 : u.toLinearMap w = u.toLinearMap y := by
      rw [← hkw, hadd, huk, zero_add]
    rw [hvw, hw2]

name: HodgePilot.exists_iso_of_injective_covered
statement:
theorem exists_iso_of_injective_covered (M : FComodCat ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
    (Φ : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) M.carrier T)
    (hΦinj : Function.Injective Φ.toLinearMap)
    (hcov : CoveredSub V (LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap)) :
    ∃ Z : GeneratedSub V, Nonempty ((toComod V).obj Z ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨X, P, g, hle⟩ := hcov
  
  have hSstable : ∀ t ∈ LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap,
      Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) t
        ∈ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
            (LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap).subtype) := by
    rintro t ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hco : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap
        (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) x)
        = Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
            (Φ.toLinearMap x) := ComodHom.coaction_comm_apply Φ x
    refine ⟨LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap.rangeRestrict
      (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) x), ?_⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply, subtype_comp_rangeRestrict]
    exact hco
  obtain ⟨Y, PY, u, hrangeu⟩ := exists_comodHom_range_eq V X P g
    (LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) hSstable hle
  obtain ⟨Z, v, hvinj, hrangev0⟩ :=
    exists_injective_comodHom_range_eq V Y PY u
  have hrangev : LinearMap.range v.toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap := hrangev0.trans hrangeu
  
  have hvres_mem : ∀ z : Z.obj.carrier,
      v.toLinearMap z ∈ LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap := by
    intro z
    rw [← hrangev]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  set vres : Z.obj.carrier →ₗ[ℚ] ↥(LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) :=
    v.toLinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) hvres_mem
    with hvres
  have hvres_bij : Function.Bijective vres := by
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      exact hvinj (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      rw [← hrangev] at ht
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ht
      exact ⟨z, Subtype.ext hz⟩
  set eS : M.carrier ≃ₗ[ℚ] ↥(LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective Φ.toLinearMap hΦinj with heS
  set θ : Z.obj.carrier →ₗ[ℚ] M.carrier :=
    (eS.symm : ↥(LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) →ₗ[ℚ] M.carrier) ∘ₗ vres
    with hθ
  have hθbij : Function.Bijective θ := by
    have h := Function.Bijective.comp eS.symm.bijective hvres_bij
    exact h
  
  have hΦsymm : ∀ s : ↥(LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap),
      Φ.toLinearMap (eS.symm s) = (s : T) := by
    intro s
    conv_rhs => rw [← eS.apply_symm_apply s]
    exact (LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply Φ.toLinearMap (eS.symm s)).symm
  have hΦθ : Φ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ θ = v.toLinearMap := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
    exact hΦsymm (vres z)
  
  have hθcomod : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) θ ∘ₗ
      Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) (M := Z.obj.carrier)
      = Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) (M := M.carrier)
          ∘ₗ θ := by
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap) :=
      Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hΦinj
    refine LinearMap.ext fun z => hinj ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hL : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap
        (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) θ
          (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) z))
        = Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
            (v.toLinearMap z) := by
      rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply, hΦθ]
      exact ComodHom.coaction_comm_apply v z
    have hR : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap
        (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) (θ z))
        = Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
            (v.toLinearMap z) := by
      have hco : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) Φ.toLinearMap
          (Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V) (θ z))
          = Comodule.coaction (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
              (Φ.toLinearMap (θ z)) := ComodHom.coaction_comm_apply Φ (θ z)
      rw [hco]
      exact congrArg _ (LinearMap.congr_fun hΦθ z)
    rw [hL, hR]
  set θc : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) Z.obj.carrier M.carrier :=
    ⟨θ, hθcomod⟩ with hθc
  set eθ : Z.obj.carrier ≃ₗ[ℚ] M.carrier :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective θ hθbij with heθ
  set θinv : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) M.carrier Z.obj.carrier :=
    θc.inverse eθ.symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ext fun z => eθ.symm_apply_apply z)
      (LinearMap.ext fun m => eθ.apply_symm_apply m) with hθinv
  refine ⟨Z, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  refine ⟨ObjectProperty.homMk ⟨θc⟩, ObjectProperty.homMk ⟨θinv⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ObjectProperty.hom_ext _ (ComodCat.hom_ext _ _ (ComodHom.ext
      fun z => eθ.symm_apply_apply z))
  · exact ObjectProperty.hom_ext _ (ComodCat.hom_ext _ _ (ComodHom.ext
      fun m => eθ.apply_symm_apply m))

name: HodgePilot.essSurj_toComod_of_polarizable
statement:
theorem essSurj_toComod_of_polarizable (hV : V.Polarizable)
    (M : FComodCat ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) :
    ∃ Z : GeneratedSub V, Nonempty ((toComod V).obj Z ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P₀⟩ := hV
  set n : ℕ := Module.finrank ℚ M.carrier with hn
  set b : Basis (Fin n) ℚ M.carrier := Module.finBasis ℚ M.carrier with hb
  set Treg := ⨁ (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
    with hTreg
  
  set comps : ∀ _ : Fin n,
      ((ObjectProperty.ι (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))).obj M ⟶
        ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) := fun i =>
    (⟨coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i)⟩ :
      (ObjectProperty.ι (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))).obj M ⟶
        ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) with hcomps
  set Φ : ComodHom ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) M.carrier ↥Treg :=
    (biproduct.lift comps).toComodHom with hΦ
  have hπΦ : ∀ (i : Fin n) (x : M.carrier),
      (biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
          i).toComodHom (Φ x)
        = coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) x := by
    intro i x
    have hlift := biproduct.lift_π comps i
    exact congrArg (fun t : (ObjectProperty.ι
      (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))).obj M ⟶
        ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V) => t.toComodHom x) hlift
  have hΦinj : Function.Injective Φ.toLinearMap := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hcoord : ∀ i, coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) x
        = coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) y := by
      intro i
      rw [← hπΦ i x, ← hπΦ i y]
      exact congrArg (fun t : ↥Treg =>
        (biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n =>
          ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i).toComodHom t) hxy
    have hsub : ∀ i, coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i)
        (x - y) = 0 := fun i => by
      rw [map_sub, hcoord i, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_forall_coactionCoordHom_eq_zero b hsub)
  
  set fam : (Fin n × Σ p : ℕ × ℕ,
        Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) → Submodule ℚ ↥Treg :=
    fun σ => LinearMap.range
      (((biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
          σ.1).toComodHom.comp
        (matrixCoeffComodHom V σ.2.1 σ.2.2)).toLinearMap) with hfam
  have hfamCov : ∀ σ, CoveredSub V (fam σ) := by
    intro σ
    refine ⟨(wordIncl V).obj (σ.2.1 : WordCat V),
      wordPolarization P₀ σ.2.1,
      ((biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
          σ.1).toComodHom.comp
        (matrixCoeffComodHom V σ.2.1 σ.2.2)).comp (wordCompare V σ.2.1), ?_⟩
    rintro t ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hmemFam : ∀ x : M.carrier, Φ x ∈ ⨆ σ, fam σ := by
    intro x
    have htot : Φ x = ∑ i,
        (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
            i).toComodHom
          ((biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n =>
              ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i).toComodHom (Φ x)) := by
      calc Φ x
          = ((𝟙 Treg : Treg ⟶ Treg)).toComodHom (Φ x) := rfl
        _ = ((∑ i, biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n =>
              ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i ≫
              biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n =>
                ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i :
              Treg ⟶ Treg)).toComodHom (Φ x) := by
            rw [biproduct.total]
        _ = ∑ i, (biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n =>
              ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i ≫
              biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n =>
                ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i).toComodHom (Φ x) :=
            map_sum (homEvalAddHom (Φ x)) _ _
        _ = ∑ i, (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n =>
              ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i).toComodHom
                ((biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin n =>
                  ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) i).toComodHom (Φ x)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => rfl
    rw [htot]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    rw [hπΦ i x]
    have hc0 : coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) x
        ∈ (⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
          LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap) := by
      rw [iSup_range_matrixCoeffComodHom_eq_top V]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    set ℓ : mtCoalgebra V →ₗ[ℚ] ↥Treg :=
      (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin n => ComodCat.regular ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
        i).toComodHom.toLinearMap with hℓ
    have h1 : ℓ (coactionCoordHom (A := mtCoalgebra V) (b.coord i) x)
        ∈ Submodule.map ℓ
          (⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
            LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap) :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hc0
    rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at h1
    have h2 : (⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ), Submodule.map ℓ
          (⨆ (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
            LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap))
        = ⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
            Submodule.map ℓ
              (LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap) :=
      iSup_congr fun p => Submodule.map_iSup _ _
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : (⨆ (p : ℕ × ℕ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
          Submodule.map ℓ
            (LinearMap.range (matrixCoeffComodHom V p f).toLinearMap))
        ≤ ⨆ σ, fam σ := by
      refine iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun f => ?_
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq (LinearMap.range_comp _ _).symm) ?_
      exact le_iSup fam ⟨i, ⟨p, f⟩⟩
    exact h3 h1
  
  have hcov : CoveredSub V (LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap) := by
    have hgen : ∀ j : Fin n, ∃ s : Finset (Fin n × Σ p : ℕ × ℕ,
        Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)),
        Φ.toLinearMap (b j) ∈ ⨆ σ ∈ s, fam σ :=
      fun j => Submodule.exists_finset_of_mem_iSup fam (hmemFam (b j))
    choose sfun hsfun using hgen
    have hspan : LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap
        = Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (Φ.toLinearMap ∘ b)) := by
      rw [← Submodule.map_top, ← b.span_eq, Submodule.map_span,
        ← Set.range_comp]
    have hle : LinearMap.range Φ.toLinearMap
        ≤ ⨆ σ ∈ Finset.univ.biUnion sfun, fam σ := by
      rw [hspan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro t ⟨j, rfl⟩
      have hj : (⨆ σ ∈ sfun j, fam σ)
          ≤ ⨆ σ ∈ Finset.univ.biUnion sfun, fam σ :=
        biSup_mono fun σ hσ =>
          Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hσ⟩
      exact hj (hsfun j)
    exact coveredSub_mono V hle
      (coveredSub_biSup V P₀ (Finset.univ.biUnion sfun) fam
        fun σ => hfamCov σ)
  exact exists_iso_of_injective_covered V M Φ hΦinj hcov

name: HodgePilot.toComod_isEquivalence
statement:
theorem toComod_isEquivalence (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)
    (hV : V.Polarizable) : (toComod V).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  haveI hfull : (toComod V).Full :=
    ⟨fun {X Y} φ => toComod_full V X Y φ⟩
  haveI hsurj : (toComod V).EssSurj :=
    ⟨fun M => essSurj_toComod_of_polarizable V hV M⟩
  exact {}

name: HodgePilot.toComod_isEquivalence_of_polarizable
statement:
theorem toComod_isEquivalence_of_polarizable (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)
    (hV : V.Polarizable) :
    Nonempty (GeneratedSub V ≌ FComodCat.{0} ℚ (mtCoalgebra V))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toComod_isEquivalence V hV
  exact ⟨(toComod V).asEquivalence⟩

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.isOpen_polydisc
statement:
theorem isOpen_polydisc (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) :
    IsOpen (polydisc c R)
proof:
:=
  isOpen_set_pi Set.finite_univ fun _ _ => isOpen_ball

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.update_mem_closedPolydisc
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_closedPolydisc.2 fun j => ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
  · simpa using ht
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact mem_closedPolydisc.1 hw j

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.separately_differentiableOn_of_differentiableAt
statement:
theorem separately_differentiableOn_of_differentiableAt {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E}
    {U : Set (Fin n → ℂ)}
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ U,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t)) (w i))
    {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ} (hUR : closedPolydisc c R ⊆ U) :
    ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
        (closedBall (c i) (R i))
proof:
:= by
  intro i w hw t ht
  have h := hsep i (Function.update w i t) (hUR (update_mem_closedPolydisc hw ht))
  rw [Function.update_self] at h
  have heq : (fun s => f (Function.update (Function.update w i t) i s))
      = fun s => f (Function.update w i s) :=
    funext fun s => by rw [Function.update_idem]
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h.differentiableWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn
    [CompleteSpace E] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ},
      ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
          (closedBall (c i) (R i))) →
      z ∈ polydisc c R →
      (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
        = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f c z R _ _ _
    have hzc : z = c := Subsingleton.elim z c
    subst hzc
    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_zero, one_smul, pow_zero, torusIntegral_dim0]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f c z R hcont hsep hz
    have hzb : ∀ i, z i ∈ ball (c i) (R i) := mem_polydisc.1 hz
    have hR0 : 0 < R 0 := dist_nonneg.trans_lt (mem_ball.1 (hzb 0))
    have hti : TorusIntegrable (fun w => (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w) c R :=
      torusIntegrable_kernel_smul hz hcont
    have hztail : (z ∘ Fin.succ) ∈ polydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ) :=
      mem_polydisc.2 fun j => hzb j.succ
    
    
    
    have hcong : Set.EqOn
        (fun x : ℂ => ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
          (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
        (fun x : ℂ => (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
          ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))))
        (sphere (c 0) (R 0)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxmem : x ∈ closedBall (c 0) (R 0) := sphere_subset_closedBall hx
      have hconsC : Continuous fun y : Fin n → ℂ =>
          (Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :=
        continuous_const.finCons continuous_id
      have hcontx : ContinuousOn (fun y : Fin n → ℂ => f (Fin.cons x y))
          (closedPolydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ)) :=
        hcont.comp hconsC.continuousOn fun y hy => cons_mem_closedPolydisc hxmem hy
      have hsepx : ∀ (j : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun t => f (Fin.cons x (Function.update w j t)))
            (closedBall ((c ∘ Fin.succ) j) ((R ∘ Fin.succ) j)) := by
        intro j w hw
        have h := hsep j.succ (Fin.cons x w) (cons_mem_closedPolydisc hxmem hw)
        have heq : (fun t => f (Function.update (Fin.cons x w) j.succ t))
            = fun t => f (Fin.cons x (Function.update w j t)) :=
          funext fun t => by rw [Fin.cons_update]
        rw [heq] at h
        exact h
      have hsplit : (fun y : Fin n → ℂ =>
            (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
          = fun y : Fin n → ℂ => (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y)) := by
        funext y
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_smul]
        simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply]
      calc (∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
              (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
          = ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ), (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y)) := by rw [hsplit]
        _ = (x - z 0)⁻¹ • ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
              (∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y) :=
            torusIntegral_smul ((x - z 0)⁻¹)
              (fun y => (∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
              (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ)
        _ = (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
            congrArg (fun t => (x - z 0)⁻¹ • t) (ih hcontx hsepx hztail)
    
    
    have hw0 : (Fin.cons (c 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) ∈ closedPolydisc c R :=
      cons_mem_closedPolydisc (mem_closedBall_self hR0.le)
        (polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc _ _ hztail)
    have h0 := hsep 0 _ hw0
    have heq0 : (fun t : ℂ => f (Function.update (Fin.cons (c 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ)) 0 t))
        = fun t : ℂ => f (Fin.cons t (z ∘ Fin.succ)) :=
      funext fun t => by rw [Fin.update_cons_zero]
    rw [heq0] at h0
    have hslice : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun x : ℂ => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ)))
        (closedBall (c 0) (R 0)) :=
      DifferentiableOn.fun_const_smul h0 _
    calc (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
        = ∮ x in C(c 0, R 0), ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
            (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y) :=
          torusIntegral_succ hti
      _ = ∮ x in C(c 0, R 0), (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
            ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
          circleIntegral.integral_congr hR0.le hcong
      _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) •
            ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons (z 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
          hslice.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (hzb 0)
      _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ (n + 1) • f z := by
          have hzz : Fin.cons (z 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ) = z := Fin.cons_self_tail z
          rw [smul_smul,
            mul_comm (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n),
            ← pow_succ, hzz]

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul_of_cauchy
statement:
theorem hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul_of_cauchy [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R)) (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R)
    (hcauchy : (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
      = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z) :
    HasSum
      (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w)
      ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i := fun i =>
    dist_nonneg.trans_lt (mem_ball.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedPolydisc c R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
  have hMt : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ, ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤ M := fun θ =>
    hM _ (torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc (fun i => (hR i).le) θ)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hMt 0)
  have hzn : ∀ i, ‖z i - c i‖ < R i := fun i =>
    mem_ball_iff_norm.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)
  
  have hGint : ∀ α : Fin n → ℕ,
      TorusIntegrable (fun w =>
        ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) * ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) c R :=
    fun α => torusIntegrable_pow_kernel_smul hR hcont _ α
  have hFint : ∀ α : Fin n → ℕ,
      Integrable (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ =>
        (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)) :=
    fun α => (hGint α).function_integrable
  
  have hptwise : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ,
      HasSum
        (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
          (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
              ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        ((∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))) := by
    intro θ
    have hlt : ∀ i, ‖z i - c i‖ < ‖torusMap c R θ i - c i‖ := fun i => by
      rw [norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]
      exact hzn i
    exact ((hasSum_cauchyKernel hlt).smul_const (f (torusMap c R θ))).const_smul _
  
  have hqs : Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ n * M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i :=
    (summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one
      (fun i => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hR i).le)
      fun i => (div_lt_one (hR i)).mpr (hzn i)).mul_left _
  have hFsum : Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      ∫ θ, ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)) := by
    have hIcc : (volume (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)).toReal =
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ n := by
      rw [Real.volume_Icc_pi_toReal (a := (0 : Fin n → ℝ))
        (Pi.le_def.mpr fun _ => Real.two_pi_pos.le)]
      simp
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun α => integral_nonneg fun θ => norm_nonneg _) (fun α => ?_) hqs
    have hsplit : (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1)) = (∏ i, R i ^ α i) * ∏ i, R i := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => pow_succ _ _
    have hPR : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => hR i
    have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i ^ α i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => pow_pos (hR i) _
    have hpt : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi,
        ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖ ≤
          M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
      intro θ _
      have hjac : ‖∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I‖ =
          ∏ i, R i := by
        rw [Complex.norm_prod]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, Complex.norm_I,
          mul_one, mul_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (hR i).le]
      have hker : ‖(∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹‖ =
          (∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_prod, Complex.norm_prod]
        congr 1
        · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => norm_pow _ _
        · rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [norm_inv, norm_pow, norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]
      have hA : (∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i) =
          (∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) / ∏ i, R i ^ α i := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_div_distrib]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => div_pow _ _ _
      calc ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
              ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖ =
          (∏ i, R i) * (((∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) *
            ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖) := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, hjac, hker]
        _ ≤ (∏ i, R i) * (((∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) * M) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hMt θ) ?_) hPR.le
            exact mul_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hR i).le _))
        _ = M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
            rw [hA, hsplit]
            field_simp
    calc (∫ θ, ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖
          ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) ≤
        ∫ _ in Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi,
          (M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i) ∂volume := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on ((hFint α).norm) ?_ measurableSet_Icc hpt
          exact integrableOn_const measure_Icc_lt_top.ne
      _ = (2 * Real.pi) ^ n * M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
          rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, hIcc]
          ring
  
  have hswap := MeasureTheory.hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm hFint hFsum
  
  have hval : (∫ θ, (∑' α : Fin n → ℕ,
      (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
      ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z := by
    have h1 : (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => ∑' α : Fin n → ℕ,
        (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))) =
        fun θ : Fin n → ℝ =>
          (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)) :=
      funext fun θ => (hptwise θ).tsum_eq
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : (∫ θ, ((∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w := rfl
    rw [h2, hcauchy]
  rw [hval] at hswap
  
  have hterm : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∫ θ,
      (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))
      ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w := by
    funext α
    have h3 : (∫ θ, (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
        ∯ w in T(c, R), ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w := rfl
    rw [h3]
    have h4 : (fun w : Fin n → ℂ => ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
        ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) =
        fun w : Fin n → ℂ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
          ((∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) :=
      funext fun w => mul_smul _ _ _
    rw [h4]
    exact torusIntegral_smul _ _ _ _
  rw [hterm] at hswap
  exact hswap

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_cauchy
statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_cauchy [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R)) (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R)
    (hcauchy : (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
      = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z) :
    HasSum (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α)
      (f z)
proof:
:= by
  have H := (hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul_of_cauchy hcont hz hcauchy).const_smul
    (((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n)⁻¹ : ℂ)
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (two_pi_I_pow_ne_zero n)] at H
  have hfun : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n)⁻¹ •
      ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w)) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α :=
    funext fun α => smul_comm _ _ _
  rw [hfun] at H
  exact H

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries_of_cauchy
statement:
theorem hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries_of_cauchy [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hcauchy : ∀ z ∈ polydisc c R,
      (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
        = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z)
    {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : ∀ i, (r : ℝ) < R i) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f (polydiscSeries f c R) c r
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i := fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt r.coe_nonneg (hrR i)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedPolydisc c R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
  have hMt : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ, ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤ M := fun θ =>
    hM _ (torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc (fun i => (hR i).le) θ)
  refine ⟨le_radius_polydiscSeries hR hMt hrR, ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr hr, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hy' : ∀ i, ‖y i‖ < R i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ‖y‖ₑ < (r : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right] at hy
    have h2 : ‖y‖ < (r : ℝ) := by
      have := enorm_lt_coe.mp h1
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact lt_trans (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_le_pi_norm y i) h2) (hrR i)
  have hcy : c + y ∈ polydisc c R := mem_polydisc.2 fun i => by
    rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
    simpa using hy' i
  have H := hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_cauchy hcont hcy (hcauchy _ hcy)
  have hyc : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      (∏ i, ((c + y) i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, y i ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α := by
    funext α
    congr 1
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp
  rw [hyc] at H
  exact ((Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∑ i, α i).hasSum_iff.mpr H).sigma
    fun m => hasSum_polydiscSeries_fiber f c R m y

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
        (closedBall (c i) (R i)))
    (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R) :
    HasSum (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α)
      (f z)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul_of_cauchy hcont hz
    (torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn hcont hsep hz)

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_of_separately_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_of_separately_differentiableOn [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
        (closedBall (c i) (R i)))
    {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : ∀ i, (r : ℝ) < R i) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f (polydiscSeries f c R) c r
proof:
:=
  hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries_of_cauchy hcont
    (fun _ hz =>
      torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_separately_differentiableOn hcont hsep hz)
    hr hrR

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.analyticAt_center_of_separately_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem analyticAt_center_of_separately_differentiableOn [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
        (closedBall (c i) (R i)))
    (hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ f c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεR⟩ := Pi.exists_forall_pos_add_lt (x := fun _ : Fin n => (0 : ℝ))
    (y := R) hR
  have hεR' : ∀ i, ε < R i := fun i => by simpa using hεR i
  exact (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_of_separately_differentiableOn hcont hsep
    (r := ε.toNNReal) (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hε0)
    fun i => by rw [Real.coe_toNNReal ε hε0.le]; exact hεR' i).analyticAt

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.osgood
statement:
theorem osgood [CompleteSpace E] {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {U : Set (Fin n → ℂ)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hcont : ContinuousOn f U)
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ U,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t)) (w i)) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f U
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU z hz
  have hr0 : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε0
  have hsub : closedPolydisc z (fun _ => ε / 2) ⊆ U := by
    intro w hw
    refine hεU (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε0) ?_)
    rw [closedBall_pi _ hr0.le]
    exact hw
  exact analyticAt_center_of_separately_differentiableOn (hcont.mono hsub)
    (separately_differentiableOn_of_differentiableAt hsep hsub) fun _ => hr0

name: HodgePilot.Osgood.osgood_polydisc
statement:
theorem osgood_polydisc [CompleteSpace E] {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E}
    {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hsep : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ w ∈ closedPolydisc c R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => f (Function.update w i t))
        (closedBall (c i) (R i))) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (polydisc c R)
proof:
:= by
  refine osgood (isOpen_polydisc c R)
    (hcont.mono (polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc c R)) ?_
  intro i w hw
  exact (hsep i w (polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc c R hw) (w i)
      (ball_subset_closedBall (mem_polydisc.1 hw i))).differentiableAt
    (closedBall_mem_nhds_of_mem (mem_polydisc.1 hw i))

name: HodgePilot.TwistedPredicate.twistedLeg_eq_drScale_untwistedLeg
statement:
theorem twistedLeg_eq_drScale_untwistedLeg (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] (p : ℕ)
    (c : bettiQ (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p)) :
    analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
        (toComplexCoeffsTwisted (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) p c) =
      drScale g d p
        (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
          (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) c))
proof:
:= by
  show analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
      (scalePowTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) p
        (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) c)) = _
  show _ =
    analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
      (scalePowTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) p
        ((analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)).symm
          (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
            (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) c))))
  rw [(analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)).symm_apply_apply]

        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ g d))

    (hinv : FiltrationImageScaleInvariant g d u p) :

proof:
:= by
  show analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
      (toComplexCoeffsTwisted (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) p c) ∈ _ ↔ _
  rw [twistedLeg_eq_drScale_untwistedLeg g d p c]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed_X
statement: theorem chartEmbed_X (d : ℤ) : chartEmbed A d Polynomial.X = T d
proof:
:= by
  show Polynomial.aeval (T d) Polynomial.X = T d
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_X]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed_transition
statement:
theorem chartEmbed_transition :
    chartEmbed A 1 Polynomial.X * chartEmbed A (-1) Polynomial.X = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEmbed_X, chartEmbed_X, ← T_add, show (1 : ℤ) + -1 = 0 by norm_num,
    T_zero]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed_support
statement:
theorem chartEmbed_support (d : ℤ) (p : A[X]) :
    ∀ m ∈ (chartEmbed A d p).support, ∃ k : ℕ, m = (k : ℤ) * d
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      intro m hm
      rw [map_add] at hm
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (Finsupp.support_add hm) with h | h
      · exact hp m h
      · exact hq m h
  | monomial n a =>
      intro m hm
      have he : chartEmbed A d ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) =
          AddMonoidAlgebra.single ((n : ℤ) * d) a := by
        show Polynomial.aeval (T d) ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = _
        rw [Polynomial.aeval_monomial, T_pow, ← C_eq_algebraMap,
          ← single_eq_C_mul_T]
      rw [he] at hm
      have h1 := Finsupp.support_single_subset hm
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at h1
      exact ⟨n, h1⟩

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.eulerFun_apply
statement:
theorem eulerFun_apply (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) (m : ℤ) :
    eulerFun A f m = (m : A) * f m
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [eulerFun_zero]
      show (0 : A) = (m : A) * (0 : A)
      rw [mul_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [eulerFun_add]
      have h1 : (eulerFun A f + eulerFun A g) m =
          eulerFun A f m + eulerFun A g m := Finsupp.add_apply _ _ _
      have h2 : (f + g) m = f m + g m := Finsupp.add_apply _ _ _
      rw [h1, h2, hf, hg, mul_add]
  | single n a =>
      rw [eulerFun_single]
      rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | hn
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' hn, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' hn, mul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.mul_eulerFun_apply_zero
statement:
theorem mul_eulerFun_apply_zero {d : ℤ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (x y : A[T;T⁻¹])
    (hx : ∀ m ∈ x.support, ∃ k : ℕ, m = (k : ℤ) * d)
    (hy : ∀ m ∈ y.support, ∃ k : ℕ, m = (k : ℤ) * d) :
    (x * eulerFun A y) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ (x * eulerFun A y).support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h
  rcases Finset.mem_add.mp (AddMonoidAlgebra.support_mul x (eulerFun A y) h0)
    with ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq⟩
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hq (eulerFun_apply_zero A y)
  have hqy : q ∈ y.support := by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hq ⊢
    intro hy0
    exact hq (by rw [eulerFun_apply, hy0, mul_zero])
  obtain ⟨kp, rfl⟩ := hx p hp
  obtain ⟨kq, hkq⟩ := hy q hqy
  have hsum : ((kp : ℤ) + (kq : ℤ)) * d = 0 := by
    rw [add_mul, ← hkq]
    exact hpq
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hsum with hk | hd'
  · have hkq0 : (kq : ℤ) = 0 := by omega
    exact hq0 (by rw [hkq, hkq0, zero_mul])
  · exact hd hd'

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residue_add
statement:
theorem residue_add (x y : overlapOneForms A) :
    ContentAnchor.residue A (x + y) =
      ContentAnchor.residue A x + ContentAnchor.residue A y
proof:
:= by
  show (eulerDerivation A).liftKaehlerDifferential
      (drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹] (x + y)) 0 =
    ContentAnchor.residue A x + ContentAnchor.residue A y
  rw [map_add, map_add]
  exact Finsupp.add_apply _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residue_smul
statement:
theorem residue_smul (c : A) (ω : overlapOneForms A) :
    ContentAnchor.residue A (c • ω) = c * ContentAnchor.residue A ω
proof:
:= by
  have hC : algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] c = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (0 : ℤ) c := by
    rw [← C_eq_algebraMap, single_eq_C_mul_T, T_zero, mul_one]
  show (eulerDerivation A).liftKaehlerDifferential
      (drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹] (c • ω)) 0 = c * ContentAnchor.residue A ω
  rw [← algebraMap_smul A[T;T⁻¹] c ω, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hC,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero_mul_apply]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueLin_apply (ω : overlapOneForms A) :
    residueLin A ω = ContentAnchor.residue A ω
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_dlog_tUnit
statement:
theorem residueLin_dlog_tUnit :
    residueLin A (DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A)) = 1
proof:
:=
  residue_dlog_tUnit A

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residue_mk_single
statement:
theorem residue_mk_single (t : Fin 1 → A[T;T⁻¹]) (s : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    ContentAnchor.residue A (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)) =
      (s * eulerFun A (t 0)) 0
proof:
:= by
  show (eulerDerivation A).liftKaehlerDifferential
      (drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹] (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s))) 0 =
    (s * eulerFun A (t 0)) 0
  rw [drOneEquiv_mk_single, map_smul, Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D,
    eulerDerivation_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_chartRes
statement:
theorem residueLin_chartRes (d : ℤ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (ω : chartOneForms A) :
    residueLin A (chartRes A d ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ω
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, hf, hg, add_zero]
  | single t s =>
      show ContentAnchor.residue A (DeRham.map (chartEmbed A d) 1
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s))) = 0
      rw [map_mk_single, residue_mk_single]
      have hcomp : (⇑(chartEmbed A d) ∘ t) 0 = chartEmbed A d (t 0) := rfl
      rw [hcomp]
      exact mul_eulerFun_apply_zero A hd _ _
        (chartEmbed_support A d s) (chartEmbed_support A d (t 0))

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_zChart
statement:
theorem residueLin_zChart (ω : chartOneForms A) :
    residueLin A (chartRes A 1 ω) = 0
proof:
:=
  residueLin_chartRes A 1 one_ne_zero ω

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_wChart
statement:
theorem residueLin_wChart (ω : chartOneForms A) :
    residueLin A (chartRes A (-1) ω) = 0
proof:
:=
  residueLin_chartRes A (-1) (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero) ω

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.chartDifference_apply
statement:
theorem chartDifference_apply (a b : chartOneForms A) :
    chartDifference A (a, b) = chartRes A 1 a - chartRes A (-1) b
proof:
:= by
  show LinearMap.coprod (chartRes A 1) (- chartRes A (-1)) (a, b) =
    chartRes A 1 a - chartRes A (-1) b
  rw [LinearMap.coprod_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueLin_chartDifference
statement:
theorem residueLin_chartDifference (x : chartOneForms A × chartOneForms A) :
    residueLin A (chartDifference A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := x
  rw [chartDifference_apply, map_sub, residueLin_zChart, residueLin_wChart,
    sub_zero]

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.dlog_tUnit_not_mem_range_chartDifference
statement:
theorem dlog_tUnit_not_mem_range_chartDifference [Nontrivial A] :
    DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A) ∉ LinearMap.range (chartDifference A)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h := residueLin_chartDifference A x
  rw [hx, residueLin_apply, residue_dlog_tUnit] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.range_chartDifference_le_ker_residueLin
statement:
theorem range_chartDifference_le_ker_residueLin :
    LinearMap.range (chartDifference A) ≤ LinearMap.ker (residueLin A)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (residueLin_chartDifference A y)

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.residueCokernel_edgeClass

name: HodgePilot.TwoChartResidue.edgeClass_ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_prod
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hle : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), (A j).prod (B j)) ≤
      (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), A j).prod (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), B j) :=
    iSup₂_le fun j hj => Submodule.prod_mono
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ i) => A j) j hj)
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ i) => B j) j hj)
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((A i).prod (B i))
      ((⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), A j).prod (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), B j)) := by
    rw [disjoint_iff, Submodule.prod_inf_prod, disjoint_iff.mp (hA i),
      disjoint_iff.mp (hB i), Submodule.prod_bot]
  exact hdisj.mono_right hle

name: HodgePilot.iSup_prod_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Submodule.prod (⨆ i, A i) (⨆ i, B i)) ≤
      ⨆ i, (A i).prod (B i) := by
    rw [LinearMap.prod_eq_sup_map, Submodule.map_iSup, Submodule.map_iSup]
    refine sup_le (iSup_le fun i => ?_) (iSup_le fun i => ?_)
    · rw [Submodule.map_inl]
      exact le_trans (Submodule.prod_mono le_rfl bot_le)
        (le_iSup (fun i => (A i).prod (B i)) i)
    · rw [Submodule.map_inr]
      exact le_trans (Submodule.prod_mono bot_le le_rfl)
        (le_iSup (fun i => (A i).prod (B i)) i)
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  calc (⊤ : Submodule R (M × N))
      = Submodule.prod (⊤ : Submodule R M) (⊤ : Submodule R N) :=
        Submodule.prod_top.symm
    _ = Submodule.prod (⨆ i, A i) (⨆ i, B i) := by rw [hA, hB]
    _ ≤ ⨆ i, (A i).prod (B i) := h1

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_prod
statement:
theorem isInternal_prod [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Submodule R M}
    {B : ι → Submodule R N} (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A)
    (hB : DirectSum.IsInternal B) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (A i).prod (B i)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_prod hA.submodule_iSupIndep hB.submodule_iSupIndep)
    (iSup_prod_eq_top hA.submodule_iSup_eq_top hB.submodule_iSup_eq_top)

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_tmul
statement:
theorem prodBaseChange_tmul (c : ℂ) (p : V × W) :
    prodBaseChange V W (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] p) = (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] p.1, c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_tmul_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem prodBaseChange_tmul_pair (c : ℂ) (v : V) (w : W) :
    prodBaseChange V W (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (v, w)) = (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v, c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem prodBaseChange_symm_tmul (c : ℂ) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (prodBaseChange V W).symm (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v, c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) = c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (v, w)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.prodRight_symm_tmul ℚ ℂ ℂ V W c v w

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_sigmaQR
statement:
theorem prodBaseChange_sigmaQR (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V × W)) :
    prodBaseChange V W (sigmaQR (V × W) x) =
      LinearMap.prodMap (sigmaQR V) (sigmaQR W) (prodBaseChange V W x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c p =>
      simp only [sigmaQR_tmul, prodBaseChange_tmul, LinearMap.prodMap_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_prodBaseChange_symm
statement:
theorem sigmaQR_prodBaseChange_symm (y : (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) × (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)) :
    sigmaQR (V × W) ((prodBaseChange V W).symm y) =
      (prodBaseChange V W).symm (sigmaQR V y.1, sigmaQR W y.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (prodBaseChange V W).injective
  rw [prodBaseChange_sigmaQR, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.prodMap_apply]

name: HodgePilot.map_sigma_prodPiece
statement:
theorem map_sigma_prodPiece (P : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
    (Q : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)) :
    ((P.prod Q).map (prodBaseChange V W).symm.toLinearMap).map
        (sigmaQ (V × W)) =
      ((P.map (sigmaQ V)).prod (Q.map (sigmaQ W))).map
        (prodBaseChange V W).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(sigmaQR V s.1, sigmaQR W s.2),
      ⟨Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hs.1, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hs.2⟩,
      (sigmaQR_prodBaseChange_symm V W s).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨t1, t2⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(prodBaseChange V W).symm (a, b),
      ⟨(a, b), Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩,
      sigmaQR_prodBaseChange_symm V W (a, b)⟩

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.prod_H
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.prod_H (M : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (K : QHodgeStructure n W) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (M.prod K).H pq =
      ((M.H pq).prod (K.H pq)).map (prodBaseChange V W).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_baseChange_inl
statement:
theorem prodBaseChange_baseChange_inl (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    prodBaseChange V W ((LinearMap.inl ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ x) = (x, 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; rfl
  | tmul c v =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.inl_apply,
        prodBaseChange_tmul_pair, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
      exact Prod.ext rfl (add_zero (0 : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W))

name: HodgePilot.prodBaseChange_baseChange_inr
statement:
theorem prodBaseChange_baseChange_inr (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    prodBaseChange V W ((LinearMap.inr ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ y) = (0, y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; rfl
  | tmul c w =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.inr_apply,
        prodBaseChange_tmul_pair, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
      exact Prod.ext (add_zero (0 : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) rfl

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_fst
statement:
theorem baseChange_fst (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V × W)) :

proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; rfl
  | tmul c p => rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.fst_apply,
      prodBaseChange_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, Prod.fst_add]

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_snd
statement:
theorem baseChange_snd (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V × W)) :

proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; rfl
  | tmul c p => rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.snd_apply,
      prodBaseChange_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, Prod.snd_add]
