name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isZero_zeroObj
statement: theorem isZero_zeroObj (n : ℤ) : Limits.IsZero (zeroObj.{u} n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton (zeroObj.{u} n).carrier :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton PUnit)
  constructor
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun f => ?_⟩
    apply hom_ext
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0]
    simp
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨⟨0⟩, fun f => ?_⟩
    apply hom_ext
    exact LinearMap.ext fun x => Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_sigma_of_le
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_sigma_of_le {ι : Type*} {κ : ι → Type*} {C : ι → α}
    {A : ∀ i, κ i → α} (hC : iSupIndep C) (hA : ∀ i, iSupIndep (A i))
    (hle : ∀ i k, A i k ≤ C i) :
    iSupIndep fun p : Σ i, κ i => A p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i₀, k₀⟩
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  have hbound : (⨆ (p : Σ i, κ i) (_ : p ≠ ⟨i₀, k₀⟩), A p.1 p.2) ≤
      (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i := by
    refine iSup₂_le ?_
    rintro ⟨i, k⟩ hp
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      have hk : k ≠ k₀ := fun h => hp (by rw [h])
      exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : k ≠ k₀) => A i k) k hk)
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right
        (le_trans (hle i k) (le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : i ≠ i₀) => C i) i hi))
  refine le_trans (inf_le_inf_left _ hbound) ?_
  have hXC : (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ≤ C i₀ := iSup₂_le fun k _ => hle i₀ k
  have hYC : (⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀ = ⊥ := by
    rw [inf_comm]
    exact disjoint_iff.mp (hC i₀)
  have hkey : ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀ =
      ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k := by
    rw [sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hXC, hYC, sup_bot_eq]
  calc A i₀ k₀ ⊓ ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i)
      = A i₀ k₀ ⊓ (((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀) := by
        rw [inf_comm _ (C i₀), ← inf_assoc, inf_of_le_left (hle i₀ k₀)]
    _ = A i₀ k₀ ⊓ ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k := by rw [hkey]
    _ ≤ ⊥ := disjoint_iff_inf_le.mp (hA i₀ k₀)

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_prod_of_le
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i₀, k₀⟩
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  have hbound : (⨆ (p : ι × κ) (_ : p ≠ (i₀, k₀)), A p.1 p.2) ≤
      (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i := by
    refine iSup₂_le ?_
    rintro ⟨i, k⟩ hp
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      have hk : k ≠ k₀ := fun h => hp (by rw [h])
      exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : k ≠ k₀) => A i k) k hk)
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right
        (le_trans (hle i k) (le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : i ≠ i₀) => C i) i hi))
  refine le_trans (inf_le_inf_left _ hbound) ?_
  have hXC : (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ≤ C i₀ := iSup₂_le fun k _ => hle i₀ k
  have hYC : (⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀ = ⊥ := by
    rw [inf_comm]
    exact disjoint_iff.mp (hC i₀)
  have hkey : ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀ =
      ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k := by
    rw [sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hXC, hYC, sup_bot_eq]
  calc A i₀ k₀ ⊓ ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i)
      = A i₀ k₀ ⊓ (((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), C i) ⊓ C i₀) := by
        rw [inf_comm _ (C i₀), ← inf_assoc, inf_of_le_left (hle i₀ k₀)]
    _ = A i₀ k₀ ⊓ ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ k₀), A i₀ k := by rw [hkey]
    _ ≤ ⊥ := disjoint_iff_inf_le.mp (hA i₀ k₀)

name: HodgePilot.biSup_fiber_snd
statement:
theorem biSup_fiber_snd {ι κ : Type*} (f : ι × κ → α) (k : κ) :
    (⨆ (p : ι × κ) (_ : p.2 = k), f p) = ⨆ i, f (i, k)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun p hp => ?_) (iSup_le fun i => ?_)
  · have hB : f p = f (p.1, k) := by rw [← hp]
    rw [hB]
    exact le_iSup (fun i => f (i, k)) p.1
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun p (_ : p.2 = k) => f p) (i, k) rfl

name: HodgePilot.biSup_fiber_fst
statement:
theorem biSup_fiber_fst {ι κ : Type*} (f : ι × κ → α) (i : ι) :
    (⨆ (p : ι × κ) (_ : p.1 = i), f p) = ⨆ k, f (i, k)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun p hp => ?_) (iSup_le fun k => ?_)
  · have hB : f p = f (i, p.2) := by rw [← hp]
    rw [hB]
    exact le_iSup (fun k => f (i, k)) p.2
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun p (_ : p.1 = i) => f p) (i, k) rfl

name: HodgePilot.biSup_fiber_comp
statement:
theorem biSup_fiber_comp {ι κ μ : Type*} (g : κ → ι) (h : ι → μ) (A : κ → α)
    (m : μ) :
    (⨆ (i) (_ : h i = m), ⨆ (k) (_ : g k = i), A k) =
      ⨆ (k) (_ : h (g k) = m), A k
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun i hi => iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_)
    (iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_)
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : h (g k) = m) => A k) k (by rw [hk, hi])
  · refine le_trans ?_
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : h i = m) => ⨆ (k) (_ : g k = i), A k) (g k) hk)
    exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun k' (_ : g k' = g k) => A k') k rfl

name: HodgePilot.biSup_fiber_add
statement:
theorem biSup_fiber_add {γ : Type*} [AddCommGroup γ] (B : γ × γ → α) (n : γ) :
    (⨆ (p : γ × γ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = n), B p) = ⨆ i, B (i, n - i)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun p hp => ?_) (iSup_le fun i => ?_)
  · have hj : p.2 = n - p.1 := by rw [← hp]; abel
    have hB : B p = B (p.1, n - p.1) := by rw [← hj]
    rw [hB]
    exact le_iSup (fun i => B (i, n - i)) p.1
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun p (_ : p.1 + p.2 = n) => B p) (i, n - i)
      (by show i + (n - i) = n; abel)

name: HodgePilot.lof_injective
statement:
theorem lof_injective (i : ι) :
    Function.Injective ⇑(DirectSum.lof R ι N i)
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  simpa only [DirectSum.lof_apply] using congrArg (fun y : ⨁ i, N i => y i) h

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_range_lof
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_range_lof :
    iSupIndep fun i => LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i₀
  have hle : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i₀), LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N j)) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (DirectSum.component R ι N i₀) := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun j hj => ?_
    rintro - ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, DirectSum.component.of, dif_neg hj]
  refine Disjoint.mono_right hle ?_
  rw [disjoint_iff, eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨v, rfl⟩, hker⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hx
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, DirectSum.component.lof_self] at hker
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot, hker, map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.iSup_range_lof_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_range_lof_eq_top :
    (⨆ i, LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    (le_iSup (fun i => LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)) i) ⟨x i, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_range_lof
statement:
theorem isInternal_range_lof :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    iSupIndep_range_lof iSup_range_lof_eq_top

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_map_of_injective {A : κ → Submodule R M} (hA : iSupIndep A)
    {f : M →ₗ[R] M'} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    iSupIndep fun k => (A k).map f
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have hle : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ k), (A j).map f) ≤ (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ k), A j).map f :=
    iSup₂_le fun j hj =>
      Submodule.map_mono (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ k) => A j) j hj)
  refine Disjoint.mono_right hle ?_
  rw [disjoint_iff, ← Submodule.map_inf f hf, disjoint_iff.mp (hA k),
    Submodule.map_bot]

name: HodgePilot.directSumPiece_def
statement:
theorem directSumPiece_def (A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)) (k : κ) :
    directSumPiece A k = ⨆ i, (A i k).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.mem_directSumPiece_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hle : directSumPiece A k ≤
        ⨅ i, (A i k).comap (DirectSum.component R ι N i) := by
      refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
      rintro - ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      rw [Submodule.mem_iInf _]
      intro j
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, DirectSum.component.of]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        rw [dif_pos rfl]
        exact hv
      · rw [dif_neg hij]
        exact (A j k).zero_mem
    intro i
    exact (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp (hle hx) i
  · intro hx
    classical
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      (le_iSup (fun i => (A i k).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N i)) i)
        (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hx i))

name: HodgePilot.directSumPiece_eq_iInf_comap
statement:
theorem directSumPiece_eq_iInf_comap (A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)) (k : κ) :
    directSumPiece A k = ⨅ i, (A i k).comap (DirectSum.component R ι N i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_directSumPiece_iff, Submodule.mem_iInf _]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.directSumPiece_congr
statement:
theorem directSumPiece_congr {A B : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)} {k k' : κ}
    (h : ∀ i, A i k = B i k') : directSumPiece A k = directSumPiece B k'
proof:
:=
  iSup_congr fun i => by rw [h i]

name: HodgePilot.directSumPiece_eq_bot
statement:
theorem directSumPiece_eq_bot {A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)} {k : κ}
    (h : ∀ i, A i k = ⊥) : directSumPiece A k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [directSumPiece_def]
  refine iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun i => ?_
  rw [h i, Submodule.map_bot]

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_map_lof_prod
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_map_lof_prod (A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i))
    (hA : ∀ i, iSupIndep (A i)) :
    iSupIndep fun p : ι × κ => (A p.1 p.2).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N p.1)
proof:
:=
  iSupIndep_prod_of_le iSupIndep_range_lof
    (fun i => iSupIndep_map_of_injective (hA i) (lof_injective i))
    (fun _ _ => LinearMap.map_le_range)

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_directSumPiece
proof:
:= by
  have hfib := iSupIndep_biSup_fiber (iSupIndep_map_lof_prod A hA) Prod.snd
  have hfun : (fun k : κ => ⨆ (p : ι × κ) (_ : p.2 = k),
      (A p.1 p.2).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N p.1)) = directSumPiece A := by
    funext k
    rw [directSumPiece_def]
    exact biSup_fiber_snd
      (fun p : ι × κ => (A p.1 p.2).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N p.1)) k
  rwa [hfun] at hfib

name: HodgePilot.iSup_directSumPiece_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  calc (⨆ k, directSumPiece A k)
      = ⨆ i, ⨆ k, (A i k).map (DirectSum.lof R ι N i) := by
        simp_rw [directSumPiece_def]
        exact iSup_comm
    _ = ⨆ i, LinearMap.range (DirectSum.lof R ι N i) :=
        iSup_congr fun i => by
          rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hA i, Submodule.map_top]
    _ = ⊤ := iSup_range_lof_eq_top

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_directSumPiece
statement:
theorem isInternal_directSumPiece [DecidableEq κ]
    {A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)} (hA : ∀ i, DirectSum.IsInternal (A i)) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (directSumPiece A)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_directSumPiece fun i => (hA i).submodule_iSupIndep)
    (iSup_directSumPiece_eq_top fun i => (hA i).submodule_iSup_eq_top)

name: HodgePilot.directSumPiece_map_of_comm
statement:
theorem directSumPiece_map_of_comm {R' : Type*} [Ring R'] {N' : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (N' i)] [∀ i, Module R' (N' i)]
    {τ : R →+* R'} [RingHomSurjective τ]
    (g : (⨁ i, N i) →ₛₗ[τ] ⨁ i, N' i) (gi : ∀ i, N i →ₛₗ[τ] N' i)
    (hcomm : ∀ i x, g (DirectSum.lof R ι N i x) = DirectSum.lof R' ι N' i (gi i x))
    (A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule R (N i)) (k : κ) :
    (directSumPiece A k).map g =
      directSumPiece (fun i k => (A i k).map (gi i)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [directSumPiece_def, directSumPiece_def, Submodule.map_iSup]
  refine iSup_congr fun i => ?_
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨gi i v, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv, (hcomm i v).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨DirectSum.lof R ι N i v, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv, hcomm i v⟩

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_biSup_fiber_add
statement:
theorem isInternal_biSup_fiber_add {γ : Type*} [AddCommGroup γ] [DecidableEq γ]
    {B : γ × γ → Submodule R M} (hB : DirectSum.IsInternal B) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun n : γ => ⨆ i, B (i, n - i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hB.regroup fun p : γ × γ => p.1 + p.2
  have hfun : (fun n : γ => ⨆ (p : γ × γ) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = n), B p) =
      fun n : γ => ⨆ i, B (i, n - i) := funext fun n => biSup_fiber_add B n
  rwa [hfun] at h

name: HodgePilot.moduleFinite_directSum
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_directSum (S : Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ i, i ∉ S → Subsingleton (N i)) [∀ i, Module.Finite R (N i)] :
    Module.Finite R (⨁ i, N i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Module.Finite R (∀ i : S, N i.val) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite R (⨁ i : S, N i.val) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv
      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R S (fun i : S => N i.val)).symm
  refine Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (DirectSum.toModule R S (⨁ i, N i) fun i => DirectSum.lof R ι N i.val) ?_
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
  have hiS : i ∈ S := by
    by_contra hiS
    haveI := hS i hiS
    exact (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  exact ⟨DirectSum.lof R S (fun j : S => N j.val) ⟨i, hiS⟩ (x i),
    DirectSum.toModule_lof R _ _⟩

name: HodgePilot.moduleFinite_directSum_of_finite
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_directSum_of_finite
    (hS : {i | ¬ Subsingleton (N i)}.Finite) [∀ i, Module.Finite R (N i)] :
    Module.Finite R (⨁ i, N i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine moduleFinite_directSum hS.toFinset fun i hi => ?_
  by_contra h
  exact hi (hS.mem_toFinset.mpr h)

name: HodgePilot.finite_conv_support
proof:
:= by
  refine (hV.add hW).subset ?_
  rintro n ⟨i, hi, hni⟩
  exact Set.mem_add.mpr ⟨i, hi, n - i, hni, by abel⟩

name: HodgePilot.subsingleton_directSum
statement:
theorem subsingleton_directSum {ι : Type*} (N : ι → Type*)
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (N i)] [∀ i, Subsingleton (N i)] :
    Subsingleton (⨁ i, N i)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: HodgePilot.finite_not_subsingleton_conv
statement:
theorem finite_not_subsingleton_conv {γ : Type*} [AddCommGroup γ]
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (P Q : γ → Type*)
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (P i)] [∀ i, Module S (P i)]
    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (Q j)] [∀ j, Module S (Q j)]
    (hP : {i | ¬ Subsingleton (P i)}.Finite)
    (hQ : {j | ¬ Subsingleton (Q j)}.Finite) :
    {n : γ | ¬ Subsingleton (⨁ i, (P i ⊗[S] Q (n - i)))}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_conv_support hP hQ).subset ?_
  intro n hn
  by_contra hcon
  refine hn ?_
  have hall : ∀ i, Subsingleton (P i ⊗[S] Q (n - i)) := by
    intro i
    rcases not_and_or.mp fun h : (¬ Subsingleton (P i)) ∧ ¬ Subsingleton (Q (n - i)) =>
        hcon ⟨i, h.1, h.2⟩ with h | h
    · haveI : Subsingleton (P i) := not_not.mp h
      infer_instance
    · haveI : Subsingleton (Q (n - i)) := not_not.mp h
      infer_instance
  exact inferInstance

name: HodgePilot.directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof (c : ℂ) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
    directSumBaseChange M (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ ι M i m) =
      DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] m)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.directSumRight_tmul_lof ℚ ℂ c i m

name: HodgePilot.directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul (c : ℂ) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
    (directSumBaseChange M).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] m)) =
      c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ ι M i m
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.directSumRight_symm_lof_tmul ℚ ℂ c i m

name: HodgePilot.directSumBaseChange_tmul_apply
statement:
theorem directSumBaseChange_tmul_apply (c : ℂ) (v : ⨁ i, M i) (i : ι) :
    directSumBaseChange M (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) i = c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v i
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.directSumRight_tmul ℚ ℂ c v i

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDiag_lof
statement:
theorem sigmaDiag_lof (i : ι) (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) :
    sigmaDiag M (DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i (sigmaQR (M i) z)
proof:
:= by
  show DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap (fun i => sigmaQR (M i)) (DFinsupp.single i z) =
    DFinsupp.single i (sigmaQR (M i) z)
  simp only [DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, DFinsupp.mapRange_single]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDiag_apply
statement:
theorem sigmaDiag_apply (y : ⨁ i, ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) (i : ι) :
    sigmaDiag M y i = sigmaQR (M i) (y i)
proof:
:= by
  show DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap (fun i => sigmaQR (M i)) y i = sigmaQR (M i) (y i)
  rw [DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, DFinsupp.mapRange_apply]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDiag_sigmaDiag
statement:
theorem sigmaDiag_sigmaDiag (y : ⨁ i, ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) :
    sigmaDiag M (sigmaDiag M y) = y
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.ext_component ℚ fun i => ?_
  show sigmaDiag M (sigmaDiag M y) i = y i
  rw [sigmaDiag_apply, sigmaDiag_apply, sigmaQR_involutive]

name: HodgePilot.directSumBaseChange_sigmaQR
statement:
theorem directSumBaseChange_sigmaQR (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ⨁ i, M i) :
    directSumBaseChange M (sigmaQR (⨁ i, M i) x) =
      sigmaDiag M (directSumBaseChange M x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      | of j m =>
          rw [sigmaQR_tmul, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof,
            directSumBaseChange_tmul_lof, sigmaDiag_lof, sigmaQR_tmul]
      | add v w hv hw =>
          rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hw]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_directSumBaseChange_symm
statement:
theorem sigmaQR_directSumBaseChange_symm (y : ⨁ i, ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) :
    sigmaQR (⨁ i, M i) ((directSumBaseChange M).symm y) =
      (directSumBaseChange M).symm (sigmaDiag M y)
proof:
:= by
  apply (directSumBaseChange M).injective
  rw [directSumBaseChange_sigmaQR, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDiag_mem_directSumPiece
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_directSumPiece_iff] at hy ⊢
  intro i
  rw [sigmaDiag_apply]
  exact ⟨y i, hy i, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.map_sigma_directSumPiece
statement:
theorem map_sigma_directSumPiece {κ : Type*}
    (A : ∀ i, κ → Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i)) (k : κ) :
    ((directSumPiece A k).map (directSumBaseChange M).symm.toLinearMap).map
        (sigmaQ (⨁ i, M i)) =
      (directSumPiece (fun i k => (A i k).map (sigmaQ (M i))) k).map
        (directSumBaseChange M).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨sigmaDiag M s, sigmaDiag_mem_directSumPiece M hs,
      (sigmaQR_directSumBaseChange_symm M s).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(directSumBaseChange M).symm (sigmaDiag M t),
      ⟨sigmaDiag M t, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · have ht' : t ∈ directSumPiece (fun i k => (A i k).map (sigmaQ (M i))) k := ht
      rw [mem_directSumPiece_iff] at ht'
      show sigmaDiag M t ∈ directSumPiece A k
      rw [mem_directSumPiece_iff]
      intro i
      rw [sigmaDiag_apply]
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := ht' i
      rw [← hww, sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQR_involutive]
      exact hw
    · rw [sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQR_directSumBaseChange_symm, sigmaDiag_sigmaDiag]
      rfl

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_lid_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_lid_tensorEquiv (u : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ) (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    (TensorProduct.lid ℚ V).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        (tensorEquiv ℚ V (u ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)) =
      TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ u • z
proof:
:= by
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, zero_smul]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂, add_smul]
  | tmul c q =>
      induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
      | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, smul_add]
      | tmul d v =>
          rw [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
            show (TensorProduct.lid ℚ V).toLinearMap (q ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = q • v from rfl,
            ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul]
          simp only [Rat.smul_def]
          congr 1
          ring

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_rid_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_rid_tensorEquiv (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (u : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ) :
    (TensorProduct.rid ℚ V).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        (tensorEquiv V ℚ (z ⊗ₜ[ℂ] u)) =
      TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ u • z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂, smul_add]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, zero_smul]
      | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, add_smul]
      | tmul d q =>
          rw [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
            show (TensorProduct.rid ℚ V).toLinearMap (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] q) = q • v from rfl,
            ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul]
          simp only [Rat.smul_def]
          congr 1
          ring

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_assoc_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_assoc_tensorEquiv (a : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (b : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)
    (t : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X) :
    (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ V W X).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        (tensorEquiv (V ⊗[ℚ] W) X ((tensorEquiv V W (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] t)) =
      tensorEquiv V (W ⊗[ℚ] X) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (tensorEquiv W X (b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] t)))
proof:
:= by
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c₁ v =>
      induction b using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
      | add b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂]
      | tmul c₂ w =>
          induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
          | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
          | add t₁ t₂ h₁ h₂ =>
              simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
          | tmul c₃ y =>
              simp only [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
                LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.assoc_tmul]
              congr 1
              ring

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_map_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_map_tensorEquiv {V' W' : Type*} [AddCommGroup V']
    [Module ℚ V'] [AddCommGroup W'] [Module ℚ W']
    (φ : V →ₗ[ℚ] V') (ψ : W →ₗ[ℚ] W') (a : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (b : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    (TensorProduct.map φ ψ).baseChange ℂ (tensorEquiv V W (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)) =
      tensorEquiv V' W' ((φ.baseChange ℂ a) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (ψ.baseChange ℂ b))
proof:
:= by
  induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction b using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
      | add b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
            TensorProduct.map_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.assoc_summand_le
statement:
theorem assoc_summand_le (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (k : QHodgeStructure m W)
    (l : QHodgeStructure p X) {uv ef pq : ℤ × ℤ} (hx : uv + ef = pq) :
    ((LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (tensorPiece h k uv) (l.H ef))).map
        (tensorEquiv (V ⊗[ℚ] W) X).toLinearMap).map
      ((TensorProduct.assoc ℚ V W X).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ≤
    tensorPiece h (k.tensor l) pq
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp ht
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hs
  clear hw ht hs
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | tmul s z =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      
      
      have hkey : tensorPiece h k uv ≤ Submodule.comap
          (((TensorProduct.assoc ℚ V W X).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ∘ₗ
            (tensorEquiv (V ⊗[ℚ] W) X).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
            ((TensorProduct.mk ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V ⊗[ℚ] W)) (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X)).flip
              (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X)))
          (tensorPiece h (k.tensor l) pq) := by
        rw [tensorPiece_def h k uv]
        refine iSup₂_le fun y hy => ?_
        intro s' hs'
        obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hs'
        obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp ht'
        clear hs' ht'
        rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
        induction u' using TensorProduct.induction_on with
        | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
            simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
        | tmul a b =>
            simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
              Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.comp_apply,
              LinearMap.flip_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
            rw [baseChange_assoc_tensorEquiv]
            
            have hbz : tensorEquiv W X ((b : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X)) ∈
                (k.tensor l).H (y.2 + ef) := by
              show _ ∈ tensorPiece k l (y.2 + ef)
              have hle : (LinearMap.range
                    (TensorProduct.mapIncl (k.H y.2) (l.H ef))).map
                  (tensorEquiv W X).toLinearMap ≤ tensorPiece k l (y.2 + ef) :=
                le_iSup₂ (f := fun (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
                    (_ : x.1 + x.2 = y.2 + ef) =>
                  (LinearMap.range
                      (TensorProduct.mapIncl (k.H x.1) (l.H x.2))).map
                    (tensorEquiv W X).toLinearMap) (y.2, ef) rfl
              exact hle (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem
                (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z, rfl⟩))
            have hfinal : (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H y.1)
                  ((k.tensor l).H (y.2 + ef)))).map
                (tensorEquiv V (W ⊗[ℚ] X)).toLinearMap ≤
                tensorPiece h (k.tensor l) pq := by
              rw [tensorPiece_def h (k.tensor l) pq]
              refine le_iSup₂ (f := fun (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
                  (_ : x.1 + x.2 = pq) =>
                (LinearMap.range
                    (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) ((k.tensor l).H x.2))).map
                  (tensorEquiv V (W ⊗[ℚ] X)).toLinearMap) (y.1, y.2 + ef) ?_
              show y.1 + (y.2 + ef) = pq
              rw [← add_assoc, hy]
              exact hx
            exact hfinal (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
              ⟨a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (⟨_, hbz⟩ : (k.tensor l).H (y.2 + ef)), rfl⟩))
      have hmem := hkey s.2
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at hmem
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
        TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using hmem

name: HodgePilot.evalHom_assocHom_coevalHom'
statement:
theorem evalHom_assocHom_coevalHom' (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    (((HodgeHom.id h).tensorHom h.evalHom).castWeight (add_zero n)).comp
        (((h.assocHom h.dual h).castWeight
            (show n + (-n + n) = n by omega)).comp
          ((h.coevalHom.tensorHom (HodgeHom.id h)).castWeight (zero_add n))) =
      h.rightUnitorInv.comp h.leftUnitorHom

:= by
  apply HodgeStructCat.hodgeHom_ext
  exact evalHom_assoc_coevalHom' h

            (show -n + (n + -n) = -n by omega)).comp
          (((HodgeHom.id h.dual).tensorHom h.coevalHom).castWeight
            (add_zero (-n)))) =
      (h.dual).leftUnitorInv.comp (h.dual).rightUnitorHom
proof:
:= by
  apply HodgeStructCat.hodgeHom_ext
  exact evalHom_assoc_coevalHom h

statement:
lemma hom_sum_apply {A B : AddCommGrpCat.{0}} {ι' : Type*} (T : Finset ι')
