name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.valAlgHom_apply
statement: theorem valAlgHom_apply (x : Away 𝒜₂ (X01)) : valAlgHom x = x.val
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply x

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.realizePt_apply
statement:
theorem realizePt_apply (w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) (x : Away 𝒜₂ (X01)) :
    realizePt w x =
      Analytic.awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01)) (basePt w)
        (basePt_X01_ne_zero w) x.val
proof:
:= by
  show Analytic.awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01)) (basePt w)
      (basePt_X01_ne_zero w) (valAlgHom x) = _
  rw [valAlgHom_apply]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.realizePt_awayNum
statement: theorem realizePt_awayNum (w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) : realizePt w awayNum = w.1
proof:
:= by
  have hval : awayNum.val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
        (⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)) := by
    unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNum
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  have hspec := congrArg
    (Analytic.awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01)) (basePt w)
      (basePt_X01_ne_zero w))
    (IsLocalization.mk'_spec (Localization.Away (X01))
      (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
      (⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)))
  rw [map_mul, Analytic.awayLift_algebraMap, Analytic.awayLift_algebraMap] at hspec
  have hpow : basePt w
      (((⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)) : Submonoid.powers (X01)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) = w.1 := by
    show basePt w ((X01) ^ 1) = w.1
    rw [pow_one, basePt_X01]
  rw [hpow, basePt_X1_sq] at hspec
  rw [realizePt_apply, hval, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ w.2 hspec

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.realizePt_awayNumInv
statement:
theorem realizePt_awayNumInv (w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) :
    realizePt w awayNumInv = (w.1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hval : awayNumInv.val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 0)
        (⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)) := by
    unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNumInv
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  have hspec := congrArg
    (Analytic.awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01)) (basePt w)
      (basePt_X01_ne_zero w))
    (IsLocalization.mk'_spec (Localization.Away (X01))
      (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 0)
      (⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)))
  rw [map_mul, Analytic.awayLift_algebraMap, Analytic.awayLift_algebraMap] at hspec
  have hpow : basePt w
      (((⟨(X01) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X01)) : Submonoid.powers (X01)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) = w.1 := by
    show basePt w ((X01) ^ 1) = w.1
    rw [pow_one, basePt_X01]
  rw [hpow, basePt_X0_sq] at hspec
  rw [realizePt_apply, hval, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hspec

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.continuous_realizePt
statement: theorem continuous_realizePt : Continuous realizePt
proof:
:= by
  have hcons : Continuous fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => (![1, w.1] : Fin 2 → ℂ) := by
    refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · have h : (fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => (![1, w.1] : Fin 2 → ℂ) 0) =
          fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
        funext w; rw [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [h]; exact continuous_const
    · have h : (fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => (![1, w.1] : Fin 2 → ℂ) j.succ) =
          fun w => w.1 := by
        funext w; rw [Matrix.cons_val_succ, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [h]; exact continuous_subtype_val
  have hbase : Continuous fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => basePt w := by
    refine continuous_induced_rng.2 ?_
    have h2 : (Analytic.toPi (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) ∘
        fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => basePt w) =
        fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} => fun p => MvPolynomial.eval ![1, w.1] p := by
      funext w p
      show MvPolynomial.aeval ![1, w.1] p = MvPolynomial.eval ![1, w.1] p
      rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self, MvPolynomial.eval₂_id]
    rw [h2]
    exact continuous_pi fun p => (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval p).comp hcons
  have hmk : Continuous fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} =>
      (⟨basePt w, basePt_X01_ne_zero w⟩ :
        {φ : CPoints (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) // φ (X01) ≠ 0}) :=
    Continuous.subtype_mk hbase _
  have hlift : Continuous fun w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} =>
      Analytic.awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01)) (basePt w)
        (basePt_X01_ne_zero w) :=
    (Analytic.continuous_awayLift (X01) (Localization.Away (X01))).comp hmk
  exact (Analytic.continuous_comap valAlgHom).comp hlift

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.adjoin_away_units
statement:
theorem adjoin_away_units :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range ![awayNum, awayNumInv]) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  have htop := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.adjoin_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
    (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) hX01 (Fin 2) MvPolynomial.X adjoin_range_X_eq_top
    (fun _ => 1) (fun k => X_mem_grade_one k)
  have hx := htop.ge (Algebra.mem_top (x := x))
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ai, hai, hle, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h3 : ai 0 + ai 1 = a * 2 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hai
    have hle0 : ai 0 ≤ 2 := hle 0
    have hle1 : ai 1 ≤ 2 := hle 1
    have ha2 : a ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hprod : (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ ai 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ ai 1 :=
      Fin.prod_univ_two _
    interval_cases a
    · 
      have hk0 : ai 0 = 0 := by omega
      have hk1 : ai 1 = 0 := by omega
      have hgen : ∀ prf, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ hX01 0
          (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i) prf = 1 := by
        intro prf
        apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
        use 1
        simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, hprod, hk0, hk1, pow_zero]
        try ring
      rw [hgen _]
      exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    · 
      have hk : ai 0 = 0 ∨ ai 0 = 1 ∨ ai 0 = 2 := by omega
      rcases hk with hk0 | hk0 | hk0
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 2 := by omega
        have hgen : ∀ prf, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ hX01 1
            (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i) prf = awayNum := by
          intro prf
          apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
          unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNum
          rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
            Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
          use 1
          simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, hprod, hk0, hk1, pow_zero]
          try ring
        rw [hgen _]
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 1 := by omega
        have hgen : ∀ prf, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ hX01 1
            (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i) prf = 1 := by
          intro prf
          apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
          rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
            ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
          use 1
          simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, hprod, hk0, hk1, pow_one]
          try ring
        rw [hgen _]
        exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 0 := by omega
        have hgen : ∀ prf, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ hX01 1
            (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i) prf = awayNumInv := by
          intro prf
          apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
          unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNumInv
          rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
            Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
          use 1
          simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, hprod, hk0, hk1, pow_zero]
          try ring
        rw [hgen _]
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · 
      have hk0 : ai 0 = 2 := by omega
      have hk1 : ai 1 = 2 := by omega
      have hgen : ∀ prf, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ hX01 2
          (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i) prf = 1 := by
        intro prf
        apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
        use 1
        simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, hprod, hk0, hk1]
        try ring
      rw [hgen _]
      exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
  | algebraMap r =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective.2 r
    have hc : algebraMap (𝒜₂ 0) (Away 𝒜₂ (X01)) (algebraMap ℂ (𝒜₂ 0) c) =
        algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (X01)) c :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℂ (𝒜₂ 0) (Away 𝒜₂ (X01)) c).symm
    rw [hc]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
  | add y w _ _ hy hw => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hy hw
  | mul y w _ _ hy hw => exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hy hw

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.realizePt_evCoord
statement:
theorem realizePt_evCoord (φ : CPoints (Away 𝒜₂ (X01))) :
    realizePt ⟨evCoord φ, evCoord_ne_zero φ⟩ = φ
proof:
:= by
  apply Analytic.injective_evalGen ![awayNum, awayNumInv] adjoin_away_units
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · show realizePt ⟨evCoord φ, evCoord_ne_zero φ⟩
        ((![awayNum, awayNumInv] : Fin 2 → _) 0) =
      φ ((![awayNum, awayNumInv] : Fin 2 → _) 0)
    rw [Matrix.cons_val_zero, realizePt_awayNum]
    rfl
  · show realizePt ⟨evCoord φ, evCoord_ne_zero φ⟩
        ((![awayNum, awayNumInv] : Fin 2 → _) j.succ) =
      φ ((![awayNum, awayNumInv] : Fin 2 → _) j.succ)
    rw [Matrix.cons_val_succ, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, realizePt_awayNumInv]
    have hmul : φ awayNum * φ awayNumInv = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, awayNum_mul_awayNumInv, map_one]
    exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul).symm

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.evCoord_realizePt
statement:
theorem evCoord_realizePt (w : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) :
    evCoord (realizePt w) = w.1
proof:
:=
  realizePt_awayNum w

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.preimage_evCoord_eq
statement:
theorem preimage_evCoord_eq (S : Set ℂ) :
    evCoord ⁻¹' S = realizePt '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  constructor
  · intro hφ
    exact ⟨⟨evCoord φ, evCoord_ne_zero φ⟩, hφ, realizePt_evCoord φ⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    show evCoord (realizePt w) ∈ S
    rw [evCoord_realizePt]
    exact hw

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.slit0_eq_slitPlane
statement: theorem slit0_eq_slitPlane : slit0 = Complex.slitPlane
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.isPreconnected_slit0
statement: theorem isPreconnected_slit0 : IsPreconnected slit0
proof:
:= by
  rw [slit0_eq_slitPlane]
  haveI : ContractibleSpace Complex.slitPlane :=
    Complex.starConvex_one_slitPlane.contractibleSpace
      ⟨1, by rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff, Complex.one_re]; exact Or.inl one_pos⟩
  exact isPreconnected_iff_preconnectedSpace.mpr inferInstance

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.slit1_eq_neg_image
statement: theorem slit1_eq_neg_image : slit1 = (fun z : ℂ => -z) '' slit0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨-z, ?_, neg_neg z⟩
    rcases hz with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (show (0 : ℝ) < (-z).re by
        rw [Complex.neg_re]; exact neg_pos.mpr h)
    · exact Or.inr (show (-z).im ≠ 0 by
        rw [Complex.neg_im]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr h)
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    rcases hu with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (show (-u).re < 0 by
        rw [Complex.neg_re]; exact neg_lt_zero.mpr h)
    · exact Or.inr (show (-u).im ≠ 0 by
        rw [Complex.neg_im]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr h)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.isPreconnected_slit1
statement: theorem isPreconnected_slit1 : IsPreconnected slit1
proof:
:= by
  rw [slit1_eq_neg_image]
  exact isPreconnected_slit0.image _ continuous_neg.continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.slit0_subset
statement: theorem slit0_subset : slit0 ⊆ {z : ℂ | z ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rintro z (h | h) rfl
  · have h' : (0 : ℝ) < (0 : ℂ).re := h
    rw [Complex.zero_re] at h'
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h'
  · exact h Complex.zero_im

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.slit1_subset
statement: theorem slit1_subset : slit1 ⊆ {z : ℂ | z ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rintro z (h | h) rfl
  · have h' : ((0 : ℂ)).re < 0 := h
    rw [Complex.zero_re] at h'
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h'
  · exact h Complex.zero_im

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.isPreconnected_preimage_evCoord
statement:
theorem isPreconnected_preimage_evCoord {S : Set ℂ} (hS : IsPreconnected S)
    (hsub : S ⊆ {z : ℂ | z ≠ 0}) :
    IsPreconnected (evCoord ⁻¹' S)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsPreconnected (Subtype.val ⁻¹' S : Set {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) := by
    have himg : Subtype.val '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' S : Set {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0}) = S := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · rintro y ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact hw
      · intro z hz
        exact ⟨⟨z, hsub hz⟩, hz, rfl⟩
    have hind : Topology.IsInducing (Subtype.val : {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0} → ℂ) :=
      Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal
    refine hind.isPreconnected_image.mp ?_
    rw [himg]
    exact hS
  rw [preimage_evCoord_eq]
  exact h1.image _ continuous_realizePt.continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.isPreconnected_coe_W0
statement: theorem isPreconnected_coe_W0 : IsPreconnected (W0 : Set ↑anP1)
proof:
:= by
  show IsPreconnected (prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit0))
  exact (isPreconnected_preimage_evCoord isPreconnected_slit0 slit0_subset).image _
    prb_isOpenEmbedding.continuous.continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.isPreconnected_coe_W1
statement: theorem isPreconnected_coe_W1 : IsPreconnected (W1 : Set ↑anP1)
proof:
:= by
  show IsPreconnected (prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit1))
  exact (isPreconnected_preimage_evCoord isPreconnected_slit1 slit1_subset).image _
    prb_isOpenEmbedding.continuous.continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.upPt_mem_AUp
statement: theorem upPt_mem_AUp : upPt ∈ AUp
proof:
:= by
  show upPt ∈ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' upperSet)
  refine ⟨realizePt ⟨Complex.I, Complex.I_ne_zero⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
  show evCoord (realizePt ⟨Complex.I, Complex.I_ne_zero⟩) ∈ upperSet
  rw [evCoord_realizePt]
  show (0 : ℝ) < Complex.I.im
  rw [Complex.I_im]
  exact zero_lt_one

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.loPt_mem_BLo
statement: theorem loPt_mem_BLo : loPt ∈ BLo
proof:
:= by
  show loPt ∈ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' lowerSet)
  refine ⟨realizePt ⟨-Complex.I, neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
  show evCoord (realizePt ⟨-Complex.I, neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero⟩) ∈ lowerSet
  rw [evCoord_realizePt]
  show (-Complex.I).im < 0
  rw [Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_im]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr zero_lt_one

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.constOne_eq_constSec
statement: theorem constOne_eq_constSec (W : Opens ↑anP1) : constOne W = constSec 1 W
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.constSec_res
statement:
theorem constSec_res (q : ℚ) {W V : Opens ↑anP1} (h : W ≤ V) :
    FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (constSec q V) = constSec q W
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := (toSheafify JAn constPresheafQ).naturality (homOfLE h).op
  have := congrArg
    (fun (g : constPresheafQ.obj (op V) ⟶ FqAn.obj.obj (op W)) => g (ULift.up q))
    hnat
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.constSec_add
statement:
theorem constSec_add (q r : ℚ) (W : Opens ↑anP1) :
    constSec q W + constSec r W = constSec (q + r) W
proof:
:= by
  show _ = (toSheafify JAn constPresheafQ).app (op W) (ULift.up (q + r))
  rw [show (ULift.up (q + r) : ULift.{0} ℚ) = ULift.up q + ULift.up r from rfl,
    map_add]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.constSec_inj
statement:
theorem constSec_inj {W : Opens ↑anP1} {x : ↑anP1} (hx : x ∈ W) {q r : ℚ}
    (h : constSec q W = constSec r W) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  have hmem0 : Presheaf.equalizerSieve (F := constPresheafQ)
      (ULift.up q) (ULift.up r) ∈ JAn W :=
    Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem JAn (toSheafify JAn constPresheafQ)
      (X := op W) (ULift.up q) (ULift.up r) h
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ W, ∃ (V : Opens ↑anP1) (f : V ⟶ W),
      Presheaf.equalizerSieve (F := constPresheafQ)
        (ULift.up q) (ULift.up r) f ∧ y ∈ V := hmem0
  obtain ⟨V, f, harr, -⟩ := hmem x hx
  have harr' : constPresheafQ.map f.op (ULift.up q) =
      constPresheafQ.map f.op (ULift.up r) := harr
  have hup : (ULift.up q : ULift.{0} ℚ) = ULift.up r := harr'
  exact congrArg ULift.down hup

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.exists_hasVal
statement:
theorem exists_hasVal (U : Opens ↑anP1) (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op U)) {x : ↑anP1}
    (hx : x ∈ U) : ∃ q : ℚ, hasVal U s x q
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ U, ∃ (V : Opens ↑anP1) (f : V ⟶ U),
      Presheaf.imageSieve (toSheafify JAn constPresheafQ) s f ∧ y ∈ V :=
    Presheaf.imageSieve_mem JAn (toSheafify JAn constPresheafQ) s
  obtain ⟨V, f, ⟨t, ht⟩, hxV⟩ := hmem x hx
  refine ⟨t.down, V, f.le, hxV, ?_⟩
  have harr : (homOfLE f.le : V ⟶ U) = f := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [harr]
  exact ht.symm

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.hasVal_unique
statement:
theorem hasVal_unique {U : Opens ↑anP1} {s : FqAn.obj.obj (op U)} {x : ↑anP1}
    {q r : ℚ} (hq : hasVal U s x q) (hr : hasVal U s x r) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, hres⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨V', hVU', hxV', hres'⟩ := hr
  have h1 : FqAn.obj.map
      (homOfLE ((inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V).trans hVU)).op s =
      constSec q (V ⊓ V') := by
    rw [← res_comp (inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V) hVU s, hres, constSec_res]
  have h2 : FqAn.obj.map
      (homOfLE ((inf_le_right : V ⊓ V' ≤ V').trans hVU')).op s =
      constSec r (V ⊓ V') := by
    rw [← res_comp (inf_le_right : V ⊓ V' ≤ V') hVU' s, hres', constSec_res]
  exact constSec_inj (⟨hxV, hxV'⟩ : x ∈ V ⊓ V') (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_spec
statement:
theorem secVal_spec (U : Opens ↑anP1) (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op U)) {x : ↑anP1}
    (hx : x ∈ U) : hasVal U s x (secVal U s x hx)
proof:
:=
  (exists_hasVal U s hx).choose_spec

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_eq_of_witness
proof:
:=
  hasVal_unique (secVal_spec U s (hVU hz)) ⟨V, hVU, hz, hres⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_constSec
statement:
theorem secVal_constSec (q : ℚ) (U : Opens ↑anP1) {x : ↑anP1} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    secVal U (constSec q U) x hx = q
proof:
:= by
  refine hasVal_unique (secVal_spec U (constSec q U) hx) ⟨U, le_refl U, hx, ?_⟩
  rw [show (homOfLE (le_refl U) : U ⟶ U) = 𝟙 U from rfl, op_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_res
statement:
theorem secVal_res {V U : Opens ↑anP1} (hVU : V ≤ U) (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op U))
    {x : ↑anP1} (hxV : x ∈ V) :
    secVal V (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) x hxV =
      secVal U s x (hVU hxV)
proof:
:= by
  refine hasVal_unique (secVal_spec V _ hxV) ?_
  obtain ⟨W, hWU, hxW, hres⟩ := secVal_spec U s (hVU hxV)
  refine ⟨W ⊓ V, inf_le_right, ⟨hxW, hxV⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [res_comp (inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ≤ V) hVU s,
    ← res_comp (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ≤ W) hWU s, hres, constSec_res]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_add
proof:
:= by
  refine hasVal_unique (secVal_spec U (s + t) hx) ?_
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, hres⟩ := secVal_spec U s hx
  obtain ⟨V', hVU', hxV', hres'⟩ := secVal_spec U t hx
  refine ⟨V ⊓ V', (inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V).trans hVU, ⟨hxV, hxV'⟩, ?_⟩
  have hs : FqAn.obj.map
      (homOfLE ((inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V).trans hVU)).op s =
      constSec (secVal U s x hx) (V ⊓ V') := by
    rw [← res_comp (inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V) hVU s, hres, constSec_res]
  have ht : FqAn.obj.map
      (homOfLE ((inf_le_right : V ⊓ V' ≤ V').trans hVU')).op t =
      constSec (secVal U t x hx) (V ⊓ V') := by
    rw [← res_comp (inf_le_right : V ⊓ V' ≤ V') hVU' t, hres', constSec_res]
  rw [map_add, hs, ht, constSec_add]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.secVal_congr_pt
statement:
theorem secVal_congr_pt {U : Opens ↑anP1}
    (hU : IsPreconnected (U : Set ↑anP1)) (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op U))
    {x y : ↑anP1} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    secVal U s x hx = secVal U s y hy
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hU
  have hlc : IsLocallyConstant
      (fun p : (U : Set ↑anP1) => secVal U s p.1 p.2) := by
    refine (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).mpr fun p => ?_
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hpV, hres⟩ := secVal_spec U s p.2
    refine ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (V : Set ↑anP1),
      V.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val, hpV, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h1 : secVal U s z.1 z.2 = secVal U s z.1 (hVU hz) := rfl
    have h2 : secVal U s p.1 p.2 = secVal U s p.1 (hVU hpV) := rfl
    rw [h1, h2, secVal_eq_of_witness hVU hres hz, secVal_eq_of_witness hVU hres hpV]
  have := hlc.apply_eq_of_isPreconnected isPreconnected_univ
    (Set.mem_univ (⟨x, hx⟩ : (U : Set ↑anP1)))
    (Set.mem_univ (⟨y, hy⟩ : (U : Set ↑anP1)))
  exact this

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.valA_constOne
statement: theorem valA_constOne : valA (constOne AUp) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show secVal AUp (constOne AUp) upPt upPt_mem_AUp = 1
  rw [constOne_eq_constSec]
  exact secVal_constSec 1 AUp upPt_mem_AUp

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.valA_valB_compat_W0
statement:
theorem valA_valB_compat_W0 (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op W0)) :
    valA (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE aUp_le_W0).op s) =
      valB (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE bLo_le_W0).op s)
proof:
:= by
  show secVal AUp _ upPt upPt_mem_AUp = secVal BLo _ loPt loPt_mem_BLo
  rw [secVal_res aUp_le_W0 s upPt_mem_AUp, secVal_res bLo_le_W0 s loPt_mem_BLo]
  exact secVal_congr_pt isPreconnected_coe_W0 s
    (aUp_le_W0 upPt_mem_AUp) (bLo_le_W0 loPt_mem_BLo)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.valA_valB_compat_W1
statement:
theorem valA_valB_compat_W1 (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op W1)) :
    valA (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE aUp_le_W1).op s) =
      valB (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE bLo_le_W1).op s)
proof:
:= by
  show secVal AUp _ upPt upPt_mem_AUp = secVal BLo _ loPt loPt_mem_BLo
  rw [secVal_res aUp_le_W1 s upPt_mem_AUp, secVal_res bLo_le_W1 s loPt_mem_BLo]
  exact secVal_congr_pt isPreconnected_coe_W1 s
    (aUp_le_W1 upPt_mem_AUp) (bLo_le_W1 loPt_mem_BLo)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.edgeOne_ne_zero
statement: theorem edgeOne_ne_zero : PredicateAcceptance.edgeOne ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  edgeOne_ne_zero_of_wallInput wallInput

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.edgeTwoRaw_ne_zero_of_receipts
statement:
theorem edgeTwoRaw_ne_zero_of_receipts (h0 : AnalyticChartOneVanishingV0)
    (h1 : AnalyticChartOneVanishingV1) : edgeTwoRaw ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hδ : (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).δ FqAn 1 2 rfl
      PredicateAcceptance.edgeOne = 0 := hz
  have hex := ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).sequence_exact FqAn 1 2 rfl).exact 1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).mp hex
    PredicateAcceptance.edgeOne hδ
  have hb' : (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).fromBiprod FqAn 1 b =
      PredicateAcceptance.edgeOne := hb
  obtain ⟨⟨a0, a1⟩, rfl⟩ :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.symm.surjective b
  rw [Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv_symm_apply,
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply FqAn a0 a1]
    at hb'
  haveI hs2 : Subsingleton
      (FqAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).X₂) := h0
  haveI hs3 : Subsingleton
      (FqAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).X₃) := h1
  have ha0 : a0 = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hs2 a0 0
  have ha1 : a1 = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hs3 a1 0
  rw [ha0, ha1, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero] at hb'
  exact edgeOne_ne_zero hb'.symm

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.bettiEdgeClass_ne_zero_of_receipts
statement:
theorem bettiEdgeClass_ne_zero_of_receipts (h0 : AnalyticChartOneVanishingV0)
    (h1 : AnalyticChartOneVanishingV1) :
    PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply edgeTwoRaw_ne_zero_of_receipts h0 h1
  have h2 : PredicateAcceptance.edgeTwo = 0 := by
    have h' : hPrimeTopEquivH (⊤ : Opens ↑anP1) (opensTopTerminal anP1) FqAn 2
        PredicateAcceptance.edgeTwo = 0 := h
    have hz := congrArg
      (hPrimeTopEquivH (⊤ : Opens ↑anP1) (opensTopTerminal anP1) FqAn 2).symm h'
    rwa [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_zero] at hz
  have h2' : (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft (Y := FqAn)
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) V0_sup_V1)) 2) edgeTwoRaw = 0 := h2
  have h3 := congrArg (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft (Y := FqAn)
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) V0_sup_V1)) 2).symm h2'
  rwa [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_zero] at h3

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallA.toComplexCoeffs_injective
statement:
theorem toComplexCoeffs_injective (X : TopCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (Betti.toComplexCoeffs X n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hid : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map Betti.coeffHom ≫
      (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map coeffRetract =
      𝟙 ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℚ))) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, coeffHom_comp_coeffRetract,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  have hx := Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply
    ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      Betti.coeffHom)
    ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      coeffRetract) x
  have hy := Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply
    ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      Betti.coeffHom)
    ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      coeffRetract) y
  rw [hid, Sheaf.H.map_id_apply] at hx hy
  calc x = Sheaf.H.map
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          coeffRetract) n (Betti.toComplexCoeffs X n x) := hx
    _ = Sheaf.H.map
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          coeffRetract) n (Betti.toComplexCoeffs X n y) := by rw [h]
    _ = y := hy.symm

theorem sigmaQR_baseChange (g : V →ₗ[ℚ] W) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.baseChange_proj_comm
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.baseChange_proj_comm (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (u : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    ((hW.isInternal.proj pq (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u) : hW.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)
      = f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        ((hV.isInternal.proj pq u : hV.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {ab : ℤ × ℤ | hV.H ab ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep hV.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hmem : ∀ ab : ℤ × ℤ,
      f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        ((hV.isInternal.proj ab u : hV.H ab) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ∈ hW.H ab :=
    fun ab =>
      f.maps_pieces ab (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hV.isInternal.proj ab u).2)
  have hfu : f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u
      = ∑ ab ∈ hfin.toFinset, f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
          ((hV.isInternal.proj ab u : hV.H ab) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) := by
    rw [← map_sum]
    exact congrArg _
      (hV.isInternal.sum_coe_proj u fun ab hab => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hab).symm
  by_cases hpq : pq ∈ hfin.toFinset
  · have hproj : hW.isInternal.proj pq (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u)
        = ⟨f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
            ((hV.isInternal.proj pq u : hV.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V), hmem pq⟩ := by
      rw [hfu, map_sum,
        Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem pq hpq
          (fun ab _ hne => hW.isInternal.proj_of_mem_ne hne (hmem ab)),
        hW.isInternal.proj_of_mem (hmem pq)]
    rw [hproj]
  · have hbot : hV.H pq = ⊥ := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hpq (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hne)
    have hz : ((hV.isInternal.proj pq u : hV.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = 0 :=
      (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot _ (hV.isInternal.proj pq u).2
    have hL : hW.isInternal.proj pq (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u) = 0 := by
      rw [hfu, map_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ab hab =>
        hW.isInternal.proj_of_mem_ne (fun h => hpq (by rwa [h] at hab)) (hmem ab)
    rw [hL, hz, map_zero]
    exact ZeroMemClass.coe_zero _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.map_H_eq_range_inf
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.map_H_eq_range_inf (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (hV.H pq).map (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ)
      = LinearMap.range (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ⊓ hW.H pq
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_inf LinearMap.map_le_range (f.maps_pieces pq)) ?_
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨hwr, hwH⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hw
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hwr
  refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr
    ⟨((hV.isInternal.proj pq u : hV.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V),
      (hV.isInternal.proj pq u).2, ?_⟩
  have h1 := f.baseChange_proj_comm pq u
  rw [hW.isInternal.proj_of_mem hwH] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.comap_of_injective
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.comap_of_injective
    (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A) {j : M' →ₗ[R] M}
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hfin : {i | A i ≠ ⊥}.Finite)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : ι) (x : M), x ∈ LinearMap.range j →
      ((hA.proj i x : A i) : M) ∈ LinearMap.range j) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (A i).comap j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hxi hxsup
    have hji : j x ∈ A i := Submodule.mem_comap.mp hxi
    have hjsup : j x ∈ ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), A k := by
      have hle : (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), (A k).comap j)
          ≤ ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), A k)).comap j :=
        iSup₂_le fun k hk =>
          Submodule.comap_mono (le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : k ≠ i) => A k) k hk)
      exact Submodule.mem_comap.mp (hle hxsup)
    have hz : j x = 0 :=
      Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (hA.submodule_iSupIndep i) (j x) hji hjsup
    exact hj (by rw [hz, map_zero])
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hex : ∀ i : ι, ∃ y : M', j y = ((hA.proj i (j x) : A i) : M) := fun i =>
      LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hinv i (j x) (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩))
    choose y hy using hex
    have hsum : j (∑ i ∈ hfin.toFinset, y i) = j x := by
      rw [map_sum]
      calc (∑ i ∈ hfin.toFinset, j (y i))
          = ∑ i ∈ hfin.toFinset, ((hA.proj i (j x) : A i) : M) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hy i
        _ = j x := hA.sum_coe_proj (j x) fun i hi => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hi
    have hxeq : x = ∑ i ∈ hfin.toFinset, y i := (hj hsum).symm
    rw [hxeq]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, hy i]
    exact (hA.proj i (j x)).2

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.map_of_surjective
    (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A) {π : M →ₗ[R] M''}
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : ι) (x : M), x ∈ LinearMap.ker π →
      ((hA.proj i x : A i) : M) ∈ LinearMap.ker π) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (A i).map π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro z hz1 hz2
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hz1
    have hz2' : π a ∈ ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), A k)).map π := by
      have hle : (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), (A k).map π)
          ≤ ((⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), A k)).map π :=
        iSup₂_le fun k hk =>
          Submodule.map_mono (le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : k ≠ i) => A k) k hk)
      exact hle hz2
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hz2'
    have hker : a - b ∈ LinearMap.ker π := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hba, sub_self]
    have hprojb : hA.proj i b = 0 := by
      have hkerproj : (⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), A k) ≤ LinearMap.ker (hA.proj i) :=
        iSup₂_le fun k hk => fun y hy =>
          LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hA.proj_of_mem_ne hk hy)
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hkerproj hb)
    have hproja : ((hA.proj i (a - b) : A i) : M) = a := by
      rw [map_sub, hA.proj_of_mem ha, hprojb, sub_zero]
    have hmem : a ∈ LinearMap.ker π := by
      rw [← hproja]
      exact hinv i (a - b) hker
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hmem
  · calc (⨆ i, (A i).map π)
        = ((⨆ i, A i)).map π := by rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
      _ = (⊤ : Submodule R M).map π := by rw [hA.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
      _ = ⊤ := by
          rw [Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
          exact hπ

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaQ_comap_baseChange
statement:
theorem map_sigmaQ_comap_baseChange (g : V' →ₗ[ℚ] V)
    (A : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :
    (A.comap (g.baseChange ℂ)).map (sigmaQ V') =
      (A.map (sigmaQ V)).comap (g.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx
    have hyA : g.baseChange ℂ y ∈ A := Submodule.mem_comap.mp hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, ← sigmaQ_baseChange g y]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hyA
  · intro hx
    have hgx : g.baseChange ℂ x ∈ A.map (sigmaQ V) := Submodule.mem_comap.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hgw⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hgx
    refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨sigmaQ V' x, ?_, sigmaQ_sigmaQ V' x⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, ← sigmaQ_baseChange g x, ← hgw, sigmaQ_sigmaQ]
    exact hw

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaQ_map_baseChange
statement:
theorem map_sigmaQ_map_baseChange (g : V' →ₗ[ℚ] V)
    (A : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V')) :
    (A.map (g.baseChange ℂ)).map (sigmaQ V) =
      (A.map (sigmaQ V')).map (g.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
    rw [sigmaQ_baseChange g a]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ha)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
    rw [← sigmaQ_baseChange g a]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ha)

name: HodgePilot.subtype_baseChange_injective

name: HodgePilot.ker_baseChange_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_baseChange_eq_range (g : V →ₗ[ℚ] W) :

proof:
:= by
  have h : Function.Exact ((LinearMap.ker g).subtype.baseChange ℂ)
      (g.baseChange ℂ) :=
    Module.Flat.lTensor_exact ℂ (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map g)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.proj_mem_ker_baseChange
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.proj_mem_ker_baseChange (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)

    ((hV.isInternal.proj pq x : hV.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
      ∈ LinearMap.ker (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx ⊢

statement:
theorem HodgeHom.proj_mem_range_baseChange (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)

    ((hW.isInternal.proj pq x : hW.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.cokernelProj_comp_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.cokernelProj_comp_toLinearMap (f : HodgeHom hV hW) :

proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun v => by
    show (LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).mkQ (f.toLinearMap v) = 0

name: HodgePilot.range_subtype_baseChange
statement:
theorem range_subtype_baseChange (g : V →ₗ[ℚ] W) :
    LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.range g).subtype.baseChange ℂ)
      = LinearMap.range (g.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (g.rangeRestrict.baseChange ℂ) := by
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective ℂ (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict g)
  have hcomp : (LinearMap.range g).subtype.comp g.rangeRestrict = g :=
    LinearMap.ext fun _ => rfl
  calc LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.range g).subtype.baseChange ℂ)
      = LinearMap.range (((LinearMap.range g).subtype.baseChange ℂ).comp
          (g.rangeRestrict.baseChange ℂ)) :=
        (LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _
          (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)).symm
    _ = LinearMap.range (g.baseChange ℂ) := by
        rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp, hcomp]

name: HodgePilot.ker_mkQ_baseChange_subtype
statement:
theorem ker_mkQ_baseChange_subtype (p : Submodule ℚ W) :
    LinearMap.ker (p.mkQ.baseChange ℂ)
      = LinearMap.range (p.subtype.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Function.Exact (p.subtype.baseChange ℂ) (p.mkQ.baseChange ℂ) :=
    lTensor_exact ℂ (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ p) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
  exact LinearMap.exact_iff.mp h

statement:
theorem HodgeHom.coimageToImageLinear_comp_mkQ (f : HodgeHom hV hW) :
    f.coimageToImageLinear.comp (LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap).mkQ
      = f.toLinearMap.rangeRestrict
proof:
:=
  Submodule.liftQ_mkQ _ f.toLinearMap.rangeRestrict
    (le_of_eq (LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict f.toLinearMap).symm)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.subtype_comp_coimageToImage_comp_mkQ
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.subtype_comp_coimageToImage_comp_mkQ (f : HodgeHom hV hW) :
    (LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).subtype.comp
        (f.coimageToImageLinear.comp (LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap).mkQ)
      = f.toLinearMap

  exact LinearMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.subtype_coimageToImage_apply
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.subtype_coimageToImage_apply (f : HodgeHom hV hW)
    (u : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    ((LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).subtype.baseChange ℂ)
        ((f.coimageToImageLinear.baseChange ℂ)
          (((LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap).mkQ.baseChange ℂ) u))
      = f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u
proof:
:= by
  have h : (((LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap).subtype.comp
      (f.coimageToImageLinear.comp
        (LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap).mkQ)).baseChange ℂ) u
      = f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ u := by
    rw [f.subtype_comp_coimageToImage_comp_mkQ]
  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_comp, LinearMap.baseChange_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.coimageToImage_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem HodgeHom.coimageToImage_toLinearMap (f : HodgeHom hV hW) :

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.coimageToImage_bijective
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.coimageToImage_bijective (f : HodgeHom hV hW) :
    Function.Bijective f.coimageToImageLinear
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    exact Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ _
      (le_of_eq (LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict f.toLinearMap))
  · rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    have h1 : LinearMap.range f.coimageToImageLinear
        = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap.rangeRestrict :=
      Submodule.range_liftQ _ _ _
    rw [h1, LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.imageOpen_coe

      c.1.target ∩ ⇑c.1.symm ⁻¹' (U : Set (SPoints sX))
proof:
:=
  c.1.image_source_inter_eq' (U : Set (SPoints sX))

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.mem_imageOpen_iff
proof:
:= by
  have h : y ∈ imageOpen c U ↔ y ∈ (imageOpen c U : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) := Iff.rfl
  rw [h, imageOpen_coe]
  exact Set.mem_inter_iff _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen
proof:
:=
  ((mem_imageOpen_iff c).mp hy).1

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen

proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.transition_mem_imageOpen
statement:
lemma transition_mem_imageOpen {c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d}
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ imageOpen c₂ U)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈ imageOpen c₁ U
proof:
:=
  mem_imageOpen_of_source c₁ hsrc (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.imageOpen_mono
statement:
lemma imageOpen_mono (c : GluedChart sX d) {U V : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) : imageOpen c U ≤ imageOpen c V
proof:
:= by

  exact ⟨hy.1, hUV hy.2⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.imageOpen_iSup_le
statement:
lemma imageOpen_iSup_le {ι : Type} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (U : ι → Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) :
    imageOpen c (iSup U) ≤ ⨆ i, imageOpen c (U i)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy)
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
    ⟨i, (mem_imageOpen_iff c).mpr ⟨mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy, hi⟩⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.exists_gluedChart_mem_source
statement:
theorem exists_gluedChart_mem_source (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)

    ∃ c : GluedChart sX d, x ∈ c.1.source
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_sPatch_probe_eq sX d x
  exact ⟨⟨glueChart P, ⟨P, rfl⟩⟩, hP ▸ mem_glueChart_source_center P⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.analyticAt_transFun
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂⟩ := c₂.2
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁⟩ := c₁.2
  rw [hP₂] at hyt hys
  rw [hP₁] at hys
  rw [hP₁, hP₂]
  refine analyticAt_glueChart_trans P₂ P₁ ?_
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.isCompat_map
statement:
lemma isCompat_map {p : ℕ} {U V : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    {s : ∀ c : GluedChart sX d,
      (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c U))}
    (hs : IsCompat p U s) :
    IsCompat p V (fun c => (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c hVU)).op (s c))
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ y hy hsrc
  calc sectionExtendV ((omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c₂ hVU)).op (s c₂)) y
      = sectionExtendV (s c₂) y :=
        sectionExtendV_map_eq (imageOpen_mono c₂ hVU) (s c₂) hy
    _ = (sectionExtendV (s c₁) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) :=
        hs c₁ c₂ y (imageOpen_mono c₂ hVU hy) hsrc
    _ = (sectionExtendV ((omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c₁ hVU)).op (s c₁))
              ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) :=
        congrArg (fun φ => φ.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y))
          (sectionExtendV_map_eq (imageOpen_mono c₁ hVU) (s c₁)
            (transition_mem_imageOpen hy hsrc)).symm

statement:
theorem isSheafUniqueGluing_formPresheafChartsAb (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d p : ℕ) : (formPresheafChartsAb sX d p).IsSheafUniqueGluing
proof:
:= by
  intro ι U sf hsf
  
  have hcomp : ∀ c : GluedChart sX d,
      TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf
        (fun i => imageOpen c (U i)) (fun i => (sf i).1 c) := by
    intro c i j
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    have hyi : y.1 ∈ imageOpen c (U i) :=
      (inf_le_left : imageOpen c (U i) ⊓ imageOpen c (U j) ≤ _) y.2
    have hyj : y.1 ∈ imageOpen c (U j) :=
      (inf_le_right : imageOpen c (U i) ⊓ imageOpen c (U j) ≤ _) y.2
    have hyij : y.1 ∈ imageOpen c (U i ⊓ U j) :=
      (mem_imageOpen_iff c).mpr ⟨mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hyi,
        symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hyi, symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hyj⟩
    exact congrArg (fun t => (t.1 c).1
      (⟨y.1, hyij⟩ : ↥(imageOpen c (U i ⊓ U j)))) (hsf i j)
  
  have hglue : ∀ c : GluedChart sX d,
      ∃! g : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c (iSup U))),
        ∀ i : ι, (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c (le_iSup U i))).op g = (sf i).1 c :=
    fun c => (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).existsUnique_gluing'
      (fun i => imageOpen c (U i)) (imageOpen c (iSup U))
      (fun i => homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c (le_iSup U i)))
      (imageOpen_iSup_le c U) (fun i => (sf i).1 c) (hcomp c)
  
  have hspec : ∀ (c : GluedChart sX d) (i : ι),
      (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c (le_iSup U i))).op (hglue c).exists.choose =
      (sf i).1 c :=
    fun c => (hglue c).exists.choose_spec
  have hcompat : IsCompat p (iSup U) (fun c => (hglue c).exists.choose) := by
    intro c₁ c₂ y hy hsrc
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy)
    have hy_i : y ∈ imageOpen c₂ (U i) :=
      (mem_imageOpen_iff c₂).mpr ⟨mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy, hi⟩
    have ht_i : (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈ imageOpen c₁ (U i) :=
      transition_mem_imageOpen hy_i hsrc
    have e₂ : sectionExtendV ((sf i).1 c₂) y =
        sectionExtendV (hglue c₂).exists.choose y := by
      have h := sectionExtendV_map_eq (imageOpen_mono c₂ (le_iSup U i))
        (hglue c₂).exists.choose hy_i
      rw [hspec c₂ i] at h
      exact h
    have e₁ : sectionExtendV ((sf i).1 c₁) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) =
        sectionExtendV (hglue c₁).exists.choose ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) := by
      have h := sectionExtendV_map_eq (imageOpen_mono c₁ (le_iSup U i))
        (hglue c₁).exists.choose ht_i
      rw [hspec c₁ i] at h
      exact h
    calc sectionExtendV (hglue c₂).exists.choose y
        = sectionExtendV ((sf i).1 c₂) y := e₂.symm
      _ = (sectionExtendV ((sf i).1 c₁) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) := (sf i).2 c₁ c₂ y hy_i hsrc
      _ = (sectionExtendV (hglue c₁).exists.choose
            ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) :=
          congrArg (fun φ => φ.compContinuousLinearMap
            (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)) e₁
  refine ⟨⟨fun c => (hglue c).exists.choose, hcompat⟩, fun i => ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · 
    exact Subtype.ext (funext fun c => hspec c i)
  · 
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun c => ?_)
    refine (hglue c).unique (fun i => ?_) (fun i => hspec c i)
    exact congrArg (fun z => z.1 c) (ht i)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.formSheafChartsAb_obj
statement:
lemma formSheafChartsAb_obj (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d p : ℕ)
    (U : (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ) :
    (formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj U =
      AddCommGrpCat.of ↥(compatSubgroup sX d p (unop U))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.isCompat_dSection
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ y₀ hy₀ hsrc
  
  have hNopen : IsOpen ((imageOpen c₂ U : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) ∩
      (c₂.1.target ∩ ⇑c₂.1.symm ⁻¹' c₁.1.source)) :=
    (imageOpen c₂ U).isOpen.inter (c₂.1.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm c₁.1.open_source)
  have hy₀N : y₀ ∈ (imageOpen c₂ U : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) ∩
      (c₂.1.target ∩ ⇑c₂.1.symm ⁻¹' c₁.1.source) :=
    ⟨hy₀, mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy₀, hsrc⟩
  
  have hfeq : sectionExtendV (s c₂) =ᶠ[nhds y₀]
      fun y => (sectionExtendV (s c₁) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNopen.mem_nhds hy₀N)
      (fun y hy => hs c₁ c₂ y hy.1 hy.2.2)
  have hmem₁ : (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ ∈ imageOpen c₁ U :=
    transition_mem_imageOpen hy₀ hsrc
  have hτan : AnalyticAt ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ :=
    analyticAt_transFun c₁ c₂ (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy₀) hsrc
  have hω : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sectionExtendV (s c₁)) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (s c₁) _ hmem₁).differentiableAt
  have h₂ : sectionExtendV (dSection (s c₂)) y₀ = extDeriv (sectionExtendV (s c₂)) y₀ :=
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (dSection (s c₂)) hy₀
  have h₁ : sectionExtendV (dSection (s c₁)) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) =
      extDeriv (sectionExtendV (s c₁)) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) :=
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (dSection (s c₁)) hmem₁
  have hmain : extDeriv (sectionExtendV (s c₂)) y₀ =
      (extDeriv (sectionExtendV (s c₁)) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) :=
    hfeq.extDeriv_eq.trans (extDeriv_pullback (r := 2) hω (hτan.contDiffAt)
      (minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField (𝕜 := ℂ)).le)
  exact (h₂.trans hmain).trans
    (congrArg (fun φ => φ.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀))
      h₁.symm)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.dSheafFormsCharts_comp_dSheafFormsCharts
statement:
theorem dSheafFormsCharts_comp_dSheafFormsCharts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d p : ℕ) :
    dSheafFormsCharts sX d p ≫ dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  show dPresheafChartsAb sX d p ≫ dPresheafChartsAb sX d (p + 1) = 0
  ext U s
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun c => dSection_dSection (s.1 c))

theorem analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN_d (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d p : ℕ) :

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN_d_zero_one

theorem constFamily_add (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)
    (U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) (z z' : ℂ) :
