name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.augmentCharts_homEquiv
statement:
theorem augmentCharts_homEquiv (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ) :
    ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
      AddCommGrpCat).homEquiv _ _) (augmentCharts sX d) = augmentPresheafCharts sX d
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.toSheafify_comp_augmentCharts
statement:
theorem toSheafify_comp_augmentCharts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ) :
    toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))) ≫
      (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
        AddCommGrpCat).map (augmentCharts sX d) = augmentPresheafCharts sX d
proof:
:= by
  have h := augmentCharts_homEquiv sX d
  rwa [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app] at h

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.augmentPresheafCharts_comp_d
statement:
theorem augmentPresheafCharts_comp_d (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ) :
    augmentPresheafCharts sX d ≫ dPresheafChartsAb sX d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext U z
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun c => ?_)
  show dSection (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (unop U))) z.down) = 0
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
    (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (unop U))) z.down)) ↑y = 0
  have heq : sectionExtendV (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (unop U))) z.down)
      =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin d → ℂ)]
      (fun _ => ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) (Fin 0) z.down) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((imageOpen c (unop U)).isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
      (fun w hw => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw)
  rw [heq.extDeriv_eq]
  exact extDeriv_const_eq_zero _ _

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.augmentCharts_comp_dSheafFormsCharts
statement:
theorem augmentCharts_comp_dSheafFormsCharts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) : augmentCharts sX d ≫ dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (γ : (presheafToSheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) AddCommGrpCat).obj
          ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))) ⟶ formSheafChartsAb sX d 0),
      ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) γ = augmentPresheafCharts sX d →
        γ ≫ dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0 = 0 := by
    intro γ hγ
    refine ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _).injective ?_
    calc ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) (γ ≫ dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
        = ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) γ ≫
            (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
              AddCommGrpCat).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0) :=
          (sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv_naturality_right γ
            (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
      _ = augmentPresheafCharts sX d ≫
            (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
              AddCommGrpCat).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0) :=
          congrArg (· ≫ _) hγ
      _ = 0 := augmentPresheafCharts_comp_d sX d
      _ = ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) 0 := by
          rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero]
          exact comp_zero.symm
  exact key (augmentCharts sX d) (augmentCharts_homEquiv sX d)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.augmentCharts_comp_d
statement:
theorem augmentCharts_comp_d (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ) :
    augmentCharts sX d ≫ (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN_d_zero_one]
  exact augmentCharts_comp_dSheafFormsCharts sX d

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.augmentSingleCharts_f_zero
statement:
theorem augmentSingleCharts_f_zero (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ) :
    (augmentSingleCharts sX d).f 0 =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))).hom ≫
        augmentCharts sX d ≫
          (Hyper.reindexZXIso (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) 0).inv
proof:
:=
  DiscResolution.singleZeroToReindexZ_f_zero _ _

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.analyticOnNhd_pullback
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_pullback {p : ℕ} (c c' : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    (g : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c U))) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
      (fun y => (sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) y))
      (imageOpen c' U : Set (Fin d → ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have hτ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) (imageOpen c' U : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) :=
    fun y hy => analyticAt_transFun c c' (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy)
      (hU _ (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy))
  have hτd : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm))
      (imageOpen c' U : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) :=
    hτ.fderiv_of_isOpen (imageOpen c' U).isOpen
  refine PolydiscPoincare.analyticOnNhd_of_differentiableOn (imageOpen c' U).isOpen ?_
  intro y hy
  have hmem : (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) y ∈ imageOpen c U :=
    transition_mem_imageOpen hy (hU _ (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy))
  have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) z)) y :=
    ((analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV g _ hmem).comp (hτ y hy)).differentiableAt
  exact (h1.continuousAlternatingMapCompContinuousLinearMap
    ((hτd y hy).differentiableAt)).differentiableWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.pullbackFamily_apply
statement:
lemma pullbackFamily_apply {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    (g : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c U)))
    (c' : GluedChart sX d) (y : ↥(imageOpen c' U)) :
    (pullbackFamily c hU g c').1 y =
      (sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) ↑y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) ↑y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.isCompat_pullbackFamily
statement:
theorem isCompat_pullbackFamily {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    (g : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c U))) :
    IsCompat p U (pullbackFamily c hU g)
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ y₀ hy₀ hsrc
  have hy₀t : y₀ ∈ c₂.1.target := mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy₀
  have hsymmU : c₂.1.symm y₀ ∈ U := symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy₀
  have hmem₁ : (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ ∈ imageOpen c₁ U :=
    transition_mem_imageOpen hy₀ hsrc
  
  have hread : c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) = c₂.1.symm y₀ :=
    c₁.1.left_inv hsrc
  
  have hτ' : AnalyticAt ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ :=
    analyticAt_transFun c₁ c₂ hy₀t hsrc
  have hτout : AnalyticAt ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) := by
    refine analyticAt_transFun c c₁ ?_ ?_
    · exact c₁.1.map_source hsrc
    · rw [hread]
      exact hU _ hsymmU
  
  have hNopen : IsOpen (c₂.1.target ∩ ⇑c₂.1.symm ⁻¹' c₁.1.source) :=
    c₂.1.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm c₁.1.open_source
  have hev : (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm) ∘ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) =ᶠ[nhds y₀]
      ⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hNopen.mem_nhds ⟨hy₀t, hsrc⟩) (fun z hz => ?_)
    show c.1 (c₁.1.symm (c₁.1 (c₂.1.symm z))) = c.1 (c₂.1.symm z)
    rw [c₁.1.left_inv hz.2]
  
  have hchain : fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ =
      (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀)).comp
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) := by
    rw [← hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_comp y₀ hτout.differentiableAt hτ'.differentiableAt
  
  have hpt : (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) =
      (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀ := by
    show c.1 (c₁.1.symm (c₁.1 (c₂.1.symm y₀))) = c.1 (c₂.1.symm y₀)
    rw [c₁.1.left_inv hsrc]
  
  calc sectionExtendV (pullbackFamily c hU g c₂) y₀
      = (sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) :=
        sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (pullbackFamily c hU g c₂) hy₀
    _ = ((sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm) ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm)
            y₀))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c₁.1.symm)
            ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀))).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) := by
        rw [hpt, hchain, compContinuousLinearMap_comp]
    _ = (sectionExtendV (pullbackFamily c hU g c₁)
          ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀) :=
        congrArg (fun φ => φ.compContinuousLinearMap
            (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y₀))
          (sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (pullbackFamily c hU g c₁) hmem₁).symm

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.pullbackFamily_self
statement:
theorem pullbackFamily_self {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    (g : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c U))) :
    pullbackFamily c hU g c = g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  have hyt : (y : Fin d → ℂ) ∈ c.1.target := mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen y.2
  have hev : ⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c.1.symm =ᶠ[nhds (y : Fin d → ℂ)] id :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (c.1.open_target.mem_nhds hyt)
      (fun z hz => c.1.right_inv hz)
  have hfd : fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c.1.symm) (y : Fin d → ℂ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) := by
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  have hpt : (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c.1.symm) (y : Fin d → ℂ) = (y : Fin d → ℂ) :=
    c.1.right_inv hyt
  show (sectionExtendV g ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c.1.symm) ↑y)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c.1.symm) ↑y) = g.1 y
  rw [hpt, hfd, compContinuousLinearMap_id, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g y.2]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.pullbackFamily_component
statement:
theorem pullbackFamily_component {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    {s : ∀ c' : GluedChart sX d,
      (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (imageOpen c' U))}
    (hs : IsCompat p U s) :
    pullbackFamily c hU (s c) = s
proof:
:= by
  funext c'
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  have h := hs c c' (y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2 (hU _ (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen y.2))
  show (sectionExtendV (s c) ((⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) ↑y)).compContinuousLinearMap
      (fderiv ℂ (⇑c.1 ∘ ⇑c'.1.symm) ↑y) = (s c').1 y
  rw [← h, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (s c') y.2]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.chartSectionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma chartSectionEquiv_apply (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source) (p : ℕ)
    (s : ToType ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj (op U))) :
    chartSectionEquiv c U hU p s = s.1 c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.chartSectionEquiv_map
statement:
theorem chartSectionEquiv_map (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U V : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source) (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x ∈ c.1.source) (p : ℕ)
    (s : ToType ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj (op U))) :
    chartSectionEquiv c V hV p
        ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) =
      (formSheafAb d p).obj.map (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c hVU)).op
        (chartSectionEquiv c U hU p s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.chartSectionEquiv_dSection
statement:
theorem chartSectionEquiv_dSection (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source) (p : ℕ)
    (s : ToType ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj (op U))) :
    chartSectionEquiv c U hU (p + 1)
        ((dSheafFormsCharts sX d p).hom.app (op U) s) =
      (dSheafForms d p).hom.app (op (imageOpen c U))
        (chartSectionEquiv c U hU p s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticFormsCharts.chartSectionEquiv_augment
statement:
theorem chartSectionEquiv_augment (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U → x ∈ c.1.source)
    (z : ULift.{0} ℂ) :
    chartSectionEquiv c U hU 0
        ((augmentPresheafCharts sX d).app (op U) z) =
      (augmentPresheaf d).app (op (imageOpen c U)) z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaR_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaR_tmul (c : ℂ) (v : V) :
    sigmaR V (c ⊗ₜ[ℝ] v) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c ⊗ₜ[ℝ] v
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigmaR, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Complex.conjAe_coe]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.isOpen_polydisc
statement: theorem isOpen_polydisc (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) : IsOpen (polydisc c R)
proof:
:=
  isOpen_set_pi finite_univ fun _ _ => isOpen_ball

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.closedBall_eq_closedPolydisc
statement:
theorem closedBall_eq_closedPolydisc (x : Fin n → ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    closedBall x r = closedPolydisc x (fun _ => r)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_pi_le_iff hr, mem_closedPolydisc]
  exact forall_congr' fun i => by rw [mem_closedBall]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.analyticOnNhd_of_differentiableOn
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hs z hz
  have hsub : closedPolydisc z (fun _ => r / 2) ⊆ s := by
    rw [← closedBall_eq_closedPolydisc z (by positivity)]
    exact (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr0)).trans hball
  exact analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_closedPolydisc (hf.mono hsub) fun _ => half_pos hr0

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.discStar_polydisc
statement:
theorem discStar_polydisc (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) :
    DiscStar c (polydisc c R)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz s hs
  refine mem_polydisc.2 fun i => ?_
  rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
  have h1 : (c + s • (z - c)) i - c i = s * (z i - c i) := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [h1, norm_mul]
  calc ‖s‖ * ‖z i - c i‖ ≤ 1 * ‖z i - c i‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖z i - c i‖ := one_mul _
    _ < R i := mem_ball_iff_norm.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.discStar_ball
statement: theorem discStar_ball (c : Fin n → ℂ) (r : ℝ) : DiscStar c (ball c r)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz s hs
  rw [mem_ball_iff_norm] at hz ⊢
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul]
  calc ‖s‖ * ‖z - c‖ ≤ 1 * ‖z - c‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖z - c‖ := one_mul _
    _ < r := hz

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.segMap_mem
statement:
theorem segMap_mem {c : Fin n → ℂ} {U : Set (Fin n → ℂ)} (hst : DiscStar c U)
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    segMap c t z ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  refine hst z hz _ ?_
  rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
  exact ht.2

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.segMap_one
statement: @[simp] theorem segMap_one (c z : Fin n → ℂ) : segMap c 1 z = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [segMap, Complex.ofReal_one, one_smul]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.continuousOn_segMap
statement:
theorem continuousOn_segMap (c : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin n → ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => segMap c t z) (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.smul continuous_const)).continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.removeNth_succ_cons
statement:
theorem removeNth_succ_cons {α : Type*} (x : α) (v : Fin (q + 1) → α) (i : Fin (q + 1)) :
    Fin.removeNth (α := fun _ => α) i.succ (Fin.cons x v) =
      Fin.cons x (Fin.removeNth i v)
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  induction k using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [Fin.removeNth_apply]
  | succ m => simp [Fin.removeNth_apply, Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.curryApplyCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem curryApplyCLM_apply (u : Fin n → ℂ)
    (A : (Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F) :
    curryApplyCLM u A = A.curryLeft u
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.norm_curryApplyCLM_le
statement:
theorem norm_curryApplyCLM_le (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
    ‖(curryApplyCLM (q := q) (F := F) u)‖ ≤ ‖u‖
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ (norm_nonneg u) _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.isBoundedBilinearMap_curryApply
statement:
theorem isBoundedBilinearMap_curryApply :
    IsBoundedBilinearMap ℂ (fun p :
      ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F) × (Fin n → ℂ) => p.1.curryLeft p.2) where
  add_left A B u
proof:
:= by simp
  smul_left a A u := by simp
  add_right A u v := by simp
  smul_right a A u := by simp
  bound := ⟨1, one_pos, fun A u => by
    rw [one_mul]
    calc ‖A.curryLeft u‖ ≤ ‖A.curryLeft‖ * ‖u‖ := (A.curryLeft).le_opNorm u
    _ = ‖A‖ * ‖u‖ := by rw [norm_curryLeft]⟩

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.continuousOn_radialIntegrand
statement:
theorem continuousOn_radialIntegrand (hst : DiscStar c U) (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U)
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrand c ω t z) (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => segMap c t z) (Icc 0 1) U :=
    fun t ht => segMap_mem hst hz ht
  have hωγ : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ω (segMap c t z)) (Icc 0 1) :=
    hω.continuousOn.comp (continuousOn_segMap c z) hmaps
  have hcurry : ContinuousOn
      (fun t : ℝ => (ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft (z - c)) (Icc 0 1) :=
    (curryApplyCLM (z - c)).continuous.comp_continuousOn hωγ
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow q).continuousOn.smul hcurry

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.intervalIntegrable_radialIntegrand
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_radialIntegrand (hst : DiscStar c U)
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U) {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrand c ω t z) volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
  exact continuousOn_radialIntegrand hst hω hz

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.hasFDerivAt_radialIntegrand
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_radialIntegrand (hst : DiscStar c U) (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U)
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => radialIntegrand c ω t y) (radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) z
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : segMap c t z ∈ U := segMap_mem hst hz ht
  have hA : HasFDerivAt ω (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z)) (segMap c t z) :=
    (hω _ hmem).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hsub : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin n → ℂ => y - c)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)) z := (hasFDerivAt_id z).sub_const c
  have hseg : HasFDerivAt (fun y => segMap c t y)
      ((t : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)) z := by
    have h2 := hsub.const_smul ((t : ℂ))
    exact h2.const_add c
  have hωσ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ω (segMap c t y))
      ((fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z)).comp
        ((t : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin n → ℂ))) z := hA.comp z hseg
  have hpair := hωσ.prodMk hsub
  have hbil := (isBoundedBilinearMap_curryApply (n := n) (q := q) (F := F)).hasFDerivAt
    (ω (segMap c t z), z - c)
  have hcomp := hbil.comp z hpair
  have hfinal := hcomp.const_smul ((t : ℂ) ^ q)
  have heq : (t : ℂ) ^ q •
      (((isBoundedBilinearMap_curryApply (n := n) (q := q) (F := F)).deriv
          (ω (segMap c t z), z - c)).comp
        (((fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z)).comp
            ((t : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin n → ℂ))).prod
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)))) =
      radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z := by
    ext w
    simp only [radialIntegrandFDeriv, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id', id_eq,
      IsBoundedBilinearMap.deriv_apply, map_smul, curryLeft_smul,
      curryApplyCLM_apply, smul_add]
    rw [smul_smul ((t : ℂ) ^ q) ((t : ℂ)), ← pow_succ (t : ℂ) q]
    exact add_comm _ _
  exact heq ▸ hfinal

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.hasFDerivAt_radialContract
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_radialContract [CompleteSpace F] (hU : IsOpen U) (hst : DiscStar c U)
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U) {z₀ : Fin n → ℂ} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (radialContract c ω)
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z₀) z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z₀ hz₀
  have hδ0 : 0 < r / 2 := half_pos hr0
  have hδU : closedBall z₀ (r / 2) ⊆ U :=
    (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr0)).trans hball
  have hballU : ball z₀ (r / 2) ⊆ U := ball_subset_closedBall.trans hδU
  
  have hcont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℂ) => segMap c p.1 p.2) :=
    continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).smul
      (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const))
  have hKcomp : IsCompact ((fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℂ) => segMap c p.1 p.2) ''
      (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ closedBall z₀ (r / 2))) :=
    (isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall z₀ (r / 2))).image hcont2
  have hKU : (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℂ) => segMap c p.1 p.2) ''
      (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ closedBall z₀ (r / 2)) ⊆ U := by
    rintro y ⟨⟨t, x⟩, ⟨ht, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    exact segMap_mem hst (hδU hx) ht
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := hKcomp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hω.continuousOn.mono hKU)
  obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ :=
    hKcomp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (((hω.fderiv_of_isOpen hU).continuousOn).mono hKU)
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => segMap c t z₀) (Icc 0 1) U :=
    fun t ht => segMap_mem hst hz₀ ht
  have huIoc : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one
  refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (F := fun x t => radialIntegrand c ω t x)
    (F' := fun x t => radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t x)
    (bound := fun _ => max ((‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ + M₁) 0)
    (ball_mem_nhds z₀ hδ0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    refine Filter.eventually_iff_exists_mem.mpr
      ⟨ball z₀ (r / 2), ball_mem_nhds z₀ hδ0, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [huIoc]
    exact ((continuousOn_radialIntegrand hst hω (hballU hx)).mono
      Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc
  · exact intervalIntegrable_radialIntegrand hst hω hz₀
  · 
    rw [huIoc]
    refine ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable (ContinuousOn.mono ?_ Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
      measurableSet_Ioc
    have hωγ := hω.continuousOn.comp (continuousOn_segMap c z₀) hmaps
    have hD := ((hω.fderiv_of_isOpen hU).continuousOn).comp (continuousOn_segMap c z₀) hmaps
    refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
    · refine ContinuousOn.smul ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow (q + 1)).continuousOn) ?_
      exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)
        ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F) ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F)
        (curryApplyCLM (z₀ - c))).continuous).comp_continuousOn hD
    · refine ContinuousOn.smul ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow q).continuousOn) ?_
      have hlip : LipschitzWith 1
          (fun A : (Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F => A.curryLeft) := by
        refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun A B => ?_
        rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
        have hsub2 : A.curryLeft - B.curryLeft = (A - B).curryLeft := by
          ext w v
          simp
        rw [hsub2, norm_curryLeft]
      exact hlip.continuous.comp_continuousOn hωγ
  · 
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_
    rw [huIoc] at ht
    have ht' : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht
    intro x hx
    have hxc : ‖x - c‖ ≤ ‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2 := by
      calc ‖x - c‖ = ‖x - z₀ + (z₀ - c)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖x - z₀‖ + ‖z₀ - c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ r / 2 + ‖z₀ - c‖ :=
          add_le_add (mem_ball_iff_norm.1 hx).le le_rfl
      _ = ‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2 := add_comm _ _
    have hmemK : segMap c t x ∈ (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℂ) => segMap c p.1 p.2) ''
        (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ closedBall z₀ (r / 2)) :=
      ⟨(t, x), ⟨ht', ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hDb : ‖fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x)‖ ≤ M₂ := hM₂ _ hmemK
    have hAb : ‖ω (segMap c t x)‖ ≤ M₁ := hM₁ _ hmemK
    have htpow : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(t : ℂ) ^ k‖ ≤ 1 := fun k => by
      rw [norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht.1]
      exact pow_le_one₀ ht.1.le ht.2
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (le_max_right _ 0) fun w => ?_
    have happly : radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t x w =
        (t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c) +
          (t : ℂ) ^ q • (ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w := by
      simp only [radialIntegrandFDeriv, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, curryApplyCLM_apply]
    have hDw : ‖fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w‖ ≤ M₂ * ‖w‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.le_of_opNorm_le _ hDb w
    have hDw0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M₂ * ‖w‖ :=
      (norm_nonneg (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w)).trans hDw
    have h1 : ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c)‖ ≤
        (‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul]
      calc ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1)‖ * ‖(fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c)‖
          ≤ 1 * ‖(fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (htpow _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖(fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c)‖ := one_mul _
        _ ≤ ‖(fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft‖ * ‖x - c‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w‖ * ‖x - c‖ := by rw [norm_curryLeft]
        _ ≤ (M₂ * ‖w‖) * ‖x - c‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDw (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (M₂ * ‖w‖) * (‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxc hDw0
        _ = (‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ * ‖w‖ := by ring
    have h2 : ‖(t : ℂ) ^ q • (ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul]
      calc ‖(t : ℂ) ^ q‖ * ‖(ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w‖
          ≤ 1 * ‖(ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (htpow _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖(ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w‖ := one_mul _
        _ ≤ ‖(ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft‖ * ‖w‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖ω (segMap c t x)‖ * ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_curryLeft]
        _ ≤ M₁ * ‖w‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAb (norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t x w‖
        ≤ ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t x) w).curryLeft (x - c)‖ +
          ‖(t : ℂ) ^ q • (ω (segMap c t x)).curryLeft w‖ := by
          rw [happly]
          exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ * ‖w‖ + M₁ * ‖w‖ := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = ((‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ + M₁) * ‖w‖ := by ring
      _ ≤ max ((‖z₀ - c‖ + r / 2) * M₂ + M₁) 0 * ‖w‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
  · exact intervalIntegrable_const
  · 
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_
    rw [huIoc] at ht
    intro x hx
    exact hasFDerivAt_radialIntegrand hst hω (hballU hx) (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.analyticOnNhd_radialContract
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_radialContract [CompleteSpace F] (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hst : DiscStar c U) (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (radialContract c ω) U
proof:
:=
  analyticOnNhd_of_differentiableOn hU fun _ hz =>
    (hasFDerivAt_radialContract hU hst hω hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.hasDerivAt_comp_ofReal
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_comp_ofReal {W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℂ W]
    {h : ℂ → W} {h' : W} {t : ℝ} (hf : HasDerivAt h h' (t : ℂ)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => h τ) h' t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using
    (hf.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt t Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.lipschitzWith_clm_apply
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_clm_apply (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
    LipschitzWith ‖u‖₊
      (fun M : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F) => M u)
proof:
:= by
  refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun M M' => ?_
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, coe_nnnorm]
  calc ‖M u - M' u‖ = ‖(M - M') u‖ := by rw [_root_.sub_apply]
    _ ≤ ‖M - M'‖ * ‖u‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    _ = ‖u‖ * ‖M - M'‖ := mul_comm _ _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign
    (f : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F))
    (v : Fin (q + 1) → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    alternatizeUncurryFin f v =
      ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • f (v i) (Fin.removeNth i v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  simp only [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.fderiv_contraction_of_closed
statement:
theorem fderiv_contraction_of_closed (hcl : ∀ y ∈ U, extDeriv ω y = 0)
    {y : Fin n → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ U) (u : Fin n → ℂ) (v : Fin (q + 1) → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    (fderiv ℂ ω y u) v =
      ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        (fderiv ℂ ω y (v i)) (Fin.cons u (Fin.removeNth i v))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv ℂ ω y) (Fin.cons u v) = 0 := by
    rw [show ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv ℂ ω y) =
      extDeriv ω y from rfl, hcl y hy]
    simp
  rw [alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign, Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h0
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul,
    Fin.removeNth_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ, mul_neg_one,
    removeNth_succ_cons, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h0
  exact add_neg_eq_zero.mp h0

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.alternatizeUncurryFin_radialIntegrandFDeriv
statement:
theorem alternatizeUncurryFin_radialIntegrandFDeriv
    (hcl : ∀ y ∈ U, extDeriv ω y = 0) {z : Fin n → ℂ} {t : ℝ}
    (hy : segMap c t z ∈ U) (v : Fin (q + 1) → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    alternatizeUncurryFin (radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) v =
      (t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) (z - c)) v +
        (((q : ℂ) + 1) * (t : ℂ) ^ q) • (ω (segMap c t z)) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign]
  have happly : ∀ w, radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z w =
      (t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) w).curryLeft (z - c) +
        (t : ℂ) ^ q • (ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft w := fun w => by
    simp only [radialIntegrandFDeriv, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, curryApplyCLM_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin (q + 1),
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • (radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
        (t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) (v i)) (Fin.cons (z - c) (Fin.removeNth i v))) +
        (t : ℂ) ^ q • ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          ((ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v)) := fun i => by
    rw [happly (v i), ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply,
      show ((fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) (v i)).curryLeft (z - c)) (Fin.removeNth i v)
        = (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) (v i)) (Fin.cons (z - c) (Fin.removeNth i v)) from rfl,
      smul_add, smul_comm ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ)) ((t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1)),
      smul_comm ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ)) ((t : ℂ) ^ q)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.smul_sum,
    ← fderiv_contraction_of_closed hcl hy (z - c) v]
  congr 1
  rw [show (∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        ((ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v)) =
      alternatizeUncurryFin ((ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft) v from
    (alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign _ v).symm]
  rw [alternatizeUncurryFin_curryLeft, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply,
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℂ (q + 1) ((ω (segMap c t z)) v), smul_smul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.extDeriv_radialContract_of_closed
statement:
theorem extDeriv_radialContract_of_closed [CompleteSpace F] (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hst : DiscStar c U) (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U)
    (hcl : ∀ y ∈ U, extDeriv ω y = 0) {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    extDeriv (radialContract c ω) z = ω z
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => segMap c t z) (Icc 0 1) U :=
    fun t ht => segMap_mem hst hz ht
  have huIcc : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
  have hωγ := hω.continuousOn.comp (continuousOn_segMap c z) hmaps
  have hD := ((hω.fderiv_of_isOpen hU).continuousOn).comp (continuousOn_segMap c z) hmaps
  have hK := hasFDerivAt_radialContract hU hst hω hz
  refine ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext fun v => ?_
  
  have hvi : ∀ w : Fin n → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z w) (Icc 0 1) := by
    intro w
    have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z w) = fun t : ℝ =>
        (t : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c t z) w).curryLeft (z - c) +
          (t : ℂ) ^ q • (ω (segMap c t z)).curryLeft w := funext fun t => by
      simp only [radialIntegrandFDeriv, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, curryApplyCLM_apply]
    rw [hfun]
    refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
    · exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow (q + 1)).continuousOn).smul
        ((curryApplyCLM (z - c)).continuous.comp_continuousOn
          ((lipschitzWith_clm_apply w).continuous.comp_continuousOn hD))
    · exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow q).continuousOn).smul
        ((curryApplyCLM w).continuous.comp_continuousOn hωγ)
  
  have hexch : ∀ i : Fin (q + 1),
      ((∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) =
        ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := by
    intro i
    have hint_i : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z (v i)) volume 0 1 := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [huIcc]
      exact hvi (v i)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
      (φ := fun t : ℝ => radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (μ := volume) (by
        apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (zero_le_one (α := ℝ))]
        refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
        · refine ContinuousOn.smul
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow (q + 1)).continuousOn) ?_
          exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)
            ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F) ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F)
            (curryApplyCLM (z - c))).continuous).comp_continuousOn hD
        · refine ContinuousOn.smul ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow q).continuousOn) ?_
          have hlip : LipschitzWith 1
              (fun A : (Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F => A.curryLeft) := by
            refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun A B => ?_
            rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
            have hsub2 : A.curryLeft - B.curryLeft = (A - B).curryLeft := by
              ext w v'
              simp
            rw [hsub2, norm_curryLeft]
          exact hlip.continuous.comp_continuousOn hωγ) (v i)]
    exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F
      (Fin.removeNth i v)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hint_i).symm
  
  set g : ℝ → F := fun τ => (τ : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (ω (segMap c τ z)) v with hgdef
  set g' : ℝ → F := fun τ =>
    (τ : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c τ z) (z - c)) v +
      (((q : ℂ) + 1) * (τ : ℂ) ^ q) • (ω (segMap c τ z)) v with hg'def
  
  have hstep1 : extDeriv (radialContract c ω) z v =
      ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := by
    show (alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv ℂ (radialContract c ω) z)) v = _
    rw [hK.fderiv, alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hexch i]
  
  have hstep2 : (∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v)) =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := by
    have hsmul : ∀ i : Fin (q + 1),
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v)) =
        ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := fun i =>
      (intervalIntegral.integral_smul _ _).symm
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hsmul i]
    refine (intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum fun i _ => ?_).symm
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [huIcc]
    exact continuousOn_const.smul
      ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F
        (Fin.removeNth i v)).continuous.comp_continuousOn (hvi (v i)))
  
  have hstep3 : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
      ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v)) =
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g' t := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun τ hτ => ?_
    rw [huIcc] at hτ
    rw [← alternatizeUncurryFin_apply_complexSign]
    exact alternatizeUncurryFin_radialIntegrandFDeriv hcl (segMap_mem hst hz hτ) v
  
  have hderiv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g (g' τ) τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [huIcc] at hτ
    have hyU : segMap c τ z ∈ U := segMap_mem hst hz hτ
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => s ^ (q + 1))
        (((q : ℂ) + 1) * (τ : ℂ) ^ q) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simpa using hasDerivAt_pow (q + 1) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hδ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => c + s • (z - c)) (z - c) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ)).smul_const (z - c)).const_add c
    have hωd : HasFDerivAt ω (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c τ z)) (segMap c τ z) :=
      (hω _ hyU).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => ω (c + s • (z - c)))
        (fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c τ z) (z - c)) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      hωd.comp_hasDerivAt _ hδ
    have happ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => (ω (c + s • (z - c))) v)
        ((fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c τ z) (z - c)) v) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F
        v).hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt _ hcomp
    have hprod : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => s ^ (q + 1) • (ω (c + s • (z - c))) v)
        ((τ : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) • ((fderiv ℂ ω (segMap c τ z) (z - c)) v) +
          (((q : ℂ) + 1) * (τ : ℂ) ^ q) • ((ω (segMap c τ z)) v)) ((τ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      hp.smul happ
    exact hasDerivAt_comp_ofReal hprod
  have hg'int : IntervalIntegrable g' volume 0 1 := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [huIcc]
    refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
    · exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow (q + 1)).continuousOn).smul
        ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F v).continuous.comp_continuousOn
          ((lipschitzWith_clm_apply (z - c)).continuous.comp_continuousOn hD))
    · exact ((continuous_const.mul
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.pow q)).continuousOn).smul
        ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F v).continuous.comp_continuousOn
          hωγ)
  have hftc : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g' t) = g 1 - g 0 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hg'int
  have hg1 : g 1 = (ω z) v := by
    rw [hgdef]
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, one_pow, one_smul, segMap_one]
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hgdef]
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero q), zero_smul]
  calc extDeriv (radialContract c ω) z v
      = ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := hstep1
    _ = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i : Fin (q + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          ((radialIntegrandFDeriv c ω t z) (v i)) (Fin.removeNth i v) := hstep2
    _ = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g' t := hstep3
    _ = g 1 - g 0 := hftc
    _ = (ω z) v := by rw [hg1, hg0, sub_zero]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.exists_primitive_form_discStar
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_form_discStar [CompleteSpace F] {U : Set (Fin n → ℂ)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hst : DiscStar c U) (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω U)
    (hcl : ∀ z ∈ U, extDeriv ω z = 0) :
    ∃ η : (Fin n → ℂ) → ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F),
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ η U ∧ ∀ z ∈ U, extDeriv η z = ω z
proof:
:=
  ⟨radialContract c ω, analyticOnNhd_radialContract hU hst hω,
    fun _ hz => extDeriv_radialContract_of_closed hU hst hω hcl hz⟩

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.exists_primitive_form_polydisc
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_form_polydisc [CompleteSpace F] {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω (polydisc c R))
    (hcl : ∀ z ∈ polydisc c R, extDeriv ω z = 0) :
    ∃ η : (Fin n → ℂ) → ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F),
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ η (polydisc c R) ∧ ∀ z ∈ polydisc c R, extDeriv η z = ω z
proof:
:=
  exists_primitive_form_discStar (isOpen_polydisc c R) (discStar_polydisc c R) hω hcl

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.exists_primitive_form_ball
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_form_ball [CompleteSpace F] {r : ℝ}
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω (ball c r)) (hcl : ∀ z ∈ ball c r, extDeriv ω z = 0) :
    ∃ η : (Fin n → ℂ) → ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F),
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ η (ball c r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball c r, extDeriv η z = ω z
proof:
:=
  exists_primitive_form_discStar isOpen_ball (discStar_ball c r) hω hcl

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.exists_primitive_form_locally
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_form_locally [CompleteSpace F] {s : Set (Fin n → ℂ)}
    (hs : IsOpen s) {ω' : (Fin n → ℂ) → ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin (q + 1)]→L[ℂ] F)}
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω' s) (hcl : ∀ z ∈ s, extDeriv ω' z = 0)
    {x : Fin n → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    ∃ r > 0, ball x r ⊆ s ∧
      ∃ η : (Fin n → ℂ) → ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F),
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ η (ball x r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball x r, extDeriv η z = ω' z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hs x hx
  exact ⟨r, hr0, hball,
    exists_primitive_form_ball (hω.mono hball) fun z hz => hcl z (hball hz)⟩

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscPoincare.const_of_extDeriv_eq_zero_ball
proof:
:= by
  set σ : ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin 0]→L[ℂ] F) →L[ℂ] F :=
    ((constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (Fin 0)).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv :
      ((Fin n → ℂ) [⋀^Fin 0]→L[ℂ] F) ≃L[ℂ] F).toContinuousLinearMap with hσ
  set k : (Fin n → ℂ) → F := fun v => σ (g v) with hk
  have hgk : g = fun v => constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (k v) := by
    funext v
    have h1 : constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (k v) =
        (constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (Fin 0))
          ((constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (Fin 0)).symm (g v)) := rfl
    rw [h1, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hkdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ k (ball x r) :=
    σ.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hg.differentiableOn
  have hk0 : Set.EqOn (fderiv ℂ k) 0 (ball x r) := by
    intro y hy
    have hder : extDeriv g y =
        ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hgk]
      exact extDeriv_constOfIsEmpty k y
    have h0 : ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y) = 0 :=
      hder.symm.trans (hd y hy)
    show fderiv ℂ k y = 0
    ext w
    have h1 : (ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) F (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y))
        (fun _ => w) = 0 := by rw [h0]; rfl
    rw [ofSubsingleton_apply_apply] at h1
    exact h1
  intro y hy z hz
  have hconst : k y = k z :=
    isOpen_ball.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (convex_ball x r).isPreconnected
      hkdiff hk0 hy hz
  rw [hgk]
  exact congrArg (constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0)) hconst

name: HodgePilot.StatementScope.isHodgeClassOfInputsProjective_iff_proper
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassOfInputsProjective_iff_proper
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth g]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper g] (hproj : IsProjectiveWitnessedOver g)
    {T : TopCat.{0}} (π : T ⟶ (X : TopCat))
    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T)
      AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ℤ)
    (u : Hyper.reindexZ (DeRhamSheaf.deRhamSheafComplexSpaceN (cRingHom g)) ⟶
      ((pushforwardAb π).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
    (e : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) 0).obj
          (bettiSheafC T) ⟶ K)
    (p : ℕ) (c : bettiQ T (2 * p)) :
    IsHodgeClassOfInputsProjective g d hproj π K u e p c ↔
      IsHodgeClassOfInputsProper g π K u e p c
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.StatementScope.hodgeShapeOfInputsProjective_iff_proper
statement:
theorem hodgeShapeOfInputsProjective_iff_proper
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian X]
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth g]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper g] (hproj : IsProjectiveWitnessedOver g)
    {T : TopCat.{0}} (π : T ⟶ (X : TopCat))
    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T)
      AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ℤ)
    (u : Hyper.reindexZ (DeRhamSheaf.deRhamSheafComplexSpaceN (cRingHom g)) ⟶
      ((pushforwardAb π).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
    (e : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) 0).obj
          (bettiSheafC T) ⟶ K)
    (p : ℕ)
    (cyc : Scheme.ChowGroup X (p : ℕ∞) →+ bettiQ T (2 * p)) :
    hodgeShapeOfInputsProjective g d hproj π K u e p cyc ↔
      hodgeShapeOfInputsProper g π K u e p cyc
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_zero
statement: theorem eulerFun_zero : eulerFun A 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_single
statement:
theorem eulerFun_single (n : ℤ) (a : A) :
    eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single n ((n : A) * a)
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_single_index
    (by rw [mul_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero])

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_add
statement:
theorem eulerFun_add (f g : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    eulerFun A (f + g) = eulerFun A f + eulerFun A g
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index'
    (fun n => by rw [mul_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero])
    (fun n a b => by rw [mul_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add])

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_smul
statement:
theorem eulerFun_smul (c : A) (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    eulerFun A (c • f) = c • eulerFun A f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, eulerFun_zero, smul_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [smul_add, eulerFun_add, hf, hg, eulerFun_add, smul_add]
  | single m a =>
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.smul_single, eulerFun_single, eulerFun_single,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.smul_single]
      congr 1
      rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_single_mul_single
statement:
theorem eulerFun_single_mul_single (m n : ℤ) (a b : A) :
    eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m a * AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single m a * eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b) +
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b * eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, eulerFun_single, eulerFun_single,
    eulerFun_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, show n + m = m + n from add_comm n m,
    ← AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_mul_single
statement:
theorem eulerFun_mul_single (n : ℤ) (b : A) (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    eulerFun A (f * AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b) =
      f * eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b) +
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single n b * eulerFun A f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, eulerFun_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [add_mul, eulerFun_add, hf, hg, eulerFun_add]
      ring
  | single m a => exact eulerFun_single_mul_single A m n a b

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_mul
statement:
theorem eulerFun_mul (f g : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    eulerFun A (f * g) = f * eulerFun A g + g * eulerFun A f
proof:
:= by
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, eulerFun_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [mul_add, eulerFun_add, h₁, h₂, eulerFun_add]
      ring
  | single n b => exact eulerFun_mul_single A n b f

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerDerivation_apply
statement:
theorem eulerDerivation_apply (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    eulerDerivation A f = eulerFun A f
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerFun_apply_zero
statement: theorem eulerFun_apply_zero (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) : eulerFun A f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [eulerFun_zero]; rfl
  | add f g hf hg =>
      have hadd : (eulerFun A f + eulerFun A g) 0 = eulerFun A f 0 + eulerFun A g 0 :=
        Finsupp.add_apply _ _ _
      rw [eulerFun_add, hadd, hf, hg, add_zero]
  | single n a =>
      rw [eulerFun_single]
      rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
      · rw [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero]; rfl
      · exact Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' hn

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.tUnit_val
statement: @[simp] theorem tUnit_val : ((tUnit A : (A[T;T⁻¹])ˣ) : A[T;T⁻¹]) = T 1
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.residue_d
statement:
theorem residue_d (x : DR A A[T;T⁻¹] 0) :
    residue A (DeRham.d A A[T;T⁻¹] 0 x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (eulerDerivation A).liftKaehlerDifferential
      (drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹] (DeRham.d A A[T;T⁻¹] 0 x)) 0 = 0
  rw [drOneEquiv_d, Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D]
  exact eulerFun_apply_zero A _

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.eulerDerivation_T_one
statement: theorem eulerDerivation_T_one : eulerDerivation A (T 1) = (T 1 : A[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:= by
  show eulerFun A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : A)) = T 1
  rw [eulerFun_single, Int.cast_one, one_mul]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.residue_dlog_tUnit
statement:
theorem residue_dlog_tUnit :
    residue A (DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show (eulerDerivation A).liftKaehlerDifferential
      (drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹] (DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A))) 0 = 1
  have h1 : DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A) =
      (T (-1) : A[T;T⁻¹]) •
        DeRham.gen A A[T;T⁻¹] (DLog.konst A[T;T⁻¹] (T 1)) := rfl
  have h2 : drOneEquiv A A[T;T⁻¹]
      (DeRham.gen A A[T;T⁻¹] (DLog.konst A[T;T⁻¹] (T 1))) =
        D A A[T;T⁻¹] (T 1) := by
    have h := drOneEquiv_mk_single A A[T;T⁻¹] (DLog.konst A[T;T⁻¹] (T 1)) 1
    rw [one_smul] at h
    exact h
  rw [h1, map_smul, h2, map_smul, Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D,
    eulerDerivation_T_one, smul_eq_mul, ← T_add,
    show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num, T_zero]
  exact Finsupp.single_eq_same

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.dlog_tUnit_not_exact
statement:
theorem dlog_tUnit_not_exact [Nontrivial A] :
    DLog.dlog A A[T;T⁻¹] (tUnit A) ∉
      LinearMap.range (DeRham.d A A[T;T⁻¹] 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h := residue_d A x
  rw [hx, residue_dlog_tUnit] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.deRhamSc'_f
statement:
theorem deRhamSc'_f :
    ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).f = ModuleCat.ofHom (DeRham.d A B 0)
proof:
:=
  deRhamComplex_d A B 0

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.deRhamSc'_g
statement:
theorem deRhamSc'_g :
    ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).g = ModuleCat.ofHom (DeRham.d A B 1)
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.unitClass_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unitClass_ne_zero (u : Bˣ)
    (h : DLog.dlog A B u ∉ LinearMap.range (DeRham.d A B 0)) :
    unitClass A B u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h0' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (unitCycle A B u) :
      _ ⧸ LinearMap.range ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).moduleCatToCycles) = 0 := h0
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h0'
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h0'
  apply h
  have hval : ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).f.hom x = DLog.dlog A B u :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hx
  have hfd := congrArg
    (fun q : ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).X₁ ⟶
        ((deRhamComplex A B).sc' 0 1 2).X₂ => q.hom x)
    (deRhamSc'_f A B)
  exact ⟨x, hfd.symm.trans hval⟩

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.unitCohomologyClass_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unitCohomologyClass_ne_zero (u : Bˣ)
    (h : DLog.dlog A B u ∉ LinearMap.range (DeRham.d A B 0)) :
    unitCohomologyClass A B u ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 =>
  unitClass_ne_zero A B u h ((h1Equiv A B).symm.map_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.nontrivial_deRhamCohomology_one
statement:
theorem nontrivial_deRhamCohomology_one (u : Bˣ)
    (h : DLog.dlog A B u ∉ LinearMap.range (DeRham.d A B 0)) :
    Nontrivial (deRhamCohomology A B 1)
proof:
:=
  nontrivial_of_ne _ _ (unitCohomologyClass_ne_zero A B u h)

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.laurentAnchorClass_ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.gmChart_aeval_vanish
statement:
theorem gmChart_aeval_vanish :
    ∀ a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation),
      aeval (R := ℂ) (S₁ := ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) ![T 1, T (-1)] a = 0
proof:
:= fun a ha => by
  have hker : Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation) ≤
      RingHom.ker (aeval (R := ℂ) (S₁ := ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) ![T 1, T (-1)]) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro q ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker]
    show aeval ![T 1, T (-1)] ((X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) * X 1 - 1) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, aeval_X, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, ← T_add,
      show (1 : ℤ) + -1 = 0 by norm_num, T_zero, sub_self]
  exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hker ha)

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.gmChartToLaurent_mk
statement:
theorem gmChartToLaurent_mk (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    gmChartToLaurent (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) q) =
      aeval ![T 1, T (-1)] q
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun
    (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_comp (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation))
      (aeval ![T 1, T (-1)]) gmChart_aeval_vanish) q

statement:

:= by

    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 0)) = T 1
  rw [gmChartToLaurent_mk, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero]

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.unitsMap_gmUnit

theorem unitsMap_gmUnit :

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.dlog_gmUnit_not_exact
statement:
theorem dlog_gmUnit_not_exact :
    DLog.dlog ℂ GmRing gmUnit ∉ LinearMap.range (DeRham.d ℂ GmRing 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  apply dlog_tUnit_not_exact ℂ
  refine ⟨DeRham.map gmChartToLaurent 0 x, ?_⟩
  calc DeRham.d ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) 0 (DeRham.map gmChartToLaurent 0 x)
      = DeRham.map gmChartToLaurent 1 (DeRham.d ℂ GmRing 0 x) :=
        LinearMap.congr_fun (DeRham.d_comp_map gmChartToLaurent 0) x
    _ = DeRham.map gmChartToLaurent 1 (DLog.dlog ℂ GmRing gmUnit) := by
        rw [hx]
    _ = DLog.dlog ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹])
          (Units.map (gmChartToLaurent : GmRing →* ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) gmUnit) :=
        DLog.map_dlog ℂ GmRing gmChartToLaurent gmUnit
    _ = DLog.dlog ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) (tUnit ℂ) := by rw [unitsMap_gmUnit]

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.gmChart_laurent_roundtrip
statement:
theorem gmChart_laurent_roundtrip :
    gmChartToLaurent.comp laurentToGmChart = AlgHom.id ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:=
  algHom_laurent_ext (by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
    have h1 : laurentToGmChart (T 1) = ((gmUnit : GmRingˣ) : GmRing) := by
      show laurentEvalAlgHom (R := ℂ) gmUnit (T 1) = _
      rw [laurentEvalAlgHom_T, zpow_one]
    rw [h1, gmChartToLaurent_x])

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.laurent_gmChart_roundtrip
statement:
theorem laurent_gmChart_roundtrip :
    laurentToGmChart.comp gmChartToLaurent = AlgHom.id ℂ GmRing
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      show laurentToGmChart (gmChartToLaurent
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 0))) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 0)
      rw [gmChartToLaurent_mk, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      show laurentEvalAlgHom (R := ℂ) gmUnit (T 1) = _
      rw [laurentEvalAlgHom_T, zpow_one]
      rfl
  | succ i =>
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim i 0
      show laurentToGmChart (gmChartToLaurent
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 1))) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 1)
      rw [gmChartToLaurent_mk, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      show laurentEvalAlgHom (R := ℂ) gmUnit (T (-1)) = _
      rw [laurentEvalAlgHom_T, zpow_neg_one]
      rfl

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.gmScheme_presheaf_map_top
statement:
theorem gmScheme_presheaf_map_top (y : Γ(gmScheme, ⊤)) :
    gmScheme.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : gmScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op y = y
proof:
:= by
  have key : gmScheme.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : gmScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 Γ(gmScheme, ⊤) := by
    rw [show homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : gmScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤) = 𝟙 (⊤ : gmScheme.Opens)
        from rfl, op_id, gmScheme.presheaf.map_id]
  exact congrArg (fun g => g.hom y) key

name: HodgePilot.ContentAnchor.gammaSpec_roundtrip
statement:
theorem gammaSpec_roundtrip (x : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) :

      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]))).inv.hom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun q : CommRingCat.of (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) ⟶ CommRingCat.of (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) => q.hom x)
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]))).inv_hom_id

proof:
:= by

  refine ⟨DeRham.map sectionsToLaurent 0 x, ?_⟩
  calc DeRham.d ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) 0 (DeRham.map sectionsToLaurent 0 x)
      = DeRham.map sectionsToLaurent 1
          (DeRham.d ℂ (DeRhamPresheaf.Sec gmBase ⊤) 0 x) :=
        LinearMap.congr_fun (DeRham.d_comp_map sectionsToLaurent 0) x
    _ = DeRham.map sectionsToLaurent 1
          (DLog.dlog ℂ (DeRhamPresheaf.Sec gmBase ⊤) gmSectionsUnit) := by
        rw [hx]
    _ = DLog.dlog ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹])
          (Units.map (sectionsToLaurent :
            DeRhamPresheaf.Sec gmBase ⊤ →* ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) gmSectionsUnit) :=
        DLog.map_dlog ℂ (DeRhamPresheaf.Sec gmBase ⊤) sectionsToLaurent
          gmSectionsUnit
    _ = DLog.dlog ℂ (ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) (tUnit ℂ) := by rw [unitsMap_gmSectionsUnit]

statement:
theorem gmScheme_presheafOpens_top (p : ℕ) :

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_of_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases h0 : i = i₀
    · subst h0
      have hrest : (⨆ (j : ι) (_ : j ≠ i), A j) = ⊥ :=
        iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun j => iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun hj => hbot j hj
      rw [hrest]
      exact disjoint_bot_right
    · rw [hbot i h0]
      exact disjoint_bot_left
  · refine eq_top_iff.mpr ?_
    rw [← htop]
    exact le_iSup A i₀

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_of_isCompl_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem isInternal_of_isCompl_of_eq_bot {A : ι → Submodule R M} {i₀ i₁ : ι}
    (hne : i₀ ≠ i₁) (hbot : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → i ≠ i₁ → A i = ⊥)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (A i₀) (A i₁)) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal A
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases h0 : i = i₀
    · subst h0
      have hrest : (⨆ (j : ι) (_ : j ≠ i), A j) ≤ A i₁ := by
        refine iSup₂_le fun j hj => ?_
        by_cases h1 : j = i₁
        · exact h1 ▸ le_rfl
        · rw [hbot j hj h1]
          exact bot_le
      exact hcompl.disjoint.mono_right hrest
    · by_cases h1 : i = i₁
      · subst h1
        have hrest : (⨆ (j : ι) (_ : j ≠ i), A j) ≤ A i₀ := by
          refine iSup₂_le fun j hj => ?_
          by_cases h0' : j = i₀
          · exact h0' ▸ le_rfl
          · rw [hbot j h0' hj]
            exact bot_le
        exact hcompl.symm.disjoint.mono_right hrest
      · rw [hbot i h0 h1]
        exact disjoint_bot_left
  · refine eq_top_iff.mpr ?_
    rw [← codisjoint_iff.mp hcompl.codisjoint]
    exact sup_le (le_iSup A i₀) (le_iSup A i₁)

name: HodgePilot.biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep
statement:
theorem biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep {A : ι → Submodule R M}
    (hA : iSupIndep A) (P Q : ι → Prop) :
    (⨆ (i) (_ : P i), A i) ⊓ (⨆ (i) (_ : Q i), A i) ≤
      ⨆ (i) (_ : P i ∧ Q i), A i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hxP, hxQ⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_biSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp] at hxP hxQ
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hxP
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hxQ
  have hfg : f.filter P = g.filter Q :=
    (iSupIndep_iff_dfinsupp_lsum_injective A).mp hA (hf.trans hg.symm)
  rw [Submodule.mem_biSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp]
  refine ⟨f.filter P, ?_⟩
  have hkey : (f.filter P).filter (fun i => P i ∧ Q i) = f.filter P := by
    ext i
    by_cases hPQ : P i ∧ Q i
    · simp [DFinsupp.filter_apply, hPQ]
    · rcases not_and_or.mp hPQ with hP | hQ
      · simp [DFinsupp.filter_apply, hP]
      · rw [hfg]
        simp [DFinsupp.filter_apply, hQ]
  rw [hkey]
  exact hf

name: HodgePilot.biSup_inf_biSup_of_iSupIndep
statement:
theorem biSup_inf_biSup_of_iSupIndep {A : ι → Submodule R M}
    (hA : iSupIndep A) (P Q : ι → Prop) :
    (⨆ (i) (_ : P i), A i) ⊓ (⨆ (i) (_ : Q i), A i) =
      ⨆ (i) (_ : P i ∧ Q i), A i
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep hA P Q)
    (le_inf
      (iSup₂_le fun i hi => le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : P i) => A i) i hi.1)
      (iSup₂_le fun i hi => le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : Q i) => A i) i hi.2))

name: HodgePilot.ordFrac_algebraMap_eq_one_of_isUnit
statement:
lemma ordFrac_algebraMap_eq_one_of_isUnit {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R] [Nontrivial R]
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    {r : R} (hr : IsUnit r) :
    Ring.ordFrac R (algebraMap R K r) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact zero_ne_one (isUnit_zero_iff.mp hr)
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord R hr0,
    Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe R hr.mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (n := 0) (by simp [Ring.ord_of_isUnit hr])]
  simp

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso
statement:
lemma stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso {x w : X} (h : w ⤳ x) :
    X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h ≫
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr
        (Inseparable.of_eq (fromSpecStalk_generizationPt h).symm)).hom ≫
      (X.fromSpecStalk x).stalkMap (generizationPt h) ≫
      (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) (generizationPt h)).hom =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (Localization.AtPrime (generizationPt h).asIdeal))
proof:
:= by
  apply Spec.map_injective
  rw [← cancel_mono (X.fromSpecStalk x)]
  simp only [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk,
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk,
    Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, Category.assoc,
    Spec.germ_stalkMapIso_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso_apply
statement:
lemma stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso_apply {x w : X} (h : w ⤳ x)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) (generizationPt h)).hom
      ((X.fromSpecStalk x).stalkMap (generizationPt h)
        ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr
          (Inseparable.of_eq (fromSpecStalk_generizationPt h).symm)).hom
            (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h a))) =
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (Localization.AtPrime (generizationPt h).asIdeal) a
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso h)
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h2
  have h3 := RingHom.congr_fun h2 a
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h3
  exact h3

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.residueFieldCongr_residue_apply
statement:
lemma residueFieldCongr_residue_apply {x y : X} (e : x = y)
    (t : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    (X.residueFieldCongr e).hom (X.residue x t) =
      X.residue y ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq e)).hom t)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residue_residueFieldCongr X e)
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h2
  have h3 := RingHom.congr_fun h2 t
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h3
  exact h3

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.residueFieldMap_residue_apply

    (s : Y.presheaf.stalk (f p)) :
    f.residueFieldMap p (Y.residue (f p) s) = X.residue p (f.stalkMap p s)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residue_residueFieldMap f p)
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h2
  have h3 := RingHom.congr_fun h2 s
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h3
  exact h3

statement:
lemma residueFieldIso_residue_apply (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R)
    (u : (Spec R).presheaf.stalk p) :
    (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso R p).hom ((Spec R).residue p u) =

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.residue_localization_algebraMap
statement:
lemma residue_localization_algebraMap {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (q : Ideal R)
    [q.IsPrime] (a : R) :
    IsLocalRing.residue (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) a) =
      algebraMap (R ⧸ q) q.ResidueField (Ideal.Quotient.mk q a)
proof:
:=
  ((RingHom.congr_fun
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq (Localization.AtPrime q))
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) a)).symm.trans
    (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (Localization.AtPrime q)
      q.ResidueField a).symm).trans
    ((IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (R ⧸ q) q.ResidueField a).trans
      (congrArg (algebraMap (R ⧸ q) q.ResidueField)
        (RingHom.congr_fun (Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq q) a)))

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.residueFieldEquivGenerization_residue
statement:
lemma residueFieldEquivGenerization_residue {x w : X} (h : w ⤳ x)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    residueFieldEquivGenerization h (X.residue w (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h a)) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ (generizationPt h).asIdeal)
        ((generizationPt h).asIdeal).ResidueField
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold residueFieldEquivGenerization
  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
    commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv_apply, commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv_apply,
    RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply, commRingCat_hom_apply,
    residueFieldCongr_residue_apply, residueFieldMap_residue_apply,
    residueFieldIso_residue_apply, stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_stalkIso_apply,
    residue_localization_algebraMap]

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.ordAt_residue_stalkSpecializes_of_isUnit
statement:
lemma ordAt_residue_stalkSpecializes_of_isUnit {x w : X} (h : x ⋖ w)

    ordAt h (X.residue w
      (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_covby h) a)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := krullDimLE_one_stalkQuotient h
  rw [ordAt_apply, residueFieldEquivGenerization_residue]
  exact ordFrac_algebraMap_eq_one_of_isUnit (ha.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _))

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.finite_setOf_covby_mem_closed
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_covby_mem_closed {X : Scheme.{u}} [NoetherianSpace X]
    {w : X} {Z : Set X} (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hw : w ∉ Z) :
    {x : X | x ⋖ w ∧ x ∈ Z}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSf, hSc, hSi, hSU⟩ :=
    NoetherianSpace.exists_finite_set_isClosed_irreducible
      (hZ.inter (isClosed_closure (s := ({w} : Set X))))
  refine Set.Finite.subset
    (hSf.biUnion (t := fun t => {y : X | IsGenericPoint y t})
      (fun t _ => Set.Subsingleton.finite fun _ h1 _ h2 => h1.eq h2)) ?_
  rintro x ⟨hcov, hxZ⟩
  have hxw : x ∈ closure ({w} : Set X) :=
    specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hcov.lt.le)
  have hx' : x ∈ Z ∩ closure ({w} : Set X) := ⟨hxZ, hxw⟩
  rw [hSU] at hx'
  obtain ⟨t, htS, hxt⟩ := hx'
  have hti : IsIrreducible t := hSi t htS
  have hgen : IsGenericPoint hti.genericPoint t :=
    hti.isGenericPoint_genericPoint (hSc t htS)
  have htsub : t ⊆ Z ∩ closure ({w} : Set X) := by
    rw [hSU]; exact Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem htS
  have hxc : x ≤ hti.genericPoint :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hgen.specializes hxt)
  have hcw : hti.genericPoint ≤ w :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr (htsub hgen.mem).2)
  have hcne : hti.genericPoint ≠ w := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hw (htsub hgen.mem).1
  have hxeq : x = hti.genericPoint := by
    by_cases hcx : hti.genericPoint ≤ x
    · exact point_le_antisymm hxc hcx
    · exact absurd (lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr
        ⟨hcw, fun hwc => hcne (point_le_antisymm hcw hwc)⟩)
        (hcov.2 (lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hxc, hcx⟩))
  exact Set.mem_biUnion htS (hxeq ▸ hgen)

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.support_divFun_finite
statement:
theorem support_divFun_finite {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (w : X) {f : X.residueField w} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    (Function.support (divFun w f)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := X.residue_surjective w f
  have hu : IsUnit t := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    show X.residue w t ≠ 0
    rw [ht]; exact hf
  
  obtain ⟨U, hwU, s, hs⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq t
  have hwB : w ∈ X.basicOpen s := by
    rw [X.mem_basicOpen s w hwU, hs]; exact hu
  
  refine Set.Finite.subset
    (finite_setOf_covby_mem_closed
      (isClosed_compl_iff.mpr (X.basicOpen s).isOpen)
      (fun hc => hc hwB)) ?_
  intro x hx
  have hcov : x ⋖ w := support_divFun_subset w f hx
  refine ⟨hcov, fun hxB => hx ?_⟩
  have hxU : x ∈ U := X.basicOpen_le s hxB
  have hgu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU s) := by
    have hxB' : x ∈ X.basicOpen s := hxB
    rwa [X.mem_basicOpen s x hxU] at hxB'
  have hgw : X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_covby hcov)
      (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU s) = t := by
    rw [← hs]
    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply X.presheaf hxU
      (specializes_of_covby hcov) s
  show divFun w f x = 0
  rw [divFun_apply_of_covby hcov, ← ht, ← hgw,
    ordAt_residue_stalkSpecializes_of_isUnit hcov hgu, WithZero.log_one]

lemma pointClass_add {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {p : ℕ∞} (x : X)

    pointClass X x hx (m + n) = pointClass X x hx m + pointClass X x hx n

  refine congrArg (cycleClass X p) (Subtype.ext ?_)

  show Cycle.single x (m + n) y
    = (Cycle.single x m + Cycle.single x n : Scheme.Cycle X ℤ) y
  rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_add, Pi.add_apply,
    Cycle.single_apply, Cycle.single_apply, Cycle.single_apply]

statement:
theorem hyperH_exact₁_zero (Z : C) {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) {m n : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n)
    (hsub : Subsingleton (hyperH Z S.X₃ m))
    (x : hyperH Z S.X₁ n) (hx : hyperHMap Z S.f n x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hsub
  have hT := Triangle.shift_distinguished _
    (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished hS) n
  have hT' := inv_rot_of_distTriang _ hT
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ hT' x (by
    show x ≫ (n.negOnePow •
      ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.f))) = 0
    have hx' : x ≫ (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.f) = 0 := hx
    rw [Units.smul_def, Preadditive.comp_zsmul, hx', smul_zero])
  have e : (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z) ⟶
      ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n ⋙ shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) (-1)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₃))) ≃ hyperH Z S.X₃ m :=
    Iso.homCongr (Iso.refl _)
      ((shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) n (-1) m (by omega)).symm.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₃))
  have hgz : g = 0 := e.injective (Subsingleton.elim (e g) (e 0))
  rw [hg, hgz, Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.FullNonvanishing.hyperHMap_injective_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem hyperHMap_injective_of_subsingleton (Z : C)
    {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact) {m n : ℤ}
    (hmn : m + 1 = n) (hsub : Subsingleton (hyperH Z S.X₃ m)) :
    Function.Injective ⇑(hyperHMap Z S.f n)
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => hyperH_exact₁_zero Z hS hmn hsub x hx

name: HodgePilot.FullNonvanishing.truncSES_shortExact
statement: theorem truncSES_shortExact : truncSES.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact
  intro i
  rcases lt_trichotomy i 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · 
    have hz1 : IsZero ((Hyper.brutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1).X i) :=
      Hyper.isZero_brutalTruncGE_X _ 1 i (by omega)
    have hz2 : IsZero ((deRhamSheafComplex φC).X i) :=
      Hyper.isZero_reindexZ_X (deRhamSheafComplexN φC) i hneg
    have hz3 : IsZero (structOSingle.X i) :=
      HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (deRhamSheafAb φC 0) i (by omega)
    exact
      { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ hz2
        mono_f := mono_of_isZero_src hz1 _
        epi_g := epi_of_isZero_tgt hz3 _ }
  · 
    
    subst hzero
    have hz1 : IsZero ((Hyper.brutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1).X 0) :=
      Hyper.isZero_brutalTruncGE_X _ 1 0 (by omega)
    have hf0 : (truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ (0 : ℤ))).f = 0 :=
      hz1.eq_of_src _ _
    haveI hgi : IsIso ((truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ (0 : ℤ))).g) := by
      rw [show (truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ (0 : ℤ))).g =
          projZeroIso.hom ≫ (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
            (deRhamSheafAb φC 0)).inv from
        HomologicalComplex.mkHomToSingle_f projZeroIso.hom projZero_d_comp]
      infer_instance
    exact
      { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono _ hf0).mpr inferInstance
        mono_f := mono_of_isZero_src hz1 _
        epi_g := inferInstance }
  · 
    
    have hz3 : IsZero (structOSingle.X i) :=
      HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
        (deRhamSheafAb φC 0) i (by omega)
    have hg0 : (truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ i)).g = 0 :=
      hz3.eq_of_tgt _ _
    have hie : (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE (1 : ℤ)).f (i - 1).toNat = i := by
      rw [Hyper.embeddingUpIntGE_f]; omega
    haveI hfi : IsIso ((truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ i)).f) := by
      rw [show (truncSES.map (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ i)).f =
          ((deRhamSheafComplex φC).stupidTruncXIso
            (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE 1) hie).hom from
        Hyper.ιStupidTrunc_f (deRhamSheafComplex φC)
          (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE 1) hie]
      infer_instance
    exact
      { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi _ hg0).mpr inferInstance
        mono_f := inferInstance
        epi_g := epi_of_isZero_tgt hz3 _ }
