name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.pi_alt_fin1_eq
statement:
theorem pi_alt_fin1_eq (φ : (Fin 1 → ℂ) [⋀^Fin 1]→L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (w : Fin 1 → (Fin 1 → ℂ)) :
    φ w = w 0 0 * φ (fun _ => oneVec)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : w = fun i => (w i 0) • oneVec := by
    funext i j
    have hj : j = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j
    subst hj
    simp [oneVec]
  calc φ w = φ (fun i => (w i 0) • oneVec) := congrArg (fun v => φ v) hw
    _ = (∏ i : Fin 1, w i 0) • φ (fun _ => oneVec) :=
        φ.map_smul_univ (fun i => w i 0) (fun _ => oneVec)
    _ = w 0 0 * φ (fun _ => oneVec) := by
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_one, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.formSpace_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem formSpace_apply_eq_zero {p : ℕ} (φ : FormSpace 1 (p + 2))
    (w : Fin (p + 2) → (Fin 1 → ℂ)) : φ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw : w = fun i => (w i 0) • oneVec := by
    funext i j
    have hj : j = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j
    subst hj
    simp [oneVec]
  have hzero : φ (fun _ => oneVec) = 0 :=
    φ.map_eq_zero_of_eq (fun _ => oneVec) (i := 0) (j := 1) rfl
      (by exact Fin.zero_ne_one)
  calc φ w = φ (fun i => (w i 0) • oneVec) := congrArg (fun v => φ v) hw
    _ = (∏ i, w i 0) • φ (fun _ => oneVec) :=
        φ.map_smul_univ (fun i => w i 0) (fun _ => oneVec)
    _ = 0 := by rw [hzero, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.exists_primitive_form_pi
proof:
:= by
  
  set ℓ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (Fin 1 → ℂ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun _ : Fin 1 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) with hℓ
  set π : (Fin 1 → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0 with hπ
  have hℓ_apply : ∀ (z : ℂ) (j : Fin 1), ℓ z j = z := fun z j => rfl
  have hℓ_eq : ∀ v : Fin 1 → ℂ, ℓ (v 0) = v := by
    intro v
    funext j
    have hj : j = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j
    subst hj
    rfl
  
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo ℓ (ball (x 0) r) (ball x r) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
    have hsub : ℓ z - x = fun _ : Fin 1 => z - x 0 := by
      funext j
      have hj : j = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j
      subst hj
      rfl
    rw [hsub, pi_norm_const]
    exact hz
  
  set h : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F (ℓ z) (fun _ => oneVec) with hh
  have hFdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F (ℓ z)) (ball (x 0) r) :=
    (hF.differentiableOn.comp ℓ.differentiable.differentiableOn hmaps)
  have hhdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ h (ball (x 0) r) :=
    hFdiff.continuousAlternatingMap_apply (fun _ => differentiableOn_const oneVec)
  
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hhdiff.isExactOn_ball
  have hg₀diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₀ (ball (x 0) r) := fun z hz =>
    (hg₀ z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hg₀an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g₀ (ball (x 0) r) :=
    hg₀diff.analyticOnNhd isOpen_ball
  have hball : ∀ y : Fin 1 → ℂ, y ∈ ball x r → π y ∈ ball (x 0) r := by
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy ⊢
    calc ‖π y - x 0‖ = ‖(y - x) 0‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (y - x) 0
      _ < r := hy
  refine ⟨fun v => g₀ (π v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro y hy
    exact (hg₀an (π y) (hball y hy)).comp (π.analyticAt y)
  · intro y hy
    
    have hDf : HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin 1 → ℂ => g₀ (π v))
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) (h (π y))).comp π) y :=
      (hg₀ (π y) (hball y hy)).hasFDerivAt.comp y π.hasFDerivAt
    rw [extDeriv_constOfIsEmpty, hDf.fderiv]
    refine ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext fun w => ?_
    have hval : h (π y) = F y (fun _ => oneVec) := by
      show F (ℓ (π y)) (fun _ => oneVec) = F y (fun _ => oneVec)
      rw [show ℓ (π y) = y from hℓ_eq y]
    have hLHS : (ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (0 : Fin 1)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) (h (π y))).comp π)) w =
        w 0 0 * h (π y) := by
      rw [ofSubsingleton_apply_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self]
      show w 0 0 • h (π y) = w 0 0 * h (π y)
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
    have hRHS : F y w = w 0 0 * h (π y) := by
      rw [pi_alt_fin1_eq (F y) w, hval]
    rw [hLHS, hRHS]

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.const_of_extDeriv_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  set σ : ((Fin 1 → ℂ) [⋀^Fin 0]→L[ℂ] ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    ((constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv :
      ((Fin 1 → ℂ) [⋀^Fin 0]→L[ℂ] ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap with hσ
  set k : (Fin 1 → ℂ) → ℂ := fun v => σ (g v) with hk
  
  have hgk : g = fun v => constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (k v) := by
    funext v
    have h1 : constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (k v) =
        (constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0))
          ((constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm (g v)) := rfl
    rw [h1, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hkdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ k (ball x r) :=
    σ.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hg.differentiableOn
  
  have hk0 : Set.EqOn (fderiv ℂ k) 0 (ball x r) := by
    intro y hy
    have hder : extDeriv g y =
        ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hgk]
      exact extDeriv_constOfIsEmpty k y
    have h0 : ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y) = 0 :=
      hder.symm.trans (hd y hy)
    ext v
    have h1 : (ofSubsingleton ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (0 : Fin 1) (fderiv ℂ k y))
        (fun _ => v) = 0 := by rw [h0]; rfl
    rw [ofSubsingleton_apply_apply] at h1
    exact h1
  intro y hy z hz
  have hconst : k y = k z :=
    isOpen_ball.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (convex_ball x r).isPreconnected
      hkdiff hk0 hy hz
  rw [hgk]
  exact congrArg (constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0)) hconst

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv
statement:
theorem stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
    {U : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))} (hx : x ∈ U) (c : ULift.{0} ℂ) :
    (stalkAt x).map (augment 1)
        ((stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv c) =
      germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hx (constFormSection 1 (op U) c.down)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : germ x (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) hx
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c) =
      (stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv c := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toSheafify_comp_germ x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) hx) c
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (augment 1) hx)
    ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
      ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c)
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  
  have h2 : (augment 1).hom.app (op U)
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c) =
      constFormSection 1 (op U) c.down := by
    have hnat := NatTrans.congr_app (toSheafify_comp_augment 1) (op U)
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hnat c
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  exact (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) t) h0.symm).trans
    (h1.trans (congrArg (fun t => germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hx t) h2))

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_augment_injective
statement:
theorem stalk_augment_injective (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) :
    Function.Injective ((stalkAt x).map (augment 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have htop : x ∈ (⊤ : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) := trivial
  set e := stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) with he
  
  have hcd : germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) htop (constFormSection 1 (op ⊤) (e.hom a).down) =
      germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) htop (constFormSection 1 (op ⊤) (e.hom b).down) := by
    calc germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) htop (constFormSection 1 (op ⊤) (e.hom a).down)
        = (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) (e.inv (e.hom a)) :=
          (stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv x htop (e.hom a)).symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) a :=
          congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) t) (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a)
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) b := hab
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) (e.inv (e.hom b)) :=
          (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) t) (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)).symm
      _ = germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) htop (constFormSection 1 (op ⊤) (e.hom b).down) :=
          stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv x htop (e.hom b)
  
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ := (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafAb 1 0) htop _ _).mp hcd
  have heval : ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom a).down =
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down :=
    congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres) ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have hdown : (e.hom a).down = (e.hom b).down := by
    have h1 : (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom a).down) =
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down) :=
      congrArg (fun φ => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm φ) heval
    exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom a).down).symm.trans
      (h1.trans ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom b).down))
  have hab' : e.hom a = e.hom b := ULift.ext _ _ hdown
  exact ((Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => e.inv t) hab')).trans (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_exact_deg0
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_deg0 (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb 1 0)))
    (ht : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) t = 0) :
    ∃ z : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))),
      (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) z = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, g, hg⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective x (formSheafAb 1 0) t
  
  have h1 : germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxU (dSection g) = 0 := by
    have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (dSheafForms 1 0) hxU) g
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h2
    calc germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxU (dSection g)
        = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) (germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hxU g) := h2.symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) t :=
          congrArg (fun u => (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) u) hg
      _ = 0 := ht
  have hzero : germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxU 0 = 0 :=
    map_zero (germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxU).hom
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ :=
    (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxU (dSection g) 0).mp (h1.trans hzero.symm)
  have hres0 : (formSheafAb 1 1).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op (dSection g) = 0 := by
    rw [hres]
    exact map_zero ((formSheafAb 1 1).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hBV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp V.isOpen x hxV
  have hd0 : ∀ y ∈ ball x r, extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres0) ⟨y, hBV hy⟩
  have hgan : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sectionExtendV g) (ball x r) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV g).mono (fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy))
  have hconst := const_of_extDeriv_eq_zero hgan hd0
  have hxball : x ∈ ball x r := mem_ball_self hr0
  set c : ℂ :=
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
      (sectionExtendV g x) with hc
  set B : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)) := ⟨ball x r, isOpen_ball⟩ with hB
  have hxB : x ∈ B := hxball
  have hBU : B ≤ U := fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy)
  
  have hrestr : (formSheafAb 1 0).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op g =
      constFormSection 1 (op B) c := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    show g.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩ = ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) c
    calc g.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩ = sectionExtendV g y.1 :=
          (sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g (hBU y.2)).symm
      _ = sectionExtendV g x := hconst y.1 y.2 x hxball
      _ = ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) c := by
          rw [hc]
          exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ
            (Fin 0)).apply_symm_apply _).symm
  refine ⟨(stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv ⟨c⟩, ?_⟩
  have hstep3 : germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hxB ((formSheafAb 1 0).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op g) =
      germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) (hBU hxB) g := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_res x (formSheafAb 1 0) hBU hxB) g
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  exact (stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv x hxB ⟨c⟩).trans
    ((congrArg (fun s => germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hxB s) hrestr.symm).trans
      (hstep3.trans hg))

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_exact_deg1
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_deg1 (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
    (s : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb 1 1))) :
    ∃ t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb 1 0)),
      (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) t = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective x (formSheafAb 1 1) s
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hBU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp U.isOpen x hxU
  have hFan : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sectionExtendV f) (ball x r) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV f).mono hBU
  obtain ⟨G, hGan, hGd⟩ := exists_primitive_form_pi hFan
  set B : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)) := ⟨ball x r, isOpen_ball⟩ with hB
  have hxB : x ∈ B := mem_ball_self hr0
  have hBU' : B ≤ U := hBU
  
  have hg0 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
      (fun v => ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (G v))
      (ball x r) := by
    intro y hy
    exact (((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap).analyticAt _).comp
      (hGan y hy)
  set g := sectionOfAnalyticOnNhdV (U := B) hg0 with hgdef
  refine ⟨germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hxB g, ?_⟩
  
  have hd : dSection g = (formSheafAb 1 1).obj.map (homOfLE hBU').op f := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    show extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y.1 = f.1 ⟨y.1, hBU' y.2⟩
    have heq : sectionExtendV g =ᶠ[nhds (y.1 : Fin 1 → ℂ)]
        (fun v => ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (G v)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (B.isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
        (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g hz)
    calc extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y.1
        = extDeriv (fun v =>
            ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin 1 → ℂ) (Fin 0) (G v)) y.1 :=
          heq.extDeriv_eq
      _ = sectionExtendV f y.1 := hGd y.1 y.2
      _ = f.1 ⟨y.1, hBU' y.2⟩ := sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem f (hBU' y.2)
  calc (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) (germ x (formSheafAb 1 0) hxB g)
      = germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxB ((dSheafForms 1 0).hom.app (op B) g) := by
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (dSheafForms 1 0) hxB) g
        rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
        exact h
    _ = germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxB ((formSheafAb 1 1).obj.map (homOfLE hBU').op f) :=
        congrArg (fun s => germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) hxB s) hd
    _ = germ x (formSheafAb 1 1) (hBU' hxB) f := by
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_res x (formSheafAb 1 1) hBU' hxB) f
        rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
        exact h
    _ = s := hf

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.resolutionMap_f_zero

    resolutionMap.f 0 =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0

proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_d_zero_one
statement:
theorem stalk_d_zero_one (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1)).d 0 1 =
      (stalkReindex0 x).hom ≫ (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ≫
        (stalkReindex1 x).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hde : (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1).d 0 1 =
      (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN 1) 0).hom ≫ dSheafForms 1 0 ≫
        (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN 1) 1).inv := by
    have h := reindexZ_d_eq (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN 1) 0 1
    rw [holomorphicDeRhamComplexN_d_zero_one] at h
    exact h
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f) hde).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map
    (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN 1) 0).hom ≫ t) ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero
statement:
theorem stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map resolutionMap).f 0 =
      (stalkSingle0 x).hom ≫ (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ≫ (stalkReindex0 x).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f) resolutionMap_f_zero).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
    (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))).hom ≫ t) ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.quasiIso_stalk_resolutionMap
statement:
theorem quasiIso_stalk_resolutionMap (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) :
    QuasiIso (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map resolutionMap)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hSx : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology
        (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))) AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ))))).X n) := fun n hn =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 _ n hn)
  have hTneg : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1)).X n) := fun n hn =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_deRhamZ_X_neg n hn)
  have hTbig : ∀ n : ℤ, 2 ≤ n → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1)).X n) := fun n hn =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_deRhamZ_X_two n hn)
  
  have hexact : ∀ (W : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat ℤ) (n : ℤ),
      IsZero (W.X n) → W.ExactAt n := by
    intro W n h
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff]
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ h
  
  have hd_app : ∀ u, (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1)).d 0 1 u =
      (stalkReindex1 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ((stalkReindex0 x).hom u)) := by
    intro u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_d_zero_one x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  
  have hf_app : ∀ u, ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      resolutionMap).f 0) u =
      (stalkReindex0 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ((stalkSingle0 x).hom u)) := by
    intro u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  rw [quasiIso_iff]
  intro n
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | h0
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      resolutionMap) (-1) 0 1
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; norm_num) (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; norm_num)]
    have hf₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))))).f = 0 :=
      (hSx (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    have hg₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin 1 → ℂ)))))).g = 0 :=
      (hSx 1 (by decide)).eq_of_tgt _ _
    have hf₂ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1))).f = 0 :=
      (hTneg (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    rw [ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros
      ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).map
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map resolutionMap))
      hf₁ hg₁ hf₂]
    constructor
    · 
      rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
      intro t ht
      
      have hdt : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ((stalkReindex0 x).hom t) = 0 := by
        have h2 : (stalkReindex1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ((stalkReindex0 x).hom t)) = 0 :=
          (hd_app t).symm.trans ht
        have h3 := congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex1 x).hom u) h2
        have h4 : (stalkReindex1 x).hom ((stalkReindex1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ((stalkReindex0 x).hom t))) =
            (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) ((stalkReindex0 x).hom t) :=
          Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex1 x) _
        have h5 : (stalkReindex1 x).hom (0 : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj
            ((holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1).X 1))) = 0 :=
          map_zero (stalkReindex1 x).hom.hom
        exact h4.symm.trans (h3.trans h5)
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := stalk_exact_deg0 x ((stalkReindex0 x).hom t) hdt
      refine ⟨(stalkSingle0 x).inv z', ?_⟩
      exact (hf_app ((stalkSingle0 x).inv z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex0 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (augment 1) u))
          (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkSingle0 x) z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex0 x).inv u) hz').trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindex0 x) t)))
    · 
      show Mono ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        resolutionMap).f 0)
      rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
      intro a b hab
      have h1 : (stalkReindex0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ((stalkSingle0 x).hom a)) =
          (stalkReindex0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ((stalkSingle0 x).hom b)) :=
        (hf_app a).symm.trans (hab.trans (hf_app b))
      have h2 : (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ((stalkSingle0 x).hom a) =
          (stalkAt x).map (augment 1) ((stalkSingle0 x).hom b) :=
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex0 x) _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex0 x).hom u) h1).trans
            (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex0 x) _))
      have h3 : (stalkSingle0 x).hom a = (stalkSingle0 x).hom b :=
        stalk_augment_injective x h2
      exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0 x) a).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkSingle0 x).inv u) h3).trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0 x) b))
  rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with rfl | h1
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map resolutionMap) 1 (hexact _ _ (hSx 1 (by decide)))]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ 1)) 0 1 2
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; norm_num) (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; norm_num)]
    rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
    intro s _
    obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := stalk_exact_deg1 x ((stalkReindex1 x).hom s)
    refine ⟨(stalkReindex0 x).inv t', ?_⟩
    exact (hd_app ((stalkReindex0 x).inv t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex1 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms 1 0) u))
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex0 x) t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex1 x).inv u) ht').trans
        (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindex1 x) s)))
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map resolutionMap) n (hexact _ _ (hSx n h0))]
    rcases (show n < 0 ∨ 2 ≤ n by lia) with hneg | h2
    · exact hexact _ _ (hTneg n hneg)
    · exact hexact _ _ (hTbig n h2)

name: HodgePilot.DiscResolution.analyticDeRhamEquiv_apply
statement:

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.comp_reindexZ_d_of_comp_d_eq_zero_deg
statement:
theorem comp_reindexZ_d_of_comp_d_eq_zero_deg (m : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ K.X m)
    (hf : f ≫ K.d m (m + 1) = 0) :
    (f ≫ (reindexZXIso K m).inv) ≫ (reindexZ K).d (m : ℤ) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (reindexZ K).d (m : ℤ) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (reindexZXIso K m).hom ≫ K.d m (m + 1) ≫ (reindexZXIso K (m + 1)).inv :=
    reindexZ_d_eq K m (m + 1)
  rw [Category.assoc, hd, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc, hf,
    Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.singleToReindexZDeg_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleToReindexZDeg_f (m : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ K.X m)
    (hf : f ≫ K.d m (m + 1) = 0) :
    (singleToReindexZDeg m f hf).f (m : ℤ) =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) M).hom ≫ f ≫
        (reindexZXIso K m).inv
proof:
:=
  mkHomFromSingle_f _ _

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_f (m : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ K.X m)
    (hf : f ≫ K.d m (m + 1) = 0) :
    (singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg m f hf).f (m : ℤ) =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) M).hom ≫ f ≫
        (reindexZXIso K m).inv ≫
        (brutalTruncGEXIso (reindexZ K) (m : ℤ) (m : ℤ) le_rfl).inv
proof:
:=
  mkHomFromSingle_f _ _

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_ι
statement:
theorem singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_ι (m : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ K.X m)
    (hf : f ≫ K.d m (m + 1) = 0) :
    singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg m f hf ≫ ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ K) (m : ℤ) =
      singleToReindexZDeg m f hf
proof:
:= by
  apply from_single_hom_ext
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_f m f hf,
    singleToReindexZDeg_f m f hf,
    DLog.ιBrutalTruncGE_f (reindexZ K) (m : ℤ) (m : ℤ) le_rfl]
  simp

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_congr
statement:
theorem singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_congr (m : ℕ) {f g : M ⟶ K.X m} (h : f = g)
    (hf : f ≫ K.d m (m + 1) = 0) :
    singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg m f hf =
      singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg m g (h ▸ hf)
proof:

  cases h
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.chernShapeN_apply
statement:
theorem chernShapeN_apply (m : ℕ) (Z M : C) (L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (u : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C (m : ℤ)).obj M ⟶ L)
    (x : Abelian.Ext Z M m) :
    chernShapeN m Z M L u x =
      x.hom.comp (hyperHMap M u (m : ℤ) (singleShiftedHomDeg m M))
        (show (m : ℤ) + (m : ℤ) = 2 * (m : ℤ) by ring)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIter_zero_receipt
statement:
@[simp] theorem spliceIter_zero_receipt (xs : Fin 0 → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    spliceIter X 0 xs e = e
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIter_succ_receipt
statement:
theorem spliceIter_succ_receipt (n : ℕ)
    (xs : Fin (n + 1) → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    spliceIter X (n + 1) xs e = spliceStep X (xs 0) (spliceIter X n (Fin.tail xs) e)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIter_add
statement:
theorem spliceIter_add (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
      (e e' : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1),
      spliceIter X n xs (e + e') = spliceIter X n xs e + spliceIter X n xs e'
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro xs e e'; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro xs e e'
      rw [spliceIter_succ_receipt, spliceIter_succ_receipt, spliceIter_succ_receipt,
        ih, spliceStep_add]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIter_map_zero
statement:
theorem spliceIter_map_zero (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X),
      spliceIter X n xs (0 : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro xs; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro xs
      rw [spliceIter_succ_receipt, ih, spliceStep_map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIterHom_apply
statement:
theorem spliceIterHom_apply (n : ℕ) (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    spliceIterHom X n xs e = spliceIter X n xs e
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceIter_eq_zero_of_slot_factors
statement:
theorem spliceIter_eq_zero_of_slot_factors (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) (k : Fin n)
      (y : pairAnchor X ⟶ (cartierSCMod X).X₂), xs k = y ≫ (cartierSCMod X).g →
      ∀ e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1,
        spliceIter X n xs e = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _ k; exact k.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro xs k y hk e
      rw [spliceIter_succ_receipt]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) k hk
      · intro h0
        rw [h0]
        exact spliceStep_principal X y _
      · intro hi
        rw [ih (Fin.tail xs) i y hi e, spliceStep_map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_zero_receipt
statement:
theorem spliceN_zero_receipt (xs : Fin 1 → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) :

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_succ_receipt

theorem spliceN_succ_receipt (n : ℕ)

    spliceN X (n + 1) xs = spliceStep X (xs 0) (spliceN X n (Fin.tail xs))

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceTwo_eq_pairedClass
statement:
theorem spliceTwo_eq_pairedClass (xs : Fin 2 → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) :

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceTwo_pairData_eq_pairedDivClass
statement:
theorem spliceTwo_pairData_eq_pairedDivClass (d d' : CDiv X) :
    spliceN X 1 ![pairData X d, pairData X d'] = pairedDivClass X d d'
proof:
:= by
  rw [spliceTwo_eq_pairedClass]
  show pairedClass X (pairData X d) (spliceOne X (pairData X d')) = _
  rw [spliceOne_pairData]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_snoc
statement:
theorem spliceN_snoc (n : ℕ) (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X) :
    spliceN X n (Fin.snoc xs x) = spliceIter X n xs (spliceOne X x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold spliceN
  rw [Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_snoc_add
statement:
theorem spliceN_snoc_add (n : ℕ) (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (x x' : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X) :
    spliceN X n (Fin.snoc xs (x + x')) =
      spliceN X n (Fin.snoc xs x) + spliceN X n (Fin.snoc xs x')
proof:
:= by
  rw [spliceN_snoc, spliceN_snoc, spliceN_snoc, spliceOne_add, spliceIter_add]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceNLastHom_apply
statement:
theorem spliceNLastHom_apply (n : ℕ) (xs : Fin n → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X))
    (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X) :
    spliceNLastHom X n xs x = spliceN X n (Fin.snoc xs x)
proof:
:=
  (spliceN_snoc X n xs x).symm

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_eq_zero_of_slot_factors
statement:
theorem spliceN_eq_zero_of_slot_factors (n : ℕ)
    (xs : Fin (n + 1) → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (y : pairAnchor X ⟶ (cartierSCMod X).X₂)
    (hk : xs k = y ≫ (cartierSCMod X).g) :
    spliceN X n xs = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) k hk
  · intro hlast
    have h0 : spliceOne X (xs (Fin.last n)) = 0 := by
      rw [hlast]
      exact spliceOne_principal X y
    show spliceIter X n (Fin.init xs) (spliceOne X (xs (Fin.last n))) = 0
    rw [h0]
    exact spliceIter_map_zero X n (Fin.init xs)
  · intro hi
    exact spliceIter_eq_zero_of_slot_factors X n (Fin.init xs) i y hi _

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceN_eq_zero_of_slot_divOf
statement:
theorem spliceN_eq_zero_of_slot_divOf (n : ℕ)
    (xs : Fin (n + 1) → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (f : Additive (X.functionField)ˣ)
    (hk : xs k = pairData X (divOf X f)) :
    spliceN X n xs = 0
proof:
:=
  spliceN_eq_zero_of_slot_factors X n xs k
    (Ext.addEquiv₀ (((kUnitsH0Equiv X).symm f).mapExactFunctor
      (zSheafCarrierEquiv.{0} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).inverse))
    (by rw [hk]; exact pairData_divOf_factors X f)

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceDegreeEq
statement: theorem spliceDegreeEq (n : ℕ) : 1 + (n + 1) = n + 2
proof: := by omega

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.presheafZCongr_comp_d
statement:
theorem presheafZCongr_comp_d {m k : ℕ} (h : m = k) :
    (presheafZCongr φ h).hom ≫ dPresheafZ φ k =
      dPresheafZ φ m ≫ (presheafZCongr φ (congrArg (· + 1) h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedgePayload_comp_d
statement:
theorem spliceWedgePayload_comp_d (n : ℕ)
    (q : ((Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor X).op ⋙ (spliceCarrier X n).obj) ⟶
      presheafZ φ (n + 1))
    (hq : q ≫ dPresheafZ φ (n + 1) = 0) :
    spliceWedgePayload φ n q ≫ dPresheafZ φ (n + 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ((dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ q) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ 1 (n + 1)) ≫
      dPresheafZ φ (1 + (n + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [Category.assoc, wedgePresheafZ_d φ 1 (n + 1), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.comp_zsmul]
    have h1 : (dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ q) ≫
        ((dPresheafZ φ 1 ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (presheafZ φ (n + 1))) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ (1 + 1) (n + 1) ≫
          (presheafZCongr φ (Nat.add_right_comm 1 1 (n + 1))).hom) = 0 := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, dlogMod_comp_d,
        Category.comp_id, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_tensor, Limits.zero_comp]
    have h2 : (dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ q) ≫
        ((𝟙 (presheafZ φ 1) ⊗ₘ dPresheafZ φ (n + 1)) ≫
          wedgePresheafZ φ 1 ((n + 1) + 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, hq, Category.comp_id,
        MonoidalPreadditive.tensor_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
    rw [h1, h2, smul_zero, add_zero]
  show ((dlogMod φ ⊗ₘ q) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ 1 (n + 1) ≫
      (presheafZCongr φ (spliceDegreeEq n)).hom) ≫ dPresheafZ φ (n + 2) = 0
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, presheafZCongr_comp_d φ (spliceDegreeEq n),
    ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hA, Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedge_zero_receipt
statement: theorem spliceWedge_zero_receipt : spliceWedge φ 0 = ⟨dlogMod φ⟩
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedge_succ_receipt
statement:
theorem spliceWedge_succ_receipt (n : ℕ) :
    spliceWedge φ (n + 1) = (spliceCompat (X := X) n).inv ≫
      (presheafToSheaf _ _).map (spliceWedgePayload φ n (spliceWedge φ n).hom) ≫
      counitAt X (deRhamSheafZ φ (n + 2))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedge_comp_d
statement: theorem spliceWedge_comp_d (n : ℕ) : spliceWedge φ n ≫ dSheafZ φ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  (spliceWedgeAux φ n).2

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedge_comp_complex_d
statement:
theorem spliceWedge_comp_complex_d (n : ℕ) :
    spliceWedge φ n ≫ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ).d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ).d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) = dSheafZ φ (n + 1) :=
    deRhamSheafZComplexN_d φ (n + 1)
  rw [hd]
  exact spliceWedge_comp_d φ n

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceWedge_one
statement: theorem spliceWedge_one : spliceWedge φ 1 = pairedTargetWedge φ
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceSingle_one
statement: theorem spliceSingle_one : spliceSingle φ 1 = pairedSingleTwo φ
proof:
:= by
  show singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg (K := deRhamSheafZComplexN φ) 2
      (spliceWedge φ 1) (spliceWedge_comp_complex_d φ 1) = pairedSingleTwo φ
  rw [singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_congr 2 (spliceWedge_one φ)
    (spliceWedge_comp_complex_d φ 1)]
  exact singleToBrutalTruncGEDeg_two_receipt _ _

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceLandFull_apply

theorem spliceLandFull_apply (n : ℕ)
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (spliceCarrier X n) (n + 1)) :
    spliceLandFull φ n e =
      affineZHyperHMap X (pairAnchorAffine X)
        (ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
        (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (spliceLandTrunc φ n e)

:=

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceLandFull_mem

    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (spliceCarrier X n) (n + 1)) :

        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

  AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨spliceLandTrunc φ n e, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceLand_coe
statement:
theorem spliceLand_coe (n : ℕ)
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (spliceCarrier X n) (n + 1)) :

        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceNInto_coe
statement:
theorem spliceNInto_coe (n : ℕ)
    (xs : Fin (n + 1) → (pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)) :
    (spliceNInto φ n xs : affineZHyperH X (pairAnchorAffine X)
        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      spliceLandFull φ n (spliceN X n xs)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceNInto_mem

theorem spliceNInto_mem (n : ℕ)

        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) ∈
      affineZHodgeFiltration X (pairAnchorAffine X)
        (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)

proof:
:=

      spliceNInto φ (n + 1) (Fin.snoc xs x) +

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceNInto_eq_zero_of_slot_factors

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceOne_dinfPairData
statement: theorem spliceOne_dinfPairData : spliceOne p1 dinfPairData = dinfSecondSlot

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceTwo_dinf_eq_dinfPairedDivClass
statement:
theorem spliceTwo_dinf_eq_dinfPairedDivClass :
    spliceN p1 1 (fun _ => dinfPairData) = dinfPairedDivClass
proof:
:= by
  rw [spliceTwo_eq_pairedClass]
  show pairedClass p1 dinfPairData (spliceOne p1 dinfPairData) = _
  rw [spliceOne_dinfPairData]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSpliceIterate.spliceNInto_one_dinf
statement:
theorem spliceNInto_one_dinf :
    spliceNInto (cRingHom structMor) 1 (fun _ => dinfPairData) = dinfPairedInto
proof:
:= by
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1) (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ))
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [spliceNInto_coe]
  have hE : spliceN p1 1 (fun _ => dinfPairData) =
      pairedClass p1 dinfPairData dinfSecondSlot :=
    spliceTwo_dinf_eq_dinfPairedDivClass
  rw [hE]
  show affineZHyperHMap p1 (pairAnchorAffine p1)
      (ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor))) 2) 4
      (chernShapeN 2 (pairAnchorAffine p1) (spliceCarrierAffine (X := p1) 1)
        (brutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor))) 2)
        (spliceSingle (cRingHom structMor) 1)
        ((toAffineSite p1).mapExtAddHom (pairAnchor p1) (spliceCarrier p1 1) 2
          (pairedClass p1 dinfPairData dinfSecondSlot))) =
    (dinfPairedInto : affineZHyperH p1 (pairAnchorAffine p1)
      (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor))) 4)
  rw [spliceSingle_one, chernShapeN_two_receipt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.pbSES_shortExact
statement: theorem pbSES_shortExact (hS : S.ShortExact) : (pbSES S x).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have := hS.epi_g
  haveI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [ShortComplex.exact_iff_exact_up_to_refinements]
    intro A a ha
    change A ⟶ pullback S.g x at a
    change a ≫ pullback.snd S.g x = 0 at ha
    obtain ⟨A', π, hπ, x₁, fac⟩ := hS.exact.exact_up_to_refinements (a ≫ pullback.fst S.g x)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, pullback.condition, reassoc_of% ha, zero_comp])
    refine ⟨A', π, hπ, x₁, ?_⟩
    show π ≫ a = x₁ ≫ (pbSES S x).f
    dsimp only [pbSES]
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simpa only [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst] using fac
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd, comp_zero, ha, comp_zero]
  · exact @mono_of_mono_fac _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hS.mono_f
      (show (pbSES S x).f ≫ pullback.fst S.g x = S.f from pullback.lift_fst _ _ _)
  · dsimp only [pbSES]; infer_instance

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.pbExtClass_eq
statement:
theorem pbExtClass_eq (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    pbExtClass x hS = (Ext.mk₀ x).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (pbExtClass x hS).comp (Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 S.X₁)) (add_zero 1) =
      (Ext.mk₀ x).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass_naturality (pbSES_shortExact x hS) hS (pbSESHom x)
  rwa [Ext.comp_mk₀_id] at h2

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.extClass_eq_zero_of_splitting
statement:
theorem extClass_eq_zero_of_splitting {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (σ : S.Splitting) : hS.extClass = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc hS.extClass
      = (Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 S.X₃)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) := (Ext.mk₀_id_comp _).symm
    _ = (Ext.mk₀ (σ.s ≫ S.g)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) := by rw [σ.s_g]
    _ = (Ext.mk₀ σ.s).comp ((Ext.mk₀ S.g).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) := by
        rw [← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hS.comp_extClass, Ext.comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.spliceClass_add
statement:
theorem spliceClass_add (e e' : Ext Z G 1) :
    spliceClass hT u (e + e') = spliceClass hT u e + spliceClass hT u e'
proof:

  unfold spliceClass
  rw [Ext.add_comp, Ext.add_comp]

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.spliceClass_zero
statement: theorem spliceClass_zero : spliceClass hT u (0 : Ext Z G 1) = 0
proof:

name: HodgePilot.ExtSplice.spliceClass_eq_zero_of_splitting
statement:
theorem spliceClass_eq_zero_of_splitting (σ : T.Splitting) (e₂ : Ext Z G 1) :
    spliceClass hT u e₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold spliceClass
  rw [extClass_eq_zero_of_splitting hT σ, Ext.comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSpaceAgree.locMorphism_isLocalizedEquivalence
statement:
theorem locMorphism_isLocalizedEquivalence :
    (e.functor.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).IsLocalizedEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits e.functor :=
    PreservesLimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteLimits.{0, 0} _
  haveI : PreservesFiniteColimits e.functor :=
    PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteColimits.{0, 0} _
  haveI : e.symm.inverse.Additive := inferInstanceAs e.functor.Additive
  haveI : e.inverse.Additive := e.symm.toAdjunction.left_adjoint_additive
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits e.inverse :=
    PreservesLimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteLimits.{0, 0} _
  haveI : PreservesFiniteColimits e.inverse :=
    PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteColimits.{0, 0} _
  exact LocalizerMorphism.isLocalizedEquivalence_of_unit_of_unit
    (e.functor.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (e.inverse.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (e.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).unitIso.hom
    (e.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counitIso.inv
    (fun K => by
      rw [HomologicalComplex.mem_quasiIso_iff]
      infer_instance)
    (fun K => by
      rw [HomologicalComplex.mem_quasiIso_iff]
      infer_instance)

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSpaceAgree.mapDerivedCategory_isEquivalence
statement:
theorem mapDerivedCategory_isEquivalence
    [PreservesFiniteLimits e.functor] [PreservesFiniteColimits e.functor] :
    e.functor.mapDerivedCategory.IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  haveI := locMorphism_isLocalizedEquivalence e
  haveI : CatCommSq
      ((e.functor.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).functor)
      DerivedCategory.Q DerivedCategory.Q e.functor.mapDerivedCategory :=
    ⟨e.functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.symm⟩
  exact (e.functor.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).isEquivalence DerivedCategory.Q DerivedCategory.Q
    e.functor.mapDerivedCategory

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSpaceAgree.mapExtendXIso_d
statement:
lemma mapExtendXIso_d (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (K : HomologicalComplex C c)
    (o₁ o₂ : Option ι) :
    (mapExtendXIso F K o₁).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extend.d ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c).obj K) o₁ o₂ =
      F.map (HomologicalComplex.extend.d K o₁ o₂) ≫ (mapExtendXIso F K o₂).hom
proof:
:= by
  match o₁, o₂ with
  | none, o₂ =>
      rw [HomologicalComplex.extend.d_none_eq_zero _ _ _ rfl,
        HomologicalComplex.extend.d_none_eq_zero _ _ _ rfl, Limits.comp_zero,
        Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | some a, none =>
      rw [HomologicalComplex.extend.d_none_eq_zero' _ _ _ rfl,
        HomologicalComplex.extend.d_none_eq_zero' _ _ _ rfl, Limits.comp_zero,
        Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | some a, some b =>
      show (mapExtendXIso F K (some a)).hom ≫
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c).obj K).d a b =
        F.map (K.d a b) ≫ (mapExtendXIso F K (some b)).hom
      simp only [mapExtendXIso]
      exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_span_pair
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (⋀[R]^p M)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span] at hx
  refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ rfl
    (fun y z _ _ hy hz => by rw [hy, hz, add_zero])
    (fun c y _ hy => by rw [hy, smul_zero]) hx
  rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin p, v i ∈ Submodule.span R ({a, b} : Set M) := fun i =>
    hab ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  choose c d hcd using fun i => Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp (hmem i)
  have hv : v = fun i => ∑ j : Fin 2, ![c i, d i] j • ![a, b] j := by
    funext i
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    exact (hcd i).symm
  rw [hv]
  have hexp : (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p)
        (fun i => ∑ j : Fin 2, ![c i, d i] j • ![a, b] j) =
      ∑ r : Fin p → Fin 2, (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p)
        (fun i => ![c i, d i] (r i) • ![a, b] (r i)) :=
    MultilinearMap.map_sum (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p).toMultilinearMap
      (g := fun i j => ![c i, d i] j • ![a, b] j)
  rw [hexp]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
  have hsm : (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p)
        (fun i => ![c i, d i] (r i) • ![a, b] (r i)) =
      (∏ i, ![c i, d i] (r i)) •
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p) (fun i => ![a, b] (r i)) :=
    MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p).toMultilinearMap
      (fun i => ![c i, d i] (r i)) (fun i => ![a, b] (r i))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hr⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt r
    (by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]; lia)
  have hz : (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p) (fun i => ![a, b] (r i)) = 0 :=
    AlternatingMap.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ _ (congrArg (![a, b]) hr) hij
  rw [hsm, hz, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.span_D_pair_of_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_D_pair_of_adjoin {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {x y : B} (hxy : Algebra.adjoin A ({x, y} : Set B) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span B
      ({KaehlerDifferential.D A B x, KaehlerDifferential.D A B y} : Set (Ω[B⁄A])) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  rw [← KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation]
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hb : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin A ({x, y} : Set B) := hxy ▸ Algebra.mem_top
  induction hb using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · obtain rfl : z = y := hz
        exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [Derivation.map_algebraMap]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u w _ _ hu hw =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu hw
  | mul u w _ _ hu hw =>
      rw [Derivation.leibniz]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hw) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hu)

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.subsingleton_DR_of_adjoin_pair
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_of_adjoin_pair {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] {x y : B} (hxy : Algebra.adjoin A ({x, y} : Set B) = ⊤)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR A B p)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Subsingleton (⋀[B]^p (Ω[B⁄A])) := by
    refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
    exact (exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_span_pair (span_D_pair_of_adjoin hxy) hp z).symm ▸ rfl
  exact Equiv.subsingleton (DeRham.exteriorPowerEquiv A B p).toEquiv

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.nontrivial_exteriorPower_chartModel

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.nontrivial_chartModel_DR_two
statement:

    Nontrivial (DeRham.DR ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) 2)

:=

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.not_subsingleton_chartModel_DR_two
statement:
theorem not_subsingleton_chartModel_DR_two :
    ¬ Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := nontrivial_chartModel_DR_two
  exact huv (Subsingleton.elim u v)

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.adjoin_X_pair_chartModel
statement:
theorem adjoin_X_pair_chartModel :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ({MvPolynomial.X 0, MvPolynomial.X 1} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  rw [← MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le fun s hs => Algebra.subset_adjoin ?_
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hs
  match i with
  | 0 => exact Set.mem_insert _ _
  | 1 => exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.subsingleton_chartModel_DR_of_three_le
statement:
theorem subsingleton_chartModel_DR_of_three_le {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) p)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_DR_of_adjoin_pair adjoin_X_pair_chartModel hp

name: HodgePilot.PlaneCarrierProbe.chartModel_degree_profile
statement:
theorem chartModel_degree_profile :
    Nontrivial (DeRham.DR ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, 3 ≤ p → Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨nontrivial_chartModel_DR_two, fun _ hp => subsingleton_chartModel_DR_of_three_le hp⟩

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.imageSubgroup_def
statement:
theorem imageSubgroup_def (f : α → M) :
    imageSubgroup f = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range f)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.mem_imageSubgroup

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.zero_mem_imageSubgroup

:=

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.excludedFrom_iff

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.not_excludedFrom_apply

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.not_excludedFrom_zero

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.ExcludedFrom.ne_zero
statement:
theorem ExcludedFrom.ne_zero {f : α → M} {y : M} (h : ExcludedFrom f y) :
    y ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h0 => not_excludedFrom_zero f (h0 ▸ h)

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.ExcludedFrom.ne_apply
statement:
theorem ExcludedFrom.ne_apply {f : α → M} {y : M} (h : ExcludedFrom f y)
    (a : α) : y ≠ f a
proof:
:=
  fun he => h (mem_imageSubgroup_of_eq he.symm)

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero {f : α → M}
    (h : ∀ a, f a = 0) : imageSubgroup f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_bot_iff.mp ((AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr ?_)
  rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
  simpa using h a

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.excludedFrom_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem excludedFrom_of_forall_eq_zero {f : α → M} (h : ∀ a, f a = 0)
    {y : M} (hy : y ≠ 0) : ExcludedFrom f y
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero h, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact hy hmem

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.excludedFrom_anti
proof:
:=
  fun hmem => hg (imageSubgroup_mono h hmem)

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (f : α → M) :
    imageSubgroup f = ⊥
proof:
:=
  imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.imageSubgroup_eq_top_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem imageSubgroup_eq_top_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (f : α → M) :
    imageSubgroup f = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (AddSubgroup.eq_top_iff' _).mpr fun x => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0]; exact zero_mem_imageSubgroup f

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.not_excludedFrom_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem not_excludedFrom_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (f : α → M)
    (y : M) : ¬ ExcludedFrom f y
proof:
:= fun h =>
  h (by rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0]; exact zero_mem_imageSubgroup f)

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.range_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem range_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero {A : Type u} [AddCommGroup A]
    (f : A →+ M) (h : ∀ a, f a = 0) : f.range = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← imageSubgroup_eq_range]
  exact imageSubgroup_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero h

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.notMem_range_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem notMem_range_of_forall_eq_zero {A : Type u} [AddCommGroup A]
    (f : A →+ M) (h : ∀ a, f a = 0) {y : M} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    y ∉ f.range
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [range_eq_bot_of_forall_eq_zero f h, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact hy hmem

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.lt_of_eq_bot_of_mem_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem lt_of_eq_bot_of_mem_of_ne_zero {H K : AddSubgroup M} (hH : H = ⊥)
    {y : M} (hy : y ∈ K) (hy0 : y ≠ 0) : H < K
proof:
:= by
  rw [hH, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
  intro hK
  rw [hK, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hy
  exact hy0 hy

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.spliceLand_one_pairedClass
statement:
theorem spliceLand_one_pairedClass (x : pairAnchor X ⟶ divisorsMod X)
    (e : Abelian.Ext (pairAnchor X) (unitsMod X) 1) :
    spliceLand φ 1 (pairedClass X x e) = pairedClassInto φ x e
proof:
:= by
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ))
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [spliceLand_coe]
  show affineZHyperHMap X (pairAnchorAffine X)
      (ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 2) 4
      (chernShapeN 2 (pairAnchorAffine X) (spliceCarrierAffine (X := X) 1)
        (brutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 2)
        (spliceSingle φ 1)
        ((toAffineSite X).mapExtAddHom (pairAnchor X) (spliceCarrier X 1) 2
          (pairedClass X x e))) =
    (pairedClassInto φ x e : affineZHyperH X (pairAnchorAffine X)
      (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φ)) 4)
  rw [spliceSingle_one, chernShapeN_two_receipt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ExclusionEngine.spliceNInto_one_eq

proof:
:= by
  have h := spliceLand_one_pairedClass φ (xs 0) (spliceOne X (xs 1))
  rw [← spliceTwo_eq_pairedClass X xs] at h

  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr

name: HodgePilot.CartierClass.germUnitsHom_naturality
statement:
theorem germUnitsHom_naturality {U V : X.Opens} (i : op U ⟶ op V)
    (hV : genericPoint X ∈ V) :
    (unitsAb X).obj.map i ≫ germUnitsHom X hV =
      germUnitsHom X (leOfHom i.unop hV)
proof:
:= by
  show ringUnitsAb.{u}.map (X.presheaf.map i) ≫
      ringUnitsAb.{u}.map (X.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint X) hV) =
    ringUnitsAb.{u}.map (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (leOfHom i.unop hV))
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, X.presheaf.germ_res' i (genericPoint X) hV]

statement:
private theorem toAdditive_injective {M N : Type u} [MulOneClass M] [MulOneClass N]
    {f : M →* N} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (MonoidHom.toAdditive f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hab => Additive.toMul.injective (hf (Additive.ofMul.injective hab))

name: HodgePilot.CartierClass.germUnitsHom_injective

theorem germUnitsHom_injective {U : X.Opens} (h : genericPoint X ∈ U) :
    Function.Injective (germUnitsHom X h)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Function.Injective (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h) :=
    germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (genericPoint X) h
  have hu : Function.Injective
      (Units.map ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h).hom :
        Γ(X, U) →* X.functionField)) :=
    Units.map_injective hg
  exact toAdditive_injective hu

name: HodgePilot.CartierClass.subsingleton_unitsAb_obj_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : U = ⊥ := by
    refine Opens.ext (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp fun hne => h ?_)
    refine ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr ?_
    simpa using hne
  haveI : Subsingleton (Γ(X, (⊥ : X.Opens)))ˣ :=
    ⟨fun a b => Units.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  haveI hs : Subsingleton (Additive (Γ(X, (⊥ : X.Opens)))ˣ) :=
    ⟨fun a b => Additive.toMul.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  exact ⟨fun a b => @Subsingleton.elim _ hs a b⟩

name: HodgePilot.CartierClass.cdivClass_divOf
statement:
theorem cdivClass_divOf (f : Additive (X.functionField)ˣ) :
    cdivClass X (divOf X f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc cdivClass X (divOf X f)
      = (((kUnitsH0Equiv X).symm f).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (divisorsπ X))
          (add_zero 0)).comp (cartierδ X) (zero_add 1) := rfl
    _ = ((kUnitsH0Equiv X).symm f).comp
          ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (divisorsπ X)).comp (cartierδ X) (zero_add 1))
          (zero_add 1) :=
        Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero _ _ _ _
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [divisorsπ_comp_cartierδ, Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
        rfl

name: HodgePilot.CartierClass.cdivClass_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cdivClass_eq_zero_iff (x : CDiv X) :
    cdivClass X x = 0 ↔ ∃ f : Additive (X.functionField)ˣ, divOf X f = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ _
      (cartierSC_shortExact X) x (zero_add 1) hx
    refine ⟨kUnitsH0Equiv X y, ?_⟩
    rw [divOf_apply, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Sheaf.H.map_apply]
    exact hy
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩

proof:
:= by
  calc cdivClassAffine X (Sheaf.H.map (divisorsπAffine X) 0 y)
      = (y.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (divisorsπAffine X)) (add_zero 0)).comp
          (cartierδAffine X) (zero_add 1) := rfl
    _ = y.comp ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (divisorsπAffine X)).comp (cartierδAffine X)
          (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) :=
        Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero _ _ _ _

proof:
:= by
  rw [show singleTwoToHyper Z M x =
      chernShapeTwo Z M _ (𝟙 ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 2).obj M)) x from rfl,
    chernShapeTwo_apply]

    (hyperHMap_id M ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 2).obj M) 2 (singleShiftedHomTwo M))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.singleTwoToHyper_bijective
statement:
theorem singleTwoToHyper_bijective (Z M : C) :
    Function.Bijective (singleTwoToHyper Z M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI hIso : IsIso (singleShiftedHomTwo M) := isIso_singleShiftedHomTwo M
  haveI : IsIso ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
      (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
        (by lia)).inv.app _) :=
    inferInstance
  have hcomp : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext Z M 2,
      singleTwoToHyper Z M x =
        Abelian.Ext.homAddEquiv x ≫
          ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
              (by lia)).inv.app _) := by
    intro x
    rw [singleTwoToHyper_apply]
    rfl
  have hpost : Function.Bijective
      (fun (y : ShiftedHom ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =>
        y ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
            (by lia)).inv.app _)) := by
    have hp : (2 : ℤ) + ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (4 : ℤ) := by lia
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      have hab' : a ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
            (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
              hp).inv.app _) =
          b ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
            (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
              hp).inv.app _) := hab
      rwa [cancel_mono] at hab'
    · intro z
      refine ⟨z ≫ inv ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
        (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
        (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
          hp).inv.app _), ?_⟩
      show (z ≫ inv ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
          (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
            hp).inv.app _)) ≫
          ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
            hp).inv.app _) = z
      rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hfun : ⇑(singleTwoToHyper Z M) =
      (fun (y : ShiftedHom ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =>
        y ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHomTwo M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (2 : ℤ) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) (4 : ℤ)
            (by lia)).inv.app _)) ∘ ⇑(Abelian.Ext.homAddEquiv) :=
    funext hcomp
  rw [hfun]
  exact hpost.comp (AddEquiv.bijective _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.isZero_truncTwo_X
statement:
theorem isZero_truncTwo_X
    (hZ : ∀ m : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → IsZero (deRhamSheafZ φP2 m))
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 2) :
    IsZero ((brutalTruncGE (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φP2)) 2).X n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : n < 2
  · exact isZero_brutalTruncGE_X _ 2 n hlt
  · rw [not_lt] at hlt
    have h3 : 3 ≤ n := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hlt with h | h
      · lia
      · exact absurd h.symm hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = (m : ℤ) :=
      ⟨n.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by lia)).symm⟩
    have hm : 3 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have h2m : (2 : ℕ) ≤ m := by omega
    exact (hZ m hm).of_iso
      ((brutalTruncGEXIso (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN φP2)) 2 (m : ℤ)
          (by exact_mod_cast h2m)) ≪≫
        reindexZXIso (deRhamSheafZComplexN φP2) m)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.subsingleton_DR_basicOpen
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_basicOpen (U : p2.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ}
    (hU : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) p))
    (f : Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p2.basicOpen f)) p)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun y => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, k, hzk⟩ :=
    DeRhamSheaf.exists_res_map_eq_pow_smul (cRingHom structMor) U f p y
  rw [Subsingleton.elim z 0, map_zero] at hzk

proof:
:=
  match i with
  | 0 => subsingleton_DR_chart 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hp
  | 1 => subsingleton_DR_chart 1 0 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hp
  | 2 => subsingleton_DR_chart 2 0 1 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hp

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.exists_basicOpen_subsingleton
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_subsingleton (U : p2.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) {x : p2} (hxU : x ∈ U.toOpens) (i : Fin 3)
    (hxi : x ∈ chartOpen i) :
    ∃ f : Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens,
      Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
        (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p2.basicOpen f)) p) ∧
        x ∈ p2.basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgU, hxg⟩ :=
    (chartAffine i).2.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.toOpens) hxi
  have hWg : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p2.basicOpen g)) p) :=
    subsingleton_DR_basicOpen (chartAffine i)
      (subsingleton_DR_chart_i i hp) g
  obtain ⟨f, hf_le, hxf⟩ :=
    U.2.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxg⟩ : (p2.basicOpen g : p2.Opens)) hxU
  refine ⟨f, ?_, hxf⟩
  have hb : p2.basicOpen (res (cRingHom structMor) hgU f) = p2.basicOpen f := by
    rw [res_apply, Scheme.basicOpen_res]
    exact inf_eq_right.mpr hf_le
  exact subsingleton_DR_congr hb
    (subsingleton_DR_basicOpen ⟨p2.basicOpen g, (chartAffine i).2.basicOpen g⟩
      hWg (res (cRingHom structMor) hgU f))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.subsingleton_DR_all
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_all (U : p2.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : Set (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) :=
    {f | Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p2.basicOpen f)) p)} with hs
  have hcov : (⨆ f : s, p2.basicOpen (f.1 : Γ(p2, U.toOpens))) = U.toOpens := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun f => p2.basicOpen_le f.1) fun x hx => ?_
    have hx2 : x ∈ chart 0 ⊔ chart 1 ⊔ chart 2 := by
      rw [chart_cover_receipt]; trivial
    have hchart : ∃ i : Fin 3, x ∈ chartOpen i := by
      rcases (Opens.mem_sup).mp hx2 with h01 | h2
      · rcases (Opens.mem_sup).mp h01 with h0 | h1
        · exact ⟨0, h0⟩
        · exact ⟨1, h1⟩
      · exact ⟨2, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hchart
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_subsingleton U hp hx i hxi
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, hxf⟩
  have hspan : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := U.2.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff.mp hcov
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
  refine DeRhamSheaf.eq_of_res_map_eq_of_span (cRingHom structMor) U hspan p
    (fun f hf => ?_)
  haveI : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p2.basicOpen f)) p) := hf
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneBridge.isZero_deRhamSheafZ_P2
statement:
theorem isZero_deRhamSheafZ_P2 {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) :
    IsZero (deRhamSheafZ (cRingHom structMor) m)
proof:

  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  haveI : Subsingleton

    subsingleton_DR_all U.unop hm
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
