    chartEval i j k l0 l1 (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have hval : (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c).val =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)
        (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ))
        (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
    rw [algebraMap_away_apply]
    show Localization.mk _ 1 = _
    rw [Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap,
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [chartEval, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, hval,
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, MvPolynomial.eval_C]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chartEval_coordFrac_j
statement:
theorem chartEval_coordFrac_j {i j k : Fin 3} (hji : j ≠ i) (l0 l1 : ℂ) :
    chartEval i j k l0 l1 (coordFrac i j) = l0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEval, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    coordFrac_val,
    Localization.awayLift_mk (hv := by rw [MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_i, one_mul]),
    MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_j hji, one_pow, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chartEval_coordFrac_k
statement:
theorem chartEval_coordFrac_k {i j k : Fin 3} (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j) (l0 l1 : ℂ) :
    chartEval i j k l0 l1 (coordFrac i k) = l1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEval, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    coordFrac_val,
    Localization.awayLift_mk (hv := by rw [MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_i, one_mul]),
    MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_k hki hkj, one_pow, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chartPolyHom_injective
statement:
theorem chartPolyHom_injective {i j k : Fin 3} (hji : j ≠ i) (hki : k ≠ i)
    (hkj : k ≠ j) : Function.Injective (chartPolyHom i j k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro p hp
  have key : ∀ l0 l1 : ℂ, MvPolynomial.eval (![l0, l1]) p = 0 := by
    intro l0 l1
    have hcomp : (chartEval i j k l0 l1).comp (chartPolyHom i j k).toRingHom =
        MvPolynomial.eval (![l0, l1]) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c
        rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
        show chartEval i j k l0 l1 (chartPolyHom i j k (MvPolynomial.C c)) = _
        rw [chartPolyHom_C, chartEval_algebraMap, MvPolynomial.eval_C]
      · intro v
        rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
        fin_cases v
        · show chartEval i j k l0 l1 (chartPolyHom i j k (MvPolynomial.X 0)) = _
          rw [chartPolyHom_X0, chartEval_coordFrac_j hji, MvPolynomial.eval_X]; rfl
        · show chartEval i j k l0 l1 (chartPolyHom i j k (MvPolynomial.X 1)) = _
          rw [chartPolyHom_X1, chartEval_coordFrac_k hki hkj, MvPolynomial.eval_X]; rfl
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp p
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    show MvPolynomial.eval (![l0, l1]) p = 0
    rw [← this]
    show chartEval i j k l0 l1 (chartPolyHom i j k p) = 0
    rw [hp, map_zero]
  apply MvPolynomial.funext (R := ℂ)
  intro x
  rw [map_zero]
  have hx : x = ![x 0, x 1] := by funext v; fin_cases v <;> rfl
  rw [hx]; exact key (x 0) (x 1)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.adjoin_range_X_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_range_X_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₃ 0)
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro a _
  have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]; trivial
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) ≤
      Subalgebra.restrictScalars ℂ (Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₃ 0)
        (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ))) :=
    Algebra.adjoin_le fun s hs => Algebra.subset_adjoin hs
  exact (Subalgebra.mem_restrictScalars ℂ).mp (hle ha)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.triple_univ
statement:
theorem triple_univ {i j k : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ({i, j, k} : Finset (Fin 3)) = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hij, hik]),
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hjk]), Finset.card_singleton]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.sum_triple
statement:
theorem sum_triple {i j k : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (g : Fin 3 → ℕ) : (∑ m, g m) = g i + g j + g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triple_univ hij hik hjk,
    Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]),
    Finset.sum_singleton, add_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.prod_triple
statement:
theorem prod_triple {i j k : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (g : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) : (∏ m, g m) = g i * g j * g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triple_univ hij hik hjk,
    Finset.prod_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.prod_insert (by simp [hjk]),
    Finset.prod_singleton, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chartPolyHom_surjective
statement:
theorem chartPolyHom_surjective {i j k : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k)
    (hjk : j ≠ k) : Function.Surjective (chartPolyHom i j k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have htop := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.adjoin_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
    (𝒜 := 𝒜₃) (X_mem_grade_one i) (Fin 3) MvPolynomial.X adjoin_range_X_eq_top
    (fun _ => 1) (fun m => X_mem_grade_one m)
  have hx := htop.ge (Algebra.mem_top (x := x))
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ai, hai, -, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hsum : ai i + ai j + ai k = a := by
      have h3 : (∑ m, ai m) = a := by simpa using hai
      rw [← h3, sum_triple hij hik hjk]
    subst hsum
    refine ⟨MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ ai j * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ ai k, ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, chartPolyHom_X0, chartPolyHom_X1,
      HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow,
      HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow, coordFrac_val, coordFrac_val,
      Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
      Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    use 1
    have hprod : (∏ m, MvPolynomial.X m ^ ai m : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i * MvPolynomial.X j ^ ai j * MvPolynomial.X k ^ ai k :=
      prod_triple hij hik hjk (fun m => MvPolynomial.X m ^ ai m)
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow,
      hprod]
    ring
  | algebraMap r =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective.2 r
    exact ⟨MvPolynomial.C c,
      (chartPolyHom_C i j k c).trans
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℂ (𝒜₃ 0) (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p * q, map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.polyChartEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem polyChartEquiv_apply (i j k : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) : polyChartEquiv i j k hij hik hjk p = chartPolyHom i j k p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.awayXZeroPolyEquiv_spelling
statement:
theorem awayXZeroPolyEquiv_spelling :
    (awayXZeroPolyEquiv :
      Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X 0) ≃ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) = awayXZeroPolyEquiv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.away_unit_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem away_unit_eq_algebraMap {i j k : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k)
    (hjk : j ≠ k) (u : (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i))ˣ) :
    ∃ c : ℂˣ, (u : Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hCc⟩ :=
    (MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced
      (P := chartPolyEquiv i j k hij hik hjk (u : Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).mp
      (u.isUnit.map (chartPolyEquiv i j k hij hik hjk))
  have h2 : (u : Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      (chartPolyEquiv i j k hij hik hjk).symm (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
    rw [← hCc, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h3 : (chartPolyEquiv i j k hij hik hjk).symm (MvPolynomial.C c) =
      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]; exact AlgEquiv.commutes _ c
  exact ⟨hc.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact h2.trans h3⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.isIso_awayToSection
statement:
theorem isIso_awayToSection {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜₃ m) (hm : 0 < m) : IsIso (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom 𝒜₃ f hf hm]; infer_instance

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.awaySection_injective
statement:
theorem awaySection_injective {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜₃ m) (hm : 0 < m) : Function.Injective (awaySection f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_awayToSection hf hm
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ f)).injective

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.gradeZero_fromZero_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gradeZero_fromZero_eq_algebraMap (i : Fin 3) :
    gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₃ (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)))
proof:
:= by
  ext c; rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.constants_awayι
statement:
theorem constants_awayι (i : Fin 3) :
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i) (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).appTop =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i))) ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hs : structMor =
      Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₃ ≫ Spec.map (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) := rfl
  rw [hs, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, ← Category.assoc,
    gradeZero_fromZero_eq_algebraMap]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chart_ι_appTop_topIso
statement:
theorem chart_ι_appTop_topIso (i : Fin 3) :
    (chartOpen i).ι.appTop ≫ (chartOpen i).topIso.hom =
      p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appTop, Scheme.Opens.topIso_hom]
  exact (p2.presheaf.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg p2.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.awayι_appTop
statement:
theorem awayι_appTop (i : Fin 3) :
    (Proj.awayι 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i) (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).appTop =
      (chartOpen i).ι.appTop ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)
          (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).inv.appTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop
statement:
theorem basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop (i : Fin 3) :
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).hom.appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).hom ≫
        Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i) ≫
        (chartOpen i).topIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom]
  exact Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.constants_section_hom
statement:
theorem constants_section_hom (i : Fin 3) :
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
      p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)).op =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i))) ≫
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)
proof:
:= by
  have hι : (chartOpen i).ι.appTop =
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i) (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).appTop ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)
          (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).hom.appTop := by
    rw [awayι_appTop, Category.assoc, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← chart_ι_appTop_topIso, hι, basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [constants_awayι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.constants_receipt
statement:
theorem constants_receipt (i : Fin 3) (c : ℂ) :
    res (cRingHom structMor) (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤) (cRingHom structMor c) =
      awaySection (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : res (cRingHom structMor) (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)
      (cRingHom structMor c) =
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
        p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)).op).hom c := rfl
  rw [h1, constants_section_hom]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.awaySectionAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem awaySectionAlgHom_surjective (i : Fin 3) :
    Function.Surjective (awaySectionAlgHom i)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_awayToSection (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i))).surjective

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.chartPoly_surjective
statement:
theorem chartPoly_surjective (i j k : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Function.Surjective (chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk)
proof:
:=
  (awaySectionAlgHom_surjective i).comp (chartPolyEquiv i j k hij hik hjk).symm.surjective

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.adjoin_chartGen
statement:
theorem adjoin_chartGen (i j k : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      ({chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk (MvPolynomial.X 0),
        chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk (MvPolynomial.X 1)} :
        Set (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (chartOpen i))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have himg : (chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk '' Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → _)) =
      ({chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk (MvPolynomial.X 0),
        chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk (MvPolynomial.X 1)} :
        Set (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (chartOpen i))) := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Function.comp, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩; fin_cases v
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have h3 : Subalgebra.map (chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk)
      (Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → _))) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ
        (chartPoly i j k hij hik hjk '' Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → _)) :=
    AlgHom.map_adjoin _ _
  rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X, Algebra.map_top,
    (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).mpr (chartPoly_surjective i j k hij hik hjk), himg] at h3
  exact h3.symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlaneChart.subsingleton_DR_chart
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_chart (i j k : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (chartOpen i)) p)
proof:
:=
  PlaneCarrierProbe.subsingleton_DR_of_adjoin_pair (adjoin_chartGen i j k hij hik hjk) hp

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.filtration_antitone
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.filtration_antitone (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    Antitone h.filtration
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  exact iSup₂_le fun pq hq =>
    le_iSup₂ (f := fun pq' (_ : p ≤ pq'.1) => h.H pq') pq (hpq.trans hq)

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.H_le_filtration
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.H_le_filtration (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) : h.H pq ≤ h.filtration pq.1
proof:
:=
  le_iSup₂ (f := fun pq' (_ : pq.1 ≤ pq'.1) => h.H pq') pq le_rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.H_le_filtration_inf_conj
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.H_le_filtration_inf_conj (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    h.H (p, q) ≤ h.filtration p ⊓ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_inf (h.H_le_filtration (p, q)) ?_
  rw [← h.conj_symm q p]
  exact Submodule.map_mono (h.H_le_filtration (q, p))

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.map_filtration_sigmaQ
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.map_filtration_sigmaQ (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (q : ℤ) :
    (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V) =
      ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : q ≤ pq.2), h.H pq
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, (h.H pq).map (sigmaQ V) = h.H (pq.2, pq.1) := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    exact h.conj_symm a b
  rw [show h.filtration q = ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : q ≤ pq.1), h.H pq from rfl]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, hswap]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun pq hq => ?_) (iSup₂_le fun ab hb => ?_)
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun ab (_ : q ≤ ab.2) => h.H ab) (pq.2, pq.1) hq
  · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun pq (_ : q ≤ pq.1) => h.H (pq.2, pq.1))
      (ab.2, ab.1) hb

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_le_biSup
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_le_biSup (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    h.filtration p ⊓ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V) ≤
      ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : p ≤ pq.1 ∧ q ≤ pq.2), h.H pq
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.map_filtration_sigmaQ q]
  exact biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
    (fun pq => p ≤ pq.1) (fun pq => q ≤ pq.2)

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_le
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_le (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {p q : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = n) :
    h.filtration p ⊓ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V) ≤ h.H (p, q)
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.filtration_inf_conj_le_biSup p q).trans (iSup₂_le ?_)
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨hpa, hqb⟩
  have hpa' : p ≤ a := hpa
  have hqb' : q ≤ b := hqb
  by_cases hn : a + b = n
  · obtain rfl : a = p := by omega
    obtain rfl : b = q := by omega
    exact le_rfl
  · rw [h.supported (a, b) hn]
    exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.H_eq_filtration_inf_conj
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.H_eq_filtration_inf_conj (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {p q : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = n) :
    h.H (p, q) = h.filtration p ⊓ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (h.H_le_filtration_inf_conj p q) (h.filtration_inf_conj_le hpq)

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_eq_bot
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.filtration_inf_conj_eq_bot (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {p q : ℤ} (hpq : n < p + q) :
    h.filtration p ⊓ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  refine (h.filtration_inf_conj_le_biSup p q).trans (iSup₂_le ?_)
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨hpa, hqb⟩
  have hpa' : p ≤ a := hpa
  have hqb' : q ≤ b := hqb
  exact le_of_eq (h.supported (a, b) (by omega))

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.filtration_sup_conj_eq_top
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.filtration_sup_conj_eq_top (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {p q : ℤ} (hpq : p + q ≤ n + 1) :
    h.filtration p ⊔ (h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← h.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
  refine iSup_le ?_
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  by_cases hn : a + b = n
  · by_cases hp : p ≤ a
    · exact le_sup_of_le_left
        ((h.H_le_filtration (a, b)).trans (h.filtration_antitone hp))
    · refine le_sup_of_le_right ?_
      rw [h.map_filtration_sigmaQ q]
      exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun pq (_ : q ≤ pq.2) => h.H pq) (a, b) (by omega)
  · rw [h.supported (a, b) hn]
    exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.isCompl_filtration_conj
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.isCompl_filtration_conj (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {p q : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = n + 1) :
    IsCompl (h.filtration p) ((h.filtration q).map (sigmaQ V))
proof:
:=
  ⟨disjoint_iff.mpr (h.filtration_inf_conj_eq_bot (by omega)),
    codisjoint_iff.mpr (h.filtration_sup_conj_eq_top (by omega))⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.maps_filtration
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.maps_filtration {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W]
    [Module.Finite ℚ W] {hV : QHodgeStructure n V} {hW : QHodgeStructure n W}
    (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (p : ℤ) :
    (hV.filtration p).map (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ≤ hW.filtration p
proof:
:= by
  rw [show hV.filtration p = ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : p ≤ pq.1), hV.H pq from rfl]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
  exact iSup₂_le fun pq hpq => (f.maps_pieces pq).trans
    ((hW.H_le_filtration pq).trans (hW.filtration_antitone hpq))

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.gammaComparison_f_apply
statement:
lemma gammaComparison_f_apply (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ)
    (s : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) :
    (gammaComparison X).f n s
      = (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.pres_res_res
statement:
lemma pres_res_res {X : TopCat.{0}} (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X)
    {O P' Q : Opens X} (i : O ⟶ P') (j : P' ⟶ Q) (k : O ⟶ Q) (s : F.obj (op Q)) :
    F.map i.op (F.map j.op s) = F.map k.op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.unit_res
statement:
lemma unit_res {X : TopCat.{0}} (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X)
    {O P' : Opens X} (i : O ⟶ P') (s : F.obj (op P')) :
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) F).app (op O) (F.map i.op s)
      = ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat).obj F).1.map i.op
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) F).app (op P') s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) F).naturality]

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.unit_partitionEndo_app
statement:
lemma unit_partitionEndo_app (X : TopCat.{0}) (A : Set ↑X) (n : ℕ) (O : Opens X)
    (c : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op O)) :
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op O)
        ((partitionEndo X A n).app (op O) c)
      = (partitionEndoSheaf X A n).hom.app (op O)
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op O) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (partitionEndo X A n).app (op O)
        ≫ (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op O)
      = (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op O)
        ≫ (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (partitionEndo X A n)).app (op O) := by
    rw [← NatTrans.comp_app, ← NatTrans.comp_app, ← toSheafify_naturality]
  exact (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ c).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun (f : _ ⟶ _) => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) c) hsq).trans
      (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ c))

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.gammaComparison_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem gammaComparison_eq_zero_iff (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ)
    (s : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) :
    (gammaComparison X).f n s = 0
      ↔ LocallyZero X ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs x
    haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)
    have hg : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n))
        (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).germ ⊤ x trivial s) = 0 := by
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
      have hz : (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s = 0 := hs
      rw [hz, map_zero]
    have hstalk : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).germ ⊤ x trivial s
        = ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).germ ⊤ x trivial 0 := by
      have hinj := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)))).1
      refine hinj ?_
      rw [hg, map_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWT, iWT', hres⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) x (show x ∈ (⊤ : Opens X) from trivial)
      (show x ∈ (⊤ : Opens X) from trivial) _ _ hstalk
    refine ⟨W, hxW, ?_⟩
    have hbridge : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s
        = ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map iWT.op s := rfl
    rw [hbridge, hres, map_zero]
  · intro hs
    have hz : (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s = 0 := by
      refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) ⊤ _ _
        (fun x hx => ?_)
      obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU⟩ := hs x
      have h1 : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.germ ⊤ x hx
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s)
          = ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.germ U x hxU
            (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
              ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
                ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s)) :=
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)) x hxU _).symm
    
      have h2 : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op ⊤) s)
          = (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
              ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app (op U)
            (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op s) :=
        (unit_res ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)) s).symm
      rw [h1, h2, hU, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    exact hz

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.ker_gammaComparison
statement:
theorem ker_gammaComparison (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ) :
    (((gammaComparison X).f n).hom).ker = locallyZeroSubgroup X n
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.ext fun s => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
  exact gammaComparison_eq_zero_iff X n s

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.ambient_pushSimplex
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.pushSimplex_corestrict
proof:
:=
  ULift.down_injective (TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl))

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.corestrict_pushSimplex
statement:
lemma corestrict_pushSimplex {O W : Opens X} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)) _⦋n⦌) (j : O ⟶ W)
    {V : Opens X} (h : SimplexIn (pushSimplex j σ) V) (hOV : O ≤ V) :
    corestrict (pushSimplex j σ) h = pushSimplex (homOfLE hOV) σ
proof:
:=
  ULift.down_injective (TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl))

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.ι_res_cochain
statement:
lemma ι_res_cochain {U W : Opens X} (i : U ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
    (φ : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op W))
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) _⦋n⦌) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map i.op φ :
          (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
      = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)).ιChainComplex (pushSimplex i σ)
        ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
proof:
:= by
  show (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).ιChainComplex σ
      ≫ ((SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map i)) Qcoef).f n
        ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
    = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)).ιChainComplex (pushSimplex i σ)
      ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
  rw [← Category.assoc, SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.ι_selectCochain
statement:
lemma ι_selectCochain (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ) (A : ι → Set ↑X) (V : ι → Opens X)
    (hA : ∀ y : ↑X, ∃! i, y ∈ A i)
    (b : ∀ i, ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op (V i)))
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))) _⦋n⦌) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ (selectCochain X n A V hA b :
          (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
      = if h : SimplexIn σ (V (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)
        then ((TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
            (V (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose))).ιChainComplex (corestrict σ h)
          ≫ (b (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose :
              (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
                (V (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose))).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
        else 0
proof:
:=
  (((TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj ⊤)).isColimitChainComplexXCofan
    Qcoef n).fac _ ⟨σ⟩)

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.res_selectCochain
statement:
lemma res_selectCochain (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ) (A : ι → Set ↑X) (V : ι → Opens X)
    (hA : ∀ y : ↑X, ∃! i, y ∈ A i)
    (b : ∀ i, ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op (V i)))
    {O : Opens X} (T : Finset ι) (hOV : ∀ i ∈ T, O ≤ V i)
    (hT : ∀ i ∉ T, Disjoint (O : Set ↑X) (A i)) :
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)).op
        (selectCochain X n A V hA b)
      = ∑ i ∈ T.attach, (partitionEndo X (A i.1) n).app (op O)
          (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1))
proof:
:= by
  refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
  
  have hyO : ambient (firstVertex σ) ∈ O := (σ.down.hom (vertexPt n)).2
  have hiA : ambient (firstVertex σ) ∈ A ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) :=
    (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose_spec.1
  have hiT : (hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose ∈ T := by
    by_contra hns
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hT _ hns) hyO hiA
  have hcond : SimplexIn (pushSimplex (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)) σ)
      (V (hA (ambient (firstVertex (pushSimplex (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)) σ)))).choose) :=
    fun p => hOV _ hiT (σ.down.hom p).2
  
  have hL : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).ιChainComplex σ
      ≫ (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)).op
          (selectCochain X n A V hA b) :
        (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
      = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
            (V ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)))).ιChainComplex
          (pushSimplex (homOfLE (hOV ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) hiT)) σ)
        ≫ (b ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) :
            (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
              (V ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)))).X n ⟶ Qcoef) := by
    rw [ι_res_cochain (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)) n (selectCochain X n A V hA b) σ,
      ι_selectCochain X n A V hA b (pushSimplex (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)) σ),
      dif_pos hcond,
      corestrict_pushSimplex σ (homOfLE (le_top : O ≤ ⊤)) hcond
        (hOV ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) hiT)]
  
  have hterm : ∀ i : {x // x ∈ T},
      (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ ((partitionEndo X (A i.1) n).app (op O)
            (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1)) :
          (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
      = if ambient (firstVertex σ) ∈ A i.1
        then (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).ιChainComplex σ
          ≫ (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1) :
            (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
        else 0 := by
    intro i
    show (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ (keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)) n (vertexPred X (A i.1) O n)
          ≫ (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1) :
            (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
      = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, ι_keep]
    by_cases hmem : ambient (firstVertex σ) ∈ A i.1
    · rw [if_pos (show vertexPred X (A i.1) O n σ from hmem), if_pos hmem]
    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ vertexPred X (A i.1) O n σ from hmem), if_neg hmem,
        Limits.zero_comp]
  
  have hR : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).ιChainComplex σ
      ≫ (∑ i ∈ T.attach, ((partitionEndo X (A i.1) n).app (op O)
          (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1)) :
        (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj O)).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
      = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
            (V ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)))).ιChainComplex
          (pushSimplex (homOfLE (hOV ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) hiT)) σ)
        ≫ (b ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) :
            (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj
              (V ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)))).X n ⟶ Qcoef) := by
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i),
      Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨(hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose, hiT⟩ : {x // x ∈ T})
        (fun j _ hne => if_neg (fun hmem =>
          hne (Subtype.ext ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose_spec.2 j.1 hmem))))
        (fun habs => absurd (Finset.mem_attach T _) habs),
      if_pos hiA,
      ι_res_cochain (homOfLE (hOV ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose) hiT)) n
        (b ((hA (ambient (firstVertex σ))).choose)) σ]
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.exists_localRep
statement:
lemma exists_localRep (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ)
    (s : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) (x : ↑X) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (b : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj (op V)),
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app
          (op V) b
        = ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_stalk_toSheafify_preimage ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) x
    (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial s)
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, b₀, rfl⟩ :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) w
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hw
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWU, iWT, hres⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq
    ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf x hxU
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : Opens X) from trivial) _ _ hw
  refine ⟨W, hxW, ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map iWU.op b₀, ?_⟩
  rw [unit_res ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) iWU b₀]
  have hbridge : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s
      = ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).presheaf.map iWT.op s := rfl
  rw [hbridge]
  exact hres

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.exists_adequate_open
statement:
lemma exists_adequate_open (X : TopCat.{0}) {ι : Type} (A : ι → Set ↑X) (V : ι → Opens X)
    (hclA : ∀ i, closure (A i) ⊆ ((V i : Opens X) : Set ↑X))
    (hlf : LocallyFinite fun i => closure (A i)) (x : ↑X) :
    ∃ (O : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ O) (T : Finset ι),
      (∀ i ∈ T, O ≤ V i) ∧ ∀ i ∉ T, Disjoint (O : Set ↑X) (closure (A i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hfin⟩ := hlf x
  classical
  set F : Finset ι := hfin.toFinset with hF
  set T : Finset ι := F.filter (fun i => x ∈ closure (A i)) with hTdef
  set G : Finset ι := F.filter (fun i => x ∉ closure (A i)) with hGdef
  refine ⟨⟨interior N ∩ ((⋂ i ∈ T, ((V i : Opens X) : Set ↑X))
      ∩ ⋂ i ∈ G, (closure (A i))ᶜ), ?_⟩, ?_, T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact isOpen_interior.inter ((isOpen_biInter_finset
      (fun i _ => (V i).isOpen)).inter
      (isOpen_biInter_finset (fun i _ => isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl)))
  · refine ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun i hi => hclA i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    · exact Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  · intro i hi y hy
    exact Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hy.2.1 i hi
  · intro i hi
    by_cases hiF : i ∈ F
    · have hix : x ∉ closure (A i) := fun hmem => hi (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiF, hmem⟩)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun y hy hyA =>
        (Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hy.2.2 i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiF, hix⟩)) hyA
    · refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun y hy hyA => hiF ?_
      rw [hF, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨y, hyA, interior_subset hy.1⟩

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.gammaComparison_surjective
statement:
theorem gammaComparison_surjective (X : TopCat.{0})
    [ParacompactSpace ↑X] [T2Space ↑X] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective ((gammaComparison X).f n)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  choose V hxV b hb using fun x : ↑X => exists_localRep X n s x
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hclA, hlf⟩ := exists_subordinate_partition V
    (fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxV x⟩)
  refine ⟨selectCochain X n A V hA b, ?_⟩
  show (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app
      (op ⊤) (selectCochain X n A V hA b) = s
  choose O hxO T hOV hOT using fun x : ↑X => exists_adequate_open X A V hclA hlf x
  refine ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).eq_of_locally_eq' O ⊤
    (fun x => homOfLE le_top) (fun y _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hxO y⟩) _ _ (fun x => ?_)
  have hstep1 : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)).op
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app
        (op ⊤) (selectCochain X n A V hA b))
      = (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app
        (op (O x)) (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)).op
          (selectCochain X n A V hA b)) :=
    (unit_res ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤))
      (selectCochain X n A V hA b)).symm
  rw [hstep1,
    res_selectCochain X n A V hA b (T x) (hOV x)
      (fun i hi => ((hOT x) i hi).mono_right subset_closure),
    map_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ i : {j // j ∈ T x},
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)).app
          (op (O x)) ((partitionEndo X (A i.1) n).app (op (O x))
            (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).map (homOfLE (hOV x i.1 i.2)).op (b i.1)))
        = (partitionEndoSheaf X (A i.1) n).hom.app (op (O x))
          (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)).op s) := by
    intro i
    rw [unit_partitionEndo_app X (A i.1) n (O x),
      unit_res ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (hOV x i.1 i.2)) (b i.1),
      hb i.1]
    congr 1
    exact res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (hOV x i.1 i.2))
      (homOfLE (le_top : V i.1 ≤ ⊤)) (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)) s
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i),
    Finset.sum_attach (T x) (fun i => (partitionEndoSheaf X (A i) n).hom.app (op (O x))
      (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)).op s))]
  have hone : ∀ y ∈ ((O x : Opens X) : Set ↑X), ∃! i, i ∈ T x ∧ y ∈ A i := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, huniq⟩ := hA y
    have hiT : i₀ ∈ T x := by
      by_contra hns
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp ((hOT x) i₀ hns) hy (subset_closure hi₀)
    exact ⟨i₀, ⟨hiT, hi₀⟩, fun k hk => huniq k hk.2⟩
  exact sum_partitionEndoSheaf_app_apply X A (T x) n hone
    (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (le_top : O x ≤ ⊤)).op s)

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.point_eq_vertexPt
statement: lemma point_eq_vertexPt (p : ↑(SimplexCategory.toTop.{0}.obj ⦋0⦌)) : p = vertexPt 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ i, p.down.1 i = 1 := p.down.2.2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one] at hsum
  refine ULift.down_injective (Subtype.ext (funext fun i => ?_))
  have hi : i = (0 : Fin (SimplexCategory.len ⦋0⦌ + 1)) :=
    Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp i.isLt)
  rw [hi]
  show p.down.1 0 = (Pi.single (0 : Fin 1) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 1 → ℝ) 0
  rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
  exact hsum

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.eq_zero_of_locallyZero_degreeZero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_locallyZero_degreeZero (X : TopCat.{0})
    (s : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).obj (op (⊤ : Opens X)))
    (hs : LocallyZero X ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0) s) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU⟩ := hs (ambient (firstVertex σ))
  have h : SimplexIn σ U := by
    intro p
    rw [point_eq_vertexPt p]
    exact hxU
  calc (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ (s : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).X 0 ⟶ Qcoef)
      = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).ιChainComplex
          (pushSimplex (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)) (corestrict σ h))
        ≫ (s : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).X 0 ⟶ Qcoef) := by
        rw [pushSimplex_corestrict σ h (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)]
    _ = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).ιChainComplex (corestrict σ h)
        ≫ (((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op s :
          (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).X 0 ⟶ Qcoef) :=
      (ι_res_cochain (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)) 0 s (corestrict σ h)).symm
    _ = (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).ιChainComplex σ
        ≫ (0 : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (⊤ : Opens X))).X 0 ⟶ Qcoef) := by
        rw [hU]
        rw [Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.gammaComparison_injective_degreeZero
statement:
theorem gammaComparison_injective_degreeZero (X : TopCat.{0}) :
    Function.Injective ((gammaComparison X).f 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hz : (gammaComparison X).f 0 (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hlz := (gammaComparison_eq_zero_iff X 0 (a - b)).mp hz
  have h0 := eq_zero_of_locallyZero_degreeZero X (a - b) hlz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

name: HodgePilot.CochainGlobal.gammaComparison_surjective_of_metrizable

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_add
statement: theorem Iexp_add (a b : ℤ) : Iexp (a + b) = Iexp a * Iexp b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iexp_eq_zpow, Iexp_eq_zpow, Iexp_eq_zpow, zpow_add₀ Complex.I_ne_zero]

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_conj
statement: theorem Iexp_conj (k : ℤ) : (starRingEnd ℂ) (Iexp k) = Iexp (-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iexp_eq_zpow, Iexp_eq_zpow, map_zpow₀, Complex.conj_I, ← Complex.inv_I,
    inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg]

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_mul_neg_one_zpow
statement:
theorem Iexp_mul_neg_one_zpow {a b n : ℤ} (h : a + b = n) :
    Iexp (b - a) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n = Iexp (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : (Complex.I : ℂ) ^ (4 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℤ) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast, Complex.I_pow_four]
  have hI2 : (-1 : ℂ) = Complex.I ^ (2 : ℤ) := by
    rw [show (2 : ℤ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast, Complex.I_sq]
  rw [Iexp_eq_zpow, Iexp_eq_zpow, hI2, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ Complex.I_ne_zero,
    show b - a + 2 * n = a - b + 4 * b by omega,
    zpow_add₀ Complex.I_ne_zero, zpow_mul, h4, one_zpow, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.baseChangeℂ_comm
statement:
theorem baseChangeℂ_comm {n : ℤ} (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (hsymm : ∀ x y, B x y = (-1 : ℚ) ^ n * B y x) (u w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    baseChangeℂ B u w = (-1 : ℂ) ^ n * baseChangeℂ B w u
proof:
:= by
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, mul_add]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
      | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, mul_add]
      | tmul d y =>
          simp only [baseChangeℂ, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
          rw [hsymm v y, Rat.smul_def, Rat.smul_def]
          push_cast
          ring

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.baseChange_comm
proof:
:=
  baseChangeℂ_comm P.form P.symm u w

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.hermitian_conj
statement:
theorem Polarization.hermitian_conj {n : ℤ} {h : QHodgeStructure n V}
    (P : Polarization h) {a b : ℤ} (hab : a + b = n) (u w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (Iexp (a - b) * baseChangeℂ P.form u (sigmaQ V w))
      = Iexp (a - b) * baseChangeℂ P.form w (sigmaQ V u)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) (baseChangeℂ P.form u (sigmaQ V w))
      = baseChangeℂ P.form (sigmaQ V u) w := by
    rw [← baseChangeℂ_sigmaQ_sigmaQ, sigmaQ_sigmaQ]
  rw [map_mul, Iexp_conj, neg_sub, h1, P.baseChange_comm (sigmaQ V u) w,
    ← mul_assoc, Iexp_mul_neg_one_zpow hab]

name: HodgePilot.exists_orthonormal_family
statement:
private theorem exists_orthonormal_family {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F]
    [Module ℂ F] [Module.Finite ℂ F] (Φ : F → F → ℂ)
    (hconj : ∀ x y, (starRingEnd ℂ) (Φ y x) = Φ x y)
    (hadd : ∀ x y z, Φ (x + y) z = Φ x z + Φ y z)
    (hsmul : ∀ (x y : F) (r : ℂ), Φ (r • x) y = (starRingEnd ℂ) r * Φ x y)
    (hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (Φ x x).re)
    (hdef : ∀ x, Φ x x = 0 → x = 0) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (e : Fin d → F),
      (∀ y : F, ∃ c : Fin d → ℂ, (∑ i, c i • e i) = y) ∧
        ∀ i j, Φ (e i) (e j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI core : InnerProductSpace.Core ℂ F :=
    { inner := Φ
      conj_inner_symm := hconj
      re_inner_nonneg := hnonneg
      add_left := hadd
      smul_left := hsmul
      definite := hdef }
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup F :=
    @InnerProductSpace.Core.toNormedAddCommGroup ℂ F _ _ _ core
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℂ F := InnerProductSpace.ofCore core.toCore
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℂ F := ‹Module.Finite ℂ F›
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ F
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℂ F, ⇑b, fun y => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun i => b.toBasis.repr y i, ?_⟩
    have hy := b.toBasis.sum_repr y
    simpa only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis] using hy
  · exact orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal i j

name: HodgePilot.tensorBilinForm_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorBilinForm_tmul (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (v v' : V) (w w' : W) :
    tensorBilinForm B C (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) (v' ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w') = B v v' * C w w'
proof:
:= by
  show LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib ℚ ℚ (B ⊗ₜ[ℚ] C) (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w)
      (v' ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w') = B v v' * C w w'
  rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: HodgePilot.baseChangeℂ_tensorBilinForm_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChangeℂ_tensorBilinForm_tensorEquiv (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (u u' : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (v v' : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm B C) (tensorEquiv V W (u ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v))
        (tensorEquiv V W (u' ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v'))
      = baseChangeℂ B u u' * baseChangeℂ C v v'
proof:
:= by
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
        zero_mul]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂,
        add_mul]
  | tmul c x =>
      induction v using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
            mul_zero]
      | add v₁ v₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁,
            h₂, mul_add]
      | tmul d y =>
          induction u' using TensorProduct.induction_on with
          | zero =>
              simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, zero_mul]
          | add u₁' u₂' h₁ h₂ =>
              simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, h₁, h₂, add_mul]
          | tmul c' x' =>
              induction v' using TensorProduct.induction_on with
              | zero =>
                  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
              | add v₁' v₂' h₁ h₂ =>
                  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, mul_add]
              | tmul d' y' =>
                  rw [tensorEquiv_tmul, tensorEquiv_tmul]
                  simp only [baseChangeℂ, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul,
                    tensorBilinForm_tmul]
                  rw [Rat.smul_def, Rat.smul_def, Rat.smul_def]
                  push_cast
                  ring

name: HodgePilot.tensorBilinForm_comm
statement:
theorem tensorBilinForm_comm {h : QHodgeStructure n V} {k : QHodgeStructure m W}
    (P : Polarization h) (Q : Polarization k) (x y : V ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form x y
      = (-1 : ℚ) ^ (n + m) * tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form y x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
  | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, mul_add]
  | tmul v w =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
      | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ =>
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, mul_add]
      | tmul v' w' =>
          rw [tensorBilinForm_tmul, tensorBilinForm_tmul, P.symm v v',
            Q.symm w w', zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (-1 : ℚ) ≠ 0)]
          ring

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_eq_iSup
statement:
private theorem tensorPiece_eq_iSup (h : QHodgeStructure n V)

:=

name: HodgePilot.slotSwap_slotSwap
statement:
private theorem slotSwap_slotSwap (s : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    slotSwap (slotSwap s) = s
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.slotSwap_injective
statement:

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQ_mem_slotSwap
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.slotModule_orthogonal
statement:
private theorem slotModule_orthogonal {h : QHodgeStructure n V}
    {k : QHodgeStructure m W} (P : Polarization h) (Q : Polarization k)
    {s t : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)} (hst : t ≠ slotSwap s)
    {x y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V ⊗[ℚ] W)} (hx : x ∈ slotModule h k s)
    (hy : y ∈ slotModule h k t) :
    baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a₁, b₁⟩, ⟨c₁, d₁⟩⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨⟨a₂, b₂⟩, ⟨c₂, d₂⟩⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx
  obtain ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
  clear hx hy
  rw [TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2] at hu hu'
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      induction hu' using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem z' hz' =>
          obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
          obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩ := hz'
          simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
          rw [baseChangeℂ_tensorBilinForm_tensorEquiv]
          by_cases h1 : ((a₂ : ℤ), (b₂ : ℤ)) = ((b₁ : ℤ), (a₁ : ℤ))
          · 
            have h2 : ((c₂ : ℤ), (d₂ : ℤ)) ≠ ((d₁ : ℤ), (c₁ : ℤ)) := by
              intro h2
              exact hst (Prod.ext h1 h2)
            rw [Q.orthogonal c₁ d₁ c₂ d₂ h2 b hb b' hb', mul_zero]
          · rw [P.orthogonal a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ h1 a ha a' ha', zero_mul]
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add z₁' z₂' _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
          simp only [map_add, ih₁, ih₂, add_zero]
      | smul r z' _ ih =>
          simp only [map_smul, ih, smul_zero]
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add z₁ z₂ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ih₁, ih₂, add_zero]
  | smul r z _ ih =>
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ih, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.slotModule_repr
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2] at hu
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan ⟨a, ha⟩
      refine ⟨fun i => c i • b, fun i => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb, ?_⟩
      have ha' : (∑ i, c i • (e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = a := by
        have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
        simpa using this
      calc TensorProduct.mk ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) a b
          = (∑ i, c i • (e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b := by rw [ha']; rfl
        _ = ∑ i, (c i • (e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b :=
            TensorProduct.sum_tmul _ _ _
        _ = ∑ i, ((e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (c i • b)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, fun i => Submodule.zero_mem _, ?_⟩
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, rfl⟩ := ihx
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂, rfl⟩ := ihy
      refine ⟨fun i => w₁ i + w₂ i,
        fun i => Submodule.add_mem _ (hw₁ i) (hw₂ i), ?_⟩
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  | smul r z hz ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨fun i => r • w i, fun i => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hw i), ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.smul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: HodgePilot.slotModule_hermitian
statement:
private theorem slotModule_hermitian {h : QHodgeStructure n V}
    {k : QHodgeStructure m W} (P : Polarization h) (Q : Polarization k)
    {s : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)} {pq : ℤ × ℤ} (hs : s.1 + s.2 = pq)
    {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V ⊗[ℚ] W)} (hx : x ∈ slotModule h k s) :
    (Iexp (pq.1 - pq.2) * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
        (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).im = 0
      ∧ 0 ≤ (Iexp (pq.1 - pq.2)
          * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
              (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).re
      ∧ ((Iexp (pq.1 - pq.2)
          * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
              (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).re = 0 → x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨a₁, b₁⟩, ⟨c₁, d₁⟩⟩ := s
  obtain ⟨p, q⟩ := pq
  
  by_cases hn₁ : a₁ + b₁ = n
  swap
  · have hxz : x = 0 := by
      have hb : slotModule h k ((a₁, b₁), (c₁, d₁)) = ⊥ := by
        unfold slotModule
        rw [show h.H ((a₁, b₁), (c₁, d₁)).1 = ⊥ from h.supported _ hn₁,
          TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_left,
          Submodule.map_bot]
      rw [hb] at hx
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℂ).mp hx
    subst hxz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩ <;>
      simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re,
        le_refl]
  by_cases hn₂ : c₁ + d₁ = m
  swap
  · have hxz : x = 0 := by
      have hb : slotModule h k ((a₁, b₁), (c₁, d₁)) = ⊥ := by
        unfold slotModule
        rw [show k.H ((a₁, b₁), (c₁, d₁)).2 = ⊥ from k.supported _ hn₂,
          TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_right,
          Submodule.map_bot]
      rw [hb] at hx
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℂ).mp hx
    subst hxz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩ <;>
      simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re,
        le_refl]
  
  have hp : a₁ + c₁ = p := by
    have := congrArg Prod.fst hs
    simpa [Prod.fst_add] using this
  have hq : b₁ + d₁ = q := by
    have := congrArg Prod.snd hs
    simpa [Prod.snd_add] using this
  have hsplit : p - q = (a₁ - b₁) + (c₁ - d₁) := by omega
  
  obtain ⟨D, e, hspan, horth⟩ := exists_orthonormal_family
    (Φ := fun x y : ↥(h.H (a₁, b₁)) =>
      Iexp (a₁ - b₁) * baseChangeℂ P.form (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
        (sigmaQ V (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)))
    (fun x y => P.hermitian_conj hn₁ (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
    (fun x y z => by
      simp only [Submodule.coe_add, map_add, mul_add])
    (fun x y r => by
      simp only [SetLike.val_smul, map_smulₛₗ (sigmaQ V), map_smul,
        smul_eq_mul]
      ring)
    (fun x => P.hermitian_re_nonneg a₁ b₁ hn₁ x.2)
    (fun x hxx => by
      have hxx' : Iexp (a₁ - b₁) * baseChangeℂ P.form (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          (sigmaQ V (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = 0 := hxx
      by_contra hne
      have hpos := P.positive a₁ b₁ hn₁ (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) x.2
        (fun hz => hne (Subtype.ext hz))
      rw [hxx', Complex.zero_re] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos)
  
  have hx' : x ∈ (LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H (a₁, b₁)) (k.H (c₁, d₁)))).map
      (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) := hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx'
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hu_eq⟩ := slotModule_repr e hspan hu
  
  have hσT : ∀ (uu : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (ww : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W),
      sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) ((tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) (uu ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ww))
        = (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
            ((sigmaQ V uu) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (sigmaQ W ww)) := fun uu ww =>
    sigmaQR_tensorEquiv V W uu ww
  
  have hval : Iexp (p - q)
      * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form)
          ((tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) u)
          (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) ((tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) u))
      = ∑ i, Iexp (c₁ - d₁) * baseChangeℂ Q.form (w i)
          (sigmaQ W (w i)) := by
    rw [hu_eq, map_sum, map_sum (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W))]
    simp only [hσT]
    rw [map_sum (baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form)),
      LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [map_sum]
    simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    simp only [baseChangeℂ_tensorBilinForm_tensorEquiv]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc ∑ i, Iexp (p - q) * ∑ j,
          baseChangeℂ P.form (e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (sigmaQ V (e j : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
            * baseChangeℂ Q.form (w i) (sigmaQ W (w j))
        = ∑ i, ∑ j, (if j = i then (1 : ℂ) else 0)
            * (Iexp (c₁ - d₁) * baseChangeℂ Q.form (w i)
                (sigmaQ W (w j))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          rw [← horth j i, hsplit, Iexp_add]
          ring
      _ = ∑ i, Iexp (c₁ - d₁) * baseChangeℂ Q.form (w i)
            (sigmaQ W (w i)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i]
          simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hval, Complex.im_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ =>
      Q.hermitian_real c₁ d₁ hn₂ (w i) (hw i)
  · rw [hval, Complex.re_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Q.hermitian_re_nonneg c₁ d₁ hn₂ (hw i)
  · intro hre
    rw [hval, Complex.re_sum] at hre
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun i _ => Q.hermitian_re_nonneg c₁ d₁ hn₂ (hw i))).mp hre
    have hwz : ∀ i, w i = 0 := by
      intro i
      by_contra hne
      have hpos := Q.positive c₁ d₁ hn₂ (w i) (hw i) hne
      rw [hz i (Finset.mem_univ i)] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    have hu0 : u = 0 := by
      rw [hu_eq]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => by
        rw [hwz i, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    rw [hu0, map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_hermitian
statement:
private theorem tensorPiece_hermitian (P : Polarization h) (Q : Polarization k)
    (p q : ℤ) {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V ⊗[ℚ] W)} (hx : x ∈ tensorPiece h k (p, q)) :
    (Iexp (p - q) * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
        (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).im = 0
      ∧ 0 ≤ (Iexp (p - q)
          * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
              (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).re
      ∧ ((Iexp (p - q)
          * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
              (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)).re = 0 → x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ (s : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : s.1 + s.2 = (p, q)),
      slotModule h k s := hx
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hsum⟩ :=
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ x).mp hx'
  have hsum' : (∑ s ∈ f.support, f s) = x := hsum
  have hfs : ∀ s : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), s.1 + s.2 = (p, q) →
      f s ∈ slotModule h k s := by
    intro s hc
    have := hf s
    rwa [iSup_pos hc] at this
  have hfz : ∀ s : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), s.1 + s.2 ≠ (p, q) → f s = 0 := by
    intro s hc
    have := hf s
    rw [iSup_neg hc] at this
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℂ).mp this
  
  have key : ∀ y, baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x y
      = ∑ t ∈ f.support,
          baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f t) y := by
    intro y
    conv_lhs => rw [← hsum']
    rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hσx : sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x
      = ∑ s ∈ f.support, sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f s) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hsum']
    rw [map_sum]
  have hBval : baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
      (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)
      = ∑ t ∈ f.support, baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f t)
          (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f t)) := by
    rw [key]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht => ?_
    rw [hσx, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem t ht fun u hu hut => ?_
    by_cases hcu : u.1 + u.2 = (p, q)
    · by_cases hct : t.1 + t.2 = (p, q)
      · refine slotModule_orthogonal P Q ?_ (hfs t hct)
          (sigmaQ_mem_slotSwap (hfs u hcu))
        intro heq
        exact hut (slotSwap_injective heq)
      · rw [hfz t hct, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    · rw [hfz u hcu, map_zero, map_zero]
  have hVAL : Iexp (p - q) * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) x
      (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) x)
      = ∑ s ∈ f.support, Iexp (p - q)
          * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f s)
              (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f s)) := by
    rw [hBval, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ s ∈ f.support,
      (Iexp (p - q) * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f s)
          (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f s))).im = 0
        ∧ 0 ≤ (Iexp (p - q)
            * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f s)
                (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f s))).re
        ∧ ((Iexp (p - q)
            * baseChangeℂ (tensorBilinForm P.form Q.form) (f s)
                (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (f s))).re = 0 → f s = 0) := by
    intro s _
    by_cases hcs : s.1 + s.2 = (p, q)
    · exact slotModule_hermitian P Q hcs (hfs s hcs)
    · rw [hfz s hcs]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩ <;>
        simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re,
          le_refl]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hVAL, Complex.im_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s hs => (hterm s hs).1
  · rw [hVAL, Complex.re_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun s hs => (hterm s hs).2.1
  · intro hre
    rw [hVAL, Complex.re_sum] at hre
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun s hs => (hterm s hs).2.1)).mp hre
    rw [← hsum']
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s hs => (hterm s hs).2.2 (hz s hs)

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.nondegenerate
statement:
theorem Polarization.nondegenerate (P : Polarization h) :
    P.form.Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  refine (LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft P.isRefl).mpr ?_
  intro v hv
  have hflip : ∀ w ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℚ V), P.form w v = 0 := fun w _ =>
    P.isRefl v w (hv w)
  have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v = 0 := by
    refine P.baseChange_separating (SubHodge.top h) ?_
      (forall_baseChange_pairing_one_tmul P.form hflip)
    rw [SubHodge.top_toSubmodule, Submodule.baseChange_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  rwa [Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff] at h1

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.dualForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem Polarization.dualForm_apply (P : Polarization h)
    (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    P.dualForm φ ψ = P.form (P.fromDual φ) (P.fromDual ψ)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.dualForm_baseChangeℂ
statement:
theorem Polarization.dualForm_baseChangeℂ (P : Polarization h)
    (Φ Ψ : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    baseChangeℂ P.dualForm Φ Ψ
      = baseChangeℂ P.form (P.fromDual.baseChange ℂ Φ)
          (P.fromDual.baseChange ℂ Ψ)
proof:
:= by
  induction Φ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add Φ₁ Φ₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c f =>
      induction Ψ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add Ψ₁ Ψ₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]
      | tmul d g =>
          simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, baseChangeℂ,
            LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, dualForm_apply]

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.dualEquiv_toDualEquiv
statement:
theorem Polarization.dualEquiv_toDualEquiv (P : Polarization h)
    (Ψ : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    dualEquiv V Ψ z
      = baseChangeℂ P.form (P.fromDual.baseChange ℂ Ψ) z
proof:
:= by
  induction Ψ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add Ψ₁ Ψ₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c f =>
      induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]
      | tmul d v =>
          rw [dualEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
          simp only [baseChangeℂ, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
          have hfv : P.form (P.fromDual f) v = f v := by
            have h1 : P.toDualEquiv (P.toDualEquiv.symm f) = f :=
              P.toDualEquiv.apply_symm_apply f
            calc P.form (P.fromDual f) v
                = (P.toDualEquiv (P.toDualEquiv.symm f)) v := rfl
              _ = f v := by rw [h1]
          rw [hfv, Rat.smul_def]
          ring

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.mem_H_of_forall_otherPieces
statement:
theorem Polarization.mem_H_of_forall_otherPieces (P : Polarization h)
    {a b : ℤ} {y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V}
    (hy : ∀ z ∈ otherPieces h (a, b), baseChangeℂ P.form y z = 0) :
    y ∈ h.H (b, a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {pq : ℤ × ℤ | h.H pq ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, ((h.isInternal.proj pq y : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
        = y :=
    h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj y fun pq hpq => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hpq
  have hpiece : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, pq ≠ (b, a) →
      ((h.isInternal.proj pq y : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = 0 := by
    intro pq hne
    obtain ⟨p', q'⟩ := pq
    by_cases hn' : p' + q' = n
    · by_contra hne0
      have hmemH : ((h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y : h.H (p', q')) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ h.H (p', q') := (h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y).2
      have hσ : sigmaQ V
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y : h.H (p', q')) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ h.H (q', p') := by
        rw [← h.conj_symm p' q']
        exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hmemH
      have hswne : ((q' : ℤ), (p' : ℤ)) ≠ (a, b) := by
        intro heq
        rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
        exact hne (Prod.ext heq.2 heq.1)
      have h0 : baseChangeℂ P.form y (sigmaQ V
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y : h.H (p', q')) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = 0 :=
        hy _ (H_le_otherPieces h hswne hσ)
      have h1 := P.apply_proj_left hσ y
      have h2 : baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y : h.H (p', q')) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          (sigmaQ V
            ((h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y : h.H (p', q')) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
          = 0 := by
        rw [← h1]
        exact h0
      have hpos := P.positive p' q' hn' _ hmemH hne0
      rw [h2, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    · exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (h.supported (p', q') hn') _
        (h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y).2
  have hsingle :
      (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, ((h.isInternal.proj pq y : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
        = ((h.isInternal.proj (b, a) y : h.H (b, a)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_single (b, a) (fun pq _ hne => hpiece pq hne)
      fun hnm => ?_
    have hbot : h.H (b, a) = ⊥ :=
      of_not_not fun hne => hnm (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hne)
    exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot _ (h.isInternal.proj (b, a) y).2
  have hy_eq : y = ((h.isInternal.proj (b, a) y : h.H (b, a)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :=
    hdecomp.symm.trans hsingle
  rw [hy_eq]
  exact (h.isInternal.proj (b, a) y).2

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.dualPiece_baseChange_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualPiece_def] at hΨ
  obtain ⟨Φ₀, hΦ₀, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hΨ
  refine P.mem_H_of_forall_otherPieces ?_
  intro z hz
  rw [← P.dualEquiv_toDualEquiv]
  have hΦ : dualEquiv V (((dualEquiv V).symm : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) Φ₀) = Φ₀ := by
    simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hΦ]
  have hΦ₀' : Φ₀ ∈ (otherPieces h (-r, -s)).dualAnnihilator := hΦ₀
  exact (Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator Φ₀).mp hΦ₀' z hz

name: HodgePilot.toDual_baseChange_fromDual
statement:
private theorem toDual_baseChange_fromDual (P : Polarization h)
    (Ψ : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    (P.toDualEquiv : V →ₗ[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V).baseChange ℂ
        (P.fromDual.baseChange ℂ Ψ) = Ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.baseChange_comp]
  have hcomp : (P.toDualEquiv : V →ₗ[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) ∘ₗ P.fromDual
      = LinearMap.id := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun φ => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    exact P.toDualEquiv.apply_symm_apply φ
  rw [hcomp, LinearMap.baseChange_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: HodgePilot.oneTmul_injective
statement:
theorem oneTmul_injective (W : Type u) [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] :
    Function.Injective (fun w : W => (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w)
proof:
:= by
  have halg : Function.Injective (Algebra.linearMap ℚ ℂ) := by
    intro a b hab
    have hcast : ((a : ℚ) : ℂ) = ((b : ℚ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) a, ← eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) b]
      exact hab
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have h1 : (fun w : W => (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) =
      ⇑((Algebra.linearMap ℚ ℂ).rTensor W) ∘ ⇑(TensorProduct.lid ℚ W).symm := by
    funext w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.lid_symm_apply,
      LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Algebra.linearMap_apply, map_one]
  rw [h1]
  exact (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ halg).comp
    (TensorProduct.lid ℚ W).symm.injective

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_map_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPiece_def h k pq]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
  refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp ht
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hs
  clear hw ht hs
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | tmul a b =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      rw [baseChange_map_tensorEquiv]
      have hle : (LinearMap.range
            (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h'.H x.1) (k'.H x.2))).map
          (tensorEquiv V' W').toLinearMap ≤ tensorPiece h' k' pq :=
        le_iSup₂ (f := fun (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : x.1 + x.2 = pq) =>
          (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h'.H x.1) (k'.H x.2))).map
            (tensorEquiv V' W').toLinearMap) x hx
      refine hle (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
        ⟨(⟨_, hφ x.1 (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem a.2)⟩ : h'.H x.1) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
          (⟨_, hψ x.2 (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem b.2)⟩ : k'.H x.2), rfl⟩))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStruct.toLinearMap_eq_zero_of_weight_ne
statement:
theorem toLinearMap_eq_zero_of_weight_ne {X Y : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hw : X.weight ≠ Y.weight) : f.toLinearMap = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbot : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ,
      (X.str.H pq).map (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) ≤ ⊥ := by
    intro pq
    by_cases hp : pq.1 + pq.2 = X.weight
    · have hY : Y.str.H pq = ⊥ := Y.str.supported pq (by rw [hp]; exact hw)
      exact hY ▸ f.maps_pieces pq
    · rw [X.str.supported pq hp, Submodule.map_bot]
  
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_top, ← X.str.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top,
      Submodule.map_iSup]
    exact le_bot_iff.mp (iSup_le hbot)
  have hbc : f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ = 0 := LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hrange
  
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  have h0 : f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = 0 := by
    rw [hbc]; rfl
  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul] at h0
  refine oneTmul_injective Y.carrier ?_
  show (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (f.toLinearMap v) = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (0 : Y.carrier)
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  exact h0

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.coev_one_ofVectorSpace
statement:
private theorem coev_one_ofVectorSpace (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    [Module.Finite ℚ M] :
    coevaluation ℚ M 1 = ∑ i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex ℚ M,
      Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ M i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ M).coord i
proof:
:= by
  rw [coevaluation_apply_one]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.rightAdjointMate_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem rightAdjointMate_toLinearMap (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    HodgeHom.toLinearMap (fᘁ) = LinearMap.dualMap f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g => ?_
  show (TensorProduct.lid ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ X.carrier))
      (LinearMap.rTensor (Module.Dual ℚ X.carrier) (contractLeft ℚ Y.carrier)
        ((TensorProduct.assoc ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ Y.carrier) Y.carrier
            (Module.Dual ℚ X.carrier)).symm
          (LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ Y.carrier)
            (LinearMap.rTensor (Module.Dual ℚ X.carrier) f.toLinearMap)
            (LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ Y.carrier)
              (coevaluation ℚ X.carrier)
              ((TensorProduct.rid ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ Y.carrier)).symm g))))) =
    f.toLinearMap.dualMap g
  rw [TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    coev_one_ofVectorSpace]
  conv_rhs => rw [← (Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ X.carrier).sum_dual_apply_smul_coord
    (LinearMap.dualMap f.toLinearMap g)]
  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_sum, map_sum, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul,
    contractLeft_apply, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, LinearMap.dualMap_apply]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.antipodeAux_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipodeAux_tmul (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X) :
    E.antipodeAux X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      matrixCoeff F (E.inv X)
        ((E.dualAt X).flip v ⊗ₜ[k] E.dualInv X f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipodeAux]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.flip_dualAt_transpose
statement:
theorem flip_dualAt_transpose {X Y : J} (u : X ⟶ Y) (v : F.obj X) :
    (E.dualAt X).flip v ∘ₗ (F.map (E.transposeMor u)).hom =
      (E.dualAt Y).flip ((F.map u).hom v)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [E.transpose_dual u y]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.dualInv_comp
statement:
theorem dualInv_comp {X Y : J} (u : X ⟶ Y) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) :
    E.dualInv X (f ∘ₗ (F.map u).hom) =
      (F.map (E.transposeMor u)).hom (E.dualInv Y f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := E.transpose_dual u (E.dualInv Y f)
  rw [E.dualAt_dualInv] at h
  rw [← h, E.dualInv_dualAt]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.antipodeAux_dinatural
statement:
private theorem antipodeAux_dinatural ⦃X Y : J⦄ (u : X ⟶ Y) :
    E.antipodeAux X ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj X) (F.map u).hom.dualMap =
      E.antipodeAux Y ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (F.map u).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, antipodeAux_tmul]
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (E.transposeMor u)
    ((E.dualAt X).flip v) (E.dualInv Y f)
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', E.flip_dualAt_transpose u v] at hnat
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', E.dualInv_comp u f]
  exact hnat.symm

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.antipodeLeg_dinatural
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  exact E.antipodeAux_dinatural u

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.coeffAntipode_comp_matrixCoeff
statement:
private theorem coeffAntipode_comp_matrixCoeff (X : J) :
    E.coeffAntipode ∘ₗ matrixCoeff F X = E.antipodeAux X
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (coend.ι_desc E.antipodeLeg E.antipodeLeg_dinatural X)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.coeffAntipode_matrixCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffAntipode_matrixCoeff (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (v : F.obj X) :
    E.coeffAntipode (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      matrixCoeff F (E.inv X) ((E.dualAt X).flip v ⊗ₜ[k] E.dualInv X f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (E.coeffAntipode_comp_matrixCoeff X)
    (f ⊗ₜ[k] v)
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, E.antipodeAux_tmul] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.sum_eval_functional
statement:
theorem sum_eval_functional (X : J) :
    ∑ i, (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj (E.inv X)) (F.obj X)
        ((E.dualAt X).flip (coeffBasis F X i) ⊗ₜ[k] (coeffBasis F X).coord i) ∘ₗ
      D.concatInv (E.inv X) X) =
      D.unitFunc ∘ₗ (F.map (E.evalMor X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro y w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, E.eval_concat,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul, D.unitFunc_unitVec, mul_one]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((coeffBasis F X).sum_dual_apply_smul_coord (E.dualAt X y)) w
  simpa only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.coeval_functional
statement:
theorem coeval_functional (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X) :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj (E.inv X))
        (f ⊗ₜ[k] (E.dualAt X).flip v) ∘ₗ D.concatInv X (E.inv X)) ∘ₗ
      (F.map (E.coevalMor X)).hom = f v • D.unitFunc
proof:
:= by
  refine Basis.ext D.unitBasis fun i => ?_
  have hi : D.unitBasis i = D.unitVec := by
    rw [← D.unitBasis_default]
  rw [hi]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, E.coeval_unitVec, D.concatInv_concat,
    map_sum, TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    E.dualAt_dualInv, LinearMap.smul_apply, D.unitFunc_unitVec, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((coeffBasis F X).sum_dual_apply_smul_coord f) v
  simpa only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_comm] using h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.antipode_convolution_left
statement:
theorem antipode_convolution_left (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (v : F.obj X) :
    ∑ i, D.coeffMul
        (E.coeffAntipode (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F X i)))
        (matrixCoeff F X ((coeffBasis F X).coord i ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      f v • D.coeffOne
proof:
:= by
  simp only [E.coeffAntipode_matrixCoeff, D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul]
  rw [← map_sum, ← TensorProduct.sum_tmul, E.sum_eval_functional,
    ← LinearMap.dualMap_apply', matrixCoeff_naturality, E.eval_concat,
    E.dualAt_dualInv, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_smul]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CoeffAntipodeData.antipode_convolution_right
statement:
theorem antipode_convolution_right (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (v : F.obj X) :
    ∑ i, D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F X i))
        (E.coeffAntipode (matrixCoeff F X ((coeffBasis F X).coord i ⊗ₜ[k] v))) =
      f v • D.coeffOne
proof:
:= by
  simp only [E.coeffAntipode_matrixCoeff, D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul]
  rw [← map_sum, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum, ← map_sum, ← E.coeval_unitVec,
    ← matrixCoeff_naturality, LinearMap.dualMap_apply', E.coeval_functional,
    ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul]
  rfl
