theorem junctionChartsToBetti_apply [IsAffine X]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (m : ℕ)
    (x : DeRhamSheaf.hyperHdRSpace (cRingHom sX) (m : ℤ)) :
    junctionChartsToBetti sX d m x =
      (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv sX d m).symm (junctionCharts sX d (m : ℤ) x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagCertified.analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv_junctionChartsToBetti
statement:
theorem analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv_junctionChartsToBetti [IsAffine X]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (m : ℕ)
    (x : DeRhamSheaf.hyperHdRSpace (cRingHom sX) (m : ℤ)) :
    analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv sX d m (junctionChartsToBetti sX d m x) =
      junctionCharts sX d (m : ℤ) x
proof:
:=
  (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv sX d m).apply_symm_apply _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagCertified.isHodgeClassAffineCertified_iff_mem_junctionChartsToBetti
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassAffineCertified_iff_mem_junctionChartsToBetti
    [IsAffine X] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (p : ℕ)
    (c : bettiQ (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) (2 * p)) :
    IsHodgeClassAffineCertified sX d p c ↔
      toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) (2 * p) c ∈
        (dRSpaceFiltrationC sX (p : ℤ) ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
          (junctionChartsToBetti sX d (2 * p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show junctionChartsToBetti sX d (2 * p) =
      ((analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv sX d (2 * p)).symm.toAddMonoidHom).comp
        (junctionCharts sX d ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ)) from rfl,
    ← AddSubgroup.map_map, AddSubgroup.mem_map_equiv, AddEquiv.symm_symm]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagCertified.hodgeShapeAffineCertifiedOfInput_iff_hodgeShapeAffineOfInput

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagCertified.isHodgeClassProperCertified_iff_isHodgeClassOfInputsProper
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassProperCertified_iff_isHodgeClassOfInputsProper
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth g]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper g]

theorem feasible_iff_exists (M : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) :

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.IsSolution.feasible
statement:

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.DualWitness.dot_eq_zero_of_isSolution
statement:
theorem DualWitness.dot_eq_zero_of_isSolution {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (w : DualWitness M b) {x : n → K} (hx : IsSolution M b x) : w.y ⬝ᵥ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : M *ᵥ x = b := hx
  calc w.y ⬝ᵥ b = w.y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by rw [hx']
    _ = (w.y ᵥ* M) ⬝ᵥ x := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec w.y M x
    _ = (0 : n → K) ⬝ᵥ x := by rw [w.annihilates]
    _ = 0 := zero_dotProduct x

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.DualWitness.not_isSolution
statement:
theorem DualWitness.not_isSolution {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (w : DualWitness M b) (x : n → K) : ¬ IsSolution M b x
proof:
:=
  fun hx => w.pays (w.dot_eq_zero_of_isSolution hx)

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.DualWitness.infeasible
statement:
theorem DualWitness.infeasible {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (w : DualWitness M b) : Infeasible M b
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact w.not_isSolution x hx

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.DualWitness.not_feasible
statement:
theorem DualWitness.not_feasible {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (w : DualWitness M b) : ¬ Feasible M b
proof: := w.infeasible

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.infeasible_of_dualWitness
statement:
theorem infeasible_of_dualWitness {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K} (y : m → K)
    (hy : y ᵥ* M = 0) (hyb : y ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) : ¬ ∃ x, M *ᵥ x = b
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  apply hyb
  calc y ⬝ᵥ b = y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by rw [hx]
    _ = (y ᵥ* M) ⬝ᵥ x := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec y M x
    _ = (0 : n → K) ⬝ᵥ x := by rw [hy]
    _ = 0 := zero_dotProduct x

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.no_certificate_conflict
statement:
theorem no_certificate_conflict {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (w : DualWitness M b) (x : n → K) (hx : M *ᵥ x = b) : False
proof:

  w.not_isSolution x hx

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.not_nonempty_dualWitness_of_feasible
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_dualWitness_of_feasible {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (hf : Feasible M b) : ¬ Nonempty (DualWitness M b)
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨w⟩ => w.infeasible hf

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.DualWitness.smul_y
statement:
theorem DualWitness.smul_y {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K} (w : DualWitness M b)
    {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) : (w.smul hc).y = c • w.y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.exists_dualWitness_of_infeasible
statement:
theorem exists_dualWitness_of_infeasible {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K}
    (h : ¬ Feasible M b) : Nonempty (DualWitness M b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb : b ∉ LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin := by
    intro hmem
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range] at hmem
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] at hx
    exact h ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hfb, hmap⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hb inferInstance
  set y : m → K := fun i => f (fun j => if i = j then (1 : K) else 0) with hy
  have bridge : ∀ v : m → K, f v = v ⬝ᵥ y := by
    intro v
    rw [LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ f v]
    simp only [dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hy]
  refine ⟨⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · funext j
    show y ⬝ᵥ (fun i => M i j) = (0 : K)
    have hmem : (fun i => M i j) ∈ LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_range]
      refine ⟨Pi.single j 1, ?_⟩
      rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
      funext i
      show (fun k => M i k) ⬝ᵥ Pi.single j (1 : K) = M i j
      rw [dotProduct_single, mul_one]
    have hf0 : f (fun i => M i j) = 0 := by
      have hmem2 : f (fun i => M i j) ∈ Submodule.map f (LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin) :=
        Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hmem
      rw [hmap] at hmem2
      simpa using hmem2
    rw [dotProduct_comm, ← bridge (fun i => M i j)]
    exact hf0
  · rw [dotProduct_comm, ← bridge b]
    exact hfb

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.feasible_iff_forall_dual
statement:
theorem feasible_iff_forall_dual {M : Matrix m n K} {b : m → K} :
    Feasible M b ↔ ∀ y : m → K, y ᵥ* M = 0 → y ⬝ᵥ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ y hy
    have hx' : M *ᵥ x = b := hx
    calc y ⬝ᵥ b = y ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by rw [hx']
      _ = (y ᵥ* M) ⬝ᵥ x := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec y M x
      _ = (0 : n → K) ⬝ᵥ x := by rw [hy]
      _ = 0 := zero_dotProduct x
  · intro hall
    by_contra hinf
    obtain ⟨w⟩ := exists_dualWitness_of_infeasible hinf
    exact w.pays (hall w.y w.annihilates)

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.isMinimalNonmember_iff

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hxw, hwz⟩ := Relation.TransGen.head'_iff.mp h

proof:

proof: := h.2 y hy

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.IsMinimalNonmember.not_transGen
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.IsMinimalNonmember.independent

    IsAntichain (Relation.TransGen R) {x | IsMinimalNonmember R C x}
proof:
:= by
  intro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ _hne
  show ¬ Relation.TransGen R x₁ x₂
  exact IsMinimalNonmember.not_transGen hx₁ hx₂

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.familyMem_apply
statement:
theorem familyMem_apply {row col : α → Type*} [∀ a, Fintype (row a)]
    [∀ a, Fintype (col a)] (M : ∀ a, Matrix (row a) (col a) K)
    (b : ∀ a, row a → K) (a : α) : familyMem M b a ↔ Feasible (M a) (b a)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.CertificateSoundness.isMinimalNonmember_of_certificates
statement:
theorem isMinimalNonmember_of_certificates (R : α → α → Prop) {row col : α → Type*}
    [∀ a, Fintype (row a)] [∀ a, Fintype (col a)]
    (M : ∀ a, Matrix (row a) (col a) K) (b : ∀ a, row a → K)
    (hC : StepClosed R (familyMem M b)) {x : α} (w : DualWitness (M x) (b x))
    (prim : ∀ y, R x y → ∃ z, IsSolution (M y) (b y) z) :
    IsMinimalNonmember R (familyMem M b) x
proof:
:= by
  refine isMinimalNonmember_of_covers hC ?_ ?_
  · exact w.infeasible
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := prim y hy
    exact hz.feasible

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {r : Fin n → ℝ}, (∀ i, 0 ≤ r i) → (∀ i, r i < 1) →
      Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ i, r i ^ α i
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro r _ _
    have h : (fun α : Fin 0 → ℕ => ∏ i, r i ^ α i) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) :=
      funext fun α => by simp
    rw [h]
    exact (hasSum_single (f := fun _ : Fin 0 → ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) default
      fun b hb => absurd (Subsingleton.elim b default) hb).summable
  | succ n ih =>
    intro r h0 h1
    have hhead : Summable fun k : ℕ => r 0 ^ k := summable_geometric_of_lt_one (h0 0) (h1 0)
    have htail : Summable fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ j, r j.succ ^ β j :=
      ih (fun j : Fin n => h0 j.succ) fun j : Fin n => h1 j.succ
    have hprod : Summable fun x : ℕ × (Fin n → ℕ) => r 0 ^ x.1 * ∏ j, r j.succ ^ x.2 j :=
      Summable.mul_of_nonneg (f := fun k : ℕ => r 0 ^ k)
        (g := fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ j, r j.succ ^ β j) hhead htail
        (Pi.le_def.mpr fun k => pow_nonneg (h0 0) k)
        (Pi.le_def.mpr fun β => Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => pow_nonneg (h0 j.succ) _)
    refine ((Fin.consEquiv fun _ => ℕ).summable_iff
      (f := fun α : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ => ∏ i, r i ^ α i)).mp (hprod.congr fun x => ?_)
    show r 0 ^ x.1 * ∏ j, r j.succ ^ x.2 j = ∏ i, r i ^ (Fin.cons x.1 x.2 : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) i
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
    exact congrArg (r 0 ^ x.1 * ·) (Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [Fin.cons_succ])

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasSum_prod_geometric_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_prod_geometric_of_norm_lt_one :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin n → ℂ}, (∀ i, ‖q i‖ < 1) →
      HasSum (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ i, q i ^ α i) (∏ i, (1 - q i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro q _
    have h : (fun α : Fin 0 → ℕ => ∏ i, q i ^ α i) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) :=
      funext fun α => by simp
    have h2 : (∏ i, (1 - q i)⁻¹) = 1 := by simp
    rw [h, h2]
    exact hasSum_single (f := fun _ : Fin 0 → ℕ => (1 : ℂ)) default
      fun b hb => absurd (Subsingleton.elim b default) hb
  | succ n ih =>
    intro q hq
    have hhead : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => q 0 ^ k) (1 - q 0)⁻¹ :=
      hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (hq 0)
    have htail : HasSum (fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ j, q j.succ ^ β j)
        (∏ j : Fin n, (1 - q j.succ)⁻¹) := ih fun j : Fin n => hq j.succ
    have hs1 : Summable fun k : ℕ => ‖q 0 ^ k‖ := by
      have := summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg (q 0)) (hq 0)
      exact this.congr fun k => (norm_pow _ _).symm
    have hs2 : Summable fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ‖∏ j, q j.succ ^ β j‖ := by
      have := summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one (fun j : Fin n => norm_nonneg (q j.succ))
        fun j : Fin n => hq j.succ
      refine this.congr fun β => ?_
      rw [Complex.norm_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => (norm_pow _ _).symm
    have H := HasSum.mul (f := fun k : ℕ => q 0 ^ k)
      (g := fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ j, q j.succ ^ β j) hhead htail
      (summable_mul_of_summable_norm (R := ℂ) (f := fun k : ℕ => q 0 ^ k)
        (g := fun β : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ j, q j.succ ^ β j) hs1 hs2)
    rw [show (∏ i, (1 - q i)⁻¹) = (1 - q 0)⁻¹ * ∏ j : Fin n, (1 - q j.succ)⁻¹ from
      Fin.prod_univ_succ _]
    refine ((Fin.consEquiv fun _ => ℕ).hasSum_iff
      (f := fun α : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ => ∏ i, q i ^ α i)).mp ?_
    have hfe : ((fun α : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ => ∏ i, q i ^ α i) ∘
        (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => ℕ)) =
        fun x : ℕ × (Fin n → ℕ) => q 0 ^ x.1 * ∏ j, q j.succ ^ x.2 j := by
      funext x
      show (∏ i, q i ^ (Fin.cons x.1 x.2 : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) i) = _
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
      exact congrArg (q 0 ^ x.1 * ·) (Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [Fin.cons_succ])
    rw [hfe]
    exact H

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasSum_cauchyKernel
statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchyKernel {c z w : Fin n → ℂ}
    (h : ∀ i, ‖z i - c i‖ < ‖w i - c i‖) :
    HasSum
      (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
        (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) * ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹)
      (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ∀ i, w i - c i ≠ 0 := fun i =>
    norm_pos_iff.mp ((norm_nonneg _).trans_lt (h i))
  have hq : ∀ i, ‖(z i - c i) / (w i - c i)‖ < 1 := fun i => by
    rw [norm_div]
    exact (div_lt_one ((norm_nonneg _).trans_lt (h i))).mpr (h i)
  have H := (hasSum_prod_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq).mul_right (∏ i, (w i - c i)⁻¹)
  have hfun : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      (∏ i, ((z i - c i) / (w i - c i)) ^ α i) * ∏ i, (w i - c i)⁻¹) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
        (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) * ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ := by
    funext α
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, ← pow_succ]
  have hval : (∏ i, (1 - (z i - c i) / (w i - c i))⁻¹) * ∏ i, (w i - c i)⁻¹ =
      ∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← mul_inv]
    congr 1
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hw i)]
    ring
  rw [hfun, hval] at H
  exact H

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.isCompact_closedPolydisc
statement:
theorem isCompact_closedPolydisc (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) :
    IsCompact (closedPolydisc c R)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_univ_pi fun i => isCompact_closedBall (c i) (R i)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegrable_pow_kernel_smul
statement:
theorem torusIntegrable_pow_kernel_smul {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ}
    {R : Fin n → ℝ} (hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R)) (k : ℂ) (α : Fin n → ℕ) :
    TorusIntegrable (fun w => (k * ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) c R
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n), torusMap c R θ i - c i ≠ 0 := fun θ i =>
    norm_pos_iff.mp
      (by rw [norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]; exact hR i)
  have hker : Continuous fun θ : Fin n → ℝ =>
      k * ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ := by
    refine continuous_const.mul (continuous_finsetProd _ fun i _ => ?_)
    refine Continuous.inv₀ ?_ fun θ => pow_ne_zero _ (hne θ i)
    exact (((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_torusMap c R)).sub continuous_const).pow _
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => f (torusMap c R θ))
      (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi) :=
    hf.comp (continuous_torusMap c R).continuousOn
      fun θ _ => torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc (fun i => (hR i).le) θ
  exact (hker.continuousOn.smul hfc).integrableOn_Icc

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.norm_two_pi_I
statement: theorem norm_two_pi_I : ‖2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have h : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.norm_cauchyCoeff_le
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0)
  have hkernel : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ,
      ‖∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹‖ =
        (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ := by
    intro θ
    rw [Complex.norm_prod, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [norm_inv, norm_pow, norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]
  have hbound : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ,
      ‖(∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤
        (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ * M := by
    intro θ
    rw [norm_smul, hkernel θ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM θ)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hR i).le _))
  have hint := norm_torusIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (f := fun w => (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) (c := c) (R := R) hbound
  have h2π : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ n := pow_pos Real.two_pi_pos n
  have hPR : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => hR i
  have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i ^ α i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => pow_pos (hR i) _
  have habs : (∏ i, |R i|) = ∏ i, R i :=
    Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => abs_of_pos (hR i)
  have hsplit : (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1)) = (∏ i, R i ^ α i) * ∏ i, R i := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => pow_succ _ _
  have hnorm2πn : ‖(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n‖ = (2 * Real.pi) ^ n := by
    rw [norm_pow, norm_two_pi_I]
  rw [cauchyCoeff, norm_smul, norm_inv, hnorm2πn]
  calc ((2 * Real.pi) ^ n)⁻¹ *
        ‖∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w‖ ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi) ^ n)⁻¹ *
        (((2 * Real.pi) ^ n * ∏ i, |R i|) * ((∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ * M)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint (inv_nonneg.mpr h2π.le)
    _ = M / ∏ i, R i ^ α i := by
        rw [habs, hsplit]
        field_simp

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul
statement:
theorem hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedPolydisc c R)) (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R) :
    HasSum
      (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w)
      ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i := fun i =>
    dist_nonneg.trans_lt (mem_ball.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedPolydisc c R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf.continuousOn
  have hMt : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ, ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤ M := fun θ =>
    hM _ (torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc (fun i => (hR i).le) θ)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hMt 0)
  have hzn : ∀ i, ‖z i - c i‖ < R i := fun i =>
    mem_ball_iff_norm.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)
  
  have hGint : ∀ α : Fin n → ℕ,
      TorusIntegrable (fun w =>
        ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) * ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) c R :=
    fun α => torusIntegrable_pow_kernel_smul hR hf.continuousOn _ α
  have hFint : ∀ α : Fin n → ℕ,
      Integrable (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ =>
        (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)) :=
    fun α => (hGint α).function_integrable
  
  have hptwise : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ,
      HasSum
        (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
          (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
              ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        ((∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))) := by
    intro θ
    have hlt : ∀ i, ‖z i - c i‖ < ‖torusMap c R θ i - c i‖ := fun i => by
      rw [norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]
      exact hzn i
    exact ((hasSum_cauchyKernel hlt).smul_const (f (torusMap c R θ))).const_smul _
  
  have hqs : Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ n * M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i :=
    (summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one
      (fun i => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hR i).le)
      fun i => (div_lt_one (hR i)).mpr (hzn i)).mul_left _
  have hFsum : Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      ∫ θ, ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)) := by
    have hIcc : (volume (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi)).toReal =
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ n := by
      rw [Real.volume_Icc_pi_toReal (a := (0 : Fin n → ℝ))
        (Pi.le_def.mpr fun _ => Real.two_pi_pos.le)]
      simp
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun α => integral_nonneg fun θ => norm_nonneg _) (fun α => ?_) hqs
    have hsplit : (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1)) = (∏ i, R i ^ α i) * ∏ i, R i := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => pow_succ _ _
    have hPR : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => hR i
    have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, R i ^ α i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => pow_pos (hR i) _
    have hpt : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi,
        ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖ ≤
          M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
      intro θ _
      have hjac : ‖∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I‖ =
          ∏ i, R i := by
        rw [Complex.norm_prod]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, Complex.norm_I,
          mul_one, mul_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (hR i).le]
      have hker : ‖(∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹‖ =
          (∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_prod, Complex.norm_prod]
        congr 1
        · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => norm_pow _ _
        · rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [norm_inv, norm_pow, norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i).le]
      have hA : (∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i) =
          (∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) / ∏ i, R i ^ α i := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_div_distrib]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => div_pow _ _ _
      calc ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
              ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖ =
          (∏ i, R i) * (((∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) *
            ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖) := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, hjac, hker]
        _ ≤ (∏ i, R i) * (((∏ i, ‖z i - c i‖ ^ α i) * (∏ i, R i ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) * M) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hMt θ) ?_) hPR.le
            exact mul_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hR i).le _))
        _ = M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
            rw [hA, hsplit]
            field_simp
    calc (∫ θ, ‖(∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))‖
          ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) ≤
        ∫ _ in Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi,
          (M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i) ∂volume := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on ((hFint α).norm) ?_ measurableSet_Icc hpt
          exact integrableOn_const measure_Icc_lt_top.ne
      _ = (2 * Real.pi) ^ n * M * ∏ i, (‖z i - c i‖ / R i) ^ α i := by
          rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, hIcc]
          ring
  
  have hswap := MeasureTheory.hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm hFint hFsum
  
  have hval : (∫ θ, (∑' α : Fin n → ℕ,
      (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
      ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z := by
    have h1 : (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => ∑' α : Fin n → ℕ,
        (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
          (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
            ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))) =
        fun θ : Fin n → ℝ =>
          (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
            ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)) :=
      funext fun θ => (hptwise θ).tsum_eq
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : (∫ θ, ((∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        ((∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ)))
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w := rfl
    rw [h2, torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul hf hz]
  rw [hval] at hswap
  
  have hterm : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∫ θ,
      (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))
      ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w := by
    funext α
    have h3 : (∫ θ, (∏ i, (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I) •
        (((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((torusMap c R θ i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f (torusMap c R θ))
        ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi))) =
        ∯ w in T(c, R), ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
          ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w := rfl
    rw [h3]
    have h4 : (fun w : Fin n → ℂ => ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) *
        ∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) =
        fun w : Fin n → ℂ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
          ((∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w) :=
      funext fun w => mul_smul _ _ _
    rw [h4]
    exact torusIntegral_smul _ _ _ _
  rw [hterm] at hswap
  exact hswap

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul
proof:
:= by
  have H := (hasSum_torusIntegral_pow_kernel_smul hf hz).const_smul
    (((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n)⁻¹ : ℂ)
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (two_pi_I_pow_ne_zero n)] at H
  have hfun : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n)⁻¹ •
      ((∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) •
        ∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, ((w i - c i) ^ (α i + 1))⁻¹) • f w)) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, (z i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α :=
    funext fun α => smul_comm _ _ _
  rw [hfun] at H
  exact H

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.monomialCM_apply_diag
statement:
theorem monomialCM_apply_diag (α : Fin n → ℕ) (e : E) (y : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (monomialCM α e fun _ => y) = (∏ i, y i ^ α i) • e
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomialCM, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiRing_apply]
  congr 1
  calc (∏ j : Fin (∑ i, α i),
        ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℂ) (φ := fun _ : Fin n => ℂ)
          (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm j).1 y) =
      ∏ j : Fin (∑ i, α i), y (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm j).1 :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => rfl
    _ = ∏ s : (i : Fin n) × Fin (α i), y (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm (finSigmaFinEquiv s)).1 :=
        (Equiv.prod_comp finSigmaFinEquiv
          fun j => y (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm j).1).symm
    _ = ∏ s : (i : Fin n) × Fin (α i), y s.1 := by
        simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ = ∏ i, ∏ _k : Fin (α i), y i := Fintype.prod_sigma _
    _ = ∏ i, y i ^ α i := by
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.norm_monomialCM_le
statement: theorem norm_monomialCM_le (α : Fin n → ℕ) (e : E) : ‖monomialCM α e‖ ≤ ‖e‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_mkPiRing]
  have hproj : ∀ j : Fin (∑ i, α i),
      ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℂ) (φ := fun _ : Fin n => ℂ)
        (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm j).1)‖ ≤ 1 := fun j =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun x => by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, one_mul]
      exact norm_le_pi_norm x _
  calc ‖e‖ * ∏ j, ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℂ) (φ := fun _ : Fin n => ℂ)
        (finSigmaFinEquiv.symm j).1)‖ ≤ ‖e‖ * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Finset.prod_le_one (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) fun j _ => hproj j)
        (norm_nonneg e)
    _ = ‖e‖ := mul_one _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.polydiscSeries_apply_diag
statement:
theorem polydiscSeries_apply_diag (f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E) (c : Fin n → ℂ)
    (R : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (y : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (polydiscSeries f c R m fun _ => y) =
      ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m).attach,
        (∏ i, y i ^ a.1 i) • cauchyCoeff f c R a.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [polydiscSeries, ContinuousMultilinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply]
  exact monomialCM_apply_diag _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasSum_polydiscSeries_fiber
statement:
theorem hasSum_polydiscSeries_fiber (f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E) (c : Fin n → ℂ)
    (R : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (y : Fin n → ℂ) :
    HasSum
      (fun x : {a : Fin n → ℕ // (∑ i, a i) = m} =>
        (∏ i, y i ^ x.1 i) • cauchyCoeff f c R x.1)
      (polydiscSeries f c R m fun _ => y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hasSum_fintype
    (fun x : {x // x ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m} =>
      (∏ i, y i ^ x.1 i) • cauchyCoeff f c R x.1)
  rw [Finset.univ_eq_attach, ← polydiscSeries_apply_diag] at h1
  exact ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
    fun a : Fin n → ℕ => Finset.Nat.mem_antidiagonalTuple).hasSum_iff).mp h1

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.le_radius_polydiscSeries
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0)
  have hq0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) / R i := fun i => div_nonneg r.coe_nonneg (hR i).le
  have hq1 : ∀ i, (r : ℝ) / R i < 1 := fun i => (div_lt_one (hR i)).mpr (hrR i)
  have hsum : Summable fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ α i :=
    summable_prod_pow_of_lt_one hq0 hq1
  refine (polydiscSeries f c R).le_radius_of_bound
    (M * ∑' α : Fin n → ℕ, ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ α i) fun m => ?_
  have h1 : ‖polydiscSeries f c R m‖ ≤
      ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m).attach, M / ∏ i, R i ^ a.1 i := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_domDomCongr]
    exact (norm_monomialCM_le _ _).trans (norm_cauchyCoeff_le hR hM a.1)
  calc ‖polydiscSeries f c R m‖ * (r : ℝ) ^ m ≤
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m).attach, M / ∏ i, R i ^ a.1 i) *
        (r : ℝ) ^ m :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (pow_nonneg r.coe_nonneg m)
    _ = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m).attach,
          M * ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ a.1 i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        have hα : (∑ i, a.1 i) = m := Finset.Nat.mem_antidiagonalTuple.mp a.2
        have hrm : (r : ℝ) ^ m = ∏ i, (r : ℝ) ^ a.1 i := by
          rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, hα]
        rw [hrm, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc]
        congr 1
        rw [← Finset.prod_div_distrib]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (div_pow _ _ _).symm
    _ = M * ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m).attach,
          ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ a.1 i := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ M * ∑' α : Fin n → ℕ, ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ α i := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hM0
        rw [Finset.sum_attach (Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple n m)
          fun α => ∏ i, ((r : ℝ) / R i) ^ α i]
        exact hsum.sum_le_tsum _ fun α _ =>
          Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hq0 i) _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries
statement:
theorem hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedPolydisc c R)) {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hrR : ∀ i, (r : ℝ) < R i) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f (polydiscSeries f c R) c r
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i := fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt r.coe_nonneg (hrR i)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedPolydisc c R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf.continuousOn
  have hMt : ∀ θ : Fin n → ℝ, ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤ M := fun θ =>
    hM _ (torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc (fun i => (hR i).le) θ)
  refine ⟨le_radius_polydiscSeries hR hMt hrR, ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr hr, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hy' : ∀ i, ‖y i‖ < R i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ‖y‖ₑ < (r : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right] at hy
    have h2 : ‖y‖ < (r : ℝ) := by
      have := enorm_lt_coe.mp h1
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact lt_trans (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_le_pi_norm y i) h2) (hrR i)
  have hcy : c + y ∈ polydisc c R := mem_polydisc.2 fun i => by
    rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
    simpa using hy' i
  have H := hasSum_cauchyCoeff_smul hf hcy
  have hyc : (fun α : Fin n → ℕ =>
      (∏ i, ((c + y) i - c i) ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α) =
      fun α : Fin n → ℕ => (∏ i, y i ^ α i) • cauchyCoeff f c R α := by
    funext α
    congr 1
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp
  rw [hyc] at H
  exact ((Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv fun α : Fin n → ℕ => ∑ i, α i).hasSum_iff.mpr H).sigma
    fun m => hasSum_polydiscSeries_fiber f c R m y

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_closedPolydisc
statement:
theorem analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_closedPolydisc [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedPolydisc c R)) (hR : ∀ i, 0 < R i) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ f c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεR⟩ := Pi.exists_forall_pos_add_lt (x := fun _ : Fin n => (0 : ℝ))
    (y := R) hR
  have hεR' : ∀ i, ε < R i := fun i => by simpa using hεR i
  exact (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_polydiscSeries hf (r := ε.toNNReal)
    (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hε0)
    fun i => by rw [Real.coe_toNNReal ε hε0.le]; exact hεR' i).analyticAt

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.analyticAt_of_mem_polydisc
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : closedPolydisc z (fun i => R i - dist (z i) (c i)) ⊆
      closedPolydisc c R := by
    intro w hw
    refine mem_closedPolydisc.2 fun i => ?_
    have h1 : dist (w i) (z i) ≤ R i - dist (z i) (c i) :=
      mem_closedBall.1 (mem_closedPolydisc.1 hw i)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (w i) (z i) (c i)
    exact mem_closedBall.2 (by linarith)
  exact analyticAt_of_differentiableOn_closedPolydisc (hf.mono hsub)
    fun i => sub_pos.2 (mem_ball.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.analyticOnNhd_polydisc
proof:
:= fun _ hz =>
  analyticAt_of_mem_polydisc hf hz

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.extReanchorLeft_comp_mk₀
statement:
theorem extReanchorLeft_comp_mk₀ {Z Z' F G : A} (α : Z ≅ Z') (τ : F ⟶ G)
    (n : ℕ) (y : Ext Z F n) :
    (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft α n y).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n) =
      CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft α n (y.comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n))
proof:
:= by
  show ((Ext.mk₀ α.inv).comp y (zero_add n)).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n) =
    (Ext.mk₀ α.inv).comp (y.comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n)) (zero_add n)
  exact Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero _ _ _ (zero_add n)

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.mvδ_comp_mk₀
statement:
theorem mvδ_comp_mk₀ (S : J.MayerVietorisSquare)
    {F G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (τ : F ⟶ G) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ)
    (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J S.toSquare.X₁) F n₀) :
    (S.δ F n₀ n₁ h x).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n₁) =
      S.δ G n₀ n₁ h (x.comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n₀))
proof:
:= by
  show (S.shortComplex_shortExact.extClass.comp x (by omega)).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n₁) =
    S.shortComplex_shortExact.extClass.comp
      (x.comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero n₀)) (by omega)
  exact Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero _ _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.h0SectionsEquiv_symm_comp_mk₀
statement:
theorem h0SectionsEquiv_symm_comp_mk₀ {F G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (τ : F ⟶ G) (U : C) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    ((h0SectionsEquiv F U).symm s).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ) (add_zero 0) =
      (h0SectionsEquiv G U).symm (τ.hom.app (op U) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply]
  rw [show ((Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U s)).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ)
      (add_zero 0)) = Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U s ≫ τ) from
    Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀ _ _]
  rw [GradedEdgeProof.sheafHomOfSection_comp]

theorem officialJunctionEvaluation_iff_bettiCarrier :

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.scale_toComplexCoeffs_eq_H_map
statement:
theorem scale_toComplexCoeffs_eq_H_map (x : bettiQ anP1 2) :

      (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) 2 x) =
    Sheaf.H.map twistedCoeffSheafHom 2 x
proof:
:= by
  show Sheaf.H.map
      ((constantSheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map
        JunctionEvaluation.twoPiCoeffHom.{0}) 2
      (Sheaf.H.map
        ((constantSheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map Betti.coeffHom.{0}) 2 x) = _

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.H_map_twistedCoeff_bettiEdgeClass
statement:
theorem H_map_twistedCoeff_bettiEdgeClass :
    Sheaf.H.map twistedCoeffSheafHom 2 PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass =
      bettiEdgeClassC
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : mixH0.comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 0) = mixH0C :=
    h0SectionsEquiv_symm_comp_mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom (W0 ⊓ W1) mixSection
  have h1 : edgeOneRaw.comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 1) =
      edgeOneRawC := by
    refine (mvδ_comp_mk₀ (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1)
      twistedCoeffSheafHom 0 1 rfl mixH0).trans ?_
    exact congrArg
      (fun t => (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).δ FcAn 0 1 rfl t) h0
  have h2 : edgeOne.comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 1) =
      edgeOneC := by
    refine (extReanchorLeft_comp_mk₀
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) W0_sup_W1))
      twistedCoeffSheafHom 1 edgeOneRaw).trans ?_
    exact congrArg
      (fun t => CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
        (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) W0_sup_W1)) 1 t) h1
  have h3 : edgeTwoRaw.comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 2) =
      edgeTwoRawC := by
    refine (mvδ_comp_mk₀ (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1)
      twistedCoeffSheafHom 1 2 rfl edgeOne).trans ?_
    exact congrArg
      (fun t => (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare V0 V1).δ FcAn 1 2 rfl t) h2
  have h4 : edgeTwo.comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 2) =
      edgeTwoC := by
    refine (extReanchorLeft_comp_mk₀
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) V0_sup_V1))
      twistedCoeffSheafHom 2 edgeTwoRaw).trans ?_
    exact congrArg
      (fun t => CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
        (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JAn) V0_sup_V1)) 2 t) h3
  show (hPrimeTopEquivH (⊤ : Opens ↑anP1) (opensTopTerminal anP1) FqAn 2
      edgeTwo).comp (Ext.mk₀ twistedCoeffSheafHom) (add_zero 2) =
    bettiEdgeClassC
  refine (extReanchorLeft_comp_mk₀
    (freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JAn) (⊤ : Opens ↑anP1)
      (opensTopTerminal anP1)) twistedCoeffSheafHom 2 edgeTwo).trans ?_
  exact congrArg
    (fun t => CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
      (freeYonedaTopSheafIso (J := JAn) (⊤ : Opens ↑anP1)
        (opensTopTerminal anP1)) 2 t) h4

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.officialTarget_eq_edgeC
statement:
theorem officialTarget_eq_edgeC :
    analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1)
      (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
        (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
          PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)) =
    sheafHyperHMap JAn (zConstSheaf JAn)
      (augmentSingleCharts ProjectiveLine.structMor 1) ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (sheafHyperHSingleEquiv JAn FcAn 2 bettiEdgeClassC)
proof:
:= by
  show analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 2
      (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) 2
        (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) 2
          PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)) = _
  rw [scale_toComplexCoeffs_eq_H_map, H_map_twistedCoeff_bettiEdgeClass]
  exact analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv_apply ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 2
    bettiEdgeClassC

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.twistedCoeffSheafHom_constOne
statement:
theorem twistedCoeffSheafHom_constOne (W : Opens ↑anP1) :
    twistedCoeffSheafHom.hom.app (op W) (constOne W) =
      constC W JunctionEvaluation.twoPiI
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := (sheafificationAdjunction JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).unit.naturality
    ((Functor.const (Opens ↑anP1)ᵒᵖ).map
      (Betti.coeffHom.{0} ≫ JunctionEvaluation.twoPiCoeffHom.{0}))
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun (t : (Functor.const (Opens ↑anP1)ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℚ)) ⟶
        (presheafToSheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0} ⋙
          sheafToPresheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).obj
          ((Functor.const (Opens ↑anP1)ᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))) =>
      t.app (op W) (ULift.up (1 : ℚ))) hnat
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  refine Eq.trans h1.symm ?_
  show constC W (JunctionEvaluation.twoPiI * ((1 : ℚ) : ℂ)) =
    constC W JunctionEvaluation.twoPiI
  rw [Rat.cast_one, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.mixSectionC_restrict_up
statement:
theorem mixSectionC_restrict_up :
    FcAn.obj.map (homOfLE
        (le_sup_left.trans (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1.symm) :
          AUp ≤ W0 ⊓ W1)).op mixSectionC =
      constC AUp JunctionEvaluation.twoPiI
proof:
:= by
  have hle : AUp ≤ W0 ⊓ W1 := le_sup_left.trans (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1.symm)
  have hτ := congrArg (fun t => t mixSection)
    (twistedCoeffSheafHom.hom.naturality (homOfLE hle).op)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hτ
  refine Eq.trans hτ.symm ?_
  have hres : FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op mixSection = constOne AUp := by
    show FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op
      (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1)).op mixGlued) = _
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
    rw [show homOfLE hle ≫ homOfLE (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1) =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare AUp BLo).f₂₄ from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    exact mixGlued_restrict_left
  rw [hres]
  exact twistedCoeffSheafHom_constOne AUp

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.mixSectionC_restrict_lo
statement:

    FcAn.obj.map (homOfLE
        (le_sup_right.trans (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1.symm) :
          BLo ≤ W0 ⊓ W1)).op mixSectionC = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : BLo ≤ W0 ⊓ W1 := le_sup_right.trans (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1.symm)
  have hτ := congrArg (fun t => t mixSection)
    (twistedCoeffSheafHom.hom.naturality (homOfLE hle).op)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hτ
  refine Eq.trans hτ.symm ?_
  have hres : FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op mixSection = 0 := by
    show FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op
      (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1)).op mixGlued) = _
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
    rw [show homOfLE hle ≫ homOfLE (le_of_eq W0_inf_W1) =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare AUp BLo).f₃₄ from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    exact mixGlued_restrict_right
  rw [hres]
  exact map_zero _

name: HodgePilot.OfficialEvaluation.edgeRouteC_restriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem edgeRouteC_restriction_eq_zero
    (y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JAn W0) FcAn 0) :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).δ FcAn 0 1 rfl
      ((FcAn.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (FcAn.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op y =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod FcAn 0
        ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))) := by
    rw [(Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply
      FcAn y 0, map_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun (t : ((FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ⊞
        (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃) :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ⟶
        FcAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₄) =>
      t ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))))
    ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod_δ FcAn 0 1 rfl)
  refine h2.trans ?_
  show ((0 : _ ⟶ FcAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₄))
    ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FcAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))) = 0
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.mapStupidTruncF_eq
statement:
lemma mapStupidTruncF_eq (K : HomologicalComplex C c') (e : c.Embedding c')
    [e.IsTruncGE] {i : ι} {i' : ι'} (hi : e.f i = i') :
    mapStupidTruncF F K e i' =
      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c').map (ιStupidTrunc K e)).f i' ≫
        (((F.mapHomologicalComplex c').obj K).stupidTruncXIso e hi).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ k, e.f k = i' := ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hc : hex.choose = i := e.injective_f (hex.choose_spec.trans hi.symm)
  unfold mapStupidTruncF
  rw [dif_pos hex]
  subst hc
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.mapStupidTruncF_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mapStupidTruncF_eq_zero (K : HomologicalComplex C c') (e : c.Embedding c')
    [e.IsTruncGE] (i' : ι') (hi' : ∀ i, e.f i ≠ i') :
    mapStupidTruncF F K e i' = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapStupidTruncF
  rw [dif_neg (by rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; exact hi' i hi)]

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.mapStupidTrunc_f
statement:
lemma mapStupidTrunc_f (K : HomologicalComplex C c') (e : c.Embedding c')
    [e.IsTruncGE] (i' : ι') :

proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.mapStupidTrunc_ι
statement:
lemma mapStupidTrunc_ι (K : HomologicalComplex C c') (e : c.Embedding c')
    [e.IsTruncGE] :
    mapStupidTrunc F K e ≫ ιStupidTrunc ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c').obj K) e =
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex c').map (ιStupidTrunc K e)
proof:
:= by
  ext i'
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  by_cases hi' : ∃ i, e.f i = i'
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hi'
    rw [mapStupidTrunc_f, mapStupidTruncF_eq F K e hi,
      ιStupidTrunc_f ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c').obj K) e hi,
      Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [mapStupidTrunc_f, mapStupidTruncF_eq_zero F K e i' (fun i hi => hi' ⟨i, hi⟩),
      zero_comp]
    exact (Functor.map_isZero F
      (K.isZero_stupidTrunc_X e i' (fun i hi => hi' ⟨i, hi⟩))).eq_of_src _ _

      (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ιBrutalTruncGE K p)
proof:
:=
  mapStupidTrunc_ι F K (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p)

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.hyperHMapOf_apply
statement:
lemma hyperHMapOf_apply (Z : C) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) (x : hyperH Z K n) :
    hyperHMapOf F Z K n x =
      (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app Z ≫
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map x ≫
        (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
        (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) n).map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.hyperHMapOf_naturality
statement:
lemma hyperHMapOf_naturality (Z : C) {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (n : ℤ) (x : hyperH Z K n) :
    hyperHMapOf F Z L n (hyperHMap Z f n x) =
      hyperHMap (F.obj Z) ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f) n
        (hyperHMapOf F Z K n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hyperHMapOf_apply, hyperHMapOf_apply, hyperHMap_apply, hyperHMap_apply]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 2
  rw [Functor.commShiftIso_hom_naturality_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality]

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.hyperHMapOf_hodgeFiltration_le
statement:
lemma hyperHMapOf_hodgeFiltration_le (Z : C) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (p n : ℤ) :
    (hodgeFiltration Z K p n).map (hyperHMapOf F Z K n) ≤
      hodgeFiltration (F.obj Z)
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) p n
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_hodgeFiltration_iff Z K p n x).mp hx
  rw [mem_hodgeFiltration_iff]
  refine ⟨hyperHMap (F.obj Z) (mapBrutalTruncGE F K p) n
    (hyperHMapOf F Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n y), ?_⟩
  rw [← hyperHMap_comp, mapBrutalTruncGE_ι, ← hyperHMapOf_naturality, hy]

name: HodgePilot.HyperPullback.sheafPullback_hodgeFiltration_le

    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ℤ)
    (p n : ℤ) :
    (sheafHodgeFiltration (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Z K p n).map
        (sheafPullbackHyperHMap π Z K n) ≤
      sheafHodgeFiltration (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((sheafPullbackFunctor π).obj Z)
        (((sheafPullbackFunctor π).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) p n
proof:
:=
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  hyperHMapOf_hodgeFiltration_le (sheafPullbackFunctor π) Z K p n

name: HodgePilot.Hyper.stupidTrunc_d_stupidTruncXIso_hom
statement:
lemma stupidTrunc_d_stupidTruncXIso_hom (K : HomologicalComplex C c')
    (e : c.Embedding c') [e.IsRelIff]
    {i j : ι} {i' j' : ι'} (hi : e.f i = i') (hj : e.f j = j') :
    (K.stupidTrunc e).d i' j' ≫ (K.stupidTruncXIso e hj).hom =
      (K.stupidTruncXIso e hi).hom ≫ K.d i' j'
proof:
:= by
  subst hi hj
  simp [HomologicalComplex.stupidTrunc, HomologicalComplex.stupidTruncXIso,
    (K.restriction e).extend_d_eq e (rfl : e.f i = _) (rfl : e.f j = _)]
  rw [comp_eqToHom_iff, Category.assoc]
  exact (conj_eqToHom_iff_heq' _ _ _ _).2 HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.Hyper.stupidTrunc_d_eq
statement:
lemma stupidTrunc_d_eq (K : HomologicalComplex C c') (e : c.Embedding c') [e.IsRelIff]

    (K.stupidTrunc e).d i' j' =
      (K.stupidTruncXIso e hi).hom ≫ K.d i' j' ≫ (K.stupidTruncXIso e hj).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (K.stupidTruncXIso e hj).hom, assoc, assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, comp_id]
  exact stupidTrunc_d_stupidTruncXIso_hom K e hi hj

name: HodgePilot.Hyper.ιStupidTrunc_naturality
statement:

    hyperHSingleEquiv Z G n (x.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n)) =
      hyperHMap Z ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).map φ) (n : ℤ)
        (hyperHSingleEquiv Z F n x)
proof:
:= by
  change (x.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n)).hom = _
  rw [Abelian.Ext.comp_hom, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_hom, ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀]

      ∃ y : hyperH Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n, hyperHMap Z (ιBrutalTruncGE K p) n y = x
proof:

name: HodgePilot.Hyper.hyperH_exact₂
statement:
lemma hyperH_exact₂ (Z : C) {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (n : ℤ) (x : hyperH Z S.X₂ n) (hx : hyperHMap Z S.g n x = 0) :
    ∃ y : hyperH Z S.X₁ n, hyperHMap Z S.f n y = x
proof:
:= by
  have hT := Triangle.shift_distinguished _
    (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished hS) n
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ hT x (by
    have hx' : x ≫ (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.g) = 0 :=
      hx
    show x ≫ (n.negOnePow •
      ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.g))) = 0
    rw [Units.smul_def, Preadditive.comp_zsmul, hx', smul_zero])
  refine ⟨n.negOnePow • g, ?_⟩
  have e2 : g ≫ ((shiftFunctor (Triangle (DerivedCategory C)) n).obj
      (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hS)).mor₁ =
      (n.negOnePow : ℤ) • (g ≫ (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.f)) := by
    exact Preadditive.comp_zsmul _ _ _
  exact (map_zsmul (hyperHMap Z S.f n) _ g).trans (e2.symm.trans hg.symm)

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cdivMoveIn_apply
statement:
theorem cdivMoveIn_apply (x : CDiv X) :
    cdivMoveIn X x =
      x.mapExactFunctor
        (zSheafCarrierEquiv.{0} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).inverse
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cdivClass_moveIn
statement:
theorem cdivClass_moveIn (x : CDiv X) :
    (cdivClass X x).mapExactFunctor
        (zSheafCarrierEquiv.{0} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).inverse =
      (cdivMoveIn X x).comp (cartierδMod X) (zero_add 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdivClass_apply, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, cartierδMod_eq]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.tensorUnit_eq_constantSheaf
statement:
theorem tensorUnit_eq_constantSheaf :
    (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ))) =
      (constantSheaf J (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cdivSiteAgreement
statement: theorem cdivSiteAgreement : CDivSiteAgreement X

:=
  ⟨cdivSiteEquiv X⟩

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cartierδAffine_eq_siteMove
statement:
theorem cartierδAffine_eq_siteMove :
    (cartierδ X).mapExactFunctor (siteToSpaceEquiv X).symm.functor =
      cartierδAffine X
proof:
:=
  Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass _ _

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cdivClass_siteMove
statement:
theorem cdivClass_siteMove (x : CDiv X) :
    cdivClassAffine X (cdivSiteEquiv X x) = unitsHSiteEquiv X 1 (cdivClass X x)
proof:
:= by
  show ((Ext.mk₀ (zConstSiteAnchorIso X).inv).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor (siteToSpaceEquiv X).symm.functor) (zero_add 0)).comp
      (cartierδAffine X) (zero_add 1) =
    (Ext.mk₀ (zConstSiteAnchorIso X).inv).comp
      ((cdivClass X x).mapExactFunctor (siteToSpaceEquiv X).symm.functor)
      (zero_add 1)
  rw [cdivClass_apply, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, ← cartierδAffine_eq_siteMove]
  exact Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero _ _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.CycCarrier.cdivCycleClass_siteMove
statement:
theorem cdivCycleClass_siteMove {R : Type v} [CommRing R] (φ : R →+* Γ(X, ⊤))
    (x : CDiv X) :
    cdivCycleClass X φ (cdivSiteEquiv X x) =
      CycleClassOne.chernOneF φ (unitsHSiteEquiv X 1 (cdivClass X x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdivCycleClass_apply, cdivClass_siteMove]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.comp_terminalMap
statement:
lemma comp_terminalMap {V U : TopCat.{0}} (f : V ⟶ U) :
    f ≫ terminalMap U = terminalMap V
proof:
:=
  TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => rfl)

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.terminalMap_pointSpace
statement: lemma terminalMap_pointSpace : terminalMap pointSpace = 𝟙 pointSpace
proof:
:=
  TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => rfl)

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.pointModuleSum_ne_zero
statement: lemma pointModuleSum_ne_zero : pointModuleSum ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrArg dualPointModuleEquiv h
  rw [show dualPointModuleEquiv pointModuleSum = 1 from
    dualPointModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply 1, map_zero] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.d_one_zero_pointChains
statement: lemma d_one_zero_pointChains : (chainsFunctor.obj pointSpace).d 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have halt : (ChainComplex.alternatingConst.obj pointModule).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    simp [ChainComplex.alternatingConst, HomologicalComplex.alternatingConst]
    rfl
  have h := pointChainsIso.hom.comm 1 0
  rw [halt, comp_zero] at h
  haveI : IsIso (pointChainsIso.hom.f 0) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (IsIso ((HomologicalComplex.eval QMod (ComplexShape.down ℕ) 0).mapIso pointChainsIso).hom)
  rw [← cancel_mono (pointChainsIso.hom.f 0), zero_comp]
  exact h.symm

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.pointUnitCochainHom_ne_zero
statement: lemma pointUnitCochainHom_ne_zero : pointUnitCochainHom ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply pointModuleSum_ne_zero
  have h3 : pointChainsIso.inv.f 0 ≫ pointChainsIso.hom.f 0 ≫ pointModuleSum = 0 := by
    rw [show pointChainsIso.hom.f 0 ≫ pointModuleSum = pointUnitCochainHom from rfl, h,
      comp_zero]
  rwa [← Category.assoc, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    HomologicalComplex.id_f, Category.id_comp] at h3

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.unitCochainHom_comp
statement:
lemma unitCochainHom_comp {V U : TopCat.{0}} (f : V ⟶ U) :
    (chainsFunctor.map f).f 0 ≫ unitCochainHom U = unitCochainHom V
proof:
:= by
  show (chainsFunctor.map f).f 0 ≫ (chainsFunctor.map (terminalMap U)).f 0 ≫ pointUnitCochainHom
      = (chainsFunctor.map (terminalMap V)).f 0 ≫ pointUnitCochainHom
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, ← Functor.map_comp, comp_terminalMap]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.d_comp_unitCochainHom
statement:
lemma d_comp_unitCochainHom (U : TopCat.{0}) :
    (chainsFunctor.obj U).d 1 0 ≫ unitCochainHom U = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (chainsFunctor.obj U).d 1 0 ≫ (chainsFunctor.map (terminalMap U)).f 0 ≫ pointUnitCochainHom = 0
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← (chainsFunctor.map (terminalMap U)).comm 1 0, Category.assoc,
    show (chainsFunctor.obj pointSpace).d 1 0 ≫ pointUnitCochainHom
      = (0 : _ ⟶ _) ≫ pointUnitCochainHom from by rw [d_one_zero_pointChains],
    zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.unitCochainHom_ne_zero
statement: lemma unitCochainHom_ne_zero (U : TopCat.{0}) (u : ↑U) : unitCochainHom U ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hincl : (chainsFunctor.map (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun _ => u, continuous_const⟩ :
      pointSpace ⟶ U)).f 0 ≫ unitCochainHom U = unitCochainHom pointSpace :=
    unitCochainHom_comp _
  rw [h, comp_zero] at hincl
  apply pointUnitCochainHom_ne_zero
  have hpt : unitCochainHom pointSpace = pointUnitCochainHom := by
    show (chainsFunctor.map (terminalMap pointSpace)).f 0 ≫ pointUnitCochainHom
        = pointUnitCochainHom
    rw [terminalMap_pointSpace, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, HomologicalComplex.id_f,
      Category.id_comp]
  rw [← hpt, ← hincl]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.eq_zero_of_smul_unitCochainHom
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_smul_unitCochainHom (U : TopCat.{0}) (u : ↑U) {q : ℚ}
    (h : q • unitCochainHom U = 0) : q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hq
  apply unitCochainHom_ne_zero U u
  have h2 := congrArg (fun g => q⁻¹ • g) h
  simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq] using h2

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.smulUnitSection_zero
statement: lemma smulUnitSection_zero (X : TopCat.{0}) (U : Opens X) : smulUnitSection X U 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  zero_smul ℚ (unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.smulUnitSection_add
statement:
lemma smulUnitSection_add (X : TopCat.{0}) (U : Opens X) (a b : ℚ) :
    smulUnitSection X U (a + b) = smulUnitSection X U a + smulUnitSection X U b
proof:
:=
  add_smul a b (unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.unitCochain_map
statement:
lemma unitCochain_map {V U : TopCat.{0}} (f : V ⟶ U) :
    (singularCochainFunctor.map f.op).f 0 (unitCochainHom U) = unitCochainHom V
proof:
:=
  unitCochainHom_comp f

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.presheafRes_smulUnitSection
statement:
lemma presheafRes_smulUnitSection (X : TopCat.{0}) {U V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) (q : ℚ) :
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map i (smulUnitSection X (unop U) q)
      = smulUnitSection X (unop V) q
proof:
:= by
  show (singularCochainFunctor.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map i.unop).op).f 0
      (q • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U)))
      = q • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop V))
  rw [map_smul]
  congr 1
  exact unitCochain_map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map i.unop)

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.augmentationPresheaf_comp_d
statement:
lemma augmentationPresheaf_comp_d (X : TopCat.{0}) :
    augmentationPresheaf X ≫ (singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext U q
  show ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1).app (op U) ((augmentationPresheaf X).app (op U) q) = 0
  show (singularCochainFunctor.obj (op ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))).d 0 1
      (q.down • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) = 0
  rw [map_smul]
  have hd : (singularCochainFunctor.obj (op ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))).d 0 1
      (unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
      = ((chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).d 1 0
        ≫ unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) := rfl
  rw [hd, d_comp_unitCochainHom, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.augmentationSheaf_comp_d
statement:
lemma augmentationSheaf_comp_d (X : TopCat.{0}) :
    augmentationSheaf X ≫ (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : augmentationSheaf X ≫ (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).d 0 1
      = (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat).map
        (augmentationPresheaf X ≫ (singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1) := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h, augmentationPresheaf_comp_d X, Functor.map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.exists_coboundary
statement:
lemma exists_coboundary (B : TopCat.{0}) [ContractibleSpace ↑B] (m : ℕ)
    (s : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).X (m + 1))
    (hs : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).d (m + 1) (m + 2) s = 0) :
    ∃ t : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).X m,
      (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).d m (m + 1) t = s
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ((singularCochainFunctor.obj (op B)).sc' m (m + 1) (m + 2)).Exact := by
    rw [← (singularCochainFunctor.obj (op B)).exactAt_iff' m (m + 1) (m + 2)
      (by simp) (by simp)]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
    exact isZero_singularCohomology_of_contractible B (m + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero m)
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at hex
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex s hs
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.exact_map_stalk_of_exact
statement:
lemma exact_map_stalk_of_exact (X : TopCat.{0}) (i j k : ℕ) (x : ↑X)
    (h : (((singularPresheafComplex X).sc' i j k).map
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact) :
    (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).sc' i j k).map
      (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{0} X ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X i)
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X j)
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X k)
  refine (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X i))))
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X j))))
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X k))))
    ?_ ?_)).mp h
  · show (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X i))
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).d i j))
        = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map ((singularPresheafComplex X).d i j)
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X j))
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← toSheafify_naturality]
  · show (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X j))
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).d j k))
        = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map ((singularPresheafComplex X).d j k)
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X k))
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← toSheafify_naturality]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.exactAt_sheafifiedCochainComplex
statement:
theorem exactAt_sheafifiedCochainComplex (X : TopCat.{0})
    [StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace ↑X] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).ExactAt n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
  rw [(sheafifiedCochainComplex X).exactAt_iff' m (m + 1) (m + 2) (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  refine exact_map_stalk_of_exact X m (m + 1) (m + 2) x ?_
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 1)) z
  have hz' : ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).d (m + 1) (m + 2)))
      (((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 1)).germ U x hxU s) = 0 := hz
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hz'
  
  have h0 : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 2)).germ U x hxU
      (((singularPresheafComplex X).d (m + 1) (m + 2)).app (op U) s) =
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 2)).germ U x hxU 0 := by
    rw [hz']; simp
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWU, iWU', hres⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq _ x hxU hxU _ _ h0
  set sW := ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 1)).map iWU.op s with hsW
  have hdW : ((singularPresheafComplex X).d (m + 1) (m + 2)).app (op W) sW = 0 := by
    rw [hsW, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).d (m + 1) (m + 2)).naturality iWU.op,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hres]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨hBmem, hBcontr⟩, hBW⟩ :=
    (contractible_basis (x : ↑X)).mem_iff.mp (W.isOpen.mem_nhds hxW)
  obtain ⟨O, hOB, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hBmem
  haveI := hBcontr
  let Wsp := (Opens.toTopCat X).obj W
  let bT : TopCat.{0} := TopCat.of ↥B
  let OW : Opens X := ⟨O, hOopen⟩
  have hOle : OW ⟶ W := homOfLE fun a ha => hBW (hOB ha)
  let ιBW : bT ⟶ Wsp := TopCat.ofHom ⟨Set.inclusion hBW, continuous_inclusion hBW⟩
  let ιOB : (Opens.toTopCat X).obj OW ⟶ bT :=
    TopCat.ofHom ⟨Set.inclusion hOB, continuous_inclusion hOB⟩
  have hglue : (Opens.toTopCat X).map hOle = ιOB ≫ ιBW :=
    TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun a => Subtype.ext rfl)
  
  set sB := (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).f (m + 1) sW with hsB
  have hsBzero : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op bT)).d (m + 1) (m + 2) sB = 0 := by
    rw [hsB, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).comm (m + 1) (m + 2),
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    have hbridge : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op Wsp)).d (m + 1) (m + 2) sW = 0 := hdW
    rw [hbridge]
    simp
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_coboundary bT m sB hsBzero
  
  refine ⟨((singularPresheafComplex X).X m).germ OW x hxO
    ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιOB.op).f m t), ?_⟩
  show ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).d m (m + 1)))
      (((singularPresheafComplex X).X m).germ OW x hxO
        ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιOB.op).f m t))
      = ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 1)).germ U x hxU s
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  have hcompute : ((singularPresheafComplex X).d m (m + 1)).app (op OW)
      ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιOB.op).f m t)
      = ((singularPresheafComplex X).X (m + 1)).map hOle.op sW := by
    show (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj OW))).d m (m + 1)
        ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιOB.op).f m t)
        = (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map hOle).op).f (m + 1) sW
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιOB.op).comm m (m + 1),
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ht, hsB, hglue,
      ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  rw [hcompute, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsW, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.stalkMap_augmentationPresheaf_injective
statement:
theorem stalkMap_augmentationPresheaf_injective (X : TopCat.{0}) (x : ↑X) :
    Function.Injective
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationPresheaf X))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, qa, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq _ a
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, qb, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq _ b
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hab
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWU, iWV, hres⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq _ x hxU hxV _ _ hab
  have hWa : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map iWU.op
      ((augmentationPresheaf X).app (op U) qa) = (augmentationPresheaf X).app (op W) qa := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← (augmentationPresheaf X).naturality iWU.op,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    congr 1
  have hWb : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map iWV.op
      ((augmentationPresheaf X).app (op V) qb) = (augmentationPresheaf X).app (op W) qb := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← (augmentationPresheaf X).naturality iWV.op,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    congr 1
  rw [hWa, hWb] at hres
  have h1 : (qa.down : ℚ) • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W)
      = (qb.down : ℚ) • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W) := hres
  have hq : qa = qb := by
    by_contra hne
    have hdown : qa.down - qb.down ≠ 0 := by
      intro hd
      exact hne (ULift.ext _ _ (sub_eq_zero.mp hd))
    apply unitCochainHom_ne_zero ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W) ⟨x, hxW⟩
    have h3 : (qa.down - qb.down) • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj W) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, h1, sub_self]
    have h4 := congrArg (fun g => (qa.down - qb.down)⁻¹ • g) h3
    simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdown] using h4
  rw [hq]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext _ W hxW iWU iWV rfl

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolution.stalk_augmentationSheaf_injective
statement:
theorem stalk_augmentationSheaf_injective (X : TopCat.{0}) (x : ↑X) :
    Function.Injective ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat X ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationSheaf X))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    (constQPresheaf X)
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0)
  have hsq : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X))
      ≫ (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat X ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationSheaf X)
      = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationPresheaf X)
      ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0)) := by
    show (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X))
      ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (augmentationPresheaf X)) = _
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← toSheafify_naturality]
  have hAB : ∀ y, ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat X ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationSheaf X))
        (((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X))) y)
      = ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0)))
        (((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationPresheaf X)) y) :=
    fun y =>
      ((ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ y).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun φ => (ConcreteCategory.hom φ) y) hsq)).trans
        (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ y)
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X)))).2 a
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X)))).2 b
  have hu2 := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0)))).1
  have hab2 := (hAB a').symm.trans (hab.trans (hAB b'))
  have hinj := stalkMap_augmentationPresheaf_injective X x (hu2 hab2)
  exact congrArg _ hinj

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.range_val_subset
statement:
theorem range_val_subset (p : SPoints sX) :
    Set.range ⇑p.1 ⊆ {toSpace sX p}
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hx : x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ :=
    Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum ℂ) x _
  rw [hx]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.range_probe
statement:
theorem range_probe (c : Chart sX) :
    Set.range (probe sX c.hom c.over) = toSpace sX ⁻¹' Set.range ⇑c.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    show toSpace sX (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) ∈ Set.range ⇑c.hom
    rw [toSpace_probe]
    exact ⟨toZariski φ, rfl⟩
  · intro p hp
    have hsub : Set.range ⇑p.1 ⊆ Set.range ⇑c.hom := fun y hy => by
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (range_val_subset sX p hy)]
      exact hp
    have hfac : IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom p.1 hsub ≫ c.hom = p.1 :=
      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac c.hom p.1 hsub
    have hover : IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom p.1 hsub ≫ Analytic.structMor c.A =
        𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← c.over, ← Category.assoc, hfac]
      exact p.2
    refine ⟨(bridge c.A).symm ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom p.1 hsub, hover⟩, ?_⟩
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show ((bridge c.A) ((bridge c.A).symm
      ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom p.1 hsub, hover⟩)).1 ≫ c.hom = p.1
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hfac

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.V0_sup_V1
statement: theorem V0_sup_V1 : V0 ⊔ V1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by

  have h : (U0 : Set p1) ∪ (U1 : Set p1) = Set.univ := by
    rw [← Opens.coe_sup, U0_sup_U1, Opens.coe_top]
  show ⇑(sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor) ⁻¹' (U0 : Set p1) ∪
      ⇑(sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor) ⁻¹' (U1 : Set p1) = Set.univ
  rw [← Set.preimage_union, h, Set.preimage_univ]

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.awayι_overlap_structMor
statement:
theorem awayι_overlap_structMor :
    Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) hX01 two_pos ≫
        ProjectiveLine.structMor =
      Analytic.structMor (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1))
proof:
:= by
  show Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) hX01 two_pos ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂ ≫ Spec.map gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1))))
  rw [Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.mem_slit_union
statement: theorem mem_slit_union {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) : z ∈ slit0 ∪ slit1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases him : z.im = 0
  · have hre : z.re ≠ 0 := fun h =>
      hz (Complex.ext_iff.mpr ⟨h.trans Complex.zero_re.symm,
        him.trans Complex.zero_im.symm⟩)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hre with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr him)

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.slit_inter
statement: theorem slit_inter : slit0 ∩ slit1 = upperSet ∪ lowerSet
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [slit0, slit1, upperSet, lowerSet, Set.mem_inter_iff,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h0 | h0, h1 | h1⟩
    · exact absurd (h1.trans h0) (lt_irrefl z.re)
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h1 with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl h
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h0 with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl h
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h0 with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl h
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (ne_of_gt h), Or.inr (ne_of_gt h)⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (ne_of_lt h), Or.inr (ne_of_lt h)⟩

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.upper_inter_lower
statement: theorem upper_inter_lower : upperSet ∩ lowerSet = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [upperSet, lowerSet, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
  intro h0 h1
  exact absurd (h0.trans h1) (lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ))

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.W0_sup_W1

  show prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit0) ∪ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit1) = _

    Set.eq_univ_of_forall
      (fun φ => Set.mem_preimage.mpr (mem_slit_union (evCoord_ne_zero φ))),
    Set.image_univ, range_prb]

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.W0_inf_W1

  show prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit0) ∩ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' slit1) =
    prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' upperSet) ∪ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' lowerSet)
  rw [← Set.image_inter prb_injective, ← Set.image_union,
    ← Set.preimage_inter, ← Set.preimage_union, slit_inter]

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.AUp_inf_BLo

  show prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' upperSet) ∩ prb '' (evCoord ⁻¹' lowerSet) = ∅
  rw [← Set.image_inter prb_injective, ← Set.preimage_inter,
    upper_inter_lower, Set.preimage_empty, Set.image_empty]

proof:

  intro x hx

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero
    (y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JAn W0) FqAn 0) :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).δ FqAn 0 1 rfl
      ((FqAn.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (FqAn.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op y =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod FqAn 0
        ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))) := by
    rw [(Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply
      FqAn y 0, map_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun (t : ((FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ⊞
        (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃) :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ⟶
        FqAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₄) =>
      t ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))))
    ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).fromBiprod_δ FqAn 0 1 rfl)
  refine h2.trans ?_
  show ((0 : _ ⟶ FqAn.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₄))
    ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (FqAn.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).toSquare.X₃))) = 0
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.PredicateAcceptance.edgeRoute_constOne_eq_zero
statement:
theorem edgeRoute_constOne_eq_zero :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).δ FqAn 0 1 rfl
      ((h0SectionsEquiv FqAn (W0 ⊓ W1)).symm
        (FqAn.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op
          (constOne W0))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hres : (h0SectionsEquiv FqAn (W0 ⊓ W1)).symm
      (FqAn.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op (constOne W0)) =
    (FqAn.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare W0 W1).f₁₂).op
      ((h0SectionsEquiv FqAn W0).symm (constOne W0)) := by
    rw [h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply,
      cohomologyPresheaf_map_eq]
    exact mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_natural FqAn _ (constOne W0)
  rw [hres]
  exact edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero _
