name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of
statement:
theorem freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of {U : C} (s : P.obj (op U)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
    (g : V.unop ⟶ U) :
    (freeYonedaHomOfSection s).app V (FreeAbelianGroup.of g) = P.map g.op s
proof:
:=
  FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of _ _

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.freeYonedaHom_eq_ofSection
statement:
theorem freeYonedaHom_eq_ofSection {U : C} (φ : freeYonedaPresheaf U ⟶ P) :
    φ = freeYonedaHomOfSection (φ.app (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)))
proof:
:= by
  ext V : 2
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  refine FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ (fun g : V.unop ⟶ U => ?_)
  have hn : φ.app V ((freeYonedaPresheaf U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))) =
      P.map (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U))
        (φ.app (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))) :=
    congrArg
      (fun (h : (freeYonedaPresheaf U).obj (op U) ⟶ P.obj V) =>
        h (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)))
      (φ.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U) : op U ⟶ V))
  have h1 : (freeYonedaPresheaf U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of g := by
    show FreeAbelianGroup.map ((yoneda.obj U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (g : V.unop ⟶ U)))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of g
    rw [FreeAbelianGroup.map_of_apply]
    show FreeAbelianGroup.of (g ≫ 𝟙 U) = FreeAbelianGroup.of g
    rw [Category.comp_id]
  show φ.app V (FreeAbelianGroup.of g) =
    (freeYonedaHomOfSection (φ.app (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)))).app V
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of g)
  rw [freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of]
  exact (congrArg (fun z => φ.app V z) h1).symm.trans hn

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0ToSections_def
statement:
theorem h0ToSections_def (U : C) (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F 0) :
    h0ToSections F U x =
      (((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F) (Ext.addEquiv₀ x)).app (op U)
        (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.addEquiv₀_mk₀
statement:
theorem addEquiv₀_mk₀ {X Y : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Ext.addEquiv₀ (Ext.mk₀ f) = f
proof:
:=
  (Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).injective (Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0ToSections_sheafHomOfSection
statement:
theorem h0ToSections_sheafHomOfSection (U : C) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    h0ToSections F U (Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U s)) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [h0ToSections_def, addEquiv₀_mk₀]
  show (((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
      (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F)
      (((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F).symm (freeYonedaHomOfSection s))).app (op U)
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) = s
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, freeYonedaHomOfSection_app_of]
  show F.obj.map ((𝟙 U).op) s = s
  rw [op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_h0ToSections
statement:
theorem mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_h0ToSections (U : C)
    (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F 0) :
    Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U (h0ToSections F U x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : sheafHomOfSection F U (h0ToSections F U x) = Ext.addEquiv₀ x := by
    apply ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
      (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F).injective
    show ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F)
        (((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
          (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F).symm
          (freeYonedaHomOfSection (h0ToSections F U x))) =
      ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F) (Ext.addEquiv₀ x)
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (freeYonedaHom_eq_ofSection _).symm
  rw [h1, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0ToSections_add
statement:
theorem h0ToSections_add (U : C) (x y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F 0) :
    h0ToSections F U (x + y) = h0ToSections F U x + h0ToSections F U y
proof:
:= by
  rw [h0ToSections_def, h0ToSections_def, h0ToSections_def, map_add,
    Adjunction.homAddEquiv_add]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0SectionsEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem h0SectionsEquiv_apply (U : C) (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F 0) :
    h0SectionsEquiv F U x = h0ToSections F U x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply (U : C) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    (h0SectionsEquiv F U).symm s = Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U s)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.h0ToSections_natural
statement:
theorem h0ToSections_natural {V U : C} (i : V ⟶ U)
    (x : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf J U) F 0) :
    F.obj.map i.op (h0ToSections F U x) =
      h0ToSections F V
        ((Ext.mk₀ (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i)).comp x (zero_add 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : Ext.addEquiv₀
      ((Ext.mk₀ (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i)).comp x (zero_add 0)) =
      freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i ≫ Ext.addEquiv₀ x := by
    apply (Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).injective
    rw [Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply, ← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]
  rw [h0ToSections_def, h0ToSections_def, hEq]
  have hnatL : ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        (freeYonedaPresheaf V) F) (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i ≫ Ext.addEquiv₀ x) =
      freeYonedaPresheafMap i ≫
        ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
          (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F) (Ext.addEquiv₀ x) :=
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left _ _ _
  rw [hnatL]
  set ψ : freeYonedaPresheaf U ⟶ (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F :=
    ((sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
      (freeYonedaPresheaf U) F) (Ext.addEquiv₀ x)
  have hn : ψ.app (op V) ((freeYonedaPresheaf U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (i : V ⟶ U))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))) =
      ((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F).map (Quiver.Hom.op (i : V ⟶ U))
        (ψ.app (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))) :=
    congrArg
      (fun (h : (freeYonedaPresheaf U).obj (op U) ⟶
          ((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F).obj (op V)) =>
        h (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)))
      (ψ.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (i : V ⟶ U) : op U ⟶ op V))
  have h1 : (freeYonedaPresheaf U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (i : V ⟶ U))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i := by
    show FreeAbelianGroup.map ((yoneda.obj U).map (Quiver.Hom.op (i : V ⟶ U)))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i
    rw [FreeAbelianGroup.map_of_apply]
    show FreeAbelianGroup.of (i ≫ 𝟙 U) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i
    rw [Category.comp_id]
  have hgen : (freeYonedaPresheafMap (C := C) i).app (op V)
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i := by
    show FreeAbelianGroup.map ((yoneda.map i).app (op V))
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V)) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i
    rw [FreeAbelianGroup.map_of_apply]
    show FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V ≫ i) = FreeAbelianGroup.of i
    rw [Category.id_comp]
  exact (hn.symm.trans (congrArg (fun z => ψ.app (op V) z) h1)).trans
    (congrArg (fun z => ψ.app (op V) z) hgen).symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_natural
statement:
theorem mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_natural {V U : C} (i : V ⟶ U) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F V (F.obj.map i.op s)) =
      (Ext.mk₀ (freeYonedaSheafMap (J := J) i)).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ (sheafHomOfSection F U s)) (zero_add 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (h0SectionsEquiv F V).injective
  rw [h0SectionsEquiv_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_apply,
    h0ToSections_sheafHomOfSection, ← h0ToSections_natural,
    h0ToSections_sheafHomOfSection]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.freeYonedaTopComponent_hom_of
statement:
theorem freeYonedaTopComponent_hom_of (V : C) (g : V ⟶ T) :
    (freeYonedaTopComponent T hT V).hom (FreeAbelianGroup.of g) =
      ULift.up (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  letI := uniqueHomToTerminal T hT V
  show AddEquiv.ulift.symm (FreeAbelianGroup.lift (fun _ => (1 : ℤ))
    (FreeAbelianGroup.of g)) = ULift.up (1 : ℤ)
  rw [FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.toSpecZero_appTop_res
statement:
theorem toSpecZero_appTop_res {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜₂ m) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0))).inv ≫ (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂).appTop ≫
        p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f ≤ ⊤)).op =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers f)) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ f hf hm ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers f))) :=
    Proj.awayι_toSpecZero 𝒜₂ f hf hm
  have h2 := congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop h1
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at h2
  have h3 : (Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ f hf hm).appTop =
      (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).ι.appTop ≫
        ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).inv).appTop := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι]
  have h4 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0))).inv ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers f)))).appTop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers f)) ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ f))).inv :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality _).symm
  have h5 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0))).inv ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂).appTop ≫ (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).ι.appTop ≫
        ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).inv).appTop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers f)) ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ f))).inv := by
    rw [← h3, h2]
    exact h4
  have h6 : ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).inv).appTop ≫
      ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).hom).appTop = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Iso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have h7 : ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).hom).appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ f))).hom ≫ Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ f ≫
        (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).topIso.inv := by
    rw [Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom]
    exact Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top 𝒜₂ f
  have h8 : (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).ι.appTop ≫ (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).topIso.hom =
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f ≤ ⊤)).op := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appTop, Scheme.Opens.topIso_hom]
    exact ((p1.presheaf.map_comp _ _).symm).trans
      ((congrArg (fun t => p1.presheaf.map t) op_comp.symm).trans
        (congrArg (fun (h : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f ⟶ ⊤) => p1.presheaf.map h.op)
          (Subsingleton.elim _ _)))
  have h9 := congrArg
    (fun t => t ≫ ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ f hf hm).hom).appTop) h5
  simp only [Category.assoc] at h9
  rw [h6, Category.comp_id, h7, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at h9
  have h10 := congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f).topIso.hom) h9
  simp only [Category.assoc] at h10
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, h8] at h10
  exact h10

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.res_top_cRingHom_eq_awayToSection
statement:
theorem res_top_cRingHom_eq_awayToSection {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜₂ m) (hm : 0 < m) (c : ℂ) :
    p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f ≤ ⊤)).op (φC c) =
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ f (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ f) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat' : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0))).inv
      (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom c) =
      (Spec.map (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom)).appTop
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv c) :=
    congrArg
      (fun (t : CommRingCat.of ℂ ⟶ Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0)), ⊤)) => t c)
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom))
  have hφ : φC c = (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂).appTop
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0))).inv (algebraMap ℂ (𝒜₂ 0) c)) := by
    show (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂).appTop
        ((Spec.map (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom)).appTop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv c)) = _
    exact congrArg (fun z => (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂).appTop z) hnat'.symm
  have hmain := congrArg
    (fun (t : CommRingCat.of (𝒜₂ 0) ⟶ Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f)) =>
      t (algebraMap ℂ (𝒜₂ 0) c))
    (toSpecZero_appTop_res hf hm)
  rw [hφ, ProjectiveLineUnits.algebraMap_away_apply]
  exact hmain

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.algebraMap_sec_eq_awayToSection
statement:
theorem algebraMap_sec_eq_awayToSection {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜₂ m) (hm : 0 < m) (c : ℂ) :
    algebraMap ℂ (Sec φC (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f)) c =
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ f (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ f) c)
proof:
:=
  res_top_cRingHom_eq_awayToSection hf hm c

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.algebraMap_sec_U01
statement:
theorem algebraMap_sec_U01 (c : ℂ) :
    algebraMap ℂ (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) c =
      overlapRingHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ ⊤)).op (φC c) =
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op
        (p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
          Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ≤ ⊤)).op (φC c)) := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun (h : U0 ⊓ U1 ⟶ ⊤) => p1.presheaf.map h.op (φC c))
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  show p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ ⊤)).op (φC c) = _
  rw [hsplit, res_top_cRingHom_eq_awayToSection hX01 two_pos c]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.uniqueAlgEquiv_X
statement:
theorem uniqueAlgEquiv_X :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv (R := ℂ) (Fin 1)) (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  show (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv (R := ℂ) (Fin 1))
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 1) 1) (1 : ℂ)) = Polynomial.X
  rw [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial]
  rw [show ((Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 1) 1) default) = 1 from by
    rw [show (default : Fin 1) = 0 from rfl, Finsupp.single_eq_same]]
  exact Polynomial.monomial_one_one_eq_X

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.uniqueAlgEquiv_symm_X

proof:

    ((MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv (R := ℂ) (Fin 1)).symm Polynomial.X)) = _

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.chartHomA_surjective
statement:

    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv (R := ℂ) (Fin 1)).symm.surjective)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom_T
statement:
theorem overlapAlgHom_T :
    overlapAlgHom (T (1 : ℤ)) = (overlapUnit : Γ(p1, U0 ⊓ U1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_one_eq_single, overlapAlgHom]
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, one_smul]
  show (((zpowersHom ((Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ)) overlapUnitSec)
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = _
  rw [zpowersHom_apply]
  show ((overlapUnitSec ^ ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)).toAdd) :
    (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = _
  rw [show ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)).toAdd) = (1 : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_one]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom_T_neg
statement:
theorem overlapAlgHom_T_neg :
    overlapAlgHom (T (-1 : ℤ)) =
      ((overlapUnit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Γ(p1, U0 ⊓ U1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_neg_one_eq_single, overlapAlgHom]
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, one_smul]
  show (((zpowersHom ((Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ)) overlapUnitSec)
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd (-1 : ℤ)) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = _
  rw [zpowersHom_apply]
  show ((overlapUnitSec ^ ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (-1 : ℤ)).toAdd) :
    (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = _
  rw [show ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (-1 : ℤ)).toAdd) = (-1 : ℤ) from rfl,
    zpow_neg_one]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapSectionIso_inv_overlapRingHom
statement:
theorem overlapSectionIso_inv_overlapRingHom
    (x : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) :
    overlapSectionIso.inv (overlapRingHom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : overlapRingHom x = overlapSectionIso.hom x := by
    show p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x) =
      p1.presheaf.map ((eqToIso U0_inf_U1).hom.op)
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x)
    exact congrArg
      (fun (h : U0 ⊓ U1 ⟶ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
        p1.presheaf.map h.op
          (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x))
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [h1]
  exact overlapSectionIso.hom_inv_id_apply x

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapPt_X01_isUnit
statement:
theorem overlapPt_X01_isUnit :
    IsUnit ((MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ[T;T⁻¹]).toRingHom
      (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1))

  show IsUnit ((MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 0) *
    (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 1))
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  show IsUnit ((1 : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * T 1)
  rw [one_mul]
  exact isUnit_T 1

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapEvalRing_algebraMap
statement:
theorem overlapEvalRing_algebraMap (c : ℂ) :
    overlapEvalRing (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) c) =
      algebraMap ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] c
proof:
:= by
  have hval : (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) c).val =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)
        (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))
        (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
    rw [ProjectiveLineUnits.algebraMap_away_apply]
    show Localization.mk _ 1 = _
    rw [Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap,
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [overlapEvalRing, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    hval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  show (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.C c) = algebraMap ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] c
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_C]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.T_mul_T_neg
statement: theorem T_mul_T_neg : (T (1 : ℤ) : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-1 : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T_add]
  show (T ((1 : ℤ) + (-1)) : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) = 1
  rw [show (1 : ℤ) + (-1) = 0 by ring, T_zero]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapEvalRing_awayNum
statement: theorem overlapEvalRing_awayNum : overlapEvalRing awayNum = T (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapEvalRing, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [show (awayNum).val = Localization.mk
      (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
      (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
        Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))
    from HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _]
  rw [Localization.awayLift_mk (v := T (-1 : ℤ)) (hv := by
    rw [map_mul]
    show (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 0) *
        (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 1) * T (-1 : ℤ) = 1
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    show (1 : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * T 1 * T (-1 : ℤ) = 1
    rw [one_mul, T_mul_T_neg])]
  rw [map_mul]
  show (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 1) *
      (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 1) * T (-1 : ℤ) ^ 1 = T 1
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  show (T 1 : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * T 1 * T (-1 : ℤ) ^ 1 = T 1
  rw [pow_one, mul_assoc, T_mul_T_neg, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapEvalRing_awayNumInv
statement: theorem overlapEvalRing_awayNumInv : overlapEvalRing awayNumInv = T (-1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapEvalRing, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [show (awayNumInv).val = Localization.mk
      (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 0)
      (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
        Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))
    from HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _]
  rw [Localization.awayLift_mk (v := T (-1 : ℤ)) (hv := by
    rw [map_mul]
    show (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 0) *
        (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 1) * T (-1 : ℤ) = 1
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    show (1 : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * T 1 * T (-1 : ℤ) = 1
    rw [one_mul, T_mul_T_neg])]
  rw [map_mul]
  show (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 0) *
      (MvPolynomial.aeval overlapPt) (MvPolynomial.X 0) * T (-1 : ℤ) ^ 1 = T (-1 : ℤ)
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  show (1 : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) * 1 * T (-1 : ℤ) ^ 1 = T (-1 : ℤ)
  rw [one_mul, one_mul, pow_one]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.PhiSec_omegaSec
statement: theorem PhiSec_omegaSec : PhiSec omegaSec = 1
proof:
:= by
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (kappaU01Inv (secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) omegaRing))) = 1
  rw [kappaInv_kappa]
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (DLog.dlog ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] (ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ)))) = 1
  have hcomp : DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1 (DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1
      (DLog.dlog ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] (ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ))) =
      DeRham.map (overlapInvAlgHom.comp overlapAlgHom) 1
        (DLog.dlog ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] (ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ)) := by
    rw [DeRham.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hcomp, DLog.map_dlog]
  have hunit : Units.map ((overlapInvAlgHom.comp overlapAlgHom :
      ℂ[T;T⁻¹] →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) : ℂ[T;T⁻¹] →* ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) (ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ) =
      ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ := by
    apply Units.ext
    show (overlapInvAlgHom.comp overlapAlgHom)
      ((ContentAnchor.tUnit ℂ : (ℂ[T;T⁻¹])ˣ) : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) = _
    rw [ContentAnchor.tUnit_val]
    show overlapInvAlgHom (overlapAlgHom (T 1)) = T 1
    exact overlapInvAlgHom_overlapAlgHom_T
  rw [hunit]
  exact TwoChartResidue.residueLin_dlog_tUnit ℂ

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.presheaf_map_arrowSplit
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_arrowSplit {V W W' : p1.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (h1 : V ≤ W') (h2 : W' ≤ W) (z : Γ(p1, W)) :
    p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op z =
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op (p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op z)
proof:
:= by
  have harr : (homOfLE h).op = (homOfLE h2).op ≫ (homOfLE h1).op := by
    rw [← op_comp]
    exact congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [harr]
  exact congrArg (fun (t : Γ(p1, W) ⟶ Γ(p1, V)) => t z) (p1.presheaf.map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.res_chartHomA_X_left
statement:
theorem res_chartHomA_X_left :
    DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0) (chartHomA 0 1 Polynomial.X) =
      overlapRingHom awayNum
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartHomA_X]
  show p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op
    (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0) (coordFrac 0 1)) = overlapRingHom awayNum
  have hres := Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) (X_mem_grade_one 1)
    (rfl : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
  have hpt := congrArg
    (fun t : CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0)) ⟶
        Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
      t (coordFrac 0 1)) hres
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hpt
  rw [presheaf_map_arrowSplit (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0) (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)
    (Proj.basicOpen_mono 𝒜₂ _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩), ← hpt]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) =>
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) z))
    awayMap_coordFrac

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.awayMap_coordFrac'
statement:
theorem awayMap_coordFrac' :
    awayMap 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 0)
      (show (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 0 from mul_comm _ _)
      (coordFrac 1 0) = awayNumInv
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  have h1 : (awayMap 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 0)
      (show (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 0 from mul_comm _ _)
      (coordFrac 1 0)).val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 1)
        (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
          Submonoid.powers
            (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
    rw [show coordFrac 1 0 = HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 1) 1
        (MvPolynomial.X 0) ((one_smul ℕ 1).symm ▸ X_mem_grade_one 0) from rfl,
      awayMap_mk]
    exact HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _
  have h2 : (awayNumInv).val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 0)
        (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
          Submonoid.powers
            (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _
  rw [h1, h2, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  use 1
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.res_chartHomA_X_right
statement:
theorem res_chartHomA_X_right :
    DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1) (chartHomA 1 0 Polynomial.X) =
      overlapRingHom awayNumInv
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartHomA_X]
  show p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op
    (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 1) (coordFrac 1 0)) = overlapRingHom awayNumInv
  have hres := Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) (X_mem_grade_one 0)
    (show (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 0 from mul_comm _ _)
  have hpt := congrArg
    (fun t : CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 1)) ⟶
        Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
      t (coordFrac 1 0)) hres
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hpt
  rw [presheaf_map_arrowSplit (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1) (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)
    (Proj.basicOpen_mono 𝒜₂ _ _
      ⟨_, mul_comm (MvPolynomial.X 0) (MvPolynomial.X 1)⟩), ← hpt]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) =>
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) z))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom_chartEmbed_left

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.overlapAlgHom_chartEmbed_right
statement:

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.chartDifference_receipt
statement:
theorem chartDifference_receipt (a b : TwoChartResidue.chartOneForms ℂ) :
    DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (TwoChartResidue.chartDifference ℂ (a, b)) =
      DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 a) -
      DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 1 0) 1 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TwoChartResidue.chartDifference_apply, map_sub]
  have hL : DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (TwoChartResidue.chartRes ℂ 1 a) =
      DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 a) := by
    show DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (DeRham.map (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ 1) 1 a) = _
    rw [show DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (DeRham.map (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ 1) 1 a) =
        DeRham.map (overlapAlgHom.comp (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ 1)) 1 a from by
      rw [DeRham.map_comp]; rfl]
    rw [overlapAlgHom_chartEmbed_left]
    rw [DeRham.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hR : DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (TwoChartResidue.chartRes ℂ (-1) b) =
      DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 1 0) 1 b) := by
    show DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (DeRham.map (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ (-1)) 1 b) = _
    rw [show DeRham.map overlapAlgHom 1 (DeRham.map (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ (-1)) 1 b) =
        DeRham.map (overlapAlgHom.comp (TwoChartResidue.chartEmbed ℂ (-1))) 1 b from by
      rw [DeRham.map_comp]; rfl]
    rw [overlapAlgHom_chartEmbed_right]
    rw [DeRham.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hL, hR]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.drMap_surjective
statement:
theorem drMap_surjective {A B C' : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C']
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C'] (ψ : B →ₐ[A] C') (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ)
    (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (DeRham.map ψ n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]⟩
  | add f g hf hg =>
      obtain ⟨yf, hyf⟩ := hf
      obtain ⟨yg, hyg⟩ := hg
      exact ⟨yf + yg, by rw [map_add, hyf, hyg, Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]⟩
  | single t s =>
      choose tb htb using fun k => hψ (t k)
      obtain ⟨sb, hsb⟩ := hψ s
      refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single tb sb), ?_⟩
      rw [DeRham.map_mk_single]
      have h1 : (⇑ψ ∘ tb) = t := funext htb
      rw [h1, hsb]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.PhiSec_res_left
statement:
theorem PhiSec_res_left (s : omegaSheaf.obj.obj (op U0)) :
    PhiSec (omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (secComparison.app (op U0)) := isIso_secComparison_app aU0
  obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : ∃ s', secComparison.app (op U0) s' = s :=
    ⟨inv (secComparison.app (op U0)) s, IsIso.inv_hom_id_apply _ _⟩
  have hnat : omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
      (secComparison.app (op U0) s') =
      secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
        ((DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op s') :=
    (congrArg
      (fun (t : (DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).obj (op U0) ⟶ omegaSheaf.obj.obj (op (U0 ⊓ U1))) =>
        t s')
      (secComparison.naturality ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op)).symm
  rw [hnat]
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (kappaU01Inv (secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
      ((DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op s')))) = 0
  rw [kappaInv_kappa]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := drMap_surjective (chartHomA 0 1)
    (chartHomA_surjective 0 1 (by decide)) 1 s'
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (leOfHom (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂)) 1
      (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 a))) = 0
  have hcomp : DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
      (DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (leOfHom (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 a)) =
      DeRham.map (overlapInvAlgHom.comp
        ((DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).comp (chartHomA 0 1))) 1 a := by
    rw [DeRham.map_comp, DeRham.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hcomp, overlapInv_res_chartHomA_left]
  exact TwoChartResidue.residueLin_zChart ℂ a

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.PhiSec_res_right
statement:
theorem PhiSec_res_right (s : omegaSheaf.obj.obj (op U1)) :
    PhiSec (omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (secComparison.app (op U1)) := isIso_secComparison_app aU1
  obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : ∃ s', secComparison.app (op U1) s' = s :=
    ⟨inv (secComparison.app (op U1)) s, IsIso.inv_hom_id_apply _ _⟩
  have hnat : omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
      (secComparison.app (op U1) s') =
      secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
        ((DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op s') :=
    (congrArg
      (fun (t : (DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).obj (op U1) ⟶ omegaSheaf.obj.obj (op (U0 ⊓ U1))) =>
        t s')
      (secComparison.naturality ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op)).symm
  rw [hnat]
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (kappaU01Inv (secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
      ((DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op s')))) = 0
  rw [kappaInv_kappa]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := drMap_surjective (chartHomA 1 0)
    (chartHomA_surjective 1 0 (by decide)) 1 s'
  show TwoChartResidue.residueLin ℂ (DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
    (DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (leOfHom (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃)) 1
      (DeRham.map (chartHomA 1 0) 1 a))) = 0
  have hcomp : DeRham.map overlapInvAlgHom 1
      (DeRham.map (DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (leOfHom (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃)) 1
        (DeRham.map (chartHomA 1 0) 1 a)) =
      DeRham.map (overlapInvAlgHom.comp
        ((DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).comp (chartHomA 1 0))) 1 a := by
    rw [DeRham.map_comp, DeRham.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hcomp, overlapInv_res_chartHomA_right]
  exact TwoChartResidue.residueLin_wChart ℂ a

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassGraded_ne_zero
statement: theorem edgeClassGraded_ne_zero : edgeClassGraded ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hex := ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).sequence_exact omegaSheaf 0 1 rfl).exact 1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).mp hex omegaH hzero
  have hb' : (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod omegaSheaf 0 b = omegaH := hb
  set p := (AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd
    (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂)
    (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃)).hom b with hp
  have hbinv : (AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv p = b := by
    rw [hp]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ b
  have homega : omegaH =
      (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op p.1 -
      (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op p.2 :=
    hb'.symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z => (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod omegaSheaf 0 z)
        hbinv.symm).trans
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply
          omegaSheaf p.1 p.2))
  have hsecL : h0ToSections omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)
      ((omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op p.1) =
      omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        (h0ToSections omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂ p.1) :=
    (h0ToSections_natural omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂ p.1).symm
  have hsecR : h0ToSections omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)
      ((omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op p.2) =
      omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
        (h0ToSections omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃ p.2) :=
    (h0ToSections_natural omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃ p.2).symm
  have hsec : omegaSec =
      omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        (h0ToSections omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂ p.1) -
      omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
        (h0ToSections omegaSheaf (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃ p.2) := by
    have h1 : h0ToSections omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1) omegaH = omegaSec :=
      (h0SectionsEquiv omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)).apply_symm_apply omegaSec
    rw [← h1, homega]
    rw [show h0ToSections omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)
        ((omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op p.1 -
         (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op p.2) =
        h0SectionsEquiv omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)
          ((omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op p.1 -
           (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op p.2)
      from rfl, map_sub]
    rw [h0SectionsEquiv_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_apply, hsecL, hsecR]
  have hval : PhiSec omegaSec = 1 := PhiSec_omegaSec
  rw [hsec, PhiSec_sub, PhiSec_res_left, PhiSec_res_right, sub_zero] at hval
  exact one_ne_zero hval.symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassTop_ne_zero
statement: theorem edgeClassTop_ne_zero : edgeClassTop ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun z => (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JP1) U0_sup_U1)) 1).symm z) h
  have h3 : (CycCarrier.extReanchorLeft
      (eqToIso (congrArg (freeYonedaSheaf JP1) U0_sup_U1)) 1).symm edgeClassTop =
      edgeClassGraded :=
    AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  exact edgeClassGraded_ne_zero ((h3.symm.trans h2).trans (map_zero _))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeClassH_ne_zero
statement: theorem edgeClassH_ne_zero : edgeClassH ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun z => (hPrimeTopEquivH (⊤ : p1.Opens) (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)
      omegaSheaf 1).symm z) h
  have h3 : (hPrimeTopEquivH (⊤ : p1.Opens) (CartierClass.opensTopIsTerminal p1)
      omegaSheaf 1).symm edgeClassH = edgeClassTop :=
    AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  exact edgeClassTop_ne_zero ((h3.symm.trans h2).trans (map_zero _))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.nontrivial_omegaH1
statement: theorem nontrivial_omegaH1 : Nontrivial (Sheaf.H omegaSheaf 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨edgeClassH, 0, edgeClassH_ne_zero⟩⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero
    (y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 U0) omegaSheaf 0) :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).δ omegaSheaf 0 1 rfl
      ((omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op y =
      (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod omegaSheaf 0
        ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃))) := by
    rw [(Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply
      omegaSheaf y 0, map_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun (t : ((omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ⊞
        (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃) :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ⟶
        omegaSheaf.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₄) =>
      t ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃))))
    ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod_δ omegaSheaf 0 1 rfl)
  refine h2.trans ?_
  show ((0 : _ ⟶ omegaSheaf.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₄))
    ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
          ((y, 0) : (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ×
            (omegaSheaf.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃))) = 0
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineGraded.edgeRoute_dz_eq_zero
statement:
theorem edgeRoute_dz_eq_zero :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).δ omegaSheaf 0 1 rfl
      ((h0SectionsEquiv omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)).symm dzSec) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : dzSec = omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
      (secComparison.app (op U0) (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 dzChart)) := by
    show secComparison.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
        ((DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
          (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 dzChart)) = _
    exact congrArg
      (fun (t : (DLog.drAbOpens φC 1).obj (op U0) ⟶ omegaSheaf.obj.obj (op (U0 ⊓ U1))) =>
        t (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 dzChart))
      (secComparison.naturality ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op)
  rw [hnat]
  have hres : (h0SectionsEquiv omegaSheaf (U0 ⊓ U1)).symm
      (omegaSheaf.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        (secComparison.app (op U0) (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 dzChart))) =
      (omegaSheaf.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        ((h0SectionsEquiv omegaSheaf
          ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂ : p1.Opens)).symm
          (secComparison.app (op U0) (DeRham.map (chartHomA 0 1) 1 dzChart))) := by
    rw [h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_symm_apply]
    exact mk₀_sheafHomOfSection_natural omegaSheaf _ _
  rw [hres]
  exact edgeRoute_restriction_eq_zero _

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.map_smul_alg
statement:
theorem map_smul_alg {B' C' : Type w₂} [CommRing B'] [CommRing C'] [Algebra A B']
    [Algebra A C'] (ψ : B' →ₐ[A] C') (n : ℕ) (b : B') (x : DR A B' n) :
    DeRham.map ψ n (b • x) = ψ b • DeRham.map ψ n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, smul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, smul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, smul_add]
  | single t s =>
      have h1 : b • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s) : DR A B' n) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t (b * s)) := by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Finsupp.smul_single']
      have h2 : ψ b • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (ψ ∘ t) (ψ s)) : DR A C' n) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (ψ ∘ t) (ψ b * ψ s)) := by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Finsupp.smul_single']
      rw [h1, map_mk_single, map_mk_single, h2, map_mul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.locToC_algebraMap
statement:
theorem locToC_algebraMap (b : B) :
    locToC A B f C (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b) = algebraMap B C b
proof:
:=
  (locAlgEquiv B f C).commutes b

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.cToLoc_algebraMap
statement:
theorem cToLoc_algebraMap (b : B) :
    cToLoc A B f C (algebraMap B C b) = algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) b
proof:
:=
  (locAlgEquiv B f C).symm.commutes b

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.locToC_comp_toAlgHom
statement:
theorem locToC_comp_toAlgHom :
    (locToC A B f C).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B (Localization.Away f)) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  exact locToC_algebraMap A B f C b

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.cToLoc_comp_toAlgHom
statement:
theorem cToLoc_comp_toAlgHom :
    (cToLoc A B f C).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B (Localization.Away f)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  exact cToLoc_algebraMap A B f C b

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.drMap_locToC_locMap
statement:
theorem drMap_locToC_locMap (n : ℕ) (x : DR A B n) :
    DeRham.map (locToC A B f C) n (locMap A B f n x) =
      DeRham.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [locMap_eq_map, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← DeRham.map_comp, locToC_comp_toAlgHom]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.drMap_cToLoc_map
statement:
theorem drMap_cToLoc_map (n : ℕ) (x : DR A B n) :
    DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n (DeRham.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) n x) =
      locMap A B f n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← DeRham.map_comp, cToLoc_comp_toAlgHom, locMap_eq_map]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.drMap_locToC_cToLoc
statement:
theorem drMap_locToC_cToLoc (n : ℕ) (y : DR A C n) :
    DeRham.map (locToC A B f C) n (DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← DeRham.map_comp]
  have h : (locToC A B f C).comp (cToLoc A B f C) = AlgHom.id A C := by
    ext c
    exact (locAlgEquiv B f C).apply_symm_apply c
  rw [h, DeRham.map_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.exists_map_eq_pow_smul
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq_pow_smul (n : ℕ) (y : DR A C n) :
    ∃ (z : DR A B n) (k : ℕ),
      algebraMap B C (f ^ k) • y = DeRham.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) n z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨z, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj A B f n (DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n y)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
  have hk' : f ^ k = (s : B) := hk
  refine ⟨z, k, ?_⟩
  have h1 : algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (f ^ k) •
      DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n y = locMap A B f n z := by
    rw [algebraMap_smul, hk', ← Submonoid.smul_def]
    exact hs
  have h2 := congrArg (DeRham.map (locToC A B f C) n) h1
  rw [map_smul_alg, drMap_locToC_locMap, drMap_locToC_cToLoc, locToC_algebraMap] at h2
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.exists_pow_smul_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_of_map_eq (n : ℕ) {x₁ x₂ : DR A B n}
    (h : DeRham.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) n x₁ =
      DeRham.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) n x₂) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, f ^ k • x₁ = f ^ k • x₂
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg (DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n) h
  rw [drMap_cToLoc_map, drMap_cToLoc_map] at h2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := locMap_exists_of_eq A B f h2
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := c.2
  have hk' : f ^ k = (c : B) := hk
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [hk', ← Submonoid.smul_def, ← Submonoid.smul_def]
  exact hc

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.eq_zero_of_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_pow_smul_eq_zero (n : ℕ) {y : DR A C n} (k : ℕ)
    (h : algebraMap B C (f ^ k) • y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg (DeRham.map (cToLoc A B f C) n) h
  rw [map_smul_alg, cToLoc_algebraMap, map_zero] at h2
  have h3 := DeRham.smul_cancel_of_unit B f ⟨f ^ k, k, rfl⟩ h2
  have h4 := congrArg (DeRham.map (locToC A B f C) n) h3
  rw [map_zero] at h4
  rwa [drMap_locToC_cToLoc] at h4

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.isScalarTower_res
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra φ h
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => ((res φ h).commutes r).symm

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.exists_res_map_eq_pow_smul
statement:
theorem exists_res_map_eq_pow_smul (f : Sec φ U.toOpens) (p : ℕ)
    (y : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p) :
    ∃ (z : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ U.toOpens) p) (k : ℕ),
      res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) (f ^ k) • y =
        DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI := isScalarTower_res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) := isLocalization_away_site φ U f
  obtain ⟨z, k, hzk⟩ :=
    exists_map_eq_pow_smul R (Sec φ U.toOpens) f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p y
  rw [show IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (Sec φ U.toOpens) (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) =
    res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) from AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl] at hzk
  exact ⟨z, k, hzk⟩

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.exists_pow_smul_eq_of_res_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_of_res_map_eq (f : Sec φ U.toOpens) (p : ℕ)
    {z₁ z₂ : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ U.toOpens) p}
    (h : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z₁ =
      DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z₂) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, f ^ k • z₁ = f ^ k • z₂
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI := isScalarTower_res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) := isLocalization_away_site φ U f
  refine exists_pow_smul_eq_of_map_eq R (Sec φ U.toOpens) f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p ?_
  rw [show IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (Sec φ U.toOpens) (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) =
    res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) from AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl]
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.eq_zero_of_res_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_res_pow_smul_eq_zero (f : Sec φ U.toOpens) (p : ℕ)
    {y : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p} (k : ℕ)
    (h : res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) (f ^ k) • y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI := isScalarTower_res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) := isLocalization_away_site φ U f
  exact eq_zero_of_pow_smul_eq_zero R (Sec φ U.toOpens) f (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p k h

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.basicOpen_mul_le_left
statement:
theorem basicOpen_mul_le_left {V : X.Opens} (f g : Sec φ V) :
    X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen f
proof:
:=
  (X.basicOpen_mul f g).le.trans inf_le_left

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.basicOpen_mul_le_right
statement:
theorem basicOpen_mul_le_right {V : X.Opens} (f g : Sec φ V) :
    X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen g
proof:
:=
  (X.basicOpen_mul f g).le.trans inf_le_right

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.res_res
statement:
theorem res_res {U' V' W' : X.Opens} (h₁ : U' ≤ V') (h₂ : V' ≤ W') (b : Sec φ W') :
    res φ h₁ (res φ h₂ b) = res φ (h₁.trans h₂) b
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (res_comp φ h₁ h₂ (h₁.trans h₂)) b

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.map_res_map_res
statement:
theorem map_res_map_res {U' V' W' : X.Opens} (h₁ : U' ≤ V') (h₂ : V' ≤ W') (p : ℕ)
    (z : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ W') p) :
    DeRham.map (res φ h₁) p (DeRham.map (res φ h₂) p z) =
      DeRham.map (res φ (h₁.trans h₂)) p z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← DeRham.map_comp, res_comp φ h₁ h₂ (h₁.trans h₂)]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.eq_of_res_map_eq_of_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s₀, hsub, hs₀⟩ := (Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite s).mp hs
  have hk : ∀ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), ∃ k : ℕ,
      x.1 ^ k • z₁ = x.1 ^ k • z₂ :=
    fun x => exists_pow_smul_eq_of_res_map_eq φ U x.1 p (h x.1 (hsub x.2))
  choose k hk using hk
  set K := Finset.univ.sup k with hK
  have hkK : ∀ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), x.1 ^ K • z₁ = x.1 ^ K • z₂ := by
    intro x
    rw [← pow_sub_mul_pow x.1 (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ x) : k x ≤ K),
      mul_smul, mul_smul, hk x]
  have h1 : (1 : Sec φ U.toOpens) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)) => x.1 ^ K) := by
    refine Ideal.span_mono ?_ (le_of_eq (Ideal.span_pow_eq_top (↑s₀) hs₀ K).symm
      Submodule.mem_top)
    rintro b ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp h1
  calc z₁ = (1 : Sec φ U.toOpens) • z₁ := (one_smul _ _).symm
    _ = (∑ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), c x * x.1 ^ K) • z₁ := by rw [hc]
    _ = ∑ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), c x • (x.1 ^ K • z₁) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_smul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => mul_smul _ _ _
    _ = ∑ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), c x • (x.1 ^ K • z₂) := by
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by rw [hkK x]
    _ = (∑ x : (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)), c x * x.1 ^ K) • z₂ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_smul]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => (mul_smul _ _ _).symm)
    _ = (1 : Sec φ U.toOpens) • z₂ := by rw [hc]
    _ = z₂ := one_smul _ _

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.exists_glue
statement:
theorem exists_glue (p : ℕ) (s₀ : Finset (Sec φ U.toOpens))
    (hs₀ : Ideal.span (s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens)) = ⊤)
    (y : ∀ f : Sec φ U.toOpens, f ∈ s₀ → DeRham.DR R (Sec φ (X.basicOpen f)) p)
    (hy : ∀ (f g : Sec φ U.toOpens) (hf : f ∈ s₀) (hg : g ∈ s₀),
      DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_left φ f g)) p (y f hf) =
        DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_right φ f g)) p (y g hg)) :
    ∃ z : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ U.toOpens) p,
      ∀ (f : Sec φ U.toOpens) (hf : f ∈ s₀),
        DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z = y f hf
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ι := (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens))
  
  have hA : ∀ x : ι, ∃ (m : DeRham.DR R (Sec φ U.toOpens) p) (k : ℕ),
      res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ k) • y x.1 x.2 =
        DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p m :=
    fun x => exists_res_map_eq_pow_smul φ U x.1 p (y x.1 x.2)
  choose m k hmk using hA
  set N₁ := Finset.univ.sup k with hN₁
  set m' : ι → DeRham.DR R (Sec φ U.toOpens) p :=
    fun x => x.1 ^ (N₁ - k x) • m x with hm'
  have hA' : ∀ x : ι,
      res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ N₁) • y x.1 x.2 =
        DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (m' x) := by
    intro x
    have e1 : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (m' x) =
        res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ (N₁ - k x)) •
          DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (m x) :=
      map_smul_alg R _ p _ _
    rw [e1, ← hmk x, smul_smul, ← map_mul,
      pow_sub_mul_pow x.1 (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ x) : k x ≤ N₁)]
  
  have hB : ∀ x x' : ι, ∃ k₂ : ℕ,
      (x.1 * x'.1) ^ k₂ • (x'.1 ^ N₁ • m' x) =
        (x.1 * x'.1) ^ k₂ • (x.1 ^ N₁ • m' x') := by
    intro x x'
    
    have b1' : res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x.1 ^ N₁) •
        DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_left φ x.1 x'.1)) p
          (y x.1 x.2) =
          DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (m' x) := by
      have h := congrArg
        (DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_left φ x.1 x'.1)) p) (hA' x)
      rw [map_smul_alg, res_res, map_res_map_res] at h
      exact h
    have b2' : res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x'.1 ^ N₁) •
        DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_right φ x.1 x'.1)) p
          (y x'.1 x'.2) =
          DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (m' x') := by
      have h := congrArg
        (DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_right φ x.1 x'.1)) p) (hA' x')
      rw [map_smul_alg, res_res, map_res_map_res] at h
      exact h
    
    apply exists_pow_smul_eq_of_res_map_eq φ U (x.1 * x'.1) p
    calc DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (x'.1 ^ N₁ • m' x)
        = res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x'.1 ^ N₁) •
            DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (m' x) :=
          map_smul_alg R _ p _ _
      _ = res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x'.1 ^ N₁) •
            (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x.1 ^ N₁) •
              DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_left φ x.1 x'.1)) p
                (y x.1 x.2)) := by rw [b1']
      _ = res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x.1 ^ N₁) •
            (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x'.1 ^ N₁) •
              DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_right φ x.1 x'.1)) p
                (y x'.1 x'.2)) := by
          rw [hy x.1 x'.1 x.2 x'.2, smul_smul, smul_smul,
            mul_comm (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x'.1 ^ N₁))
              (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x.1 ^ N₁))]
      _ = res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1)) (x.1 ^ N₁) •
            DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (m' x') := by rw [b2']
      _ = DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le (x.1 * x'.1))) p (x.1 ^ N₁ • m' x') :=
          (map_smul_alg R _ p _ _).symm
  choose k₂ hk₂ using hB
  set K := Finset.univ.sup (fun q : ι × ι => k₂ q.1 q.2) with hKdef
  have hk₂K : ∀ x x' : ι,
      (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K • (x'.1 ^ N₁ • m' x) =
        (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K • (x.1 ^ N₁ • m' x') := by
    intro x x'
    have hle : k₂ x x' ≤ K := by
      rw [hKdef]
      exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun q : ι × ι => k₂ q.1 q.2) (Finset.mem_univ (x, x'))
    rw [← pow_sub_mul_pow (x.1 * x'.1) hle, mul_smul, mul_smul, hk₂ x x']
  set N := N₁ + K with hNdef
  
  have hMN : ∀ x x' : ι,
      x'.1 ^ N • (x.1 ^ K • m' x) = x.1 ^ N • (x'.1 ^ K • m' x') := by
    intro x x'
    have hsc1 : x'.1 ^ N * x.1 ^ K = (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K * x'.1 ^ N₁ := by
      rw [hNdef]; ring
    have hsc2 : (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K * x.1 ^ N₁ = x.1 ^ N * x'.1 ^ K := by
      rw [hNdef]; ring
    calc x'.1 ^ N • (x.1 ^ K • m' x)
        = (x'.1 ^ N * x.1 ^ K) • m' x := smul_smul _ _ _
      _ = ((x.1 * x'.1) ^ K * x'.1 ^ N₁) • m' x := by rw [hsc1]
      _ = (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K • (x'.1 ^ N₁ • m' x) := (smul_smul _ _ _).symm
      _ = (x.1 * x'.1) ^ K • (x.1 ^ N₁ • m' x') := hk₂K x x'
      _ = ((x.1 * x'.1) ^ K * x.1 ^ N₁) • m' x' := smul_smul _ _ _
      _ = (x.1 ^ N * x'.1 ^ K) • m' x' := by rw [hsc2]
      _ = x.1 ^ N • (x'.1 ^ K • m' x') := (smul_smul _ _ _).symm
  
  have hMy : ∀ x : ι,
      res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ N) • y x.1 x.2 =
        DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (x.1 ^ K • m' x) := by
    intro x
    have e1 : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (x.1 ^ K • m' x) =
        res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ K) •
          DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (m' x) :=
      map_smul_alg R _ p _ _
    have hsc : x.1 ^ K * x.1 ^ N₁ = x.1 ^ N := by rw [hNdef]; ring
    calc res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ N) • y x.1 x.2
        = res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ K * x.1 ^ N₁) • y x.1 x.2 := by rw [hsc]
      _ = (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ K) *
            res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ N₁)) • y x.1 x.2 := by rw [map_mul]
      _ = res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ K) •
            (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ N₁) • y x.1 x.2) :=
          (smul_smul _ _ _).symm
      _ = res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1) (x.1 ^ K) •
            DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (m' x) := by rw [hA' x]
      _ = DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le x.1)) p (x.1 ^ K • m' x) := e1.symm
  
  have h1 : (1 : Sec φ U.toOpens) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun x : ι => x.1 ^ N) := by
    refine Ideal.span_mono ?_ (le_of_eq (Ideal.span_pow_eq_top (↑s₀) hs₀ N).symm
      Submodule.mem_top)
    rintro b ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp h1
  refine ⟨∑ x : ι, c x • (x.1 ^ K • m' x), ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  
  have hMNf : ∀ x : ι, f ^ N • (x.1 ^ K • m' x) =
      x.1 ^ N • (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩) := fun x => hMN x ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hMyf : res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) (f ^ N) • y f hf =
      DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩) := hMy ⟨f, hf⟩
  
  have hz : f ^ N • ∑ x : ι, c x • (x.1 ^ K • m' x) = f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩ := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    have e1 : ∀ x : ι, f ^ N • (c x • (x.1 ^ K • m' x)) =
        c x • (x.1 ^ N • (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩)) := by
      intro x
      calc f ^ N • (c x • (x.1 ^ K • m' x))
          = (f ^ N * c x) • (x.1 ^ K • m' x) := smul_smul _ _ _
        _ = (c x * f ^ N) • (x.1 ^ K • m' x) := by rw [mul_comm (f ^ N) (c x)]
        _ = c x • (f ^ N • (x.1 ^ K • m' x)) := (smul_smul _ _ _).symm
        _ = c x • (x.1 ^ N • (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩)) := by rw [hMNf x]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => e1 x]
    have e2 : ∀ x : ι, c x • (x.1 ^ N • (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩)) =
        (c x * x.1 ^ N) • (f ^ K • m' ⟨f, hf⟩) := fun x => smul_smul _ _ _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => e2 x, ← Finset.sum_smul, hc, one_smul]
  
  have hres := congrArg (DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p) hz
  rw [map_smul_alg, ← hMyf] at hres
  have hzero : res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) (f ^ N) •
      (DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p (∑ x : ι, c x • (x.1 ^ K • m' x)) -
        y f hf) = 0 := by
    rw [smul_sub, hres]
    exact sub_self _
  have hfin := eq_zero_of_res_pow_smul_eq_zero φ U f p N hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hfin

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.basicOpen_mul_site_le_left
statement:
theorem basicOpen_mul_site_le_left (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (f g : Sec φ U.toOpens) :
    U.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ U.basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) g, ?_⟩
  show X.basicOpen (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op g) = _
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_res]
  exact (X.basicOpen_mul f g).symm

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.basicOpen_mul_site_le_right
statement:
theorem basicOpen_mul_site_le_right (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (f g : Sec φ U.toOpens) :
    U.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ U.basicOpen g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨res φ (X.basicOpen_le g) f, ?_⟩
  show X.basicOpen (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op f) = _
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_res, inf_comm]
  exact (X.basicOpen_mul f g).symm

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.basicOpen_res_le
statement:
theorem basicOpen_res_le (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) {V : X.AffineZariskiSite}
    (g : V ⟶ U) (f : Sec φ U.toOpens) :
    V.basicOpen (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le) f) ≤
      U.basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := g.le
  refine ⟨res φ (X.basicOpen_le f) h₀, ?_⟩
  show X.basicOpen (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op h₀) = _
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_res, hh₀]
  show X.basicOpen f ⊓ V.toOpens =
    X.basicOpen (X.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le)).op f)
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_res, inf_comm]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.isSheaf_forget
statement:
theorem isSheaf_forget (p : ℕ) :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X)
      (presheafSite φ p ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{u} R))
proof:
:= by
  intro U S hS x hx
  have hspan : @Ideal.span (Sec φ U.toOpens) _ (sectionsOfPresieve S.1) = ⊤ :=
    mem_grothendieckTopology_iff_sectionsOfPresieve.mp hS
  obtain ⟨s₀, hsub, hs₀⟩ := (Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite _).mp hspan
  
  have hcompat : ∀ (f g : Sec φ U.toOpens) (hf : f ∈ s₀) (hg : g ∈ s₀),
      DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_left φ f g)) p
        (x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) (hsub hf)) =
      DeRham.map (res φ (basicOpen_mul_le_right φ f g)) p
        (x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le g)) (hsub hg)) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hf' : S.arrows (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) := hsub hf
    have hg' : S.arrows (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le g)) := hsub hg
    exact hx (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_site_le_left φ U f g))
      (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_site_le_right φ U f g)) hf' hg'
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue φ U p s₀ hs₀
    (fun f hf => x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) (hsub hf)) hcompat
  
  have hamalg : x.IsAmalgamation z := by
    intro V g hg
    have hVspan : Ideal.span
        ((res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le)) ''
          (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens))) = ⊤ := by
      have hms := Ideal.map_span (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le))
        (↑s₀ : Set (Sec φ U.toOpens))
      rw [← hms, hs₀, Ideal.map_top]
    apply eq_of_res_map_eq_of_span φ V hVspan p
    rintro f' ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hf' : S.arrows (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) := hsub hf
    
    have hR : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le
        (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le) f))) p (x g hg) =
        DeRham.map (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono
          (basicOpen_res_le φ U g f))) p (x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) hf') :=
      hx (homOfLE (V.basicOpen_le
        (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le) f)))
        (homOfLE (basicOpen_res_le φ U g f)) hg hf' (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    have hy0 : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z =
        x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) hf' := hz f hf
    show DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le
        (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le) f))) p
        (DeRham.map (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le)) p z) =
      DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le
        (res φ (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono g.le) f))) p (x g hg)
    rw [hR, ← hy0]
    exact (map_res_map_res φ _ _ p z).trans (map_res_map_res φ _ _ p z).symm
  
  refine ⟨z, hamalg, fun t' ht' => ?_⟩
  apply eq_of_res_map_eq_of_span φ U hspan p
  intro f hf
  have h1 : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p t' =
      x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) hf := ht' _ hf
  have h2 : DeRham.map (res φ (X.basicOpen_le f)) p z =
      x (homOfLE (U.basicOpen_le f)) hf := hamalg _ hf
  rw [h1, h2]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.isSheaf_presheafSite
statement:
theorem isSheaf_presheafSite (p : ℕ) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X)
      (presheafSite φ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (forget (ModuleCat.{u} R)),
    isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type]
  exact isSheaf_forget φ p

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.isSheaf_presheafSiteAb
statement:
theorem isSheaf_presheafSiteAb (p : ℕ) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X)
      (presheafSite φ p ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
    isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type]
  show Presieve.IsSheaf _ (presheafSite φ p ⋙
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
  rw [HasForget₂.forget_comp]
  exact isSheaf_forget φ p

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamSheaf.dSheafAb_comp_dSheafAb
statement: theorem dSheafAb_comp_dSheafAb (p : ℕ) : dSheafAb φ p ≫ dSheafAb φ (p + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  show Functor.whiskerRight (dSite φ p) (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (dSite φ (p + 1)) (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) =
    (0 : presheafSite φ p ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⟶
      presheafSite φ (p + 1 + 1) ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  rw [← Functor.whiskerRight_comp, dSite_comp_dSite, Functor.whiskerRight_zero]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.toModuleCat_map_hom

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.lmap_add_toLinearMap
statement:

    (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((f + g) n).toLinearMap)
      = (DirectSum.lmap fun n => (f n).toLinearMap)
        + (DirectSum.lmap fun n => (g n).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun n => LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
    DirectSum.lmap_lof, add_apply, HodgeStructCat.add_toLinearMap, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.kernelι_component_injective

theorem kernelι_component_injective (n : ℤ) :

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.lmap_kernelι_injective
statement:
theorem lmap_kernelι_injective :
    Function.Injective (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.lmap_comp_lmap_kernelι
statement:
theorem lmap_comp_lmap_kernelι :
    (DirectSum.lmap fun n => (f n).toLinearMap).comp
      (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun n => LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have h0 : (f n).toLinearMap (((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap v) = 0 :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (HodgeHom.toLinearMap_comp_kernelIncl (f n)) v
  exact (congrArg
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => (Y.component k).carrier) n) h0).trans
    (map_zero _)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.map_kernelι_comp

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.mem_range_kernelι_component
proof:
:= by
  have h : LinearMap.range ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.ker (f n).toLinearMap :=
    HodgeStructCat.range_kernelι_toLinearMap (f n)
  rw [h]
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hv

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.mem_range_lmap_kernelι
statement:
theorem mem_range_lmap_kernelι (x : ⨁ n : ℤ, (X.component n).carrier)
    (hx : (DirectSum.lmap fun n => (f n).toLinearMap) x = 0) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.range
      (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.range_lmap, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_pi]
  intro n _
  refine mem_range_kernelι_component f ?_
  have h3 := congrArg
    (fun t : ⨁ k : ℤ, (Y.component k).carrier => t n) hx
  simpa using h3

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.kernelMapLift_comp
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply _
      (h := lmap_kernelι_injective f) (kernelCorestrict f g' hg' w)).trans
    (LinearMap.codRestrict_apply _ g'.hom w)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.kernelMapLift_unique
statement:
theorem kernelMapLift_unique {W' : ModuleCat.{u} ℚ}
    (g' : W' ⟶ toModuleCat.obj X) (hg' : g' ≫ toModuleCat.map f = 0)
    (m : W' ⟶ toModuleCat.obj (kernelObj f))
    (hm : m ≫ toModuleCat.map (kernelι f) = g') :
    m = kernelMapLift f g' hg'
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  apply lmap_kernelι_injective f
  have h1 : (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap) (m.hom w)
      = g'.hom w :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun
      (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hm :
        (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap).comp m.hom
          = g'.hom) w
  have h2 : (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap)
        ((kernelMapLift f g' hg').hom w) = g'.hom w :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun
      (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (kernelMapLift_comp f g' hg') :
        (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap).comp
          (kernelMapLift f g' hg').hom = g'.hom) w
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.lmap_cokernelπ_comp_lmap

theorem lmap_cokernelπ_comp_lmap :
    (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap).comp
      (DirectSum.lmap fun n => (f n).toLinearMap) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun n => LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have h0 : ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap ((f n).toLinearMap v) = 0 :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (HodgeHom.cokernelProj_comp_toLinearMap (f n)) v
  exact (congrArg
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => ((cokernelObj f).component k).carrier) n)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.map_comp_cokernelπ

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.range_le_ker_descComponent
statement:
theorem range_le_ker_descComponent {Z' : ModuleCat.{u} ℚ}
    (g' : toModuleCat.obj Y ⟶ Z') (hg' : toModuleCat.map f ≫ g' = 0)
    (n : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.range (f n).toLinearMap
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (cokernelDescComponent g' n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have h1 : g'.hom.comp (DirectSum.lmap fun k => (f k).toLinearMap) = 0 :=
    congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hg'
  have h2 : DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => (Y.component k).carrier) n
        ((f n).toLinearMap v)
      = (DirectSum.lmap fun k => (f k).toLinearMap)
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => (X.component k).carrier) n v) :=
    (DirectSum.lmap_lof (fun k => (f k).toLinearMap) n v).symm
  have h3 : cokernelDescComponent g' n ((f n).toLinearMap v)
      = g'.hom ((DirectSum.lmap fun k => (f k).toLinearMap)
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => (X.component k).carrier) n v)) :=
    congrArg g'.hom h2
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    (h3.trans (LinearMap.congr_fun h1
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => (X.component k).carrier) n v)))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.cokernelMapDesc_hom_lof
statement:
theorem cokernelMapDesc_hom_lof {Z' : ModuleCat.{u} ℚ}
    (g' : toModuleCat.obj Y ⟶ Z') (hg' : toModuleCat.map f ≫ g' = 0)
    (n : ℤ) (q : ((cokernelObj f).component n).carrier) :
    (cokernelMapDesc f g' hg').hom
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun k => ((cokernelObj f).component k).carrier)
          n q)
      = (LinearMap.range (f n).toLinearMap).liftQ
          (cokernelDescComponent g' n)
          (range_le_ker_descComponent f g' hg' n) q
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof ℚ
    (M := fun k => ((cokernelObj f).component k).carrier) (N := Z')
    (φ := fun k => (LinearMap.range (f k).toLinearMap).liftQ
      (cokernelDescComponent g' k) (range_le_ker_descComponent f g' hg' k))
    n q

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.map_cokernelπ_comp_cokernelMapDesc
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun n => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  have h2 : (DirectSum.lmap fun k => ((cokernelπ f) k).toLinearMap)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) n y)
      = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
          (fun k => ((cokernelObj f).component k).carrier) n
          (((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap y) :=
    DirectSum.lmap_lof (fun k => ((cokernelπ f) k).toLinearMap) n y
  exact (congrArg (cokernelMapDesc f g' hg').hom h2).trans
    ((cokernelMapDesc_hom_lof f g' hg' n
        (((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap y)).trans
      (LinearMap.congr_fun
        (Submodule.liftQ_mkQ (LinearMap.range (f n).toLinearMap)
          (cokernelDescComponent g' n)
          (range_le_ker_descComponent f g' hg' n)) y))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.cokernelMapDesc_unique
statement:
theorem cokernelMapDesc_unique {Z' : ModuleCat.{u} ℚ}
    (g' : toModuleCat.obj Y ⟶ Z') (hg' : toModuleCat.map f ≫ g' = 0)
    (m : toModuleCat.obj (cokernelObj f) ⟶ Z')
    (hm : toModuleCat.map (cokernelπ f) ≫ m = g') :
    m = cokernelMapDesc f g' hg'
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := lmap_cokernelπ_surjective f z
  have h1 : m.hom
        ((DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap) y)
      = g'.hom y :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun
      (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hm :
        m.hom.comp (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap)
          = g'.hom) y
  have h2 : (cokernelMapDesc f g' hg').hom
        ((DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap) y)
      = g'.hom y :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun
      (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
        (map_cokernelπ_comp_cokernelMapDesc f g' hg') :
        (cokernelMapDesc f g' hg').hom.comp
          (DirectSum.lmap fun n => ((cokernelπ f) n).toLinearMap)
          = g'.hom) y
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagProper.comparisonPresheafChartsProper_app
statement:
theorem comparisonPresheafChartsProper_app (p : ℕ) (U : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    (comparisonPresheafChartsProper sX d p).app U =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (secRealizeFamilyHom (d := d) p (unop U))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagProper.comparisonPresheafChartsProper_square
statement:
theorem comparisonPresheafChartsProper_square (p : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (dOpens (cRingHom sX) p)
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{0} ℂ) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ≫
        comparisonPresheafChartsProper sX d (p + 1) =
      comparisonPresheafChartsProper sX d p ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).op
          (dPresheafChartsAb sX d p)
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun c => ?_)
  show secRealizeChartOpen c (p + 1) (unop U)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) (unop U)) p x) =
    dSection (secRealizeChartOpen c p (unop U) x)
  exact (secRealizeChartOpen_d c p (unop U) x).symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagProper.comparisonSiteChartsProper_square
statement:
theorem comparisonSiteChartsProper_square (p : ℕ) :
    dSheafAb (cRingHom sX) p ≫ comparisonSiteChartsProper sX d (p + 1) =
      comparisonSiteChartsProper sX d p ≫
        (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.sheafEquiv (X := X)
            (A := AddCommGrpCat.{0})).inverse.map
          ((pushforwardAb (sPointsToZariski sX)).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p))
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  have h := congrArg
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor X).op)
    (comparisonPresheafChartsProper_square sX d p)
  rw [Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp] at h
  exact h

proof:

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.kernel_ι_component_injective
statement:
theorem kernel_ι_component_injective {X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℤ) : Function.Injective ((kernel.ι f) n).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (HodgeStructCat.kernelι (f n)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((kernelIso f).hom n).toLinearMap = ((kernel.ι f) n).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (congrFun (kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι f) n)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact (HodgeStructCat.kernelι_toLinearMap_injective (f n)).comp
    (iso_hom_component_bijective (kernelIso f) n).injective

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.range_kernel_ι_component
statement:
theorem range_kernel_ι_component {X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℤ) : LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι f) n).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.ker (f n).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap.comp
      ((kernelIso f).hom n).toLinearMap = ((kernel.ι f) n).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (congrFun (kernelIso_hom_comp_kernelι f) n)
  calc LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι f) n).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.range (((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap.comp
          ((kernelIso f).hom n).toLinearMap) :=
        congrArg (fun t => LinearMap.range t) h.symm
    _ = LinearMap.range ((kernelι f) n).toLinearMap :=
        LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _
          (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr
            (iso_hom_component_bijective (kernelIso f) n).surjective)
    _ = LinearMap.ker (f n).toLinearMap :=
        HodgeStructCat.range_kernelι_toLinearMap (f n)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.cokernel_π_component_surjective
statement:
theorem cokernel_π_component_surjective {X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℤ) : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π f) n).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((cokernelIso f).inv n).toLinearMap.comp
      (HodgeStructCat.cokernelπ (f n)).toLinearMap
        = ((cokernel.π f) n).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap
      (congrFun (cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv f) n)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact (iso_inv_component_bijective (cokernelIso f) n).surjective.comp
    (HodgeStructCat.cokernelπ_toLinearMap_surjective (f n))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.ker_cokernel_π_component
statement:
theorem ker_cokernel_π_component {X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℤ) : LinearMap.ker ((cokernel.π f) n).toLinearMap
      = LinearMap.range (f n).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((cokernelIso f).inv n).toLinearMap.comp
      (HodgeStructCat.cokernelπ (f n)).toLinearMap
        = ((cokernel.π f) n).toLinearMap :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap
      (congrFun (cokernelπ_comp_cokernelIso_inv f) n)
  rw [← h, LinearMap.ker_comp,
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
      (iso_inv_component_bijective (cokernelIso f) n).injective,
    Submodule.comap_bot]
  exact HodgeStructCat.ker_cokernelπ_toLinearMap (f n)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coimageImageComparison_component_bijective
statement:
theorem coimageImageComparison_component_bijective
    {X Y : HodgeFamily.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective ((Abelian.coimageImageComparison f) n).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  bijective_of_factorization
    (π := ((Abelian.coimage.π f) n).toLinearMap)
    (φ := ((Abelian.coimageImageComparison f) n).toLinearMap)
    (ι := ((Abelian.image.ι f) n).toLinearMap)
    (g := (f n).toLinearMap)
    (congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap
      (congrFun (Abelian.coimage_image_factorisation f) n))
    (cokernel_π_component_surjective (kernel.ι f) n)
    (kernel_ι_component_injective (cokernel.π f) n)
    ((ker_cokernel_π_component (kernel.ι f) n).trans
      (range_kernel_ι_component f n))
    ((range_kernel_ι_component (cokernel.π f) n).trans
      (ker_cokernel_π_component f n))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFixed_toLinearMap {X Y : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {m : ℤ} (hx : m = X.weight) (hy : m = Y.weight) :
    (f.toFixed hx hy).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed_comp
statement:
theorem toFixed_comp {X Y Z : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    {m : ℤ} (hx : m = X.weight) (hy : m = Y.weight) (hz : m = Z.weight) :
    @Eq (HodgeStructCat.of X.carrier (X.str.weightCast hx.symm) ⟶
          HodgeStructCat.of Z.carrier (Z.str.weightCast hz.symm))
      (HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed (f ≫ g) hx hz)
      (@CategoryStruct.comp (HodgeStructCat.{u} m) _
        (HodgeStructCat.of X.carrier (X.str.weightCast hx.symm))
        (HodgeStructCat.of Y.carrier (Y.str.weightCast hy.symm))
        (HodgeStructCat.of Z.carrier (Z.str.weightCast hz.symm))
        (HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed f hx hy)
        (HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed g hy hz))
proof:
:=
  HodgeHom.ext rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem toFixed_comp_eq_zero {X Y Z : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) {m : ℤ} (hx : m = X.weight) (hz : m = Z.weight)
    (hy : m ≠ Y.weight) :
    HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed (f ≫ g) hx hz
      = (0 : HodgeStructCat.of X.carrier (X.str.weightCast hx.symm) ⟶
            HodgeStructCat.of Z.carrier (Z.str.weightCast hz.symm))
proof:
:=
  HodgeHom.ext (by
    show g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap = 0
    rw [HodgeStruct.toLinearMap_eq_zero_of_weight_ne f
      (fun hEq => hy (hx.trans hEq)), LinearMap.comp_zero])

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.ofTotalObj_component_pos
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.ofTotalMap_apply_pos
statement:
theorem ofTotalMap_apply_pos {X Y : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {m : ℤ}
    (hx : m = X.weight) (hy : m = Y.weight) :
    ofTotalMap f m
      = eqToHom (ofTotalObj_component_pos X hx)
          ≫ HodgeStruct.Hom.toFixed f hx hy
          ≫ eqToHom (ofTotalObj_component_pos Y hy).symm
proof:

  (dif_pos hx).trans (dif_pos hy)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.ofTotalMap_apply_of_ne_left

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.ofTotalMap_apply_of_ne_right

theorem ofTotalMap_apply_of_ne_right {X Y : HodgeStruct.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)

proof:
