name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.single_obj_eq_ofTotal_obj
statement:
theorem single_obj_eq_ofTotal_obj (n : ℤ) (X : HodgeStructCat.{u} n) :
    (single n).obj X = ofTotal.obj ((HodgeStruct.incl n).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_component (funext fun m => ?_)
  show (singleObj n X).component m
    = (ofTotalObj ((HodgeStruct.incl n).obj X)).component m
  by_cases h : m = n
  · rw [singleObj_component_pos X h,
      ofTotalObj_component_pos ((HodgeStruct.incl n).obj X) h]
    rfl
  · rw [singleObj_component_of_ne X h,
      ofTotalObj_component_of_ne ((HodgeStruct.incl n).obj X) h]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.single_map_eq_ofTotal_map
statement:
theorem single_map_eq_ofTotal_map (n : ℤ) {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{u} n}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (singleMap f : singleObj n X ⟶ singleObj n Y)
      = ofTotalMap ((HodgeStruct.incl n).map f)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  by_cases h : m = n
  · rw [singleMap_apply_pos f h,
      ofTotalMap_apply_pos ((HodgeStruct.incl n).map f) h h]
    rfl
  · rw [singleMap_apply_of_ne f h,
      ofTotalMap_apply_of_ne_left ((HodgeStruct.incl n).map f) h]
    exact HodgeHom.ext rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.single_eq_incl_comp_ofTotal
statement:
theorem single_eq_incl_comp_ofTotal (n : ℤ) :
    single.{u} n = HodgeStruct.incl n ⋙ ofTotal
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun X => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  show singleMap f
    = eqToHom rfl ≫ ofTotalMap ((HodgeStruct.incl n).map f) ≫ eqToHom rfl
  rw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact single_map_eq_ofTotal_map n f

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.proj_of_mem
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.proj_of_mem (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A)
    {i : ι} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ A i) : hA.proj i x = ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:=
  hA.ofBijective_coeLinearMap_of_mem hx

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.proj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.proj_of_mem_ne (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A)
    {i j : ι} (hij : j ≠ i) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ A j) : hA.proj i x = 0
proof:
:=
  hA.ofBijective_coeLinearMap_of_mem_ne hij hx

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.sum_coe_proj
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.sum_coe_proj (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A)
    (u : M) {s : Finset ι} (hs : ∀ i, A i ≠ ⊥ → i ∈ s) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, ((hA.proj i u : A i) : M)) = u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set x := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap A) hA).symm u with hxdef
  have hu : DirectSum.coeLinearMap A x = u :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap A) hA).apply_symm_apply u
  have hsupp : x.support ⊆ s := by
    intro i hi
    refine hs i fun hbot => ?_
    refine DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi ?_
    exact Subtype.ext ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot _ (x i).2)
  have hkey : (∑ i ∈ x.support, ((x i : A i) : M)) = u := by
    have h1 := congrArg (DirectSum.coeLinearMap A) (DirectSum.sum_support_of x)
    rw [map_sum] at h1
    simp only [DirectSum.coeLinearMap_of] at h1
    exact h1.trans hu
  calc (∑ i ∈ s, ((hA.proj i u : A i) : M))
      = ∑ i ∈ s, ((x i : A i) : M) := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => rfl
    _ = ∑ i ∈ x.support, ((x i : A i) : M) :=
        (Finset.sum_subset hsupp fun i _ hi => by
          rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hi]; rfl).symm
    _ = u := hkey

name: iSupIndep.eq_of_le_of_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem _root_.iSupIndep.eq_of_le_of_iSup_eq_top {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α]
    [IsModularLattice α] {ι : Type*} {B C : ι → α} (hB : iSupIndep B)
    (hle : ∀ i, C i ≤ B i) (htop : (⨆ i, C i) = ⊤) (i : ι) : C i = B i
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : (⨆ j, C j) = C i ⊔ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), C j := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun j => ?_)
      (sup_le (le_iSup C i) (iSup₂_le fun j _ => le_iSup C j))
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; exact le_sup_left
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ i) => C j) j hj)
  have hdisj : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), C j) ⊓ B i = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.mp <| calc
      (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), C j) ⊓ B i
          ≤ (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), B j) ⊓ B i :=
            inf_le_inf_right _ (iSup₂_le fun j hj =>
              le_trans (hle j) (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ i) => B j) j hj))
      _ = ⊥ := by rw [inf_comm]; exact disjoint_iff.mp (hB i)
  refine Eq.symm ?_
  calc B i = (⨆ j, C j) ⊓ B i := by rw [htop, top_inf_eq]
    _ = (C i ⊔ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), C j) ⊓ B i := by rw [hsplit]
    _ = C i ⊔ (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), C j) ⊓ B i := sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (hle i)
    _ = C i ⊔ ⊥ := by rw [hdisj]
    _ = C i := sup_bot_eq _

name: HodgePilot.hodgeUnit_H
statement:
theorem hodgeUnit_H (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    hodgeUnit.H pq = if pq = ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) then ⊤ else ⊥
proof:
:= by
  show (if pq = ((-(0 : ℤ)), (-(0 : ℤ))) then (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ)) else ⊥) = _
  simp only [neg_zero]

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_contractLeft_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_contractLeft_tensorEquiv (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V)
    (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    (contractLeft ℚ V).baseChange ℂ (tensorEquiv (Module.Dual ℚ V) V (y ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)) =
      dualEquiv V y z ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy₁, hy₂]
  | tmul c f =>
      induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero,
          TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
      | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hz₁, hz₂,
            TensorProduct.add_tmul]
      | tmul d v =>
          rw [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, contractLeft_apply,
            dualEquiv_tmul]
          calc (d * c) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (f v)
              = (d * c) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ((f v) • (1 : ℚ)) := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
            _ = ((f v) • (d * c)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) :=
                (TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _).symm
            _ = (d * c * ((f v : ℚ) : ℂ)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) := by
                rw [Rat.smul_def]
                congr 1
                ring

name: HodgePilot.dualEquiv_baseChange_eval
statement:
theorem dualEquiv_baseChange_eval (v' : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    dualEquiv (Module.Dual ℚ V) ((Module.Dual.eval ℚ V).baseChange ℂ v') y =
      dualEquiv V y v'
proof:
:= by
  induction v' using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add v₁ v₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul d v =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂]
      | tmul c f =>
          rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, dualEquiv_tmul, dualEquiv_tmul,
            Module.Dual.eval_apply]
          ring

name: HodgePilot.endoOfTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem endoOfTensor_tmul (w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
    (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    endoOfTensor V (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) =
      dualTensorHom ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (dualEquiv V y ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [endoOfTensor, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, TensorProduct.comm_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.endoOfTensor_injective
statement: theorem endoOfTensor_injective : Function.Injective (endoOfTensor V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd : Function.Injective (dualTensorHom ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :=
    Function.LeftInverse.injective
      (g := (dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis (Basis.ofVectorSpace ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))).symm)
      (fun x => dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis_symm_cancel_left _ x)
  have hcoe : ⇑(endoOfTensor V) =
      ⇑(dualTensorHom ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) ∘
        ⇑(TensorProduct.comm ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))) ∘
        ⇑(TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) (dualEquiv V)) := by
    simp only [endoOfTensor, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [hcoe]
  exact hd.comp ((TensorProduct.comm ℂ _ _).injective.comp
    (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ _) (dualEquiv V)).injective)

name: HodgePilot.ratCast_smul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem ratCast_smul_one_tmul (q : ℚ) (w : V) :
    ((q : ℂ)) • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (q • w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    show ((q : ℂ)) = q • (1 : ℂ) by rw [Rat.smul_def, mul_one],
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.tensorEquiv_symm_one_coev
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_one_coev :
    (tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coevaluation ℚ V 1) =
      ∑ i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex ℚ V,
        ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ V i) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
          ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ V).coord i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coevaluation_apply_one]
  dsimp only
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, tensorEquiv_tmul, one_mul]

name: HodgePilot.endoOfTensor_coev_eq_id
statement:
theorem endoOfTensor_coev_eq_id :
    endoOfTensor V ((tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm
      ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coevaluation ℚ V 1)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquiv_symm_one_coev, map_sum]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, endoOfTensor_tmul,
    dualTensorHom_apply]
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul d v =>
      simp only [dualEquiv_tmul, mul_one, mul_smul, ratCast_smul_one_tmul,
        Basis.coord_apply]
      rw [← Finset.smul_sum, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum, Basis.sum_repr,
        TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.map_baseChange_contractLeft_summand
statement:
theorem map_baseChange_contractLeft_summand (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    {x1 x2 : ℤ × ℤ} (hne : x2 ≠ (-x1.1, -x1.2)) :
    ((LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (dualPiece h x1) (h.H x2))).map
        ((tensorEquiv (Module.Dual ℚ V) V : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _))).map
      ((contractLeft ℚ V).baseChange ℂ) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2,
    Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
  intro z hz
  simp only [Set.image_image2, Set.mem_image2] at hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, v', hv', rfl⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
  have hz0 : ψ v' = 0 := by
    rw [dualPieceAux_def, Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hψ
    exact hψ v' (H_le_otherPieces h hne hv')
  show (contractLeft ℚ V).baseChange ℂ
      (tensorEquiv (Module.Dual ℚ V) V (((dualEquiv V).symm ψ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v')) = 0
  rw [baseChange_contractLeft_tensorEquiv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hz0,
    TensorProduct.zero_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.evalHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem QHodgeStructure.evalHom_toLinearMap (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    h.evalHom.toLinearMap = contractLeft ℚ V
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.map_H_eq
statement:
theorem HodgeHom.map_H_eq {hV : QHodgeStructure n V} {hW : QHodgeStructure n W}
    (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (hf : Function.Surjective (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ))
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (hV.H pq).map (f.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) = hW.H pq
proof:
:=
  iSupIndep.eq_of_le_of_iSup_eq_top hW.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
    f.maps_pieces
    (by
      rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hV.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top,
        Submodule.map_top]
      exact LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hf) pq

name: HodgePilot.HodgeHom.inverse_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem HodgeHom.inverse_toLinearMap {hV : QHodgeStructure n V}
    {hW : QHodgeStructure n W} (f : HodgeHom hV hW) (e : V ≃ₗ[ℚ] W)
    (he : (e : V →ₗ[ℚ] W) = f.toLinearMap) :
    (f.inverse e he).toLinearMap = (e.symm : W →ₗ[ℚ] V)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.doubleDualHom_toLinearMap

@[simp] theorem QHodgeStructure.doubleDualHom_toLinearMap

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.doubleDualHom_bijective
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.doubleDualHom_bijective (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    Function.Bijective h.doubleDualHom.toLinearMap

name: HodgePilot.exists_endoOfTensor_eq_proj
statement:
theorem exists_endoOfTensor_eq_proj (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ∃ t ∈ LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H pq) (dualPiece h (-pq.1, -pq.2))),
      endoOfTensor V t = (h.H pq).subtype ∘ₗ h.isInternal.proj pq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set e : Basis _ ℂ (h.H pq) := Basis.ofVectorSpace ℂ (h.H pq) with he
  set φ : _ → Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :=
    fun i => (e.coord i) ∘ₗ (h.isInternal.proj pq) with hφ
  have hφmem : ∀ i, φ i ∈ dualPieceAux h (-pq.1, -pq.2) := by
    intro i
    have haux : dualPieceAux h (-pq.1, -pq.2) =
        (otherPieces h pq).dualAnnihilator := by
      rw [dualPieceAux_pair, neg_neg, neg_neg]
    rw [haux, Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    intro w hw
    have hker : otherPieces h pq ≤ LinearMap.ker (φ i) := by
      rw [otherPieces_def]
      refine iSup₂_le fun ab hab => ?_
      intro a ha
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφ]
      show e.coord i (h.isInternal.proj pq a) = 0
      rw [h.isInternal.proj_of_mem_ne hab ha, map_zero]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hker hw)
  refine ⟨∑ i, ((e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ((dualEquiv V).symm (φ i))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
      ⟨(e i) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (⟨(dualEquiv V).symm (φ i),
        Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨φ i, hφmem i, rfl⟩⟩ :
          dualPiece h (-pq.1, -pq.2)), rfl⟩
  · rw [map_sum]
    refine LinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, endoOfTensor_tmul, dualTensorHom_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hφ, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      Submodule.coe_subtype, Basis.coord_apply]
    have hsub : ((h.H pq).subtype)
        (∑ i, (e.repr (h.isInternal.proj pq u) i) • e i)
        = ∑ i, (e.repr (h.isInternal.proj pq u) i) • ((e i : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) := by
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul, Submodule.coe_subtype]
    rw [← hsub, Basis.sum_repr]
    rfl

name: HodgePilot.coev_one_mem
statement:
theorem coev_one_mem (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coevaluation ℚ V 1) ∈
      tensorPiece h h.dual ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Submodule ℂ ((ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ⊗[ℂ] (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V)) :=
    ⨆ (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : x.1 + x.2 = ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))),
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (dualPiece h x.2))
    with hSdef
  have hpiece : tensorPiece h h.dual ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) =
      S.map ((tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V) : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)) := by
    rw [tensorPiece_def, hSdef]
    simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
    rfl
  choose t ht hteq using fun pq : ℤ × ℤ => exists_endoOfTensor_eq_proj h pq
  have hfin : {ab : ℤ × ℤ | h.H ab ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hTmem : (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, t pq) ∈ S := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun pq _ => ?_
    have hle : LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H pq) (dualPiece h (-pq.1, -pq.2))) ≤ S := by
      rw [hSdef]
      refine le_iSup₂
        (f := fun (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : x.1 + x.2 = ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))) =>
          LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (dualPiece h x.2)))
        (pq, (-pq.1, -pq.2)) ?_
      exact Prod.ext (add_neg_cancel pq.1) (add_neg_cancel pq.2)
    exact hle (ht pq)
  have hTid : endoOfTensor V (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, t pq) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [map_sum]
    refine LinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    have hterm : ∀ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, (endoOfTensor V (t pq)) u
        = ((h.isInternal.proj pq u : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) := fun pq _ => by
      rw [hteq pq]; rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
    exact h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj u fun i hi => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hi
  have hteqT : (tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm
      ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coevaluation ℚ V 1) = ∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, t pq :=
    endoOfTensor_injective V (by rw [endoOfTensor_coev_eq_id, hTid])
  rw [hpiece]
  refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr
    ⟨(tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coevaluation ℚ V 1),
      ?_, (tensorEquiv V (Module.Dual ℚ V)).apply_symm_apply _⟩
  rw [hteqT]
  exact hTmem

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.coevalHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem QHodgeStructure.coevalHom_toLinearMap (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    h.coevalHom.toLinearMap = coevaluation ℚ V
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.evalHom_assoc_coevalHom
statement:
theorem evalHom_assoc_coevalHom (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    (h.evalHom.toLinearMap).rTensor (Module.Dual ℚ V) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ V) V
          (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          (h.coevalHom.toLinearMap).lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ V) =
      (TensorProduct.lid ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ V)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.rid ℚ (Module.Dual ℚ V)).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation ℚ V

name: HodgePilot.evalHom_assoc_coevalHom'
statement:
theorem evalHom_assoc_coevalHom' (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    (h.evalHom.toLinearMap).lTensor V ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ V (Module.Dual ℚ V) V).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          (h.coevalHom.toLinearMap).rTensor V =
      (TensorProduct.rid ℚ V).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.lid ℚ V).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation' ℚ V

name: HodgePilot.pairLeft_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairLeft_tmul (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) (m : M) (a : A) :
    pairLeft f (m ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a) = f m • a
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairLeft]

name: HodgePilot.pairLeft_comp_rTensor
statement:
theorem pairLeft_comp_rTensor {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N]
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ N) (g : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) :
    pairLeft f ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor A g = pairLeft (f ∘ₗ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun m a => ?_
  simp [pairLeft]

name: HodgePilot.sum_dual_apply_smul_apply'
statement:
theorem sum_dual_apply_smul_apply' (b : Basis ι ℚ M)
    (ξ : Module.Dual ℚ M ⊗[ℚ] M →ₗ[ℚ] A) (f : Module.Dual ℚ M) (v : M) :
    ∑ i, f (b i) • ξ (b.coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = ξ (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_dual_apply_smul_coord f, TensorProduct.sum_tmul,
    map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClass_map
statement:
theorem hodgeClass_map {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {v : X.carrier} (hv : v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X) :
    g.toLinearMap v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff] at hv ⊢
  have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] g.toLinearMap v
      = g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) := by
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  rw [h1]
  exact g.maps_pieces (0, 0) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv)

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_hodgeClassSubmodule_le
statement:
theorem baseChange_hodgeClassSubmodule_le (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    (hodgeClassSubmodule X).baseChange ℂ ≤ X.str.H (0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨w, rfl⟩
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c v =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
      have hmem := (X.str.H (0, 0)).smul_mem c
        (mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff.mp v.2)
      rwa [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hmem
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact (X.str.H (0, 0)).add_mem hx hy

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClassSub_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem hodgeClassSub_toSubmodule (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    (hodgeClassSub X).toSubmodule = hodgeClassSubmodule X
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.H_eq_bot_of_hodgeClass_top
statement:
theorem H_eq_bot_of_hodgeClass_top (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)
    (hX : hodgeClassSubmodule X = ⊤) {pq : ℤ × ℤ} (hpq : pq ≠ (0, 0)) :
    X.str.H pq = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (⊤ : Submodule ℚ X.carrier).baseChange ℂ ≤ X.str.H (0, 0) := by
    rw [← hX]
    exact baseChange_hodgeClassSubmodule_le X
  rw [Submodule.baseChange_top] at h1
  have htop : X.str.H (0, 0) = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp h1
  have hd : Disjoint (X.str.H pq) (X.str.H (0, 0)) :=
    X.str.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint hpq
  rw [htop] at hd
  exact disjoint_top.mp hd

name: HodgePilot.hom_eq_zero_of_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_classes {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : hodgeClassSubmodule X = ⊤) (hY : hodgeClassSubmodule Y = ⊥) :
    g = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
  have hv : g.toLinearMap v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule Y :=
    hodgeClass_map g (hX.ge Submodule.mem_top)
  rw [hY, Submodule.mem_bot] at hv
  rw [HodgeStructCat.zero_toLinearMap', LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact hv

name: HodgePilot.unitProj_apply_eq
statement:
theorem unitProj_apply_eq {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (P : Polarization X.str)
    (v : X.carrier) :
    (unitProj P).toLinearMap v
      = (hodgeClassSub X).toSubmodule.subtype
          ((classCorestrict P).toLinearMap v)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.unitProj_apply_mem
statement:
theorem unitProj_apply_mem {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (P : Polarization X.str)
    (v : X.carrier) :
    (unitProj P).toLinearMap v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitProj_apply_eq]
  exact ((classCorestrict P).toLinearMap v).2

name: HodgePilot.sub_unitProj_mem
statement:
theorem sub_unitProj_mem {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (P : Polarization X.str)
    (v : X.carrier) :
    v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v
      ∈ P.form.orthogonal (hodgeClassSubmodule X)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X => f.toLinearMap v)
    (P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv_hom_id
  simp only [HodgeStructCat.comp_toLinearMap, HodgeStructCat.id_toLinearMap,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h1
  have h2 : ((((P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv.toLinearMap v).1 : X.carrier))
      + ((((P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv.toLinearMap v).2 : X.carrier))
      = v := h1
  have h4 : (unitProj P).toLinearMap v
      = ((((P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv.toLinearMap v).1 : X.carrier)) :=
    rfl
  have h3 : v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v
      = ((((P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv.toLinearMap v).2 : X.carrier)) := by
    rw [h4]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -h2
  rw [h3]
  exact (((P.splitIso' (hodgeClassSub X)).inv.toLinearMap v).2).2

name: HodgePilot.unitProj_apply_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X :=
    Submodule.sub_mem _ hv (unitProj_apply_mem P v)
  have h0 : v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v = 0 :=
    Submodule.disjoint_def.mp
      (P.isCompl_orthogonal (hodgeClassSub X)).disjoint _ hsub
      (sub_unitProj_mem P v)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClass_orthoComplement_eq_bot
statement:
theorem hodgeClass_orthoComplement_eq_bot {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization X.str) :
    hodgeClassSubmodule (HodgeStructCat.of
        ↥(P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule
        (X.str.sub (P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)))) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro w hw
  rw [mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff] at hw
  have h1 : (P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule.subtype.baseChange
      ℂ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) ∈ X.str.H (0, 0) := hw
  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul] at h1
  have h2 : (P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule.subtype w
      ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X := h1
  have hmem : (P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule.subtype w
      ∈ P.form.orthogonal (hodgeClassSubmodule X) :=
    Submodule.coe_mem
      (w : ↥(P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule)
  have h0 : (P.orthoComplement (hodgeClassSub X)).toSubmodule.subtype w = 0 :=
    Submodule.disjoint_def.mp
      (P.isCompl_orthogonal (hodgeClassSub X)).disjoint _ h2 hmem
  exact Subtype.ext h0

name: HodgePilot.H_hodgeClassObj_eq_bot
statement:
theorem H_hodgeClassObj_eq_bot (X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) {pq : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hpq : pq ≠ (0, 0)) : (hodgeClassObj X).str.H pq = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine H_eq_bot_of_hodgeClass_top (hodgeClassObj X) ?_ hpq
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro v
  rw [mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff]
  show (hodgeClassSub X).toSubmodule.subtype.baseChange ℂ ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
      ∈ X.str.H (0, 0)
  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  exact v.2

name: HodgePilot.formTranspose_apply
statement:
theorem formTranspose_apply {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization X.str) (Q : Polarization Y.str) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y.carrier) (x : X.carrier) :
    P.form (formTranspose P Q g y) x = Q.form y (g.toLinearMap x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : P.toDualEquiv (formTranspose P Q g y)
      = g.toLinearMap.dualMap (Q.toDualEquiv y) :=
    P.toDualEquiv.apply_symm_apply _
  calc P.form (formTranspose P Q g y) x
      = (P.toDualEquiv (formTranspose P Q g y)) x := rfl
    _ = (g.toLinearMap.dualMap (Q.toDualEquiv y)) x := by rw [h1]
    _ = Q.form y (g.toLinearMap x) := rfl

name: HodgePilot.baseChangeℂ_formTranspose
statement:
theorem baseChangeℂ_formTranspose {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization X.str) (Q : Polarization Y.str) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y.carrier) (z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] X.carrier) :
    baseChangeℂ P.form ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] formTranspose P Q g y) z
      = baseChangeℂ Q.form ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)
          (g.toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul s x =>
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul,
        LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, formTranspose_apply]
  | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]

name: HodgePilot.formTranspose_mem_hodgeClass
statement:
theorem formTranspose_mem_hodgeClass {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization X.str) (Q : Polarization Y.str) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {c : Y.carrier} (hc : c ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule Y) :
    formTranspose P Q g c ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff]
  refine P.mem_H_of_forall_otherPieces (a := 0) (b := 0) ?_
  intro z hz
  have hker : otherPieces X.str (0, 0)
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] formTranspose P Q g c)) := by
    refine iSup_le fun ab => iSup_le fun hab => fun w hw => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, baseChangeℂ_formTranspose]
    exact Q.orthogonal 0 0 ab.1 ab.2 hab _
      (mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff.mp hc) _
      (g.maps_pieces ab (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hw))
  exact hker hz

name: HodgePilot.unitProj_naturality
proof:
:= by
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
  simp only [HodgeStructCat.comp_toLinearMap, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hdmem : (unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)
      - g.toLinearMap ((unitProj P).toLinearMap v) ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule Y :=
    Submodule.sub_mem _ (unitProj_apply_mem Q (g.toLinearMap v))
      (hodgeClass_map g (unitProj_apply_mem P v))
  have hall : ∀ c ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule Y,
      Q.form c ((unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)
        - g.toLinearMap ((unitProj P).toLinearMap v)) = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 : Q.form c (g.toLinearMap v
        - (unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)) = 0 :=
      LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff.mp
        (sub_unitProj_mem Q (g.toLinearMap v)) c hc
    have h2 : Q.form c (g.toLinearMap (v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v)) = 0 := by
      have h3 : P.form (formTranspose P Q g c)
          (v - (unitProj P).toLinearMap v) = 0 :=
        LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff.mp (sub_unitProj_mem P v)
          (formTranspose P Q g c) (formTranspose_mem_hodgeClass P Q g hc)
      rw [← formTranspose_apply P Q g]
      exact h3
    simp only [map_sub] at h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination h2 - h1
  have hd0 : (unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)
      - g.toLinearMap ((unitProj P).toLinearMap v) = 0 := by
    have hnd := (Q.restrict_nondegenerate (hodgeClassSub Y)).1
    have hz : (⟨_, hdmem⟩ : ↥(hodgeClassSub Y).toSubmodule) = 0 := by
      refine hnd _ fun c => ?_
      show Q.form ((unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)
        - g.toLinearMap ((unitProj P).toLinearMap v)) (c : Y.carrier) = 0
      rw [Q.symm ((unitProj Q).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap v)
          - g.toLinearMap ((unitProj P).toLinearMap v)) (c : Y.carrier),
        zpow_zero, one_mul]
      exact hall (c : Y.carrier) c.2
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hz
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hd0).symm

name: HodgePilot.wordProj_naturality
statement:
theorem wordProj_naturality {V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (P : Polarization V.str)
    {p q : ℕ × ℕ} (u : word V p ⟶ word V q) :
    wordProj P p ≫ u = u ≫ wordProj P q
proof:
:=
  unitProj_naturality (wordPolarization P p) (wordPolarization P q) u

name: HodgePilot.classLeg_dinatural
statement:
theorem classLeg_dinatural {V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (P : Polarization V.str)
    ⦃p q : WordCat V⦄ (u : p ⟶ q) :
    ((coeffDiagram (wordFiber V)).map u.op).app p ≫ classLeg P p =
      ((coeffDiagram (wordFiber V)).obj (op q)).map u ≫ classLeg P q
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun f v => ?_
  have h : u.hom.toLinearMap ((wordProj P p).toLinearMap v)
      = (wordProj P q).toLinearMap (u.hom.toLinearMap v) := by
    have h0 := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (wordProj_naturality P u.hom)) v
    simpa using h0
  show f (u.hom.toLinearMap ((wordProj P p).toLinearMap v))
      = f ((wordProj P q).toLinearMap (u.hom.toLinearMap v))
  rw [h]

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClassFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem hodgeClassFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff {V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization V.str) (p : WordCat V) :
    hodgeClassFunctional P ∘ₗ matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
      = contractLeft ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p) ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p))
            (wordProj P p).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (coend.ι_desc (fun p => classLeg P p) (classLeg_dinatural P) p)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClassFunctional_matrixCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hodgeClassFunctional_matrixCoeff {V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization V.str) (p : WordCat V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    hodgeClassFunctional P (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))
      = f ((wordProj P p).toLinearMap v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hodgeClassFunctional_comp_matrixCoeff P p)
    (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClass_unit_top
statement:
theorem hodgeClass_unit_top :
    hodgeClassSubmodule (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro v
  have htop : (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0)).str.H (0, 0) = ⊤ := by
    have h := hodgeUnit_H ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h
    exact h
  rw [mem_hodgeClassSubmodule_iff, htop]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClass_top_of_iso
statement:
theorem hodgeClass_top_of_iso {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hX : hodgeClassSubmodule X = ⊤) : hodgeClassSubmodule Y = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro v
  have hw : e.inv.toLinearMap v ∈ hodgeClassSubmodule X :=
    hX.ge Submodule.mem_top
  have h2 := hodgeClass_map e.hom hw
  have h1 : e.hom.toLinearMap (e.inv.toLinearMap v) = v := by simp
  rwa [h1] at h2

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClass_word_empty_top
statement:
theorem hodgeClass_word_empty_top (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    hodgeClassSubmodule (word V (0, 0)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  hodgeClass_top_of_iso (X := 𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0))
    (λ_ (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0))).symm hodgeClass_unit_top

name: HodgePilot.H_word_empty_zero_top
statement:
theorem H_word_empty_zero_top (V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    (word V (0, 0)).str.H (0, 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (⊤ : Submodule ℚ (word V (0, 0)).carrier).baseChange ℂ
      ≤ (word V (0, 0)).str.H (0, 0) := by
    rw [← hodgeClass_word_empty_top V]
    exact baseChange_hodgeClassSubmodule_le (word V (0, 0))
  rw [Submodule.baseChange_top] at h1
  exact top_le_iff.mp h1

name: HodgePilot.hodgeClassFunctional_one
statement:
theorem hodgeClassFunctional_one {V : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (P : Polarization V.str) : hodgeClassFunctional P (mtUnit V) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc hodgeClassFunctional P (mtUnit V)
      = (TensorProduct.lid ℚ ℚ).toLinearMap
          ((wordProj P (0, 0)).toLinearMap
            (((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) : ℚ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ) : (word V (0, 0)).carrier)) :=
        hodgeClassFunctional_matrixCoeff P ((0, 0) : WordCat V) _ _
    _ = (TensorProduct.lid ℚ ℚ).toLinearMap ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)) := by
        have h2 : (wordProj P (0, 0)).toLinearMap
            (((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) : ℚ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ) : (word V (0, 0)).carrier)
            = (((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) : ℚ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ) : (word V (0, 0)).carrier) :=
          unitProj_apply_of_mem (wordPolarization P (0, 0))
            ((hodgeClass_word_empty_top V).ge Submodule.mem_top)
        rw [h2]
    _ = 1 := by simp

name: HodgePilot.pairLeft_wordCoaction
statement:
theorem pairLeft_wordCoaction (p : WordCat V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    pairLeft f (wordCoaction V p v)
      = matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : wordCoaction V p v = ∑ i, coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
      matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
        ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) :=
    coeffCoaction_apply (wordFiber V) p v
  rw [h1, map_sum]
  simp only [pairLeft_tmul]
  exact sum_dual_apply_smul_apply' (coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p)
    (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p) f v

name: HodgePilot.intertwiner_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem intertwiner_matrixCoeff {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ψ : (word V p).carrier →ₗ[ℚ] (word V q).carrier)
    (hψ : LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ ∘ₗ wordCoaction V p
      = wordCoaction V q ∘ₗ ψ)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((word V q).carrier)) (v : (word V p).carrier) :
    matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (q : WordCat V) (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ψ v)
      = matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (p : WordCat V) ((f ∘ₗ ψ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hψ v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h0
  calc matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (q : WordCat V) (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ψ v)
      = pairLeft f (wordCoaction V q (ψ v)) :=
        (pairLeft_wordCoaction V q f (ψ v)).symm
    _ = pairLeft f (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) ψ
          (wordCoaction V p v)) := by rw [h0]
    _ = pairLeft (f ∘ₗ ψ) (wordCoaction V p v) := by
        have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (pairLeft_comp_rTensor f ψ)
          (wordCoaction V p v)
        simpa using h2
    _ = matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (p : WordCat V) ((f ∘ₗ ψ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) :=
        pairLeft_wordCoaction V p (f ∘ₗ ψ) v

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.apply_aeval
statement:
lemma apply_aeval (G : Algebra.Generators ℂ S ι) (φ : CPoints S)
    (q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    φ (aeval G.val q) = eval (ambient G φ) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.algebraMap_apply]
  exact ambient_algebraMap G φ q

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.eval_relation_ambient
statement:
lemma eval_relation_ambient (Pr : Algebra.Presentation ℂ S ι σ)
    (φ : CPoints S) (j : σ) :
    eval (ambient Pr.toGenerators φ) (Pr.relation j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← apply_aeval, Pr.aeval_val_relation, map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.iftChart_coe
statement: lemma iftChart_coe : ⇑(iftChart P φ₀ h) = extendedMap P
proof:
:=
  (hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap_equiv P φ₀ h).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_iftChart_source
statement:
lemma mem_iftChart_source :
    ambient P.toGenerators φ₀ ∈ (iftChart P φ₀ h).source
proof:
:=
  (hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap_equiv P φ₀ h).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.chartFun_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma chartFun_apply (φ : CPoints S) (k : Kappa P) :
    chartFun P φ k = φ (P.val k.val)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.iftChart_ambient
statement:
lemma iftChart_ambient (φ : CPoints S) :
    iftChart P φ₀ h (ambient P.toGenerators φ) = ((0 : σ → ℂ), chartFun P φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrFun (iftChart_coe P φ₀ h) (ambient P.toGenerators φ)
  rw [hc, extendedMap_apply]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
  funext j
  simpa using eval_relation_ambient P.toPresentation φ j

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_chartSource_iff
statement:
lemma mem_chartSource_iff {φ : CPoints S} :
    φ ∈ chartSource P φ₀ h ↔
      ambient P.toGenerators φ ∈ (iftChart P φ₀ h).source
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_chartSource_self
statement: lemma mem_chartSource_self : φ₀ ∈ chartSource P φ₀ h
proof:
:=
  mem_iftChart_source P φ₀ h

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.isOpen_chartSource
statement: lemma isOpen_chartSource : IsOpen (chartSource P φ₀ h)
proof:
:=
  (iftChart P φ₀ h).open_source.preimage
    (isEmbedding_ambient P.toGenerators).continuous

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_chartTarget_iff
statement:
lemma mem_chartTarget_iff {y : Kappa P → ℂ} :
    y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h ↔
      ((0 : σ → ℂ), y) ∈ (iftChart P φ₀ h).target
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.isOpen_chartTarget
statement: lemma isOpen_chartTarget : IsOpen (chartTarget P φ₀ h)
proof:
:=
  (iftChart P φ₀ h).open_target.preimage (Continuous.prodMk_right _)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.symm_mem_range_ambient
statement:
lemma symm_mem_range_ambient {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y) ∈ Set.range (ambient P.toGenerators)
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_ambient P.toPresentation]
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro j
  have hr := (iftChart P φ₀ h).right_inv ((mem_chartTarget_iff P φ₀ h).mp hy)
  have hc := congrFun (iftChart_coe P φ₀ h)
    ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
  rw [hc, extendedMap_apply] at hr
  simpa using congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst hr) j

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.ambient_chartInv
statement:
lemma ambient_chartInv {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    ambient P.toGenerators (chartInv P φ₀ h y)
      = (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints S) := ⟨φ₀⟩
  exact Function.invFun_eq (Set.mem_range.mp (symm_mem_range_ambient P φ₀ h hy))

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.chartFun_mem_chartTarget
statement:
lemma chartFun_mem_chartTarget {φ : CPoints S} (hφ : φ ∈ chartSource P φ₀ h) :
    chartFun P φ ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartTarget_iff, ← iftChart_ambient P φ₀ h φ]
  exact (iftChart P φ₀ h).map_source ((mem_chartSource_iff P φ₀ h).mp hφ)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.chartInv_mem_chartSource
statement:
lemma chartInv_mem_chartSource {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    chartInv P φ₀ h y ∈ chartSource P φ₀ h
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartSource_iff, ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy]
  exact (iftChart P φ₀ h).map_target ((mem_chartTarget_iff P φ₀ h).mp hy)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.chartInv_chartFun
statement:
lemma chartInv_chartFun {φ : CPoints S} (hφ : φ ∈ chartSource P φ₀ h) :
    chartInv P φ₀ h (chartFun P φ) = φ
proof:
:= by
  refine (isEmbedding_ambient P.toGenerators).injective ?_
  rw [ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h (chartFun_mem_chartTarget P φ₀ h hφ),
    ← iftChart_ambient P φ₀ h φ]
  exact (iftChart P φ₀ h).left_inv ((mem_chartSource_iff P φ₀ h).mp hφ)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.chartFun_chartInv
statement:
lemma chartFun_chartInv {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    chartFun P (chartInv P φ₀ h y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hr := (iftChart P φ₀ h).right_inv ((mem_chartTarget_iff P φ₀ h).mp hy)
  have hc := congrFun (iftChart_coe P φ₀ h)
    ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
  rw [hc, extendedMap_apply] at hr
  funext k
  calc chartFun P (chartInv P φ₀ h y) k
      = ambient P.toGenerators (chartInv P φ₀ h y) k.val := rfl
    _ = (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y) k.val := by
        rw [ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy]
    _ = y k := congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd hr) k

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.continuous_chartFun
statement: lemma continuous_chartFun : Continuous (chartFun P)
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi fun k => continuous_ev (P.val k.val)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.continuousOn_chartInv
statement:
lemma continuousOn_chartInv :
    ContinuousOn (chartInv P φ₀ h) (chartTarget P φ₀ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isEmbedding_ambient P.toGenerators).continuousOn_iff]
  have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y : Kappa P → ℂ => (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
      (chartTarget P φ₀ h) :=
    (iftChart P φ₀ h).continuousOn_symm.comp
      (Continuous.prodMk_right _).continuousOn fun _ hy =>
        (mem_chartTarget_iff P φ₀ h).mp hy
  exact h1.congr fun y hy => ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChart_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sliceChart_apply (φ : CPoints S) :
    sliceChart P φ₀ h φ = chartFun P φ
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChart_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sliceChart_symm_apply (y : Kappa P → ℂ) :
    (sliceChart P φ₀ h).symm y = chartInv P φ₀ h y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChart_source
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sliceChart_source :
    (sliceChart P φ₀ h).source = chartSource P φ₀ h
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChart_target
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sliceChart_target :
    (sliceChart P φ₀ h).target = chartTarget P φ₀ h
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_sliceChart_source
statement: lemma mem_sliceChart_source : φ₀ ∈ (sliceChart P φ₀ h).source
proof:
:=
  mem_chartSource_self P φ₀ h

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.ambient_sliceChart_symm
statement:
lemma ambient_sliceChart_symm {y : Kappa P → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ (sliceChart P φ₀ h).target) :
    ambient P.toGenerators ((sliceChart P φ₀ h).symm y)
      = (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)
proof:
:=
  ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_iftChart_symm
statement:
theorem analyticAt_iftChart_symm :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), chartFun P φ₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe := iftChart_coe P φ₀ h
  have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h) (ambient P.toGenerators φ₀) := by
    rw [hcoe]
    exact analyticAt_extendedMap P _
  have h2 : fderiv ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h) (ambient P.toGenerators φ₀)
      = (extendedDerivEquiv P φ₀ h :
          (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (σ → ℂ) × (Kappa P → ℂ)) := by
    rw [hcoe, (hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap P _).hasFDerivAt.fderiv,
      coe_extendedDerivEquiv]
  have h3 := (iftChart P φ₀ h).analyticAt_symm'
    (mem_iftChart_source P φ₀ h) h1 h2
  rwa [iftChart_ambient P φ₀ h φ₀] at h3

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_iftChart_symm_of_mem
statement:
theorem analyticAt_iftChart_symm_of_mem
    (hall : ∀ ψ : CPoints S, IsUnit (ψ P.jacobian))
    {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe := iftChart_coe P φ₀ h
  have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h)
      ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)) := by
    rw [hcoe]
    exact analyticAt_extendedMap P _
  have h2 : fderiv ℂ (iftChart P φ₀ h) ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
      = (extendedDerivEquiv P (chartInv P φ₀ h y) (hall _) :
          (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (σ → ℂ) × (Kappa P → ℂ)) := by
    rw [hcoe, (hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap P _).hasFDerivAt.fderiv,
      coe_extendedDerivEquiv, ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy]
  exact (iftChart P φ₀ h).analyticAt_symm
    ((mem_chartTarget_iff P φ₀ h).mp hy) h1 h2

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_symm_section
statement:
theorem analyticAt_symm_section :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y : Kappa P → ℂ => (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
      (chartFun P φ₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hinr : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y : Kappa P → ℂ => ((0 : σ → ℂ), y))
      (chartFun P φ₀) := analyticAt_const.prod analyticAt_id
  exact (analyticAt_iftChart_symm P φ₀ h).comp hinr

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_symm_section_of_mem
statement:
theorem analyticAt_symm_section_of_mem
    (hall : ∀ ψ : CPoints S, IsUnit (ψ P.jacobian))
    {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y' : Kappa P → ℂ => (iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y'))
      y
proof:
:= by
  have hinr : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y' : Kappa P → ℂ => ((0 : σ → ℂ), y')) y :=
    analyticAt_const.prod analyticAt_id
  exact (analyticAt_iftChart_symm_of_mem P φ₀ h hall hy).comp hinr

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_eval_symm_section
statement:
theorem analyticAt_eval_symm_section (q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun y : Kappa P → ℂ => eval ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)) q)
      (chartFun P φ₀)
proof:
:=
  (analyticAt_eval q _).comp (analyticAt_symm_section P φ₀ h)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_eval_symm_section_of_mem
statement:
theorem analyticAt_eval_symm_section_of_mem
    (hall : ∀ ψ : CPoints S, IsUnit (ψ P.jacobian))
    {y : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h) (q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun y' : Kappa P → ℂ => eval ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y')) q)
      y
proof:
:=
  (analyticAt_eval q _).comp (analyticAt_symm_section_of_mem P φ₀ h hall hy)

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChart_symm_apply_eq_eval
statement:
theorem sliceChart_symm_apply_eq_eval {y : Kappa P → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ (sliceChart P φ₀ h).target) (q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    (sliceChart P φ₀ h).symm y (aeval P.val q)
      = eval ((iftChart P φ₀ h).symm ((0 : σ → ℂ), y)) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [sliceChart_symm_apply, apply_aeval P.toGenerators (chartInv P φ₀ h y) q,
    ambient_chartInv P φ₀ h hy]

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_sliceChart_symm_apply_center
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sliceChart_symm_apply_center (s : S) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (sliceChart P φ₀ h).symm y s)
      (sliceChart P φ₀ h φ₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := P.toGenerators.aeval_val_surjective s
  have h1 := analyticAt_eval_symm_section P φ₀ h q
  refine h1.congr ?_
  have hy₀ : chartFun P φ₀ ∈ chartTarget P φ₀ h :=
    chartFun_mem_chartTarget P φ₀ h (mem_chartSource_self P φ₀ h)
  filter_upwards [(isOpen_chartTarget P φ₀ h).mem_nhds hy₀] with y hy
  exact (sliceChart_symm_apply_eq_eval P φ₀ h hy q).symm

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_sliceChart_symm_apply
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sliceChart_symm_apply
    (hall : ∀ ψ : CPoints S, IsUnit (ψ P.jacobian)) (s : S)
    {y₀ : Kappa P → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ (sliceChart P φ₀ h).target) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (sliceChart P φ₀ h).symm y s) y₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := P.toGenerators.aeval_val_surjective s
  have h1 := analyticAt_eval_symm_section_of_mem P φ₀ h hall hy₀ q
  refine h1.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [(isOpen_chartTarget P φ₀ h).mem_nhds hy₀] with y hy
  exact (sliceChart_symm_apply_eq_eval P φ₀ h hy q).symm

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.sliceChartOfSubmersive_def
statement:
lemma sliceChartOfSubmersive_def :
    sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀
      = sliceChart Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation φ₀ (isUnit_apply_jacobian Q φ₀)
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.mem_sliceChartOfSubmersive_source
statement:
lemma mem_sliceChartOfSubmersive_source :
    φ₀ ∈ (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).source
proof:

name: HodgePilot.SliceChart.analyticAt_sliceChartOfSubmersive_symm_apply
statement:
theorem analyticAt_sliceChartOfSubmersive_symm_apply (s : S)
    {y₀ : Kappa Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation → ℂ}
    (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).target) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).symm y s) y₀
proof:

  analyticAt_sliceChart_symm_apply Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation φ₀ _

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.p2_receipt
statement:
theorem p2_receipt :
    p2 = Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.isProper_toSpecZero
statement:
theorem isProper_toSpecZero :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₃)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective
statement:
theorem gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap ℂ (𝒜₃ 0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    exact MvPolynomial.C_injective (Fin 3) ℂ (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
  · intro x
    have hx : (x : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) ∈
        (1 : Submodule ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) := by
      rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero]
      exact x.2
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hx
    exact ⟨c, Subtype.ext hc⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.structMor_receipt
statement:
theorem structMor_receipt :
    structMor =
      Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₃ ≫ Spec.map (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.closure_botPoint
statement:
theorem closure_botPoint :
    closure ({botPoint} : Set (ProjectiveSpectrum 𝒜₃)) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ProjectiveSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
    ProjectiveSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_singleton,
    show botPoint.asHomogeneousIdeal = (⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜₃) from rfl,
    HomogeneousIdeal.coe_bot, ← Set.singleton_zero]
  exact ProjectiveSpectrum.zeroLocus_singleton_zero 𝒜₃

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.chart_inf
statement:
theorem chart_inf (i j : Fin 3) :
    chart i ⊓ chart j =
      Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)
proof:
:=
  (Proj.basicOpen_mul 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i) (MvPolynomial.X j)).symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.iSup_chart_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_chart_eq_top : (⨆ i : Fin 3, chart i) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' 𝒜₃
    (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)
    (fun i => ⟨1, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ i)⟩)
    (top_le_iff.mp fun a _ => by
      have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
          (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]; trivial
      have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℂ
          (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) ≤
          Subalgebra.restrictScalars ℂ (Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₃ 0)
            (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ))) :=
        Algebra.adjoin_le fun s hs => Algebra.subset_adjoin hs
      exact (Subalgebra.mem_restrictScalars ℂ).mp (hle ha))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.chart_cover_receipt
statement: theorem chart_cover_receipt : chart 0 ⊔ chart 1 ⊔ chart 2 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_chart_eq_top]
  exact le_antisymm
    (sup_le (sup_le (le_iSup chart 0) (le_iSup chart 1)) (le_iSup chart 2))
    (iSup_le fun i => match i with
      | 0 => le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left
      | 1 => le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left
      | 2 => le_sup_right)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.botPt_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem botPt_mem_basicOpen {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    botPt ∈ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₃ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proj.mem_basicOpen]
  intro h
  have h' : f ∈ ((⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜₃) : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ)) := h
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.coe_bot] at h'
  exact hf (Set.mem_zero.mp h')

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.genericPoint_mem
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem {W : p2.Opens} (hW : (W : Set p2).Nonempty) :
    genericPoint p2 ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  refine ((genericPoint_spec p2).mem_open_set_iff W.isOpen).mpr ?_
  simpa using hW

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.genericPoint_mem_chart
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_chart (i : Fin 3) : genericPoint p2 ∈ chart i
proof:
:=
  genericPoint_mem
    ⟨botPt, botPt_mem_basicOpen (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) i)⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.genericPoint_mem_chartInf
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_chartInf (i j : Fin 3) :
    genericPoint p2 ∈ chart i ⊓ chart j
proof:
:=
  genericPoint_mem ⟨botPt, by
    rw [chart_inf]
    exact botPt_mem_basicOpen (mul_ne_zero
      (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) i) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) j))⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hXdeg
statement:
theorem hXdeg (i : Fin 3) :
    (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) ∈ 𝒜₃ 1
proof:
:=
  (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
    (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ i)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hX
statement:
theorem hX (i j : Fin 3) :
    (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℂ) ∈ 𝒜₃ 2
proof:
:=
  SetLike.mul_mem_graded (hXdeg i) (hXdeg j)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hXsq
proof:
:=
  (one_smul ℕ 2).symm ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded (hXdeg j) (hXdeg j)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.awayNum_mul_awayNumInv
statement:
theorem awayNum_mul_awayNumInv (i j : Fin 3) :
    awayNum i j * awayNumInv i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one]
  unfold awayNum awayNumInv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    Localization.mk_mul, ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_exists]
  use 1
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.mk_mul_mk]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.zElt_def
statement:
theorem zElt_def (i j : Fin 3) :
    (germUnitsHom p2 (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j)).hom
      (overlapUnitAb i j) = zElt i j
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hx01
statement: theorem hx01 : x3 = (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) * MvPolynomial.X 2
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hx12
statement: theorem hx12 : x3 = (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2) * MvPolynomial.X 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold x3; ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.hx02
statement: theorem hx02 : x3 = (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 2) * MvPolynomial.X 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold x3; ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.x3_ne_zero
statement: theorem x3_ne_zero : x3 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold x3
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) 0)
      (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) 1))
    (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := ℂ) 2)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.genericPoint_mem_T
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_T : genericPoint p2 ∈ T
proof:
:=
  genericPoint_mem ⟨botPt, botPt_mem_basicOpen x3_ne_zero⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.T_le_chartInf
proof:
:=
  le_of_le_of_eq (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, hx⟩) (chart_inf i j).symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.awayMap_cocycle
statement:
theorem awayMap_cocycle :
    awayMap 𝒜₃ (hXdeg 2) hx01 (awayNum 0 1) *
      awayMap 𝒜₃ (hXdeg 0) hx12 (awayNum 1 2) =
    awayMap 𝒜₃ (hXdeg 1) hx02 (awayNum 0 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul]
  unfold awayNum HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  use 1
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.mk_mul_mk]
  unfold x3
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.overlapRingHom_res
statement:
theorem overlapRingHom_res {i j k : Fin 3}
    (hx : x3 = (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j) * MvPolynomial.X k)
    (a : Away 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)) :
    (p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx)).op).hom
        (overlapRingHom i j a) =
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ x3).hom (awayMap 𝒜₃ (hXdeg k) hx a)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : p2.presheaf.map ((homOfLE (le_of_eq (chart_inf i j))).op) ≫
      p2.presheaf.map ((homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx)).op) =
      p2.presheaf.map
        ((homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, hx⟩)).op) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun F : Γ(p2, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₃ (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)) ⟶
        Γ(p2, T) =>
      F.hom ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃
        (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)).hom a)) hcomp
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (𝒜 := 𝒜₃) (g_deg := hXdeg k) (hx := hx))) a
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.overlapUnit_val
statement:
theorem overlapUnit_val (i j : Fin 3) :
    ((overlapUnit i j : (Γ(p2, chart i ⊓ chart j))ˣ) :
        Γ(p2, chart i ⊓ chart j)) =
      overlapRingHom i j (awayNum i j)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.overlapUnit_res_cocycle
statement:
theorem overlapUnit_res_cocycle :
    Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx01)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 0 ⊓ chart 1) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 0 1) *
      Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx12)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 1 ⊓ chart 2) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 1 2) =
    Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx02)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 0 ⊓ chart 2) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 0 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_map, Units.coe_map, Units.coe_map]
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_coe, overlapUnit_val]
  exact (congrArg₂ (· * ·) (overlapRingHom_res hx01 (awayNum 0 1))
      (overlapRingHom_res hx12 (awayNum 1 2))).trans
    ((map_mul (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ x3).hom _ _).symm.trans
      ((DFunLike.congr_arg (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₃ x3).hom
        awayMap_cocycle).trans (overlapRingHom_res hx02 (awayNum 0 2)).symm))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.zElt_eq_germ
statement:
theorem zElt_eq_germ {W' : p2.Opens} (h' : genericPoint p2 ∈ W')
    (i j : Fin 3) (hle : W' ≤ chart i ⊓ chart j) :
    (germUnitsHom p2 h').hom
        (((unitsAb p2).obj.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom (overlapUnitAb i j)) =
      zElt i j
proof:
:= by
  have h := germUnitsHom_naturality p2 (homOfLE hle).op h'
  exact congrArg (fun F => F.hom (overlapUnitAb i j)) h

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.zElt_cocycle
statement: theorem zElt_cocycle : zElt 0 1 + zElt 1 2 = zElt 0 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zElt_eq_germ genericPoint_mem_T 0 1 (T_le_chartInf hx01),
    ← zElt_eq_germ genericPoint_mem_T 1 2 (T_le_chartInf hx12),
    ← zElt_eq_germ genericPoint_mem_T 0 2 (T_le_chartInf hx02),
    ← map_add]
  refine congrArg _ ?_
  show Additive.ofMul (Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx01)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 0 ⊓ chart 1) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 0 1)) +
      Additive.ofMul (Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx12)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 1 ⊓ chart 2) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 1 2)) =
    Additive.ofMul (Units.map ((p2.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (T_le_chartInf hx02)).op).hom :
        Γ(p2, chart 0 ⊓ chart 2) →* Γ(p2, T)) (overlapUnit 0 2))
  rw [← ofMul_mul]
  exact congrArg Additive.ofMul overlapUnit_res_cocycle

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.divSection_res
statement:
theorem divSection_res {U V : (p2.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (hU : genericPoint p2 ∈ U.unop) (hV : genericPoint p2 ∈ V.unop)
    (v : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) :
    ((divisorsAb p2).obj.map f).hom (divSection hU v) = divSection hV v
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ((divisorsAb p2).obj.map f).hom
      ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app U (zSection hU v)) =
      (divisorsπ p2).hom.app V
        (((KUnitsAb p2).obj.map f).hom (zSection hU v)) := by
    show ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app U ≫ (divisorsAb p2).obj.map f)
        (zSection hU v) = _
    rw [← (divisorsπ p2).hom.naturality]
    rfl
  have hres : ((KUnitsAb p2).obj.map f).hom (zSection hU v) =
      zSection hV v := by
    rw [KUnitsAb_map_of_mem p2 f hV]
    show (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p2 hU).symm ≫ eqToHom _) v = _
    rw [eqToHom_trans]
    rfl
  exact hnat.trans (congrArg ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app V) hres)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.divSection_eq_of_unit
statement:
theorem divSection_eq_of_unit {W : p2.Opens} (h : genericPoint p2 ∈ W)
    (v v' : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) (u : ((unitsAb p2).obj.obj (op W)))
    (huv : v = v' + (germUnitsHom p2 h).hom u) :
    divSection h v = divSection h v'
proof:
:= by
  have hz : zSection h v =
      zSection h v' + zSection h ((germUnitsHom p2 h).hom u) := by
    rw [huv]
    exact map_add (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p2 h).symm).hom _ _
  have hu : zSection h ((germUnitsHom p2 h).hom u) =
      (unitsToK p2).hom.app (op W) u := by
    rw [unitsToK_app_of_mem p2 h]
    rfl
  have h0 : ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W)).hom
      ((unitsToK p2).hom.app (op W) u) = 0 := by
    have h1 : ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W)).hom
        ((unitsToK p2).hom.app (op W) u) =
        ((unitsToK p2 ≫ divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W)) u := rfl
    rw [h1, show unitsToK p2 ≫ divisorsπ p2 = 0 from
      cokernel.condition (unitsToK p2)]
    rfl
  show ((divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W)).hom (zSection h v) = _
  rw [hz, map_add, hu, h0, add_zero]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineOneDatum_receipt
statement:
theorem lineOneDatum_receipt :
    lineOneDatum 0 = zElt 0 1 ∧ lineOneDatum 1 = 0 ∧
      lineOneDatum 2 = -zElt 1 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineTwoDatum_receipt
statement:
theorem lineTwoDatum_receipt :
    lineTwoDatum 0 = zElt 0 2 ∧ lineTwoDatum 1 = zElt 1 2 ∧
      lineTwoDatum 2 = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.germ_overlapUnitAbSwap
statement:
theorem germ_overlapUnitAbSwap (i j : Fin 3) :
    (germUnitsHom p2 (genericPoint_mem_chartInf j i)).hom
      (overlapUnitAbSwap i j) = zElt i j
proof:
:=
  zElt_eq_germ (genericPoint_mem_chartInf j i) i j
    (le_of_eq (inf_comm (chart j) (chart i)))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineOneDatum_diff
statement:
theorem lineOneDatum_diff (i j : Fin 3) :
    ∃ u : ((unitsAb p2).obj.obj (op (chart i ⊓ chart j))),
      lineOneDatum i = lineOneDatum j +
        (germUnitsHom p2 (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j)).hom u
proof:
:= by
  match i, j with
  | 0, 0 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 1, 1 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 2, 2 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 0, 1 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 0 1, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show zElt 0 1 = 0 + zElt 0 1
      rw [zero_add]⟩
  | 1, 0 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 0 1, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) = zElt 0 1 + -zElt 0 1
      rw [add_neg_cancel]⟩
  | 1, 2 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 1 2, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) = -zElt 1 2 + zElt 1 2
      rw [neg_add_cancel]⟩
  | 2, 1 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 1 2, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show -zElt 1 2 = 0 + -zElt 1 2
      rw [zero_add]⟩
  | 0, 2 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 0 2, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show zElt 0 1 = -zElt 1 2 + zElt 0 2
      rw [← zElt_cocycle]
      abel⟩
  | 2, 0 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 0 2, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show -zElt 1 2 = zElt 0 1 + -zElt 0 2
      rw [← zElt_cocycle]
      abel⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineTwoDatum_diff
statement:
theorem lineTwoDatum_diff (i j : Fin 3) :
    ∃ u : ((unitsAb p2).obj.obj (op (chart i ⊓ chart j))),
      lineTwoDatum i = lineTwoDatum j +
        (germUnitsHom p2 (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j)).hom u
proof:
:= by
  match i, j with
  | 0, 0 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 1, 1 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 2, 2 => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | 0, 2 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 0 2, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show zElt 0 2 = 0 + zElt 0 2
      rw [zero_add]⟩
  | 2, 0 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 0 2, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) = zElt 0 2 + -zElt 0 2
      rw [add_neg_cancel]⟩
  | 1, 2 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 1 2, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show zElt 1 2 = 0 + zElt 1 2
      rw [zero_add]⟩
  | 2, 1 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 1 2, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) = zElt 1 2 + -zElt 1 2
      rw [add_neg_cancel]⟩
  | 0, 1 => exact ⟨overlapUnitAb 0 1, by
      rw [zElt_def]
      show zElt 0 2 = zElt 1 2 + zElt 0 1
      rw [← zElt_cocycle]
      abel⟩
  | 1, 0 => exact ⟨-overlapUnitAbSwap 0 1, by
      rw [map_neg, germ_overlapUnitAbSwap]
      show zElt 1 2 = zElt 0 2 + -zElt 0 1
      rw [← zElt_cocycle]
      abel⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineOneCompatible
statement:
theorem lineOneCompatible :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible (divisorsAb p2).obj chart lineOneSection
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := lineOneDatum_diff i j
  exact (divSection_res (Opens.infLELeft (chart i) (chart j)).op
      (genericPoint_mem_chart i) (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _).trans
    ((divSection_eq_of_unit (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _ _ u hu).trans
      (divSection_res (Opens.infLERight (chart i) (chart j)).op
        (genericPoint_mem_chart j) (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _).symm)

      (genericPoint_mem_chart i) (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _).trans
    ((divSection_eq_of_unit (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _ _ u hu).trans
      (divSection_res (Opens.infLERight (chart i) (chart j)).op
        (genericPoint_mem_chart j) (genericPoint_mem_chartInf i j) _).symm)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectivePlane.lineOneGlue
statement:

      ∀ i : Fin 3,
