name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_apply
statement:
theorem chartEvOpen_apply (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartEvOpen c b y =
      if h : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U then sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) h b
      else 0
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_apply]
  exact dif_pos h

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_apply]
  exact dif_neg h

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_add
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U
  · rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c (a + b) h, chartEvOpen_of_mem c a h,
      chartEvOpen_of_mem c b h]
    exact map_add (sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) h) a b
  · rw [chartEvOpen_of_notMem c (a + b) h, chartEvOpen_of_notMem c a h,
      chartEvOpen_of_notMem c b h, add_zero]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_mul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U
  · rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c (a * b) h, chartEvOpen_of_mem c a h,
      chartEvOpen_of_mem c b h]
    exact map_mul (sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) h) a b
  · rw [chartEvOpen_of_notMem c (a * b) h, chartEvOpen_of_notMem c a h,
      chartEvOpen_of_notMem c b h, mul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c 1 h]
  exact map_one (sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) h)

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c (b ^ k) h, chartEvOpen_of_mem c b h]
  exact map_pow (sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) h) b k

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartEvOpen_algebraMap (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens} (z : ℂ)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (h : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartEvOpen c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z) y = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c _ h, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_res_le
statement:
theorem chartEvOpen_res_le (c : GluedChart sX d) {U V : X.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V)
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) V) {y : Fin d → ℂ}
    (h : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartEvOpen c (res (cRingHom sX) hUV b) y = chartEvOpen c b y
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c _ h, chartEvOpen_of_mem c b (hUV h)]
  exact sPointEvalOpen_res_le (c.1.symm y) hUV h (hUV h) b

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_powers_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
  rw [← hk, chartEvOpen_pow c f k hU]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ hy

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_transition
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) = c₂.1.symm y :=
    c₁.1.left_inv hsrc
  rw [chartEvOpen_apply, chartEvOpen_apply, hpt]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.appLE_top_hom
statement:
theorem appLE_top_hom {Z : Scheme} (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ) ⟶ Z)
    (e : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).Opens) ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Z.Opens))
    (b : Γ(Z, ⊤)) : q.appLE ⊤ ⊤ e b = q.appTop b
proof:
:= by
  show (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op (q.app ⊤ b) =
    q.appTop b
  have h1 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op =
      𝟙 Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ), ⊤) :=
    (congrArg (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).presheaf.map
      (show (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 (op (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).Opens)) from
        rfl)).trans
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).presheaf.map_id _)
  exact congrArg
    (fun g : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ), ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ), ⊤) =>
      g (q.app ⊤ b)) h1

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.sPointEvalOpen_probe
statement:
theorem sPointEvalOpen_probe (c : Chart sX) (φ : CPoints c.A)
    (h : toSpace sX (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) ∈ c.hom.opensRange)
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) c.hom.opensRange) :
    sPointEvalOpen (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) h b = φ (chartRingMapOpen c b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sPointEvalOpen_apply]
  have h1 : (probe sX c.hom c.over φ).1.appLE c.hom.opensRange ⊤
      (preimage_eq_top (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) h).ge b =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_rfl
        (c.hom.appLE c.hom.opensRange ⊤
          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_opensRange c.hom).ge b) :=
    (congrArg
      (fun g : Γ(X, c.hom.opensRange) ⟶ Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ), ⊤) => g b)
      (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))
        c.hom c.hom.opensRange ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_opensRange c.hom).ge le_rfl)).symm
  rw [h1, appLE_top_hom]
  have h2 := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
  exact congrArg (fun g : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of c.A), ⊤) ⟶ CommRingCat.of ℂ =>
    g (c.hom.appLE c.hom.opensRange ⊤
      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_opensRange c.hom).ge b)) h2

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.toSpace_probe_mem
statement:
theorem toSpace_probe_mem (c : Chart sX) (φ : CPoints c.A) :
    toSpace sX (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) ∈ c.hom.opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [toSpace_probe sX c.hom c.over φ]
  exact ⟨toZariski φ, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.toSpace_symm_mem
statement:
theorem toSpace_symm_mem (P : SPatch sX d) (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (hP : c.1 = glueChart P) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ P.chart.hom.opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP, glueChart_symm_apply]
  exact toSpace_probe_mem P.chart ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y)

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.isOpen_chartMemLocus
statement:
theorem isOpen_chartMemLocus (c : GluedChart sX d) (U : X.Opens) :
    IsOpen {y : Fin d → ℂ | y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U}
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => toSpace sX (c.1.symm y)) c.1.target :=
    (continuous_toSpace sX).comp_continuousOn c.1.continuousOn_symm
  exact hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage c.1.open_target U.2

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.mem_nvChartOpen
statement:
theorem mem_nvChartOpen {c : GluedChart sX d} {U : X.Opens}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} {y : Fin d → ℂ} :
    y ∈ nvChartOpen c f ↔
      y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ X.basicOpen f
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.nvChartOpen_target
HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.nvChartOpen_mem_basicOpen
HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.nvChartOpen_memU
proof: := X.basicOpen_le f hy.2

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.nvChartOpen_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c f (nvChartOpen_memU hy)]
  exact (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff_open (c.1.symm y) (nvChartOpen_memU hy) f).mp
    hy.2

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.nvChartOpen_mul_le_left
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨hyt, hyb⟩
  exact ⟨hyt, basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g hyb⟩

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartEvOpen_eq_patch
statement:
theorem chartEvOpen_eq_patch (P : SPatch sX d) (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (hP : c.1 = glueChart P) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) P.chart.hom.opensRange) :
    chartEvOpen c b = fun y =>
      (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y
        (chartRingMapOpen P.chart b)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (pt : SPoints sX) (hpt : toSpace sX pt ∈ P.chart.hom.opensRange)
      (φ : CPoints P.chart.A), pt = probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over φ →
      sPointEvalOpen pt hpt b = φ (chartRingMapOpen P.chart b) := by
    rintro pt hpt φ rfl
    exact sPointEvalOpen_probe P.chart φ hpt b
  funext y
  rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c b (toSpace_symm_mem P c hP y)]
  exact key (c.1.symm y) (toSpace_symm_mem P c hP y)
    ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y)
    (by rw [hP]; exact glueChart_symm_apply P y)

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.analyticAt_chartEvOpen_patch
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEvOpen_patch (P : SPatch sX d) (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (hP : c.1 = glueChart P) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) P.chart.hom.opensRange)
    {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ c.1.target) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEvOpen c b) y₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEvOpen_eq_patch P c hP b]
  rw [hP, glueChart_target] at hy₀
  exact analyticAt_patchChart_symm_apply P.patch P.center P.ne_zero _ hy₀

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.analyticAt_chartEvOpen_basicOpen
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEvOpen_basicOpen (P : SPatch sX d) (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (hP : c.1 = glueChart P) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) P.chart.hom.opensRange)
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ c.1.target) (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y₀) ∈ X.basicOpen f) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEvOpen c b) y₀
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI hloc : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) :=
    isLocalization_away (cRingHom sX) (isAffineOpen_opensRange P.chart.hom) f
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers f) b
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := s.2
  have key : ∀ y : Fin d → ℂ, toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ X.basicOpen f →
      chartEvOpen c b y = chartEvOpen c a y / chartEvOpen c f y ^ n := by
    intro y hy
    have hyU : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ P.chart.hom.opensRange :=
      X.basicOpen_le f hy
    have hf0 : sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hyU f ≠ 0 :=
      (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff_open (c.1.symm y) hyU f).mp hy
    have h1 := congrArg (fun t => sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hy t) hs
    have h2 : sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hy
        (algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) P.chart.hom.opensRange)
          (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) s.1) =
        sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hyU s.1 :=
      sPointEvalOpen_res_le (c.1.symm y) (X.basicOpen_le f) hy hyU s.1
    have h3 : sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hy
        (algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) P.chart.hom.opensRange)
          (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) a) =
        sPointEvalOpen (c.1.symm y) hyU a :=
      sPointEvalOpen_res_le (c.1.symm y) (X.basicOpen_le f) hy hyU a
    rw [map_mul] at h1
    rw [h2, h3] at h1
    rw [← hn, map_pow] at h1
    rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c b hy, chartEvOpen_of_mem c a hyU,
      chartEvOpen_of_mem c f hyU, eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero n hf0)]
    exact h1
  have hev : (fun y => chartEvOpen c a y / chartEvOpen c f y ^ n)
      =ᶠ[nhds y₀] chartEvOpen c b :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_chartMemLocus c (X.basicOpen f)).mem_nhds ⟨hy₀, hm⟩)
      (fun y hy => (key y hy.2).symm)
  have hyU₀ : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y₀) ∈ P.chart.hom.opensRange :=
    X.basicOpen_le f hm
  have hf0' : chartEvOpen c f y₀ ^ n ≠ 0 := by
    refine pow_ne_zero n ?_
    rw [chartEvOpen_of_mem c f hyU₀]
    exact (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff_open (c.1.symm y₀) hyU₀ f).mp hm
  exact AnalyticAt.congr
    ((analyticAt_chartEvOpen_patch P c hP a hy₀).div
      ((analyticAt_chartEvOpen_patch P c hP f hy₀).pow n) hf0') hev

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.analyticAt_chartEvOpen
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEvOpen (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y₀) ∈ U) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEvOpen c b) y₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := c.2
  obtain ⟨g, hgU, hmg⟩ :=
    (isAffineOpen_opensRange P.chart.hom).exists_basicOpen_le
      (⟨toSpace sX (c.1.symm y₀), hm⟩ : U) (toSpace_symm_mem P c hP y₀)
  have hev : chartEvOpen c (res (cRingHom sX) hgU b) =ᶠ[nhds y₀]
      chartEvOpen c b :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_chartMemLocus c (X.basicOpen g)).mem_nhds ⟨hy₀, hmg⟩)
      (fun y hy => chartEvOpen_res_le c hgU b hy.2)
  exact AnalyticAt.congr
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen_basicOpen P c hP g (res (cRingHom sX) hgU b)
      hy₀ hmg) hev

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartSmulOpen_val
statement:
theorem chartSmulOpen_val {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d} {U : X.Opens}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChartOpen c f)))
    (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (s • ω).1 y = chartEvOpen c s (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show chartEvOpen c s (↑y) • sectionExtendV ω ↑y =
    chartEvOpen c s (↑y) • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.invChartSMulSectionOpen_val
statement:
theorem invChartSMulSectionOpen_val {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d}
    {U : X.Opens} {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChartOpen c f, chartEvOpen c g z ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChartOpen c f)))
    (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg ω).1 y =
      (chartEvOpen c g (↑y : Fin d → ℂ))⁻¹ • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show (chartEvOpen c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV ω ↑y =
    (chartEvOpen c g ↑y)⁻¹ • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.invChartOpen_smul_cancel
statement:
theorem invChartOpen_smul_cancel {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d} {U : X.Opens}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChartOpen c f, chartEvOpen c g z ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChartOpen c f))) :
    invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg (g • ω) = ω
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show (chartEvOpen c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV (g • ω) ↑y = ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (g • ω) y.2]
  show (chartEvOpen c g ↑y)⁻¹ • (chartEvOpen c g ↑y • sectionExtendV ω ↑y) =
    ω.1 y
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2), sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.smul_invChartOpen_cancel
statement:
theorem smul_invChartOpen_cancel {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d} {U : X.Opens}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChartOpen c f, chartEvOpen c g z ≠ 0)
    (η : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChartOpen c f))) :
    g • invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg η = η
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show chartEvOpen c g ↑y • sectionExtendV (invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg η) ↑y =
    η.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg η) y.2]
  show chartEvOpen c g ↑y • ((chartEvOpen c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV η ↑y) =
    η.1 y
  rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2), sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem η y.2]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.isUnit_algebraMap_end_chartOpen
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_end_chartOpen {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d}
    {U : X.Opens} {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} {g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U}
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChartOpen c f, chartEvOpen c g z ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
      (Module.End (Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
        ((omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c f)))) g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ω η h
    have h3 : g • ω = g • η := h
    calc ω = invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg (g • ω) :=
          (invChartOpen_smul_cancel g hg ω).symm
      _ = invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg (g • η) := by rw [h3]
      _ = η := invChartOpen_smul_cancel g hg η
  · intro η
    exact ⟨invChartSMulSectionOpen g hg η, smul_invChartOpen_cancel g hg η⟩

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartGradOpen_add
statement:
theorem chartGradOpen_add (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartGradOpen c (a + b) y = chartGradOpen c a y + chartGradOpen c b y
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartEvOpen c (a + b) =
      fun z => chartEvOpen c a z + chartEvOpen c b z :=
    funext fun z => chartEvOpen_add c a b z
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c (a + b)) y = _
  rw [h, fderiv_fun_add (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c a hy hm).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c b hy hm).differentiableAt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartGradOpen_mul
statement:
theorem chartGradOpen_mul (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartGradOpen c (a * b) y =
      chartEvOpen c a y • chartGradOpen c b y +
        chartEvOpen c b y • chartGradOpen c a y
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartEvOpen c (a * b) =
      fun z => chartEvOpen c a z * chartEvOpen c b z :=
    funext fun z => chartEvOpen_mul c a b z
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c (a * b)) y = _
  rw [h, fderiv_fun_mul (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c a hy hm).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c b hy hm).differentiableAt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartGradOpen_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartGradOpen_algebraMap (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens} (z : ℂ)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartGradOpen c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartEvOpen c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)
      =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => z :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_chartMemLocus c U).mem_nhds ⟨hy, hm⟩)
      (fun w hw => chartEvOpen_algebraMap c z hw.2)
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)) y = 0
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℂ) z

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartAlgFormOpen_apply
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormOpen_apply {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartAlgFormOpen c s t y =
      chartEvOpen c s y • formOfTuple (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) y)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.analyticAt_chartEvalPiOpen
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEvalPiOpen {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c u) y
proof:
:=
  AnalyticAt.pi fun k => analyticAt_chartEvOpen c (u k) hy hm

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPiOpen
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPiOpen {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (chartEvalPiOpen c u)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => chartGradOpen c (u k) y) y
proof:
:=
  hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun k =>
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c (u k) hy hm).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.fderiv_chartEvalPiOpen
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartEvalPiOpen {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c u) y =
      ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => chartGradOpen c (u k) y
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPiOpen c u hy hm).fderiv

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartAlgFormOpen_eq_pullback_at
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormOpen_eq_pullback_at {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartAlgFormOpen c s t y =
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t)) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAlgFormOpen_apply, coeffForm, smul_compContinuousLinearMap,
    tailProjForm, formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap,
    fderiv_chartEvalPiOpen c _ hy hm]
  congr 1

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.analyticOnNhd_chartAlgFormOpen
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_chartAlgFormOpen {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (chartAlgFormOpen c s t)
      {y : Fin d → ℂ | y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U}
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen
      {y : Fin d → ℂ | y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U} :=
    isOpen_chartMemLocus c U
  have hτ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t))
      {y : Fin d → ℂ | y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U} :=
    fun y hy => analyticAt_chartEvalPiOpen c _ hy.1 hy.2
  have hτd : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t)))
      {y : Fin d → ℂ | y ∈ c.1.target ∧ toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U} :=
    hτ.fderiv_of_isOpen hopen
  refine PolydiscPoincare.analyticOnNhd_of_differentiableOn hopen ?_
  intro y hy
  have hev : chartAlgFormOpen c s t =ᶠ[nhds y] fun z =>
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t)) z) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hy)
      (fun z hz => chartAlgFormOpen_eq_pullback_at c s t hz.1 hz.2)
  have h0 : (fun z => coeffForm p (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z)) =
      fun z =>
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z) •
        tailProjForm p :=
    rfl
  have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (fun z => coeffForm p (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z)) y := by
    rw [h0]
    have h2 : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z)) =
        chartEvOpen c s :=
      rfl
    refine DifferentiableAt.smul_const ?_ (tailProjForm p)
    rw [h2]
    exact (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c s hy.1 hy.2).differentiableAt
  have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z =>
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) z)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t)) z)) y :=
    h1.continuousAlternatingMapCompContinuousLinearMap
      ((hτd y hy).differentiableAt)
  exact (h3.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartAlgFormSecOpen_val
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormSecOpen_val {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (chartAlgFormSecOpen c f t s).1 y = chartAlgFormOpen c s t ↑y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.preRealizeChartOpen_single
statement:
theorem preRealizeChartOpen_single {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) :
    preRealizeChartOpen c f p (Finsupp.single t s) =
      chartAlgFormSecOpen c f t s
proof:
:= by
  rw [preRealizeChartOpen, Finsupp.lsum_single]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartGradOpen_comp_update
statement:
theorem chartGradOpen_comp_update {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (i : Fin p) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (fun j => chartGradOpen c (Function.update t i b j) y) =
      Function.update (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) y) i
        (chartGradOpen c b y)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
  · rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji, Function.update_of_ne hji]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.preRealizeChartOpen_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet
statement:
theorem preRealizeChartOpen_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    {w : DRFree (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p}
    (hw : w ∈ relSet ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p) :
    preRealizeChartOpen c f p w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealizeChartOpen_single, preRealizeChartOpen_single,
      preRealizeChartOpen_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [sections_sub_val, sections_add_val, chartAlgFormSecOpen_val,
      chartAlgFormSecOpen_val, chartAlgFormSecOpen_val]
    show chartAlgFormOpen c 1 (Function.update t i x) ↑z +
        chartAlgFormOpen c 1 (Function.update t i y) ↑z -
        chartAlgFormOpen c 1 (Function.update t i (x + y)) ↑z =
      (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
        (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgFormOpen_apply]
    rw [chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU z.2)]
    simp only [one_smul]
    rw [chartGradOpen_comp_update, chartGradOpen_comp_update,
      chartGradOpen_comp_update,
      chartGradOpen_add c x y (nvChartOpen_target z.2) (nvChartOpen_memU z.2),
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartGradOpen c x ↑z) (chartGradOpen c y ↑z), sub_self]
    rfl
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealizeChartOpen_single, preRealizeChartOpen_single,
      preRealizeChartOpen_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [sections_sub_val, sections_add_val, chartAlgFormSecOpen_val,
      chartAlgFormSecOpen_val, chartAlgFormSecOpen_val]
    show chartAlgFormOpen c x (Function.update t i y) ↑z +
        chartAlgFormOpen c y (Function.update t i x) ↑z -
        chartAlgFormOpen c 1 (Function.update t i (x * y)) ↑z =
      (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
        (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgFormOpen_apply]
    rw [chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU z.2)]
    simp only [one_smul]
    rw [chartGradOpen_comp_update, chartGradOpen_comp_update,
      chartGradOpen_comp_update,
      chartGradOpen_mul c x y (nvChartOpen_target z.2) (nvChartOpen_memU z.2),
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartEvOpen c x ↑z • chartGradOpen c y ↑z)
        (chartEvOpen c y ↑z • chartGradOpen c x ↑z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartEvOpen c x ↑z) (chartGradOpen c y ↑z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartEvOpen c y ↑z) (chartGradOpen c x ↑z), sub_self]
    rfl
  · 
    rw [preRealizeChartOpen_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [chartAlgFormSecOpen_val]
    show chartAlgFormOpen c 1
        (Function.update t i (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) a)) ↑z =
      (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
        (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgFormOpen_apply]
    rw [chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU z.2)]
    simp only [one_smul]
    rw [chartGradOpen_comp_update,
      chartGradOpen_algebraMap c a (nvChartOpen_target z.2)
        (nvChartOpen_memU z.2)]
    have h := formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑z) i 0 0
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact left_eq_add.mp h
  · 
    rw [preRealizeChartOpen_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [chartAlgFormSecOpen_val]
    show chartAlgFormOpen c 1 t ↑z =
      (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
        (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgFormOpen_apply]
    rw [chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU z.2)]
    simp only [one_smul]
    exact formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_eq (fun k => chartGradOpen c (t k) ↑z) i j
      (congrArg (fun b => chartGradOpen c b ↑z) htij) hij

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.rel_le_ker_preRealizeChartOpen
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_preRealizeChartOpen (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) :
    rel ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p ≤
      LinearMap.ker (preRealizeChartOpen c f p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  intro w hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  exact preRealizeChartOpen_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet c f hw

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartRealizeOpen_mk
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_mk {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (w : DRFree (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p) :
    chartRealizeOpen c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk w) =
      preRealizeChartOpen c f p w
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartRealizeOpen_mk_single
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_mk_single {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s))).1 y =
      chartAlgFormOpen c s t ↑y
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartRealizeOpen_mk, preRealizeChartOpen_single, chartAlgFormSecOpen_val]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartRealizeOpen_gen
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_gen {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c f p (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) t)).1 y =
      formOfTuple (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single, chartAlgFormOpen_apply,
    chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU y.2), one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.extDeriv_chartAlgFormOpen_at
statement:
theorem extDeriv_chartAlgFormOpen_at {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    extDeriv (chartAlgFormOpen c s t) y =
      chartAlgFormOpen c 1 (Fin.cons s t) y
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartAlgFormOpen c s t =ᶠ[nhds y] fun x =>
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
          (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) x) •
        tailProjForm p).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t)) x) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_chartMemLocus c U).mem_nhds ⟨hy, hm⟩)
      (fun z hz => chartAlgFormOpen_eq_pullback_at c s t hz.1 hz.2)
  rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
  rw [extDeriv_pullback (𝕜 := ℂ) (r := minSmoothness ℂ 2)
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).differentiableAt).smul_const (tailProjForm p))
    ((analyticAt_chartEvalPiOpen c (Fin.cons s t) hy hm).contDiffAt) le_rfl]
  rw [extDeriv_coeffForm, formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap,
    fderiv_chartEvalPiOpen c _ hy hm, chartAlgFormOpen_apply,
    chartEvOpen_one c hm, one_smul]
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun k => ?_)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_pi]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.dSection_chartRealizeOpen
statement:
theorem dSection_chartRealizeOpen (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p) :
    dSection (chartRealizeOpen c f p x) =
      chartRealizeOpen c f (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
      have heq : sectionExtendV
          (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
            (op (nvChartOpen c f))) =
          fun _ => (0 : FormSpace d p) :=
        funext fun z => sectionExtendV_zero z
      show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
        (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c f)))) ↑y =
        (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d (p + 1))).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 y
      rw [heq]
      exact extDeriv_const_eq_zero _ _
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, dSection_add,
        hu, hv]
  | single t s =>
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
      have hev : sectionExtendV
          (chartRealizeOpen c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)))
          =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin d → ℂ)] chartAlgFormOpen c s t := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
          ((nvChartOpen c f).isOpen.mem_nhds y.2) (fun z hz => ?_)
        rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz]
        exact chartRealizeOpen_mk_single c f t s ⟨z, hz⟩
      show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
        (chartRealizeOpen c f p
          (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)))) ↑y = _
      rw [hev.extDeriv_eq,
        extDeriv_chartAlgFormOpen_at c s t (nvChartOpen_target y.2)
          (nvChartOpen_memU y.2),
        d_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_gen, chartAlgFormOpen_apply,
        chartEvOpen_one c (nvChartOpen_memU y.2), one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p) :
    localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p x) =
      chartRealizeOpen c f p x
proof:
:=
  IsLocalizedModule.lift_apply (Submonoid.powers f)
    (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p) (chartRealizeOpen c f p) _ x

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.localizedRealizeChartOpen_val_smul_locMap
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChartOpen_val_smul_locMap (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ)
    {ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p} {b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U}
    {x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p}
    (h : b • ξ = locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p x)
    (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    chartEvOpen c b ↑y • (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1 y =
      (chartRealizeOpen c f p x).1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : b • localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ = chartRealizeOpen c f p x :=
    ((LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p) b ξ).symm.trans
      (congrArg (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p) h)).trans
      (localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap c f p x)
  calc chartEvOpen c b ↑y • (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1 y
      = (b • localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1 y :=
        (chartSmulOpen_val b (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ) y).symm
    _ = (chartRealizeOpen c f p x).1 y := by rw [h1]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartRealizeOpen_wedgeP_val
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_wedgeP_val (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (z : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p) (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p
          (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (fun _ => g)) z)).1 y =
      wedge1 (chartGradOpen c g ↑y) ((chartRealizeOpen c f p z).1 y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      rw [show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 y) = 0 from rfl,
        show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d (p + 1))).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c f))).1 y) = 0 from rfl, wedge1_zero_right]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add,
        sections_add_val, sections_add_val, hu, hv, wedge1_add_right]
  | single t s =>
      rw [show gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (fun _ => g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) 1)
          from rfl, wedgeP_mk_single, one_mul, ← mk_single_eq_smul_gen,
        chartRealizeOpen_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single,
        chartAlgFormOpen_apply, chartAlgFormOpen_apply]
      have hc : (fun j => chartGradOpen c
          (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Sec (cRingHom sX) U) g t j) ↑y) =
          Fin.cons (chartGradOpen c g ↑y)
            (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑y) := by
        funext j
        induction j using Fin.cases with
        | zero => rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
        | succ i => rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      rw [show formOfTuple
            (fun j => chartGradOpen c
              (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Sec (cRingHom sX) U) g t j) ↑y) =
          formOfTuple (Fin.cons (chartGradOpen c g ↑y)
            (fun j => chartGradOpen c (t j) ↑y))
          from congrArg formOfTuple hc,
        formOfTuple_cons, wedge1_smul_right]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.localizedRealizeChartOpen_wedgeP_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChartOpen_wedgeP_val (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :
    (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
          (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f) g))
          ξ)).1 y =
      wedge1 (chartGradOpen c g ↑y)
        ((localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1 y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p ξ
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  have hsy : chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) ↑y ≠ 0 :=
    chartEvOpen_powers_ne_zero c (nvChartOpen_memU y.2)
      (nvChartOpen_ne_zero y.2) s
  have hclear : (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) •
      (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f) g))
        ξ) =
      locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p
          (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (fun _ => g)) x) := by
    calc (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) •
        (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
          (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f) g))
          ξ)
        = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f) g))
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) • ξ) := by
          rw [← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
              (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
                (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                  (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
                    (Localization.Away f) g)) ξ),
            ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f)
              (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) ξ,
            map_smul]
      _ = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f) g))
            (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p x) := by rw [hs]
      _ = locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p
              (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (fun _ => g)) x) :=
          locMap_wedgeP_gen f p g x
  have h1 := localizedRealizeChartOpen_val_smul_locMap c f (p + 1) hclear y
  rw [chartRealizeOpen_wedgeP_val] at h1
  have h2 := localizedRealizeChartOpen_val_smul_locMap c f p hs y
  rw [← h2, wedge1_smul_right] at h1
  exact ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsy h1

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.dSection_localizedRealizeChartOpen
statement:
theorem dSection_localizedRealizeChartOpen (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) :
    dSection (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ) =
      localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p ξ
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun ypt => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ypt
  have hsz : chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z ≠ 0 :=
    chartEvOpen_powers_ne_zero c (nvChartOpen_memU hz)
      (nvChartOpen_ne_zero hz) s
  
  have hev : ((fun w => chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ))
      =ᶠ[nhds z] sectionExtendV (chartRealizeOpen c f p x) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvChartOpen c f).isOpen.mem_nhds hz)
      (fun w hw => ?_)
    show chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ) w = _
    rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw]
    exact localizedRealizeChartOpen_val_smul_locMap c f p hs ⟨w, hw⟩
  
  have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun w => chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w)
      (chartGradOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z) z :=
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
      (nvChartOpen_target hz) (nvChartOpen_memU hz)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ))
      (fderiv ℂ (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z) z :=
    ((analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ))
      z hz).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hprod := hder.smul hG
  have hLHS : extDeriv ((fun w => chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z =
      chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z •
        extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z +
      wedge1 (chartGradOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)
        (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ) z) := by
    show ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin
      (fderiv ℂ ((fun w => chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w) •
        sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z) = _
    rw [hprod.fderiv, ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_add,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_smul]
    rfl
  
  have hext : extDeriv ((fun w => chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z =
      (chartRealizeOpen c f (p + 1)
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
    rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
    show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (chartRealizeOpen c f p x))
      ↑(⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) = _
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val (dSection_chartRealizeOpen c f p x))
      (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f))
  
  have hd : locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f (p + 1)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p x) =
      wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f)
            (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U))) ξ +
      (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) • DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ := by
    rw [← d_locMap, ← hs,
      ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) ξ,
      ComparisonLocalize.d_smul_wedgeP, algebraMap_smul]
  have hval : (chartRealizeOpen c f (p + 1)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ =
      wedge1 (chartGradOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)
        ((localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1
          (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f))) +
      chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z •
        (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
          (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) := by
    calc (chartRealizeOpen c f (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
        = (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U))) ξ) +
           localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) •
              DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
          rw [← localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap c f (p + 1), hd, map_add]
      _ = (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U))) ξ)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ +
          (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) •
              DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
          sections_add_val _ _ _
      _ = wedge1 (chartGradOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)
            ((localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1
              (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f))) +
          chartEvOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z •
            (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
              (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) := by
          rw [localizedRealizeChartOpen_wedgeP_val,
            LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1))
              (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)]
          exact congrArg
            (fun v => wedge1 (chartGradOpen c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) z)
              ((localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1
                (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f))) + v)
            (chartSmulOpen_val (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
              (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f (p + 1)
                (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)) ⟨z, hz⟩)
  
  have hGval : sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ) z =
      (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChartOpen c f)) :=
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz
  have h1 := (hLHS.symm.trans hext).trans hval
  rw [hGval] at h1
  have hkey := add_left_cancel ((add_comm _ _).trans h1)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ)) z = _
  exact ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsz hkey

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.chartRealizeOpen_mul_val
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_mul_val (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p)
    (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (f * g)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c f p x).1 ⟨z, nvChartOpen_mul_le_left c f g hz⟩ =
      (chartRealizeOpen c (f * g) p x).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, sections_add_val,
        sections_add_val, hu, hv]
  | single t s => rw [chartRealizeOpen_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.localizedRealizeChartOpen_mul_compat
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChartOpen_mul_compat (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) :
    (sectionsResChartOpen p c f g).comp (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p) =
      (localizedRealizeChartOpen c (f * g) p).comp (crossMulDRSec f g p)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsLocalizedModule.ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p)
    (fun s => isUnit_algebraMap_end_chartOpen (fun z hz =>
      chartEvOpen_powers_ne_zero c (nvChartOpen_memU hz)
        (left_ne_zero_of_mul (by
          have h5 := nvChartOpen_ne_zero hz
          rwa [chartEvOpen_mul] at h5)) s)) ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  show sectionsResChartOpen p c f g
      (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p
        (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p x)) =
    localizedRealizeChartOpen c (f * g) p
      (crossMulDRSec f g p (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) f p x))
  rw [localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap, crossMulDRSec_locMap,
    localizedRealizeChartOpen_locMap]
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun y =>
    chartRealizeOpen_mul_val c f g p x (y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2)

name: HodgePilot.LocalChartRealize.localizedRealizeChartOpen_mul_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChartOpen_mul_val (c : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ)
    (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (y : ↥(nvChartOpen c (f * g))) :
    (localizedRealizeChartOpen c f p ξ).1
        ⟨(y : Fin d → ℂ), nvChartOpen_mul_le_left c f g y.2⟩ =
      (localizedRealizeChartOpen c (f * g) p (crossMulDRSec f g p ξ)).1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (localizedRealizeChartOpen_mul_compat c f g p) ξ
  exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) y

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.twoPiI_ne_zero
statement: theorem twoPiI_ne_zero : twoPiI ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
    Complex.I_ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialScaleFactor_def
statement: theorem officialScaleFactor_def (p : ℕ) : officialScaleFactor p = twoPiI ^ p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialScaleFactor_zero
statement: theorem officialScaleFactor_zero : officialScaleFactor 0 = 1
proof: := pow_zero _

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialScaleFactor_one
statement: theorem officialScaleFactor_one : officialScaleFactor 1 = twoPiI
proof: := pow_one _

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialScaleFactor_add
statement:
theorem officialScaleFactor_add (p q : ℕ) :
    officialScaleFactor (p + q) = officialScaleFactor p * officialScaleFactor q
proof:
:=
  pow_add _ p q

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialScaleFactor_ne_zero
statement: theorem officialScaleFactor_ne_zero (p : ℕ) : officialScaleFactor p ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  pow_ne_zero p twoPiI_ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.zpow_twoPiI_ne_zero
statement: theorem zpow_twoPiI_ne_zero (m : ℤ) : twoPiI ^ m ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  zpow_ne_zero m twoPiI_ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_def
statement:
theorem tateCarrierQ_def (m : ℤ) :
    tateCarrierQ m = Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ m}
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.mem_tateCarrierQ_self
statement: theorem mem_tateCarrierQ_self (m : ℤ) : twoPiI ^ m ∈ tateCarrierQ m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_ne_bot
statement: theorem tateCarrierQ_ne_bot (m : ℤ) : tateCarrierQ m ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h =>
  zpow_twoPiI_ne_zero m ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp h _ (mem_tateCarrierQ_self m))

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_zero
statement: theorem tateCarrierQ_zero : tateCarrierQ 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ (0 : ℤ)} = 1
  rw [zpow_zero]
  exact (Submodule.one_eq_span).symm

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_one
statement: theorem tateCarrierQ_one : tateCarrierQ 1 = Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI}
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ (1 : ℤ)} = _
  rw [zpow_one]

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_natCast
statement:
theorem tateCarrierQ_natCast (p : ℕ) :
    tateCarrierQ p = Submodule.span ℚ {officialScaleFactor p}
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ (p : ℤ)} = _
  rw [zpow_natCast]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateCarrierQ_mul
statement:
theorem tateCarrierQ_mul (a b : ℤ) :
    tateCarrierQ a * tateCarrierQ b = tateCarrierQ (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ a} * Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ b} =
    Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ (a + b)}
  rw [Submodule.span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul_singleton,
    ← zpow_add₀ twoPiI_ne_zero]

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.map_mulLeft_tateCarrierQ
statement:
theorem map_mulLeft_tateCarrierQ (m : ℤ) :
    (tateCarrierQ m).map (LinearMap.mulLeft ℚ twoPiI) = tateCarrierQ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  show (Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ m}).map (LinearMap.mulLeft ℚ twoPiI) =
    Submodule.span ℚ {twoPiI ^ (m + 1)}
  rw [Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    mul_comm twoPiI (twoPiI ^ m), ← zpow_add_one₀ twoPiI_ne_zero]

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateRealization_apply
statement:
theorem tateRealization_apply (m : ℤ) (c : ℚ) :
    tateRealization m c = c • twoPiI ^ m
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateRealization_apply_eq_mul
statement:
theorem tateRealization_apply_eq_mul (m : ℤ) (c : ℚ) :

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.tateRealization_injective

    Function.Injective (tateRealization m)
proof:

  intro a b hab
  have h : (a : ℂ) * twoPiI ^ m = (b : ℂ) * twoPiI ^ m := by
    rw [← tateRealization_apply_eq_mul, ← tateRealization_apply_eq_mul]
    exact hab
  exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ (zpow_twoPiI_ne_zero m) h

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.twoPiPowCoeffHom_zero
statement:
theorem twoPiPowCoeffHom_zero :
    twoPiPowCoeffHom.{u} 0 = 𝟙 (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  refine AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext (AddMonoidHom.ext fun z => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z⟩ := z
  show ULift.up (twoPiI ^ 0 * z) = ULift.up z
  rw [pow_zero, one_mul]

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.twoPiPowCoeffHom_add

    twoPiPowCoeffHom.{u} (p + q) = twoPiPowCoeffHom.{u} p ≫ twoPiPowCoeffHom.{u} q
proof:
:= by
  refine AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext (AddMonoidHom.ext fun z => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z⟩ := z
  show ULift.up (twoPiI ^ (p + q) * z) = ULift.up (twoPiI ^ q * (twoPiI ^ p * z))
  exact congrArg ULift.up (by rw [pow_add]; ring)

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.scalePowTwoPiI_add_apply

proof:

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.scalePowTwoPiI_succ_apply

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialJunctionEvaluation_receipt
statement:
theorem officialJunctionEvaluation_receipt :
    OfficialJunctionEvaluation =
      (deRhamJunction (cRingHom ProjectiveLine.structMor)
          (sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor)
          (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ ProjectiveLine.structMor 1)
          (formsInputProper ProjectiveLine.structMor 1) ((2 * 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
          PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace =
        analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1)
          (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
            (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
              PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateTwistLayer.officialJunctionEvaluation_zsmul
statement:
theorem officialJunctionEvaluation_zsmul
    (htw : JunctionEvaluation.DinfJunctionEvaluationTwisted) (k : ℤ) :
    deRhamJunction (cRingHom ProjectiveLine.structMor)
        (sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor)
        (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ ProjectiveLine.structMor 1)
        (formsInputProper ProjectiveLine.structMor 1) ((2 * 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        (k • PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace) =
      analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1)
        (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
          (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
            (k • PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (map_zsmul (deRhamJunction (cRingHom ProjectiveLine.structMor)
      (sPointsToZariski ProjectiveLine.structMor)
      (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ ProjectiveLine.structMor 1)
      (formsInputProper ProjectiveLine.structMor 1) ((2 * 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) k
      PredicateAcceptance.dinfCycleClassSpace).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t => k • t) htw).trans ?_
  refine (map_zsmul (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1))
      k (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
        (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
          PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass))).symm.trans ?_
  refine congrArg (analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv ProjectiveLine.structMor 1 (2 * 1)) ?_
  refine (map_zsmul (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor))
      (2 * 1)) k
      (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1)
        PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass)).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (scaleTwoPiI (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor)) (2 * 1))
    (map_zsmul (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints ProjectiveLine.structMor))
      (2 * 1)) k PredicateAcceptance.bettiEdgeClass).symm

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineRatio_def
statement: theorem lineRatio_def : lineRatio = -(zElt 1 2)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.divSection_add
statement:
theorem divSection_add {W : p2.Opens} (h : genericPoint p2 ∈ W)
    (v v' : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) :
    divSection h (v + v') = divSection h v + divSection h v'
proof:
:= by
  have hz : zSection h (v + v') = zSection h v + zSection h v' :=
    map_add (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p2 h).symm).hom v v'
  show (divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W) (zSection h (v + v')) =
    (divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W) (zSection h v) +
      (divisorsπ p2).hom.app (op W) (zSection h v')
  rw [hz, map_add]

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineOneDatum_eq
statement:
theorem lineOneDatum_eq (i : Fin 3) :
    lineOneDatum i = lineTwoDatum i + lineRatio
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineRatio_def]
  match i with
  | 0 =>
    show zElt 0 1 = zElt 0 2 + -(zElt 1 2)
    rw [← zElt_cocycle]; abel
  | 1 =>
    show (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) = zElt 1 2 + -(zElt 1 2)
    rw [add_neg_cancel]
  | 2 =>
    show -(zElt 1 2) = (0 : functionFieldUnitsAb p2) + -(zElt 1 2)
    rw [zero_add]

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineOneSection_eq
statement:
theorem lineOneSection_eq (i : Fin 3) :
    lineOneSection i =
      lineTwoSection i + divSection (genericPoint_mem_chart i) lineRatio
proof:
:= by
  show divSection (genericPoint_mem_chart i) (lineOneDatum i) =
    divSection (genericPoint_mem_chart i) (lineTwoDatum i) +
      divSection (genericPoint_mem_chart i) lineRatio
  rw [← divSection_add, ← lineOneDatum_eq]

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineOneTop_eq
statement:
theorem lineOneTop_eq :
    lineOneTop =
      lineTwoTop +
        divSection (Opens.mem_top (genericPoint p2)) lineRatio
proof:
:= by
  refine (lineOneTop_unique _ ?_).symm
  intro i
  have hres :
      (divisorsAb p2).obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op
          (divSection (Opens.mem_top (genericPoint p2)) lineRatio) =
        divSection (genericPoint_mem_chart i) lineRatio :=
    divSection_res (homOfLE (le_top : chart i ≤ ⊤)).op
      (Opens.mem_top (genericPoint p2)) (genericPoint_mem_chart i) lineRatio
  rw [map_add, lineTwoTop_restrict i, hres, ← lineOneSection_eq i]

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineOne_eq
statement: theorem lineOne_eq : lineOne = lineTwo + divOf p2 lineRatio
proof:
:= by
  apply (cdivSectionsEquiv p2).injective
  
  
  
  rw [map_add, cdivSectionsEquiv_divOf_lineRatio,
      show cdivSectionsEquiv p2 lineOne = lineOneTop from
        (cdivSectionsEquiv p2).apply_symm_apply lineOneTop,
      show cdivSectionsEquiv p2 lineTwo = lineTwoTop from
        (cdivSectionsEquiv p2).apply_symm_apply lineTwoTop]
  exact lineOneTop_eq

name: HodgePilot.PlaneLineHomology.lineDataDistinct_iff
statement: theorem lineDataDistinct_iff : LineDataDistinct ↔ divOf p2 lineRatio ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold LineDataDistinct
  constructor
  · intro h hz
    exact h (by rw [lineOne_eq, hz, add_zero])
  · intro h heq
    apply h
    have hcancel : lineTwo + divOf p2 lineRatio = lineTwo + 0 := by
      rw [add_zero, ← lineOne_eq]; exact heq
    exact add_left_cancel hcancel

name: HodgePilot.CycleClassOne.chernShape_comp_hyperHMap
statement:
theorem chernShape_comp_hyperHMap (Z M : A) {L L' : CochainComplex A ℤ}
    (u : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor A 1).obj M ⟶ L) (v : L ⟶ L')
    (x : Abelian.Ext Z M 1) :
    chernShape Z M L' (u ≫ v) x = hyperHMap Z v 2 (chernShape Z M L u x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernShape_apply, chernShape_apply, hyperHMap_comp,
    hyperHMap_apply M v 1, hyperHMap_apply Z v 2]
  rw [← ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀ (hyperHMap M u 1 (singleShiftedHom M)) 0 rfl
    (DerivedCategory.Q.map v)]
  rw [← ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀
    (x.hom.comp (hyperHMap M u 1 (singleShiftedHom M)) (by lia)) 0 rfl
    (DerivedCategory.Q.map v)]
  exact (ShiftedHom.comp_assoc x.hom (hyperHMap M u 1 (singleShiftedHom M))
    (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl (DerivedCategory.Q.map v)) (by lia) (by lia) (by lia)).symm

name: HodgePilot.CycleClassOne.dlogSheaf_comp_d
statement: theorem dlogSheaf_comp_d : dlogSheaf φ ≫ (deRhamSheafComplexN φ).d 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (deRhamSheafComplexN φ).d 1 2 = dSheafAb φ 1 := deRhamSheafComplexN_d φ 1
  rw [hd]
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  show dlogSite φ ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (dSite φ 1) (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) =
    (0 : (unitsAffine X).obj ⟶
      presheafSite φ 2 ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  have h2 : (drComplexAbSite φ).d 1 2 =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor X).op (dAbOpens φ 1) :=
    drComplexAbSite_d φ 1
  have h3 : Functor.whiskerRight (dSite φ 1) (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) =
      (drComplexAbSite φ).d 1 2 := by
    rw [h2]
    rfl
  rw [h3]
  exact dlogSite_comp_d φ

name: HodgePilot.CycleClassOne.chernOne_eq_full
statement:
theorem chernOne_eq_full (x : unitsAffineH X 1) :
    chernOne φ x = chernOneFull φ x
proof:
:= by
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  rw [chernOne_apply]
  show hyperHMap (zConstSheaf _) (ιBrutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φ) 1) 2
      (chernOneTrunc φ x) = chernOneFull φ x
  rw [show chernOneFull φ x = chernShape (zConstSheaf _) (unitsAffine X)
      (deRhamSheafComplex φ) (chernOneSingleFull φ) x from rfl,
    ← chernOneSingle_ι φ]

name: HodgePilot.sum_basis_tmul_dualMap
statement:
theorem sum_basis_tmul_dualMap {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] {ιV ιW : Type*} [Fintype ιV] [Fintype ιW]
    (bV : Basis ιV k V) (bW : Basis ιW k W) (u : V →ₗ[k] W) :
    ∑ i, u (bV i) ⊗ₜ[k] bV.coord i = ∑ j, bW j ⊗ₜ[k] u.dualMap (bW.coord j)
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ i, u (bV i) ⊗ₜ[k] bV.coord i
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, bW.repr (u (bV i)) j • (bW j ⊗ₜ[k] bV.coord i) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        conv_lhs => rw [← bW.sum_repr (u (bV i))]
        rw [TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, bW.repr (u (bV i)) j • (bW j ⊗ₜ[k] bV.coord i) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ j, bW j ⊗ₜ[k] u.dualMap (bW.coord j) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        conv_rhs => rw [← bV.sum_dual_apply_smul_coord (u.dualMap (bW.coord j))]
        rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, LinearMap.dualMap_apply, Basis.coord_apply]

name: HodgePilot.sum_dual_apply_smul_apply
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_dual_apply_smul_coord f, TensorProduct.sum_tmul, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul]

name: HodgePilot.sum_coord_apply_smul_apply

name: HodgePilot.CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext₂

    (h : ∀ X Y : J,
      φ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (matrixCoeff F X) (matrixCoeff F Y) =
        ψ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (matrixCoeff F X) (matrixCoeff F Y)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.curry_injective
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro X
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro w
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro w'
  have hww' := LinearMap.congr_fun (h X Y) (w ⊗ₜ[k] w')

statement:
@[simp]
theorem comulComponent_tmul (X : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (v : F.obj X) :
    comulComponent F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      ∑ i, matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F X i) ⊗ₜ[k]
        matrixCoeff F X ((coeffBasis F X).coord i ⊗ₜ[k] v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [comulComponent]

name: HodgePilot.comulComponent_dinatural
statement:
theorem comulComponent_dinatural {X Y : J} (u : X ⟶ Y) :
    comulComponent F X ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj X) (F.map u).hom.dualMap =
      comulComponent F Y ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (F.map u).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, comulComponent_tmul]
  have key := congrArg
    (TensorProduct.map
      (matrixCoeff F Y ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk k (Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (F.obj Y) f)
      (matrixCoeff F X ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk k (Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (F.obj X)).flip v))
    (sum_basis_tmul_dualMap (coeffBasis F X) (coeffBasis F Y) (F.map u).hom)
  simp only [map_sum, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply] at key
  simp only [matrixCoeff_naturality] at key ⊢
  exact key

proof:

        zarComparisonPresheaf N (p + 1) =
      zarComparisonPresheaf N p ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).op
          (dPresheafAb N p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).op)
    (comparisonPresheaf_square (N := N) p)

name: HodgePilot.JunctionForms.zarComparisonSheaf_square
statement:
lemma zarComparisonSheaf_square (p : ℕ) :
    (constantSheaf (zarSite N) AddCommGrpCat).map (dAb (N := N) p) ≫
        zarComparisonSheaf N (p + 1) =
      zarComparisonSheaf N p ≫
        (pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).map (dSheafForms N p)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm
    (adj := sheafificationAdjunction (zarSite N) AddCommGrpCat)
    (Y := (pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).obj (formSheafAb N (p + 1)))
    ((Functor.const (Opens (zarTop N))ᵒᵖ).map (dAb (N := N) p))
    (zarComparisonPresheaf N (p + 1))
  have hR := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
    (adj := sheafificationAdjunction (zarSite N) AddCommGrpCat)
    (Y := (pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).obj (formSheafAb N p))
    (zarComparisonPresheaf N p)
    ((pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).map (dSheafForms N p))
  refine Eq.trans (Eq.trans hL.symm ?_) hR
  exact congrArg
    (fun q => ((sheafificationAdjunction (zarSite N) AddCommGrpCat).homEquiv
      ((Functor.const (Opens (zarTop N))ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (DR ℂ (Poly N) p)))
      ((pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).obj (formSheafAb N (p + 1)))).symm q)
    (zarComparisonPresheaf_square N p)

name: HodgePilot.analyticOnNhd_sectionExtend
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ) ω f.1 := f.2
  have h1 : (fun z : ↥U => sectionExtend f ↑z) = f.1 :=

  have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ) ω
      (fun z : ↥U => sectionExtend f ↑z) ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    rw [h1]; exact hf ⟨y, hy⟩
  have h3 : ContDiffAt ℂ ω (sectionExtend f) y :=
    contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp (contMDiffAt_subtype_iff.mp h2)
  exact analyticWithinAt_univ.mp (contDiffWithinAt_omega_iff_analyticWithinAt.mp h3)

    φ v = v 0 * φ (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : v = fun i => v i • (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℂ)) i := by
    funext i; simp
  rw [h, φ.map_smul_univ]
  simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.exists_primitive_form
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_form (ω : ℂ → (ℂ [⋀^Fin 1]→L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (hω : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ω (ball c r)) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ ball c r,
      extDeriv (fun x => constOfIsEmpty ℂ ℂ (Fin 0) (G x)) z = ω z
proof:
:= by
  
  have hωd : DifferentiableOn ℂ ω (ball c r) := fun z hz =>
    (hω z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (coeff1 ω) (ball c r) :=
    hωd.continuousAlternatingMap_apply (fun _ => differentiableOn_const 1)
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := hg.isExactOn_ball
  refine ⟨G, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hfd : fderiv ℂ G z =
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) (coeff1 ω z) :=
    (hG z hz).hasFDerivAt.fderiv
  rw [extDeriv_constOfIsEmpty, hfd]
  ext
  simp [coeff1]
