lemma finChart_symm_apply (φ₀ : CPoints S) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (finChart Q e φ₀).symm y
      = chartInv Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation φ₀ (isUnit_apply_jacobian Q φ₀)
          ((reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.finChart_source
statement:
lemma finChart_source (φ₀ : CPoints S) :
    (finChart Q e φ₀).source = (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).source
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.finChart_target
statement:
lemma finChart_target (φ₀ : CPoints S) :
    (finChart Q e φ₀).target
      = ⇑(reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm ⁻¹' (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).target
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.mem_finChart_source
statement: lemma mem_finChart_source (φ₀ : CPoints S) : φ₀ ∈ (finChart Q e φ₀).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [finChart_source]
  exact mem_sliceChartOfSubmersive_source Q φ₀

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.mem_finChart_target
statement:
lemma mem_finChart_target (φ₀ : CPoints S) {y : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ (finChart Q e φ₀).target) :
    (reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y
      ∈ chartTarget Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation φ₀ (isUnit_apply_jacobian Q φ₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finChart_target] at hy
  have h1 : (reindexHomeomorph Q e).symm y
      ∈ (sliceChartOfSubmersive Q φ₀).target := hy
  rwa [sliceChartOfSubmersive_def, sliceChart_target] at h1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.finChart_apply_symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [finChart_apply, finChart_symm_apply,
    chartFun_chartInv Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation φ₀ (isUnit_apply_jacobian Q φ₀)
      (mem_finChart_target Q e φ₀ hy)]
  exact (reindexHomeomorph Q e).apply_symm_apply y

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.mem_atlas_chartedSpaceCPoints
statement:
lemma mem_atlas_chartedSpaceCPoints {c : OpenPartialHomeomorph (CPoints S) (Fin d → ℂ)} :
    c ∈ (chartedSpaceCPoints Q e).atlas ↔ ∃ φ₀ : CPoints S, c = finChart Q e φ₀
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.isManifold_cpoints
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartedSpaceCPoints Q e
  refine isManifold_of_contDiffOn 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω (CPoints S) ?_
  rintro c₁ c₂ ⟨φ₁, rfl⟩ ⟨φ₂, rfl⟩
  simp only [modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Function.comp_id,
    Function.id_comp, Set.preimage_id, Set.range_id, Set.inter_univ]
  refine contDiffOn_id.congr fun y hy => ?_
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source] at hy
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply, id_eq]
  exact finChart_apply_symm Q e φ₁ φ₂ hy.1

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.isManifold_cpoints_dimension
proof:
:=
  isManifold_cpoints Q (kappaEquivFin Q)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.affinePresentation_dimension
statement: lemma affinePresentation_dimension : (affinePresentation n).dimension = n
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card (Fin n) - Nat.card (Fin 0) = n
  simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.gmPre_jacobiMatrix
statement:
lemma gmPre_jacobiMatrix (i j : Fin 1) :
    gmPre.jacobiMatrix i j = pderiv (0 : Fin 2) (gmRelation j)
proof:
:=
  PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_naive _ _ _ _ i j

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.gmPre_jacobian
statement:
lemma gmPre_jacobian :
    gmPre.jacobian = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation)) (X 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det, Matrix.det_fin_one,
    gmPre_jacobiMatrix]
  have h1 : pderiv (0 : Fin 2) (gmRelation 0) = X 1 := by
    show pderiv (0 : Fin 2) ((X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) * X 1 - 1) = X 1
    rw [map_sub, pderiv_one, sub_zero, pderiv_mul, pderiv_X_self,
      pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide), one_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [h1, Generators.algebraMap_apply, aeval_X]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.isUnit_gmPre_jacobian
statement: lemma isUnit_gmPre_jacobian : IsUnit gmPre.jacobian
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmPre_jacobian]
  refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X 0)) ?_
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range gmRelation))),
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
  refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨0, ?_⟩
  show (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) * X 1 - 1 = X 1 * X 0 - 1
  rw [mul_comm (X 0) (X 1)]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsStandardSmooth.gmPresentation_dimension
statement: lemma gmPresentation_dimension : gmPresentation.dimension = 1
proof:
:= by
  show Nat.card (Fin 2) - Nat.card (Fin 1) = 1
  simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.awayRes_apply
statement: lemma awayRes_apply (ψ : CPoints S) (a : A) : awayRes A S ψ a = ψ (algebraMap A S a)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.awayRes_ne_zero
statement: lemma awayRes_ne_zero (ψ : CPoints S) : awayRes A S ψ f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (IsUnit.map ψ (IsLocalization.map_units S
    (⟨f, Submonoid.mem_powers f⟩ : Submonoid.powers f))).ne_zero

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isUnit_apply_powers
statement:
lemma isUnit_apply_powers (φ : CPoints A) (hφ : φ f ≠ 0) (y : Submonoid.powers f) :
    IsUnit (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.2
  rw [← hn, map_pow]
  exact (pow_ne_zero n hφ).isUnit

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.awayLift_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma awayLift_algebraMap (φ : CPoints A) (hφ : φ f ≠ 0) (a : A) :
    awayLift f S φ hφ (algebraMap A S a) = φ a
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.lift_eq _ a

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.awayRes_awayLift
statement:
lemma awayRes_awayLift (φ : CPoints A) (hφ : φ f ≠ 0) :
    awayRes A S (awayLift f S φ hφ) = φ
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun a => awayLift_algebraMap f S φ hφ a

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_awayRes
statement: lemma continuous_awayRes : Continuous (awayRes A S)
proof: := continuous_comap _

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_awayEquiv
statement: lemma continuous_awayEquiv : Continuous (awayEquiv f S)
proof:
:= by
  exact Continuous.subtype_mk (continuous_awayRes S) _

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_awayLift
statement:
lemma continuous_awayLift :
    Continuous fun s : {φ : CPoints A // φ f ≠ 0} => awayLift f S s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_induced_rng.2 (continuous_pi fun x => ?_)
  show Continuous fun s : {φ : CPoints A // φ f ≠ 0} => awayLift f S s.1 s.2 x
  obtain ⟨⟨a, y⟩, hxy⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := Submonoid.powers f) (S := S) x
  dsimp only at hxy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.2
  have key : ∀ s : {φ : CPoints A // φ f ≠ 0},
      awayLift f S s.1 s.2 x = s.1 a * (s.1 f ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro s
    rw [eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq₀ (pow_ne_zero n s.2), ← map_pow]
    have h1 := congrArg (awayLift f S s.1 s.2) hxy
    rw [map_mul, awayLift_algebraMap, awayLift_algebraMap, ← hn] at h1
    exact h1
  simp only [key]
  exact ((continuous_ev a).comp continuous_subtype_val).mul
    ((((continuous_ev f).comp continuous_subtype_val).pow n).inv₀
      fun s => pow_ne_zero n s.2)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.awayRes_eq_val_comp
statement: lemma awayRes_eq_val_comp : awayRes A S = Subtype.val ∘ (awayHomeomorph f S)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isOpenEmbedding_awayRes
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_awayRes : IsOpenEmbedding (awayRes A S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayRes_eq_val_comp f S]
  exact ((isOpen_setOf_ne_zero f).isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal).comp
    (awayHomeomorph f S).isOpenEmbedding

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.range_awayRes
statement: theorem range_awayRes : Set.range (awayRes A S) = {φ : CPoints A | φ f ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayRes_eq_val_comp f S, (awayHomeomorph f S).surjective.range_comp]
  exact Subtype.range_coe

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.SpecMap_algHomOfSpecHom
statement:
lemma SpecMap_algHomOfSpecHom {R S : Type} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℂ R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra ℂ S] (g : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    (hg : g ≫ structMor R = structMor S) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algHomOfSpecHom g hg).toRingHom) = g
proof:
:= by
  show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Spec.preimage g).hom) = g
  rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.probe_coe
statement:
lemma probe_coe {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B] (h : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ X)
    (hh : h ≫ sX = structMor B) (φ : CPoints B) :
    (probe sX h hh φ).1 = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ h
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.topSPoints_eq
statement:
lemma topSPoints_eq : instTopSPoints sX =
    ⨆ c : Chart sX, TopologicalSpace.coinduced (probe sX c.hom c.over) (instTopCPoints c.A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_probeChart
statement: theorem continuous_probeChart (c : Chart sX) : Continuous (probe sX c.hom c.over)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_coinduced_le, topSPoints_eq sX]
  exact le_iSup
    (fun c : Chart sX => TopologicalSpace.coinduced (probe sX c.hom c.over) (instTopCPoints c.A)) c

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_of_probeCharts
statement:
theorem continuous_of_probeCharts {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] {k : SPoints sX → T}
    (H : ∀ c : Chart sX, Continuous (k ∘ probe sX c.hom c.over)) : Continuous k
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_le_induced, topSPoints_eq sX, iSup_le_iff]
  intro c
  rw [coinduced_le_iff_le_induced, induced_compose]
  exact continuous_iff_le_induced.mp (H c)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isOpen_SPoints_iff
statement:
lemma isOpen_SPoints_iff {V : Set (SPoints sX)} :
    IsOpen V ↔ ∀ c : Chart sX, IsOpen (probe sX c.hom c.over ⁻¹' V)
proof:
:= by
  show IsOpen[⨆ c : Chart sX,
    TopologicalSpace.coinduced (probe sX c.hom c.over) (instTopCPoints c.A)] V ↔ _
  rw [isOpen_iSup_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun c => isOpen_coinduced

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.injective_probeChart
statement: theorem injective_probeChart (c : Chart sX) : Function.Injective (probe sX c.hom c.over)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ hfψ
  have h1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ c.hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) ≫ c.hom := congrArg Subtype.val hfψ
  have h2 := Spec.map_injective ((cancel_mono c.hom).mp h1)
  have h3 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom h2
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h3
  exact AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective h3

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.bridge_eq_probe_id
statement: lemma bridge_eq_probe_id : ⇑(bridge A) = probe (structMor A) (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _)
proof:
:= by
  funext φ
  exact Subtype.ext (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_bridge
statement: theorem continuous_bridge : Continuous (bridge A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bridge_eq_probe_id A]
  exact continuous_probeChart (structMor A)
    { A := A, hom := 𝟙 _, over := Category.id_comp _ }

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_bridge_symm
statement: theorem continuous_bridge_symm : Continuous (bridge A).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_probeCharts
  intro c
  have hkey : ⇑(bridge A).symm ∘ probe (structMor A) c.hom c.over =
      comap (algHomOfSpecHom c.hom c.over) := by
    funext φ
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ c.hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((comap (algHomOfSpecHom c.hom c.over) φ)).toRingHom)
    rw [show ((comap (algHomOfSpecHom c.hom c.over) φ)).toRingHom =
        φ.toRingHom.comp (algHomOfSpecHom c.hom c.over).toRingHom from rfl]
    rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp, SpecMap_algHomOfSpecHom]
  rw [hkey]
  exact continuous_comap _

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.exists_chart_mem
statement: theorem exists_chart_mem (x : X) : ∃ c : Chart sX, x ∈ Set.range ⇑c.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  refine ⟨affineOpenChart sX hU, ?_⟩
  show x ∈ Set.range ⇑(IsAffineOpen.fromSpec hU)
  rw [IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec]
  exact hxU

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.mem_basicOpen_toZariski
statement:
lemma mem_basicOpen_toZariski {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B] (φ : CPoints B) (g : B) :
    toZariski φ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ↔ φ g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen]
  simp [toZariski, RingHom.mem_ker]

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.exists_away_factor
statement:
theorem exists_away_factor {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (h : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ X) (hh : h ≫ sX = structMor B) (c : Chart sX)
    {φ₀ : CPoints B} (hc : h (toZariski φ₀) ∈ Set.range ⇑c.hom) :
    ∃ (g : B) (ρ : c.A →ₐ[ℂ] Localization.Away g), φ₀ g ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ s : {φ : CPoints B // φ g ≠ 0},
        probe sX h hh s.1 =
          probe sX c.hom c.over (comap ρ (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2))
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsOpen (⇑h ⁻¹' (Set.range ⇑c.hom)) :=
    (c.hom.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range).preimage h.continuous
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxs, hsub⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hc hV
  have hg0 : φ₀ g ≠ 0 := (mem_basicOpen_toZariski φ₀ g).mp hxs
  have hrange : Set.range ⇑(Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g))) ≫ h)
      ⊆ Set.range ⇑c.hom := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    apply hsub
    show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g))) y ∈
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g : Set (PrimeSpectrum B))
    rw [Spec.map_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
    have hy : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)) y ∈
        Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g))) :=
      Set.mem_range_self y
    rwa [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (Localization.Away g) g] at hy
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l', l' ≫ c.hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g))) ≫ h :=
    ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom _ hrange, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac c.hom _ hrange⟩
  have hstep : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g))) ≫ structMor B =
      structMor (Localization.Away g) := by
    rw [structMor, structMor, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  have hlover : l ≫ structMor c.A = structMor (Localization.Away g) := by
    rw [← c.over, ← Category.assoc, hl, Category.assoc, hh, hstep]
  have hρ := SpecMap_algHomOfSpecHom l hlover
  refine ⟨g, algHomOfSpecHom l hlover, hg0, fun s => ?_⟩
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom s.1.toRingHom) ≫ h =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2).comp
      (algHomOfSpecHom l hlover)).toRingHom) ≫ c.hom
  rw [show ((awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2).comp
      (algHomOfSpecHom l hlover)).toRingHom =
      (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2).toRingHom.comp
        (algHomOfSpecHom l hlover).toRingHom from rfl]
  rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp, hρ, Category.assoc, hl, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rw [show (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2).toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)) = s.1.toRingHom from
    congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (awayRes_awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2)]

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_probe
statement:
theorem continuous_probe {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (h : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ X) (hh : h ≫ sX = structMor B) :
    Continuous (probe sX h hh)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro φ₀
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_chart_mem sX (h (toZariski φ₀))
  obtain ⟨g, ρ, hg0, hfact⟩ := exists_away_factor sX h hh c hc
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (probe sX h hh) {φ : CPoints B | φ g ≠ 0} := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have hres : ({φ : CPoints B | φ g ≠ 0}).restrict (probe sX h hh) =
        (probe sX c.hom c.over) ∘ (comap ρ) ∘
          (fun s : {φ : CPoints B // φ g ≠ 0} =>
            awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2) :=
      funext fun s => hfact s
    rw [hres]
    exact (continuous_probeChart sX c).comp
      ((continuous_comap _).comp (continuous_awayLift g (Localization.Away g)))
  exact hcont.continuousAt ((isOpen_setOf_ne_zero g).mem_nhds hg0)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.toSpace_probe
statement:
theorem toSpace_probe {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    (h : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ X) (hh : h ≫ sX = structMor B) (φ : CPoints B) :
    toSpace sX (probe sX h hh φ) = h (toZariski φ)
proof:
:= by
  show (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ h) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ) = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ) = toZariski φ
  rw [Spec.map_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  refine PrimeSpectrum.ext ?_
  show Ideal.comap φ.toRingHom (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ).asIdeal = RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom
  rw [show (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ).asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℂ from rfl,
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot]
  exact (RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot _).symm

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_toSpace
statement: theorem continuous_toSpace : Continuous (toSpace sX)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_probeCharts
  intro c
  have hfact : toSpace sX ∘ probe sX c.hom c.over = ⇑c.hom ∘ toZariski := by
    funext φ
    exact toSpace_probe sX c.hom c.over φ
  rw [hfact]
  exact c.hom.continuous.comp continuous_toZariski

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isOpenMap_probeChart
statement: theorem isOpenMap_probeChart (c : Chart sX) : IsOpenMap (probe sX c.hom c.over)
proof:
:= by
  intro W hW
  rw [isOpen_SPoints_iff sX]
  intro c'
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro φ' hφ'
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, hψ₀W, hψ₀⟩ := hφ'
  have hx : c'.hom (toZariski φ') ∈ Set.range ⇑c.hom := by
    have h1 := congrArg (toSpace sX) hψ₀
    rw [toSpace_probe sX c.hom c.over ψ₀, toSpace_probe sX c'.hom c'.over φ'] at h1
    exact ⟨toZariski ψ₀, h1⟩
  obtain ⟨g, ρ, hg0, hfact⟩ := exists_away_factor sX c'.hom c'.over c hx
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' ((fun s : {φ'' : CPoints c'.A // φ'' g ≠ 0} =>
      comap ρ (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) s.1 s.2)) ⁻¹' W), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨s, hsW, rfl⟩
    show probe sX c'.hom c'.over s.1 ∈ probe sX c.hom c.over '' W
    exact ⟨_, hsW, (hfact s).symm⟩
  · exact ((isOpen_setOf_ne_zero g).isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal).isOpenMap _
      (hW.preimage ((continuous_comap _).comp (continuous_awayLift g (Localization.Away g))))
  · refine ⟨⟨φ', hg0⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    show comap ρ (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) φ' hg0) ∈ W
    have h3 : probe sX c.hom c.over (comap ρ (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) φ' hg0)) =
        probe sX c.hom c.over ψ₀ := (hfact ⟨φ', hg0⟩).symm.trans hψ₀.symm
    exact (injective_probeChart sX c h3) ▸ hψ₀W

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.isOpenEmbedding_probeChart
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_probeChart (c : Chart sX) : IsOpenEmbedding (probe sX c.hom c.over)
proof:
:=
  .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (continuous_probeChart sX c) (injective_probeChart sX c)
    (isOpenMap_probeChart sX c)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.continuous_mapSPoints
statement:
theorem continuous_mapSPoints {Y : Scheme} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (k : X ⟶ Y)
    (hk : k ≫ sY = sX) : Continuous (mapSPoints sX sY k hk)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_probeCharts
  intro c
  have hfact : mapSPoints sX sY k hk ∘ probe sX c.hom c.over =
      probe sY (c.hom ≫ k) (by rw [Category.assoc, hk, c.over]) := by
    funext φ
    exact Subtype.ext (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  rw [hfact]
  exact continuous_probe sY _ _

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.mapSPoints_id
statement: theorem mapSPoints_id : mapSPoints sX sX (𝟙 X) (Category.id_comp sX) = id
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  exact Subtype.ext (Category.comp_id p.1)

name: HodgePilot.Analytic.mapSPoints_comp
statement:
theorem mapSPoints_comp {Y Z : Scheme} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (sZ : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (k : X ⟶ Y) (m : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hk : k ≫ sY = sX) (hm : m ≫ sZ = sY) :
    mapSPoints sX sZ (k ≫ m) (by rw [Category.assoc, hm, hk]) =
      mapSPoints sY sZ m hm ∘ mapSPoints sX sY k hk
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  exact Subtype.ext (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: HodgePilot.sigmaR_involutive
statement: theorem sigmaR_involutive (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] V) : sigmaR V (sigmaR V x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c v => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaR_smul
statement:
theorem sigmaR_smul (c : ℂ) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] V) :
    sigmaR V (c • x) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c • sigmaR V x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c' v =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', sigmaR_tmul, sigmaR_tmul,
        TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]

name: HodgePilot.sigma_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem sigma_apply (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] V) : sigma V x = sigmaR V x

name: HodgePilot.sigma_sigma
statement: theorem sigma_sigma (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] V) : sigma V (sigma V x) = x
proof:

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.locallyConstant_apply_eq_of_joined
statement:
theorem locallyConstant_apply_eq_of_joined (f : LocallyConstant Y M) {x y : Y}
    (h : Joined x y) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  have hc : IsLocallyConstant (⇑f ∘ ⇑p) :=
    f.isLocallyConstant.comp_continuous p.continuous
  simpa using hc.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace 0 1

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.isSheaf_locConstPresheaf
statement: theorem isSheaf_locConstPresheaf : (locConstPresheaf X M).IsSheaf
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro ι U sf hsf
  change ∀ i, LocallyConstant (U i : Opens X) M at sf
  
  have hmem : ∀ x : ↥(iSup U), ∃ i, x.1 ∈ U i := fun x => Opens.mem_iSup.mp x.2
  let g : ↥(iSup U) → M := fun x => sf (hmem x).choose ⟨x.1, (hmem x).choose_spec⟩
  
  have key : ∀ (i : ι) (x : ↥(iSup U)) (hx : x.1 ∈ U i), sf i ⟨x.1, hx⟩ = g x := fun i x hx =>
    LocallyConstant.congr_fun (hsf i (hmem x).choose) ⟨x.1, hx, (hmem x).choose_spec⟩
  
  have hglc : IsLocallyConstant g := by
    rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmem x
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hfW⟩ := (sf i).isLocallyConstant.exists_open ⟨x.1, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨W', hW', rfl⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.mp hW
    refine ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (W' ∩ (U i : Set X)), ?_, ⟨hxW, hi⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact (hW'.inter (U i).2).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    · intro y hy
      rw [← key i y hy.2, ← key i x hi]
      exact (hfW ⟨y.1, hy.2⟩ hy.1).trans (hfW ⟨x.1, hi⟩ hxW).symm
  refine ⟨⟨g, hglc⟩, fun i => LocallyConstant.ext fun y => ?_, fun s' hs' => ?_⟩
  · 
    exact (key i ⟨y.1, (Opens.leSupr U i).le y.2⟩ y.2).symm
  · 
    exact LocallyConstant.ext fun x =>
      LocallyConstant.congr_fun (hs' (hmem x).choose) ⟨x.1, (hmem x).choose_spec⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.bijective_stalkMap_constToLocConst
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_constToLocConst (x : X) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constToLocConst X M))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro s t hst
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, a, rfl⟩ := (constPresheaf X M).exists_germ_eq (x := x) s
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, b, rfl⟩ := (constPresheaf X M).exists_germ_eq (x := x) t
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hst
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, hab⟩ := (locConstPresheaf X M).germ_eq x hxU hxV _ _ hst
    
    have hval : a = b := LocallyConstant.congr_fun hab ⟨x, hxW⟩
    calc (constPresheaf X M).germ U x hxU a
        = (constPresheaf X M).germ W x hxW ((constPresheaf X M).map iU.op a) :=
          ((constPresheaf X M).germ_res_apply iU x hxW a).symm
      _ = (constPresheaf X M).germ W x hxW ((constPresheaf X M).map iV.op b) :=
          congrArg (fun m => (constPresheaf X M).germ W x hxW m)
            (show (constPresheaf X M).map iU.op a = (constPresheaf X M).map iV.op b from hval)
      _ = (constPresheaf X M).germ V x hxV b :=
          (constPresheaf X M).germ_res_apply iV x hxW b
  · 
    intro t
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, rfl⟩ := (locConstPresheaf X M).exists_germ_eq (x := x) t
    change LocallyConstant (U : Opens X) M at f
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hfW⟩ := f.isLocallyConstant.exists_open ⟨x, hxU⟩
    obtain ⟨W', hW', rfl⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.mp hW
    have hxV : x ∈ U ⊓ ⟨W', hW'⟩ := ⟨hxU, hxW⟩
    refine ⟨(constPresheaf X M).germ (U ⊓ ⟨W', hW'⟩) x hxV (f ⟨x, hxU⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
    have hres : (locConstPresheaf X M).map
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ ⟨W', hW'⟩ ≤ U)).op f
        = (constToLocConst X M).app (op (U ⊓ ⟨W', hW'⟩)) (f ⟨x, hxU⟩) :=
      LocallyConstant.ext fun y => hfW ⟨y.1, y.2.1⟩ y.2.2
    rw [← hres,
      (locConstPresheaf X M).germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_left) x hxV f]

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.unit_comp_constantSheafToLocConstHom
statement:
lemma unit_comp_constantSheafToLocConstHom :
    constantSheafUnit X M ≫ constantSheafToLocConstHom X M = constToLocConst X M
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
    AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv (constPresheaf X M)
      (locConstSheaf X M)).apply_symm_apply (constToLocConst X M)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.bijective_stalkMap_constantSheafToLocConstHom
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_constantSheafToLocConstHom (x : X) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        (constantSheafToLocConstHom X M))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantSheafUnit X M) ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantSheafToLocConstHom X M) =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constToLocConst X M) :=
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map_comp
      (constantSheafUnit X M) (constantSheafToLocConstHom X M)).symm.trans
      (congrArg ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map)
        (unit_comp_constantSheafToLocConstHom X M))
  have hψ := bijective_stalkMap_constToLocConst X M x
  haveI : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
      (constantSheafUnit X M)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (constPresheaf X M)
  have hu : Function.Bijective
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantSheafUnit X M)) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have hfun : ∀ a, ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        (constantSheafToLocConstHom X M))
      (((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantSheafUnit X M)) a)
      = ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constToLocConst X M)) a := by
    intro a
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hcomp]
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hu.2 a
    obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hu.2 b
    rw [hfun, hfun] at hab
    rw [hψ.1 hab]
  · intro c
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hψ.2 c
    exact ⟨_, (hfun a').trans ha'⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.bijective_constantSheafToLocConst_app_top
statement:
theorem bijective_constantSheafToLocConst_app_top :
    Function.Bijective
      ((constantSheafToLocConst X M).hom.app (op (⊤ : Opens X)))
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Presheaf.app_bijective_of_stalkFunctor_map_bijective
    (constantSheafToLocConst X M) ⊤
    (fun x _ => bijective_stalkMap_constantSheafToLocConstHom X M x)

name: HodgePilot.SingularDegreeZero.bijective_dualDescend
statement: theorem bijective_dualDescend : Function.Bijective (dualDescend K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro φ φ' h
    have h' : homologyClassMap K ≫ φ = homologyClassMap K ≫ φ' :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h
    exact (cancel_epi (homologyClassMap K)).mp h'
  · rintro ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    have hψ' : K.d 1 0 ≫ ψ = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hψ
    refine ⟨(ChainComplex.isoHomologyι₀ K).hom ≫
      K.descOpcycles ψ 1 (by simp [ChainComplex.prev]) hψ', Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    show homologyClassMap K ≫ (ChainComplex.isoHomologyι₀ K).hom ≫
      K.descOpcycles ψ 1 (by simp [ChainComplex.prev]) hψ' = ψ
    rw [isoHomologyι_hom, ← Category.assoc, homologyClassMap_comp_homologyι,
      p_descOpcycles]

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.overlapRingHom_eq_iso_hom
statement:
theorem overlapRingHom_eq_iso_hom
    (x : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) :
    overlapRingHom x = overlapSectionIso.hom x
proof:
:= by
  show p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x) =
    p1.presheaf.map ((eqToIso U0_inf_U1).hom.op)
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x)
  exact congrArg
    (fun (h : U0 ⊓ U1 ⟶ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
      p1.presheaf.map h.op
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) x))
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.overlapRingHom_surjective

proof:
:= fun z =>
  ⟨overlapSectionIso.inv z, by

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.overlapAlgHom_T_int
statement:
theorem overlapAlgHom_T_int (n : ℤ) :
    overlapAlgHom (T n) =
      ((overlapUnitSec ^ n : (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (T n : ℂ[T;T⁻¹]) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (n : ℤ) (1 : ℂ) from by
      rw [single_eq_C_mul_T, map_one, one_mul],
    overlapAlgHom]
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, one_smul]
  show (((zpowersHom ((Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ)) overlapUnitSec)
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ)) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = _
  rw [zpowersHom_apply]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.overlapAlgHom_surjective
statement: theorem overlapAlgHom_surjective : Function.Surjective overlapAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := overlapRingHom_surjective z
  have htop := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.adjoin_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
    (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) hX01 (Fin 2) MvPolynomial.X adjoin_range_X_eq_top
    (fun _ => 1) (fun k => X_mem_grade_one k)
  have hx := htop.ge (Algebra.mem_top (x := x))
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ai, hai, hle, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h3 : ai 0 + ai 1 = a * 2 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hai
    have hle0 : ai 0 ≤ 2 := hle 0
    have hle1 : ai 1 ≤ 2 := hle 1
    have ha2 : a ≤ 2 := by omega
    interval_cases a
    · 
      have hk0 : ai 0 = 0 := by omega
      have hk1 : ai 1 = 0 := by omega
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [map_one, show (1 : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = overlapRingHom 1 from
        (map_one overlapRingHom).symm]
      refine congrArg overlapRingHom ?_
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
        Fin.prod_univ_two, hk0, hk1, ← Localization.mk_one,
        Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      use 1
      simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_zero]
    · 
      have hk : ai 0 = 0 ∨ ai 0 = 1 ∨ ai 0 = 2 := by omega
      rcases hk with hk0 | hk0 | hk0
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 2 := by omega
        refine ⟨T 1, ?_⟩
        rw [overlapAlgHom_T, overlapUnit_coe]
        refine congrArg overlapRingHom ?_
        apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
        unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNum
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          Fin.prod_univ_two, hk0, hk1, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
          Localization.r_iff_exists]
        use 1
        simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_zero]
        ring
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 1 := by omega
        refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        rw [map_one, show (1 : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = overlapRingHom 1 from
          (map_one overlapRingHom).symm]
        refine congrArg overlapRingHom ?_
        apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          Fin.prod_univ_two, hk0, hk1, ← Localization.mk_one,
          Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
        use 1
        simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_one]
        ring
      · have hk1 : ai 1 = 0 := by omega
        refine ⟨T (-1), ?_⟩
        rw [overlapAlgHom_T_neg, overlapUnit_inv_coe]
        refine congrArg overlapRingHom ?_
        apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
        unfold ProjectiveLine.awayNumInv
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          Fin.prod_univ_two, hk0, hk1, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
          Localization.r_iff_exists]
        use 1
        simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_zero]
        ring
    · 
      have hk0 : ai 0 = 2 := by omega
      have hk1 : ai 1 = 2 := by omega
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [map_one, show (1 : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = overlapRingHom 1 from
        (map_one overlapRingHom).symm]
      refine congrArg overlapRingHom ?_
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
        Fin.prod_univ_two, hk0, hk1, ← Localization.mk_one,
        Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      use 1
      simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
      ring
  | algebraMap r =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective.2 r
    refine ⟨algebraMap ℂ ℂ[T;T⁻¹] c, ?_⟩
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_sec_U01 c]
    exact congrArg overlapRingHom
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℂ (𝒜₂ 0)
        (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) c)
  | add y w _ _ hy hw =>
    obtain ⟨Ly, hLy⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨Lw, hLw⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨Ly + Lw, by rw [map_add, hLy, hLw, map_add]⟩
  | mul y w _ _ hy hw =>
    obtain ⟨Ly, hLy⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨Lw, hLw⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨Ly * Lw, by rw [map_mul, hLy, hLw, map_mul]⟩

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.laurent_section_split
statement:
theorem laurent_section_split (z : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) :
    ∃ (a : Sec φC U0) (b : Sec φC U1),
      DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0) a -
        DeRhamPresheaf.res φC (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1) b = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := overlapAlgHom_surjective z
  induction L using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨ap, bp, hp'⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨aq, bq, hq'⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨ap + aq, bp + bq, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ← hp', ← hq']
    ring
  | C_mul_T n c =>
    have hval : overlapAlgHom (LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n) =
        c • ((overlapUnitSec ^ n : (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) := by
      rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, overlapAlgHom_T_int]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg n
    · 
      refine ⟨chartHomA 0 1 (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X ^ m), 0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, sub_zero, hval, zpow_natCast]
      have hpow : ((overlapUnitSec ^ m : (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) : Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) =
          overlapRingHom awayNum ^ m := by
        rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
        exact congrArg (fun t => t ^ m) overlapUnit_coe
      rw [hpow]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow]
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes,
        res_chartHomA_X_left]
      exact (Algebra.smul_def c _).symm
    · 
      refine ⟨0, -(chartHomA 1 0 (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X ^ m)), ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, hval, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      have hpow : (((overlapUnitSec ^ m)⁻¹ : (Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1))ˣ) :
          Sec φC (U0 ⊓ U1)) = overlapRingHom awayNumInv ^ m := by
        rw [← inv_pow, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
        exact congrArg (fun t => t ^ m) overlapUnit_inv_coe
      rw [hpow]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow]
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes,
        res_chartHomA_X_right]
      exact (Algebra.smul_def c _).symm

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.sections_split
statement:
theorem sections_split (s : structO.obj.obj (op (U0 ⊓ U1))) :
    ∃ (s0 : structO.obj.obj (op U0)) (s1 : structO.obj.obj (op U1)),
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op s0 -
        structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op s1 = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := laurent_section_split
    (oToRing ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩ s)
  refine ⟨ringToO ⟨U0, isAffineOpen_U0⟩ a, ringToO ⟨U1, isAffineOpen_U1⟩ b, ?_⟩
  have hOcL : structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op
      (ringToO ⟨U0, isAffineOpen_U0⟩ a) =
      ringToO ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩
        (p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op a) := by
    have h1 := oToRing_natural (W' := ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩)
      (W := ⟨U0, isAffineOpen_U0⟩) inf_le_left (ringToO ⟨U0, isAffineOpen_U0⟩ a)
    rw [oToRing_ringToO] at h1
    have h2 := congrArg (ringToO ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩) h1
    rwa [ringToO_oToRing] at h2
  have hOcR : structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op
      (ringToO ⟨U1, isAffineOpen_U1⟩ b) =
      ringToO ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩
        (p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op b) := by
    have h1 := oToRing_natural (W' := ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩)
      (W := ⟨U1, isAffineOpen_U1⟩) inf_le_right (ringToO ⟨U1, isAffineOpen_U1⟩ b)
    rw [oToRing_ringToO] at h1
    have h2 := congrArg (ringToO ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩) h1
    rwa [ringToO_oToRing] at h2
  rw [hOcL, hOcR, ← ringToO_sub]
  have h3 : p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op a -
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op b =
      oToRing ⟨U0 ⊓ U1, isAffineOpen_U01⟩ s := hab
  rw [h3, ringToO_oToRing]

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.fromBiprodO_surjective
statement:
theorem fromBiprodO_surjective (y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 (U0 ⊓ U1)) structO 0) :
    ∃ b, (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod structO 0 b = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s0, s1, hsplit⟩ := sections_split (h0ToSections structO (U0 ⊓ U1) y)
  refine ⟨(AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).inv
    (((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0,
      (h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1) :
      (structO.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ×
        (structO.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃)), ?_⟩
  rw [(Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod_biprodIsoProd_inv_apply structO
    ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0) ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1)]
  apply (h0SectionsEquiv structO (U0 ⊓ U1)).injective
  rw [map_sub, h0SectionsEquiv_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_apply, h0SectionsEquiv_apply]
  have hsecL : h0ToSections structO (U0 ⊓ U1)
      ((structO.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0)) =
      structO.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
        (h0ToSections structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂
          ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0)) :=
    (h0ToSections_natural structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂
      ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0)).symm
  have hsecR : h0ToSections structO (U0 ⊓ U1)
      ((structO.cohomologyPresheaf 0).map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
        ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1)) =
      structO.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
        (h0ToSections structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃
          ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1)) :=
    (h0ToSections_natural structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃
      ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1)).symm
  rw [hsecL, hsecR]
  have hL : h0ToSections structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂
      ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).symm s0) = s0 := by
    rw [← h0SectionsEquiv_apply]
    exact (h0SectionsEquiv structO U0).apply_symm_apply s0
  have hR : h0ToSections structO (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃
      ((h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).symm s1) = s1 := by
    rw [← h0SectionsEquiv_apply]
    exact (h0SectionsEquiv structO U1).apply_symm_apply s1
  rw [hL, hR]
  have harrL : structO.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op s0 =
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U0)).op s0 :=
    congrArg (fun (t : (U0 ⊓ U1 : p1.Opens) ⟶ U0) => structO.obj.map t.op s0)
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have harrR : structO.obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op s1 =
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0 ⊓ U1 ≤ U1)).op s1 :=
    congrArg (fun (t : (U0 ⊓ U1 : p1.Opens) ⟶ U1) => structO.obj.map t.op s1)
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [harrL, harrR, hsplit]

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.deltaO_eq_zero
statement:
theorem deltaO_eq_zero (y : Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 (U0 ⊓ U1)) structO 0) :
    (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).δ structO 0 1 rfl y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := fromBiprodO_surjective y
  rw [← hb]
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun (t : ((structO.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) ⊞
        (structO.H' 0 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃) :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ⟶
        structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₄) => t b)
    ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).fromBiprod_δ structO 0 1 rfl)
  refine h2.trans ?_
  show ((0 : _ ⟶ structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₄)) b = 0
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.subsingleton_hPrimeOne_sup
statement:
theorem subsingleton_hPrimeOne_sup :
    Subsingleton (Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 (U0 ⊔ U1)) structO 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  haveI hs2 : Subsingleton
      (structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂) :=
    subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U0
  haveI hs3 : Subsingleton
      (structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃) :=
    subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U1
  haveI hprod : Subsingleton
      ((structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂ :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ×
        (structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃ :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0})) :=
    ⟨fun p q => Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  haveI hbi : Subsingleton
      ((structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂ ⊞
        structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃ :
          AddCommGrpCat.{0})) :=
    ((AddCommGrpCat.biprodIsoProd
      (structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₂)
      (structO.H' 1 (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toSquare.X₃)
      ).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv).subsingleton
  have htoB : (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).toBiprod structO 1 x = 0 :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hex := ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).sequence_exact structO 0 1 rfl).exact 2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).mp hex x htoB
  have hy' : (Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).δ structO 0 1 rfl y = x := hy
  rw [← hy']
  exact deltaO_eq_zero y

name: HodgePilot.InterferenceProof.subsingleton_hPrimeOne_top

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.singularCohomologyMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularCohomologyMap_id (n : ℕ) (X : TopCat.{0}) :
    singularCohomologyMap n (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 ((singularCohomologyFunctor n).obj (op X))
proof:
:= by
  simp [singularCohomologyMap]

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.singularCohomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem singularCohomologyMap_comp (n : ℕ) {X Y Z : TopCat.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    singularCohomologyMap n (f ≫ g) = singularCohomologyMap n g ≫ singularCohomologyMap n f
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.comapC_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapC_id : comapC (AlgHom.id ℂ A) = 𝟙 (analyticSpace A)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.comapC_comp
statement:
theorem comapC_comp {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {C : Type} [CommRing C] [Algebra ℂ C] (f : A →ₐ[ℂ] B) (g : B →ₐ[ℂ] C) :
    comapC (g.comp f) = comapC g ≫ comapC f
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.analyticCohomologyMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem analyticCohomologyMap_id (n : ℕ) :
    analyticCohomologyMap (AlgHom.id ℂ A) n = 𝟙 (analyticCohomology A n)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (singularCohomologyMap n) comapC_id).trans (singularCohomologyMap_id n (analyticSpace A))

name: HodgePilot.SingularCohomology.analyticCohomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem analyticCohomologyMap_comp {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {C : Type} [CommRing C] [Algebra ℂ C] (f : A →ₐ[ℂ] B) (g : B →ₐ[ℂ] C) (n : ℕ) :
    analyticCohomologyMap (g.comp f) n
      = analyticCohomologyMap f n ≫ analyticCohomologyMap g n
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (singularCohomologyMap n) (comapC_comp f g)).trans
    (singularCohomologyMap_comp n (comapC g) (comapC f))

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.hSE
statement: lemma hSE (i : ℕ) : (D.S i).ShortExact
proof: := D.shortExact i

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.cocycle_iff
statement:
lemma cocycle_iff {n : ℕ} (x : Z ⟶ K.X n) :
    x ≫ K.d n (n + 1) = 0 ↔ x ≫ D.π n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.fac n, ← Category.assoc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact zero_of_comp_mono (D.ι (n + 1)) h
  · intro h
    rw [h, Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.toCyc_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma toCyc_ι {n : ℕ} (x : Z ⟶ K.X n) (hx : x ≫ D.π n = 0) :
    D.toCyc Z x hx ≫ D.ι n = x
proof:
:=
  (KernelFork.IsLimit.lift' ((D.hSE n).exact.fIsKernel) x hx).2

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.toCyc_unique
statement:
lemma toCyc_unique {n : ℕ} (x : Z ⟶ K.X n) (hx : x ≫ D.π n = 0)
    (z : Z ⟶ D.Cyc n) (hz : z ≫ D.ι n = x) : z = D.toCyc Z x hx
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (D.ι n)).1
  rw [hz, D.toCyc_ι]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.chainClass_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma chainClass_zero : D.chainClass 0 = Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 _)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.chainClass_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainClass_succ (n : ℕ) :
    D.chainClass (n + 1) =
      ((D.hSE n).extClass).comp (D.chainClass n) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_add
statement:
lemma edge_add {n : ℕ} (x y : Z ⟶ K.X n) (hx : x ≫ D.π n = 0)
    (hy : y ≫ D.π n = 0) :
    D.edge Z (x + y) (by rw [Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy, add_zero]) =
      D.edge Z x hx + D.edge Z y hy
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : D.toCyc Z (x + y) (by rw [Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy, add_zero]) =
      D.toCyc Z x hx + D.toCyc Z y hy := by
    symm
    apply D.toCyc_unique
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, D.toCyc_ι, D.toCyc_ι]
  rw [edge, edge, edge, h1, Ext.mk₀_add, Ext.add_comp]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_coboundary
statement:
lemma edge_coboundary {n : ℕ} (y : Z ⟶ K.X n)
    (hx : (y ≫ K.d n (n + 1)) ≫ D.π (n + 1) = 0) :
    D.edge Z (y ≫ K.d n (n + 1)) hx = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : D.toCyc Z (y ≫ K.d n (n + 1)) hx = y ≫ D.π n := by
    symm
    apply D.toCyc_unique
    rw [Category.assoc, ← D.fac n]
  have h2 : (Ext.mk₀ (D.π n)).comp
      (((D.hSE n).extClass).comp (D.chainClass n) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega))
      (zero_add (n + 1)) = 0 :=
    (D.hSE n).comp_extClass_assoc _ _
  rw [edge, h1, ← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, D.chainClass_succ,
    Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, h2, Ext.comp_zero]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.postcomp_extClass_bijective
statement:
lemma postcomp_extClass_bijective
    (hAc : ∀ i m, Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z (K.X i) (m + 1))) (i m : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (((D.hSE i).extClass).postcomp Z (show (m + 1) + 1 = m + 2 from rfl) :
        Ext Z (D.Cyc (i + 1)) (m + 1) →+ Ext Z (D.Cyc i) (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    replace hx : x.comp ((D.hSE i).extClass) rfl = 0 := hx
    obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ Z (D.hSE i) x rfl hx
    haveI := hAc i m
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x₂ 0, Ext.zero_comp] at hx₂
    exact hx₂.symm
  · intro e
    haveI := hAc i (m + 1)
    obtain ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩ :=
      Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ Z (D.hSE i) e (Subsingleton.elim _ 0) rfl
    exact ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.postcomp_chainClass_bijective
statement:
lemma postcomp_chainClass_bijective
    (hAc : ∀ i m, Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z (K.X i) (m + 1))) :
    ∀ (n m c : ℕ) (h : (m + 1) + n = c),
    Function.Bijective ((D.chainClass n).postcomp Z h :
      Ext Z (D.Cyc n) (m + 1) →+ Ext Z (D.Cyc 0) c)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro m c h
    obtain rfl : m + 1 = c := h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      calc x = x.comp (D.chainClass 0) (add_zero (m + 1)) :=
            (Ext.comp_mk₀_id x).symm
        _ = y.comp (D.chainClass 0) (add_zero (m + 1)) := hxy
        _ = y := Ext.comp_mk₀_id y
    · intro e
      exact ⟨e, Ext.comp_mk₀_id e⟩
  | succ n IH =>
    intro m c h
    have hstep := D.postcomp_extClass_bijective Z hAc n m
    have hrest := IH (m + 1) c (by omega)
    have heq : ⇑((D.chainClass (n + 1)).postcomp Z h) =
        ⇑((D.chainClass n).postcomp Z (show (m + 2) + n = c by omega)) ∘
          ⇑(((D.hSE n).extClass).postcomp Z
            (show (m + 1) + 1 = m + 2 from rfl)) := by
      funext x
      exact (Ext.comp_assoc x ((D.hSE n).extClass) (D.chainClass n)
        (show (m + 1) + 1 = m + 2 from rfl) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)
        (show (m + 1) + 1 + n = c by omega)).symm
    rw [heq]
    exact hrest.comp hstep

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_surjective
statement:
theorem edge_surjective
    (hAc : ∀ i m, Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z (K.X i) (m + 1))) (n : ℕ)
    (e : Ext Z (D.Cyc 0) (n + 1)) :
    ∃ (x : Z ⟶ K.X (n + 1)) (hx : x ≫ D.π (n + 1) = 0), D.edge Z x hx = e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ :=
    (D.postcomp_chainClass_bijective Z hAc n 0 (n + 1) (by omega)).2 e
  haveI := hAc n 0
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ :=
    Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ Z (D.hSE n) e₁ (Subsingleton.elim _ 0) rfl
  refine ⟨(Ext.addEquiv₀ x₀) ≫ D.ι (n + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, D.ι_π, Limits.comp_zero]
  · have htc : D.toCyc Z ((Ext.addEquiv₀ x₀) ≫ D.ι (n + 1))
        (by rw [Category.assoc, D.ι_π, Limits.comp_zero]) = Ext.addEquiv₀ x₀ :=
      (D.toCyc_unique Z _ _ _ rfl).symm
    rw [edge, htc, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply, D.chainClass_succ,
      ← Ext.comp_assoc x₀ ((D.hSE n).extClass) (D.chainClass n)
        (show 0 + 1 = 1 from rfl) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)
        (show 0 + 1 + n = n + 1 by omega),
      hx₀]
    exact he₁

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem edge_eq_zero_iff
    (hAc : ∀ i m, Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z (K.X i) (m + 1))) (n : ℕ)
    (x : Z ⟶ K.X (n + 1)) (hx : x ≫ D.π (n + 1) = 0) :
    D.edge Z x hx = 0 ↔ ∃ y : Z ⟶ K.X n, y ≫ K.d n (n + 1) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have h1 : ((Ext.mk₀ (D.toCyc Z x hx)).comp ((D.hSE n).extClass)
        (zero_add 1)).comp (D.chainClass n) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega) = 0 :=
      (Ext.comp_assoc (Ext.mk₀ (D.toCyc Z x hx)) ((D.hSE n).extClass)
        (D.chainClass n) (zero_add 1) (show 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)
        (show 0 + 1 + n = n + 1 by omega)).trans h0
    have h2 : (Ext.mk₀ (D.toCyc Z x hx)).comp ((D.hSE n).extClass)
        (zero_add 1) = 0 :=
      (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1
        (D.postcomp_chainClass_bijective Z hAc n 0 (n + 1) (by omega)).1 _ h1
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ Z (D.hSE n) _ rfl h2
    refine ⟨Ext.addEquiv₀ y₀, ?_⟩
    have h3 : (Ext.addEquiv₀ y₀) ≫ D.π n = D.toCyc Z x hx := by
      apply (Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).1
      rw [← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]
      exact hy₀
    rw [D.fac n, ← Category.assoc, h3]
    exact D.toCyc_ι Z x hx
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact D.edge_coboundary Z y hx

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_zero_injective
statement:
theorem edge_zero_injective (x x' : Z ⟶ K.X 0) (hx : x ≫ D.π 0 = 0)
    (hx' : x' ≫ D.π 0 = 0) (h : D.edge Z x hx = D.edge Z x' hx') : x = x'
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge, edge, chainClass_zero, Ext.comp_mk₀_id, Ext.comp_mk₀_id] at h
  have h2 := (Ext.mk₀_bijective Z (D.Cyc 0)).1 h
  rw [← D.toCyc_ι Z x hx, ← D.toCyc_ι Z x' hx', h2]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.edge_zero_surjective
statement:
theorem edge_zero_surjective (e : Ext Z (D.Cyc 0) 0) :
    ∃ (x : Z ⟶ K.X 0) (hx : x ≫ D.π 0 = 0), D.edge Z x hx = e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(Ext.addEquiv₀ e) ≫ D.ι 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, D.ι_π, Limits.comp_zero]
  · have htc : D.toCyc Z ((Ext.addEquiv₀ e) ≫ D.ι 0)
        (by rw [Category.assoc, D.ι_π, Limits.comp_zero]) = Ext.addEquiv₀ e :=
      (D.toCyc_unique Z _ _ _ rfl).symm
    rw [edge, htc, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply, chainClass_zero, Ext.comp_mk₀_id]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.Decomp.coboundaries_le_ker
statement:
lemma coboundaries_le_ker (n : ℕ) :
    (coboundaries (K := K) Z n).addSubgroupOf (D.cocycles Z (n + 1)) ≤
      (D.edgeHom Z (n + 1)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ hmem
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf] at hmem
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hmem
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
  have hy' : y ≫ K.d n (n + 1) = x := hy
  subst hy'
  exact D.edge_coboundary Z y hx

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.step_exact
statement:
lemma step_exact (waug : aug ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0)
    (hex0 : (ShortComplex.mk aug (K.d 0 1) waug).Exact)
    (hexS : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (K.d i (i + 1)) (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2))
      (K.d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact) :
    ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (step K F aug waug i).ι (K.d i (i + 1))
      (step K F aug waug i).w).Exact
  | 0 => hex0
  | (i + 1) => by
    exact (@ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono C _ _
      (ShortComplex.mk (K.d i (i + 1)) (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2)) (K.d_comp_d _ _ _))
      (ShortComplex.mk (step K F aug waug (i + 1)).ι (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2))
        (step K F aug waug (i + 1)).w)
      { τ₁ := cokernel.π (step K F aug waug i).ι
        τ₂ := 𝟙 _
        τ₃ := 𝟙 _
        comm₁₂ := (cokernel.π_desc _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm
        comm₂₃ := (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm }
      (inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π (step K F aug waug i).ι)))
      (inferInstanceAs (IsIso (𝟙 (K.X (i + 1)))))
      (inferInstanceAs (Mono (𝟙 (K.X (i + 2)))))).1 (hexS i)

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.step_mono
statement:
lemma step_mono (waug : aug ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0) (hmono : Mono aug)
    (hex0 : (ShortComplex.mk aug (K.d 0 1) waug).Exact)
    (hexS : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (K.d i (i + 1)) (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2))
      (K.d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact) :
    ∀ i, Mono (step K F aug waug i).ι
  | 0 => hmono
  | (i + 1) => (step_exact waug hex0 hexS i).mono_cokernelDesc

                                                                            
                                       
def decompOfExact (waug : aug ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0) (hmono : Mono aug)
    (hex0 : (ShortComplex.mk aug (K.d 0 1) waug).Exact)
    (hexS : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (K.d i (i + 1)) (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2))
      (K.d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact) :
    Decomp K where
  Cyc i
proof:
:= (step K F aug waug i).Cyc
  ι i := (step K F aug waug i).ι
  π i := cokernel.π (step K F aug waug i).ι
  ι_π _ := cokernel.condition _
  fac _ := (cokernel.π_desc _ _ _).symm
  shortExact i :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact _
      mono_f := step_mono waug hmono hex0 hexS i
      epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π (step K F aug waug i).ι)) }

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.decompOfExact_cyc_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma decompOfExact_cyc_zero (waug : aug ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0) (hmono : Mono aug)
    (hex0 : (ShortComplex.mk aug (K.d 0 1) waug).Exact)
    (hexS : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (K.d i (i + 1)) (K.d (i + 1) (i + 2))
      (K.d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact) :
    (decompOfExact waug hmono hex0 hexS).Cyc 0 = F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.sectionsD_comp_apply
statement:
lemma sectionsD_comp_apply (n m k : ℕ) (t : (K.X n).obj.obj (op T)) :
    sectionsD T K m k (sectionsD T K n m t) =
      ((K.d n m ≫ K.d m k).hom.app (op T)).hom t
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.sectionsCoboundaries_le
statement:
lemma sectionsCoboundaries_le (n : ℕ) :
    sectionsCoboundaries T K n ≤ sectionsCocycles T K (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨t, rfl⟩
  show sectionsD T K (n + 1) (n + 2) (sectionsD T K n (n + 1) t) = 0
  rw [sectionsD_comp_apply, K.d_comp_d]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.homEquivSections_naturality
statement:
lemma homEquivSections_naturality (hT : IsTerminal T)
    {F G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}} (f : F ⟶ G) (u : constZ J ⟶ F) :
    f.hom.app (op T) (homEquivSections hT F u) = homEquivSections hT G (u ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Sheaf.H.map f 0 (Ext.addEquiv₀.symm u) = Ext.addEquiv₀.symm (u ≫ f) :=
    Ext.addEquiv₀.injective (by
      rw [Sheaf.H.addEquiv₀_map, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
  show f.hom.app (op T) (Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F hT (Ext.addEquiv₀.symm u)) =
    Sheaf.H.equiv₀ G hT (Ext.addEquiv₀.symm (u ≫ f))
  rw [← h]
  exact Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality hT f _

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.homEquivSections_symm_naturality
statement:
lemma homEquivSections_symm_naturality (hT : IsTerminal T)
    {F G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}} (f : F ⟶ G) (s : F.obj.obj (op T)) :
    (homEquivSections hT F).symm s ≫ f =
      (homEquivSections hT G).symm (f.hom.app (op T) s)
proof:
:= by
  apply (homEquivSections hT G).injective
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← homEquivSections_naturality hT f,
    AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.sectionsD_homEquivSections
statement:
lemma sectionsD_homEquivSections (hT : IsTerminal T) (n m : ℕ)
    (u : constZ J ⟶ K.X n) :
    sectionsD T K n m (homEquivSections hT (K.X n) u) =
      homEquivSections hT (K.X m) (u ≫ K.d n m)
proof:
:=
  homEquivSections_naturality hT (K.d n m) u

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicDescent.sectionsCoboundaries_map
statement:
lemma sectionsCoboundaries_map (hT : IsTerminal T) (n : ℕ) :
    (((Decomp.coboundaries (K := K) (constZ J) n).addSubgroupOf
        (D.cocycles (constZ J) (n + 1))).map
      (sectionsCocyclesEquiv D hT (n + 1))) =
      (sectionsCoboundaries T K n).addSubgroupOf (sectionsCocycles T K (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp only [AddSubgroup.mem_map, AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hmem, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hmem
    have hu' : u ≫ K.d n (n + 1) = y := hu
    refine ⟨homEquivSections hT (K.X n) u, ?_⟩
    rw [sectionsD_homEquivSections K hT n (n + 1) u, hu']
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨(sectionsCocyclesEquiv D hT (n + 1)).symm s, ?_,
      (sectionsCocyclesEquiv D hT (n + 1)).apply_symm_apply s⟩
    refine ⟨(homEquivSections hT (K.X n)).symm t, ?_⟩
    show (homEquivSections hT (K.X n)).symm t ≫ K.d n (n + 1) =
      (homEquivSections hT (K.X (n + 1))).symm s.1
    rw [homEquivSections_symm_naturality hT (K.d n (n + 1)) t]
    exact congrArg (homEquivSections hT (K.X (n + 1))).symm ht

name: HodgePilot.CoeffPoints.ext_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem CoeffPoints.ext_matrixCoeff {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    {f g : CoeffPoints V B}
    (h : ∀ (p : WordCat V)
      (x : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p) ⊗[ℚ] (wordFiber V).obj p),
      f.ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p x) =
        g.ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p x)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply WithConv.ext
  apply AlgHom.toLinearMap_injective
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro p
  exact LinearMap.ext fun x => h p x

name: HodgePilot.coeffPoints_one_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem coeffPoints_one_matrixCoeff (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    (p : WordCat V) (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p))
    (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    (1 : CoeffPoints V B).ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)) =
      algebraMap ℚ B (f v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((1 : CoeffPoints V B).ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
      (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))) = algebraMap ℚ B (Coalgebra.counit (matrixCoeff
      (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))) from AlgHom.convOne_apply _]
  rw [show (Coalgebra.counit : mtCoalgebra V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) =
    coeffCounit (wordFiber V) from rfl, coeffCounit_matrixCoeff]

name: HodgePilot.coeffPoints_mul_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem coeffPoints_mul_matrixCoeff (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    (f g : CoeffPoints V B) (p : WordCat V)
    (h : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    (f * g).ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (h ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)) =
      ∑ i, f.ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
          (h ⊗ₜ[ℚ] coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p i)) *
        g.ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p
          ((coeffBasis (wordFiber V) p).coord i ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgHom.convMul_apply]
  rw [show (Coalgebra.comul : mtCoalgebra V →ₗ[ℚ] _) =
    coeffComul (wordFiber V) from rfl, coeffComul_matrixCoeff, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.coeffPoints_inv_apply
statement:
theorem coeffPoints_inv_apply (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    (f : CoeffPoints V B) (x : mtCoalgebra V) :
    (f⁻¹).ofConv x = f.ofConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode ℚ x)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.coeffPoints_inv_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem coeffPoints_inv_matrixCoeff (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    (f : CoeffPoints V B) (p : WordCat V)
    (h : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p) :
    (f⁻¹).ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (h ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v)) =
      f.ofConv (matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (dualWord V p)
        ((wordDualHom V p).flip v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] wordDualInv V p h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffPoints_inv_apply, antipode_matrixCoeff]

name: HodgePilot.dualDistrib_comp
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_comp (ψ : Module.Dual k M') (χ : Module.Dual k N')
    (u : M →ₗ[k] M') (w : N →ₗ[k] N') :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib k M N ((ψ ∘ₗ u) ⊗ₜ[k] (χ ∘ₗ w)) =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k M' N' (ψ ⊗ₜ[k] χ) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map u w
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m n
  simp

name: HodgePilot.dualDistrib_comp_comm
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_comp_comm (f : Module.Dual k M) (g : Module.Dual k N) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib k N M (g ⊗ₜ[k] f) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.comm k M N).toLinearMap =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k M N (f ⊗ₜ[k] g)
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m n
  simp [mul_comm]

name: HodgePilot.dualDistrib_comp_assoc
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_comp_assoc (f : Module.Dual k M) (g : Module.Dual k N)
    (h : Module.Dual k P) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib k M (N ⊗[k] P)
        (f ⊗ₜ[k] TensorProduct.dualDistrib k N P (g ⊗ₜ[k] h)) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc k M N P).toLinearMap =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (M ⊗[k] N) P
        (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k M N (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ⊗ₜ[k] h)
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
  intro m n p
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.dualDistrib_lid_left
statement:

      g ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.lid k M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.lid k k).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
  intro a b m
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.dualDistrib_lid_right
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_lid_right (g : Module.Dual k M) :

      g ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid k M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.lid k k).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold'
  intro m a b
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.basis_tensorProduct_coord
statement:
theorem basis_tensorProduct_coord {ι κ : Type*} (b : Basis ι k M)
