    (ρ_ X).hom.toLinearMap = (TensorProduct.rid ℚ X.carrier).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.braiding_hom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem braiding_hom_toLinearMap (Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0) :
    (β_ X Y).hom.toLinearMap =
      (TensorProduct.comm ℚ X.carrier Y.carrier).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_inv_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem iso_hom_inv_toLinearMap (m : X ≅ Y) :
    m.inv.toLinearMap ∘ₗ m.hom.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap m.hom_inv_id
  rwa [comp_toLinearMap, id_toLinearMap] at h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem iso_inv_hom_toLinearMap (m : X ≅ Y) :
    m.hom.toLinearMap ∘ₗ m.inv.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap m.inv_hom_id
  rwa [comp_toLinearMap, id_toLinearMap] at h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem iso_inv_hom_apply (m : X ≅ Y) (x : X.carrier) :
    m.inv.toLinearMap (m.hom.toLinearMap x) = x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (iso_hom_inv_toLinearMap m) x

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem iso_hom_inv_apply (m : X ≅ Y) (y : Y.carrier) :
    m.hom.toLinearMap (m.inv.toLinearMap y) = y
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (iso_inv_hom_toLinearMap m) y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isoLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem isoLinearEquiv_apply (m : X ≅ Y) (x : X.carrier) :
    isoLinearEquiv m x = m.hom.toLinearMap x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeStructCat.isoLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem isoLinearEquiv_symm_apply (m : X ≅ Y) (y : Y.carrier) :
    (isoLinearEquiv m).symm y = m.inv.toLinearMap y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext₂'
statement:
theorem CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext₂' {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {φ ψ : CoeffCoalgebra F →ₗ[k] CoeffCoalgebra F →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ (X Y : J) (x : Module.Dual k (F.obj X) ⊗[k] F.obj X)
      (y : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y) ⊗[k] F.obj Y),
      φ (matrixCoeff F X x) (matrixCoeff F Y y) =
        ψ (matrixCoeff F X x) (matrixCoeff F Y y)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro X
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h X Y x y

name: HodgePilot.comulComponent_apply_basis
statement:
theorem comulComponent_apply_basis (X : J) {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    (b : Basis ι k (F.obj X)) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X) :
    comulComponent F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      ∑ i, matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] b i) ⊗ₜ[k]
        matrixCoeff F X (b.coord i ⊗ₜ[k] v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comulComponent_tmul]
  have key := congrArg
    (TensorProduct.map
      (matrixCoeff F X ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk k (Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (F.obj X) f)
      (matrixCoeff F X ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk k (Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (F.obj X)).flip v))
    (sum_basis_tmul_dualMap b (coeffBasis F X) LinearMap.id)
  simp only [map_sum, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    LinearMap.dualMap_id] at key
  exact key.symm

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.concat_cancel
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  have hy := LinearMap.congr_fun h (D.concatInv X Y y)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.concat_concatInv] using hy

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.concat_cancel_left
statement:
theorem concat_cancel_left {X Y Z : J} {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T]
    [Module k T] {φ φ' : (F.obj (D.mul X Y) ⊗[k] F.obj Z) →ₗ[k] T}
    (h : φ ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj Z) (D.concat X Y) =
      φ' ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj Z) (D.concat X Y)) : φ = φ'
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro s c
  have hs := LinearMap.congr_fun h (D.concatInv X Y s ⊗ₜ[k] c)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    D.concat_concatInv] using hs

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.concat_cancel_right
statement:
theorem concat_cancel_right {X Y Z : J} {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T]
    [Module k T] {φ φ' : (F.obj X ⊗[k] F.obj (D.mul Y Z)) →ₗ[k] T}
    (h : φ ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (F.obj X) (D.concat Y Z) =
      φ' ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (F.obj X) (D.concat Y Z)) : φ = φ'
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a s
  have hs := LinearMap.congr_fun h (a ⊗ₜ[k] D.concatInv Y Z s)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    D.concat_concatInv] using hs

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulAux_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulAux_tmul (X Y : J)
    (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X)
    (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (w : F.obj Y) :
    D.mulAux X Y ((f ⊗ₜ[k] v) ⊗ₜ[k] (g ⊗ₜ[k] w)) =
      matrixCoeff F (D.mul X Y)
        ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
            D.concatInv X Y) ⊗ₜ[k] D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulAux, LinearMap.dualMap_apply']

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.right_functional
statement:
theorem right_functional (X : J) {Y Y' : J} (u : Y ⟶ Y')
    (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y')) :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y') (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
        D.concatInv X Y') ∘ₗ (F.map (D.right X u)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)
        (f ⊗ₜ[k] (g ∘ₗ (F.map u).hom)) ∘ₗ D.concatInv X Y
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a b
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.right_concat, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulAux_dinatural_right
statement:
private theorem mulAux_dinatural_right (X : J) ⦃Y Y' : J⦄ (u : Y ⟶ Y') :
    (TensorProduct.curry (D.mulAux X Y)).flip ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj Y) (F.map u).hom.dualMap =
      (TensorProduct.curry (D.mulAux X Y')).flip ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual k (F.obj Y')) (F.map u).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply, TensorProduct.curry_apply, mulAux_tmul,
    LinearMap.dualMap_apply']
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.right X u)
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y') (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
      D.concatInv X Y')
    (D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.right_functional X u f g,
    D.right_concat X u v w] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulLeg₁_dinatural
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  exact D.mulAux_dinatural_right X u

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.descRight_matrixCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (coend.ι_desc (D.mulLeg₁ X) (D.mulLeg₁_dinatural X) Y)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulFlip_matrixCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem mulFlip_matrixCoeff (X Y : J)
    (x : Module.Dual k (F.obj X) ⊗[k] F.obj X)
    (y : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y) ⊗[k] F.obj Y) :
    D.mulFlip X x (matrixCoeff F Y y) = D.mulAux X Y (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (D.descRight_matrixCoeff X Y) y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  exact congrArg (fun φ => φ x) h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.left_functional
statement:
theorem left_functional {X X' : J} (t : X ⟶ X') (Y : J)
    (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X')) (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X') (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
        D.concatInv X' Y) ∘ₗ (F.map (D.left t Y)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)
        ((f ∘ₗ (F.map t).hom) ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ D.concatInv X Y
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a b
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.left_concat, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulFlip_dinatural
statement:
private theorem mulFlip_dinatural ⦃X X' : J⦄ (t : X ⟶ X') :
    D.mulFlip X ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (F.obj X) (F.map t).hom.dualMap =
      D.mulFlip X' ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual k (F.obj X')) (F.map t).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, mulFlip_matrixCoeff, mulAux_tmul,
    LinearMap.dualMap_apply']
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.left t Y)
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X') (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
      D.concatInv X' Y)
    (D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.left_functional t Y f g,
    D.left_concat t Y v w] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.mulLeg₂_dinatural
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  exact D.mulFlip_dinatural t

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_comp_matrixCoeff
statement:
private theorem coeffMul_comp_matrixCoeff (X : J) :
    D.coeffMul ∘ₗ matrixCoeff F X = D.mulFlip X
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
    (coend.ι_desc D.mulLeg₂ D.mulLeg₂_dinatural X)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_matrixCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffMul_matrixCoeff (X Y : J)
    (x : Module.Dual k (F.obj X) ⊗[k] F.obj X)
    (y : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y) ⊗[k] F.obj Y) :
    D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X x) (matrixCoeff F Y y) =
      D.mulAux X Y (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (D.coeffMul_comp_matrixCoeff X) x
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  rw [h, D.mulFlip_matrixCoeff]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul
statement:
theorem coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul (X Y : J)
    (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X)
    (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (w : F.obj Y) :
    D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v)) (matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w)) =
      matrixCoeff F (D.mul X Y)
        ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
            D.concatInv X Y) ⊗ₜ[k] D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff, D.mulAux_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.assoc_functional
statement:
theorem assoc_functional (X Y Z : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (h : Module.Dual k (F.obj Z)) :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj (D.mul Y Z))
          (f ⊗ₜ[k] (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj Y) (F.obj Z)
            (g ⊗ₜ[k] h) ∘ₗ D.concatInv Y Z)) ∘ₗ
        D.concatInv X (D.mul Y Z)) ∘ₗ (F.map (D.assocMor X Y Z)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj (D.mul X Y)) (F.obj Z)
        ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
          D.concatInv X Y) ⊗ₜ[k] h) ∘ₗ D.concatInv (D.mul X Y) Z
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply D.concat_cancel_left
  apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
  intro a b c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, D.assoc_concat,
    D.concatInv_concat, TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_assoc
statement:
theorem coeffMul_assoc (x y z : CoeffCoalgebra F) :
    D.coeffMul (D.coeffMul x y) z = D.coeffMul x (D.coeffMul y z)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : (D.coeffMul).compr₂ D.coeffMul =
      ((LinearMap.llcomp k (CoeffCoalgebra F) (CoeffCoalgebra F)
        (CoeffCoalgebra F)).comp D.coeffMul).compl₂ D.coeffMul by
    have h3 := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h x) y) z
    simpa only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.compl₂_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.llcomp_apply] using h3
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro X
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Z
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro h c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply,
    LinearMap.compl₂_apply, LinearMap.llcomp_apply]
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y f v g w,
    D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul Y Z g w h c,
    D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul (D.mul X Y) Z _ _ h c,
    D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X (D.mul Y Z) f v _ _]
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.assocMor X Y Z)
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj (D.mul Y Z))
        (f ⊗ₜ[k] (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj Y) (F.obj Z)
          (g ⊗ₜ[k] h) ∘ₗ D.concatInv Y Z)) ∘ₗ
      D.concatInv X (D.mul Y Z))
    (D.concat (D.mul X Y) Z (D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w) ⊗ₜ[k] c))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.assoc_functional X Y Z f g h,
    D.assoc_concat X Y Z v w c] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.swap_functional
statement:
theorem swap_functional (X Y : J) (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X))
    (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj Y) (F.obj X) (g ⊗ₜ[k] f) ∘ₗ
        D.concatInv Y X) ∘ₗ (F.map (D.swapMor X Y)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
        D.concatInv X Y
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a b
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.swap_concat, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, mul_comm]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_comm
statement: theorem coeffMul_comm : D.coeffMul = D.coeffMul.flip
proof:
:= by
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro X
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y f v g w,
    D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul Y X g w f v]
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.swapMor X Y)
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj Y) (F.obj X) (g ⊗ₜ[k] f) ∘ₗ
      D.concatInv Y X)
    (D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.swap_functional X Y f g,
    D.swap_concat X Y v w] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.lunit_functional
statement:
theorem lunit_functional (Y : J) (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) :
    g ∘ₗ (F.map (D.lunitMor Y)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj D.one) (F.obj Y)
        (D.unitFunc ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ D.concatInv D.one Y
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro x w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.lunit_concat, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_coeffOne_left
statement: theorem coeffMul_coeffOne_left : D.coeffMul D.coeffOne = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  show D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F D.one (D.unitFunc ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitVec))
      (matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w)) = matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w)
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul D.one Y D.unitFunc D.unitVec g w]
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.lunitMor Y) g
    (D.concat D.one Y (D.unitVec ⊗ₜ[k] w))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.lunit_functional Y g,
    D.lunit_concat Y D.unitVec w, D.unitFunc_unitVec, one_smul] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.runit_functional
statement:
theorem runit_functional (Y : J) (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) :
    g ∘ₗ (F.map (D.runitMor Y)).hom =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj Y) (F.obj D.one)
        (g ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitFunc) ∘ₗ D.concatInv Y D.one
proof:
:= by
  apply D.concat_cancel
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro w x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, D.runit_concat, D.concatInv_concat,
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffMul_coeffOne_right
statement: theorem coeffMul_coeffOne_right : D.coeffMul.flip D.coeffOne = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  show D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w))
      (matrixCoeff F D.one (D.unitFunc ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitVec)) =
    matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w)
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul Y D.one g w D.unitFunc D.unitVec]
  have hnat := matrixCoeff_naturality F (D.runitMor Y) g
    (D.concat Y D.one (w ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitVec))
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply', D.runit_functional Y g,
    D.runit_concat Y D.unitVec w, D.unitFunc_unitVec, one_smul] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.compr₂_coeffMul_coeffCounit
statement:
theorem compr₂_coeffMul_coeffCounit :
    (D.coeffMul).compr₂ (coeffCounit F) =
      LinearMap.smulRight (coeffCounit F) (coeffCounit F)
proof:
:= by
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro X
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro f v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  apply CoeffCoalgebra.lhom_ext
  intro Y
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro g w
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply,
    LinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y f v g w]
  simp only [coeffCounit_matrixCoeff, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    D.concatInv_concat, TensorProduct.dualDistrib_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffCounit_coeffOne
statement: theorem coeffCounit_coeffOne : coeffCounit F D.coeffOne = 1
proof:
:= by
  show coeffCounit F (matrixCoeff F D.one (D.unitFunc ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitVec)) = 1
  rw [coeffCounit_matrixCoeff, D.unitFunc_unitVec]

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffComul_coeffOne
statement:
theorem coeffComul_coeffOne :
    coeffComul F D.coeffOne = D.coeffOne ⊗ₜ[k] D.coeffOne
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : coeffComul F D.coeffOne =
      comulComponent F D.one (D.unitFunc ⊗ₜ[k] D.unitVec) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (coeffComul_comp_matrixCoeff F D.one) _
  have hcoord : D.unitBasis.coord default = D.unitFunc :=
    LinearMap.ext D.unitBasis_coord
  rw [h1, comulComponent_apply_basis F D.one D.unitBasis]
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, D.unitBasis_default,
    hcoord]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CoeffMulData.coeffComul_coeffMul
statement:
theorem coeffComul_coeffMul (X Y : J)
    (f : Module.Dual k (F.obj X)) (v : F.obj X)
    (g : Module.Dual k (F.obj Y)) (w : F.obj Y) :
    coeffComul F (D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] v))
        (matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] w))) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X (f ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F X i))
            (matrixCoeff F Y (g ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F Y j)) ⊗ₜ[k]
          D.coeffMul (matrixCoeff F X ((coeffBasis F X).coord i ⊗ₜ[k] v))
            (matrixCoeff F Y ((coeffBasis F Y).coord j ⊗ₜ[k] w))
proof:
:= by
  set bC : Basis (Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj X) ×
      Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj Y)) k (F.obj (D.mul X Y)) :=
    ((coeffBasis F X).tensorProduct (coeffBasis F Y)).map (D.concatEquiv X Y)
    with hbC
  have hb : ∀ (i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj X))
      (j : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj Y)),
      bC (i, j) = D.concat X Y (coeffBasis F X i ⊗ₜ[k] coeffBasis F Y j) := by
    intro i j
    rw [hbC]
    simp [Basis.tensorProduct_apply, concatEquiv]
  have hc : ∀ (i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj X))
      (j : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex k (F.obj Y)),
      bC.coord (i, j) =
        TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)
          ((coeffBasis F X).coord i ⊗ₜ[k] (coeffBasis F Y).coord j) ∘ₗ
          D.concatInv X Y := by
    intro i j
    refine LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_
    have h2 : bC.coord (i, j) s =
        ((coeffBasis F X).tensorProduct (coeffBasis F Y)).coord (i, j)
          ((D.concatEquiv X Y).symm s) := by
      rw [hbC]
      simp [Basis.coord_apply, Basis.map_repr]
    have h3 := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (basis_tensorProduct_coord (coeffBasis F X) (coeffBasis F Y) i j)
      ((D.concatEquiv X Y).symm s)
    rw [h2, h3]
    rfl
  rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y f v g w]
  have h1 : coeffComul F (matrixCoeff F (D.mul X Y)
      ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
          D.concatInv X Y) ⊗ₜ[k] D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w))) =
      comulComponent F (D.mul X Y)
        ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib k (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (f ⊗ₜ[k] g) ∘ₗ
          D.concatInv X Y) ⊗ₜ[k] D.concat X Y (v ⊗ₜ[k] w)) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (coeffComul_comp_matrixCoeff F (D.mul X Y)) _
  rw [h1, comulComponent_apply_basis F (D.mul X Y) bC]
  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  congr 1
  · rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y f (coeffBasis F X i) g
      (coeffBasis F Y j), hb i j]
  · rw [D.coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul X Y ((coeffBasis F X).coord i) v
      ((coeffBasis F Y).coord j) w, hc i j]

name: HodgePilot.wordConcatInv_comp_wordConcatHom
statement:
theorem wordConcatInv_comp_wordConcatHom (p q : WordCat V) :
    wordConcatInv V p q ∘ₗ wordConcatHom V p q = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_inv_toLinearMap (wordConcat V p q)

name: HodgePilot.wordConcatHom_comp_wordConcatInv
statement:
theorem wordConcatHom_comp_wordConcatInv (p q : WordCat V) :
    wordConcatHom V p q ∘ₗ wordConcatInv V p q = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_toLinearMap (wordConcat V p q)

name: HodgePilot.wordConcatInv_wordConcatHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordConcatInv_wordConcatHom_apply (p q : WordCat V)
    (x : (wordFiber V).obj p ⊗[ℚ] (wordFiber V).obj q) :
    wordConcatInv V p q (wordConcatHom V p q x) = x
proof:
:=
  HodgeStructCat.iso_inv_hom_apply (wordConcat V p q) x

name: HodgePilot.wordConcatHom_wordConcatInv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordConcatHom_wordConcatInv_apply (p q : WordCat V)
    (y : (wordFiber V).obj (p + q)) :
    wordConcatHom V p q (wordConcatInv V p q y) = y
proof:
:=
  HodgeStructCat.iso_hom_inv_apply (wordConcat V p q) y

name: HodgePilot.matrixCoeff_word_naturality
statement:
theorem matrixCoeff_word_naturality {s t : WordCat V}
    (e : word V s ⟶ word V t)
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj t)) (ξ : (wordFiber V).obj s) :
    matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) s ((ψ ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ξ) =
      matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) t (ψ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] e.toLinearMap ξ)
proof:
:=
  matrixCoeff_naturality (wordFiber V)
    (InducedCategory.homMk (X := s) (Y := t) e) ψ ξ

name: HodgePilot.wordConcatHom_cancel
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  have hy := LinearMap.congr_fun h (wordConcatInv V p q y)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, wordConcatHom_wordConcatInv_apply] using hy

name: HodgePilot.mtCoalgebra_mul_def
statement:
theorem mtCoalgebra_mul_def (x y : mtCoalgebra V) :
    x * y = (wordMulData V).coeffMul x y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.mtCoalgebra_one_def
statement: theorem mtCoalgebra_one_def : (1 : mtCoalgebra V) = mtUnit V
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.matrixCoeff_mul_matrixCoeff
statement:
theorem matrixCoeff_mul_matrixCoeff (p q : WordCat V)
    (f : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)) (v : (wordFiber V).obj p)
    (g : Module.Dual ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj q)) (w : (wordFiber V).obj q) :
    matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) p (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) *
        matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) q (g ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w) =
      matrixCoeff (wordFiber V) (p + q)
        ((TensorProduct.dualDistrib ℚ ((wordFiber V).obj p)
            ((wordFiber V).obj q) (f ⊗ₜ[ℚ] g) ∘ₗ wordConcatInv V p q) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          wordConcatHom V p q (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w))
proof:
:=
  (wordMulData V).coeffMul_matrixCoeff_tmul p q f v g w

name: HodgePilot.coeffCounit_mul
statement:
theorem coeffCounit_mul (x y : mtCoalgebra V) :
    coeffCounit (wordFiber V) (x * y) =
      coeffCounit (wordFiber V) x * coeffCounit (wordFiber V) y
proof:
:=
  Bialgebra.counit_mul x y

name: HodgePilot.coeffComul_mul
statement:
theorem coeffComul_mul (x y : mtCoalgebra V) :
    coeffComul (wordFiber V) (x * y) =
      coeffComul (wordFiber V) x * coeffComul (wordFiber V) y
proof:
:=
  Bialgebra.comul_mul x y

name: HodgePilot.coeffComul_mtUnit
statement:
theorem coeffComul_mtUnit :
    coeffComul (wordFiber V) (mtUnit V) = mtUnit V ⊗ₜ[ℚ] mtUnit V
proof:
:=
  (wordMulData V).coeffComul_coeffOne

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    gen] using h t

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_comp_update
statement:
theorem genWedge_comp_update {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (z : B) :
    genWedge A B (update t i z) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti B n (update (fun j => D A B (t j)) i (D A B z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [genWedge]
  congr 1
  exact Function.comp_update (⇑(D A B)) t i z

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_update_add
statement:
theorem genWedge_update_add {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    genWedge A B (update t i (x + y)) =
      genWedge A B (update t i x) + genWedge A B (update t i y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genWedge_comp_update, genWedge_comp_update, genWedge_comp_update, map_add,
    AlternatingMap.map_update_add]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_update_mul
statement:
theorem genWedge_update_mul {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (x y : B) :
    genWedge A B (update t i (x * y)) =
      x • genWedge A B (update t i y) + y • genWedge A B (update t i x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genWedge_comp_update, genWedge_comp_update, genWedge_comp_update,
    Derivation.leibniz, AlternatingMap.map_update_add,
    AlternatingMap.map_update_smul, AlternatingMap.map_update_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_update_algebraMap
statement:
theorem genWedge_update_algebraMap {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (i : Fin n) (a : A) :
    genWedge A B (update t i (algebraMap A B a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [genWedge_comp_update, Derivation.map_algebraMap,
    AlternatingMap.map_update_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem genWedge_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → B} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (htij : t i = t j) : genWedge A B t = 0
proof:
:=
  (exteriorPower.ιMulti B n).map_eq_zero_of_eq _
    (show D A B (t i) = D A B (t j) from congrArg _ htij) hij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExteriorFree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem toExteriorFree_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    toExteriorFree A B n (single t s) = s • genWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [toExteriorFree, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_toExteriorFree
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_toExteriorFree (n : ℕ) :
    rel A B n ≤ LinearMap.ker (toExteriorFree A B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, toExteriorFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [genWedge_update_add]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, toExteriorFree_single, one_smul]
    rw [genWedge_update_mul]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [toExteriorFree_single, one_smul]
    exact genWedge_update_algebraMap A B t i a
  · simp only [toExteriorFree_single, one_smul]
    exact genWedge_eq_zero A B hij htij

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExterior_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem toExterior_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    toExterior A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) = s • genWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [toExterior, Submodule.liftQ_apply, toExteriorFree_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExterior_gen
statement:
theorem toExterior_gen {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) :
    toExterior A B n (gen A B t) = genWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, toExterior_mk_single, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consAux_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem consAux_single {n : ℕ} (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    consAux A B x (single t s) = s • gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [consAux, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.rel_le_ker_consAux
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_consAux {n : ℕ} (x : B) :
    rel A B n ≤ LinearMap.ker (consAux A B (n := n) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w hw
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  obtain ⟨t, i, y, z, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, y, z, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, consAux_single, one_smul, Fin.cons_update]
    rw [gen_update_add]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, consAux_single, one_smul, Fin.cons_update]
    rw [gen_update_mul]
    exact sub_self _
  · simp only [consAux_single, one_smul, Fin.cons_update]
    exact gen_update_algebraMap A B _ i.succ a
  · simp only [consAux_single, one_smul]
    exact gen_eq_zero A B (i := i.succ) (j := j.succ)
      (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ h)) (by simp [Fin.cons_succ, htij])

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consMap_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem consMap_mk_single {n : ℕ} (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    consMap A B x (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      s • gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [consMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply, consAux_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consMap_gen
statement:
theorem consMap_gen {n : ℕ} (x : B) (t : Fin n → B) :
    consMap A B x (gen A B t) = gen A B (Fin.cons x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, consMap_mk_single, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consHom_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem consHom_single (n : ℕ) (x s : B) :
    consHom A B n (single x s) = s • consMap A B x
proof:
:= by
  rw [consHom, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.kerTotal_le_ker_consHom
statement:
theorem kerTotal_le_ker_consHom (n : ℕ) :
    kerTotal A B ≤ LinearMap.ker (consHom A B n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kerTotal, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro w ((⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, consHom_single, one_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, consMap_gen]
    rw [gen_cons_add]
    abel
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, consHom_single, one_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, consMap_gen]
    rw [gen_cons_mul]
    abel
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
    simp only [consHom_single, one_smul, LinearMap.zero_apply, consMap_gen]
    exact gen_cons_algebraMap A B a t

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consQ_D
statement: theorem consQ_D (n : ℕ) (x : B) : consQ A B n (D A B x) = consMap A B x
proof:
:= by
  have h : quotKerTotalEquiv A B (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single x 1)) = D A B x := by
    show (Finsupp.linearCombination B (D A B)) (single x 1) = D A B x
    simp
  have hsymm : (quotKerTotalEquiv A B).symm (D A B x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single x 1) :=
    (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr h.symm
  rw [consQ, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hsymm,
    Submodule.liftQ_apply, consHom_single, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consQ₂_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem consQ₂_apply (n : ℕ) (x y : Ω[B⁄A]) (w : DR A B n) :
    consQ₂ A B n x y w = consQ A B (n + 1) x (consQ A B n y w)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consQ₂_add_swap
statement:
theorem consQ₂_add_swap (n : ℕ) (x y : Ω[B⁄A]) :
    consQ₂ A B n x y + consQ₂ A B n y x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ u v : B, consQ₂ A B n (D A B u) (D A B v) +
      consQ₂ A B n (D A B v) (D A B u) = 0 := by
    intro u v
    refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, consQ₂_apply, consQ_D, consMap_gen,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
    simpa only [Fin.update_cons_zero] using
      gen_cons_cons_swap A B u v (Fin.cons v t) 0
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span B (Set.range ⇑(D A B)) := by
    rw [span_range_derivation]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction generalizing y with
  | mem x hxm =>
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxm
      have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span B (Set.range ⇑(D A B)) := by
        rw [span_range_derivation]; exact Submodule.mem_top
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hym =>
          obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hym
          exact key u v
      | zero => simp
      | add y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
          have hsplit : consQ₂ A B n (D A B u) (y + z) +
              consQ₂ A B n (y + z) (D A B u) =
              (consQ₂ A B n (D A B u) y + consQ₂ A B n y (D A B u)) +
                (consQ₂ A B n (D A B u) z + consQ₂ A B n z (D A B u)) := by
            simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
            abel
          rw [hsplit, ihy, ihz, add_zero]
      | smul b y hy ihy =>
          simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ← smul_add, ihy, smul_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' ihx ihx' =>
      have hsplit : consQ₂ A B n (x + x') y + consQ₂ A B n y (x + x') =
          (consQ₂ A B n x y + consQ₂ A B n y x) +
            (consQ₂ A B n x' y + consQ₂ A B n y x') := by
        simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
        abel
      rw [hsplit, ihx y, ihx' y, add_zero]
  | smul b x hx ihx =>
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ← smul_add, ihx y, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consQ₂_self
statement: theorem consQ₂_self (n : ℕ) (x : Ω[B⁄A]) : consQ₂ A B n x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span B (Set.range ⇑(D A B)) := by
    rw [span_range_derivation]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hxm =>
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxm
      refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
      simp only [consQ₂_apply, consQ_D, consMap_gen, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact gen_eq_zero A B (i := (0 : Fin (n + 2))) (j := Fin.succ 0)
        (Fin.succ_ne_zero 0).symm (by simp [Fin.cons_zero])
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have hsplit : consQ₂ A B n (x + y) (x + y) =
          consQ₂ A B n x x + consQ₂ A B n y y +
            (consQ₂ A B n x y + consQ₂ A B n y x) := by
        simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
        abel
      rw [hsplit, ihx, ihy, consQ₂_add_swap, add_zero, add_zero]
  | smul b x hx ihx =>
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ihx, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.alphaMulti_zero_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem alphaMulti_zero_apply (u : Fin 0 → Ω[B⁄A]) :
    alphaMulti A B 0 u = gen A B Fin.elim0
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.alphaMulti_succ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem alphaMulti_succ_apply (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (n + 1) → Ω[B⁄A]) :
    alphaMulti A B (n + 1) u = consQ A B n (u 0) (alphaMulti A B n (Fin.tail u))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.consQ_alphaMulti_eq_zero
statement:
theorem consQ_alphaMulti_eq_zero (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (k : Fin n) (u : Fin n → Ω[B⁄A]),
      consQ A B n (u k) (alphaMulti A B n u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun k => k.elim0
  | succ m IH =>
      intro k u
      induction k using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          rw [alphaMulti_succ_apply]
          simpa only [consQ₂_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using
            DFunLike.congr_fun (consQ₂_self A B m (u 0))
              (alphaMulti A B m (Fin.tail u))
      | succ j =>
          rw [alphaMulti_succ_apply]
          have h1 : consQ A B m (u j.succ) (alphaMulti A B m (Fin.tail u)) = 0 :=
            IH j (Fin.tail u)
          have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (consQ₂_add_swap A B m (u j.succ) (u 0))
            (alphaMulti A B m (Fin.tail u))
          simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, consQ₂_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h2
          rw [h1, map_zero, add_zero] at h2
          exact h2

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.alphaMulti_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
theorem alphaMulti_eq_zero_of_eq (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (u : Fin n → Ω[B⁄A]) (i j : Fin n), u i = u j → i ≠ j →
      alphaMulti A B n u = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun u i => i.elim0
  | succ m IH =>
      intro u i j
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          induction j using Fin.cases with
          | zero => exact fun _ hij => absurd rfl hij
          | succ j' =>
              intro hu _
              rw [alphaMulti_succ_apply, hu]
              exact consQ_alphaMulti_eq_zero A B m j' (Fin.tail u)
      | succ i' =>
          induction j using Fin.cases with
          | zero =>
              intro hu _
              rw [alphaMulti_succ_apply, ← hu]
              exact consQ_alphaMulti_eq_zero A B m i' (Fin.tail u)
          | succ j' =>
              intro hu hij
              rw [alphaMulti_succ_apply,
                IH (Fin.tail u) i' j' hu (fun h => hij (congrArg Fin.succ h)),
                map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.alphaAlt_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem alphaAlt_coe (n : ℕ) : ⇑(alphaAlt A B n) = ⇑(alphaMulti A B n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.alphaMulti_apply_D
statement:
theorem alphaMulti_apply_D (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ t : Fin n → B, alphaMulti A B n (fun i => D A B (t i)) = gen A B t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro t
      rw [alphaMulti_zero_apply]
      exact congrArg (gen A B) (funext fun i => i.elim0)
  | succ m IH =>
      intro t
      show consQ A B m (D A B (t 0))
          (alphaMulti A B m (fun i => D A B (Fin.tail t i))) = gen A B t
      rw [IH (Fin.tail t), consQ_D, consMap_gen, Fin.cons_self_tail]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.ofExterior_ιMulti
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofExterior_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Ω[B⁄A]) :
    ofExterior A B n (exteriorPower.ιMulti B n v) = alphaMulti A B n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofExterior, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.ofExterior_comp_toExterior
statement:
theorem ofExterior_comp_toExterior (n : ℕ) :
    (ofExterior A B n).comp (toExterior A B n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, toExterior_gen, genWedge, ofExterior_ιMulti,
    alphaMulti_apply_D, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.multilinearMap_ext_D
statement:
theorem multilinearMap_ext_D {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {f g : MultilinearMap B (fun _ : Fin n => Ω[B⁄A]) N},
      (∀ t : Fin n → B, f (fun i => D A B (t i)) = g (fun i => D A B (t i))) →
        f = g
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro f g h
      refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
      have hv : v = fun i : Fin 0 => D A B (Fin.elim0 i) := funext fun i => i.elim0
      rw [hv]
      exact h Fin.elim0
  | succ m IH =>
      intro f g h
      have key : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span B (Set.range ⇑(D A B)) →
          f.curryLeft x = g.curryLeft x := by
        intro x hx
        induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem x hxm =>
            obtain ⟨t₀, rfl⟩ := hxm
            refine IH fun u => ?_
            have h' := h (Fin.cons t₀ u)
            have hc : (fun i => D A B (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => B) t₀ u i)) =
                Fin.cons (D A B t₀) fun i => D A B (u i) := by
              refine funext fun i => ?_
              induction i using Fin.cases with
              | zero => simp
              | succ i' => simp
            rw [hc] at h'
            exact h'
        | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
        | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => rw [map_add, map_add, ihx, ihy]
        | smul b x hx ihx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, ihx]
      refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
      have hv := key (v 0) (by rw [span_range_derivation]; exact Submodule.mem_top)
      have h1 : f v = f.curryLeft (v 0) (Fin.tail v) := by
        rw [MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, Fin.cons_self_tail]
      have h2 : g v = g.curryLeft (v 0) (Fin.tail v) := by
        rw [MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, Fin.cons_self_tail]
      rw [h1, h2, hv]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExterior_alphaMulti
statement:
theorem toExterior_alphaMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Ω[B⁄A]) :
    toExterior A B n (alphaMulti A B n v) = exteriorPower.ιMulti B n v
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : (toExterior A B n).compMultilinearMap (alphaMulti A B n) =
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti B n (M := Ω[B⁄A])).toMultilinearMap := by
    refine multilinearMap_ext_D A B fun t => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, alphaMulti_apply_D, toExterior_gen]
    rfl
  simpa only [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply,
    AlternatingMap.coe_multilinearMap] using DFunLike.congr_fun hkey v

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExterior_comp_ofExterior
statement:
theorem toExterior_comp_ofExterior (n : ℕ) :
    (toExterior A B n).comp (ofExterior A B n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine exteriorPower.linearMap_ext ?_
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ofExterior_ιMulti, LinearMap.id_apply]
  exact toExterior_alphaMulti A B n v

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.exteriorPowerEquiv_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem exteriorPowerEquiv_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    exteriorPowerEquiv A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      s • genWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPowerEquiv, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_apply, toExterior_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.exteriorPowerEquiv_gen
statement:
theorem exteriorPowerEquiv_gen {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) :
    exteriorPowerEquiv A B n (gen A B t) = genWedge A B t
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPowerEquiv, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_apply, toExterior_gen]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.exteriorPowerEquiv_symm_ιMulti
statement:
@[simp] theorem exteriorPowerEquiv_symm_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Ω[B⁄A]) :
    (exteriorPowerEquiv A B n).symm (exteriorPower.ιMulti B n v) =
      alphaMulti A B n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPowerEquiv, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_symm_apply, ofExterior_ιMulti]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.oneEquiv_exteriorPowerEquiv
statement:
theorem oneEquiv_exteriorPowerEquiv (x : DR A B 1) :
    exteriorPower.oneEquiv B (Ω[B⁄A]) (exteriorPowerEquiv A B 1 x) =
      drOneEquiv A B x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (exteriorPower.oneEquiv B (Ω[B⁄A])).toLinearMap.comp
      (toExterior A B 1) = (drOneEquiv A B : DR A B 1 →ₗ[B] Ω[B⁄A]) := by
    refine hom_ext A B fun t => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, toExterior_gen, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, genWedge,
      exteriorPower.oneEquiv_ιMulti, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, gen,
      drOneEquiv_mk_single, one_smul]
  calc exteriorPower.oneEquiv B (Ω[B⁄A]) (exteriorPowerEquiv A B 1 x)
      = ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv B (Ω[B⁄A])).toLinearMap.comp
          (toExterior A B 1)) x := by
        rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, exteriorPowerEquiv, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_apply]
        rfl
    _ = drOneEquiv A B x := by rw [h]; rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.toExterior_d_mk_single
statement:
theorem toExterior_d_mk_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    toExterior A B (n + 1) (d A B n (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s))) =
      genWedge A B (Fin.cons s t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mk_single, toExterior_gen]

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.polyGrad_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma polyGrad_apply (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v w : ι → ℂ) :
    polyGrad p v w = ∑ i, eval v (pderiv i p) * w i
proof:
:= by
  simp [polyGrad]

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.polyGrad_C
statement: lemma polyGrad_C (a : ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) : polyGrad (C a) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.polyGrad_add
statement:
lemma polyGrad_add (p q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    polyGrad (p + q) v = polyGrad p v + polyGrad q v
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul]

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.polyGrad_mul_X
statement:
lemma polyGrad_mul_X [DecidableEq ι] (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (j : ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    polyGrad (p * X j) v =
      eval v p • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j + v j • polyGrad p v
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  have hterm : ∀ i : ι, eval v (pderiv i (p * X j)) * w i
      = (if i = j then eval v p * w i else 0) + v j * (eval v (pderiv i p) * w i) := by
    intro i
    rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
    · rw [pderiv_mul, pderiv_X_self]
      simp only [map_add, eval_mul, eval_X, mul_one, if_true]
      ring
    · rw [pderiv_mul, pderiv_X_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
      simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, mul_zero, add_zero, if_neg hij]
      ring
  simp only [polyGrad_apply, _root_.add_apply,
    _root_.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ j (fun i => eval v p * w i), ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.hasFDerivAt_eval
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_eval (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) (polyGrad p v) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply p.induction_on (fun a => ?_) (fun p q hp hq => ?_) fun p j hp => ?_
  · rw [polyGrad_C]
    simp only [eval_C]
    exact hasFDerivAt_const a v
  · rw [polyGrad_add]
    simp only [map_add]
    exact hp.add hq
  · have hfun : (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w (p * X j)) =
        fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p * w j := by
      funext w
      simp
    have hXj : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ι → ℂ => w j)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) v :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).hasFDerivAt
    rw [polyGrad_mul_X, hfun]
    exact hp.mul hXj

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.analyticAt_eval
statement:
theorem analyticAt_eval (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) v
proof:
:=
  AnalyticOnNhd.eval_mvPolynomial p v (Set.mem_univ v)

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.hasStrictFDerivAt_eval
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_eval (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) (polyGrad p v) v
proof:
:= by
  have ha : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) v := analyticAt_eval p v
  have h := ha.hasStrictFDerivAt
  rwa [(hasFDerivAt_eval p v).fderiv] at h

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.hasStrictFDerivAt_eval_pi
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_eval_pi (p : σ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun w (j : σ) => eval w (p j))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j => polyGrad (p j) v) v
proof:
:=
  hasStrictFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun j => hasStrictFDerivAt_eval (p j) v

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.analyticAt_eval_pi
statement:
theorem analyticAt_eval_pi (p : σ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w (j : σ) => eval w (p j)) v
proof:
:=
  AnalyticAt.pi fun j => analyticAt_eval (p j) v

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.ambient_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ambient_apply (G : Generators ℂ S ι) (φ : CPoints S) (i : ι) :
    ambient G φ i = φ (G.val i)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.ambient_algebraMap
statement:
lemma ambient_algebraMap (G : Generators ℂ S ι) (φ : CPoints S)
    (q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    φ (algebraMap G.Ring S q) = eval (ambient G φ) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.algebraMap_apply]
  exact comp_aeval_apply G.val φ q

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.isEmbedding_ambient
statement: theorem isEmbedding_ambient (G : Generators ℂ S ι) : IsEmbedding (ambient G)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range G.val) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
    exact (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).mpr G.aeval_val_surjective
  exact isEmbedding_evalGen G.val hg

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.kappaProj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma kappaProj_apply (z : ι → ℂ) (k : Kappa P) : kappaProj P z k = z k.val
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.extendedMap_def
statement:
lemma extendedMap_def :
    extendedMap P = fun z => (fun j => eval z (P.relation j), fun k => z k.val)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.extendedMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma extendedMap_apply (z : ι → ℂ) :
    extendedMap P z = (fun j => eval z (P.relation j), fun k => z k.val)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.analyticAt_extendedMap
statement: theorem analyticAt_extendedMap (z : ι → ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (extendedMap P) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedMap_def]
  exact (AnalyticAt.pi fun j => analyticAt_eval (P.relation j) z).prod
    (AnalyticAt.pi fun k =>
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k.val : (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).analyticAt z)

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.extendedDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma extendedDeriv_apply (v u : ι → ℂ) :
    extendedDeriv P v u = (fun j => polyGrad (P.relation j) v u, kappaProj P u)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap (v : ι → ℂ) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (extendedMap P) (extendedDeriv P v) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedMap_def]
  exact (hasStrictFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun j =>
    hasStrictFDerivAt_eval (P.relation j) v).prodMk
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun k => hasStrictFDerivAt_apply k.val v)

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.evalJacobiMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma evalJacobiMatrix_apply (v : ι → ℂ) (i j : σ) :
    evalJacobiMatrix P v i j = eval v (pderiv (P.map i) (P.relation j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalJacobiMatrix, P.jacobiMatrix_apply]

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.apply_jacobian
statement:
theorem apply_jacobian (φ : CPoints S) :
    φ P.jacobian = (evalJacobiMatrix P (ambient P.toGenerators φ)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det, ambient_algebraMap, RingHom.map_det]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.isUnit_apply_jacobian
statement:
theorem isUnit_apply_jacobian (Q : SubmersivePresentation ℂ S ι σ)
    (φ : CPoints S) : IsUnit (φ Q.jacobian)
proof:
:=
  Q.jacobian_isUnit.map φ

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.sumEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumEquiv_inl (j : σ) : sumEquiv P (Sum.inl j) = P.map j
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.sumEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumEquiv_inr (k : Kappa P) : sumEquiv P (Sum.inr k) = k.val
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.det_blockMatrix
statement:
theorem det_blockMatrix (v : ι → ℂ) :
    (blockMatrix P v).det = (evalJacobiMatrix P v).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockMatrix, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_one, mul_one,
    Matrix.det_transpose]

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.mulVec_apply'
statement:
private lemma mulVec_apply' {m n : Type*} [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (x : n → ℂ) (i : m) : (M *ᵥ x) i = ∑ s, M i s * x s
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.extendedDeriv_eq_comp
statement:
theorem extendedDeriv_eq_comp (v : ι → ℂ) :
    ⇑(extendedDeriv P v) =
      ⇑(Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow σ (Kappa P) ℂ) ∘ (blockMatrix P v).mulVec ∘
        fun u => u ∘ ⇑(sumEquiv P)
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  have hfst : ∀ j : σ, polyGrad (P.relation j) v u
      = ((blockMatrix P v) *ᵥ (u ∘ ⇑(sumEquiv P))) (Sum.inl j) := by
    intro j
    have hL : polyGrad (P.relation j) v u
        = ∑ j' : σ, eval v (pderiv (P.map j') (P.relation j)) * u (P.map j')
          + ∑ k : Kappa P, eval v (pderiv k.val (P.relation j)) * u k.val := by
      rw [polyGrad_apply,
        ← Equiv.sum_comp (sumEquiv P)
          (fun i => eval v (pderiv i (P.relation j)) * u i),
        Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      rfl
    have hR : ((blockMatrix P v) *ᵥ (u ∘ ⇑(sumEquiv P))) (Sum.inl j)
        = ∑ j' : σ, eval v (pderiv (P.map j') (P.relation j)) * u (P.map j')
          + ∑ k : Kappa P, eval v (pderiv k.val (P.relation j)) * u k.val := by
      rw [mulVec_apply', Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ => by
        simp [blockMatrix, evalJacobiMatrix, P.jacobiMatrix_apply]
    exact hL.trans hR.symm
  have hsnd : ∀ k : Kappa P, u k.val
      = ((blockMatrix P v) *ᵥ (u ∘ ⇑(sumEquiv P))) (Sum.inr k) := by
    intro k
    rw [mulVec_apply', Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp [blockMatrix, Matrix.one_apply]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · funext j
    exact hfst j
  · funext k
    exact hsnd k

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.bijective_extendedDeriv
statement:
theorem bijective_extendedDeriv (φ : CPoints S) (h : IsUnit (φ P.jacobian)) :
    Function.Bijective (extendedDeriv P (ambient P.toGenerators φ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedDeriv_eq_comp]
  have hM : IsUnit (blockMatrix P (ambient P.toGenerators φ)) := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, det_blockMatrix, ← apply_jacobian]
    exact h
  refine (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow σ (Kappa P) ℂ).bijective.comp
    (Function.Bijective.comp ?_ ?_)
  · exact ⟨Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hM,
      Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.mpr hM⟩
  · constructor
    · intro u u' huu'
      funext i
      simpa using congrFun huu' ((sumEquiv P).symm i)
    · intro w
      refine ⟨w ∘ ⇑(sumEquiv P).symm, ?_⟩
      funext s
      simp

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.coe_extendedDerivEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_extendedDerivEquiv (φ : CPoints S) (h : IsUnit (φ P.jacobian)) :
    (extendedDerivEquiv P φ h : (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (σ → ℂ) × (Kappa P → ℂ))
      = extendedDeriv P (ambient P.toGenerators φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap_equiv
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap_equiv (φ : CPoints S)
    (h : IsUnit (φ P.jacobian)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (extendedMap P)
      (extendedDerivEquiv P φ h : (ι → ℂ) →L[ℂ] (σ → ℂ) × (Kappa P → ℂ))
      (ambient P.toGenerators φ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hasStrictFDerivAt_extendedMap P (ambient P.toGenerators φ)
  rwa [← coe_extendedDerivEquiv P φ h] at h1

name: HodgePilot.JacobianBridge.range_ambient
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩ j
    rw [← ambient_algebraMap]
    simp
  · intro hv
    have hker : ∀ a ∈ Pr.ker, (aeval v : MvPolynomial ι ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) a = 0 := by
      have hle : Ideal.span (Set.range Pr.relation)
          ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval v : MvPolynomial ι ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) := by
        rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        simpa [RingHom.mem_ker] using hv j
      intro a ha
      rw [← Pr.span_range_relation_eq_ker] at ha
      exact hle ha
    refine ⟨(Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ Pr.ker (aeval v) hker).comp
      ((Pr.quotientEquiv.restrictScalars ℂ).symm.toAlgHom), ?_⟩
    funext i
    show (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ Pr.ker (aeval v) hker)
      ((Pr.quotientEquiv.restrictScalars ℂ).symm (Pr.val i)) = v i
    have he : (Pr.quotientEquiv.restrictScalars ℂ).symm (Pr.val i)
        = Ideal.Quotient.mk Pr.ker (Pr.σ (Pr.val i)) :=
      Pr.quotientEquiv_symm (Pr.val i)
    rw [he, Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_apply, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]
    have hmem : Pr.σ (Pr.val i) - X i ∈ Pr.ker := by
      rw [Pr.ker_eq_ker_aeval_val, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, Pr.aeval_val_σ,
        aeval_X, sub_self]
    have h0 := hker _ hmem
    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero, aeval_X] at h0
    exact h0

name: HodgePilot.LocallyContractible.stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace_of_locally
statement:
theorem stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace_of_locally {Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z]
    (h : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Set Z, IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace U) :
    StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace Z where
  contractible_basis z
proof:
:= by
    rw [Filter.hasBasis_self]
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hzU, hU⟩ := h z
    haveI := hU
    have hemb : IsOpenEmbedding (Subtype.val : U → Z) := hUo.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal
    have hmap : Filter.map (Subtype.val : U → Z) (𝓝 ⟨z, hzU⟩) = 𝓝 z :=
      hemb.map_nhds_eq ⟨z, hzU⟩
    rw [← hmap, Filter.mem_map] at ht
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs_mem, hs_contr⟩, hst⟩ :=
      (contractible_basis (⟨z, hzU⟩ : U)).mem_iff.mp ht
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hmap]
      exact Filter.image_mem_map hs_mem
    · exact (hemb.toIsEmbedding.homeomorphImage s).contractibleSpace_iff.mp hs_contr
    · exact Set.image_subset_iff.mpr hst

name: HodgePilot.LocallyContractible.stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace_sPointsSmooth
statement:
theorem stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace_sPointsSmooth [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] :
    StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace (SPoints sX)
proof:
:= by
  refine stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace_of_locally fun pt => ?_
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_sPatch_probe_eq sX d pt
  have hmem : pt ∈ (glueChart P).source := by
    rw [← hP]
    exact mem_glueChart_source_center P
  haveI : StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace ((glueChart P).target) :=
    (glueChart P).open_target.stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace
  exact ⟨(glueChart P).source, (glueChart P).open_source, hmem,
    (glueChart P).toHomeomorphSourceTarget.isOpenEmbedding.stronglyLocallyContractibleSpace⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.eq_smul_of_addEquiv_rat
statement:
lemma eq_smul_of_addEquiv_rat {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    (e : M ≃+ ℚ) {u : M} (hu : u ≠ 0) (s : M) : s = (e s / e u) • u
proof:
:= by
  have hne : e u ≠ 0 := fun h => hu (e.injective (h.trans (map_zero e).symm))
  apply e.injective
  rw [map_rat_smul e (e s / e u) u, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.exists_eq_smul_unitCochainHom
statement:
lemma exists_eq_smul_unitCochainHom (B : TopCat.{0}) [ContractibleSpace ↑B] (b : ↑B)
    (s : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).X 0)
    (hs : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op B)).d 0 1 s = 0) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, cochainZeroHom B s = q • unitCochainHom B
proof:
:= by
  
  have hs' : (chainsFunctor.obj B).d 1 0 ≫ cochainZeroHom B s = 0 := hs
  
  have hmemS : cochainZeroHom B s ∈
      LinearMap.ker ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom) :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      (show ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom)
        (cochainZeroHom B s) = 0 from hs')
  have hmemU : unitCochainHom B ∈
      LinearMap.ker ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom) :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      (show ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom)
        (unitCochainHom B) = 0 from d_comp_unitCochainHom B)
  
  let e : ↥(LinearMap.ker ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom)) ≃+ ℚ :=
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (SingularDegreeZero.dualDescend (chainsFunctor.obj B))
        (SingularDegreeZero.bijective_dualDescend (chainsFunctor.obj B))).symm.trans
      ((SingularDegreeZero.dualHomologyZeroEquiv (chainsFunctor.obj B)).symm.trans
        (contractibleCohomologyZeroEquiv B))
  have hu : (⟨unitCochainHom B, hmemU⟩ :
      ↥(LinearMap.ker ((SingularDegreeZero.dualSc (chainsFunctor.obj B)).g.hom))) ≠ 0 :=
    fun h0 => unitCochainHom_ne_zero B b (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
  have hq := eq_smul_of_addEquiv_rat e hu ⟨cochainZeroHom B s, hmemS⟩
  exact ⟨_, congrArg Subtype.val hq⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.exact_stalk_augmentedPresheaf
statement:
theorem exact_stalk_augmentedPresheaf (X : TopCat.{0})
    [StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace ↑X] (x : ↑X) :
    ((ShortComplex.mk (augmentationPresheaf X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1)
        (augmentationPresheaf_comp_d X)).map
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0) z
  have hz' : ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1))
      (((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).germ U x hxU s) = 0 := hz
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hz'
  
  have h0 : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 1).germ U x hxU
      (((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1).app (op U) s) =
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 1).germ U x hxU 0 := by
    rw [hz']; simp
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWU, iWU', hres⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq _ x hxU hxU _ _ h0
  set sW := ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map iWU.op s with hsW
  have hdW : ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1).app (op W) sW = 0 := by
    rw [hsW, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1).naturality iWU.op,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hres]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨hBmem, hBcontr⟩, hBW⟩ :=
    (contractible_basis (x : ↑X)).mem_iff.mp (W.isOpen.mem_nhds hxW)
  obtain ⟨O, hOB, hOopen, hxO⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hBmem
  haveI := hBcontr
  let Wsp := (Opens.toTopCat X).obj W
  let bT : TopCat.{0} := TopCat.of ↥B
  let OW : Opens X := ⟨O, hOopen⟩
  have hOle : OW ⟶ W := homOfLE fun a ha => hBW (hOB ha)
  let ιBW : bT ⟶ Wsp := TopCat.ofHom ⟨Set.inclusion hBW, continuous_inclusion hBW⟩
  let ιOB : (Opens.toTopCat X).obj OW ⟶ bT :=
    TopCat.ofHom ⟨Set.inclusion hOB, continuous_inclusion hOB⟩
  have hglue : (Opens.toTopCat X).map hOle = ιOB ≫ ιBW :=
    TopCat.hom_ext (ContinuousMap.ext fun a => Subtype.ext rfl)
  
  have hsBzero : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op bT)).d 0 1
      ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).f 0 sW) = 0 := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).comm 0 1,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    have hbridge : (singularCochainAbFunctor.obj (op Wsp)).d 0 1 sW = 0 := hdW
    rw [hbridge]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eq_smul_unitCochainHom bT ⟨x, hOB hxO⟩
    ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).f 0 sW) hsBzero
  
  have hOres : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map hOle.op sW = smulUnitSection X OW q := by
    have hstep : ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).map hOle.op sW
        = (singularCochainFunctor.map ιOB.op).f 0
          (cochainZeroHom bT ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).f 0 sW)) := by
      show (singularCochainAbFunctor.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map hOle).op).f 0 sW
          = (singularCochainFunctor.map ιOB.op).f 0
            (cochainZeroHom bT ((singularCochainAbFunctor.map ιBW.op).f 0 sW))
      rw [hglue, op_comp, Functor.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
        ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
      rfl
    refine hstep.trans (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (fun t => (singularCochainFunctor.map ιOB.op).f 0 t) hq) ?_)
    show (singularCochainFunctor.map ιOB.op).f 0 (q • unitCochainHom bT)
        = (q • unitCochainHom ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj OW) :
          (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj OW)).X 0 ⟶ Qcoef)
    rw [map_smul]
    congr 1
    exact unitCochain_map ιOB
  
  refine ⟨(constQPresheaf X).germ OW x hxO (ULift.up q), ?_⟩
  show ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationPresheaf X))
      ((constQPresheaf X).germ OW x hxO (ULift.up q))
      = ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0).germ U x hxU s
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  have happ : (augmentationPresheaf X).app (op OW) (ULift.up q) = smulUnitSection X OW q := rfl
  rw [happ, ← hOres, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsW, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.exact_map_stalk_augmented_of_exact
statement:
lemma exact_map_stalk_augmented_of_exact (X : TopCat.{0}) (x : ↑X)
    (h : ((ShortComplex.mk (augmentationPresheaf X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1)
        (augmentationPresheaf_comp_d X)).map
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact) :
    ((augmentedShortComplex X).map
      (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{0} X ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    (constQPresheaf X)
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0)
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat
    ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 1)
  refine (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X))))
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0))))
    (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 1))))
    ?_ ?_)).mp h
  · show (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (constQPresheaf X))
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (augmentationPresheaf X))
        = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map (augmentationPresheaf X)
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0))
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← toSheafify_naturality]
  · show (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 0))
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1))
        = (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map ((singularPresheafComplex X).d 0 1)
        ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ((singularPresheafComplex X).X 1))
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← toSheafify_naturality]

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.stalkFunctor_map_exact_augmentedShortComplex
statement:
theorem stalkFunctor_map_exact_augmentedShortComplex (X : TopCat.{0})

name: HodgePilot.SingularResolutionZero.stalkFunctor_map_exact_sheafifiedCochainComplex
statement:
theorem stalkFunctor_map_exact_sheafifiedCochainComplex (X : TopCat.{0})
    [StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace ↑X] (i : ℕ) (x : ↑X) :
    ((ShortComplex.mk ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).d i (i + 1))
        ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).d (i + 1) (i + 2))
        ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).d_comp_d i (i + 1) (i + 2))).map
      (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{0} X ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{0} x)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  have h := exactAt_sheafifiedCochainComplex X (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)
  rw [(sheafifiedCochainComplex X).exactAt_iff' i (i + 1) (i + 2) (by simp) (by simp),
    TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact] at h
  exact h x

name: HodgePilot.Junction.evalMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalMatrix_apply (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (v : Fin p → (Fin n → ℂ)) (j i : Fin p) :
    evalMatrix ω v j i = ω i (v j)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedgeAlt_apply
statement:
theorem wedgeAlt_apply (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (v : Fin p → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    wedgeAlt ω v = (evalMatrix ω v).det
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedgeAlt_norm_le
statement:
theorem wedgeAlt_norm_le (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (v : Fin p → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    ‖wedgeAlt ω v‖ ≤ ((p.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ i, ‖ω i‖) * ∏ j, ‖v j‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeAlt_apply, Matrix.det_apply]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have hterm : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p),
      ‖Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ i, evalMatrix ω v (σ i) i‖ ≤
        (∏ i, ‖ω i‖) * ∏ j, ‖v j‖ := by
    intro σ
    have hsign : ‖Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ i, evalMatrix ω v (σ i) i‖ =
        ‖∏ i, evalMatrix ω v (σ i) i‖ := by
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) with h | h <;>
        simp [h, Units.smul_def, norm_neg]
    rw [hsign, norm_prod]
    calc ∏ i, ‖evalMatrix ω v (σ i) i‖
        ≤ ∏ i, (‖ω i‖ * ‖v (σ i)‖) := by
          refine Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i _ => ?_)
          exact (ω i).le_opNorm (v (σ i))
      _ = (∏ i, ‖ω i‖) * ∏ i, ‖v (σ i)‖ := Finset.prod_mul_distrib
      _ = (∏ i, ‖ω i‖) * ∏ j, ‖v j‖ := by
          rw [Equiv.prod_comp σ fun j => ‖v j‖]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => hterm σ).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedge_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wedge_apply (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (v : Fin p → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    wedge ω v = (evalMatrix ω v).det
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge, wedgeAlt_apply]

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedge_norm_le
statement:
theorem wedge_norm_le (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) :
    ‖wedge ω‖ ≤ (p.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ i, ‖ω i‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousAlternatingMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ?_ (wedgeAlt_norm_le ω)
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)

name: HodgePilot.Junction.evalMatrix_update
statement:
theorem evalMatrix_update
    (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (i : Fin p)
    (x : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (v : Fin p → (Fin n → ℂ)) :
    evalMatrix (Function.update ω i x) v =
      (evalMatrix ω v).updateCol i (fun j => x (v j))
proof:
:= by
  ext j i'
  rw [Matrix.updateCol_apply]
  by_cases h : i' = i <;> simp [h]

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedge_update_add
statement:
theorem wedge_update_add
    (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (i : Fin p)
    (x y : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge (Function.update ω i (x + y)) =
      wedge (Function.update ω i x) + wedge (Function.update ω i y)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [wedge_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply, evalMatrix_update]
  have hx : (fun j => (x + y) (v j)) = (fun j => x (v j)) + fun j => y (v j) := by
    funext j; simp
  rw [hx]
  exact Matrix.det_updateCol_add (evalMatrix ω v) i
    (fun j => x (v j)) (fun j => y (v j))

name: HodgePilot.Junction.wedge_update_smul
statement:
theorem wedge_update_smul
    (ω : Fin p → ((Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (i : Fin p)
    (c : ℂ) (x : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge (Function.update ω i (c • x)) = c • wedge (Function.update ω i x)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [wedge_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, evalMatrix_update]
  have hx : (fun j => (c • x) (v j)) = c • fun j => x (v j) := by
    funext j; simp
  rw [hx, smul_eq_mul]
  exact Matrix.det_updateCol_smul (evalMatrix ω v) i c (fun j => x (v j))

name: HodgePilot.Junction.analyticOnNhd_wedge
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => (fun i => ω i z)) s := AnalyticOnNhd.pi hω
  have h2 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (⇑(wedgeCMM (n := n) (p := p))) Set.univ :=
    (wedgeCMM (n := n) (p := p)).analyticOnNhd
  have key : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => wedgeCMM (fun i => ω i z)) s :=
    h2.comp h1 (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _)
  have hfun : (fun z => wedge (fun i => ω i z)) =
      fun z => wedgeCMM (fun i => ω i z) := by
    funext z
    exact (wedgeCMM_apply fun i => ω i z).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact key

name: HodgePilot.Junction.counitComplexMap_f
statement:

name: HodgePilot.Junction.junctionHyperH_apply

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective
statement:
theorem gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap ℂ (𝒜₂ 0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    exact MvPolynomial.C_injective (Fin 2) ℂ (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
  · intro x
    have hx : (x : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) ∈
        (1 : Submodule ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
      rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero]
      exact x.2
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hx
    exact ⟨c, Subtype.ext hc⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.closure_botPoint
statement:
theorem closure_botPoint :
    closure ({botPoint} : Set (ProjectiveSpectrum 𝒜₂)) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ProjectiveSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
    ProjectiveSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_singleton,
    show botPoint.asHomogeneousIdeal = (⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜₂) from rfl,
    HomogeneousIdeal.coe_bot, ← Set.singleton_zero]
  exact ProjectiveSpectrum.zeroLocus_singleton_zero 𝒜₂

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.U0_sup_U1
statement: theorem U0_sup_U1 : U0 ⊔ U1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h : (⨆ i : Fin 2, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = ⊤ :=
    Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' 𝒜₂
      (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (fun i => ⟨1, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
        (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ i)⟩)
      (top_le_iff.mp fun a _ => by
        have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
            (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
          rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]; trivial
        have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℂ
            (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤
            Subalgebra.restrictScalars ℂ (Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₂ 0)
              (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))) :=
          Algebra.adjoin_le fun s hs => Algebra.subset_adjoin hs
        exact (Subalgebra.mem_restrictScalars ℂ).mp (hle ha))
  rw [← h]
  exact le_antisymm
    (sup_le
      (le_iSup (fun i : Fin 2 => Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) 0)
      (le_iSup (fun i : Fin 2 => Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) 1))
    (iSup_le (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨le_sup_left, le_sup_right⟩))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.U0_inf_U1
statement:
theorem U0_inf_U1 :
    U0 ⊓ U1 = Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.botPt_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem botPt_mem_basicOpen {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    botPt ∈ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proj.mem_basicOpen]
  intro h
  have h' : f ∈ ((⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜₂) : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := h
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.coe_bot] at h'
  exact hf (Set.mem_zero.mp h')

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.genericPoint_mem_U01

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.hX01
statement:
theorem hX01 :
    (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) ∈ 𝒜₂ 2
proof:
:=
  SetLike.mul_mem_graded
    ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ 0))
    ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ 1))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.hXsq
proof:
:=
  (one_smul ℕ 2).symm ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded
    ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ i))
    ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X ℂ i))

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.awayNum_mul_awayNumInv
statement: theorem awayNum_mul_awayNumInv : awayNum * awayNumInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one]
  unfold awayNum awayNumInv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    Localization.mk_mul, ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_exists]
  use 1
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.mk_mul_mk]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLine.dinf_overlap
statement:
theorem dinf_overlap :
    ((divisorsAb p1).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).map
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op dinfLeft =
      ((divisorsAb p1).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).map
        ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op dinfRight
proof:
:= by
  show (divisorsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
      ((divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) =
    (divisorsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
      (0 : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op U1))
  have hz : (divisorsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op
      (0 : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op U1)) = 0 :=
    map_zero ((divisorsAb p1).obj.map
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₃).op).hom
  rw [hz]
  have hnat : (divisorsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
      ((divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) =
      (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
        ((KUnitsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
          (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0)) := by
    show ((divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) ≫
        (divisorsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op)
        (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) = _
    rw [← (divisorsπ p1).hom.naturality]
    rfl
  rw [hnat]
  have hres : (KUnitsAb p1).obj.map ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₁₂).op
      (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) = zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U01 := by
    rw [KUnitsAb_map_of_mem p1 _ genericPoint_mem_U01]
    show (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p1 genericPoint_mem_U0).symm ≫
      eqToHom _) zElt = _
    rw [eqToHom_trans]
    rfl
  rw [hres]
  have hunit : zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U01 =
      (unitsToK p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb := by
    rw [unitsToK_app_of_mem p1 genericPoint_mem_U01]
    rfl
  rw [hunit]
  have h1 : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))
      ((unitsToK p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1)) overlapUnitAb) =
      ((unitsToK p1 ≫ divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op (U0 ⊓ U1))) overlapUnitAb := rfl
  rw [h1, show unitsToK p1 ≫ divisorsπ p1 = 0 from
    cokernel.condition (unitsToK p1)]
  rfl
