name: HodgePilot.DLog.update_konst
statement: theorem update_konst (x y : B) (i : Fin 1) : update (konst B x) i y = konst B y
proof:
:=
  funext fun j => update_fin_one_apply B (konst B x) i y j

name: HodgePilot.DLog.gen_konst_add
statement:
theorem gen_konst_add (x y : B) :
    gen A B (konst B (x + y)) = gen A B (konst B x) + gen A B (konst B y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_add A B (konst B 1) 0 x y
  rwa [update_konst, update_konst, update_konst] at h

name: HodgePilot.DLog.gen_konst_mul
statement:
theorem gen_konst_mul (x y : B) :
    gen A B (konst B (x * y)) = x • gen A B (konst B y) + y • gen A B (konst B x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_mul A B (konst B 1) 0 x y
  rwa [update_konst, update_konst, update_konst] at h

name: HodgePilot.DLog.gen_konst_algebraMap
statement: theorem gen_konst_algebraMap (a : A) : gen A B (konst B (algebraMap A B a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_update_algebraMap A B (konst B 1) 0 a
  rwa [update_konst] at h

name: HodgePilot.DLog.gen_konst_one
statement: theorem gen_konst_one : gen A B (konst B 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := gen_konst_algebraMap A B 1
  rwa [map_one] at h

name: HodgePilot.DLog.dlog_mul
statement: theorem dlog_mul (u v : Bˣ) : dlog A B (u * v) = dlog A B u + dlog A B v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((((u * v)⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B)) * (u : B) = ((v⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) := by
    rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
  have h2 : ((((u * v)⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B)) * (v : B) = ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) := by
    rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm (v⁻¹) (u⁻¹), mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
  rw [dlog, Units.val_mul, gen_konst_mul, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, h1, h2,
    add_comm]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DLog.dlog_one
statement: theorem dlog_one : dlog A B 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dlog]
  have h : ((1 : Bˣ) : B) = (1 : B) := rfl
  rw [h, gen_konst_one A B, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.DLog.dlogHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dlogHom_apply (u : Additive Bˣ) :
    dlogHom A B u = dlog A B u.toMul
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DLog.dlog_inv
statement: theorem dlog_inv (u : Bˣ) : dlog A B u⁻¹ = - dlog A B u
proof:
:= by
  have h : dlog A B u⁻¹ + dlog A B u = 0 := by
    rw [← dlog_mul, inv_mul_cancel, dlog_one]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: HodgePilot.DLog.d_dlog
statement: theorem d_dlog (u : Bˣ) : d A B 1 (dlog A B u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : dlog A B u =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (konst B (u : B)) ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B)) := by
    rw [mk_single_eq_smul_gen, dlog]
  rw [hmk, d_mk_single]
  
  have hswap : gen A B (Fin.cons ((u : B)) (konst B (u : B))) = 0 :=
    gen_eq_zero A B (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide)
      (by rw [show (1 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 1).succ from rfl, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero]; rfl)
  have hkey := gen_cons_mul A B (u : B) ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) (konst B (u : B))
  rw [Units.mul_inv, gen_cons_one, hswap, smul_zero, add_zero] at hkey
  have hsmul := congrArg (fun z => ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) • z) hkey.symm
  simpa [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul] using hsmul

name: HodgePilot.DLog.map_dlog
statement:
theorem map_dlog {B' : Type v} [CommRing B'] [Algebra A B'] (φ : B →ₐ[A] B') (u : Bˣ) :
    DeRham.map φ 1 (dlog A B u) =
      dlog A B' (Units.map (φ : B →* B') u)
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : dlog A B u =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (konst B (u : B)) ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B)) := by
    rw [mk_single_eq_smul_gen, dlog]
  rw [hmk, map_mk_single]
  have hc : φ ∘ konst B (u : B) = konst B' ((Units.map (φ : B →* B') u : B'ˣ) : B') := by
    funext j
    simp [konst, Units.coe_map]
  have hs : φ (((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B)) = (((Units.map (φ : B →* B') u)⁻¹ : B'ˣ) : B') := by
    rw [Units.coe_map_inv]
    rfl
  rw [hc, hs, mk_single_eq_smul_gen]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DLog.brutalTruncGE_d_eq
statement:
theorem brutalTruncGE_d_eq (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (p n m : ℤ) (hn : p ≤ n) (hm : p ≤ m) :
    (brutalTruncGE K p).d n m =
      (brutalTruncGEXIso K p n hn).hom ≫ K.d n m ≫ (brutalTruncGEXIso K p m hm).inv
proof:
:=
  stupidTrunc_d_eq K (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p)
    (i := (n - p).toNat) (j := (m - p).toNat)
    (by rw [embeddingUpIntGE_f]; lia) (by rw [embeddingUpIntGE_f]; lia)

name: HodgePilot.DLog.ιBrutalTruncGE_f
statement:
theorem ιBrutalTruncGE_f (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (p n : ℤ) (hn : p ≤ n) :
    (ιBrutalTruncGE K p).f n = (brutalTruncGEXIso K p n hn).hom
proof:
:=
  ιStupidTrunc_f K (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p)
    (i := (n - p).toNat) (by rw [embeddingUpIntGE_f]; lia)

name: HodgePilot.DLog.comp_reindexZ_d_of_comp_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp_reindexZ_d_of_comp_d_eq_zero (f : M ⟶ K.X 1) (hf : f ≫ K.d 1 2 = 0) :
    (f ≫ (reindexZXIso K 1).inv) ≫ (reindexZ K).d 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (reindexZ K).d (1 : ℤ) (2 : ℤ) =
      (reindexZXIso K 1).hom ≫ K.d 1 2 ≫ (reindexZXIso K 2).inv :=
    reindexZ_d_eq K 1 2
  rw [Category.assoc, hd, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc, hf,
    Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.DLog.singleToReindexZ_f_one
statement:

    (singleToReindexZ f hf).f 1 =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 1 M).hom ≫ f ≫ (reindexZXIso K 1).inv
proof:

name: HodgePilot.DLog.singleToBrutalTruncGE_f_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleToBrutalTruncGE_f_one (f : M ⟶ K.X 1) (hf : f ≫ K.d 1 2 = 0) :
    (singleToBrutalTruncGE f hf).f 1 =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 1 M).hom ≫ f ≫ (reindexZXIso K 1).inv ≫
        (brutalTruncGEXIso (reindexZ K) 1 1 le_rfl).inv
proof:
:=
  mkHomFromSingle_f _ _

name: HodgePilot.DLog.singleToBrutalTruncGE_ι
statement:
theorem singleToBrutalTruncGE_ι (f : M ⟶ K.X 1) (hf : f ≫ K.d 1 2 = 0) :
    singleToBrutalTruncGE f hf ≫ ιBrutalTruncGE (reindexZ K) 1 =
      singleToReindexZ f hf
proof:
:= by
  apply from_single_hom_ext
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, singleToBrutalTruncGE_f_one f hf,
    singleToReindexZ_f_one f hf, ιBrutalTruncGE_f (reindexZ K) 1 1 le_rfl]
  simp

name: HodgePilot.DLog.chernShape_apply

name: HodgePilot.DLog.dAbOpens_app

name: HodgePilot.bialgEquiv_rat_laurent_false
statement:
theorem bialgEquiv_rat_laurent_false (e : ℚ ≃ₐc[ℚ] LaurentPolynomial ℚ) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have i : trivialGroupScheme ≅ gmGroupScheme := groupSchemeIsoOfBialgEquiv e
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton (op (CommAlgCat.of ℚ ℚ) ⟶ trivialGroupScheme.X) :=
    trivialGroupScheme_points_subsingleton ℚ
  have equiv := (pointsMulEquivOfGrpIso i (op (CommAlgCat.of ℚ ℚ))).trans
    (gmPointsMulEquiv ℚ)
  haveI : Subsingleton ℚˣ := (equiv.symm.toEquiv).subsingleton
  have h2 : (Units.mk0 (2 : ℚ) (by norm_num)) = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have h3 := congrArg Units.val h2
  norm_num at h3

name: HodgePilot.CochainAcyclic.isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_isFlasque
statement:
theorem isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_isFlasque
    (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X) [G.IsFlasque] :
    IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X) G
proof:
:= by
  intro B R f g hfg hS
  haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).X₁ :=
    inferInstanceAs G.IsFlasque
  have hepi : Epi ((ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).g.1.app (op (⊤ : Opens X))) :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.epi_of_shortExact hS
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hepi

name: HodgePilot.CochainAcyclic.isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_sheafifiedCochain
statement:
theorem isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_sheafifiedCochain
    [ParacompactSpace ↑X] [T2Space ↑X] (n : ℕ) :
    IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X)
      ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n)
proof:
:= by
  intro B R f g hfg hS
  exact HodgePilot.SingularGamma.gammaSurjective_of_shortExact_sheafifiedCochain
    X n f g hfg hS

name: HodgePilot.CochainAcyclic.flasqueCokernel_sheafifiedCochain
statement:
theorem flasqueCokernel_sheafifiedCochain [T2Space ↑X]
    (hpar : ∀ W : Opens X, ParacompactSpace ↥W) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) ⦃B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X⦄
      (f : (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R)
      (hfg : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact →
      Injective B → R.IsFlasque
proof:
:= by
  intro n B R f g hfg hSE hB
  refine ⟨fun {U V} i => ?_⟩
  refine (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr fun q => ?_
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.relativeLemmaW X V.unop (hpar _) n f g hfg hSE q
  haveI := HodgePilot.FlasqueEmbed.isFlasque_of_injective B hB
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective (B.1.map i)).mp inferInstance b
  refine ⟨g.hom.app U b', ?_⟩
  have hnat : R.1.map i (g.hom.app U b') = g.hom.app V (B.1.map i b') := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      g.hom.naturality]
  rw [hnat, hb']
  exact hb

name: HodgePilot.CochainAcyclic.subsingleton_H_sheafifiedCochain_of_flasqueCokernel
statement:
theorem subsingleton_H_sheafifiedCochain_of_flasqueCokernel
    [ParacompactSpace ↑X] [T2Space ↑X]
    (hcok : ∀ (n : ℕ) ⦃B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X⦄
      (f : (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact → Injective B → R.IsFlasque)
    (k m : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X k) (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : ∀ G, FlasqueOrCochain X G →
      IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X) G := by
    rintro G (hfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
    · haveI := hfl
      exact isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_isFlasque G
    · exact isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_sheafifiedCochain n
  have hquot : ∀ ⦃G B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X⦄ (f : G ⟶ B)
      (g : B ⟶ R) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact →
      FlasqueOrCochain X G → Injective B → FlasqueOrCochain X R := by
    rintro G B R f g hfg hSE (hfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩) hB
    · haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).X₁ := hfl
      haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).X₂ :=
        HodgePilot.FlasqueEmbed.isFlasque_of_injective B hB
      exact Or.inl
        (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.of_shortExact_of_isFlasque₁₂ hSE)
    · exact Or.inl (hcok n f g hfg hSE hB)
  exact space_subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class
    (FlasqueOrCochain X) hsurj hquot m ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X k)
    (Or.inr ⟨k, rfl⟩)

statement:

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.polySmul_val
statement:
theorem polySmul_val {p : ℕ} {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))} (s : Poly N)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U)) (y : ↥U) :
    (s • ω).1 y = eval (y : Fin N → ℂ) s • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) s • sectionExtendV ω ↑y =
    eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) s • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.sections_add_val
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.invEvalSMulSection_val
statement:
theorem invEvalSMulSection_val {p : ℕ} {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))}
    (g : Poly N) (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, eval z g ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U)) (y : ↥U) :
    (invEvalSMulSection g hg ω).1 y = (eval (y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show (eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV ω ↑y =
    (eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.invEval_smul_cancel
statement:
theorem invEval_smul_cancel {p : ℕ} {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))}
    (g : Poly N) (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, eval z g ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    invEvalSMulSection g hg (g • ω) = ω
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show (eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV (g • ω) ↑y = ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (g • ω) y.2]
  show (eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ •
    (eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g • sectionExtendV ω ↑y) = ω.1 y
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) y.2),
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.smul_invEval_cancel
statement:
theorem smul_invEval_cancel {p : ℕ} {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))}
    (g : Poly N) (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, eval z g ≠ 0)
    (η : (omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    g • invEvalSMulSection g hg η = η
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g •
    sectionExtendV (invEvalSMulSection g hg η) ↑y = η.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (invEvalSMulSection g hg η) y.2]
  show eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g •
    ((eval (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) g)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV η ↑y) = η.1 y
  rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin N → ℂ) y.2),
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem η y.2]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.isUnit_algebraMap_end
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_end {p : ℕ} {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))}
    {g : Poly N} (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, eval z g ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (Poly N)
      (Module.End (Poly N) ((omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U))) g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ω η h
    have h3 : g • ω = g • η := h
    calc ω = invEvalSMulSection g hg (g • ω) :=
          (invEval_smul_cancel g hg ω).symm
      _ = invEvalSMulSection g hg (g • η) := by rw [h3]
      _ = η := invEval_smul_cancel g hg η
  · intro η
    exact ⟨invEvalSMulSection g hg η, smul_invEval_cancel g hg η⟩

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem smul_cancel_of_ne_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℂ M]
    {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) {v w : M} (h : c • v = c • w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun u => c⁻¹ • u) h
  simpa only [inv_smul_smul₀ hc] using h1

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.realizeToNv_val
statement:
theorem realizeToNv_val (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p)
    (y : ↥(nvLocus f)) :
    (realizeToNv f p x).1 y = drRealize N p x (y : Fin N → ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.localizedRealize_locMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedRealize_locMap (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ)
    (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    localizedRealize f p (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x) =
      realizeSection (op (nvLocus f)) x
proof:
:=
  IsLocalizedModule.lift_apply (Submonoid.powers f) (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p)
    (realizeToNv f p) _ x

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.localizedRealize_val_smul_locMap
statement:
theorem localizedRealize_val_smul_locMap (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ)
    {y : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p} {c : Poly N} {x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p}
    (h : c • y = locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hz : eval z f ≠ 0) :
    eval z c • (localizedRealize f p y).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ = drRealize N p x z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : c • localizedRealize f p y =
      realizeSection (op (nvLocus f)) x :=
    ((LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealize f p) c y).symm.trans
      (congrArg (localizedRealize f p) h)).trans
      (localizedRealize_locMap f p x)
  calc eval z c • (localizedRealize f p y).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
      = (c • localizedRealize f p y).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
        (polySmul_val c (localizedRealize f p y) ⟨z, hz⟩).symm
    _ = (realizeSection (op (nvLocus f)) x).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ := by rw [h1]
    _ = drRealize N p x z := realizeSection_val (op (nvLocus f)) x ⟨z, hz⟩

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.d_smul_wedgeP
statement:
theorem d_smul_wedgeP {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] [Algebra ℂ B'] (m : ℕ)
    (c : B') (w : DR ℂ B' m) :
    DeRham.d ℂ B' m (c • w) =
      wedgeP ℂ B' m (gen ℂ B' (fun _ => c)) w + c • DeRham.d ℂ B' m w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, smul_add, map_add, hu, hv, map_add,
        map_add, smul_add]
      abel
  | single t s =>
      have h1 : c • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s) : DR ℂ B' m) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t (c * s)) := by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Finsupp.smul_single']
      rw [h1, d_mk_single, d_mk_single, gen_cons_mul,
        mk_single_eq_smul_gen, map_smul, wedgeP_gen]
      abel

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.locMap_wedgeP_gen
statement:
theorem locMap_wedgeP_gen (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ) (g : Poly N)
    (z : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g))
        (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p z) =
      locMap ℂ (Poly N) f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Poly N) p (gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, hu, hv, map_add,
        map_add]
  | single t s =>
      rw [locMap_mk_single,
        show gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single
            (fun _ : Fin 1 => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g) 1)
          from rfl,
        show gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) 1)
          from rfl,
        wedgeP_mk_single, wedgeP_mk_single, one_mul, one_mul, map_smul,
        locMap_gen, algebraMap_smul]
      refine congrArg (fun w => s • w)
        (congrArg (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)) (funext fun j => ?_))
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
      | succ i => rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.drRealize_wedgeP_gen
statement:
theorem drRealize_wedgeP_gen (g : Poly N) (p : ℕ) (z : DR ℂ (Poly N) p)
    (w : Fin N → ℂ) :
    drRealize N (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Poly N) p (gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g)) z) w =
      wedge1 (polyGrad g w) (drRealize N p z w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      show (0 : FormFn N (p + 1)) w = wedge1 (polyGrad g w) ((0 : FormFn N p) w)
      rw [show (0 : FormFn N p) w = 0 from rfl,
        show (0 : FormFn N (p + 1)) w = 0 from rfl, wedge1_zero_right]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add]
      show (drRealize N (p + 1) _ + drRealize N (p + 1) _) w = _
      rw [Pi.add_apply, hu, hv,
        show (drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) +
            drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk v)) w =
          drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) w +
            drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk v) w from rfl,
        wedge1_add_right]
  | single t s =>
      rw [show gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) 1)
          from rfl, wedgeP_mk_single, one_mul, ← mk_single_eq_smul_gen,
        drRealize_mk_single, drRealize_mk_single, algForm_apply,
        algForm_apply]
      have hc : (fun j => polyGrad (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Poly N) g t j) w) =
          Fin.cons (polyGrad g w) (fun j => polyGrad (t j) w) := by
        funext j
        induction j using Fin.cases with
        | zero => rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
        | succ i => rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      rw [show formOfTuple
            (fun j => polyGrad (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Poly N) g t j) w) =
          formOfTuple (Fin.cons (polyGrad g w) (fun j => polyGrad (t j) w))
          from congrArg formOfTuple hc,
        formOfTuple_cons, wedge1_smul_right]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.localizedRealize_wedgeP_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealize_wedgeP_val (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ) (g : Poly N)
    (y : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (z : Fin N → ℂ) (hz : eval z f ≠ 0) :
    (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
          (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g)) y)).1
        ⟨z, hz⟩ =
      wedge1 (polyGrad g z) ((localizedRealize f p y).1 ⟨z, hz⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Poly N) f p y
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  have hsz : eval z (s : Poly N) ≠ 0 := eval_pow_ne_zero hz s
  have hclear : (s : Poly N) • (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
      (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
        (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g)) y) =
      locMap ℂ (Poly N) f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Poly N) p (gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g)) x) := by
    calc (s : Poly N) • (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g)) y)
        = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g))
            ((s : Poly N) • y) := by
          rw [← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Poly N)
              (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
                (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                  (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g)) y),
            ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Poly N) y, map_smul]
      _ = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) g))
            (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x) := by rw [hs]
      _ = locMap ℂ (Poly N) f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Poly N) p (gen ℂ (Poly N) (fun _ => g)) x) :=
          locMap_wedgeP_gen f p g x
  have h1 := localizedRealize_val_smul_locMap f (p + 1) hclear z hz
  rw [drRealize_wedgeP_gen] at h1
  have h2 := localizedRealize_val_smul_locMap f p hs z hz
  rw [← h2, wedge1_smul_right] at h1
  exact smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsz h1

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.dSection_localizedRealize
statement:
theorem dSection_localizedRealize (f : Poly N) (p : ℕ)
    (y : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) :
    dSection (localizedRealize f p y) =
      localizedRealize f (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Poly N) f p y
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun ypt => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ypt
  have hsz : eval z (s : Poly N) ≠ 0 := eval_pow_ne_zero hz s
  
  have hev : ((fun w => eval w (s : Poly N)) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y))
      =ᶠ[nhds z] drRealize N p x := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvLocus f).isOpen.mem_nhds hz)
      (fun w hw => ?_)
    show eval w (s : Poly N) • sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y) w = _
    rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw]
    exact localizedRealize_val_smul_locMap f p hs w hw
  
  have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun w => eval w (s : Poly N))
      (polyGrad (s : Poly N) z) z :=
    hasFDerivAt_eval (s : Poly N) z
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y))
      (fderiv ℂ (sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z) z :=
    ((analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y))
      z hz).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hprod := hder.smul hG
  have hLHS : extDeriv ((fun w => eval w (s : Poly N)) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z =
      eval z (s : Poly N) •
        extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z +
      wedge1 (polyGrad (s : Poly N) z)
        (sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y) z) := by
    show ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin
      (fderiv ℂ ((fun w => eval w (s : Poly N)) •
        sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z) = _
    rw [hprod.fderiv, ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_add,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_smul]
    rfl
  
  have hext : extDeriv ((fun w => eval w (s : Poly N)) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z =
      drRealize N (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Poly N) p x) z := by
    rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
    exact congrFun (extDeriv_drRealize x) z
  
  have hd : locMap ℂ (Poly N) f (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Poly N) p x) =
      wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) (s : Poly N))) y +
      (s : Poly N) • DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y := by
    rw [← d_locMap, ← hs, ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Poly N) y,
      d_smul_wedgeP, algebraMap_smul]
  have hval : drRealize N (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Poly N) p x) z =
      wedge1 (polyGrad (s : Poly N) z)
        ((localizedRealize f p y).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f))) +
      eval z (s : Poly N) •
        (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)).1
          (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f)) := by
    calc drRealize N (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Poly N) p x) z
        = (realizeSection (op (nvLocus f)) (DeRham.d ℂ (Poly N) p x)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
          (realizeSection_val (op (nvLocus f)) _ ⟨z, hz⟩).symm
      _ = (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Poly N))) y) +
           localizedRealize f (p + 1)
            ((s : Poly N) • DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
          rw [← localizedRealize_locMap, hd, map_add]
      _ = (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Poly N))) y)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ +
          (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
            ((s : Poly N) • DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
          sections_add_val _ _ _
      _ = wedge1 (polyGrad (s : Poly N) z)
            ((localizedRealize f p y).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f))) +
          eval z (s : Poly N) •
            (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)).1
              (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f)) := by
          rw [localizedRealize_wedgeP_val,
            LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealize f (p + 1)) (s : Poly N)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)]
          exact congrArg
            (fun v => wedge1 (polyGrad (s : Poly N) z)
              ((localizedRealize f p y).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f))) + v)
            (polySmul_val (s : Poly N)
              (localizedRealize f (p + 1)
                (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p y)) ⟨z, hz⟩)
  
  have hGval : sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y) z =
      (localizedRealize f p y).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus f)) :=
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz
  have h1 := (hLHS.symm.trans hext).trans hval
  rw [hGval] at h1
  have hkey := add_left_cancel ((add_comm _ _).trans h1)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealize f p y)) z = _
  exact smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsz hkey

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.sectionsRes_val
statement:
theorem sectionsRes_val (p : ℕ) {V U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))}
    (h : V ≤ U) (ω : (omegaSheaf N (FormSpace N p)).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (y : ↥V) :
    (sectionsRes p h ω).1 y = ω.1 ⟨(y : Fin N → ℂ), h y.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left (f g : Poly N) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away (f * g)) f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit
    (S := Localization.Away (f * g)) (f * g)
  rw [map_mul] at h
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.awayToAwayMul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayToAwayMul_algebraMap (f g t : Poly N) :
    awayToAwayMul f g (algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f) t) =
      algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away (f * g)) t
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq f (isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left f g) t

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.crossMulDR_locMap
statement:
theorem crossMulDR_locMap (f g : Poly N) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    crossMulDR f g p (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x) =
      locMap ℂ (Poly N) (f * g) p x
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (awayToAwayMul f g).comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ (Poly N) (Localization.Away f)) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ (Poly N) (Localization.Away (f * g)) :=
    AlgHom.ext fun t => awayToAwayMul_algebraMap f g t
  show DeRham.map (awayToAwayMul f g) p (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x) = _
  rw [locMap_eq_map, locMap_eq_map, ← LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ← DeRham.map_comp, hcomp]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.localizedRealize_mul_compat
statement:
theorem localizedRealize_mul_compat (f g : Poly N) (p : ℕ) :
    (sectionsRes p (nvLocus_mul_le_left f g)).comp (localizedRealize f p) =
      (localizedRealize (f * g) p).comp (crossMulDR f g p)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsLocalizedModule.ext (Submonoid.powers f) (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p)
    (fun s => isUnit_algebraMap_end (fun z hz =>
      eval_pow_ne_zero
        (left_ne_zero_of_mul (by rwa [mem_nvLocus, map_mul] at hz)) s)) ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  show sectionsRes p (nvLocus_mul_le_left f g)
      (localizedRealize f p (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x)) =
    localizedRealize (f * g) p (crossMulDR f g p (locMap ℂ (Poly N) f p x))
  rw [localizedRealize_locMap, crossMulDR_locMap, localizedRealize_locMap]
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun _ => rfl)

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.localizedRealize_mul_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealize_mul_val (f g : Poly N) (p : ℕ)
    (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hz : eval z (f * g) ≠ 0) :
    (localizedRealize f p ξ).1
        ⟨z, left_ne_zero_of_mul (by rwa [map_mul] at hz)⟩ =
      (localizedRealize (f * g) p (crossMulDR f g p ξ)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (localizedRealize_mul_compat f g p) ξ
  exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvLocus (f * g)))

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.dfOpen_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem dfOpen_eq_basicOpen (f : Poly N) :
    dfOpen N f = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f
proof:
:=
  basicOpen_eq_of_affine (R := CommRingCat.of (Poly N)) f

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.modelToZariski_apply
statement:
theorem modelToZariski_apply (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    modelToZariski N z =
      toZariski (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : modelToZariski N z =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N)).toRingHom)
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ) := by
    show toSpace (structMor (Poly N))
      (affineSPointsHomeomorph (Poly N) (modelToAn N z)) = _
    have hmod : modelToAn N z = (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N)) := by
      show (mvPolynomialHomeomorph (Fin N)).symm z = _
      rfl
    rw [hmod]
    rfl
  rw [h1, Spec.map_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  refine PrimeSpectrum.ext ?_
  show Ideal.comap _ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ).asIdeal = RingHom.ker _
  rw [show (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ).asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℂ
      from rfl,
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot]
  exact (RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot _).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.aeval_apply_eq_eval
statement:
theorem aeval_apply_eq_eval (z : Fin N → ℂ) (f : Poly N) :
    (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N)) f = eval z f
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N)) f =
      MvPolynomial.aeval z f from rfl,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self, MvPolynomial.eval₂_id]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen
statement:
theorem modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen (f : Poly N) (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    modelToZariski N z ∈ dfOpen N f ↔ eval z f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h5 : (toZariski (MvPolynomial.aeval z : CPoints (Poly N)) ∈
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ↔ eval z f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [HodgePilot.Analytic.mem_basicOpen_toZariski, aeval_apply_eq_eval]
  rw [dfOpen_eq_basicOpen, modelToZariski_apply]
  exact h5

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.dfOpen_mul_le_left
statement:
theorem dfOpen_mul_le_left (f g : Poly N) :
    dfOpen N (f * g) ≤ dfOpen N f
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul]
    exact inf_le_left
  rw [dfOpen_eq_basicOpen, dfOpen_eq_basicOpen]
  exact h2

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.exists_dfOpen_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs, hsW⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      hξ W.isOpen
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [dfOpen_eq_basicOpen]
    exact hxs
  · intro ζ hζ
    rw [dfOpen_eq_basicOpen] at hζ
    exact hsW hζ

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secToLoc_res
statement:
theorem secToLoc_res (f : Poly N) (t : Sec (φPoly N) ⊤) :
    secToLoc N f (res (φPoly N)
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t) =
      algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).hom t)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Sec (φPoly N) ⊤) (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) :=
    resAlgebra (φPoly N)
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f))
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (polyToSec N f)
      (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) :=
    isLocalization_away (φPoly N)
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))))
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)
  show secToLoc N f
      (algebraMap (Sec (φPoly N) ⊤) (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) t) = _
  exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (polyToSec N f) _ t

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.φPoly_eq
statement:
theorem φPoly_eq (c : ℂ) :
    φPoly N c = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv
      (algebraMap ℂ (Poly N) c)
proof:
:= by
  show ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Poly N)))).appTop).hom c = _
  rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secToLoc_res_mul
statement:
theorem secToLoc_res_mul (f g : Poly N) :
    (secToLoc N (f * g)).comp
        (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g)).toRingHom =
      ((awayToAwayMul f g : Localization.Away f →ₐ[ℂ]
          Localization.Away (f * g)) :
        Localization.Away f →+* Localization.Away (f * g)).comp
        (secToLoc N f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Sec (φPoly N) ⊤) (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) :=
    resAlgebra (φPoly N)
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f))
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (polyToSec N f)
      (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) :=
    isLocalization_away (φPoly N)
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))))
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)
  refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (polyToSec N f)) ?_
  refine RingHom.ext fun t => ?_
  show secToLoc N (f * g) (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g)
      (res (φPoly N) ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t)) =
    awayToAwayMul f g (secToLoc N f
      (res (φPoly N) ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t))
  calc secToLoc N (f * g) (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g)
      (res (φPoly N) ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t))
      = secToLoc N (f * g) (res (φPoly N)
          ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv (f * g))) t) :=
        congrArg (secToLoc N (f * g)) (res_res (φPoly N)
          (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g)
          ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t)
    _ = algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away (f * g))
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).hom t) :=
        secToLoc_res N (f * g) t
    _ = awayToAwayMul f g (algebraMap (Poly N) (Localization.Away f)
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).hom t)) :=
        (awayToAwayMul_algebraMap f g _).symm
    _ = awayToAwayMul f g (secToLoc N f
          (res (φPoly N) ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).basicOpen_le
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).inv f)) t)) :=
        congrArg (awayToAwayMul f g) (secToLoc_res N f t).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secToLocA_res_mul
statement:
theorem secToLocA_res_mul (f g : Poly N) :
    (awayToAwayMul f g).comp (secToLocA N f) =
      (secToLocA N (f * g)).comp
        (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g))
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun t => (RingHom.congr_fun (secToLoc_res_mul N f g) t).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.basicSec_congr_poly
statement:
theorem basicSec_congr_poly {f₁ f₂ : Poly N} (hf : f₁ = f₂) (p : ℕ)
    {W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens}
    (h₁ : dfOpen N f₁ ≤ W) (h₂ : dfOpen N f₂ ≤ W)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hz₁ : eval z f₁ ≠ 0) (hz₂ : eval z f₂ ≠ 0) :
    (basicSec N f₁ p h₁ x).1 ⟨z, hz₁⟩ = (basicSec N f₂ p h₂ x).1 ⟨z, hz₂⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.basicSec_mul
statement:
theorem basicSec_mul (f g : Poly N) (p : ℕ)
    {W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens} (hf : dfOpen N f ≤ W)
    (hfg : dfOpen N (f * g) ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p)
    (z : Fin N → ℂ) (hz : eval z (f * g) ≠ 0) :
    (basicSec N f p hf x).1
        ⟨z, left_ne_zero_of_mul (by rwa [map_mul] at hz)⟩ =
      (basicSec N (f * g) p hfg x).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : crossMulDR f g p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x)) =
      DeRham.map (secToLocA N (f * g)) p
        (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hfg) p x) := by
    calc crossMulDR f g p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
        (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x))
        = DeRham.map ((awayToAwayMul f g).comp (secToLocA N f)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x) :=
          (LinearMap.congr_fun
            (DeRham.map_comp (secToLocA N f) (awayToAwayMul f g) p) _).symm
      _ = DeRham.map ((secToLocA N (f * g)).comp
            (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g))) p
            (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x) := by
          rw [secToLocA_res_mul]
      _ = DeRham.map (secToLocA N (f * g)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g)) p
              (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x)) :=
          LinearMap.congr_fun (DeRham.map_comp
            (res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g))
            (secToLocA N (f * g)) p) _
      _ = DeRham.map (secToLocA N (f * g)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hfg) p x) :=
          congrArg (DeRham.map (secToLocA N (f * g)) p)
            (map_res_map_res (φPoly N) (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f g) hf p x)
  have h1 := localizedRealize_mul_val f g p
    (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hf) p x)) z hz
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secVal_spec
proof:
:= by
  have hgs := Classical.choose_spec (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)
  have hzg : eval z (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) ≠ 0 :=
    (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N _ z).mp hgs.1
  have hzf : eval z f ≠ 0 := (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f z).mp h1
  have hzgf : eval z (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz) * f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hzg hzf
  have hzfg : eval z (f * Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hzf hzg
  have hgf_le : dfOpen N (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz) * f) ≤ W :=
    (dfOpen_mul_le_left N _ f).trans hgs.2
  have hfg_le : dfOpen N (f * Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) ≤ W :=
    (dfOpen_mul_le_left N f _).trans h2
  have e1 := basicSec_mul N (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) f p
    hgs.2 hgf_le x z hzgf
  have e2 := basicSec_mul N f (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) p
    h2 hfg_le x z hzfg
  exact e1.trans ((basicSec_congr_poly N
    (mul_comm (Classical.choose (exists_dfOpen_le N hz)) f) p
    hgf_le hfg_le x z hzgf hzfg).trans e2.symm)

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secValExt_eq_on
statement:
theorem secValExt_eq_on (p : ℕ) {W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens}
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) {f : Poly N} (h2 : dfOpen N f ≤ W) :
    ∀ w ∈ nvLocus f, secValExt N p x w =
      sectionExtendV (basicSec N f p h2 x) w
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  have hπw : modelToZariski N w ∈ dfOpen N f :=
    (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f w).mpr hw
  have hWw : modelToZariski N w ∈ W := h2 hπw
  show (if hz : modelToZariski N w ∈ W then secVal N p x w hz else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos hWw, secVal_spec N p x hWw f hπw h2,
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (basicSec N f p h2 x) hw]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.analyticOnNhd_secValExt
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_secValExt (p : ℕ)
    {W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens}
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (secValExt N p x)
      (((Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).obj W : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ))) :
        Set (Fin N → ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro z₀ hz₀
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_dfOpen_le N (show modelToZariski N z₀ ∈ W from hz₀)
  have hz₀f : z₀ ∈ nvLocus f := (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f z₀).mp h1
  refine (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (basicSec N f p h2 x) z₀ hz₀f).congr ?_
  refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvLocus f).isOpen.mem_nhds hz₀f)
    (fun w hw => ?_)
  exact (secValExt_eq_on N p x h2 w hw).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secRealize_val
statement:
theorem secRealize_val (p : ℕ) (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p)
    (y : ↥((Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).obj W)) :
    (secRealize N p W x).1 y =
      secVal N p x (y : Fin N → ℂ) y.2
proof:
:= by
  show (if hz : modelToZariski N ↑y ∈ W then secVal N p x ↑y hz else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secVal_add
statement:
theorem secVal_add (p : ℕ) {W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens}
    (x x' : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hz : modelToZariski N z ∈ W) :
    secVal N p (x + x') z hz = secVal N p x z hz + secVal N p x' z hz
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_dfOpen_le N hz
  rw [secVal_spec N p (x + x') hz f h1 h2, secVal_spec N p x hz f h1 h2,
    secVal_spec N p x' hz f h1 h2]
  rw [show basicSec N f p h2 (x + x') =
      basicSec N f p h2 x + basicSec N f p h2 x' from by
    show localizedRealize f p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
        (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p (x + x'))) = _
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
    rfl]
  exact sections_add_val _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secVal_res
statement:
theorem secVal_res (p : ℕ) {V W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens}
    (hVW : V ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hzV : modelToZariski N z ∈ V) :
    secVal N p (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hVW) p x) z hzV =
      secVal N p x z (hVW hzV)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_dfOpen_le N hzV
  rw [secVal_spec N p (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hVW) p x) hzV f h1 h2,
    secVal_spec N p x (hVW hzV) f h1 (h2.trans hVW)]
  show (localizedRealize f p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p
        (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) hVW) p x)))).1 _ =
    (localizedRealize f p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) (h2.trans hVW)) p x))).1 _
  rw [map_res_map_res]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.secRealize_d
statement:
theorem secRealize_d (p : ℕ) (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N))).Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p) :
    dSection (secRealize N p W x) =
      secRealize N (p + 1) W (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun ypt => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ypt
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_dfOpen_le N (show modelToZariski N z ∈ W from hz)
  have hzf : z ∈ nvLocus f := (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f z).mp h1
  have hsub : ∀ w ∈ nvLocus f, w ∈ (Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).obj W :=
    fun w hw => h2 ((modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f w).mpr hw)
  
  have hev : sectionExtendV (secRealize N p W x) =ᶠ[nhds z]
      sectionExtendV (basicSec N f p h2 x) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvLocus f).isOpen.mem_nhds hzf)
      (fun w hw => ?_)
    rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (secRealize N p W x) (hsub w hw),
      sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (basicSec N f p h2 x) hw, secRealize_val]
    have hπw : modelToZariski N w ∈ dfOpen N f :=
      (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f w).mpr hw
    exact secVal_spec N p x (hsub w hw) f hπw h2
  
  have hds : dSection (basicSec N f p h2 x) =
      basicSec N f (p + 1) h2 (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x) := by
    show dSection (localizedRealize f p (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p x))) = _
    rw [dSection_localizedRealize]
    have e1 : DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) p (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p x)) =
        DeRham.map (secToLocA N f) (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p x)) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_map (secToLocA N f) p) _
    have e2 : DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) (dfOpen N f)) p
        (DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) p x) =
        DeRham.map (res (φPoly N) h2) (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_map (res (φPoly N) h2) p) x
    rw [e1, e2]
    rfl
  
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (secRealize N p W x)) z = _
  rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
  have hL : extDeriv (sectionExtendV (basicSec N f p h2 x)) z =
      (basicSec N f (p + 1) h2 (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x)).1
        ⟨z, hzf⟩ := by
    calc extDeriv (sectionExtendV (basicSec N f p h2 x)) z
        = (dSection (basicSec N f p h2 x)).1 ⟨z, hzf⟩ := rfl
      _ = (basicSec N f (p + 1) h2
            (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x)).1 ⟨z, hzf⟩ := by rw [hds]
  rw [hL, secRealize_val]
  have hπz : modelToZariski N z ∈ dfOpen N f :=
    (modelToZariski_mem_dfOpen N f z).mpr hzf
  exact (secVal_spec N (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) W) p x) hz f
    hπz h2).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.locComparisonPresheaf_square
statement:
theorem locComparisonPresheaf_square (p : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (dOpens (φPoly N) p)
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{0} ℂ) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ≫
        locComparisonPresheaf N (p + 1) =
      locComparisonPresheaf N p ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (Opens.map (modelToZariski N)).op
          (dPresheafAb N p)
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show (secRealize N (p + 1) (unop U)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (φPoly N) (unop U)) p x)).1 y =
    (dSection (secRealize N p (unop U) x)).1 y
  exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val
    (secRealize_d N p (unop U) x).symm) y

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.locComparisonSite_square
statement:
theorem locComparisonSite_square (p : ℕ) :
    dSheafAb (φPoly N) p ≫ locComparisonSite N (p + 1) =
      locComparisonSite N p ≫
        (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.sheafEquiv
            (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N)))
            (A := AddCommGrpCat.{0})).inverse.map
          ((pushforwardAb (modelToZariski N)).map (dSheafForms N p))
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  have h := congrArg
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Poly N)))).op)
    (locComparisonPresheaf_square N p)
  rw [Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonLocalize.isHodgeClassAnDR_def
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassAnDR_def (p : ℕ)
    (c : bettiQ (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)) (2 * p)) :
    IsHodgeClassAnDR N p c ↔
      HodgePredicateAn.uLegAn N (2 * p) c ∈
        (dRSpaceFiltration (Poly N) (p : ℤ) ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
          (junctionDR N ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.sPointEval_apply
statement:
theorem sPointEval_apply (pt : SPoints sX) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    sPointEval pt b = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).hom (pt.1.appTop b)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.sPointEval_probe
statement:
theorem sPointEval_probe (c : Chart sX) (φ : CPoints c.A) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    sPointEval (probe sX c.hom c.over φ) b = φ (chartRingMap c b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sPointEval_apply]
  have h1 : (probe sX c.hom c.over φ).1.appTop b =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop (c.hom.appTop b) := by
    rw [probe_coe]
    rfl
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
  have h3 := congrArg
    (fun g : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of c.A), ⊤) ⟶ CommRingCat.of ℂ =>
      g (c.hom.appTop b)) h2
  exact h3

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff
statement:
theorem toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff (pt : SPoints sX) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    toSpace sX pt ∈ X.basicOpen f ↔ sPointEval pt f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).hom (pt.1.appTop f)) ↔
      sPointEval pt f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen,
      show (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ).asIdeal = ⊥ from IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot]
    exact not_congr (Ideal.mem_bot)
  have h0 : toSpace sX pt ∈ X.basicOpen f ↔
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ ∈ pt.1 ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f := Iff.rfl
  have h2 : pt.1 ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).hom (pt.1.appTop f)) :=
    (Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top pt.1 f).trans (basicOpen_eq_of_affine' _)
  have h6 : (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ ∈ pt.1 ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f) =
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).hom (pt.1.appTop f))) :=
    congrArg (fun V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).Opens =>
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ ∈ V) h2
  exact (h0.trans (Iff.of_eq h6)).trans h3

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.mem_pullbackOpen
statement:
theorem mem_pullbackOpen (pt : SPoints sX) (W : X.Opens) :
    pt ∈ (Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W ↔ toSpace sX pt ∈ W
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_apply
statement:
theorem chartEv_apply (c : GluedChart sX d) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) : chartEv c b y = sPointEval (c.1.symm y) b
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_add
statement:
theorem chartEv_add (c : GluedChart sX d) (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) : chartEv c (a + b) y = chartEv c a y + chartEv c b y
proof:
:=
  map_add (sPointEval (c.1.symm y)) a b

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_mul
statement:
theorem chartEv_mul (c : GluedChart sX d) (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) : chartEv c (a * b) y = chartEv c a y * chartEv c b y
proof:
:=
  map_mul (sPointEval (c.1.symm y)) a b

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_one
statement:
theorem chartEv_one (c : GluedChart sX d) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartEv c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) y = 1
proof:
:=
  map_one (sPointEval (c.1.symm y))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_pow
statement:
theorem chartEv_pow (c : GluedChart sX d) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (k : ℕ)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) : chartEv c (b ^ k) y = chartEv c b y ^ k
proof:
:=
  map_pow (sPointEval (c.1.symm y)) b k

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartEv_algebraMap (c : GluedChart sX d) (z : ℂ) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartEv c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z) y = z
proof:
:= by
  show sPointEval (c.1.symm y) (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z) = z
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_eq
statement:
theorem chartEv_eq (c : GluedChart sX d) (P : SPatch sX d) (hP : c.1 = glueChart P)
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    chartEv c b = fun y =>
      (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y (chartRingMap P.chart b)
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  show sPointEval (c.1.symm y) b = _
  rw [hP, glueChart_symm_apply, sPointEval_probe]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.analyticAt_chartEv
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEv (c : GluedChart sX d) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ} (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ c.1.target) : AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEv c b) y₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := c.2
  rw [chartEv_eq c P hP b]
  rw [hP, glueChart_target] at hy₀
  exact analyticAt_patchChart_symm_apply P.patch P.center P.ne_zero _ hy₀

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_transition
statement:
theorem chartEv_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    chartEv c₂ b y = chartEv c₁ b ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  show sPointEval (c₂.1.symm y) b = sPointEval (c₁.1.symm (c₁.1 (c₂.1.symm y))) b
  rw [c₁.1.left_inv hsrc]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.mem_nvChart
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.nvChart_target
statement:
theorem nvChart_target {c : GluedChart sX d} {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤}
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c f) : y ∈ c.1.target

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.nvChart_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nvChart_ne_zero {c : GluedChart sX d} {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤}
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c f) : chartEv c f y ≠ 0

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.nvChart_mul_le_left
statement:
theorem nvChart_mul_le_left (c : GluedChart sX d) (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    nvChart c (f * g) ≤ nvChart c f
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨hyt, hyfg⟩
  refine ⟨hyt, ?_⟩
  rw [chartEv_mul] at hyfg
  exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hyfg

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartEv_powers_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
  rw [← hk, chartEv_pow]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ hy

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartSmul_val
statement:
theorem chartSmul_val {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d} {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤}
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f)))
    (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (s • ω).1 y = chartEv c s (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show chartEv c s (↑y) • sectionExtendV ω ↑y = chartEv c s (↑y) • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.sections_add_val
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.sections_sub_val
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.invChartSMulSection_val
statement:
theorem invChartSMulSection_val {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChart c f, chartEv c g z ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f)))
    (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (invChartSMulSection g hg ω).1 y =
      (chartEv c g (↑y : Fin d → ℂ))⁻¹ • ω.1 y
proof:
:= by
  show (chartEv c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV ω ↑y = (chartEv c g ↑y)⁻¹ • ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.invChart_smul_cancel
statement:
theorem invChart_smul_cancel {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChart c f, chartEv c g z ≠ 0)
    (ω : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))) :
    invChartSMulSection g hg (g • ω) = ω
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show (chartEv c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV (g • ω) ↑y = ω.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (g • ω) y.2]
  show (chartEv c g ↑y)⁻¹ • (chartEv c g ↑y • sectionExtendV ω ↑y) = ω.1 y
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2), sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem ω y.2]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.smul_invChart_cancel
statement:
theorem smul_invChart_cancel {p : ℕ} {c : GluedChart sX d}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ nvChart c f, chartEv c g z ≠ 0)
    (η : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))) :
    g • invChartSMulSection g hg η = η
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show chartEv c g ↑y • sectionExtendV (invChartSMulSection g hg η) ↑y = η.1 y
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (invChartSMulSection g hg η) y.2]
  show chartEv c g ↑y • ((chartEv c g ↑y)⁻¹ • sectionExtendV η ↑y) = η.1 y
  rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hg (↑y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2), sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem η y.2]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.isUnit_algebraMap_end_chart
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ω η h
    have h3 : g • ω = g • η := h
    calc ω = invChartSMulSection g hg (g • ω) := (invChart_smul_cancel g hg ω).symm
      _ = invChartSMulSection g hg (g • η) := by rw [h3]
      _ = η := invChart_smul_cancel g hg η
  · intro η
    exact ⟨invChartSMulSection g hg η, smul_invChart_cancel g hg η⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartGrad_add
statement:
theorem chartGrad_add (c : GluedChart sX d) (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    chartGrad c (a + b) y = chartGrad c a y + chartGrad c b y
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartEv c (a + b) = fun z => chartEv c a z + chartEv c b z :=
    funext fun z => chartEv_add c a b z
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEv c (a + b)) y = _
  rw [h, fderiv_fun_add (analyticAt_chartEv c a hy).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_chartEv c b hy).differentiableAt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartGrad_mul
statement:
theorem chartGrad_mul (c : GluedChart sX d) (a b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    chartGrad c (a * b) y =
      chartEv c a y • chartGrad c b y + chartEv c b y • chartGrad c a y
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartEv c (a * b) = fun z => chartEv c a z * chartEv c b z :=
    funext fun z => chartEv_mul c a b z
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEv c (a * b)) y = _
  rw [h, fderiv_fun_mul (analyticAt_chartEv c a hy).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_chartEv c b hy).differentiableAt]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartGrad_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartGrad_algebraMap (c : GluedChart sX d) (z : ℂ) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartGrad c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartEv c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z) = fun _ => z :=
    funext fun w => chartEv_algebraMap c z w
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEv c (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z)) y = 0
  rw [h]
  exact fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℂ) z

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartAlgForm_apply
statement:
theorem chartAlgForm_apply {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    chartAlgForm c s t y = chartEv c s y • formOfTuple (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.analyticAt_chartEvalPi
statement:
theorem analyticAt_chartEvalPi {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (chartEvalPi c u) y
proof:
:=
  AnalyticAt.pi fun k => analyticAt_chartEv c (u k) hy

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPi
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPi {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    HasFDerivAt (chartEvalPi c u)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => chartGrad c (u k) y) y
proof:
:=
  hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun k =>
    (analyticAt_chartEv c (u k) hy).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.fderiv_chartEvalPi
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartEvalPi {q : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (u : Fin q → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c u) y =
      ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => chartGrad c (u k) y
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_chartEvalPi c u hy).fderiv

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartAlgForm_eq_pullback_at
statement:
theorem chartAlgForm_eq_pullback_at {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    chartAlgForm c s t y =
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t)) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAlgForm_apply, coeffForm, smul_compContinuousLinearMap, tailProjForm,
    formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap, fderiv_chartEvalPi c _ hy]
  congr 1

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.analyticOnNhd_chartAlgForm
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_chartAlgForm {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (chartAlgForm c s t) c.1.target
proof:
:= by
  have hτ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t)) c.1.target :=
    fun y hy => analyticAt_chartEvalPi c _ hy
  have hτd : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t))) c.1.target :=
    hτ.fderiv_of_isOpen c.1.open_target
  refine PolydiscPoincare.analyticOnNhd_of_differentiableOn c.1.open_target ?_
  intro y hy
  have hev : chartAlgForm c s t =ᶠ[nhds y] fun z =>
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t)) z) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (c.1.open_target.mem_nhds hy)
      (fun z hz => chartAlgForm_eq_pullback_at c s t hz)
  have h0 : (fun z => coeffForm p (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z)) = fun z =>
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z) • tailProjForm p :=
    rfl
  have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (fun z => coeffForm p (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z)) y := by
    rw [h0]
    have h2 : (fun z => (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z)) = chartEv c s :=
      rfl
    refine DifferentiableAt.smul_const ?_ (tailProjForm p)
    rw [h2]
    exact (analyticAt_chartEv c s hy).differentiableAt
  have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z =>
      (coeffForm p (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) z)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t)) z)) y :=
    h1.continuousAlternatingMapCompContinuousLinearMap ((hτd y hy).differentiableAt)
  exact (h3.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartAlgFormSec_val
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormSec_val {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (chartAlgFormSec c f t s).1 y = chartAlgForm c s t ↑y
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.preRealizeChart_single
statement:
theorem preRealizeChart_single {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    preRealizeChart c f p (Finsupp.single t s) = chartAlgFormSec c f t s
proof:
:= by
  rw [preRealizeChart, Finsupp.lsum_single]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartGrad_comp_update
statement:
theorem chartGrad_comp_update {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (i : Fin p) (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (fun j => chartGrad c (Function.update t i b j) y) =
      Function.update (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) y) i (chartGrad c b y)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
  · rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji, Function.update_of_ne hji]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.preRealizeChart_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet
statement:
theorem preRealizeChart_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) {w : DRFree (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p}
    (hw : w ∈ relSet ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p) :
    preRealizeChart c f p w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealizeChart_single, preRealizeChart_single,
      preRealizeChart_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [sections_sub_val, sections_add_val, chartAlgFormSec_val,
      chartAlgFormSec_val, chartAlgFormSec_val]
    show chartAlgForm c 1 (Function.update t i x) ↑z +
        chartAlgForm c 1 (Function.update t i y) ↑z -
        chartAlgForm c 1 (Function.update t i (x + y)) ↑z = (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]
    rw [chartGrad_comp_update, chartGrad_comp_update, chartGrad_comp_update,
      chartGrad_add c x y (nvChart_target z.2),
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartGrad c x ↑z) (chartGrad c y ↑z), sub_self]
    rfl
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealizeChart_single, preRealizeChart_single,
      preRealizeChart_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [sections_sub_val, sections_add_val, chartAlgFormSec_val,
      chartAlgFormSec_val, chartAlgFormSec_val]
    show chartAlgForm c x (Function.update t i y) ↑z +
        chartAlgForm c y (Function.update t i x) ↑z -
        chartAlgForm c 1 (Function.update t i (x * y)) ↑z = (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]
    rw [chartGrad_comp_update, chartGrad_comp_update, chartGrad_comp_update,
      chartGrad_mul c x y (nvChart_target z.2),
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑z) i
        (chartEv c x ↑z • chartGrad c y ↑z) (chartEv c y ↑z • chartGrad c x ↑z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑z) i (chartEv c x ↑z)
        (chartGrad c y ↑z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑z) i (chartEv c y ↑z)
        (chartGrad c x ↑z), sub_self]
    rfl
  · 
    rw [preRealizeChart_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [chartAlgFormSec_val]
    show chartAlgForm c 1 (Function.update t i (algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) a)) ↑z = (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]
    rw [chartGrad_comp_update, chartGrad_algebraMap]
    have h := formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑z) i 0 0
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact left_eq_add.mp h
  · 
    rw [preRealizeChart_single]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
    rw [chartAlgFormSec_val]
    show chartAlgForm c 1 t ↑z = (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))).1 z
    simp only [chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]
    exact formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_eq (fun k => chartGrad c (t k) ↑z) i j
      (congrArg (fun b => chartGrad c b ↑z) htij) hij

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.rel_le_ker_preRealizeChart
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_preRealizeChart (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) :
    rel ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p ≤ LinearMap.ker (preRealizeChart c f p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  intro w hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  exact preRealizeChart_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet c f hw

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_mk
statement:
theorem chartRealize_mk {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (w : DRFree (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p) :
    chartRealize c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk w) = preRealizeChart c f p w
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_mk_single
statement:
theorem chartRealize_mk_single {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (chartRealize c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s))).1 y =
      chartAlgForm c s t ↑y
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartRealize_mk, preRealizeChart_single, chartAlgFormSec_val]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_gen
statement:
theorem chartRealize_gen {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (chartRealize c f p (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) t)).1 y =
      formOfTuple (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, chartRealize_mk_single, chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.extDeriv_chartAlgForm_at
statement:
theorem extDeriv_chartAlgForm_at {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ c.1.target) :
    extDeriv (chartAlgForm c s t) y = chartAlgForm c 1 (Fin.cons s t) y
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartAlgForm c s t =ᶠ[nhds y] fun x =>
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
          (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) x) •
        tailProjForm p).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t)) x) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (c.1.open_target.mem_nhds hy)
      (fun z hz => chartAlgForm_eq_pullback_at c s t hz)
  rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
  rw [extDeriv_pullback (𝕜 := ℂ) (r := minSmoothness ℂ 2)
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).differentiableAt).smul_const (tailProjForm p))
    ((analyticAt_chartEvalPi c (Fin.cons s t) hy).contDiffAt) le_rfl]
  rw [extDeriv_coeffForm, formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap,
    fderiv_chartEvalPi c _ hy, chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun k => ?_)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_pi]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.dSection_chartRealize
statement:
theorem dSection_chartRealize (c : GluedChart sX d) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p) :
    dSection (chartRealize c f p x) =
      chartRealize c f (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
      have heq : sectionExtendV
          (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f))) =
          fun _ => (0 : FormSpace d p) :=
        funext fun z => sectionExtendV_zero z
      show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
        (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj (op (nvChart c f)))) ↑y =
        (0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d (p + 1))).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChart c f))).1 y
      rw [heq]
      exact extDeriv_const_eq_zero _ _
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, dSection_add,
        hu, hv]
  | single t s =>
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
      have hev : sectionExtendV
          (chartRealize c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)))
          =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin d → ℂ)] chartAlgForm c s t := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvChart c f).isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
          (fun z hz => ?_)
        rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz]
        exact chartRealize_mk_single c f t s ⟨z, hz⟩
      show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
        (chartRealize c f p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)))) ↑y = _
      rw [hev.extDeriv_eq,
        extDeriv_chartAlgForm_at c s t (nvChart_target y.2), d_mk_single,
        chartRealize_gen, chartAlgForm_apply, chartEv_one, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_locMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedRealizeChart_locMap (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p) :
    localizedRealizeChart c f p (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p x) =
      chartRealize c f p x
proof:
:=
  IsLocalizedModule.lift_apply (Submonoid.powers f)
    (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p) (chartRealize c f p) _ x

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ)
    {ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p} {b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤}
    {x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p}
    (h : b • ξ = locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p x) (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    chartEv c b ↑y • (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 y =
      (chartRealize c f p x).1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : b • localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ = chartRealize c f p x :=
    ((LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealizeChart c f p) b ξ).symm.trans
      (congrArg (localizedRealizeChart c f p) h)).trans
      (localizedRealizeChart_locMap c f p x)
  calc chartEv c b ↑y • (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 y
      = (b • localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 y :=
        (chartSmul_val b (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ) y).symm
    _ = (chartRealize c f p x).1 y := by rw [h1]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.locMap_wedgeP_gen
statement:
theorem locMap_wedgeP_gen {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] [Algebra ℂ B'] (f : B')
    (p : ℕ) (g : B') (z : DR ℂ B' p) :
    wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap B' (Localization.Away f) g))
        (locMap ℂ B' f p z) =
      locMap ℂ B' f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ B' p (gen ℂ B' (fun _ => g)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, hu, hv, map_add,
        map_add]
  | single t s =>
      rw [locMap_mk_single,
        show gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap B' (Localization.Away f) g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single
            (fun _ : Fin 1 => algebraMap B' (Localization.Away f) g) 1)
          from rfl,
        show gen ℂ B' (fun _ => g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) 1)
          from rfl,
        wedgeP_mk_single, wedgeP_mk_single, one_mul, one_mul, map_smul,
        locMap_gen, algebraMap_smul]
      refine congrArg (fun w => s • w)
        (congrArg (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)) (funext fun j => ?_))
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
      | succ i => rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_wedgeP_val
statement:
theorem chartRealize_wedgeP_val (c : GluedChart sX d) (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (p : ℕ) (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (z : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p)
    (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (chartRealize c f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p
          (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (fun _ => g)) z)).1 y =
      wedge1 (chartGrad c g ↑y) ((chartRealize c f p z).1 y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      rw [show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChart c f))).1 y) = 0 from rfl,
        show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d (p + 1))).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChart c f))).1 y) = 0 from rfl, wedge1_zero_right]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add,
        sections_add_val, sections_add_val, hu, hv, wedge1_add_right]
  | single t s =>
      rw [show gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (fun _ => g) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) 1)
          from rfl, wedgeP_mk_single, one_mul, ← mk_single_eq_smul_gen,
        chartRealize_mk_single, chartRealize_mk_single, chartAlgForm_apply,
        chartAlgForm_apply]
      have hc : (fun j => chartGrad c
          (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) g t j) ↑y) =
          Fin.cons (chartGrad c g ↑y) (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑y) := by
        funext j
        induction j using Fin.cases with
        | zero => rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
        | succ i => rw [Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      rw [show formOfTuple
            (fun j => chartGrad c
              (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) g t j) ↑y) =
          formOfTuple (Fin.cons (chartGrad c g ↑y)
            (fun j => chartGrad c (t j) ↑y))
          from congrArg formOfTuple hc,
        formOfTuple_cons, wedge1_smul_right]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_wedgeP_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChart_wedgeP_val (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (y : ↥(nvChart c f)) :
    (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
          (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) g))
          ξ)).1 y =
      wedge1 (chartGrad c g ↑y) ((localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p ξ
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  have hsy : chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) ↑y ≠ 0 :=
    chartEv_powers_ne_zero (nvChart_ne_zero y.2) s
  have hclear : (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) •
      (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) g))
        ξ) =
      locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f (p + 1)
        (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p
          (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (fun _ => g)) x) := by
    calc (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) •
        (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
          (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
            (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) g))
          ξ)
        = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) g))
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) • ξ) := by
          rw [← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
              (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
                (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                  (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
                    (Localization.Away f) g)) ξ),
            ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) ξ,
            map_smul]
      _ = wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
            (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
              (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) g))
            (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p x) := by rw [hs]
      _ = locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p
              (gen ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (fun _ => g)) x) :=
          locMap_wedgeP_gen f p g x
  have h1 := localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap c f (p + 1) hclear y
  rw [chartRealize_wedgeP_val] at h1
  have h2 := localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap c f p hs y
  rw [← h2, wedge1_smul_right] at h1
  exact ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsy h1

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.dSection_localizedRealizeChart
statement:
theorem dSection_localizedRealizeChart (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) :
    dSection (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ) =
      localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p ξ
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun ypt => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ypt
  have hsz : chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z ≠ 0 :=
    chartEv_powers_ne_zero (nvChart_ne_zero hz) s
  
  have hev : ((fun w => chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ))
      =ᶠ[nhds z] sectionExtendV (chartRealize c f p x) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvChart c f).isOpen.mem_nhds hz)
      (fun w hw => ?_)
    show chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ) w = _
    rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hw]
    exact localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap c f p hs ⟨w, hw⟩
  
  have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun w => chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w)
      (chartGrad c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z) z :=
    (analyticAt_chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
      (nvChart_target hz)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ))
      (fderiv ℂ (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z) z :=
    ((analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ))
      z hz).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hprod := hder.smul hG
