  have hLHS : extDeriv ((fun w => chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z =
      chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z •
        extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z +
      wedge1 (chartGrad c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z)
        (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ) z) := by
    show ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin
      (fderiv ℂ ((fun w => chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w) •
        sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z) = _
    rw [hprod.fderiv, ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_add,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_smul]
    rfl
  
  have hext : extDeriv ((fun w => chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) w) •
      sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z =
      (chartRealize c f (p + 1)
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
    rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
    show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (chartRealize c f p x))
      ↑(⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f)) = _
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val (dSection_chartRealize c f p x))
      (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f))
  
  have hd : locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f (p + 1)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p x) =
      wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
          (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f)
            (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤))) ξ +
      (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) • DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ := by
    rw [← d_locMap, ← hs,
      ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away f) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) ξ,
      ComparisonLocalize.d_smul_wedgeP, algebraMap_smul]
  have hval : (chartRealize c f (p + 1)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ =
      wedge1 (chartGrad c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z)
        ((localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f))) +
      chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z •
        (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
          (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f)) := by
    calc (chartRealize c f (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p x)).1
          ⟨z, hz⟩
        = (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤))) ξ) +
           localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) •
              DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
          rw [← localizedRealizeChart_locMap c f (p + 1), hd, map_add]
      _ = (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
            (wedgeP ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
              (gen ℂ (Localization.Away f)
                (fun _ => algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f)
                  (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤))) ξ)).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ +
          (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
            ((s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) •
              DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
            ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
          sections_add_val _ _ _
      _ = wedge1 (chartGrad c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z)
            ((localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f))) +
          chartEv c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z •
            (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)).1
              (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f)) := by
          rw [localizedRealizeChart_wedgeP_val,
            LinearMap.map_smul (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1))
              (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
              (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)]
          exact congrArg
            (fun v => wedge1 (chartGrad c (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) z)
              ((localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1
                (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f))) + v)
            (chartSmul_val (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
              (localizedRealizeChart c f (p + 1)
                (DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p ξ)) ⟨z, hz⟩)
  
  have hGval : sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ) z =
      (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1 (⟨z, hz⟩ : ↥(nvChart c f)) :=
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz
  have h1 := (hLHS.symm.trans hext).trans hval
  rw [hGval] at h1
  have hkey := add_left_cancel ((add_comm _ _).trans h1)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ)) z = _
  exact ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsz hkey

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] (f g : B') :
    IsUnit (algebraMap B' (Localization.Away (f * g)) f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit
    (S := Localization.Away (f * g)) (f * g)
  rw [map_mul] at h
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.awayMulHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayMulHom_algebraMap {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] [Algebra ℂ B']
    (f g t : B') :
    awayMulHom f g (algebraMap B' (Localization.Away f) t) =
      algebraMap B' (Localization.Away (f * g)) t
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq f (isUnit_algebraMap_away_mul_left f g) t

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.crossMulDRSec_locMap
statement:
theorem crossMulDRSec_locMap {B' : Type} [CommRing B'] [Algebra ℂ B']
    (f g : B') (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ B' p) :
    crossMulDRSec f g p (locMap ℂ B' f p x) = locMap ℂ B' (f * g) p x
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (awayMulHom f g).comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ B' (Localization.Away f)) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ B' (Localization.Away (f * g)) :=
    AlgHom.ext fun t => awayMulHom_algebraMap f g t
  show DeRham.map (awayMulHom f g) p (locMap ℂ B' f p x) = _
  rw [locMap_eq_map, locMap_eq_map, ← LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ← DeRham.map_comp, hcomp]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_mul_val
statement:
theorem chartRealize_mul_val (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p)
    (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : z ∈ nvChart c (f * g)) :
    (chartRealize c f p x).1 ⟨z, nvChart_mul_le_left c f g hz⟩ =
      (chartRealize c (f * g) p x).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, sections_add_val,
        sections_add_val, hu, hv]
  | single t s => rw [chartRealize_mk_single, chartRealize_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_mul_compat
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChart_mul_compat (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) :
    (sectionsResChart p c f g).comp (localizedRealizeChart c f p) =
      (localizedRealizeChart c (f * g) p).comp (crossMulDRSec f g p)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsLocalizedModule.ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p)
    (fun s => isUnit_algebraMap_end_chart (fun z hz =>
      chartEv_powers_ne_zero
        (left_ne_zero_of_mul (by
          have h5 := nvChart_ne_zero hz
          rwa [chartEv_mul] at h5)) s)) ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  show sectionsResChart p c f g
      (localizedRealizeChart c f p (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p x)) =
    localizedRealizeChart c (f * g) p
      (crossMulDRSec f g p (locMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p x))
  rw [localizedRealizeChart_locMap, crossMulDRSec_locMap,
    localizedRealizeChart_locMap]
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun y => chartRealize_mul_val c f g p x (y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_mul_val
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChart_mul_val (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ)
    (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p) (y : ↥(nvChart c (f * g))) :
    (localizedRealizeChart c f p ξ).1
        ⟨(y : Fin d → ℂ), nvChart_mul_le_left c f g y.2⟩ =
      (localizedRealizeChart c (f * g) p (crossMulDRSec f g p ξ)).1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (localizedRealizeChart_mul_compat c f g p) ξ
  exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secToLocAway_res
statement:
theorem secToLocAway_res [IsAffine X] (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    (t : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    secToLocAway f (res (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f) t) =
      algebraMap (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (Localization.Away f) t
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI := isScalarTower_res (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) :=
    isLocalization_away (cRingHom sX) (isAffineOpen_top X) f
  exact cToLoc_algebraMap ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f
    (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) t

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secToLocAway_res_mul
statement:
theorem secToLocAway_res_mul [IsAffine X] (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) :
    (awayMulHom f g).comp (secToLocAway f) =
      (secToLocAway (f * g)).comp
        (res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g))
proof:
:= by
  letI := resAlgebra (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI := isScalarTower_res (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away f (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) :=
    isLocalization_away (cRingHom sX) (isAffineOpen_top X) f
  have hR : ((awayMulHom f g).comp (secToLocAway f)).toRingHom =
      ((secToLocAway (f * g)).comp
        (res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g))).toRingHom := by
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f) ?_
    refine RingHom.ext fun t => ?_
    show awayMulHom f g (secToLocAway f
        (res (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f) t)) =
      secToLocAway (f * g)
        (res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g)
          (res (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen_le f) t))
    rw [secToLocAway_res, awayMulHom_algebraMap,
      res_res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g)
        (X.basicOpen_le f) t, secToLocAway_res]
  exact AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective hR

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem [IsAffine X]
    (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) {W : X.Opens} {ξ : X}
    (hξ : ξ ∈ W) :
    ∃ f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤, ξ ∈ X.basicOpen f ∧ X.basicOpen f ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := (isAffineOpen_top X).exists_basicOpen_le
    (⟨ξ, hξ⟩ : W) (by trivial)
  exact ⟨f, h2, h1⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.basicSecChart_congr
statement:
theorem basicSecChart_congr [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {f₁ f₂ : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} (hf : f₁ = f₂) (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens}
    (h₁ : X.basicOpen f₁ ≤ W) (h₂ : X.basicOpen f₂ ≤ W)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) (z : Fin d → ℂ)
    (hz₁ : z ∈ nvChart c f₁) (hz₂ : z ∈ nvChart c f₂) :
    (basicSecChart c f₁ p h₁ x).1 ⟨z, hz₁⟩ =
      (basicSecChart c f₂ p h₂ x).1 ⟨z, hz₂⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.basicSecChart_mul
statement:
theorem basicSecChart_mul [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (f g : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens}
    (hf : X.basicOpen f ≤ W) (hfg : X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ W)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) (z : Fin d → ℂ)
    (hz : z ∈ nvChart c (f * g)) :
    (basicSecChart c f p hf x).1 ⟨z, nvChart_mul_le_left c f g hz⟩ =
      (basicSecChart c (f * g) p hfg x).1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : crossMulDRSec f g p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x)) =
      DeRham.map (secToLocAway (f * g)) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hfg) p x) := by
    calc crossMulDRSec f g p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x))
        = DeRham.map ((awayMulHom f g).comp (secToLocAway f)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x) :=
          (LinearMap.congr_fun
            (DeRham.map_comp (secToLocAway f) (awayMulHom f g) p) _).symm
      _ = DeRham.map ((secToLocAway (f * g)).comp
            (res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g))) p
            (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x) := by
          rw [secToLocAway_res_mul]
      _ = DeRham.map (secToLocAway (f * g)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX)
              (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g)) p
              (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x)) :=
          LinearMap.congr_fun (DeRham.map_comp
            (res (cRingHom sX) (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g))
            (secToLocAway (f * g)) p) _
      _ = DeRham.map (secToLocAway (f * g)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hfg) p x) :=
          congrArg (DeRham.map (secToLocAway (f * g)) p)
            (map_res_map_res (cRingHom sX)
              (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f g) hf p x)
  have h1 := localizedRealizeChart_mul_val c f g p
    (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hf) p x))
    ⟨z, hz⟩
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.toSpace_symm_mem
proof:
:=
  symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.mem_nvChart_of_basicOpen
proof:
:=
  ⟨hyt, (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mp hf⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.nvChart_subset_imageOpen
statement:
theorem nvChart_subset_imageOpen (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} {W : X.Opens} (h2 : X.basicOpen f ≤ W) :
    (nvChart c f : Set (Fin d → ℂ)) ⊆
      (imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) :
        Set (Fin d → ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  refine (mem_imageOpen_iff c).mpr ⟨hw.1, ?_⟩
  exact h2 ((toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mpr hw.2)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secValChart_spec
statement:
theorem secValChart_spec [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {W : X.Opens} (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) {y : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hy : y ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W))
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (h1 : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ X.basicOpen f)
    (h2 : X.basicOpen f ≤ W) :
    secValChart c p x y hy = (basicSecChart c f p h2 x).1
      ⟨y, mem_nvChart_of_basicOpen (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy) h1⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hgs := Classical.choose_spec (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX
    (toSpace_symm_mem hy))
  have hyt : y ∈ c.1.target := mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy
  have hzg : chartEv c
      (Classical.choose (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy)))
      y ≠ 0 :=
    (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ _).mp hgs.1
  have hzf : chartEv c f y ≠ 0 :=
    (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mp h1
  have hzgf : y ∈ nvChart c
      (Classical.choose (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy))
        * f) :=
    ⟨hyt, by rw [chartEv_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hzg hzf⟩
  have hzfg : y ∈ nvChart c
      (f * Classical.choose
        (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy))) :=
    ⟨hyt, by rw [chartEv_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hzf hzg⟩
  have hgf_le : X.basicOpen
      (Classical.choose (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy))
        * f) ≤ W :=
    (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) _ f).trans hgs.2
  have hfg_le : X.basicOpen
      (f * Classical.choose
        (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy))) ≤ W :=
    (basicOpen_mul_le_left (cRingHom sX) f _).trans h2
  have e1 := basicSecChart_mul c
    (Classical.choose (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy)))
    f p hgs.2 hgf_le x y hzgf
  have e2 := basicSecChart_mul c f
    (Classical.choose (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy)))
    p h2 hfg_le x y hzfg
  exact e1.trans ((basicSecChart_congr c
    (mul_comm (Classical.choose
      (exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy))) f) p
    hgf_le hfg_le x y hzgf hzfg).trans e2.symm)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secValChart_add
statement:
theorem secValChart_add [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {W : X.Opens} (x x' : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) (y : Fin d → ℂ)
    (hy : y ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W)) :
    secValChart c p (x + x') y hy =
      secValChart c p x y hy + secValChart c p x' y hy
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy)
  rw [secValChart_spec c p (x + x') hy f h1 h2,
    secValChart_spec c p x hy f h1 h2, secValChart_spec c p x' hy f h1 h2]
  rw [show basicSecChart c f p h2 (x + x') =
      basicSecChart c f p h2 x + basicSecChart c f p h2 x' from by
    show localizedRealizeChart c f p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p (x + x'))) = _
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
    rfl]
  exact sections_add_val _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.pullbackOpen_mono
statement:
theorem pullbackOpen_mono {V W : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    (Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj V ≤
      (Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W
proof:
:=
  fun _ hpt => hVW hpt

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secValChart_res
statement:
theorem secValChart_res [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {V W : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hyV : y ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj V)) :
    secValChart c p (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x) y hyV =
      secValChart c p x y (imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW) hyV)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hyV)
  rw [secValChart_spec c p (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x) hyV f h1 h2,
    secValChart_spec c p x (imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW) hyV) f h1
      (h2.trans hVW)]
  show (localizedRealizeChart c f p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x)))).1 _ =
    (localizedRealizeChart c f p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) (h2.trans hVW)) p x))).1 _
  rw [map_res_map_res]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secValExtChart_eq_on
statement:
theorem secValExtChart_eq_on [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {W : X.Opens} (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} (h2 : X.basicOpen f ≤ W) :
    ∀ w ∈ nvChart c f, secValExtChart c p x w =
      sectionExtendV (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) w
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  have hwi : w ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) :=
    nvChart_subset_imageOpen c h2 hw
  have h1w : toSpace sX (c.1.symm w) ∈ X.basicOpen f :=
    (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mpr (nvChart_ne_zero hw)
  show (if hz : w ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) then
      secValChart c p x w hz else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos hwi, secValChart_spec c p x hwi f h1w h2,
    sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) hw]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.analyticOnNhd_secValExtChart
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_secValExtChart [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d)
    (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens} (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (secValExtChart c p x)
      ((imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) :
        Opens (TopCat.of (Fin d → ℂ))) : Set (Fin d → ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro y₀ hy₀
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy₀)
  have hy₀f : y₀ ∈ nvChart c f :=
    mem_nvChart_of_basicOpen (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy₀) h1
  refine (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) y₀
    hy₀f).congr ?_
  refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvChart c f).isOpen.mem_nhds hy₀f)
    (fun w hw => ?_)
  exact (secValExtChart_eq_on c p x h2 w hw).symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secRealizeChart_val
statement:
theorem secRealizeChart_val [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    (W : X.Opens) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    (y : ↥(imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W))) :
    (secRealizeChart c p W x).1 y = secValChart c p x (y : Fin d → ℂ) y.2
proof:
:= by
  show (if hz : (y : Fin d → ℂ) ∈
      imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) then
      secValChart c p x (y : Fin d → ℂ) hz else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.secRealizeChart_d
statement:
theorem secRealizeChart_d [IsAffine X] (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    (W : X.Opens) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    dSection (secRealizeChart c p W x) =
      secRealizeChart c (p + 1) W (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun ypt => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ypt
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX
    (toSpace_symm_mem
      (show z ∈ imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) from hz))
  have hzf : z ∈ nvChart c f :=
    mem_nvChart_of_basicOpen (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hz) h1
  have hsub := nvChart_subset_imageOpen c (f := f) (W := W) h2
  
  have hev : sectionExtendV (secRealizeChart c p W x) =ᶠ[nhds z]
      sectionExtendV (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((nvChart c f).isOpen.mem_nhds hzf)
      (fun w hw => ?_)
    rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (secRealizeChart c p W x) (hsub hw),
      sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) hw,
      secRealizeChart_val]
    have h1w : toSpace sX (c.1.symm w) ∈ X.basicOpen f :=
      (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mpr (nvChart_ne_zero hw)
    exact secValChart_spec c p x (hsub hw) f h1w h2
  
  have hds : dSection (basicSecChart c f p h2 x) =
      basicSecChart c f (p + 1) h2 (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x) := by
    show dSection (localizedRealizeChart c f p (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
      (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p x))) = _
    rw [dSection_localizedRealizeChart]
    have e1 : DeRham.d ℂ (Localization.Away f) p
        (DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) p
          (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p x)) =
        DeRham.map (secToLocAway f) (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) p
            (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p x)) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_map (secToLocAway f) p) _
    have e2 : DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) (X.basicOpen f)) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p x) =
        DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) (p + 1)
          (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_map (res (cRingHom sX) h2) p) x
    rw [e1, e2]
    rfl
  
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (secRealizeChart c p W x)) z = _
  rw [hev.extDeriv_eq]
  have hL : extDeriv (sectionExtendV (basicSecChart c f p h2 x)) z =
      (basicSecChart c f (p + 1) h2
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)).1 ⟨z, hzf⟩ := by
    calc extDeriv (sectionExtendV (basicSecChart c f p h2 x)) z
        = (dSection (basicSecChart c f p h2 x)).1 ⟨z, hzf⟩ := rfl
      _ = (basicSecChart c f (p + 1) h2
            (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)).1 ⟨z, hzf⟩ := by rw [hds]
  rw [hL, secRealizeChart_val]
  have h1z : toSpace sX (c.1.symm z) ∈ X.basicOpen f :=
    (toSpace_mem_basicOpen_iff _ f).mpr (nvChart_ne_zero hzf)
  exact (secValChart_spec c (p + 1) (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)
    hz f h1z h2).symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartGrad_transition
statement:
theorem chartGrad_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hyt : y ∈ c₂.1.target)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    chartGrad c₂ b y =
      (chartGrad c₁ b ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).comp
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartEv c₂ b =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (chartEv c₁ b) ∘ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((c₂.1.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm c₁.1.open_source).mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hsrc⟩)
      (fun z hz => chartEv_transition c₁ c₂ b hz.2)
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEv c₂ b) y = _
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_comp y
    (analyticAt_chartEv c₁ b (c₁.1.map_source hsrc)).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_transFun c₁ c₂ hyt hsrc).differentiableAt

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.transition_mem_nvChart
statement:
theorem transition_mem_nvChart {c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤} {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈ nvChart c₁ f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨c₁.1.map_source hsrc, ?_⟩
  rw [← chartEv_transition c₁ c₂ f hsrc]
  exact nvChart_ne_zero hy

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartAlgForm_transition
statement:
theorem chartAlgForm_transition {p : ℕ} (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hyt : y ∈ c₂.1.target)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    chartAlgForm c₂ s t y =
      (chartAlgForm c₁ s t ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAlgForm_apply, chartAlgForm_apply, smul_compContinuousLinearMap,
    formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap, chartEv_transition c₁ c₂ s hsrc]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun j => ?_)
  exact chartGrad_transition c₁ c₂ (t j) hyt hsrc

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.chartRealize_transition
statement:
theorem chartRealize_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) p)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (chartRealize c₂ f p x).1 ⟨y, hy⟩ =
      ((chartRealize c₁ f p x).1
          ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChart hy hsrc⟩).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      rw [show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChart c₂ f))).1 ⟨y, hy⟩) = 0 from rfl,
        show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChart c₁ f))).1 ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChart hy hsrc⟩) = 0 from rfl,
        zero_compContinuousLinearMap]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, sections_add_val,
        sections_add_val, hu, hv, add_compContinuousLinearMap]
  | single t s =>
      rw [chartRealize_mk_single, chartRealize_mk_single]
      exact chartAlgForm_transition c₁ c₂ s t (nvChart_target hy) hsrc

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.localizedRealizeChart_transition
statement:
theorem localizedRealizeChart_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) (ξ : DR ℂ (Localization.Away f) p)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (localizedRealizeChart c₂ f p ξ).1 ⟨y, hy⟩ =
      ((localizedRealizeChart c₁ f p ξ).1
          ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChart hy hsrc⟩).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hs⟩ := locMap_surj ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) f p ξ
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hs
  have hsy : chartEv c₂ (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) y ≠ 0 :=
    chartEv_powers_ne_zero (nvChart_ne_zero hy) s
  have e2 := localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap c₂ f p hs
    (⟨y, hy⟩ : ↥(nvChart c₂ f))
  have e1 := localizedRealizeChart_val_smul_locMap c₁ f p hs
    (⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y, transition_mem_nvChart hy hsrc⟩ :
      ↥(nvChart c₁ f))
  have e1' := congrArg
    (fun φ : FormSpace d p =>
      φ.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)) e1
  simp only at e1'
  rw [smul_compContinuousLinearMap,
    ← chartRealize_transition c₁ c₂ f p x hy hsrc,
    ← chartEv_transition c₁ c₂ (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) hsrc, ← e2] at e1'
  exact (ComparisonLocalize.smul_cancel_of_ne_zero hsy e1').symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.basicSecChart_transition
statement:
theorem basicSecChart_transition [IsAffine X] (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) ⊤) (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens}
    (h : X.basicOpen f ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChart c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (basicSecChart c₂ f p h x).1 ⟨y, hy⟩ =
      ((basicSecChart c₁ f p h x).1
          ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChart hy hsrc⟩).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:=
  localizedRealizeChart_transition c₁ c₂ f p _ hy hsrc

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.isCompat_secRealizeChart
statement:
theorem isCompat_secRealizeChart [IsAffine X] (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens}
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    IsCompat p ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W)
      (fun c : GluedChart sX d => secRealizeChart c p W x)
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ y hy hsrc
  have hyi : (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈
      imageOpen c₁ ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) :=
    transition_mem_imageOpen hy hsrc
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hy, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hyi,
    secRealizeChart_val, secRealizeChart_val]
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_mem sX (toSpace_symm_mem hy)
  have hy₂ : y ∈ nvChart c₂ f :=
    mem_nvChart_of_basicOpen (mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy) h1
  have hread : c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) = c₂.1.symm y :=
    c₁.1.left_inv hsrc
  have h1' : toSpace sX (c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)) ∈
      X.basicOpen f := by
    rw [hread]
    exact h1
  rw [secValChart_spec c₂ p x hy f h1 h2,
    secValChart_spec c₁ p x hyi f h1' h2]
  exact basicSecChart_transition c₁ c₂ f p h2 x hy₂ hsrc

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.comparisonPresheafCharts_square
statement:
theorem comparisonPresheafCharts_square (p : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (dOpens (cRingHom sX) p)
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{0} ℂ) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) ≫
        comparisonPresheafCharts sX d (p + 1) =
      comparisonPresheafCharts sX d p ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).op
          (dPresheafChartsAb sX d p)
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun c => ?_)
  show secRealizeChart c (p + 1) (unop U)
      (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) (unop U)) p x) =
    dSection (secRealizeChart c p (unop U) x)
  exact (secRealizeChart_d c p (unop U) x).symm

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.comparisonSiteCharts_square
statement:
theorem comparisonSiteCharts_square (p : ℕ) :
    dSheafAb (cRingHom sX) p ≫ comparisonSiteCharts sX d (p + 1) =
      comparisonSiteCharts sX d p ≫
        (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.sheafEquiv (X := X)
            (A := AddCommGrpCat.{0})).inverse.map
          ((pushforwardAb (sPointsToZariski sX)).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p))
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  have h := congrArg
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.toOpensFunctor X).op)
    (comparisonPresheafCharts_square sX d p)
  rw [Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFlagAffine.isHodgeClassAffine_def
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassAffine_def [IsAffine X] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX]
    (p : ℕ) (c : bettiQ (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) (2 * p)) :
    IsHodgeClassAffine sX d p c ↔
      uLegSpace (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)
          (augmentSingleCharts sX d) (2 * p) c ∈
        (dRSpaceFiltrationC sX (p : ℤ) ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
          (junctionCharts sX d ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.comp_cast_cast
statement:
private theorem comp_cast_cast {α : Sort*} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (h' : n = m)
    (u : Fin n → α) : (u ∘ Fin.cast h) ∘ Fin.cast h' = u
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact congrArg u (Fin.ext (by simp))

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.append_cons_eq_insertNth
statement:
private theorem append_cons_eq_insertNth {α : Type*} {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : p < p + q + 1) (z : α) (t : Fin p → α) (t' : Fin q → α) :
    Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t') =
      Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => α) (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)) z
        (Fin.append t t')
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  rcases eq_or_ne k (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)) with hk | hk
  · rw [hk, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
    have hnat : (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)) = Fin.natAdd p (0 : Fin (q + 1)) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
    rw [hnat, Fin.append_right, Fin.cons_zero]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hk
    rw [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left j0 =>
        have hs : (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)).succAbove (Fin.castAdd q j0) =
            Fin.castAdd (q + 1) j0 := by
          rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt]
          · apply Fin.ext
            simp
          · rw [Fin.lt_def]
            simp
        rw [hs, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_left]
    | right j0 =>
        have hs : (⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)).succAbove (Fin.natAdd p j0) =
            Fin.natAdd p j0.succ := by
          rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc]
          · apply Fin.ext
            simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_natAdd, Nat.add_assoc]
          · rw [Fin.le_def]
            simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_natAdd]
            omega
        rw [hs, Fin.append_right, Fin.append_right, Fin.cons_succ]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.coe_mul_mem
statement:
theorem coe_mul_mem {p q : ℕ} (x : ⋀[B]^p (Ω[B⁄A])) (y : ⋀[B]^q (Ω[B⁄A])) :
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A])) * (y : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A])) ∈
      ⋀[B]^(p + q) (Ω[B⁄A])
proof:
:=
  SetLike.mul_mem_graded x.2 y.2

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.extMul_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem extMul_coe {p q : ℕ} (x : ⋀[B]^p (Ω[B⁄A])) (y : ⋀[B]^q (Ω[B⁄A])) :
    (extMul A B p q x y : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A])) =
      (x : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A])) * (y : ExteriorAlgebra B (Ω[B⁄A]))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti
proof:
:= by
  have hfn : (fun i => ExteriorAlgebra.ι B (Fin.append v w i)) =
      Fin.append (fun i => ExteriorAlgebra.ι B (v i))
        (fun i => ExteriorAlgebra.ι B (w i)) := by
    refine funext (Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_))
    · simp only [Fin.append_left]
    · simp only [Fin.append_right]
  rw [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply,
    ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply, hfn, List.ofFn_fin_append, List.prod_append]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.extMul_genWedge
statement:
theorem extMul_genWedge {p q : ℕ} (t : Fin p → B) (t' : Fin q → B) :
    extMul A B p q (genWedge A B t) (genWedge A B t') =
      genWedge A B (Fin.append t t')
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [extMul_coe, genWedge, genWedge, genWedge, exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe,
    exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ιMulti_mul_ιMulti]
  congr 1
  refine funext (Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_))
  · simp only [Fin.append_left]
  · simp only [Fin.append_right]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_apply
statement:
theorem drWedge_apply (p q : ℕ) (x : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    drWedge A B p q x y = (exteriorPowerEquiv A B (p + q)).symm
      (extMul A B p q (exteriorPowerEquiv A B p x) (exteriorPowerEquiv A B q y))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem drWedge_gen {p q : ℕ} (t : Fin p → B) (s : B) (t' : Fin q → B)
    (s' : B) :
    drWedge A B p q (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s))
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t' s')) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (Fin.append t t') (s * s'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [drWedge_apply, exteriorPowerEquiv_mk_single, exteriorPowerEquiv_mk_single]
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [extMul_genWedge, ← exteriorPowerEquiv_gen A B (Fin.append t t'),
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, smul_smul, ← mk_single_eq_smul_gen, mul_comm s' s]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_gen'
statement:
theorem drWedge_gen' {p q : ℕ} (t : Fin p → B) (t' : Fin q → B) :
    drWedge A B p q (gen A B t) (gen A B t') = gen A B (Fin.append t t')
proof:
:= by
  have h := drWedge_gen A B t 1 t' 1
  rw [one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_add_left
statement:
theorem drWedge_add_left {p q : ℕ} (x x' : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    drWedge A B p q (x + x') y = drWedge A B p q x y + drWedge A B p q x' y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_smul_left
statement:
theorem drWedge_smul_left {p q : ℕ} (b : B) (x : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    drWedge A B p q (b • x) y = b • drWedge A B p q x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_add_right
statement:
theorem drWedge_add_right {p q : ℕ} (x : DR A B p) (y y' : DR A B q) :
    drWedge A B p q x (y + y') = drWedge A B p q x y + drWedge A B p q x y'
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drWedge_smul_right
statement:
theorem drWedge_smul_right {p q : ℕ} (b : B) (x : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    drWedge A B p q x (b • y) = b • drWedge A B p q x y
proof:
:=
  map_smul _ _ _

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drCongr_mk_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem drCongr_mk_single {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (t : Fin m → B) (s : B) :
    drCongr A B h (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t s)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (t ∘ Fin.cast h.symm) s)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.drCongr_gen
statement:
theorem drCongr_gen {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (t : Fin m → B) :
    drCongr A B h (gen A B t) = gen A B (t ∘ Fin.cast h.symm)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.genWedge_cons_append
statement:
private theorem genWedge_cons_append {p q : ℕ} (z : B) (t : Fin p → B)
    (t' : Fin q → B) :
    genWedge A B (Fin.cons z (Fin.append t t')) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • genWedge A B (Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t'))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p < p + q + 1 := by omega
  have key : Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t') ∘
      ⇑((⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)).cycleRange.symm) =
      Fin.cons z (Fin.append t t') := by
    rw [append_cons_eq_insertNth hp z t t']
    exact Fin.insertNth_comp_cycleRange_symm _ _ _
  have hfun : (fun k => D A B (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => B) z (Fin.append t t') k)) =
      (fun k => D A B (Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t') k)) ∘
        ⇑((⟨p, hp⟩ : Fin (p + q + 1)).cycleRange.symm) := by
    rw [← key]
    rfl
  rw [genWedge, genWedge, hfun, AlternatingMap.map_perm, Equiv.Perm.sign_symm,
    Fin.sign_cycleRange, Units.smul_def]
  simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.gen_cons_append
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : gen A B (Fin.cons z (Fin.append t t')) =
      (exteriorPowerEquiv A B (p + q + 1)).symm
        (genWedge A B (Fin.cons z (Fin.append t t'))) := by
    rw [← exteriorPowerEquiv_gen A B (Fin.cons z (Fin.append t t')),
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h2 : gen A B (Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t')) =
      (exteriorPowerEquiv A B (p + (q + 1))).symm
        (genWedge A B (Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t'))) := by
    rw [← exteriorPowerEquiv_gen A B (Fin.append t (Fin.cons z t')),
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [h1, h2, genWedge_cons_append A B z t t', map_zsmul]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.smul_zsmul_comm
statement:
private theorem smul_zsmul_comm {n : ℕ} (b : B) (c : ℤ) (x : DR A B n) :
    b • c • x = c • b • x
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (LinearMap.lsmul B (DR A B n) b) c x

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.zsmul_zero'
statement: private theorem zsmul_zero' {n : ℕ} (c : ℤ) : c • (0 : DR A B n) = 0
proof:
:=
  smul_zero c

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.zsmul_add'
statement:
private theorem zsmul_add' {n : ℕ} (c : ℤ) (x y : DR A B n) :
    c • (x + y) = c • x + c • y
proof:
:=
  smul_add c x y

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.d_drWedge
statement:
theorem d_drWedge (p q : ℕ) (x : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    d A B (p + q) (drWedge A B p q x y) =
      drCongr A B (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)
          (drWedge A B (p + 1) q (d A B p x) y) +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • drWedge A B p (q + 1) x (d A B q y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
        zsmul_zero', add_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, zsmul_add']
      rw [hf, hg]
      exact add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
  | single t s =>
      induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero =>
          simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, zsmul_zero', add_zero]
      | add f g hf hg =>
          simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, zsmul_add']
          rw [hf, hg]
          exact add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
      | single t' s' =>
          rw [drWedge_gen A B t s t' s',
            d_mk_single A B (Fin.append t t') (s * s'),
            d_mk_single A B t s, d_mk_single A B t' s',
            show gen A B (Fin.cons s t) =
              Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (Fin.cons s t) (1 : B)) from rfl,
            show gen A B (Fin.cons s' t') =
              Submodule.Quotient.mk (single (Fin.cons s' t') (1 : B)) from rfl,
            drWedge_gen A B (Fin.cons s t) 1 t' s',
            drWedge_gen A B t s (Fin.cons s' t') 1,
            one_mul, mul_one, drCongr_mk_single, Fin.append_cons, comp_cast_cast,
            mk_single_eq_smul_gen, mk_single_eq_smul_gen, gen_cons_mul,
            gen_cons_append A B s' t t', smul_zsmul_comm]
          exact add_comm _ _

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.quasiIso_of_stalkwise_quasiIso
statement:
theorem quasiIso_of_stalkwise_quasiIso
    {K L : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ℤ}
    (f : K ⟶ L)
    (h : ∀ x : ↑X, QuasiIso
      (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f)) :
    QuasiIso f
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiIso_iff]
  intro n
  rw [quasiIsoAt_iff]
  have γ : ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData ((shortComplexFunctor _ _ n).map f)
      ((shortComplexFunctor _ _ n).obj K).leftHomologyData
      ((shortComplexFunctor _ _ n).obj L).leftHomologyData := default
  rw [γ.quasiIso_iff]
  rw [((Opens.isConservativeFamilyOfPoints_pointsGrothendieckTopology
    X).jointlyReflectIsomorphisms AddCommGrpCat.{u}).isIso_iff]
  rintro ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := hΦ
  
  have hx : ShortComplex.QuasiIso
      ((stalkAt x).mapShortComplex.map ((shortComplexFunctor _ _ n).map f)) := by
    have := (h x).quasiIsoAt n
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff] at this
    exact this
  rw [(γ.map (stalkAt x)).quasiIso_iff, ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.map_φH] at hx
  exact hx

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.germ_res
statement:
theorem germ_res (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {U V : Opens ↑X} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hx : x ∈ V) :
    F.obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ germ x F hx = germ x F (hVU hx)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_w
    (homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U) (fiberPt x hx) F.obj).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun y => (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber U y F.obj)
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.germ_jointly_surjective
statement:
theorem germ_jointly_surjective
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (s : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj F)) :
    ∃ (U : Opens ↑X) (hx : x ∈ U) (z : ToType (F.obj.obj (op U))),
      germ x F hx z = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, pt, z, hz⟩ :=
    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective (P := F.obj) s
  exact ⟨U, pt.down.down, z, hz⟩

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.germ_eq_iff
statement:
theorem germ_eq_iff (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {U : Opens ↑X} (hx : x ∈ U) (z₁ z₂ : ToType (F.obj.obj (op U))) :
    germ x F hx z₁ = germ x F hx z₂ ↔
      ∃ (V : Opens ↑X) (_ : x ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
        F.obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op z₁ = F.obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op z₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨V, f, y, -, hf⟩ :=
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' (P := F.obj)
        U (fiberPt x hx) z₁ z₂).mp h
    exact ⟨V, y.down.down, leOfHom f, hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩
    exact ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' (P := F.obj)
      U (fiberPt x hx) z₁ z₂).mpr
      ⟨V, homOfLE hVU, fiberPt x hxV, Subsingleton.elim _ _, hres⟩

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.germ_naturality
statement:
theorem germ_naturality
    {F G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    {U : Opens ↑X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    germ x F hx ≫ (stalkAt x).map φ = φ.hom.app (op U) ≫ germ x G hx
proof:
:=
  (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_naturality φ.hom U (fiberPt x hx)

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.toPresheafFiber_constFiberIso
statement:
theorem toPresheafFiber_constFiberIso (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U : Opens ↑X}

    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber U (fiberPt x hx)

:=

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.toPresheafFiber_const_eq_constFiberIso_inv
statement:
theorem toPresheafFiber_const_eq_constFiberIso_inv (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {U : Opens ↑X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber U (fiberPt x hx)
      ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M) = (constFiberIso x M).inv
proof:
:=
  (Iso.comp_hom_eq_id (constFiberIso x M)).mp (toPresheafFiber_constFiberIso x M hx)

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.toSheafify_comp_germ
statement:
theorem toSheafify_comp_germ (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U : Opens ↑X}
    (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)).app (op U) ≫
      germ x ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj M) hx = (stalkConstIso x M).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)).app (op U) ≫
      germ x ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj M) hx =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber U (fiberPt x hx)
          ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M) ≫
        (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).presheafFiber.map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)) :=
    ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_naturality
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)) U (fiberPt x hx)).symm
  exact h1.trans (congrArg
    (· ≫ (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).presheafFiber.map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)))
    (toPresheafFiber_const_eq_constFiberIso_inv x M hx))

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.toSheafify_germ_stalkConstIso
statement:
theorem toSheafify_germ_stalkConstIso (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U : Opens ↑X}
    (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ).obj M)).app (op U) ≫
      germ x ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj M) hx ≫ (stalkConstIso x M).hom = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, toSheafify_comp_germ]
  exact (stalkConstIso x M).inv_hom_id

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV [CompleteSpace W]
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))}
    (f : (omegaSheaf n W).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sectionExtendV f) (U : Set (Fin n → ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, W) ω f.1 := f.2
  have h1 : (fun z : ↥U => sectionExtendV f ↑z) = f.1 :=
    funext fun z => dif_pos z.2
  have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, W) ω
      (fun z : ↥U => sectionExtendV f ↑z) ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    rw [h1]; exact hf ⟨y, hy⟩
  have h3 : ContDiffAt ℂ ω (sectionExtendV f) y :=
    contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp (contMDiffAt_subtype_iff.mp h2)
  exact analyticWithinAt_univ.mp (contDiffWithinAt_omega_iff_analyticWithinAt.mp h3)

    sectionExtendV ((omegaSheaf n W).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op f) y =

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.dSection_apply
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.dSection_add
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  have hfg : sectionExtendV (f + g) =
      fun z => sectionExtendV f z + sectionExtendV g z := by
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ U
    · rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem f hz,
        sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g hz]
      rfl
    · simp only [sectionExtendV, dif_neg hz, add_zero]
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (f + g)) ↑y =
    extDeriv (sectionExtendV f) ↑y + extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) ↑y
  rw [hfg]
  exact extDeriv_fun_add
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV f ↑y y.2).differentiableAt
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV g ↑y y.2).differentiableAt

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.dSection_map
statement:
theorem dSection_map {U V : Opens (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (f : (omegaSheaf n (FormSpace n p)).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    dSection ((omegaSheaf n (FormSpace n p)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op f) =
      (omegaSheaf n (FormSpace n (p + 1))).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (dSection f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV
      ((omegaSheaf n (FormSpace n p)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op f)) ↑y =
    extDeriv (sectionExtendV f) ↑y
  exact Filter.EventuallyEq.extDeriv_eq
    (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (V.isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
      (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_map_eq hVU f hz))

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.extDeriv_const_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extDeriv_const_eq_zero {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] {q : ℕ}
    (φ : E [⋀^Fin q]→L[ℂ] F) (x : E) :
    extDeriv (fun _ : E => φ) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  show ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (fderiv ℂ (fun _ : E => φ) x) = 0
  rw [fderiv_const_apply]
  exact map_zero (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℂ E F)

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.dSection_dSection
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (dSection f)) ↑y = 0
  have heq : sectionExtendV (dSection f) =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin n → ℂ)]
      extDeriv (sectionExtendV f) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (U.isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
      (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (dSection f) hz)
  rw [heq.extDeriv_eq]
  exact extDeriv_extDeriv_of_analytic (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV f ↑y y.2)

  ext U f

proof:

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.augment_homEquiv
statement:
theorem augment_homEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
      AddCommGrpCat).homEquiv _ _) (augment n) = augmentPresheaf n
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.toSheafify_comp_augment
statement:
theorem toSheafify_comp_augment (n : ℕ) :
    toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))) ≫
      (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
        AddCommGrpCat).map (augment n) = augmentPresheaf n
proof:
:= by
  have h := augment_homEquiv n
  rwa [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app] at h

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.augmentPresheaf_comp_d
statement:
theorem augmentPresheaf_comp_d (n : ℕ) :
    augmentPresheaf n ≫ dPresheafAb n 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext U c
  show dSection (constFormSection n U c.down) = 0
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show extDeriv (sectionExtendV (constFormSection n U c.down)) ↑y = 0
  have heq : sectionExtendV (constFormSection n U c.down)
      =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin n → ℂ)]
      (fun _ => constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) c.down) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((unop U).isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
      (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hz)
  rw [heq.extDeriv_eq]
  exact extDeriv_const_eq_zero _ _

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.augment_comp_dSheafForms
statement:
theorem augment_comp_dSheafForms (n : ℕ) :
    augment n ≫ dSheafForms n 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (γ : (presheafToSheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) AddCommGrpCat).obj
          ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))) ⟶ formSheafAb n 0),
      ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) γ = augmentPresheaf n →
        γ ≫ dSheafForms n 0 = 0 := by
    intro γ hγ
    refine ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _).injective ?_
    calc ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) (γ ≫ dSheafForms n 0)
        = ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) γ ≫
            (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
              AddCommGrpCat).map (dSheafForms n 0) :=
          (sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv_naturality_right γ (dSheafForms n 0)
      _ = augmentPresheaf n ≫
            (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
              AddCommGrpCat).map (dSheafForms n 0) :=
          congrArg (· ≫ _) hγ
      _ = 0 := augmentPresheaf_comp_d n
      _ = ((sheafificationAdjunction _ _).homEquiv _ _) 0 := by
          rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero]
          exact comp_zero.symm
  exact key (augment n) (augment_homEquiv n)

name: HodgePilot.StalkDetect.augment_comp_d
statement:
theorem augment_comp_d (n : ℕ) :
    augment n ≫ (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [holomorphicDeRhamComplexN_d_zero_one]
  exact augment_comp_dSheafForms n

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.subsingleton_ext_one_of_liftable
statement:
theorem subsingleton_ext_one_of_liftable (Z : A) {S : ShortComplex A}
    (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hlift : ∀ φ : Z ⟶ S.X₃, ∃ ψ : Z ⟶ S.X₂, ψ ≫ S.g = φ)
    (hmid : Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z S.X₂ 1)) :
    Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z S.X₁ 1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hmid
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ Z hS x (Subsingleton.elim _ 0) (zero_add 1)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hlift (Ext.addEquiv₀ y)
  have e1 : x =
      ((Ext.mk₀ ψ).comp (Ext.mk₀ S.g) (zero_add 0)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) := by
    rw [Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, hψ, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply, hy]
  have e2 : ((Ext.mk₀ ψ).comp (Ext.mk₀ S.g) (zero_add 0)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) =
      (Ext.mk₀ ψ).comp ((Ext.mk₀ S.g).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) :=
    Ext.comp_assoc (Ext.mk₀ ψ) (Ext.mk₀ S.g) hS.extClass (zero_add 0) (zero_add 1)
      (show 0 + 0 + 1 = 1 from rfl)
  rw [e1, e2, hS.comp_extClass]
  exact Ext.comp_zero _ _ _ _ (zero_add 1)

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.subsingleton_ext_succ_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem subsingleton_ext_succ_of_shortExact (Z : A) {S : ShortComplex A}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (m : ℕ)
    (hthird : Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z S.X₃ (m + 1)))
    (hmid : Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z S.X₂ (m + 2))) :
    Subsingleton (Ext.{w} Z S.X₁ (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hthird
  haveI := hmid
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ Z hS x (Subsingleton.elim _ 0) rfl
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, Ext.zero_comp] at hy
  exact hy.symm

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_injective
statement:
theorem isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_injective (T : C)
    (G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}) [Injective G] :
    IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel T G
proof:
:= by
  intro B R f g hfg hS
  haveI : Injective (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).X₁ := inferInstanceAs (Injective G)
  have σ := hS.splittingOfInjective
  intro r
  refine ⟨σ.s.hom.app (op T) r, ?_⟩
  have hsg : σ.s ≫ g = 𝟙 R := σ.s_g
  calc g.hom.app (op T) (σ.s.hom.app (op T) r)
      = (σ.s ≫ g).hom.app (op T) r := rfl
    _ = (𝟙 R : R ⟶ R).hom.app (op T) r := by rw [hsg]
    _ = r := rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.exists_lift_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel
statement:
lemma exists_lift_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel {T : C} (hT : IsTerminal T)
    {G B R : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}} (hG : IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel T G)
    (f : G ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact) (φ : constZ J ⟶ R) :
    ∃ ψ : constZ J ⟶ B, ψ ≫ g = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hG f g hfg hS (homEquivSections hT R φ)
  exact ⟨(homEquivSections hT B).symm b, by
    rw [homEquivSections_symm_naturality hT g b, hb, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.subsingleton_H_one_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (Injective.ι G) (cokernel.π (Injective.ι G))
      (cokernel.condition _)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact _
      mono_f := inferInstanceAs (Mono (Injective.ι G))
      epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π (Injective.ι G))) }
  exact subsingleton_ext_one_of_liftable (constZ J) hS
    (fun φ => exists_lift_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel hT hG _ _ _ hS φ)
    (inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (Injective.under G) (0 + 1))))

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class
statement:
theorem subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class {T : C}
    (hT : IsTerminal T) (P : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w} → Prop)
    (hsurj : ∀ G, P G → IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel T G)
    (hquot : ∀ ⦃G B R : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}⦄ (f : G ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R)
      (hfg : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact →
      P G → Injective B → P R) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}), P G →
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H G (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    exact fun G hG =>
      subsingleton_H_one_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel hT (hsurj G hG)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro G hG
    have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (Injective.ι G) (cokernel.π (Injective.ι G))
        (cokernel.condition _)).ShortExact :=
      { exact := ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact _
        mono_f := inferInstanceAs (Mono (Injective.ι G))
        epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π (Injective.ι G))) }
    have hQ : P (cokernel (Injective.ι G)) :=
      hquot _ _ (cokernel.condition _) hS hG (Injective.injective_under G)
    exact subsingleton_ext_succ_of_shortExact (constZ J) hS m (ih _ hQ)
      (inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (Injective.under G) ((m + 1) + 1))))

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.space_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_injective
statement:
theorem space_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_injective
    (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X) [Injective G] :
    IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X) G
proof:
:=
  isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_of_injective (⊤ : Opens X) G

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.space_subsingleton_H_one_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel
statement:
theorem space_subsingleton_H_one_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel
    {G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X}
    (hG : IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X) G) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H G 1)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_H_one_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel
    (HodgePilot.Betti.opensTopTerminal X) hG

name: HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.space_subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class
statement:
theorem space_subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class
    (P : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X → Prop)
    (hsurj : ∀ G, P G → IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (⊤ : Opens X) G)
    (hquot : ∀ ⦃G B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X⦄ (f : G ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R)
      (hfg : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact →
      P G → Injective B → P R)
    (m : ℕ) (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X) (hG : P G) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H G (m + 1))
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_H_of_isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_class
    (HodgePilot.Betti.opensTopTerminal X) P hsurj hquot m G hG

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDualFun_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaDualFun_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    sigmaDualFun V φ x = starRingEnd ℂ (φ (sigmaQR V x))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaDual_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    sigmaDual V φ x = starRingEnd ℂ (φ (sigmaQR V x))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaDual_sigmaDual
statement:
theorem sigmaDual_sigmaDual (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :
    sigmaDual V (sigmaDual V φ) = φ
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => by
    rw [sigmaDual_apply, sigmaDual_apply, sigmaQR_involutive, starRingEnd_self_apply]

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaDual_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem map_sigmaDual_dualAnnihilator (S : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :
    S.dualAnnihilator.map (sigmaDual V) = (S.map (sigmaQ V)).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hψ
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hφ ⊢
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hw
    rw [sigmaDual_apply, sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQR_involutive, hφ s hs, map_zero]
  · intro ψ hψ
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hψ
    refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨sigmaDual V ψ, ?_, sigmaDual_sigmaDual V ψ⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    intro s hs
    rw [sigmaDual_apply, hψ (sigmaQR V s) (Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩),
      map_zero]

name: HodgePilot.dualEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualEquiv_tmul (c : ℂ) (f : Module.Dual ℚ V) (d : ℂ) (v : V) :
    dualEquiv V (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] f) (d ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = d * c * (f v : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (d ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = d • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) := by
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have h2 : dualEquiv V (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] f) ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = c * algebraMap ℚ ℂ (f v) :=
    (TensorProduct.isBaseChange ℚ V ℂ).toDualBaseChange_tmul c f v
  rw [h1, map_smul, h2, smul_eq_mul, eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (f v)]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_dualEquiv
statement:
theorem sigmaQR_dualEquiv (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] Module.Dual ℚ V) :
    dualEquiv V (sigmaQR (Module.Dual ℚ V) x) = sigmaDual V (dualEquiv V x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | tmul c f =>
      refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | tmul d v =>
          rw [sigmaQR_tmul, sigmaDual_apply, sigmaQR_tmul, dualEquiv_tmul,
            dualEquiv_tmul, map_mul, map_mul, starRingEnd_self_apply, map_ratCast]

name: HodgePilot.dualEquiv_symm_sigmaDual
statement:
theorem dualEquiv_symm_sigmaDual (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :
    (dualEquiv V).symm (sigmaDual V φ) =
      sigmaQ (Module.Dual ℚ V) ((dualEquiv V).symm φ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sigmaQR_dualEquiv V ((dualEquiv V).symm φ)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [← h, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, sigmaQ_apply]

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaQ_map_dualEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem map_sigmaQ_map_dualEquiv_symm (S : Submodule ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))) :
    (S.map ((dualEquiv V).symm : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)).map (sigmaQ (Module.Dual ℚ V)) =
      (S.map (sigmaDual V)).map ((dualEquiv V).symm : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨sigmaDual V x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, dualEquiv_symm_sigmaDual V x⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(dualEquiv V).symm x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (dualEquiv_symm_sigmaDual V x).symm⟩

name: HodgePilot.otherPieces_def
statement:
theorem otherPieces_def (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (x₀ : ℤ × ℤ) :
    otherPieces h x₀ = ⨆ (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : ab ≠ x₀), h.H ab
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.H_le_otherPieces
statement:
theorem H_le_otherPieces (h : QHodgeStructure n V) {ab x₀ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hne : ab ≠ x₀) : h.H ab ≤ otherPieces h x₀
proof:
:=
  le_iSup₂ (f := fun ab (_ : ab ≠ x₀) => h.H ab) ab hne

name: HodgePilot.otherPieces_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem otherPieces_sup_eq_top (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (x₀ : ℤ × ℤ) :
    otherPieces h x₀ ⊔ h.H x₀ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← h.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
  refine iSup_le fun ab => ?_
  by_cases hab : ab = x₀
  · subst hab
    exact le_sup_right
  · exact le_sup_of_le_left (H_le_otherPieces h hab)

name: HodgePilot.otherPieces_eq_top
statement:
theorem otherPieces_eq_top (h : QHodgeStructure n V) {x₀ : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hbot : h.H x₀ = ⊥) : otherPieces h x₀ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hsup := otherPieces_sup_eq_top h x₀
  rwa [hbot, sup_bot_eq] at hsup

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaQ_otherPieces
statement:
theorem map_sigmaQ_otherPieces (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (a b : ℤ) :
    (otherPieces h (a, b)).map (sigmaQ V) = otherPieces h (b, a)
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, (h.H pq).map (sigmaQ V) = h.H (pq.2, pq.1) := by
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    exact h.conj_symm x y
  rw [otherPieces_def, otherPieces_def]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, hswap]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun ab hab => ?_) (iSup₂_le fun ab hab => ?_)
  · refine le_iSup₂ (f := fun cd (_ : cd ≠ (b, a)) => h.H cd) (ab.2, ab.1) ?_
    intro heq
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    exact hab (Prod.ext heq.2 heq.1)
  · refine le_iSup₂ (f := fun cd (_ : cd ≠ (a, b)) => h.H (cd.2, cd.1)) (ab.2, ab.1) ?_
    intro heq
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    exact hab (Prod.ext heq.2 heq.1)

name: HodgePilot.biInf_otherPieces_le
statement:
theorem biInf_otherPieces_le (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (s : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (⨅ x₀ ∈ s, otherPieces h x₀) ≤ ⨆ (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : ab ∉ s), h.H ab
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have htop : (⨆ (ab : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : ab ∉ (∅ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))), h.H ab) = ⊤ := by
        rw [eq_top_iff, ← h.isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
        exact iSup_le fun ab =>
          le_iSup₂ (f := fun ab (_ : ab ∉ (∅ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))) => h.H ab) ab
            (Finset.notMem_empty ab)
      rw [htop]
      exact le_top
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.iInf_insert, otherPieces_def]
      refine le_trans (inf_le_inf_left _ ih) ?_
      refine le_trans
        (biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep _ _) ?_
      refine iSup₂_le fun ab hab => ?_
      refine le_iSup₂ (f := fun ab (_ : ab ∉ insert a s) => h.H ab) ab ?_
      intro hmem
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmem with h1 | h2
      · exact hab.1 h1
      · exact hab.2 h2

name: HodgePilot.dualPieceAux_def
statement:
theorem dualPieceAux_def (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    dualPieceAux h pq = (otherPieces h (-pq.1, -pq.2)).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.dualPieceAux_pair
statement:
theorem dualPieceAux_pair (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (p q : ℤ) :
    dualPieceAux h (p, q) = (otherPieces h (-p, -q)).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.dualPiece_def
statement:
theorem dualPiece_def (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    dualPiece h pq = (dualPieceAux h pq).map ((dualEquiv V).symm : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_dualPieceAux
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_dualPieceAux (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    iSupIndep (dualPieceAux h)
proof:
:= by
  intro pq₀
  have hrest : (⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : pq ≠ pq₀), dualPieceAux h pq) ≤
      (h.H (-pq₀.1, -pq₀.2)).dualAnnihilator := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun pq hpq => ?_
    rw [dualPieceAux_def]
    refine Submodule.dualAnnihilator_anti (H_le_otherPieces h ?_)
    intro heq
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := heq
    exact hpq (Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega))
  refine Disjoint.mono_right hrest (disjoint_iff.mpr ?_)
  rw [dualPieceAux_def, ← Submodule.dualAnnihilator_sup_eq, otherPieces_sup_eq_top,
    Submodule.dualAnnihilator_top]

name: HodgePilot.iSup_dualPieceAux_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_dualPieceAux_eq_top (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    (⨆ pq : ℤ × ℤ, dualPieceAux h pq) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {ab : ℤ × ℤ | h.H ab ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  
  have hdistrib : ∀ s : Finset (ℤ × ℤ),
      (⨅ x₀ ∈ s, otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator =
        ⨆ x₀ ∈ s, (otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        have hLHS : (⨅ x₀ ∈ (∅ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)), otherPieces h x₀) = ⊤ :=
          eq_top_iff.mpr (le_iInf fun x₀ => le_iInf fun hx₀ =>
            absurd hx₀ (Finset.notMem_empty x₀))
        have hRHS : (⨆ x₀ ∈ (∅ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
            (otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator) = ⊥ :=
          le_bot_iff.mp (iSup₂_le fun x₀ hx₀ => absurd hx₀ (Finset.notMem_empty x₀))
        rw [hLHS, hRHS, Submodule.dualAnnihilator_top]
    | insert a s ha ih =>
        rw [Finset.iInf_insert, Finset.iSup_insert, Subspace.dualAnnihilator_inf_eq, ih]
  
  have hbot : (⨅ x₀ ∈ hfin.toFinset, otherPieces h x₀) = ⊥ := by
    refine le_bot_iff.mp ((biInf_otherPieces_le h hfin.toFinset).trans ?_)
    refine iSup₂_le fun ab hab => ?_
    have hHbot : h.H ab = ⊥ :=
      of_not_not fun hne => hab (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hne)
    exact le_of_eq hHbot
  
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  calc (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)))
      = (⊥ : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)).dualAnnihilator :=
        Submodule.dualAnnihilator_bot.symm
    _ = (⨅ x₀ ∈ hfin.toFinset, otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator := by rw [hbot]
    _ = ⨆ x₀ ∈ hfin.toFinset, (otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator := hdistrib _
    _ ≤ ⨆ pq : ℤ × ℤ, dualPieceAux h pq := by
        refine iSup₂_le fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_
        have hx : dualPieceAux h (-x₀.1, -x₀.2) =
            (otherPieces h x₀).dualAnnihilator := by
          rw [dualPieceAux_pair, neg_neg, neg_neg]
        rw [← hx]
        exact le_iSup (fun pq => dualPieceAux h pq) (-x₀.1, -x₀.2)

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_dualPieceAux
statement:
theorem isInternal_dualPieceAux (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (dualPieceAux h)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_dualPieceAux h) (iSup_dualPieceAux_eq_top h)

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_dualPiece
statement:
theorem isInternal_dualPiece (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (dualPiece h)
proof:
:=
  (isInternal_dualPieceAux h).mapEquiv (dualEquiv V).symm

name: HodgePilot.dualPiece_supported
statement:
theorem dualPiece_supported (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hpq : pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ -n) : dualPiece h pq = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : h.H (-pq.1, -pq.2) = ⊥ := by
    refine h.supported _ ?_
    show -pq.1 + -pq.2 ≠ n
    omega
  rw [dualPiece_def, dualPieceAux_def, otherPieces_eq_top h hbot,
    Submodule.dualAnnihilator_top, Submodule.map_bot]

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaDual_dualPieceAux
statement:
theorem map_sigmaDual_dualPieceAux (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (p q : ℤ) :
    (dualPieceAux h (p, q)).map (sigmaDual V) = dualPieceAux h (q, p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualPieceAux_pair, dualPieceAux_pair, map_sigmaDual_dualAnnihilator,
    map_sigmaQ_otherPieces]

name: HodgePilot.dualPiece_conj_symm
statement:
theorem dualPiece_conj_symm (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (p q : ℤ) :
    (dualPiece h (p, q)).map (sigmaQ (Module.Dual ℚ V)) = dualPiece h (q, p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualPiece_def, dualPiece_def, map_sigmaQ_map_dualEquiv_symm,
    map_sigmaDual_dualPieceAux]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.smap_smap
statement:
theorem smap_smap (F : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}) {V W T : Opens ↑anP1}
    (h1 : W ≤ T) (h2 : V ≤ W) (h3 : V ≤ T) (s : F.obj.obj (op T)) :
    F.obj.map (homOfLE h2).op (F.obj.map (homOfLE h1).op s) =
      F.obj.map (homOfLE h3).op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← F.obj.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun (t : V ⟶ T) => F.obj.map t.op s) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.app_injective_of_mono
statement:
theorem app_injective_of_mono {F G : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}} (ι : F ⟶ G)
    [Mono ι] (V : Opens ↑anP1) : Function.Injective (ι.hom.app (op V))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono ((sheafToPresheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι) :=
    (sheafToPresheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map_mono ι
  haveI : Mono (((sheafToPresheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι).app (op V)) :=
    inferInstance
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective (ι.hom.app (op V))).mp
    (inferInstanceAs
      (Mono (((sheafToPresheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι).app (op V))))

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.exists_localLift
statement:
theorem exists_localLift {B R : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}} (g : B ⟶ R)
    (hepi : Epi g) {V : Opens ↑anP1} (r : R.obj.obj (op V)) (x : ↑anP1)
    (hx : x ∈ V) :
    ∃ (W : Opens ↑anP1) (hWV : W ≤ V) (t : B.obj.obj (op W)), x ∈ W ∧
      g.hom.app (op W) t = R.obj.map (homOfLE hWV).op r
proof:
:= by
  have hls : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective g.hom :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi (F := B) (G := R) g).mpr hepi
  obtain ⟨W, hWle, ⟨t0, ht0⟩, hxW⟩ :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff g.hom).mp hls V r x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWle, t0, hxW, ht0⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.exists_kernelDiff
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.sections_exact_of_left_exact hex hmono t ht

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.exists_gluing
statement:
theorem exists_gluing {κ : Type} (Us : κ → Opens ↑anP1) (V : Opens ↑anP1)
    (hle : ∀ i, Us i ≤ V) (hcov : V ≤ iSup Us)
    (B : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0})
    (sf : ∀ i : κ, B.obj.obj (op (Us i)))
    (hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible B.1 Us sf) :
    ∃ s : B.obj.obj (op V), ∀ i, B.obj.map (homOfLE (hle i)).op s = sf i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' (F := B) Us V
    (fun i => homOfLE (hle i)) hcov sf hcomp
  exact ⟨s, hs⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.sections_locality
statement:
theorem sections_locality {κ : Type} (Us : κ → Opens ↑anP1) (V : Opens ↑anP1)
    (hle : ∀ i, Us i ≤ V) (hcov : V ≤ iSup Us)
    (R : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0}) (s t : R.obj.obj (op V))
    (h : ∀ i, R.obj.map (homOfLE (hle i)).op s =
      R.obj.map (homOfLE (hle i)).op t) : s = t
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' R Us V (fun i => homOfLE (hle i)) hcov s t h

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.sections_eq_of_empty
statement:
theorem sections_eq_of_empty (B : Sheaf JAn AddCommGrpCat.{0})
    {O : Opens ↑anP1} (hO : (O : Set ↑anP1) = ∅) (s t : B.obj.obj (op O)) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : O ≤ iSup (fun i : Empty => (i.elim : Opens ↑anP1)) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp' : p ∈ (O : Set ↑anP1) := hp
    rw [hO] at hp'
    exact absurd hp' (Set.notMem_empty p)
  exact sections_locality (fun i : Empty => i.elim) O (fun i => i.elim) hbot
    B s t (fun i => i.elim)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.eq_constSec_of_forall_hasVal
proof:
:= by
  choose W hWV hxW hres using h
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (F := FqAn)
    (fun p : {x : ↑anP1 // x ∈ V} => W p.1 p.2) V
    (fun p => homOfLE (hWV p.1 p.2))
    (fun x hx => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxW x hx⟩)
  intro p
  rw [hres p.1 p.2, constSec_res]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.eq_constSec_of_preconnected
statement:
theorem eq_constSec_of_preconnected {V : Opens ↑anP1}
    (hV : IsPreconnected (V : Set ↑anP1)) (s : FqAn.obj.obj (op V))
    {x₀ : ↑anP1} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ V) :
    s = constSec (secVal V s x₀ hx₀) V
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_constSec_of_forall_hasVal
  intro x hx
  have h1 : secVal V s x hx = secVal V s x₀ hx₀ := secVal_congr_pt hV s hx hx₀
  have h2 := secVal_spec V s hx
  rwa [h1] at h2

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.constSec_sub
statement:
theorem constSec_sub (q r : ℚ) (W : Opens ↑anP1) :
    constSec q W - constSec r W = constSec (q - r) W
proof:
:= by
  have h := constSec_add (q - r) r W
  have h2 : q - r + r = q := by ring
  rw [h2] at h
  rw [← h]
  abel

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.image_inter_preconnected
statement:
theorem image_inter_preconnected (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    {s t : Set ℂ} (hs : Convex ℝ s) (ht : Convex ℝ t) :
    IsPreconnected (e '' s ∩ e '' t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_inter he.injective]
  exact (hs.inter ht).isPreconnected.image e he.continuous.continuousOn

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.image_ball_isOpen
statement:
theorem image_ball_isOpen (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    (z : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : IsOpen (e '' Metric.ball z r)
proof:
:=
  he.isOpenMap _ Metric.isOpen_ball

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.coe_ballImg
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_ballImg (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    (x : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) : (ballImg e he x ε : Set ↑anP1) = e '' Metric.ball x ε
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.mem_ballImg
statement:
theorem mem_ballImg {e : ℂ → ↑anP1} (he : IsOpenEmbedding e) {x : ℂ} {ε : ℝ}
    {p : ℂ} (hp : p ∈ Metric.ball x ε) : e p ∈ ballImg e he x ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.mem_ballImg_inf
statement:
theorem mem_ballImg_inf {e : ℂ → ↑anP1} (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    {x y : ℂ} {εx εy : ℝ} {p : ℂ}
    (hp : p ∈ Metric.ball x εx ∩ Metric.ball y εy) :
    e p ∈ ballImg e he x εx ⊓ ballImg e he y εy
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_ballImg he hp.1, mem_ballImg he hp.2⟩

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.coe_ballImg_inf
statement:
theorem coe_ballImg_inf (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    (x y : ℂ) (εx εy : ℝ) :
    ((ballImg e he x εx ⊓ ballImg e he y εy : Opens ↑anP1) : Set ↑anP1) =
      e '' (Metric.ball x εx ∩ Metric.ball y εy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.coe_inf, coe_ballImg, coe_ballImg, ← Set.image_inter he.injective]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.preconnected_ballImg_inf
statement:
theorem preconnected_ballImg_inf (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    (x y : ℂ) (εx εy : ℝ) :
    IsPreconnected
      ((ballImg e he x εx ⊓ ballImg e he y εy : Opens ↑anP1) : Set ↑anP1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.coe_inf, coe_ballImg, coe_ballImg]
  exact image_inter_preconnected e he (convex_ball x εx) (convex_ball y εy)

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.ballImg_inf_empty
statement:
theorem ballImg_inf_empty {e : ℂ → ↑anP1} (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    {x y : ℂ} {εx εy : ℝ}
    (h : ¬ (Metric.ball x εx ∩ Metric.ball y εy).Nonempty) :
    ((ballImg e he x εx ⊓ ballImg e he y εy : Opens ↑anP1) : Set ↑anP1) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_ballImg_inf, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h, Set.image_empty]

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.prb0_isOpenEmbedding

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.range_prb0
statement: theorem range_prb0 : Set.range prb0 = (V0 : Set ↑anP1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Set.range prb0 =
      toSpace ProjectiveLine.structMor ⁻¹' Set.range ⇑chart0.hom :=
    PredicateAcceptance.range_probe ProjectiveLine.structMor chart0
  have hU0 : (U0 : p1.Opens) = Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0) := rfl
  have h1 : Set.range ⇑chart0.hom = ((U0 : p1.Opens) : Set p1) := by
    rw [hU0, ← Proj.opensRange_awayι 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0) (X_mem_grade_one 0)
      one_pos]
    rfl
  rw [h0, h1]
  rfl
