name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.cechCoboundary
statement:
theorem cechCoboundary : ∀ {κ : Type} (Us : κ → Set ℂ) (qc : κ → κ → ℚ),
    (∀ i, IsOpen (Us i)) → (∀ i, Convex ℝ (Us i)) →
    (⋃ i, Us i) = Set.univ →
    (∀ i j k, (Us i ∩ Us j ∩ Us k).Nonempty → qc i j + qc j k = qc i k) →
    ∃ b : κ → ℚ, ∀ i j, (Us i ∩ Us j).Nonempty → qc i j = b j - b i
proof:
:=
  fun Us qc hop hconv hcov hcoc =>
    HodgePilot.CechGoursat.exists_coboundary Us qc hop hconv hcov hcoc

name: HodgePilot.AnalyticWallB.isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_chartOpen
statement:
theorem isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_chartOpen {V : Opens ↑anP1}
    (e : ℂ → ↑anP1) (he : IsOpenEmbedding e)
    (hrange : Set.range e = (V : Set ↑anP1)) :
    HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (J := JAn) V FqAn
proof:
:= by
  intro B R fι g hfg hSE r
  classical
  haveI hmono : Mono fι := hSE.mono_f
  
  have hlift : ∀ x : ℂ, ∃ (ε : ℝ) (t : B.obj.obj (op (ballImg e he x ε)))
      (hle : ballImg e he x ε ≤ V), 0 < ε ∧
      g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x ε)) t = R.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op r := by
    intro x
    have hx : e x ∈ V := by
      have h1 : e x ∈ Set.range e := Set.mem_range_self x
      rwa [hrange] at h1
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, t0, hxW, ht0⟩ := exists_localLift g hSE.epi_g r (e x) hx
    have hopen : IsOpen (e ⁻¹' (W : Set ↑anP1)) :=
      W.isOpen.preimage he.continuous
    have hmem : x ∈ e ⁻¹' (W : Set ↑anP1) := hxW
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen x hmem
    have hleW : ballImg e he x ε ≤ W := by
      rintro p ⟨p', hp', rfl⟩
      exact hsub hp'
    refine ⟨ε, B.obj.map (homOfLE hleW).op t0, hleW.trans hWV, hε, ?_⟩
    have hnat : g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x ε))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE hleW).op t0) =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE hleW).op (g.hom.app (op W) t0) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
        g.hom.naturality]
    rw [hnat, ht0]
    exact smap_smap R hWV hleW (hleW.trans hWV) r
  choose εf tf hleV hεf htf using hlift
  
  have hcov : V ≤ iSup (fun x : ℂ => ballImg e he x (εf x)) := by
    intro p hp
    have hpr : p ∈ Set.range e := by rw [hrange]; exact hp
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hpr
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, mem_ballImg he (Metric.mem_ball_self (hεf x))⟩
  have hOV : ∀ x y : ℂ,
      ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ V :=
    fun x y => inf_le_left.trans (hleV x)
  
  have hdiff : ∀ x y : ℂ,
      g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
            ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x))).op (tf x) -
          B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
            ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y))).op (tf y)) = 0 := by
    intro x y
    rw [map_sub]
    have hnL : g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x))).op (tf x)) =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x))).op
          (g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x))) (tf x)) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
        g.hom.naturality]
    have hnR : g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y))).op (tf y)) =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y))).op
          (g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he y (εf y))) (tf y)) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
        g.hom.naturality]
    rw [hnL, hnR, htf x, htf y,
      smap_smap R (hleV x) inf_le_left (hOV x y) r,
      smap_smap R (hleV y) inf_le_right (hOV x y) r, sub_self]
  have hker : ∀ x y : ℂ, ∃ w : FqAn.obj.obj
      (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y))),
      fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y))) w =
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x))).op (tf x) -
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y))).op (tf y) :=
    fun x y => exists_kernelDiff hSE.exact hSE.mono_f _ (hdiff x y)
  choose w hw using hker
  
  have hqcex : ∀ x y : ℂ, ∃ qv : ℚ,
      (Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball y (εf y)).Nonempty →
      w x y = constSec qv (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)) := by
    intro x y
    by_cases h : (Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball y (εf y)).Nonempty
    · exact ⟨secVal (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)) (w x y)
        (e h.choose) (mem_ballImg_inf he h.choose_spec), fun _ =>
        eq_constSec_of_preconnected
          (preconnected_ballImg_inf e he x y (εf x) (εf y)) (w x y)
          (mem_ballImg_inf he h.choose_spec)⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
  choose qc hqc using hqcex
  
  have hcoc : ∀ x y z : ℂ, (Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball y (εf y) ∩
      Metric.ball z (εf z)).Nonempty → qc x y + qc y z = qc x z := by
    intro x y z htrip
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := htrip
    have hpxy : p ∈ Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball y (εf y) := hp.1
    have hpyz : p ∈ Metric.ball y (εf y) ∩ Metric.ball z (εf z) :=
      ⟨hp.1.2, hp.2⟩
    have hpxz : p ∈ Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball z (εf z) :=
      ⟨hp.1.1, hp.2⟩
    have hle_xy : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
        ballImg e he z (εf z) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) :=
      inf_le_left
    have hle_yz : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
        ballImg e he z (εf z) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z) :=
      le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right
    have hle_xz : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
        ballImg e he z (εf z) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z) :=
      le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right
    
    have hwT : FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle_xy).op (w x y) +
        FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle_yz).op (w y z) =
        FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle_xz).op (w x z) := by
      apply app_injective_of_mono fι
        (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z))
      rw [map_add]
      have hpair : ∀ (u v : ℂ) (hle : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z) ≤
          ballImg e he u (εf u) ⊓ ballImg e he v (εf v)),
          fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
            ballImg e he z (εf z)))
            (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op (w u v)) =
          B.obj.map (homOfLE (hle.trans inf_le_left)).op (tf u) -
            B.obj.map (homOfLE (hle.trans inf_le_right)).op (tf v) := by
        intro u v hle
        have hnat : fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
            ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z)))
            (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op (w u v)) =
            B.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op
              (fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he u (εf u) ⊓ ballImg e he v (εf v)))
                (w u v)) := by
          rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
            fι.hom.naturality]
        rw [hnat, hw u v, map_sub,
          smap_smap B inf_le_left hle (hle.trans inf_le_left) (tf u),
          smap_smap B inf_le_right hle (hle.trans inf_le_right) (tf v)]
      rw [hpair x y hle_xy, hpair y z hle_yz, hpair x z hle_xz]
      have hnormB : ∀ (u : ℂ) (h h' : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓ ballImg e he z (εf z) ≤
          ballImg e he u (εf u)),
          B.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (tf u) = B.obj.map (homOfLE h').op (tf u) :=
        fun u h h' => congrArg
          (fun (hh : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
            ballImg e he z (εf z) ⟶ ballImg e he u (εf u)) =>
            B.obj.map hh.op (tf u)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      rw [hnormB y (hle_xy.trans inf_le_right) (hle_yz.trans inf_le_left),
        hnormB z (hle_yz.trans inf_le_right) (hle_xz.trans inf_le_right),
        hnormB x (hle_xz.trans inf_le_left) (hle_xy.trans inf_le_left)]
      abel
    
    rw [hqc x y ⟨p, hpxy⟩, hqc y z ⟨p, hpyz⟩, hqc x z ⟨p, hpxz⟩,
      constSec_res, constSec_res, constSec_res, constSec_add] at hwT
    exact constSec_inj
      (⟨mem_ballImg_inf he hp.1, mem_ballImg he hp.2⟩ :
        (e p) ∈ ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y) ⊓
          ballImg e he z (εf z)) hwT
  
  obtain ⟨bC, hbC⟩ := cechCoboundary (fun x : ℂ => Metric.ball x (εf x)) qc
    (fun x => Metric.isOpen_ball) (fun x => convex_ball x (εf x))
    (Set.iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr fun p => ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hεf p)⟩)
    hcoc
  
  have hucompat : ∀ x y : ℂ,
      B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
        ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he x (εf x))).op
        (tf x - fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
          (constSec (- bC x) (ballImg e he x (εf x)))) =
      B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
        ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he y (εf y))).op
        (tf y - fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he y (εf y)))
          (constSec (- bC y) (ballImg e he y (εf y)))) := by
    intro x y
    by_cases hne : (Metric.ball x (εf x) ∩ Metric.ball y (εf y)).Nonempty
    · have hwc : w x y = constSec (- bC x - - bC y)
          (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)) := by
        rw [hqc x y hne]
        congr 1
        rw [hbC x y hne]
        ring
      have hnatc : ∀ (u : ℂ) (h : ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓
          ballImg e he y (εf y) ≤ ballImg e he u (εf u)),
          B.obj.map (homOfLE h).op
            (fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he u (εf u)))
              (constSec (- bC u) (ballImg e he u (εf u)))) =
          fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x) ⊓ ballImg e he y (εf y)))
            (FqAn.obj.map (homOfLE h).op
              (constSec (- bC u) (ballImg e he u (εf u)))) := by
        intro u h
        rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
          fι.hom.naturality]
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, hnatc x inf_le_left, hnatc y inf_le_right,
        constSec_res, constSec_res, sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub, ← hw x y,
        ← map_sub, constSec_sub, ← hwc]
    · exact sections_eq_of_empty B (ballImg_inf_empty he hne) _ _
  have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible B.1
      (fun x : ℂ => ballImg e he x (εf x))
      (fun x : ℂ => tf x - fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
        (constSec (- bC x) (ballImg e he x (εf x)))) :=
    fun x y => hucompat x y
  
  obtain ⟨tglue, htglue⟩ := exists_gluing
    (fun x : ℂ => ballImg e he x (εf x)) V hleV hcov B
    (fun x : ℂ => tf x - fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
      (constSec (- bC x) (ballImg e he x (εf x)))) hcomp
  refine ⟨tglue, ?_⟩
  apply sections_locality (fun x : ℂ => ballImg e he x (εf x)) V hleV hcov R
  intro x
  have hnat : R.obj.map (homOfLE (hleV x)).op (g.hom.app (op V) tglue) =
      g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (hleV x)).op tglue) := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
      g.hom.naturality]
  rw [hnat, htglue x, map_sub]
  have hzero : g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
      (fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))
        (constSec (- bC x) (ballImg e he x (εf x)))) = 0 := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
    have h0 : fι.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x))) ≫
        g.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x))) = 0 := by
      have h1 := congrArg
        (fun (z : FqAn ⟶ R) => z.hom.app (op (ballImg e he x (εf x)))) hfg
      simpa using h1
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  rw [hzero, sub_zero, htf x]

      chernShape Z M _ (𝟙 ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 1).obj M)) x from rfl,
    chernShape_apply]

    chernShape Z M L u x = hyperHMap Z u 2 (singleOneToHyper Z M x)
proof:

    (𝟙 ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 1).obj M)) u x

  exact h

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.singleOneToHyper_bijective
statement:
theorem singleOneToHyper_bijective (Z M : C) :
    Function.Bijective (singleOneToHyper Z M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI hIso : IsIso (singleShiftedHom M) := isIso_singleShiftedHom M
  haveI : IsIso ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
      (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
        (by lia)).inv.app _) :=
    inferInstance
  have hcomp : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext Z M 1,
      singleOneToHyper Z M x =
        Abelian.Ext.homAddEquiv x ≫
          ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
              (by lia)).inv.app _) := by
    intro x
    rw [singleOneToHyper_apply]
    rfl
  have hpost : Function.Bijective
      (fun (y : ShiftedHom ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =>
        y ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
            (by lia)).inv.app _)) := by
    have hp : (1 : ℤ) + ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (2 : ℤ) := by lia
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      have hab' : a ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
            (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
              hp).inv.app _) =
          b ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
            (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
              hp).inv.app _) := hab
      rwa [cancel_mono] at hab'
    · intro z
      refine ⟨z ≫ inv ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
        (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
        (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
          hp).inv.app _), ?_⟩
      show (z ≫ inv ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map
          (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
            hp).inv.app _)) ≫
          ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
            hp).inv.app _) = z
      rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hfun : ⇑(singleOneToHyper Z M) =
      (fun (y : ShiftedHom ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =>
        y ≫ ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).map (singleShiftedHom M) ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory C) (1 : ℤ) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (2 : ℤ)
            (by lia)).inv.app _)) ∘ ⇑(Abelian.Ext.homAddEquiv) :=
    funext hcomp
  rw [hfun]
  exact hpost.comp (AddEquiv.bijective _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.singleOneHyperEquiv_apply
statement:

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.singleOneToHyper_naturality
statement:
theorem singleOneToHyper_naturality (Z : C) {M N : C} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : Abelian.Ext Z M 1) :
    hyperHMap Z ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 1).map f) 2
        (singleOneToHyper Z M x) =
      singleOneToHyper Z N (x.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) (add_zero 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chernShape_eq_hyperHMap Z M _ ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 1).map f) x]
  rw [chernShape_apply, singleOneToHyper_apply]
  have hmid : hyperHMap M ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 1).map f) 1
      (singleShiftedHom M) =
      ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).hom).comp (singleShiftedHom N) (by lia) := by
    rw [Abelian.Ext.mk₀_hom, ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp]
    rw [hyperHMap_apply]
    exact (singleShiftedHom_naturality f).symm
  rw [hmid, Abelian.Ext.comp_hom]
  exact (ShiftedHom.comp_assoc x.hom (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).hom (singleShiftedHom N)
    (by lia) (by lia) (by lia)).symm

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.isZero_deRhamSheafAb
statement:
theorem isZero_deRhamSheafAb {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    IsZero (deRhamSheafAb φC m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  haveI : Subsingleton ((deRhamSheafAb φC m).obj.obj U) :=
    (CalibrationDegreeFour.subsingleton_DR_all U.unop hm)
  exact AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext (AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.isZero_truncOne_X
statement:
theorem isZero_truncOne_X (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 1) :
    IsZero ((brutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1).X n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : n < 1
  · exact isZero_brutalTruncGE_X _ 1 n hlt
  · rw [not_lt] at hlt
    have h2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hlt with h | h
      · lia
      · exact absurd h.symm hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = (m : ℤ) :=
      ⟨n.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by lia)).symm⟩
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h2
    exact (isZero_deRhamSheafAb hm).of_iso
      ((brutalTruncGEXIso (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1 (m : ℤ) (by lia)) ≪≫
        reindexZXIso (deRhamSheafComplexN φC) m)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.truncSingleXIso_one_hom
statement:
theorem truncSingleXIso_one_hom :
    (truncSingleXIso 1).hom =
      truncOneXOneIso.hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 1
          (deRhamSheafAb φC 1)).inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncSingleXIso
  rw [dif_pos rfl]
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, eqToIso.hom]
  rw [show eqToHom (congrArg (brutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1).X
      (rfl : (1 : ℤ) = 1)) = 𝟙 ((brutalTruncGE (deRhamSheafComplex φC) 1).X 1) from rfl]
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.chernOneSingle_comp_truncOneIso
statement:
theorem chernOneSingle_comp_truncOneIso :
    chernOneSingle φC ≫ truncOneIso.hom =
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) 1).map
        (dlogSheaf φC)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.from_single_hom_ext
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  rw [show (chernOneSingle φC).f 1 =
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 1 (unitsAffine p1)).hom ≫
        dlogSheaf φC ≫ (reindexZXIso (deRhamSheafComplexN φC) 1).inv ≫
        (brutalTruncGEXIso (reindexZ (deRhamSheafComplexN φC)) 1 1 le_rfl).inv from
    DLog.singleToBrutalTruncGE_f_one _ _]
  rw [show truncOneIso.hom.f 1 = (truncSingleXIso 1).hom from rfl]
  rw [truncSingleXIso_one_hom]
  rw [show truncOneXOneIso.hom =
      (brutalTruncGEXIso (reindexZ (deRhamSheafComplexN φC)) 1 1 le_rfl).hom ≫
        (reindexZXIso (deRhamSheafComplexN φC) 1).hom from rfl]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [show ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1) AddCommGrpCat.{0}) 1).map
        (dlogSheaf φC)).f 1 =
      ((HomologicalComplex.single
        (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1) AddCommGrpCat.{0})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 1).map (dlogSheaf φC)).f 1 from rfl]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.single_map_f_self]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineDetection.truncationBridgeAff_chernOneTrunc
statement:
theorem truncationBridgeAff_chernOneTrunc (x : unitsAffineH p1 1) :
    truncationBridgeAff (chernOneTrunc φC x) =
      Sheaf.H.map (dlogSheaf φC) 1 x
proof:
:= by
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1) AddCommGrpCat.{0})
  have h1 : DeRhamSpaceAgree.hyperHCongr
      (Iso.refl (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1)))
      truncOneIso 2 (chernOneTrunc φC x) =
      singleOneToHyper (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))
        (deRhamSheafAb φC 1) (Sheaf.H.map (dlogSheaf φC) 1 x) := by
    have hstep1 : DeRhamSpaceAgree.hyperHCongr
        (Iso.refl (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1)))
        truncOneIso 2 (chernOneTrunc φC x) =
        hyperHMap (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))
          truncOneIso.hom 2 (chernOneTrunc φC x) := by
      show (Iso.homCongr _ _) (chernOneTrunc φC x) = _
      rw [Iso.homCongr_apply, Functor.mapIso_refl, Iso.refl_inv, Category.id_comp,
        Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
      rfl
    rw [hstep1]
    have hstep2 : hyperHMap (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))
        truncOneIso.hom 2 (chernOneTrunc φC x) =
        chernShape (zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology p1))
          (unitsAffine p1) _ (chernOneSingle φC ≫ truncOneIso.hom) x :=
      (CycleClassOne.chernShape_comp_hyperHMap _ _ _ _ x).symm
    rw [hstep2, chernOneSingle_comp_truncOneIso, chernShape_eq_hyperHMap,
      singleOneToHyper_naturality]
    rfl
  show (singleOneHyperEquiv _ _).symm
    (DeRhamSpaceAgree.hyperHCongr _ truncOneIso 2 (chernOneTrunc φC x)) = _
  rw [h1, show singleOneToHyper (zConstSheaf _) (deRhamSheafAb φC 1)
      (Sheaf.H.map (dlogSheaf φC) 1 x) =
      singleOneHyperEquiv (zConstSheaf _) (deRhamSheafAb φC 1)
        (Sheaf.H.map (dlogSheaf φC) 1 x) from rfl]
  exact AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.componentGermHom_apply
statement:
theorem componentGermHom_apply (p : ℕ) (U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (s : ToType ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj (op U))) :
    componentGermHom c hx p U hxU s =
      germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx hxU)
        ((chartSectionEquiv c (U ⊓ sourceOpen c) (fun _ hz => hz.2) p)
          ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ U)).op s))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [componentGermHom, CategoryTheory.comp_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.componentGermHom_natural
statement:
theorem componentGermHom_natural (p : ℕ) ⦃U V : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))⦄
    (f : U ⟶ V) (u : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).fiber.obj U) :
    (formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map f.op ≫
        componentGermHom c hx p U u.down.down =
      componentGermHom c hx p V
        ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).fiber.map f u).down.down
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_res (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p)
      (imageOpen_mono c (inf_le_inf_right (sourceOpen c) (leOfHom f)))
      (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx u.down.down))
    ((chartSectionEquiv c (V ⊓ sourceOpen c) (fun _ hz => hz.2) p)
      ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ V)).op s))
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.germ_comp_chartStalkHom

theorem germ_comp_chartStalkHom (p : ℕ) {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}

    germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU ≫ chartStalkHom c hx p =
      componentGermHom c hx p U hxU
proof:
:=
  (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc
    (fun U u => componentGermHom c hx p U u.down.down)
    (componentGermHom_natural c hx p) U (fiberPt x hxU)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkHom_germ
statement:
theorem chartStalkHom_germ (p : ℕ) {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (s : ToType ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.obj (op U))) :
    chartStalkHom c hx p (germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU s) =
      germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx hxU)
        ((chartSectionEquiv c (U ⊓ sourceOpen c) (fun _ hz => hz.2) p)
          ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ U)).op s))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_comp_chartStalkHom c hx p hxU) s
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
  exact h.trans (componentGermHom_apply c hx p U hxU s)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkHom_injective
statement:
theorem chartStalkHom_injective (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (chartStalkHom c hx p)
proof:
:= by
  intro t₁ t₂ h
  obtain ⟨U, u, z₁, z₂, hz₁, hz₂⟩ :=
    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology x).toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective₂
      (P := (formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj) t₁ t₂
  have hxU : x ∈ U := u.down.down
  have hg₁ : germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU z₁ = t₁ := hz₁
  have hg₂ : germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU z₂ = t₂ := hz₂
  rw [← hg₁, ← hg₂] at h
  rw [chartStalkHom_germ c hx p hxU z₁, chartStalkHom_germ c hx p hxU z₂] at h
  obtain ⟨W, hy₀W, hWle, hres⟩ :=
    (germ_eq_iff (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p)
      (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx hxU) _ _).mp h
  
  set U' : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) :=
    (U ⊓ sourceOpen c) ⊓ chartPreimage c W with hU'def
  have hxU' : x ∈ U' := ⟨⟨hxU, hx⟩, hx, hy₀W⟩
  have hU'src : ∀ z, z ∈ U' → z ∈ c.1.source := fun _ hz => hz.1.2
  have hU'U : U' ≤ U := le_trans inf_le_left inf_le_left
  have him : imageOpen c U' ≤ W :=
    imageOpen_le_of_le_chartPreimage c (inf_le_right : U' ≤ chartPreimage c W)
  have hres' : (formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map (homOfLE hU'U).op z₁ =
      (formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map (homOfLE hU'U).op z₂ := by
    refine (chartSectionEquiv c U' hU'src p).injective ?_
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres) ⟨(y : Fin d → ℂ), him y.2⟩
  rw [← hg₁, ← hg₂]
  exact (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU z₁ z₂).mpr
    ⟨U', hxU', hU'U, hres'⟩

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkHom_surjective
statement:
theorem chartStalkHom_surjective (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (chartStalkHom c hx p)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  obtain ⟨W, hy₀W, g, hg⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p) t
  set U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) := chartPreimage c W with hUdef
  have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hx, hy₀W⟩
  have hUsrc : ∀ z, z ∈ U → z ∈ c.1.source := fun _ hz => hz.1
  have him : imageOpen c U ≤ W :=
    imageOpen_le_of_le_chartPreimage c le_rfl
  refine ⟨germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) hxU
    ((chartSectionEquiv c U hUsrc p).symm
      ((formSheafAb d p).obj.map (homOfLE him).op g)), ?_⟩
  rw [chartStalkHom_germ c hx p hxU]
  rw [chartSectionEquiv_map c (inf_le_left : U ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ U) hUsrc
    (fun _ hz => hz.2) p]
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hr1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_res (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p) (imageOpen_mono c inf_le_left)
      (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx hxU))
    ((formSheafAb d p).obj.map (homOfLE him).op g)
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hr1
  have hr2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_res (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d p) him
      (mem_imageOpen_of_source c hx hxU)) g
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hr2
  exact hr1.trans (hr2.trans hg)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem chartStalkEquiv_apply (p : ℕ)
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d p))) :
    chartStalkEquiv c hx p t = chartStalkHom c hx p t
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkHom_map_d
statement:
theorem chartStalkHom_map_d (p : ℕ)
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d p))) :
    chartStalkHom c hx (p + 1) ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) t) =
      (stalkAt (c.1 x)).map (dSheafForms d p) (chartStalkHom c hx p t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, hs⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective x (formSheafChartsAb sX d p) t
  rw [← hs]
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_naturality x (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) hxU) s
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1, chartStalkHom_germ c hx (p + 1) hxU, chartStalkHom_germ c hx p hxU]
  
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    ((dSheafFormsCharts sX d p).hom.naturality
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ U)).op) s
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hnat
  rw [← hnat]
  
  rw [chartSectionEquiv_dSection c (U ⊓ sourceOpen c) (fun _ hz => hz.2) p]
  
  have hg := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_naturality (c.1 x) (dSheafForms d p) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx hxU))
    ((chartSectionEquiv c (U ⊓ sourceOpen c) (fun _ hz => hz.2) p)
      ((formSheafChartsAb sX d p).obj.map
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ sourceOpen c ≤ U)).op s))
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hg
  exact hg.symm

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkEquiv_d
statement:
theorem chartStalkEquiv_d (p : ℕ)
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d p))) :

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.chartStalkHom_germ_constFamily
statement:
theorem chartStalkHom_germ_constFamily {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}

    chartStalkHom c hx 0
        (germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) hxU (constFamily sX d U z)) =

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_augmentCharts_stalkConstIso_inv
statement:
theorem stalk_augmentCharts_stalkConstIso_inv (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
    {U : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hx : x ∈ U) (z : ULift.{0} ℂ) :
    (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d)
        ((stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv z) =
      germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) hx (constFamily sX d U z.down)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : germ x (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) hx
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) z) =
      (stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv z := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toSheafify_comp_germ x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) hx) z
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (augmentCharts sX d) hx)
    ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
      ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) z)
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  
  have h2 : (augmentCharts sX d).hom.app (op U)
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) z) =
      constFamily sX d U z.down := by
    have hnat := NatTrans.congr_app (toSheafify_comp_augmentCharts sX d) (op U)
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hnat z
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  exact (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) t) h0.symm).trans
    (h1.trans (congrArg (fun t => germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) hx t) h2))

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_exact_pos_chart
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_pos_chart (c : GluedChart sX d) {x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}
    (hx : x ∈ c.1.source) (p : ℕ)
    (s : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d (p + 1))))
    (hs : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1)) s = 0) :
    ∃ t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d p)),
      (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) t = s
proof:
:= by
  
  have hds : (stalkAt (c.1 x)).map (dSheafForms d (p + 1))
      (chartStalkHom c hx (p + 1) s) = 0 := by
    rw [← chartStalkHom_map_d c hx (p + 1) s, hs]
    exact map_zero (chartStalkHom c hx (p + 2)).hom
  
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := PolydiscResolution.stalk_exact_pos d p (c.1 x)
    (chartStalkHom c hx (p + 1) s) hds
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := chartStalkHom_surjective c hx p t'
  refine ⟨t, chartStalkHom_injective c hx (p + 1) ?_⟩
  rw [chartStalkHom_map_d c hx p t, ht]
  exact ht'

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_exact_deg0_chart
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_deg0_chart (c : GluedChart sX d) {x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))}
    (hx : x ∈ c.1.source)
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0)))
    (ht : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0) t = 0) :
    ∃ z : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))),
      (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) z = t
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdt : (stalkAt (c.1 x)).map (dSheafForms d 0) (chartStalkHom c hx 0 t) = 0 := by
    rw [← chartStalkHom_map_d c hx 0 t, ht]
    exact map_zero (chartStalkHom c hx 1).hom
  
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := PolydiscResolution.stalk_exact_deg0 d (c.1 x)
    (chartStalkHom c hx 0 t) hdt
  set ζ : ULift.{0} ℂ :=
    (stalkConstIso (X := TopCat.of (Fin d → ℂ)) (c.1 x) (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).hom z' with hζ
  refine ⟨(stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv ζ,
    chartStalkHom_injective c hx 0 ?_⟩
  have htop : x ∈ (⊤ : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) := trivial
  calc chartStalkHom c hx 0 ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d)
        ((stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv ζ))
      = chartStalkHom c hx 0
          (germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop (constFamily sX d ⊤ ζ.down)) := by
        rw [stalk_augmentCharts_stalkConstIso_inv sX d x htop ζ]
    _ = germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop)
          (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (⊤ ⊓ sourceOpen c))) ζ.down) :=
        chartStalkHom_germ_constFamily c hx htop ζ.down
    _ = (stalkAt (c.1 x)).map (augment d)
          ((stalkConstIso (X := TopCat.of (Fin d → ℂ)) (c.1 x) (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv ζ) :=
        (PolydiscResolution.stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv d (c.1 x)
          (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop) ζ).symm
    _ = (stalkAt (c.1 x)).map (augment d) z' := by
        rw [hζ, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]
    _ = chartStalkHom c hx 0 t := hz'

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_augmentCharts_injective_chart
statement:
theorem stalk_augmentCharts_injective_chart (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))} (hx : x ∈ c.1.source) :
    Function.Injective ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have htop : x ∈ (⊤ : Opens (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) := trivial
  set e := stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) with he
  
  have hcd : germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop
      (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom a).down) =
      germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop
        (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom b).down) := by
    calc germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom a).down)
        = (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) (e.inv (e.hom a)) :=
          (stalk_augmentCharts_stalkConstIso_inv sX d x htop (e.hom a)).symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) a :=
          congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) t)
            (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a)
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) b := hab
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) (e.inv (e.hom b)) :=
          (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) t)
            (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)).symm
      _ = germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop
            (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom b).down) :=
          stalk_augmentCharts_stalkConstIso_inv sX d x htop (e.hom b)
  
  have hmodel : germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop)
      (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (⊤ ⊓ sourceOpen c))) (e.hom a).down) =
      germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop)
        (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (⊤ ⊓ sourceOpen c))) (e.hom b).down) := by
    calc germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop)
          (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (⊤ ⊓ sourceOpen c))) (e.hom a).down)
        = chartStalkHom c hx 0 (germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop
            (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom a).down)) :=
          (chartStalkHom_germ_constFamily c hx htop (e.hom a).down).symm
      _ = chartStalkHom c hx 0 (germ x (formSheafChartsAb sX d 0) htop
            (constFamily sX d ⊤ (e.hom b).down)) :=
          congrArg (fun t => chartStalkHom c hx 0 t) hcd
      _ = germ (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0) (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop)
            (constFormSection d (op (imageOpen c (⊤ ⊓ sourceOpen c))) (e.hom b).down) :=
          chartStalkHom_germ_constFamily c hx htop (e.hom b).down
  
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ :=
    (germ_eq_iff (c.1 x) (formSheafAb d 0)
      (mem_imageOpen_inf_source c hx htop) _ _).mp hmodel
  have heval : ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) (Fin 0)
      (e.hom a).down =
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down :=
    congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres) ⟨c.1 x, hxV⟩
  have hdown : (e.hom a).down = (e.hom b).down := by
    have h1 : (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom a).down) =
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down) :=
      congrArg (fun φ => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm φ) heval
    exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom a).down).symm.trans
      (h1.trans ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom b).down))
  have hab' : e.hom a = e.hom b := ULift.ext _ _ hdown
  exact ((Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => e.inv t) hab')).trans (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_exact_pos_charts
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_pos_charts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)

    (hs : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1)) s = 0) :
    ∃ t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafChartsAb sX d p)),
      (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) t = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_gluedChart_mem_source sX d x
  exact stalk_exact_pos_chart c hc p s hs

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_augmentCharts_injective
statement:
theorem stalk_augmentCharts_injective (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) :

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_d_charts
statement:
theorem stalk_d_charts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) (d p : ℕ)
    (x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (stalkReindexCharts sX d p x).hom ≫
        (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) ≫
          (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hde : (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (reindexZXIso (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) p).hom ≫
        dSheafFormsCharts sX d p ≫
          (reindexZXIso (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) (p + 1)).inv := by
    have h := reindexZ_d_eq (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) p (p + 1)
    rw [analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN_d] at h
    exact h
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f) hde).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map
    (reindexZXIso (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) p).hom ≫ t)
    ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.stalk_augmentSingleCharts_f_zero
statement:
theorem stalk_augmentSingleCharts_f_zero (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        (augmentSingleCharts sX d)).f 0 =
      (stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom ≫ (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) ≫
        (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f)
    (augmentSingleCharts_f_zero sX d)).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
    (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))).hom ≫ t)
    ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.quasiIso_stalk_augmentSingleCharts
statement:
theorem quasiIso_stalk_augmentSingleCharts (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (x : ↑(TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) :
    QuasiIso (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (augmentSingleCharts sX d))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hSx : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology
        (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))))).X m) := fun m hm =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 _ m hm)
  have hTneg : ∀ m : ℤ, m < 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)).X m) := fun m hm =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_reindexZ_X (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsN sX d) m hm)
  
  have hexact : ∀ (W : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat ℤ) (m : ℤ),
      IsZero (W.X m) → W.ExactAt m := by
    intro W m h
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff]
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ h
  
  have hd_app : ∀ (p : ℕ) (u : ToType ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)).X (p : ℤ))),
      (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) u =
      (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).inv
        ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p)
          ((stalkReindexCharts sX d p x).hom u)) := by
    intro p u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_d_charts sX d p x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans
      (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  
  have hf_app : ∀ u, ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (augmentSingleCharts sX d)).f 0) u =
      (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d)
        ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom u)) := by
    intro u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_augmentSingleCharts_f_zero sX d x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans
      (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  rw [quasiIso_iff]
  intro m
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | h0
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (augmentSingleCharts sX d)) (-1) 0 1
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; norm_num) (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; norm_num)]
    have hf₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))))).f = 0 :=
      (hSx (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    have hg₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))))).g = 0 :=
      (hSx 1 (by decide)).eq_of_tgt _ _
    have hf₂ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d))).f = 0 :=
      (hTneg (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    rw [ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros
      ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).map
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
          (augmentSingleCharts sX d)))
      hf₁ hg₁ hf₂]
    constructor
    · 
      rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
      intro t ht
      
      have hdt : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
          ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom t) = 0 := by
        have h2 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
              ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom t)) = 0 :=
          (hd_app 0 t).symm.trans ht
        have h3 := congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).hom u) h2
        have h4 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).hom ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
              ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom t))) =
            (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d 0)
              ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom t) :=
          Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x) _
        have h5 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).hom (0 : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj
            ((analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d).X ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) = 0 :=
          map_zero (stalkReindexCharts sX d 1 x).hom.hom
        exact h4.symm.trans (h3.trans h5)
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := stalk_exact_deg0_charts sX d x
        ((stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom t) hdt
      refine ⟨(stalkSingle0Charts sX x).inv z', ?_⟩
      exact (hf_app ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).inv z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) u))
          (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkSingle0Charts sX x) z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv u) hz').trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x) t)))
    · 
      show Mono ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        (augmentSingleCharts sX d)).f 0)
      rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
      intro a b hab
      have h1 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom a)) =
          (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom b)) :=
        (hf_app a).symm.trans (hab.trans (hf_app b))
      have h2 : (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom a) =
          (stalkAt x).map (augmentCharts sX d) ((stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom b) :=
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x) _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x).hom u) h1).trans
            (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d 0 x) _))
      have h3 : (stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom a = (stalkSingle0Charts sX x).hom b :=
        stalk_augmentCharts_injective sX d x h2
      exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0Charts sX x) a).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkSingle0Charts sX x).inv u) h3).trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0Charts sX x) b))
  rcases (show m < 0 ∨ 0 ≤ m by lia) with hneg | hpos
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (augmentSingleCharts sX d)) m (hexact _ _ (hSx m h0))]
    exact hexact _ _ (hTneg m hneg)
  · 
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ : ∃ p' : ℕ, m = (p' : ℤ) :=
      ⟨m.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos).symm⟩
    have hp'0 : p' ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, p' = p + 1 := ⟨p' - 1, by lia⟩
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (augmentSingleCharts sX d)) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (hexact _ _ (hSx ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) h0))]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d)) ((p : ℕ) : ℤ)
      ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((p + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; push_cast; ring)
      (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; push_cast; ring)]
    rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
    intro s hs
    
    have hds : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1))
        ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).hom s) = 0 := by
      have h2 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1))
            ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).hom s)) = 0 :=
        (hd_app (p + 1) s).symm.trans hs
      have h3 := congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).hom u) h2
      have h4 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).hom
          ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1))
            ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).hom s))) =
          (stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d (p + 1))
            ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).hom s) :=
        Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x) _
      have h5 : (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).hom (0 : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj
          ((analyticDeRhamComplexChartsZ sX d).X ((p + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) = 0 :=
        map_zero (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 2) x).hom.hom
      exact h4.symm.trans (h3.trans h5)
    obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := stalk_exact_pos_charts sX d p x
      ((stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).hom s) hds
    refine ⟨(stalkReindexCharts sX d p x).inv t', ?_⟩
    exact (hd_app p ((stalkReindexCharts sX d p x).inv t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafFormsCharts sX d p) u))
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d p x) t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x).inv u) ht').trans
        (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindexCharts sX d (p + 1) x) s)))

name: HodgePilot.ChartsResolution.analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv_apply (sX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d sX] (m : ℕ)
    (z : Betti.bettiC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)) m) :
    analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv sX d m z =
      sheafHyperHMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
        (zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))))
        (augmentSingleCharts sX d) (m : ℤ)
        (sheafHyperHSingleEquiv (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (SPoints sX)))
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (SPoints sX))) m z)
proof:
:=

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.X_mem_grade_one

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.chartEval_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartEval_algebraMap (i : Fin 2) (lam c : ℂ) :
    chartEval i lam (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have hval : (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c).val =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)
        (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))
        (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
    rw [algebraMap_away_apply]
    show Localization.mk _ 1 = _
    rw [Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap,
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [chartEval, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, hval,
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, MvPolynomial.eval_C]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.chartEval_coordFrac
statement:
theorem chartEval_coordFrac {i j : Fin 2} (hij : j ≠ i) (lam : ℂ) :
    chartEval i lam (coordFrac i j) = lam
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEval, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    coordFrac_val,
    Localization.awayLift_mk (hv := by rw [MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_self, one_mul]),
    MvPolynomial.eval_X, chartEvalPt_other hij, one_pow, mul_one]

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.chartPolyHom_injective
statement:
theorem chartPolyHom_injective {i j : Fin 2} (hij : j ≠ i) :
    Function.Injective (chartPolyHom i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro p hp
  have key : ∀ lam : ℂ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => lam) p = 0 := by
    intro lam
    have hcomp : (chartEval i lam).comp (chartPolyHom i j).toRingHom =
        MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ : Fin 1 => lam) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c
        rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
        show chartEval i lam (chartPolyHom i j (MvPolynomial.C c)) = _
        rw [chartPolyHom_C, chartEval_algebraMap, MvPolynomial.eval_C]
      · intro k
        rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
        show chartEval i lam (chartPolyHom i j (MvPolynomial.X k)) = _
        rw [chartPolyHom_X, chartEval_coordFrac hij, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp p
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    show MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ : Fin 1 => lam) p = 0
    rw [← this]
    show chartEval i lam (chartPolyHom i j p) = 0
    rw [hp, map_zero]
  apply MvPolynomial.funext (R := ℂ)
  intro x
  have hx : x = fun _ => x 0 := funext fun k => by rw [Subsingleton.elim k 0]
  rw [map_zero, hx]
  exact key (x 0)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.adjoin_range_X_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_range_X_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₂ 0)
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro a _
  have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]; trivial
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℂ
      (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤
      Subalgebra.restrictScalars ℂ (Algebra.adjoin (𝒜₂ 0)
        (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ))) :=
    Algebra.adjoin_le fun s hs => Algebra.subset_adjoin hs
  exact (Subalgebra.mem_restrictScalars ℂ).mp (hle ha)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.chartPolyHom_surjective
statement:
theorem chartPolyHom_surjective {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Function.Surjective (chartPolyHom i j)
proof:
:= by
  have huniv : ({i, j} : Finset (Fin 2)) = Finset.univ :=
    Finset.eq_univ_of_card _
      ((Finset.card_pair_eq_two_iff.mpr hij).trans (Fintype.card_fin 2).symm)
  intro x
  have htop := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.adjoin_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
    (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) (X_mem_grade_one i) (Fin 2) MvPolynomial.X adjoin_range_X_eq_top
    (fun _ => 1) (fun k => X_mem_grade_one k)
  have hx := htop.ge (Algebra.mem_top (x := x))
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ai, hai, -, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hsum : ai i + ai j = a := by
      have h3 : (∑ k, ai k) = a := by simpa using hai
      rw [← h3, ← huniv, Finset.sum_pair hij]
    subst hsum
    refine ⟨MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ ai j, ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [map_pow, chartPolyHom_X, HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow, coordFrac_val,
      Localization.mk_pow, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
      Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    use 1
    have hprod : (∏ k, MvPolynomial.X k ^ ai k : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X i ^ ai i * MvPolynomial.X j ^ ai j := by
      rw [← huniv, Finset.prod_pair hij]
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, hprod]
    ring
  | algebraMap r =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := gradeZero_algebraMap_bijective.2 r
    exact ⟨MvPolynomial.C c,
      (chartPolyHom_C i j c).trans
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℂ (𝒜₂ 0) (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p * q, map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.polyChartEquiv_apply

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.away_unit_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem away_unit_eq_algebraMap {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (u : (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))ˣ) :
    ∃ c : ℂˣ, (u : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hCc⟩ :=
    (MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced
      (P := chartPolyEquiv i j hij (u : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).mp
      (u.isUnit.map (chartPolyEquiv i j hij))
  have h2 : (u : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      (chartPolyEquiv i j hij).symm (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
    rw [← hCc, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h3 : (chartPolyEquiv i j hij).symm (MvPolynomial.C c) =
      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    exact AlgEquiv.commutes _ c
  refine ⟨hc.unit, ?_⟩
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]
  exact h2.trans h3

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.germK_awaySection_algebraMap
statement:
theorem germK_awaySection_algebraMap (i j : Fin 2)
    (hx : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)
    (c : ℂ) :
    germK (genericPoint_mem_basicX i)
      (awaySection (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)) = constK c
proof:
:= by
  have hres := Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) (X_mem_grade_one j) hx
  have hpt := congrArg
    (fun t : CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) ⟶
        Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
      t (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)) hres
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hpt
  
  
  have hmap : awayMap 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one j) hx
      (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c) =
      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) c := by
    rw [algebraMap_away_apply, awayMap_fromZeroRingHom]
    rfl
  rw [germK_apply,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply p1.presheaf
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, hx⟩)) (genericPoint p1)
      genericPoint_mem_basicX01]
  show p1.presheaf.germ _ (genericPoint p1) genericPoint_mem_basicX01
      ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, hx⟩)).op)
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)
          (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c))) = constK c
  rw [← hpt]
  exact congrArg (fun z : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) =>
    p1.presheaf.germ (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1))
      (genericPoint p1) genericPoint_mem_basicX01
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) z)) hmap

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.polyToK_C

      algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0)) c :=
    chartPolyHom_C 0 1 c
  show germK (genericPoint_mem_basicX 0)
      (awaySection (MvPolynomial.X 0)
        ((polyChartEquiv 0 1 zero_ne_one_fin) (MvPolynomial.C c))) = constK c
  rw [h1]
  exact germK_awaySection_algebraMap 0 1 rfl c

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.awayMap_coordFrac
statement:
theorem awayMap_coordFrac :
    awayMap 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 1)
      (rfl : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) (coordFrac 0 1) = awayNum
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  have h1 : (awayMap 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 1)
      (rfl : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) (coordFrac 0 1)).val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 1)
        (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
          Submonoid.powers
            (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
    rw [show coordFrac 0 1 = HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜₂ (X_mem_grade_one 0) 1
        (MvPolynomial.X 1) ((one_smul ℕ 1).symm ▸ X_mem_grade_one 1) from rfl,
      awayMap_mk]
    exact HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _
  have h2 : (awayNum).val =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
        (⟨(MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ 1, 1, rfl⟩ :
          Submonoid.powers
            (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ)) :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _
  rw [h1, h2, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  use 1
  ring

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.polyToK_X
statement:
theorem polyToK_X :
    polyToK (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      germK genericPoint_mem_basicX01
        (awaySection (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) awayNum)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (polyChartEquiv 0 1 zero_ne_one_fin) (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      coordFrac 0 1 :=
    chartPolyHom_X 0 1 0
  show germK (genericPoint_mem_basicX 0)
      (awaySection (MvPolynomial.X 0)
        ((polyChartEquiv 0 1 zero_ne_one_fin) (MvPolynomial.X 0))) = _
  rw [h1]
  have hres := Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (𝒜 := 𝒜₂) (X_mem_grade_one 1)
    (rfl : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)
  have hpt := congrArg
    (fun t : CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0)) ⟶
        Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =>
      t (coordFrac 0 1)) hres
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at hpt
  rw [germK_apply,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply p1.presheaf
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩)) (genericPoint p1)
      genericPoint_mem_basicX01]
  show p1.presheaf.germ _ (genericPoint p1) genericPoint_mem_basicX01
      ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono _ _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩)).op)
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0) (coordFrac 0 1))) = _
  rw [← hpt]
  exact congrArg (fun z : Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) =>
    p1.presheaf.germ (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1))
      (genericPoint p1) genericPoint_mem_basicX01
      (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) z)) awayMap_coordFrac

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.polyToK_X_ne_C
statement:
theorem polyToK_X_ne_C (c : ℂ) :
    polyToK (MvPolynomial.X 0) ≠ polyToK (MvPolynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hXC := polyToK_injective h
  have h1 : (MvPolynomial.X (R := ℂ) (0 : Fin 1)).totalDegree = 1 :=
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X 0

  exact zero_ne_one h1

theorem cartier_sections_extraction (U : X.Opens)

    ∃ t : (unitsAb X).obj.obj (op U), (unitsToK X).hom.app (op U) t = s
proof:

  TopCat.Sheaf.sections_exact_of_left_exact
    (S := (cartierSC X : ShortComplex (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} (X : TopCat))))
    (cartierSC_shortExact X).exact (cartierSC_shortExact X).mono_f s h

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.cdivSectionsEquiv_divOf
statement:
theorem cdivSectionsEquiv_divOf (f : Additive (X.functionField)ˣ) :
    cdivSectionsEquiv X (divOf X f) =
      (divisorsπ X).hom.app (op (⊤ : X.Opens)) ((kSectionsTopEquiv X).symm f)
proof:
:=
  calc cdivSectionsEquiv X (divOf X f)
      = Sheaf.H.equiv₀ (divisorsAb X) (opensTopIsTerminal X)
          (Sheaf.H.map (divisorsπ X) 0 ((kUnitsH0Equiv X).symm f)) := rfl
    _ = (divisorsπ X).hom.app (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
          (Sheaf.H.equiv₀ (KUnitsAb X) (opensTopIsTerminal X)
            ((kUnitsH0Equiv X).symm f)) :=
        (Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality (opensTopIsTerminal X) (divisorsπ X) _).symm
    _ = (divisorsπ X).hom.app (op (⊤ : X.Opens)) ((kSectionsTopEquiv X).symm f) :=
        congrArg _ ((Sheaf.H.equiv₀ (KUnitsAb X)
          (opensTopIsTerminal X)).apply_symm_apply _)

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.divisorsπ_app_restrict
statement:
theorem divisorsπ_app_restrict {W W' : p1.Opens} (i : W' ⟶ W)
    (s : (KUnitsAb p1).obj.obj (op W)) :
    (divisorsAb p1).obj.map i.op ((divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op W) s) =
      (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op W') ((KUnitsAb p1).obj.map i.op s)
proof:
:= by
  show ((divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op W) ≫ (divisorsAb p1).obj.map i.op) s = _
  rw [← (divisorsπ p1).hom.naturality]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.dinfTopSection_restrict_U0
statement:
theorem dinfTopSection_restrict_U0 :
    (divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE (le_top : U0 ≤ ⊤)).op dinfTopSection =
      dinfLeft
proof:
:= by
  show (divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op
      ((divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge).op
        (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1)))) = dinfLeft
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  have harr : (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge).op ≫ (homOfLE (le_top : U0 ≤ ⊤)).op =
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₂₄).op := by
    rw [← op_comp]
    exact congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [harr]
  exact dinfGlued_restrict_left

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.dinfTopSection_restrict_U1
statement:
theorem dinfTopSection_restrict_U1 :
    (divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE (le_top : U1 ≤ ⊤)).op dinfTopSection =
      0
proof:
:= by
  show (divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op
      ((divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge).op
        (dinfGlued : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op (U0 ⊔ U1)))) =
    (0 : (divisorsAb p1).obj.obj (op U1))
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  have harr : (homOfLE U0_sup_U1.ge).op ≫ (homOfLE (le_top : U1 ≤ ⊤)).op =
      ((Opens.mayerVietorisSquare U0 U1).f₃₄).op := by
    rw [← op_comp]
    exact congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [harr]
  exact dinfGlued_restrict_right

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.exists_unit_factor_U0
statement:
theorem exists_unit_factor_U0 (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ)
    (hf : divOf p1 f = dinf) :
    ∃ t : (unitsAb p1).obj.obj (op U0),
      germUnitsHom p1 genericPoint_mem_U0 t = f - zeltK
proof:
:= by
  have hTop : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op (⊤ : p1.Opens))
      ((kSectionsTopEquiv p1).symm f) = dinfTopSection := by
    have h1 := cdivSectionsEquiv_divOf p1 f
    rw [hf] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact (cdivSectionsEquiv p1).apply_symm_apply dinfTopSection
  have hres0 : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) (kSec f genericPoint_mem_U0) =
      (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0) (zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) := by
    have h2 := congrArg
      ((divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE (le_top : U0 ≤ ⊤)).op) hTop
    rw [divisorsπ_app_restrict, dinfTopSection_restrict_U0,
      kSectionsTopEquiv_symm_eq,
      kSec_restrict f (homOfLE le_top) (Opens.mem_top (genericPoint p1))
        genericPoint_mem_U0] at h2
    rw [h2]
    rfl
  have hzero : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U0)
      (kSec f genericPoint_mem_U0 - zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hres0, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cartier_sections_extraction p1 U0 _ hzero
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [unitsToK_app_of_mem p1 (U := op U0) genericPoint_mem_U0] at ht
  have hsub : kSec f genericPoint_mem_U0 - zSectionK genericPoint_mem_U0 =
      eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p1 genericPoint_mem_U0).symm (f - zeltK) := by
    rw [map_sub]
    rfl
  rw [hsub, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at ht
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p1 genericPoint_mem_U0).symm) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
  exact hinj ht

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.exists_unit_factor_U1
statement:
theorem exists_unit_factor_U1 (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ)
    (hf : divOf p1 f = dinf) :
    ∃ t : (unitsAb p1).obj.obj (op U1),
      germUnitsHom p1 genericPoint_mem_U1 t = f
proof:
:= by
  have hTop : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op (⊤ : p1.Opens))
      ((kSectionsTopEquiv p1).symm f) = dinfTopSection := by
    have h1 := cdivSectionsEquiv_divOf p1 f
    rw [hf] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact (cdivSectionsEquiv p1).apply_symm_apply dinfTopSection
  have hzero : (divisorsπ p1).hom.app (op U1)
      (kSec f genericPoint_mem_U1) = 0 := by
    have h2 := congrArg
      ((divisorsAb p1).obj.map (homOfLE (le_top : U1 ≤ ⊤)).op) hTop
    rw [divisorsπ_app_restrict, dinfTopSection_restrict_U1,
      kSectionsTopEquiv_symm_eq,
      kSec_restrict f (homOfLE le_top) (Opens.mem_top (genericPoint p1))
        genericPoint_mem_U1] at h2
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cartier_sections_extraction p1 U1 _ hzero
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [unitsToK_app_of_mem p1 (U := op U1) genericPoint_mem_U1,
    CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at ht
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (eqToHom (KUnitsAb_obj_of_mem p1 genericPoint_mem_U1).symm) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
  exact hinj ht

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.section_unit_germ_eq_const
statement:
theorem section_unit_germ_eq_const {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hx : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)
    (u : (Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))ˣ) :
    ∃ c : ℂˣ, germK (genericPoint_mem_basicX i)
      (u : Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) = constK c
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_awayToSection (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos
  let e := (asIso (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂
    (MvPolynomial.X i))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := away_unit_eq_algebraMap hij (Units.map e.symm.toMonoidHom u)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (u : Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
      awaySection (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c) := by
    have h0 : (u : Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
        e (e.symm (u : Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) :=
      (e.apply_symm_apply _).symm
    rw [h0,
      show e.symm (u : Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
        algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c from hc]
    rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact germK_awaySection_algebraMap i j hx c

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.germUnits_factor_embUnits
statement:
theorem germUnits_factor_embUnits (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hx : (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) =
      MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j)
    (h : genericPoint p1 ∈ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))
    (t : (unitsAb p1).obj.obj (op (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) :
    ∃ c : ℂˣ, (Additive.toMul (germUnitsHom p1 h t) : (p1.functionField)ˣ) =
      embUnits c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := section_unit_germ_eq_const hij hx
    (Additive.toMul t : (Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))ˣ)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  rw [toMul_germUnitsHom]
  show germK h ((Additive.toMul t :
      (Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))ˣ) :
    Γ(p1, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) = _
  rw [show germK h = germK (genericPoint_mem_basicX i) from rfl, hc]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.zElt_toMul_val
statement:
theorem zElt_toMul_val :
    ((Additive.toMul zeltK : (p1.functionField)ˣ) : p1.functionField) =
      polyToK (MvPolynomial.X 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyToK_X]
  show germK genericPoint_mem_U01 (overlapRingHom awayNum) =
    germK genericPoint_mem_basicX01
      (awaySection (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) awayNum)
  rw [germK_apply, germK_apply]
  show p1.presheaf.germ (U0 ⊓ U1) (genericPoint p1) genericPoint_mem_U01
      ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq U0_inf_U1)).op)
        (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) awayNum)) = _
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProjectiveLineUnits.divOf_ne_dinf
statement:
theorem divOf_ne_dinf (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ) :
    divOf p1 f ≠ dinf
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_unit_factor_U0 f hf
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1⟩ := exists_unit_factor_U1 f hf
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0⟩ := germUnits_factor_embUnits 0 1 zero_ne_one_fin rfl
    genericPoint_mem_U0 t0
  obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := germUnits_factor_embUnits 1 0 zero_ne_one_fin.symm
    (mul_comm _ _) genericPoint_mem_U1 t1
  have h0 : (Additive.toMul (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ) :
      (p1.functionField)ˣ) / Additive.toMul zeltK = embUnits c0 :=
    (toMul_sub f zeltK).symm.trans
      ((congrArg Additive.toMul ht0).symm.trans hc0)
  have h1 : (Additive.toMul (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ) :
      (p1.functionField)ˣ) = embUnits c1 :=
    (congrArg Additive.toMul ht1).symm.trans hc1
  have hZc : (Additive.toMul zeltK : (p1.functionField)ˣ) =
      embUnits (c0⁻¹ * c1) := by
    have hZ : (Additive.toMul zeltK : (p1.functionField)ˣ) =
        (embUnits c0)⁻¹ * Additive.toMul (f : Additive (p1.functionField)ˣ) :=
      eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq.mpr (div_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp h0).symm
    rw [hZ, h1, map_mul, map_inv]
  have hval := congrArg Units.val hZc
  rw [zElt_toMul_val] at hval
  have hval2 : polyToK (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      constK ((c0⁻¹ * c1 : ℂˣ) : ℂ) := hval
  rw [← polyToK_C] at hval2
  exact polyToK_X_ne_C _ hval2

name: HodgePilot.DeRham.map_drWedge
statement:
theorem map_drWedge (ψ : B →ₐ[A] B') (p q : ℕ) (x : DR A B p) (y : DR A B q) :
    DeRham.map ψ (p + q) (drWedge A B p q x y) =
      drWedge A B' p q (DeRham.map ψ p x) (DeRham.map ψ q y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add f g hf hg =>
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [hf, hg]
  | single t s =>
      induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero]
      | add f g hf hg =>
          simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add]
          rw [hf, hg]
      | single t' s' =>
          rw [drWedge_gen, map_mk_single, map_mk_single, map_mk_single,
            drWedge_gen, comp_append, map_mul]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamWedgeChain.wedgePresheafZ_d
statement:
theorem wedgePresheafZ_d (i j : ℕ) :
    wedgePresheafZ φ i j ≫ dPresheafZ φ (i + j) =
      (dPresheafZ φ i ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (presheafZ φ j)) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ (i + 1) j ≫
          (presheafZCongr φ (Nat.add_right_comm i 1 j)).hom +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) •
          ((𝟙 (presheafZ φ i) ⊗ₘ dPresheafZ φ j) ≫ wedgePresheafZ φ i (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  rw [NatTrans.app_add, NatTrans.app_zsmul, NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.comp_app,
    NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.comp_app]
  refine ModuleCat.hom_ext (TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => ?_)
  have happ : ∀ (M N : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) (c : ℤ) (F : M ⟶ N) (z : M),
      (c • F) z = c • F z := fun M N c F z =>
    map_zsmul
      ({ toFun := fun G => G z, map_zero' := rfl, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl } :
        (M ⟶ N) →+ N) c F
  show DeRham.d R (Sec φ U.unop.toOpens) (i + j)
      ((wedgePresheafZ φ i j).app U (x ⊗ₜ y)) =
    (presheafZCongr φ (Nat.add_right_comm i 1 j)).hom.app U
        ((wedgePresheafZ φ (i + 1) j).app U
          (((dPresheafZ φ i ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (presheafZ φ j)).app U) (x ⊗ₜ y))) +
      (((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) •
        ((𝟙 (presheafZ φ i) ⊗ₘ dPresheafZ φ j).app U ≫
          (wedgePresheafZ φ i (j + 1)).app U)) (x ⊗ₜ y)
  rw [happ]
  have key := @d_drWedge R (Sec φ U.unop.toOpens) _
    (DeRhamPresheaf.instCommRingSec φ U.unop.toOpens)
    (DeRhamPresheaf.instAlgebraSec φ U.unop.toOpens) i j x y
  rw [← presheafZCongr_hom_app_apply φ (Nat.add_right_comm i 1 j) U] at key
  exact key
