name: HodgePilot.DeRhamWedgeChain.wedgeSheafZ_def
statement:
private theorem wedgeSheafZ_def (i j : ℕ) :
    wedgeSheafZ φ i j =
      (presheafToSheaf _ _).map (wedgePresheafZ φ i j) ≫
        counitAt (deRhamSheafZ φ (i + j))
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamWedgeChain.map_comp_counit
statement:
private theorem map_comp_counit
    {P : (X.AffineZariskiSiteᵒᵖ) ⥤ ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    {H H' : Sheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X)
      (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)}
    (w : P ⟶ H.obj) (g : H ⟶ H') :
    ((presheafToSheaf _ _).map w ≫ counitAt H) ≫ g =
      (presheafToSheaf _ _).map (w ≫ g.hom) ≫ counitAt H'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, counitAt_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]

name: HodgePilot.DeRhamWedgeChain.wedgeSheafZ_d
statement:
theorem wedgeSheafZ_d (i j : ℕ) :
    wedgeSheafZ φ i j ≫ dSheafZ φ (i + j) =
      (presheafToSheaf _ _).map (dPresheafZ φ i ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (presheafZ φ j)) ≫
          wedgeSheafZ φ (i + 1) j ≫
            (sheafZCongr φ (Nat.add_right_comm i 1 j)).hom +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) •
          ((presheafToSheaf _ _).map (𝟙 (presheafZ φ i) ⊗ₘ dPresheafZ φ j) ≫
            wedgeSheafZ φ i (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeSheafZ_def, wedgeSheafZ_def, wedgeSheafZ_def, map_comp_counit,
    map_comp_counit, dSheafZ_hom, sheafZCongr_hom_hom,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, wedgePresheafZ_d,
    Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Functor.map_zsmul,
    Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
  exact rfl

name: HodgePilot.conjQ_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem conjQ_apply (z : ℂ) : conjQ z = (starRingEnd ℂ) z
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaQR_tmul (c : ℂ) (v : V) :
    sigmaQR V (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigmaQR, TensorProduct.map_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_involutive
statement: theorem sigmaQR_involutive (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) : sigmaQR V (sigmaQR V x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c v => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_smul
statement:
theorem sigmaQR_smul (c : ℂ) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    sigmaQR V (c • x) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c • sigmaQR V x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c' v =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', sigmaQR_tmul, sigmaQR_tmul,
        TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQ_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem sigmaQ_apply (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) : sigmaQ V x = sigmaQR V x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQ_sigmaQ
statement: theorem sigmaQ_sigmaQ (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) : sigmaQ V (sigmaQ V x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigmaQR_involutive]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQ_surjective
statement: theorem sigmaQ_surjective : Function.Surjective (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:=
  fun x => ⟨sigmaQ V x, sigmaQ_sigmaQ V x⟩

name: HodgePilot.sigmaZR_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaZR_tmul (c : ℂ) (w : W) :
    sigmaZR W (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] w) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] w
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaZR_involutive
statement: theorem sigmaZR_involutive (x : ℂ ⊗[ℤ] W) : sigmaZR W (sigmaZR W x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c w => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: HodgePilot.SubHodge.mem_baseChange_iff
statement:
theorem SubHodge.mem_baseChange_iff (N : SubHodge h) {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V} :
    x ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ
      ↔ x ∈ LinearMap.range (N.toSubmodule.subtype.baseChange ℂ)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.sub_H
statement:
@[simp] theorem QHodgeStructure.sub_H (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (N : SubHodge h)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (h.sub N).H pq = (h.H pq).comap (N.toSubmodule.subtype.baseChange ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SubHodge.mem_sub_H_iff
statement:
theorem SubHodge.mem_sub_H_iff (N : SubHodge h) {pq : ℤ × ℤ}
    {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ↥N.toSubmodule} :
    x ∈ (h.sub N).H pq
      ↔ N.toSubmodule.subtype.baseChange ℂ x ∈ h.H pq
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: HodgePilot.SubHodge.incl_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem SubHodge.incl_toLinearMap (N : SubHodge h) :
    N.incl.toLinearMap = N.toSubmodule.subtype
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SubHodge.baseChange_eq_biSup
statement:
theorem SubHodge.baseChange_eq_biSup (N : SubHodge h) :
    N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ
      = ⨆ pq : ℤ × ℤ, (N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ ⊓ h.H pq)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun pq => inf_le_left)
  intro x hx
  have hfin : {pq : ℤ × ℤ | h.H pq ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, ((h.isInternal.proj pq x : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
        = x :=
    h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj x fun pq hpq => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hpq
  rw [← hdecomp]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun pq _ => ?_
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem pq
    (Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨N.proj_stable pq x hx, (h.isInternal.proj pq x).2⟩)

name: HodgePilot.restrict_baseChangeℂ
statement:
theorem restrict_baseChangeℂ (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V) (p : Submodule ℚ V)
    (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ↥p) :
    baseChangeℂ (B.restrict p) x y
      = baseChangeℂ B (p.subtype.baseChange ℂ x) (p.subtype.baseChange ℂ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₁, hx₂]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => simp only [map_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, baseChangeℂ,
            LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
          rfl

name: HodgePilot.baseChangeℂ_sigmaQ_sigmaQ
statement:
theorem baseChangeℂ_sigmaQ_sigmaQ (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    baseChangeℂ B (sigmaQ V x) (sigmaQ V y)
      = starRingEnd ℂ (baseChangeℂ B x y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₁, hx₂]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => simp only [map_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | tmul d w =>
          rw [sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQR_tmul, sigmaQR_tmul]
          simp only [baseChangeℂ, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
          calc (B v w) • (starRingEnd ℂ c * starRingEnd ℂ d)
              = (B v w) • starRingEnd ℂ (c * d) := by rw [map_mul]
            _ = starRingEnd ℂ ((B v w) • (c * d)) :=
                (conjQ.map_smul (B v w) (c * d)).symm

name: HodgePilot.baseChangeℂ_pairing_eq_zero
statement:
theorem baseChangeℂ_pairing_eq_zero (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    {p r : Submodule ℚ V} (hpr : ∀ v ∈ p, ∀ w ∈ r, B v w = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ p.baseChange ℂ, ∀ y ∈ r.baseChange ℂ, baseChangeℂ B x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hx
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hy
  clear hx hy
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add t₁ t₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, baseChangeℂ,
            LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
          rw [show B (p.subtype v) (r.subtype w) = 0 from hpr v v.2 w w.2,
            zero_smul]

name: HodgePilot.forall_baseChange_pairing_one_tmul
statement:
theorem forall_baseChange_pairing_one_tmul (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    {p : Submodule ℚ V} {v : V} (hB : ∀ w ∈ p, B w v = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ p.baseChange ℂ, baseChangeℂ B x ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hx
  clear hx
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  | tmul c w =>
      simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, baseChangeℂ,
        LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
      rw [show B (p.subtype w) v = 0 from hB w w.2, zero_smul]

name: Submodule.baseChange_sup
statement:
theorem _root_.Submodule.baseChange_sup {R A M : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (p r : Submodule R M) :
    (p ⊔ r).baseChange A = p.baseChange A ⊔ r.baseChange A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le (Submodule.baseChange_mono A le_sup_left)
    (Submodule.baseChange_mono A le_sup_right))
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hx
  clear hx
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | tmul c z =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, w, hw, hyw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp z.2
      have hz : (p ⊔ r).subtype z = y + w := hyw.symm
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hz, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem c hy))
        (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem c hw))

name: Submodule.baseChange_sup_of_codisjoint
statement:
theorem _root_.Submodule.baseChange_sup_of_codisjoint {R A M : Type*}
    [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    {p r : Submodule R M} (h : Codisjoint p r) :
    p.baseChange A ⊔ r.baseChange A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.baseChange_sup, codisjoint_iff.mp h, Submodule.baseChange_top]

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.isRefl
statement:
theorem Polarization.isRefl {h : QHodgeStructure n V} (P : Polarization h) :
    P.form.IsRefl
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hs := P.symm x y
  rw [hxy] at hs
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hs.symm with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 (zpow_ne_zero n (by norm_num))
  · exact h1

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.apply_proj_right
statement:
theorem Polarization.apply_proj_right (P : Polarization h) {a b : ℤ}
    {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V} (hx : x ∈ h.H (a, b)) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    baseChangeℂ P.form x y
      = baseChangeℂ P.form x
          ((h.isInternal.proj (b, a) y : h.H (b, a)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {pq : ℤ × ℤ | h.H pq ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ pq ∈ insert (b, a) hfin.toFinset,
          ((h.isInternal.proj pq y : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = y :=
    h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj y fun pq hpq =>
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hpq)
  conv_lhs => rw [← hdecomp]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (b, a) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) ?_
  intro pq _ hne
  obtain ⟨p', q'⟩ := pq
  exact P.orthogonal a b p' q' hne x hx _ (h.isInternal.proj (p', q') y).2

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.apply_proj_left
statement:
theorem Polarization.apply_proj_left (P : Polarization h) {p q : ℤ}
    {y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V} (hy : y ∈ h.H (p, q)) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :
    baseChangeℂ P.form x y
      = baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((h.isInternal.proj (q, p) x : h.H (q, p)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {pq : ℤ × ℤ | h.H pq ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ pq ∈ insert (q, p) hfin.toFinset,
          ((h.isInternal.proj pq x : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = x :=
    h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj x fun pq hpq =>
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hpq)
  conv_lhs => rw [← hdecomp]
  rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (q, p) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) ?_
  intro pq _ hne
  obtain ⟨a', b'⟩ := pq
  refine P.orthogonal a' b' p q (fun hc => hne ?_) _
    (h.isInternal.proj (a', b') x).2 y hy
  exact Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hc).symm (congrArg Prod.fst hc).symm

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.baseChange_separating
statement:
theorem Polarization.baseChange_separating (P : Polarization h)
    (N : SubHodge h) {z : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V} (hz : z ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ)
    (horth : ∀ x ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ, baseChangeℂ P.form x z = 0) :
    z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {pq : ℤ × ℤ | h.H pq ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h.isInternal.submodule_iSupIndep
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ pq ∈ hfin.toFinset, ((h.isInternal.proj pq z : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
        = z :=
    h.isInternal.sum_coe_proj z fun pq hpq => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hpq
  have hpiece : ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ,
      ((h.isInternal.proj pq z : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = 0 := by
    intro pq
    obtain ⟨p, q⟩ := pq
    by_cases hn : p + q = n
    · by_contra hne
      have hmemH : ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ h.H (p, q) := (h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z).2
      have hmemN : ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ := N.proj_stable (p, q) z hz
      have hσH : sigmaQ V ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ h.H (q, p) := by
        rw [← h.conj_symm p q]
        exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hmemH
      have hσN : sigmaQ V ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hmemN
        exact LinearMap.mem_range.mpr
          ⟨sigmaQ ↥N.toSubmodule u, by rw [← sigmaQ_baseChange, hu]⟩
      
      
      have h0 : baseChangeℂ P.form
          (sigmaQ V ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = 0 :=
        (P.apply_proj_right hσH z).symm.trans (horth _ hσN)
      
      have hflip : baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          (sigmaQ V ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
          = 0 := by
        have hc := baseChangeℂ_sigmaQ_sigmaQ P.form
          (sigmaQ V ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V))
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
        rw [sigmaQ_sigmaQ] at hc
        rw [hc, h0, map_zero]
      
      have hpos := P.positive p q hn _ hmemH hne
      rw [hflip, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    · exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (h.supported (p, q) hn) _
        (h.isInternal.proj (p, q) z).2
  rw [← hdecomp]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun pq _ => hpiece pq

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.restrict_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem Polarization.restrict_nondegenerate (P : Polarization h)
    (N : SubHodge h) : (P.form.restrict N.toSubmodule).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  have hrefl : (P.form.restrict N.toSubmodule).IsRefl :=
    fun x y hxy => P.isRefl _ _ hxy
  refine (LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft hrefl).mpr ?_
  intro v hv
  have hB : ∀ w ∈ N.toSubmodule, P.form w (v : V) = 0 := fun w hw =>
    P.isRefl _ _ (hv ⟨w, hw⟩)
  have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (v : V) = 0 :=
    P.baseChange_separating N
      (Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem 1 v.2)
      (forall_baseChange_pairing_one_tmul P.form hB)
  have h2 : (v : V) = 0 := by
    rwa [Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  exact Subtype.ext h2

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.isCompl_orthogonal
statement:
theorem Polarization.isCompl_orthogonal (P : Polarization h) (N : SubHodge h) :
    IsCompl N.toSubmodule (P.form.orthogonal N.toSubmodule)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate
    P.isRefl (P.restrict_nondegenerate N)

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.baseChange_orthogonal
statement:
theorem Polarization.baseChange_orthogonal (P : Polarization h)
    (N : SubHodge h) :
    (P.form.orthogonal N.toSubmodule).baseChange ℂ
      = (baseChangeℂ P.form).orthogonal (N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff.mpr fun x hx =>
      baseChangeℂ_pairing_eq_zero P.form
        (p := N.toSubmodule) (r := P.form.orthogonal N.toSubmodule)
        (fun v hv w hw => hw v hv) x hx y hy
  · intro y hy
    have hymem : y ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ
        ⊔ (P.form.orthogonal N.toSubmodule).baseChange ℂ := by
      rw [Submodule.baseChange_sup_of_codisjoint
        (P.isCompl_orthogonal N).codisjoint]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hymem
    have hworth : ∀ x ∈ N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ,
        baseChangeℂ P.form x w = 0 := fun x hx =>
      baseChangeℂ_pairing_eq_zero P.form
        (p := N.toSubmodule) (r := P.form.orthogonal N.toSubmodule)
        (fun v hv w' hw' => hw' v hv) x hx w hw
    have hu0 : u = 0 := by
      refine P.baseChange_separating N hu fun x hx => ?_
      have h1 : baseChangeℂ P.form x (u + w) = 0 := by
        rw [huw]
        exact hy x hx
      rw [map_add, hworth x hx, add_zero] at h1
      exact h1
    rw [← huw, hu0, zero_add]
    exact hw

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.proj_mem_orthogonal
statement:
theorem Polarization.proj_mem_orthogonal (P : Polarization h)
    (N : SubHodge h) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) {y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V}
    (hy : y ∈ (baseChangeℂ P.form).orthogonal (N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ)) :
    ((h.isInternal.proj pq y : h.H pq) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
      ∈ (baseChangeℂ P.form).orthogonal (N.toSubmodule.baseChange ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q⟩ := pq
  refine LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff.mpr fun x hx => ?_
  have h1 : baseChangeℂ P.form x
      ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) y : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
      = baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((h.isInternal.proj (q, p) x : h.H (q, p)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) y : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :=
    P.apply_proj_left (h.isInternal.proj (p, q) y).2 x
  have h2 : baseChangeℂ P.form
      ((h.isInternal.proj (q, p) x : h.H (q, p)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) y
      = baseChangeℂ P.form
          ((h.isInternal.proj (q, p) x : h.H (q, p)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)
          ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) y : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) :=
    P.apply_proj_right (h.isInternal.proj (q, p) x).2 y
  show baseChangeℂ P.form x
      ((h.isInternal.proj (p, q) y : h.H (p, q)) : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) = 0
  rw [h1, ← h2]
  exact hy _ (N.proj_stable (q, p) x hx)

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.orthoComplement_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem Polarization.orthoComplement_toSubmodule (P : Polarization h)

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.sumHom_bijective
statement:
theorem Polarization.sumHom_bijective (P : Polarization h) (N : SubHodge h) :
    Function.Bijective (P.sumHom N).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have hcompl := P.isCompl_orthogonal N
  have heq : ⇑(P.sumHom N).toLinearMap
      = ⇑(Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl _ _ hcompl) := by
    funext z
    rw [Submodule.coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl']
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl _ _ hcompl).bijective

name: HodgePilot.Polarization.hermitian_re_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0
    simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re, le_refl]
  · exact le_of_lt (P.positive p q hpq x hx hx0)

name: HodgePilot.prodBilinForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem prodBilinForm_apply (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (x y : V × W) :
    prodBilinForm B C x y = B x.1 y.1 + C x.2 y.2
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.prodBilinForm_baseChangeℂ
statement:
theorem prodBilinForm_baseChangeℂ (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V)
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (z w : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] (V × W)) :
    baseChangeℂ (prodBilinForm B C) z w
      = baseChangeℂ B ((LinearMap.fst ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ z)
            ((LinearMap.fst ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ w)
        + baseChangeℂ C ((LinearMap.snd ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ z)
            ((LinearMap.snd ℚ V W).baseChange ℂ w)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
  | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hz₁, hz₂]
      ring
  | tmul c v =>
      induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, add_zero]
      | add w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ =>
          simp only [map_add, hw₁, hw₂]
          ring
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, baseChangeℂ,
            LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.fst_apply,
            LinearMap.snd_apply]
          rw [show prodBilinForm B C v w = B v.1 w.1 + C v.2 w.2 from rfl,
            add_smul]

statement:

    (G : (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AZ) :
    T.map (tensorSheafify G) =
      ((T.map (sheafToPresheaf _ _)).map (tensorRight G)).map (presheafToSheaf _ _)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.fiber_splitting_map_tensorSheafify
statement:
theorem fiber_splitting_map_tensorSheafify
    {T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ)}
    (G : (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AZ) (p : ↑X)
    (σ : (T.map ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).Splitting) :
    Nonempty (((T.map (tensorSheafify G)).map
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).Splitting)
proof:
:=
  ⟨ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIso
    (σ.map (tensorRight ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).presheafFiber.obj G)))
    (T.mapNatIso (sheafFiberTensorSheafifyIso G p)).symm⟩

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.shortExact_of_forall_fiber_splitting
statement:
theorem shortExact_of_forall_fiber_splitting
    (W : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ))
    (h : ∀ p : ↑X, Nonempty ((W.map
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).Splitting)) :
    W.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : ∀ p : ↑X,
      ((W.map ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ)))).ShortExact :=
    fun p => (h p).some.shortExact
  have hP := Opens.isConservativeFamilyOfPoints_pointsGrothendieckTopology (X : Type 0)
  haveI hm : ∀ Φ : (Opens.pointsGrothendieckTopology (↑X : Type 0)).FullSubcategory,
      Mono ((Φ.obj.sheafFiber (A := AZ)).map W.f) := by
    rintro ⟨Φo, ⟨p⟩⟩
    exact (hfib p).mono_f
  haveI hmono : Mono W.f := (hP.jointlyReflectMonomorphisms AZ).mono W.f
  haveI he : ∀ Φ : (Opens.pointsGrothendieckTopology (↑X : Type 0)).FullSubcategory,
      Epi ((Φ.obj.sheafFiber (A := AZ)).map W.g) := by
    rintro ⟨Φo, ⟨p⟩⟩
    exact (hfib p).epi_g
  haveI hepi : Epi W.g := (hP.jointlyReflectEpimorphisms AZ).epi W.g
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ hmono hepi
  rw [ShortComplex.exact_iff_isZero_homology, IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply (hP.jointlyFaithful AZ).map_injective
  rintro ⟨Φo, ⟨p⟩⟩
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Functor.map_zero, ← IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  exact ((W.map _).exact_iff_isZero_homology.1 (hfib p).exact).of_iso
    (W.mapHomologyIso _).symm

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.shortExact_map_tensorSheafify
statement:
theorem shortExact_map_tensorSheafify
    (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ))
    (G : (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AZ)
    (h : ∀ p : ↑X, Nonempty ((T.map
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).Splitting)) :
    (T.map (tensorSheafify G)).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  shortExact_of_forall_fiber_splitting _ fun p =>
    fiber_splitting_map_tensorSheafify G p (h p).some

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.pbSES_map_tensorSheafify_shortExact
statement:
theorem pbSES_map_tensorSheafify_shortExact
    {S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    {W : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ} (x : W ⟶ S.X₃)
    (G : (Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AZ)
    (hproj : ∀ p : ↑X,
      Projective (((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ)).obj W)) :
    ((pbSES S x).map (tensorSheafify G)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply shortExact_map_tensorSheafify
  intro p
  have hfib : ((pbSES S x).map
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).ShortExact :=
    (pbSES_shortExact x hS).map_of_exact _
  letI : Projective ((pbSES S x).map
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ))).X₃ := hproj p
  exact ⟨hfib.splittingOfProjective⟩

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.projective_sheafFiber_of_free
statement:
theorem projective_sheafFiber_of_free
    {W : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ} (p : ↑X)
    (hfree : Nonempty
      (((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ)).obj W ≅
        ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)) :
    Projective (((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ)).obj W)

  Projective.of_iso hfree.some.symm inferInstance

name: HodgePilot.CycSplitEngine.projective_sheafFiber_unit
statement:
theorem projective_sheafFiber_unit (p : ↑X) :
    Projective (((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber (A := AZ)).obj
      (𝟙_ (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AZ)))
proof:

  Projective.of_iso
    (Functor.Monoidal.εIso ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).sheafFiber))
    (inferInstanceAs (Projective (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv
statement:
theorem stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
    {U : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))} (hx : x ∈ U) (c : ULift.{0} ℂ) :
    (stalkAt x).map (augment n)
        ((stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv c) =
      germ x (formSheafAb n 0) hx (constFormSection n (op U) c.down)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : germ x (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) hx
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c) =
      (stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv c := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toSheafify_comp_germ x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) hx) c
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (augment n) hx)
    ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
      ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c)
  rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  
  have h2 : (augment n).hom.app (op U)
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)))).app (op U) c) =
      constFormSection n (op U) c.down := by
    have hnat := NatTrans.congr_app (toSheafify_comp_augment n) (op U)
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hnat c
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  exact (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment n) t) h0.symm).trans
    (h1.trans (congrArg (fun t => germ x (formSheafAb n 0) hx t) h2))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_augment_injective
statement:
theorem stalk_augment_injective (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) :
    Function.Injective ((stalkAt x).map (augment n))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have htop : x ∈ (⊤ : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) := trivial
  set e := stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ)) with he
  
  have hcd : germ x (formSheafAb n 0) htop (constFormSection n (op ⊤) (e.hom a).down) =
      germ x (formSheafAb n 0) htop (constFormSection n (op ⊤) (e.hom b).down) := by
    calc germ x (formSheafAb n 0) htop (constFormSection n (op ⊤) (e.hom a).down)
        = (stalkAt x).map (augment n) (e.inv (e.hom a)) :=
          (stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv n x htop (e.hom a)).symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment n) a :=
          congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment n) t) (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a)
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment n) b := hab
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (augment n) (e.inv (e.hom b)) :=
          (congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (augment n) t) (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)).symm
      _ = germ x (formSheafAb n 0) htop (constFormSection n (op ⊤) (e.hom b).down) :=
          stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv n x htop (e.hom b)
  
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ := (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafAb n 0) htop _ _).mp hcd
  have heval : ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom a).down =
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down :=
    congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres) ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have hdown : (e.hom a).down = (e.hom b).down := by
    have h1 : (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom a).down) =
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) (e.hom b).down) :=
      congrArg (fun φ => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm φ) heval
    exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom a).down).symm.trans
      (h1.trans ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ
        (Fin 0)).symm_apply_apply (e.hom b).down))
  have hab' : e.hom a = e.hom b := ULift.ext _ _ hdown
  exact ((Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e a).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => e.inv t) hab')).trans (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e b)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_exact_deg0
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_deg0 (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
    (t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb n 0)))
    (ht : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) t = 0) :
    ∃ z : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))),
      (stalkAt x).map (augment n) z = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, g, hg⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective x (formSheafAb n 0) t
  
  have h1 : germ x (formSheafAb n 1) hxU (dSection g) = 0 := by
    have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (dSheafForms n 0) hxU) g
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h2
    calc germ x (formSheafAb n 1) hxU (dSection g)
        = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) (germ x (formSheafAb n 0) hxU g) := h2.symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) t :=
          congrArg (fun u => (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) u) hg
      _ = 0 := ht
  have hzero : germ x (formSheafAb n 1) hxU 0 = 0 :=
    map_zero (germ x (formSheafAb n 1) hxU).hom
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ :=
    (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafAb n 1) hxU (dSection g) 0).mp (h1.trans hzero.symm)
  have hres0 : (formSheafAb n 1).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op (dSection g) = 0 := by
    rw [hres]
    exact map_zero ((formSheafAb n 1).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hBV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp V.isOpen x hxV
  have hd0 : ∀ y ∈ ball x r, extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres0) ⟨y, hBV hy⟩
  have hgan : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sectionExtendV g) (ball x r) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV g).mono (fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy))
  have hconst := PolydiscPoincare.const_of_extDeriv_eq_zero_ball hgan hd0
  have hxball : x ∈ ball x r := mem_ball_self hr0
  set c : ℂ :=
    (ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ (Fin 0)).symm
      (sectionExtendV g x) with hc
  set B : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)) := ⟨ball x r, isOpen_ball⟩
  have hxB : x ∈ B := hxball
  have hBU : B ≤ U := fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy)
  
  have hrestr : (formSheafAb n 0).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op g =
      constFormSection n (op B) c := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    show g.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩ =
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) c
    calc g.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩ = sectionExtendV g y.1 :=
          (sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g (hBU y.2)).symm
      _ = sectionExtendV g x := hconst y.1 y.2 x hxball
      _ = ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) (Fin 0) c := by
          rw [hc]
          exact ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.constOfIsEmptyLIE ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) ℂ
            (Fin 0)).apply_symm_apply _).symm
  refine ⟨(stalkConstIso x (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{0} ℂ))).inv ⟨c⟩, ?_⟩
  have hstep3 : germ x (formSheafAb n 0) hxB
      ((formSheafAb n 0).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op g) =
      germ x (formSheafAb n 0) (hBU hxB) g := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_res x (formSheafAb n 0) hBU hxB) g
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  exact (stalk_augment_stalkConstIso_inv n x hxB ⟨c⟩).trans
    ((congrArg (fun s => germ x (formSheafAb n 0) hxB s) hrestr.symm).trans
      (hstep3.trans hg))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_exact_pos
statement:
theorem stalk_exact_pos (n p : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
    (s : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb n (p + 1))))
    (hs : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) s = 0) :
    ∃ t : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj (formSheafAb n p)),
      (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n p) t = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf⟩ := germ_jointly_surjective x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) s
  
  have h1 : germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 2)) hxU (dSection f) = 0 := by
    have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) hxU) f
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h2
    calc germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 2)) hxU (dSection f)
        = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1))
            (germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) hxU f) := h2.symm
      _ = (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) s :=
          congrArg (fun u => (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) u) hf
      _ = 0 := hs
  have hzero : germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 2)) hxU 0 = 0 :=
    map_zero (germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 2)) hxU).hom
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, hres⟩ :=
    (germ_eq_iff x (formSheafAb n (p + 2)) hxU (dSection f) 0).mp (h1.trans hzero.symm)
  have hres0 : (formSheafAb n (p + 2)).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op (dSection f) = 0 := by
    rw [hres]
    exact map_zero ((formSheafAb n (p + 2)).obj.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hBV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp V.isOpen x hxV
  have hd0 : ∀ y ∈ ball x r, extDeriv (sectionExtendV f) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hres0) ⟨y, hBV hy⟩
  have hfan : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sectionExtendV f) (ball x r) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_sectionExtendV f).mono (fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy))
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηan, hηd⟩ := PolydiscPoincare.exists_primitive_form_ball hfan hd0
  set B : Opens ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)) := ⟨ball x r, isOpen_ball⟩
  have hxB : x ∈ B := mem_ball_self hr0
  have hBU : B ≤ U := fun y hy => hVU (hBV hy)
  
  set g := sectionOfAnalyticOnNhdV (U := B) hηan with hgdef
  refine ⟨germ x (formSheafAb n p) hxB g, ?_⟩
  
  have hd : dSection g = (formSheafAb n (p + 1)).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op f := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
    show extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y.1 = f.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩
    have heq : sectionExtendV g =ᶠ[nhds (y.1 : Fin n → ℂ)] η :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (B.isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
        (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem g hz)
    calc extDeriv (sectionExtendV g) y.1 = extDeriv η y.1 := heq.extDeriv_eq
      _ = sectionExtendV f y.1 := hηd y.1 y.2
      _ = f.1 ⟨y.1, hBU y.2⟩ := sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem f (hBU y.2)
  calc (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n p) (germ x (formSheafAb n p) hxB g)
      = germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) hxB ((dSheafForms n p).hom.app (op B) g) := by
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_naturality x (dSheafForms n p) hxB) g
        rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
        exact h
    _ = germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) hxB
          ((formSheafAb n (p + 1)).obj.map (homOfLE hBU).op f) :=
        congrArg (fun u => germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) hxB u) hd
    _ = germ x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) (hBU hxB) f := by
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (germ_res x (formSheafAb n (p + 1)) hBU hxB) f
        rw [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h
        exact h
    _ = s := hf

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.resolutionMap_f_zero
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_f_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (resolutionMap n).f 0 =
      (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))).hom ≫
        augment n ≫ (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) 0).inv
proof:
:=
  DiscResolution.singleZeroToReindexZ_f_zero _ _

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_d
statement:
theorem stalk_d (n p : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n)).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (stalkReindex n p x).hom ≫ (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n p) ≫
        (stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hde : (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) p).hom ≫ dSheafForms n p ≫
        (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) (p + 1)).inv := by
    have h := reindexZ_d_eq (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) p (p + 1)
    rw [holomorphicDeRhamComplexN_d] at h
    exact h
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f) hde).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map
    (reindexZXIso (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) p).hom ≫ t) ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero
statement:
theorem stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) :
    (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (resolutionMap n)).f 0 =
      (stalkSingle0 n x).hom ≫ (stalkAt x).map (augment n) ≫ (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (fun f => (stalkAt x).map f) (resolutionMap_f_zero n)).trans ?_
  refine ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun t => (stalkAt x).map (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
    (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))).hom ≫ t) ((stalkAt x).map_comp _ _)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.quasiIso_stalk_resolutionMap
statement:
theorem quasiIso_stalk_resolutionMap (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) :
    QuasiIso (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (resolutionMap n))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hSx : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology
        (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))))).X m) := fun m hm =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 _ m hm)
  have hTneg : ∀ m : ℤ, m < 0 → IsZero ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n)).X m) := fun m hm =>
    (stalkAt x).map_isZero (isZero_reindexZ_X (holomorphicDeRhamComplexN n) m hm)
  
  have hexact : ∀ (W : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat ℤ) (m : ℤ),
      IsZero (W.X m) → W.ExactAt m := by
    intro W m h
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff]
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ h
  
  have hd_app : ∀ (p : ℕ) (u : ToType ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n)).X (p : ℤ))),
      (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n)).d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) u =
      (stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).inv
        ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n p) ((stalkReindex n p x).hom u)) := by
    intro p u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_d n p x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  
  have hf_app : ∀ u, ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (resolutionMap n)).f 0) u =
      (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (augment n) ((stalkSingle0 n x).hom u)) := by
    intro u
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (stalk_resolutionMap_f_zero n x) u
    exact h.trans ((CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ u).trans (CategoryTheory.comp_apply _ _ _))
  rw [quasiIso_iff]
  intro m
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | h0
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (resolutionMap n)) (-1) 0 1
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; norm_num) (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; norm_num)]
    have hf₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))))).f = 0 :=
      (hSx (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    have hg₁ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((single (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
            AddCommGrpCat) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))))).g = 0 :=
      (hSx 1 (by decide)).eq_of_tgt _ _
    have hf₂ : ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).obj
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n))).f = 0 :=
      (hTneg (-1) (by decide)).eq_of_src _ _
    rw [ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros
      ((shortComplexFunctor' _ _ (-1) 0 1).map
        (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (resolutionMap n)))
      hf₁ hg₁ hf₂]
    constructor
    · 
      rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
      intro t ht
      
      have hdt : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) ((stalkReindex n 0 x).hom t) = 0 := by
        have h2 : (stalkReindex n 1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) ((stalkReindex n 0 x).hom t)) = 0 :=
          (hd_app 0 t).symm.trans ht
        have h3 := congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n 1 x).hom u) h2
        have h4 : (stalkReindex n 1 x).hom ((stalkReindex n 1 x).inv
            ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) ((stalkReindex n 0 x).hom t))) =
            (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n 0) ((stalkReindex n 0 x).hom t) :=
          Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex n 1 x) _
        have h5 : (stalkReindex n 1 x).hom (0 : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj
            ((holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n).X ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) = 0 :=
          map_zero (stalkReindex n 1 x).hom.hom
        exact h4.symm.trans (h3.trans h5)
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := stalk_exact_deg0 n x ((stalkReindex n 0 x).hom t) hdt
      refine ⟨(stalkSingle0 n x).inv z', ?_⟩
      exact (hf_app ((stalkSingle0 n x).inv z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv ((stalkAt x).map (augment n) u))
          (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkSingle0 n x) z')).trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv u) hz').trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindex n 0 x) t)))
    · 
      show Mono ((((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        (resolutionMap n)).f 0)
      rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
      intro a b hab
      have h1 : (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augment n) ((stalkSingle0 n x).hom a)) =
          (stalkReindex n 0 x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (augment n) ((stalkSingle0 n x).hom b)) :=
        (hf_app a).symm.trans (hab.trans (hf_app b))
      have h2 : (stalkAt x).map (augment n) ((stalkSingle0 n x).hom a) =
          (stalkAt x).map (augment n) ((stalkSingle0 n x).hom b) :=
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex n 0 x) _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n 0 x).hom u) h1).trans
            (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex n 0 x) _))
      have h3 : (stalkSingle0 n x).hom a = (stalkSingle0 n x).hom b :=
        stalk_augment_injective n x h2
      exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0 n x) a).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkSingle0 n x).inv u) h3).trans
          (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkSingle0 n x) b))
  rcases (show m < 0 ∨ 0 ≤ m by lia) with hneg | hpos
  · 
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (resolutionMap n)) m (hexact _ _ (hSx m h0))]
    exact hexact _ _ (hTneg m hneg)
  · 
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ : ∃ p' : ℕ, m = (p' : ℤ) :=
      ⟨m.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos).symm⟩
    have hp'0 : p' ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, p' = p + 1 := ⟨p' - 1, by lia⟩
    rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (resolutionMap n)) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (hexact _ _ (hSx ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) h0))]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' (((stalkAt x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n)) ((p : ℕ) : ℤ)
      ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((p + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (by rw [CochainComplex.prev]; push_cast; ring)
      (by rw [CochainComplex.next]; push_cast; ring)]
    rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
    intro s hs
    
    have hds : (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1))
        ((stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).hom s) = 0 := by
      have h2 : (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) ((stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).hom s)) = 0 :=
        (hd_app (p + 1) s).symm.trans hs
      have h3 := congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).hom u) h2
      have h4 : (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).hom ((stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) ((stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).hom s))) =
          (stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n (p + 1)) ((stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).hom s) :=
        Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x) _
      have h5 : (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).hom (0 : ToType ((stalkAt x).obj
          ((holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ n).X ((p + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) = 0 :=
        map_zero (stalkReindex n (p + 2) x).hom.hom
      exact h4.symm.trans (h3.trans h5)
    obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := stalk_exact_pos n p x ((stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).hom s) hds
    refine ⟨(stalkReindex n p x).inv t', ?_⟩
    exact (hd_app p ((stalkReindex n p x).inv t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).inv
          ((stalkAt x).map (dSheafForms n p) u))
        (Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (stalkReindex n p x) t')).trans
      ((congrArg (fun u => (stalkReindex n (p + 1) x).inv u) ht').trans
        (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (stalkReindex n (p + 1) x) s)))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscResolution.analyticDeRhamEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem analyticDeRhamEquiv_apply (n m : ℕ)
    (z : Betti.bettiC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)) m) :
    analyticDeRhamEquiv n m z =
      sheafHyperHMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
        (zConstSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))))
        (resolutionMap n) (m : ℤ)
        (sheafHyperHSingleEquiv (Opens.grothendieckTopology (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ)))
          (Betti.bettiSheafC (TopCat.of (Fin n → ℂ))) m z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

proof:
:= by
  cases F; cases G
  subst hw; subst ht
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.diagNegHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem diagNegHom_apply (m : ℤ) : diagNegHom m = (-m, -m)

    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.TwistedAlgebraicityFrame.hodgeTarget_eq
statement:
theorem TwistedAlgebraicityFrame.hodgeTarget_eq (m : ℤ) :
    F.hodgeTarget m = (-m, -m)
proof:
:= by
  have hhom : F.targetHom = diagNegHom :=
    AddMonoidHom.ext_int (by
      show F.targetHom 1 = diagNegHom 1
      rw [diagNegHom_apply]
      show F.hodgeTarget 1 = (-1, -1)
      exact F.normalization)
  have h : F.targetHom m = diagNegHom m := by rw [hhom]
  rw [diagNegHom_apply] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.tensor_tate_H_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [QHodgeStructure.tensor_H, tensorPiece_def, eq_bot_iff]
  refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
  refine le_bot_iff.mpr ?_
  by_cases hx1 : x.1 = ((-a : ℤ), (-a : ℤ))
  · by_cases hx2 : x.2 = ((-b : ℤ), (-b : ℤ))
    · exfalso
      apply h
      have hpq := hx
      rw [hx1, hx2] at hpq
      rw [← hpq]
      exact (diag_add a b).symm
    · rw [show (tate b).H x.2 = ⊥ from tate_H_of_ne b hx2,
        TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_right, Submodule.map_bot]
  · rw [show (tate a).H x.1 = ⊥ from tate_H_of_ne a hx1,
      TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_left, Submodule.map_bot]

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.tensor_tate_H_pair
statement:
theorem tensor_tate_H_pair (a b : ℤ) :
    ((tate a).tensor (tate b)).H (-(a + b), -(a + b)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
  rw [← ((tate a).tensor (tate b)).isInternal.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
  refine iSup_le fun pq => ?_
  by_cases h : pq = (-(a + b), -(a + b))
  · subst h; exact le_rfl
  · rw [tensor_tate_H_of_ne a b h]; exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.hodgeTateFrame_eq_classicalTateFrame
statement:
theorem hodgeTateFrame_eq_classicalTateFrame :
    hodgeTateFrame = classicalTateFrame
proof:
:= by
  apply TwistedAlgebraicityFrame.ext
  · funext m
    show (-(2 * m) : ℤ) = -m + -m
    ring
  · rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.parallel_weight
statement:
theorem parallel_weight (m : ℤ) :
    hodgeTateFrame.weight m = -2 * m ∧ classicalTateFrame.weight m = -2 * m
proof:
:=
  ⟨hodgeTateFrame.weight_eq m, classicalTateFrame.weight_eq m⟩

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.parallel_target
statement:
theorem parallel_target (m : ℤ) :
    hodgeTateFrame.hodgeTarget m = (-m, -m) ∧
      classicalTateFrame.hodgeTarget m = (-m, -m)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hodgeTateFrame.hodgeTarget_eq m, classicalTateFrame.hodgeTarget_eq m⟩

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.parallel_weight_twist_step
statement:
theorem parallel_weight_twist_step (m : ℤ) :
    hodgeTateFrame.weight (m + 1) = hodgeTateFrame.weight m - 2 ∧
      classicalTateFrame.weight (m + 1) = classicalTateFrame.weight m - 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨hodgeTateFrame.weight_twist_step m, classicalTateFrame.weight_twist_step m⟩

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.twistHom_toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.twistHom_id
statement:
theorem twistHom_id {hV : QHodgeStructure n V} (m : ℤ) :
    (twistHom (HodgeHom.id hV) m).toLinearMap =
      (HodgeHom.id (hV.twist m)).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistHom_toLinearMap]; simp [TensorProduct.map_id]

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.twist_realization_natural
statement:
theorem twist_realization_natural (m : ℤ) (c : ℚ) :
    (twoPiCoeffHom.{0}).hom (ULift.up (tateRealization m c)) =
      ULift.up (tateRealization (m + 1) c)
proof:
:=
  twoPiCoeffHom_tateRealization m c

name: HodgePilot.TateHodgeParallel.tateImpliesHodge_of_agreement
statement:
theorem tateImpliesHodge_of_agreement
    (h : MumfordTateAgreement isTateClass isHodgeClass) :
    TateImpliesHodgeOnCMAbelian isTateClass isHodgeClass
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => (h x).mp hx

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.ι_keep
statement:
@[simp] lemma ι_keep (S : SSet.{0}) (n : ℕ) (P : S _⦋n⦌ → Prop) (σ : S _⦋n⦌) :
    S.ιChainComplex σ ≫ keep S n P = if P σ then S.ιChainComplex σ else 0
proof:
:=
  (S.isColimitChainComplexXCofan Qcoef n).fac _ ⟨σ⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.keep_comm
statement:
lemma keep_comm {S T : SSet.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) (n : ℕ)
    (P : T _⦋n⦌ → Prop) (Q : S _⦋n⦌ → Prop)
    (hPQ : ∀ σ, Q σ ↔ P (f.app (op ⦋n⦌) σ)) :
    (SSet.chainComplexMap f Qcoef).f n ≫ keep T n P
      = keep S n Q ≫ (SSet.chainComplexMap f Qcoef).f n
proof:
:= by
  refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
  rw [SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f_assoc, ι_keep, ← Category.assoc, ι_keep]
  by_cases h : Q σ
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hPQ σ).mp h), SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hP => h ((hPQ σ).mpr hP)), Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.keep_partition_pair
statement:
lemma keep_partition_pair (S : SSet.{0}) (n : ℕ) (P Q : S _⦋n⦌ → Prop)
    (hPQ : ∀ σ, Q σ ↔ ¬ P σ) :
    keep S n P + keep S n Q = 𝟙 ((S.chainComplex Qcoef).X n)
proof:
:= by
  refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
  rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Category.comp_id, ι_keep, ι_keep]
  by_cases h : P σ
  · rw [if_pos h, if_neg (fun hQ => (hPQ σ).mp hQ h), add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_pos ((hPQ σ).mpr h), zero_add]

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.keep_finpartition
statement:
lemma keep_finpartition (S : SSet.{0}) (n : ℕ) {ι' : Type} (s : Finset ι')
    (P : ι' → (S _⦋n⦌ → Prop)) (hcov : ∀ σ, ∃! i, i ∈ s ∧ P i σ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, keep S n (P i) = 𝟙 ((S.chainComplex Qcoef).X n)
proof:
:= by
  refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum, Category.comp_id]
  obtain ⟨i₀, ⟨hi₀s, hPi₀⟩, huniq⟩ := hcov σ
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ι_keep S n (P i) σ),
    Finset.sum_eq_single i₀
      (fun b hb hne => if_neg (fun hPb => hne (huniq b ⟨hb, hPb⟩)))
      (fun habs => absurd hi₀s habs),
    if_pos hPi₀]

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.firstVertex_map
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.ambient_firstVertex_map
statement:
lemma ambient_firstVertex_map (X : TopCat.{0}) {V U : Opens X} (h : V ⟶ U) {n : ℕ}
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj V)) _⦋n⦌) :
    ambient (firstVertex ((TopCat.toSSet.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map h)).app (op ⦋n⦌) σ))
      = ambient (firstVertex σ)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.keep_comm_opens
statement:
lemma keep_comm_opens (X : TopCat.{0}) (A : Set ↑X) (n : ℕ) {V U : Opens X} (h : V ⟶ U) :
    (chainsFunctor.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map h)).f n
        ≫ keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) n (vertexPred X A U n)
      = keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj V)) n (vertexPred X A V n)
        ≫ (chainsFunctor.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map h)).f n
proof:
:=
  keep_comm (TopCat.toSSet.map ((Opens.toTopCat X).map h)) n _ _
    (fun σ => Iff.of_eq ((congrArg (· ∈ A) (ambient_firstVertex_map X h σ)).symm))

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.partApp_disjoint
statement:
lemma partApp_disjoint (X : TopCat.{0}) (A : Set ↑X) (n : ℕ) (U : Opens X)
    (h : ∀ u : ↑((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U), ambient u ∉ A) :
    partApp X A n U = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk : keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) n (vertexPred X A U n)
      = 0 := by
    refine SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext fun σ => ?_
    rw [ι_keep, if_neg (show ¬ vertexPred X A U n σ from h (firstVertex σ)),
      Limits.comp_zero]
  ext φ
  show (keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) n (vertexPred X A U n)
      ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).X n ⟶ Qcoef) :
      (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)).X n ⟶ Qcoef) = 0
  rw [hk, Limits.zero_comp]

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.partitionEndo_pair
statement:
lemma partitionEndo_pair (X : TopCat.{0}) (A : Set ↑X) (n : ℕ) :
    partitionEndo X A n + partitionEndo X Aᶜ n
      = 𝟙 ((singularPresheafComplex X).X n)
proof:
:= by
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  show (partitionEndo X A n).app U + (partitionEndo X Aᶜ n).app U
      = 𝟙 (((singularPresheafComplex X).X n).obj U)
  ext φ
  show (keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U))) n
        (vertexPred X A (unop U) n)
      ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U))).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
    + (keep (TopCat.toSSet.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U))) n
        (vertexPred X Aᶜ (unop U) n)
      ≫ (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U))).X n ⟶ Qcoef))
    = (φ : (chainsFunctor.obj ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (unop U))).X n ⟶ Qcoef)
  rw [← Preadditive.add_comp,
    keep_partition_pair _ n (vertexPred X A (unop U) n) (vertexPred X Aᶜ (unop U) n)
      (fun σ => Set.mem_compl_iff A (ambient (firstVertex σ))),
    Category.id_comp]

name: HodgePilot.SingularFineness.partitionEndoSheaf_pair
statement:
lemma partitionEndoSheaf_pair (X : TopCat.{0}) (A : Set ↑X) (n : ℕ) :
    partitionEndoSheaf X A n + partitionEndoSheaf X Aᶜ n
      = 𝟙 ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n)
proof:
:=
  ((Functor.map_add (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↑X) AddCommGrpCat)).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↑X) AddCommGrpCat).map t)
      (partitionEndo_pair X A n)).trans
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _)) :
    partitionEndoSheaf X A n + partitionEndoSheaf X Aᶜ n
      = 𝟙 ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n))

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Coc.self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Coc.self_eq_zero {U : ι → Set ℂ} {q : ι → ι → ℚ} (h : Coc U q) {i : ι}
    (hi : (U i).Nonempty) : q i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hi
  have := h i i i ⟨x, ⟨⟨hx, hx⟩, hx⟩⟩
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Coc.antisymm
statement:
theorem Coc.antisymm {U : ι → Set ℂ} {q : ι → ι → ℚ} (h : Coc U q) {i j : ι}
    (hij : (U i ∩ U j).Nonempty) : q j i = - q i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hij
  have h1 := h i j i ⟨x, ⟨⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩, hx.1⟩⟩
  have h2 := h.self_eq_zero ⟨x, hx.1⟩
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pt_zero (z w : ℂ) (N : ℕ) : pt z w N 0 = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [pt]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_last
statement: theorem pt_last (z w : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) : pt z w N N = w
proof:
:= by
  have h : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  simp only [pt]
  rw [div_self h, one_mul]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_shift
statement:
theorem pt_shift (z w : ℂ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    pt (pt z w (n + 1) 1) w n k = pt z w (n + 1) (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
  have h2 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    have h3 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
    push_cast at h3
    exact h3
  simp only [pt]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.mem_left
statement:
theorem Valid.mem_left {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι} (h : Valid U z w l)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < l.length) : pt z w l.length k ∈ U (l[k]'hk)
proof:
:=
  h k hk (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.mem_right
statement:
theorem Valid.mem_right {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι} (h : Valid U z w l)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < l.length) : pt z w l.length (k + 1) ∈ U (l[k]'hk)
proof:
:=
  h k hk (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.head_mem_z
statement:
theorem Valid.head_mem_z {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {a : ι} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w (a :: l)) : z ∈ U a
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := h.mem_left (k := 0) (by simp)
  simpa using h0

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.head_mem_pt1
statement:
theorem Valid.head_mem_pt1 {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {a : ι} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w (a :: l)) : pt z w (l.length + 1) 1 ∈ U a
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := h.mem_right (k := 0) (by simp)
  simpa using h0

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.second_mem_pt1
statement:
theorem Valid.second_mem_pt1 {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {a b : ι} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w (a :: b :: l)) : pt z w (l.length + 2) 1 ∈ U b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := h.mem_left (k := 1) (by simp)
  simpa using h0

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.singleton_mem_w
statement:
theorem Valid.singleton_mem_w {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {a : ι}
    (h : Valid U z w [a]) : w ∈ U a
proof:
:= by
  have e : pt z w 1 1 = w := pt_last z w one_ne_zero
  have h0 := h.mem_right (k := 0) (by simp)
  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.getElem_cons_zero,
    Nat.zero_add] at h0
  rwa [e] at h0

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.used_nonempty
statement:
theorem Valid.used_nonempty {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w l) {a : ι} (ha : a ∈ l) : (U a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp ha
  exact ⟨_, h.mem_left hk⟩

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.tail
statement:
theorem Valid.tail {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {a : ι} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w (a :: l)) : Valid U (pt z w (l.length + 1) 1) w l
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hn : l.length ≠ 0 := by omega
  have e1 : pt (pt z w (l.length + 1) 1) w l.length k =
      pt z w (l.length + 1) (k + 1) := pt_shift z w hn k
  have e2 : pt (pt z w (l.length + 1) 1) w l.length (k + 1) =
      pt z w (l.length + 1) (k + 2) := pt_shift z w hn (k + 1)
  rw [e1, e2]
  have h1 := h (k + 1) (by simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hk)
  simpa using h1

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.valid_singleton
statement:
theorem valid_singleton {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {j : ι}
    (h : segment ℝ z w ⊆ U j) : Valid U z w [j]
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by simpa using hk
  subst hk0
  have e : pt z w 1 1 = w := pt_last z w one_ne_zero
  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.getElem_cons_zero,
    Nat.zero_add, pt_zero]
  rwa [e]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem wSum_nil (i i' : ι) : wSum q i [] i' = q i i'
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem wSum_cons (i a i' : ι) (l : List ι) :
    wSum q i (a :: l) i' = q i a + wSum q a l i'
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_append
statement:
theorem wSum_append (i i' a : ι) (l₁ l₂ : List ι) :
    wSum q i (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) i' = wSum q i l₁ a + wSum q a l₂ i'
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l₁ ih => simp [ih, add_assoc]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_indep
statement:
theorem wSum_indep (hcoc : Coc U q) :
    ∀ (t t' : List ι) (a a' : ι) (z w : ℂ) (i i' : ι),
      t.length = t'.length →
      Valid U z w (a :: t) → Valid U z w (a' :: t') →
      z ∈ U i → w ∈ U i' →
      wSum q i (a :: t) i' = wSum q i (a' :: t') i'
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro t' a a' z w i i' hlen hv hv' hz hw
    have ht' : t' = [] := by
      cases t' with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b l => simp at hlen
    subst ht'
    have hza : z ∈ U a := hv.head_mem_z
    have hza' : z ∈ U a' := hv'.head_mem_z
    have hwa : w ∈ U a := hv.singleton_mem_w
    have hwa' : w ∈ U a' := hv'.singleton_mem_w
    have c1 : q i a + q a a' = q i a' := hcoc i a a' ⟨z, ⟨⟨hz, hza⟩, hza'⟩⟩
    have c2 : q a a' + q a' i' = q a i' := hcoc a a' i' ⟨w, ⟨⟨hwa, hwa'⟩, hw⟩⟩
    simp only [wSum_cons, wSum_nil]
    linarith
  | cons b t ih =>
    intro t' a a' z w i i' hlen hv hv' hz hw
    obtain ⟨b', t'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b' t'', t' = b' :: t'' := by
      cases t' with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons b' t'' => exact ⟨b', t'', rfl⟩
    have hlen2 : t.length = t''.length := by simpa using hlen
    
    have hza : z ∈ U a := hv.head_mem_z
    have hza' : z ∈ U a' := hv'.head_mem_z
    have hz1a : pt z w (t.length + 2) 1 ∈ U a := by
      have h0 := hv.head_mem_pt1
      simpa using h0
    have hz1a' : pt z w (t.length + 2) 1 ∈ U a' := by
      have h0 := hv'.head_mem_pt1
      simp only [List.length_cons] at h0
      rwa [show t''.length + 1 + 1 = t.length + 2 by omega] at h0
    have hz1b' : pt z w (t.length + 2) 1 ∈ U b' := by
      have h0 := hv'.second_mem_pt1
      rwa [show t''.length + 2 = t.length + 2 by omega] at h0
    
    have hta : Valid U (pt z w (t.length + 2) 1) w (b :: t) := by
      have h0 := hv.tail
      simpa using h0
    have hta' : Valid U (pt z w (t.length + 2) 1) w (b' :: t'') := by
      have h0 := hv'.tail
      simp only [List.length_cons] at h0
      rwa [show t''.length + 1 + 1 = t.length + 2 by omega] at h0
    have hIH : wSum q a (b :: t) i' = wSum q a (b' :: t'') i' :=
      ih t'' b b' (pt z w (t.length + 2) 1) w a i' hlen2 hta hta' hz1a hw
    
    have c1 : q i a + q a a' = q i a' := hcoc i a a' ⟨z, ⟨⟨hz, hza⟩, hza'⟩⟩
    have c2 : q a a' + q a' b' = q a b' :=
      hcoc a a' b' ⟨pt z w (t.length + 2) 1, ⟨⟨hz1a, hz1a'⟩, hz1b'⟩⟩
    simp only [wSum_cons] at hIH ⊢
    linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.blowup_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem blowup_nil (M : ℕ) : blowup M ([] : List ι) = []
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.blowup_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem blowup_cons (M : ℕ) (a : ι) (l : List ι) :
    blowup M (a :: l) = List.replicate M a ++ blowup M l
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.blowup_length
statement:
theorem blowup_length (M : ℕ) (l : List ι) :
    (blowup M l).length = l.length * M
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [blowup_cons, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, ih,
      List.length_cons]
    ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_replicate_append
statement:
theorem wSum_replicate_append (m : ℕ) (a i' : ι) (r : List ι) :
    wSum q a (List.replicate m a ++ r) i' = m * q a a + wSum q a r i'
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, wSum_cons, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_blowup
statement:
theorem wSum_blowup {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≠ 0) (i i' : ι) (l : List ι)
    (hq0 : ∀ a ∈ l, q a a = 0) :
    wSum q i (blowup M l) i' = wSum q i l i'
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, M = m + 1 := ⟨M - 1, by omega⟩
    have h0 : q a a = 0 := hq0 a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [blowup_cons, List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, wSum_cons,
      wSum_replicate_append, h0,
      ih a fun x hx => hq0 x (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hx)]
    simp

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.blowup_getElem
statement:
theorem blowup_getElem {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≠ 0) (l : List ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < (blowup M l).length) (hk' : k / M < l.length) :
    (blowup M l)[k]'hk = l[k / M]'hk'
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k with
  | nil => simp at hk'
  | cons a l ih =>
    by_cases h : k < M
    · have hd : k / M = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt h
      have hlt : k < (List.replicate M a).length := by
        simpa [List.length_replicate] using h
      have hk2 : k < (List.replicate M a ++ blowup M l).length := by
        rw [blowup_cons] at hk; exact hk
      show (List.replicate M a ++ blowup M l)[k]'hk2 = (a :: l)[k / M]'hk'
      rw [List.getElem_append_left hlt]
      simp [hd]
    · have h : M ≤ k := Nat.le_of_not_lt h
      have hpos : 0 < M := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
      have hd : k / M = (k - M) / M + 1 := Nat.div_eq_sub_div hpos h
      have hge : (List.replicate M a).length ≤ k := by
        simpa [List.length_replicate] using h
      have hkA : k < (List.replicate M a ++ blowup M l).length := by
        rw [blowup_cons] at hk; exact hk
      show (List.replicate M a ++ blowup M l)[k]'hkA = (a :: l)[k / M]'hk'
      rw [List.getElem_append_right hge]
      have hk2 : k - (List.replicate M a).length < (blowup M l).length := by
        simp only [List.length_replicate]
        rw [blowup_length] at hk ⊢
        simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, one_mul] at hk
        omega
      have hk2' : (k - M) / M < l.length := by
        have h5 := hk'
        rw [hd] at h5
        simp only [List.length_cons] at h5
        omega
      have hrec := ih (k - M) (by simpa [List.length_replicate] using hk2) hk2'
      simp only [List.length_replicate]
      rw [hrec]
      have : l[(k - M) / M]'hk2' = (a :: l)[(k - M) / M + 1]'(by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; omega) := by
        rw [List.getElem_cons_succ]
      rw [this]
      congr 1
      omega

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_mem_segment_block
statement:
theorem pt_mem_segment_block {z w : ℂ} {n M a k : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (h1 : a * M ≤ k) (h2 : k ≤ (a + 1) * M) :
    pt z w (n * M) k ∈ segment ℝ (pt z w n a) (pt z w n (a + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hMR : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hnC : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
  have hMC : (M : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM
  set θ : ℝ := (k : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) - (a : ℝ) with hθ
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := by
    rw [hθ, sub_nonneg, le_div_iff₀ hMR]
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hθ, sub_le_iff_le_add, div_le_iff₀ hMR]
    calc (k : ℝ) ≤ ((a + 1) * M : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
      _ = (1 + (a : ℝ)) * (M : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  refine ⟨1 - θ, θ, by linarith, hθ0, by ring, ?_⟩
  have hsmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (c : ℂ), r • c = (r : ℂ) * c := fun r c =>
    Complex.real_smul
  rw [hsmul, hsmul]
  simp only [pt, hθ]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.blowup
statement:
theorem Valid.blowup {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w l) {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≠ 0) : Valid U z w (CechGoursat.blowup M l)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hkL : k < l.length * M := by rwa [blowup_length] at hk
  have hn : l.length ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at hkL
    omega
  have hpos : 0 < M := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
  have hdiv : k / M < l.length := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hpos]
    omega
  rw [blowup_getElem hM l k hk hdiv]
  
  have hmod := Nat.div_add_mod k M
  have hmlt := Nat.mod_lt k hpos
  have hb1 : (k / M) * M ≤ k := Nat.div_mul_le_self k M
  have hb2 : k + 1 ≤ (k / M + 1) * M := by
    have : k < (k / M + 1) * M := by
      have h3 : (k / M + 1) * M = M * (k / M) + M := by ring
      omega
    omega
  have hsub : segment ℝ (pt z w ((CechGoursat.blowup M l).length) k)
      (pt z w ((CechGoursat.blowup M l).length) (k + 1)) ⊆
      segment ℝ (pt z w l.length (k / M)) (pt z w l.length (k / M + 1)) := by
    rw [blowup_length]
    exact (convex_segment _ _).segment_subset
      (pt_mem_segment_block hn hM hb1 (by omega))
      (pt_mem_segment_block hn hM (by omega) hb2)
  exact hsub.trans (h (k / M) hdiv)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_welldef
statement:
theorem wSum_welldef (hcoc : Coc U q) {z w : ℂ} {l l' : List ι}
    (hl : l ≠ []) (hl' : l' ≠ [])
    (hv : Valid U z w l) (hv' : Valid U z w l')
    {i i' : ι} (hz : z ∈ U i) (hw : w ∈ U i') :
    wSum q i l i' = wSum q i l' i'
proof:
:= by
  have hL : l.length ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  have hL' : l'.length ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl' (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  have e1 : wSum q i (blowup l'.length l) i' = wSum q i l i' :=
    wSum_blowup q hL' i i' l fun x hx => hcoc.self_eq_zero (hv.used_nonempty hx)
  have e2 : wSum q i (blowup l.length l') i' = wSum q i l' i' :=
    wSum_blowup q hL i i' l' fun x hx => hcoc.self_eq_zero (hv'.used_nonempty hx)
  have hbv : Valid U z w (blowup l'.length l) := hv.blowup hL'
  have hbv' : Valid U z w (blowup l.length l') := hv'.blowup hL
  have hne : blowup l'.length l ≠ [] := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := blowup_length l'.length l
    rw [h0] at h1
    simp only [List.length_nil] at h1
    rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm with h2 | h2
    · exact hL h2
    · exact hL' h2
  have hne' : blowup l.length l' ≠ [] := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := blowup_length l.length l'
    rw [h0] at h1
    simp only [List.length_nil] at h1
    rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm with h2 | h2
    · exact hL' h2
    · exact hL h2
  obtain ⟨a, t, hat⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
  obtain ⟨a', t', hat'⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne'
  have hlen : t.length = t'.length := by
    have h1 : (a :: t).length = (a' :: t').length := by
      rw [← hat, ← hat', blowup_length, blowup_length]
      ring
    simpa using h1
  rw [← e1, ← e2, hat, hat']
  exact wSum_indep U q hcoc t t' a a' z w i i' hlen (hat ▸ hbv) (hat' ▸ hbv')
    hz hw

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_mem_segment
statement:
theorem pt_mem_segment {z w : ℂ} {N k : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    pt z w N k ∈ segment ℝ z w
proof:
:= by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN
    exact_mod_cast this
  set θ : ℝ := (k : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) with hθ
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := by positivity
  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hθ, div_le_one hNR]
    exact_mod_cast hk
  refine ⟨1 - θ, θ, by linarith, hθ0, by ring, ?_⟩
  have hsmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (c : ℂ), r • c = (r : ℂ) * c := fun r c =>
    Complex.real_smul
  rw [hsmul, hsmul]
  simp only [pt, hθ]
  push_cast
  have hNC : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.dist_pt_succ
statement:
theorem dist_pt_succ (z w : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    dist (pt z w N (k + 1)) (pt z w N k) = dist z w / N
proof:
:= by
  have hNC : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have e : pt z w N (k + 1) - pt z w N k = (1 / (N : ℂ)) * (w - z) := by
    simp only [pt]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e, norm_mul, dist_eq_norm]
  simp only [one_div, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
  rw [norm_sub_rev]
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.exists_valid_chain
statement:
theorem exists_valid_chain (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (z w : ℂ) : ∃ l : List ι, l ≠ [] ∧ Valid U z w l
proof:
:= by
  have hcpt : IsCompact (segment ℝ z w) := by
    rw [segment_eq_image ℝ z w]
    exact isCompact_Icc.image (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hcpt hop
    (by rw [hcov]; exact subset_univ _)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (dist z w / δ)
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at hN
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hN
    have : 0 ≤ dist z w / δ := div_nonneg dist_nonneg hδ.le
    linarith
  have hstep : dist z w / N < δ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN0)]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at hN
    linarith [mul_comm δ (N : ℝ)]
  have hmem : ∀ k : ℕ, k < N → pt z w N k ∈ segment ℝ z w :=
    fun k hk => pt_mem_segment hN0 hk.le
  choose f hf using fun k : Fin N =>
    hball (pt z w N k.1) (hmem k.1 k.2)
  refine ⟨List.ofFn f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have := congrArg List.length h0
    simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.length_nil] at this
    exact hN0 this
  · intro k hk
    have hkN : k < N := by simpa using hk
    have hsub : segment ℝ (pt z w (List.ofFn f).length k)
        (pt z w (List.ofFn f).length (k + 1)) ⊆
        Metric.ball (pt z w N k) δ := by
      simp only [List.length_ofFn]
      have hcb : segment ℝ (pt z w N k) (pt z w N (k + 1)) ⊆
          Metric.closedBall (pt z w N k) (dist z w / N) := by
        apply (convex_closedBall _ _).segment_subset
        · simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, div_nonneg dist_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N)]
        · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
          rw [dist_pt_succ z w hN0 k]
      exact hcb.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hstep)
    have hgoal := hsub.trans (hf ⟨k, hkN⟩)
    have hgetElem : (List.ofFn f)[k]'hk = f ⟨k, hkN⟩ := by
      simp
    rw [hgetElem]
    exact hgoal

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_spec
statement:
theorem beta_spec (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι} (hl : l ≠ []) (hv : Valid U z w l)
    {i i' : ι} (hz : z ∈ U i) (hw : w ∈ U i') :
    beta U q hop hcov z w i i' = wSum q i l i'
proof:
:=
  wSum_welldef U q hcoc (exists_valid_chain U hop hcov z w).choose_spec.1 hl
    (exists_valid_chain U hop hcov z w).choose_spec.2 hv hz hw

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_of_segment_subset
statement:
theorem beta_of_segment_subset (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (hcoc : Coc U q) {z w : ℂ} {j : ι}
    (hseg : segment ℝ z w ⊆ U j) {i i' : ι} (hz : z ∈ U i) (hw : w ∈ U i') :
    beta U q hop hcov z w i i' = q i j + q j i'
proof:
:= by
  rw [beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc (by simp) (valid_singleton hseg) hz hw]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_concat_left
statement:
theorem pt_concat_left (z w : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :
    pt z w (N + N) j = pt z ((z + w) / 2) N j
proof:
:= by
  have hNC : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  have h2N : (N : ℂ) + (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← two_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hNC
  simp only [pt]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_concat_right
statement:
theorem pt_concat_right (z w : ℂ) {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :
    pt z w (N + N) (N + j) = pt ((z + w) / 2) w N j
proof:
:= by
  have hNC : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  have h2N : (N : ℂ) + (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← two_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hNC
  simp only [pt]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.append_halves
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hLL : (l₁ ++ l₂).length = l₁.length + l₁.length := by
    rw [List.length_append, hlen]
  have hk2 : k < l₁.length + l₁.length := by rwa [hLL] at hk
  have hN : l₁.length ≠ 0 := by omega
  by_cases hcase : k < l₁.length
  · have e1 : pt z w ((l₁ ++ l₂).length) k = pt z ((z + w) / 2) l₁.length k := by
      rw [hLL]
      exact pt_concat_left z w hN k
    have e2 : pt z w ((l₁ ++ l₂).length) (k + 1) =
        pt z ((z + w) / 2) l₁.length (k + 1) := by
      rw [hLL]
      exact pt_concat_left z w hN (k + 1)
    have hidx : (l₁ ++ l₂)[k]'hk = l₁[k]'hcase := List.getElem_append_left hcase
    rw [e1, e2, hidx]
    exact h₁ k hcase
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = l₁.length + j := ⟨k - l₁.length, by omega⟩
    have hj : j < l₂.length := by omega
    have e1 : pt z w ((l₁ ++ l₂).length) (l₁.length + j) =
        pt ((z + w) / 2) w l₂.length j := by
      rw [hLL, pt_concat_right z w hN j, hlen]
    have e2 : pt z w ((l₁ ++ l₂).length) (l₁.length + j + 1) =
        pt ((z + w) / 2) w l₂.length (j + 1) := by
      rw [hLL]
      have : l₁.length + j + 1 = l₁.length + (j + 1) := by omega
      rw [this, pt_concat_right z w hN (j + 1), hlen]
    have hle : l₁.length ≤ l₁.length + j := by omega
    have hidx : (l₁ ++ l₂)[l₁.length + j]'hk =
        l₂[l₁.length + j - l₁.length]'(by omega) :=
      List.getElem_append_right hle
    have hidx2 : l₂[l₁.length + j - l₁.length]'(by omega) = l₂[j]'hj := by
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [e1, e2, hidx, hidx2]
    exact h₂ j hj

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.getLast_mem_w
statement:
theorem Valid.getLast_mem_w {U : ι → Set ℂ} {w : ℂ} :
    ∀ (l : List ι) {z : ℂ} (hne : l ≠ []) (_ : Valid U z w l),
      w ∈ U (l.getLast hne)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro z h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro z _ hv
    cases t with
    | nil => simpa using hv.singleton_mem_w
    | cons b t₂ =>
      have h1 := ih (z := pt z w ((b :: t₂).length + 1) 1) (by simp) hv.tail
      simpa [List.getLast_cons] using h1

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_swap_right
statement:
theorem wSum_swap_right (hcoc : Coc U q) :
    ∀ (l : List ι) (a : ι) {x : ℂ} {b b' i : ι},
      x ∈ U b → x ∈ U b' → x ∈ U ((a :: l).getLast (by simp)) →
      wSum q i (a :: l) b = wSum q i (a :: l) b' + q b' b
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a x b b' i hb hb' hlast
    have hlast' : x ∈ U a := by simpa using hlast
    have c1 : q a b' + q b' b = q a b := hcoc a b' b ⟨x, ⟨⟨hlast', hb'⟩, hb⟩⟩
    simp only [wSum_cons, wSum_nil]
    linarith
  | cons c t ih =>
    intro a x b b' i hb hb' hlast
    have hlast' : x ∈ U ((c :: t).getLast (by simp)) := by
      simpa [List.getLast_cons] using hlast
    have h1 := ih c hb hb' hlast' (i := a)
    simp only [wSum_cons] at h1 ⊢
    linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_split_mid
statement:
theorem beta_split_mid (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (z w : ℂ) (i i' im : ι)
    (hm : (z + w) / 2 ∈ U im) (hz : z ∈ U i) (hw : w ∈ U i') :
    beta U q hop hcov z w i i' =
      beta U q hop hcov z ((z + w) / 2) i im +
        beta U q hop hcov ((z + w) / 2) w im i'
proof:
:= by
  set m : ℂ := (z + w) / 2 with hmdef
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁, hv₁⟩ := exists_valid_chain U hop hcov z m
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂, hv₂⟩ := exists_valid_chain U hop hcov m w
  have hL1 : l₁.length ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl₁ (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  have hL2 : l₂.length ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl₂ (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  set L₁ : List ι := CechGoursat.blowup l₂.length l₁ with hL₁def
  set L₂ : List ι := CechGoursat.blowup l₁.length l₂ with hL₂def
  have hbv₁ : Valid U z m L₁ := hv₁.blowup hL2
  have hbv₂ : Valid U m w L₂ := hv₂.blowup hL1
  have hlen : L₁.length = L₂.length := by
    rw [hL₁def, hL₂def, blowup_length, blowup_length]
    ring
  have hL₁ne : L₁ ≠ [] := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := blowup_length l₂.length l₁
    rw [← hL₁def, h0] at h1
    simp only [List.length_nil] at h1
    rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm with h2 | h2
    · exact hL1 h2
    · exact hL2 h2
  have hL₂ne : L₂ ≠ [] := by
    intro h0
