    have h1 := blowup_length l₁.length l₂
    rw [← hL₂def, h0] at h1
    simp only [List.length_nil] at h1
    rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm with h2 | h2
    · exact hL2 h2
    · exact hL1 h2
  obtain ⟨a₂, t₂, hat₂⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hL₂ne
  
  have happ : Valid U z w (L₁ ++ L₂) := hbv₁.append_halves hbv₂ hlen
  have happne : L₁ ++ L₂ ≠ [] := fun h0 => hL₁ne (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp h0).1
  have hbeta : beta U q hop hcov z w i i' = wSum q i (L₁ ++ L₂) i' :=
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc happne happ hz hw
  
  have hbeta₁ : beta U q hop hcov z m i im = wSum q i L₁ im :=
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc hL₁ne hbv₁ hz hm
  have hbeta₂ : beta U q hop hcov m w im i' = wSum q im L₂ i' :=
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc hL₂ne hbv₂ hm hw
  
  have hma₂ : m ∈ U a₂ := by
    have := hbv₂
    rw [hat₂] at this
    exact this.head_mem_z
  have hmlast : m ∈ U (L₁.getLast hL₁ne) := Valid.getLast_mem_w L₁ hL₁ne hbv₁
  
  obtain ⟨a₁, t₁, hat₁⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hL₁ne
  have hbv₁' : Valid U z m (a₁ :: t₁) := hat₁ ▸ hbv₁
  have hswap : wSum q i L₁ a₂ = wSum q i L₁ im + q im a₂ := by
    rw [hat₁]
    exact wSum_swap_right U q hcoc t₁ a₁ hma₂ hm
      (Valid.getLast_mem_w (a₁ :: t₁) (by simp) hbv₁')
  calc beta U q hop hcov z w i i'
      = wSum q i (L₁ ++ a₂ :: t₂) i' := by rw [hbeta, hat₂]
    _ = wSum q i L₁ a₂ + wSum q a₂ t₂ i' := wSum_append q i i' a₂ L₁ t₂
    _ = wSum q i L₁ im + (q im a₂ + wSum q a₂ t₂ i') := by
        rw [hswap]; ring
    _ = wSum q i L₁ im + wSum q im (a₂ :: t₂) i' := by rw [wSum_cons]
    _ = beta U q hop hcov z m i im + beta U q hop hcov m w im i' := by
        rw [hbeta₁, hbeta₂, hat₂]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.pt_rev
statement:
theorem pt_rev (z w : ℂ) {N k : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    pt w z N k = pt z w N (N - k)
proof:
:= by
  have hNC : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN
  have hcast : ((N - k : ℕ) : ℂ) = (N : ℂ) - (k : ℂ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
  simp only [pt, hcast]
  field_simp
  ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.reverse
statement:
theorem Valid.reverse {U : ι → Set ℂ} {z w : ℂ} {l : List ι}
    (h : Valid U z w l) : Valid U w z l.reverse
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hkl : k < l.length := by simpa using hk
  have hn : l.length ≠ 0 := by omega
  have e1' : pt w z l.length k = pt z w l.length (l.length - 1 - k + 1) := by
    rw [pt_rev z w hn hkl.le]
    congr 1
    omega
  have e2' : pt w z l.length (k + 1) = pt z w l.length (l.length - 1 - k) := by
    rw [pt_rev z w hn (by omega : k + 1 ≤ l.length)]
    congr 1
    omega
  simp only [List.length_reverse, List.getElem_reverse]
  rw [e1', e2', segment_symm]
  exact h (l.length - 1 - k) (by omega)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.Valid.adj
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro z h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro z _ hv i i' hz hw
    refine ⟨⟨z, hz, hv.head_mem_z⟩, ?_⟩
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨w, hv.singleton_mem_w, hw⟩
    | cons b t₂ =>
      exact ih (by simp) hv.tail hv.head_mem_pt1 hw

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.wSum_rev
statement:
theorem wSum_rev (hcoc : Coc U q) :
    ∀ (l : List ι) {i i' : ι} (_ : Adj U i l i'),
      wSum q i' l.reverse i = - wSum q i l i'
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro i i' hadj
    simpa using hcoc.antisymm hadj
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro i i' hadj
    have h1 : (a :: t).reverse = t.reverse ++ a :: [] := by simp
    rw [h1, wSum_append]
    rw [ih hadj.2, wSum_nil, wSum_cons]
    have h2 : q a i = - q i a := hcoc.antisymm hadj.1
    linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_rev
statement:
theorem beta_rev (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (z w : ℂ) (i i' : ι) (hz : z ∈ U i) (hw : w ∈ U i') :
    beta U q hop hcov w z i' i = - beta U q hop hcov z w i i'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hv⟩ := exists_valid_chain U hop hcov z w
  have hrev : beta U q hop hcov w z i' i = wSum q i' l.reverse i :=
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc (by simpa using hl) hv.reverse hw hz
  have hfwd : beta U q hop hcov z w i i' = wSum q i l i' :=
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc hl hv hz hw
  rw [hrev, hfwd, wSum_rev U q hcoc l (Valid.adj l hl hv hz hw)]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.tri_subdiv
statement:
theorem tri_subdiv (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (a b c : ℂ) (ia ib ic iab ibc ica : ι)
    (ha : a ∈ U ia) (hb : b ∈ U ib) (hc : c ∈ U ic)
    (hab : (a + b) / 2 ∈ U iab) (hbc : (b + c) / 2 ∈ U ibc)
    (hca : (c + a) / 2 ∈ U ica) :
    tri U q hop hcov a b c ia ib ic =
      tri U q hop hcov a ((a + b) / 2) ((c + a) / 2) ia iab ica +
      tri U q hop hcov ((a + b) / 2) b ((b + c) / 2) iab ib ibc +
      tri U q hop hcov ((c + a) / 2) ((b + c) / 2) c ica ibc ic +
      tri U q hop hcov ((a + b) / 2) ((b + c) / 2) ((c + a) / 2) iab ibc ica
proof:
:= by
  have s1 := beta_split_mid U q hop hcov hcoc a b ia ib iab hab ha hb
  have s2 := beta_split_mid U q hop hcov hcoc b c ib ic ibc hbc hb hc
  have s3 := beta_split_mid U q hop hcov hcoc c a ic ia ica hca hc ha
  have r1 := beta_rev U q hop hcov hcoc ((a + b) / 2) ((c + a) / 2) iab ica
    hab hca
  have r2 := beta_rev U q hop hcov hcoc ((a + b) / 2) ((b + c) / 2) iab ibc
    hab hbc
  have r3 := beta_rev U q hop hcov hcoc ((c + a) / 2) ((b + c) / 2) ica ibc
    hca hbc
  simp only [tri]
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.GTri.perim_nonneg
statement: theorem GTri.perim_nonneg (T : GTri U) : 0 ≤ T.perim
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.a T.b := dist_nonneg
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.b T.c := dist_nonneg
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.c T.a := dist_nonneg
  show (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.GTri.dist_ba_le_perim
statement: theorem GTri.dist_ba_le_perim (T : GTri U) : dist T.b T.a ≤ T.perim
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.b T.c := dist_nonneg
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.c T.a := dist_nonneg
  rw [dist_comm]
  show dist T.a T.b ≤ dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.GTri.dist_ca_le_perim
statement: theorem GTri.dist_ca_le_perim (T : GTri U) : dist T.c T.a ≤ T.perim
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.a T.b := dist_nonneg
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist T.b T.c := dist_nonneg
  show dist T.c T.a ≤ dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq
statement:
theorem dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq {x y u v : ℂ} (h : x - y = (u - v) / 2) :
    dist x y = dist u v / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, h, norm_div, Complex.norm_two]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.exists_idx
statement: theorem exists_idx (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (z : ℂ) : ∃ i, z ∈ U i
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_iUnion.mp (by rw [hcov]; trivial)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.abs_le_four_of_eq_sum
statement:
theorem abs_le_four_of_eq_sum {s t0 t1 t2 t3 : ℚ} (h : s = t0 + t1 + t2 + t3) :
    |s| ≤ 4 * |t0| ∨ |s| ≤ 4 * |t1| ∨ |s| ≤ 4 * |t2| ∨ |s| ≤ 4 * |t3|
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hcon
  have e1 : |t0 + t1| ≤ |t0| + |t1| := abs_add_le _ _
  have e2 : |t0 + t1 + t2| ≤ |t0 + t1| + |t2| := abs_add_le _ _
  have e3 : |s| ≤ |t0 + t1 + t2| + |t3| := by rw [h]; exact abs_add_le _ _
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.exists_goursat_child
statement:
theorem exists_goursat_child (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (hcoc : Coc U q) (T : GTri U) :
    ∃ T' : GTri U,
      |triVal U q hop hcov T| ≤ 4 * |triVal U q hop hcov T'| ∧
        T'.perim = T.perim / 2 ∧ dist T'.a T.a ≤ T.perim / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨iab, hiab⟩ := exists_idx U hcov ((T.a + T.b) / 2)
  obtain ⟨ibc, hibc⟩ := exists_idx U hcov ((T.b + T.c) / 2)
  obtain ⟨ica, hica⟩ := exists_idx U hcov ((T.c + T.a) / 2)
  have hsub := tri_subdiv U q hop hcov hcoc T.a T.b T.c T.ia T.ib T.ic
    iab ibc ica T.ha T.hb T.hc hiab hibc hica
  rcases abs_le_four_of_eq_sum hsub with h | h | h | h
  · refine ⟨⟨T.a, (T.a + T.b) / 2, (T.c + T.a) / 2, T.ia, iab, ica,
      T.ha, hiab, hica⟩, h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : dist T.a ((T.a + T.b) / 2) = dist T.a T.b / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e2 : dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) ((T.c + T.a) / 2) = dist T.b T.c / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e3 : dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) T.a = dist T.c T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      show dist T.a ((T.a + T.b) / 2) + dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) ((T.c + T.a) / 2) +
          dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) T.a = T.perim / 2
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      show dist T.a T.b / 2 + dist T.b T.c / 2 + dist T.c T.a / 2 =
        (dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a) / 2
      ring
    · show dist T.a T.a ≤ T.perim / 2
      have h0 := T.perim_nonneg
      rw [dist_self]
      linarith
  · refine ⟨⟨(T.a + T.b) / 2, T.b, (T.b + T.c) / 2, iab, T.ib, ibc,
      hiab, T.hb, hibc⟩, h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.b = dist T.a T.b / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e2 : dist T.b ((T.b + T.c) / 2) = dist T.b T.c / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e3 : dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) ((T.a + T.b) / 2) = dist T.c T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      show dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.b + dist T.b ((T.b + T.c) / 2) +
          dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) ((T.a + T.b) / 2) = T.perim / 2
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      show dist T.a T.b / 2 + dist T.b T.c / 2 + dist T.c T.a / 2 =
        (dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a) / 2
      ring
    · show dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.a ≤ T.perim / 2
      have e1 : dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.a = dist T.b T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have h0 := T.dist_ba_le_perim
      rw [e1]
      linarith
  · refine ⟨⟨(T.c + T.a) / 2, (T.b + T.c) / 2, T.c, ica, ibc, T.ic,
      hica, hibc, T.hc⟩, h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) ((T.b + T.c) / 2) = dist T.a T.b / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e2 : dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) T.c = dist T.b T.c / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e3 : dist T.c ((T.c + T.a) / 2) = dist T.c T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      show dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) ((T.b + T.c) / 2) + dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) T.c +
          dist T.c ((T.c + T.a) / 2) = T.perim / 2
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      show dist T.a T.b / 2 + dist T.b T.c / 2 + dist T.c T.a / 2 =
        (dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a) / 2
      ring
    · show dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) T.a ≤ T.perim / 2
      have e1 : dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) T.a = dist T.c T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have h0 := T.dist_ca_le_perim
      rw [e1]
      linarith
  · refine ⟨⟨(T.a + T.b) / 2, (T.b + T.c) / 2, (T.c + T.a) / 2, iab, ibc, ica,
      hiab, hibc, hica⟩, h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e1 : dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) ((T.b + T.c) / 2) = dist T.a T.c / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e2 : dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) ((T.c + T.a) / 2) = dist T.b T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have e3 : dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) ((T.a + T.b) / 2) = dist T.c T.b / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      show dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) ((T.b + T.c) / 2) +
          dist ((T.b + T.c) / 2) ((T.c + T.a) / 2) +
          dist ((T.c + T.a) / 2) ((T.a + T.b) / 2) = T.perim / 2
      rw [e1, e2, e3, dist_comm T.a T.c, dist_comm T.b T.a, dist_comm T.c T.b]
      show dist T.c T.a / 2 + dist T.a T.b / 2 + dist T.b T.c / 2 =
        (dist T.a T.b + dist T.b T.c + dist T.c T.a) / 2
      ring
    · show dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.a ≤ T.perim / 2
      have e1 : dist ((T.a + T.b) / 2) T.a = dist T.b T.a / 2 :=
        dist_eq_half_of_sub_eq (by ring)
      have h0 := T.dist_ba_le_perim
      rw [e1]
      linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.gseq_zero
statement:
theorem gseq_zero (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) : gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 0 = T0
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.gseq_succ
statement:
theorem gseq_succ (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) (n : ℕ) :
    gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (n + 1) =
      (exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov hcoc
        (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.gseq_val_le
statement:
theorem gseq_val_le (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) (n : ℕ) :
    |triVal U q hop hcov T0| ≤
      4 ^ n * |triVal U q hop hcov (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)|
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [gseq_zero]
    norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    have hstep := (exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov hcoc
      (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose_spec.1
    have h4 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 4 ^ n := by positivity
    rw [gseq_succ]
    calc |triVal U q hop hcov T0|
        ≤ 4 ^ n * |triVal U q hop hcov (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)| := ih
      _ ≤ 4 ^ n * (4 * |triVal U q hop hcov ((exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov
            hcoc (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose)|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep h4
      _ = 4 ^ (n + 1) * |triVal U q hop hcov ((exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov
            hcoc (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose)| := by ring

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.gseq_perim
statement:
theorem gseq_perim (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) (n : ℕ) :
    (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).perim = T0.perim / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [gseq_zero]
    norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    have hstep := (exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov hcoc
      (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose_spec.2.1
    rw [gseq_succ, hstep, ih, div_div, ← pow_succ]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.gseq_dist
statement:
theorem gseq_dist (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (n + 1)).a
      (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).a ≤ T0.perim / 2 ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep := (exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov hcoc
    (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose_spec.2.2
  rw [gseq_succ]
  calc dist ((exists_goursat_child U q hop hcov hcoc
        (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n)).choose).a (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).a
      ≤ (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).perim / 2 := hstep
    _ = T0.perim / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
        rw [gseq_perim U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n, div_div, ← pow_succ]

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.tri_eq_zero_of_segments_subset
statement:
theorem tri_eq_zero_of_segments_subset (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (hcoc : Coc U q) {a b c : ℂ} {j ia ib ic : ι}
    (hab : segment ℝ a b ⊆ U j) (hbc : segment ℝ b c ⊆ U j)
    (hca : segment ℝ c a ⊆ U j) (ha : a ∈ U ia) (hb : b ∈ U ib)
    (hc : c ∈ U ic) : tri U q hop hcov a b c ia ib ic = 0
proof:
:= by
  have haj : a ∈ U j := hab (left_mem_segment ℝ a b)
  have hbj : b ∈ U j := hab (right_mem_segment ℝ a b)
  have hcj : c ∈ U j := hbc (right_mem_segment ℝ b c)
  have h1 : q ib j = - q j ib := hcoc.antisymm ⟨b, hbj, hb⟩
  have h2 : q ic j = - q j ic := hcoc.antisymm ⟨c, hcj, hc⟩
  have h3 : q j ia = - q ia j := hcoc.antisymm ⟨a, ha, haj⟩
  unfold tri
  rw [beta_of_segment_subset U q hop hcov hcoc hab ha hb,
    beta_of_segment_subset U q hop hcov hcoc hbc hb hc,
    beta_of_segment_subset U q hop hcov hcoc hca hc ha]
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.triVal_eq_zero_of_close
statement:
theorem triVal_eq_zero_of_close (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (hcoc : Coc U q) (T : GTri U) {z : ℂ} {i0 : ι}
    {ε : ℝ} (hball : Metric.ball z ε ⊆ U i0) (ha : dist T.a z < ε)
    (hb : dist T.b z < ε) (hc : dist T.c z < ε) :
    triVal U q hop hcov T = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ∀ {x y : ℂ}, dist x z < ε → dist y z < ε →
      segment ℝ x y ⊆ U i0 := fun {x y} hx hy =>
    Set.Subset.trans
      ((convex_ball z ε).segment_subset (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hx)
        (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hy)) hball
  exact tri_eq_zero_of_segments_subset U q hop hcov hcoc (hsub ha hb)
    (hsub hb hc) (hsub hc ha) T.ha T.hb T.hc

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.triVal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem triVal_eq_zero (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (T0 : GTri U) : triVal U q hop hcov T0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hperim0 := T0.perim_nonneg
  
  have hcauchy : CauchySeq (fun k => (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 k).a) :=
    cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2) T0.perim (by norm_num) fun n => by
      show dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).a
        (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (n + 1)).a ≤ T0.perim * (1 / 2) ^ n
      rw [dist_comm]
      calc dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (n + 1)).a
            (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n).a
          ≤ T0.perim / 2 ^ (n + 1) := gseq_dist U q hop hcov hcoc T0 n
        _ ≤ T0.perim * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, ← one_div]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (Nat.le_succ n))
              hperim0
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcauchy
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := exists_idx U hcov z
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hop i0) z hi0
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hz (ε / 4) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one
    (show (0 : ℝ) < ε / 4 / (T0.perim + 1) by
      exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
    (show (1 : ℝ) / 2 < 1 by norm_num)
  
  have hzero : triVal U q hop hcov
      (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)) = 0 := by
    have haz : dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).a z < ε / 4 :=
      hN1 (max N1 N2) (le_max_left N1 N2)
    have hperim : (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).perim < ε / 4 := by
      rw [gseq_perim U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)]
      have hmono : ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ max N1 N2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ N2 :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (le_max_right N1 N2)
      have hrw : T0.perim / 2 ^ max N1 N2 = T0.perim * (1 / 2) ^ max N1 N2 := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, ← one_div]
      rw [hrw]
      have hne1 : T0.perim + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      calc T0.perim * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ max N1 N2
          ≤ (T0.perim + 1) * ((1 / 2) ^ N2) :=
            mul_le_mul (by linarith) hmono (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ < (T0.perim + 1) * (ε / 4 / (T0.perim + 1)) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN2 (by linarith)
        _ = ε / 4 := by field_simp
    have hba := (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).dist_ba_le_perim
    have hca := (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).dist_ca_le_perim
    refine triVal_eq_zero_of_close U q hop hcov hcoc _ hball (by linarith) ?_ ?_
    · calc dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).b z
          ≤ dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).b
              (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).a +
            dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).a z :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < ε := by linarith
    · calc dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).c z
          ≤ dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).c
              (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).a +
            dist (gseq U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)).a z :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < ε := by linarith
  have hval := gseq_val_le U q hop hcov hcoc T0 (max N1 N2)
  rw [hzero] at hval
  simp only [abs_zero, mul_zero] at hval
  exact hne (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hval (abs_nonneg _)))

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_triangle
statement:
theorem beta_triangle (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) (a b c : ℂ) (ia ib ic : ι)
    (ha : a ∈ U ia) (hb : b ∈ U ib) (hc : c ∈ U ic) :
    beta U q hop hcov a b ia ib + beta U q hop hcov b c ib ic +
      beta U q hop hcov c a ic ia = 0
proof:
:=
  triVal_eq_zero U q hop hcov hcoc ⟨a, b, c, ia, ib, ic, ha, hb, hc⟩

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.beta_swap_right
statement:
theorem beta_swap_right (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ)
    (hcoc : Coc U q) {z w : ℂ} {i b b' : ι}
    (hz : z ∈ U i) (hwb : w ∈ U b) (hwb' : w ∈ U b') :
    beta U q hop hcov z w i b = beta U q hop hcov z w i b' + q b' b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hv⟩ := exists_valid_chain U hop hcov z w
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hl
  rw [beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc hl hv hz hwb,
    beta_spec U q hop hcov hcoc hl hv hz hwb']
  exact wSum_swap_right U q hcoc t a hwb hwb'
    (Valid.getLast_mem_w (a :: t) (by simp) hv)

name: HodgePilot.CechGoursat.exists_coboundary
statement:
theorem exists_coboundary (hop : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hconv : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (U i))
    (hcov : ⋃ i, U i = univ) (hcoc : Coc U q) :
    ∃ b : ι → ℚ, ∀ i j, (U i ∩ U j).Nonempty → q i j = b j - b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h0mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ ⋃ i, U i := by rw [hcov]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h0mem
  refine ⟨fun i => if h : (U i).Nonempty then
    beta U q hop hcov 0 h.choose i₀ i else 0, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  obtain ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩ := hij
  have hUi : (U i).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxi⟩
  have hUj : (U j).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxj⟩
  show q i j =
    (if h : (U j).Nonempty then beta U q hop hcov 0 h.choose i₀ j else 0) -
      (if h : (U i).Nonempty then beta U q hop hcov 0 h.choose i₀ i else 0)
  rw [dif_pos hUj, dif_pos hUi]
  
  have hslide : ∀ (k : ι) (hUk : (U k).Nonempty), x ∈ U k →
      beta U q hop hcov 0 hUk.choose i₀ k = beta U q hop hcov 0 x i₀ k := by
    intro k hUk hxk
    have hpk : hUk.choose ∈ U k := hUk.choose_spec
    have htr := beta_triangle U q hop hcov hcoc 0 hUk.choose x i₀ k k
      hi₀ hpk hxk
    have hseg : segment ℝ hUk.choose x ⊆ U k := (hconv k).segment_subset hpk hxk
    have hmid : beta U q hop hcov hUk.choose x k k = q k k + q k k :=
      beta_of_segment_subset U q hop hcov hcoc hseg hpk hxk
    have hqkk : q k k = 0 := hcoc.self_eq_zero hUk
    have hrev : beta U q hop hcov x 0 k i₀ =
        - beta U q hop hcov 0 x i₀ k :=
      beta_rev U q hop hcov hcoc 0 x i₀ k hi₀ hxk
    rw [hmid, hqkk, hrev] at htr
    linarith
  rw [hslide i hUi hxi, hslide j hUj hxj]
  have hswap : beta U q hop hcov 0 x i₀ j =
      beta U q hop hcov 0 x i₀ i + q i j :=
    beta_swap_right U q hop hcov hcoc hi₀ hxj hxi
  linarith

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.basicOpen_one_sec
statement:
theorem basicOpen_one_sec (W : X.Opens) :
    X.basicOpen (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) = W
proof:
:=
  Scheme.basicOpen_one X

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.mem_nvChartOpen_one
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_target_of_mem_imageOpen hy, ?_⟩
  rw [basicOpen_one_sec W]
  exact (mem_pullbackOpen (c.1.symm y) W).mp (symm_mem_of_mem_imageOpen hy)

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.mem_imageOpen_of_nvChartOpen_one
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_imageOpen_iff c).mpr ⟨nvChartOpen_target hy, ?_⟩
  refine (mem_pullbackOpen (c.1.symm y) W).mpr ?_
  have h := nvChartOpen_mem_basicOpen hy
  rwa [basicOpen_one_sec W] at h

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.imageOpen_le_nvChartOpen_one
statement:
theorem imageOpen_le_nvChartOpen_one (c : GluedChart sX d) (W : X.Opens) :
    imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) ≤
      nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hy => mem_nvChartOpen_one hy

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartGradOpen_res_le
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartEvOpen c (res (cRingHom sX) hVW b) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      chartEvOpen c b :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_chartMemLocus c V).mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hm⟩)
      (fun w hw => chartEvOpen_res_le c hVW b hw.2)
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c (res (cRingHom sX) hVW b)) y =
    fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c b) y
  exact hev.fderiv_eq

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartAlgFormOpen_res_le
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormOpen_res_le {p : ℕ} (c : GluedChart sX d) {V W : X.Opens}
    (hVW : V ≤ W) (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) W)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hyt : y ∈ c.1.target)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c.1.symm y) ∈ V) :
    chartAlgFormOpen c (res (cRingHom sX) hVW s)
        (⇑(res (cRingHom sX) hVW) ∘ t) y =
      chartAlgFormOpen c s t y
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAlgFormOpen_apply, chartAlgFormOpen_apply,
    chartEvOpen_res_le c hVW s hm]
  refine congrArg (fun v => chartEvOpen c s y • v) ?_
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun j => ?_)
  exact chartGradOpen_res_le c hVW (t j) hyt hm

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartRealizeOpen_res_val
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_res_val (c : GluedChart sX d) {V W : X.Opens}
    (hVW : V ≤ W) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hzV : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V))
    (hzW : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x)).1 ⟨z, hzV⟩ =
      (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x).1 ⟨z, hzW⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      rfl
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add,
        sections_add_val, sections_add_val, hu, hv]
  | single t s =>
      rw [map_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single]
      exact chartAlgFormOpen_res_le c hVW s t (nvChartOpen_target hzV)
        (nvChartOpen_memU hzV)

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartRealizeOpen_res_diamond
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_res_diamond (c : GluedChart sX d)
    {V₁ V₂ W : X.Opens} (h₁ : V₁ ≤ W) (h₂ : V₂ ≤ W) (p : ℕ)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) (z : Fin d → ℂ)
    (hz₁ : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V₁))
    (hz₂ : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V₂))
    (hzW : z ∈ nvChartOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W)) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V₁) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h₁) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz₁⟩ =
      (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) V₂) p
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) h₂) p x)).1 ⟨z, hz₂⟩
proof:
:=
  (chartRealizeOpen_res_val c h₁ p x z hz₁ hzW).trans
    (chartRealizeOpen_res_val c h₂ p x z hz₂ hzW).symm

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeChartOpen_val
statement:
theorem secRealizeChartOpen_val (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ) (W : X.Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    (y : ↥(imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W))) :
    (secRealizeChartOpen c p W x).1 y =
      (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x).1
        ⟨(y : Fin d → ℂ), mem_nvChartOpen_one y.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeChartOpen_add
statement:
theorem secRealizeChartOpen_add (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ) (W : X.Opens)
    (x x' : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    secRealizeChartOpen c p W (x + x') =
      secRealizeChartOpen c p W x + secRealizeChartOpen c p W x'
proof:
:= by
  show (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (imageOpen_le_nvChartOpen_one c W)).op
      (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p (x + x')) = _
  rw [map_add]
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun _ => rfl)

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeChartOpen_res
statement:
theorem secRealizeChartOpen_res (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {V W : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    secRealizeChartOpen c p V (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x) =
      (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW))).op
        (secRealizeChartOpen c p W x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  exact chartRealizeOpen_res_val c hVW p x (y : Fin d → ℂ)
    (mem_nvChartOpen_one y.2)
    (mem_nvChartOpen_one (imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW) y.2))

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeChartOpen_res_val
statement:
theorem secRealizeChartOpen_res_val (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ)
    {V W : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p)
    (y : ↥(imageOpen c ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj V))) :
    (secRealizeChartOpen c p V
        (DeRham.map (res (cRingHom sX) hVW) p x)).1 y =
      (secRealizeChartOpen c p W x).1
        ⟨(y : Fin d → ℂ), imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW) y.2⟩
proof:
:=
  chartRealizeOpen_res_val c hVW p x (y : Fin d → ℂ)
    (mem_nvChartOpen_one y.2)
    (mem_nvChartOpen_one (imageOpen_mono c (pullbackOpen_mono hVW) y.2))

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeChartOpen_d
statement:
theorem secRealizeChartOpen_d (c : GluedChart sX d) (p : ℕ) (W : X.Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    dSection (secRealizeChartOpen c p W x) =
      secRealizeChartOpen c (p + 1) W
        (DeRham.d ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := dSection_map (imageOpen_le_nvChartOpen_one c W)
    (chartRealizeOpen c (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x)
  rw [dSection_chartRealizeOpen] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartGradOpen_transition
statement:
theorem chartGradOpen_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (b : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hyt : y ∈ c₂.1.target)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c₂.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartGradOpen c₂ b y =
      (chartGradOpen c₁ b ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).comp
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hev : chartEvOpen c₂ b =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (chartEvOpen c₁ b) ∘ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((c₂.1.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm c₁.1.open_source).mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hsrc⟩)
      (fun z hz => chartEvOpen_transition c₁ c₂ b hz.2)
  have hpt : c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) = c₂.1.symm y :=
    c₁.1.left_inv hsrc
  have hm₁ : toSpace sX (c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)) ∈ U := by
    rw [hpt]
    exact hm
  show fderiv ℂ (chartEvOpen c₂ b) y = _
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_comp y
    (analyticAt_chartEvOpen c₁ b (c₁.1.map_source hsrc) hm₁).differentiableAt
    (analyticAt_transFun c₁ c₂ hyt hsrc).differentiableAt

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.transition_mem_nvChartOpen
statement:
theorem transition_mem_nvChartOpen {c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d} {U : X.Opens}
    {f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U} {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChartOpen c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈ nvChartOpen c₁ f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨c₁.1.map_source hsrc, ?_⟩
  have hpt : c₁.1.symm ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y) = c₂.1.symm y :=
    c₁.1.left_inv hsrc
  rw [hpt]
  exact nvChartOpen_mem_basicOpen hy

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartAlgFormOpen_transition
statement:
theorem chartAlgFormOpen_transition {p : ℕ} (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d)
    {U : X.Opens} (s : Sec (cRingHom sX) U)
    (t : Fin p → Sec (cRingHom sX) U) {y : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hyt : y ∈ c₂.1.target) (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source)
    (hm : toSpace sX (c₂.1.symm y) ∈ U) :
    chartAlgFormOpen c₂ s t y =
      (chartAlgFormOpen c₁ s t
          ((⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAlgFormOpen_apply, chartAlgFormOpen_apply,
    smul_compContinuousLinearMap, formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap,
    chartEvOpen_transition c₁ c₂ s hsrc]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun j => ?_)
  exact chartGradOpen_transition c₁ c₂ (t j) hyt hsrc hm

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.chartRealizeOpen_transition
statement:
theorem chartRealizeOpen_transition (c₁ c₂ : GluedChart sX d) {U : X.Opens}
    (f : Sec (cRingHom sX) U) (p : ℕ) (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) U) p)
    {y : Fin d → ℂ} (hy : y ∈ nvChartOpen c₂ f)
    (hsrc : c₂.1.symm y ∈ c₁.1.source) :
    (chartRealizeOpen c₂ f p x).1 ⟨y, hy⟩ =
      ((chartRealizeOpen c₁ f p x).1
          ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChartOpen hy hsrc⟩).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      rw [show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c₂ f))).1 ⟨y, hy⟩) = 0 from rfl,
        show ((0 : (omegaSheaf d (FormSpace d p)).presheaf.obj
          (op (nvChartOpen c₁ f))).1 ⟨(⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y,
            transition_mem_nvChartOpen hy hsrc⟩) = 0 from rfl,
        zero_compContinuousLinearMap]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, sections_add_val,
        sections_add_val, hu, hv, add_compContinuousLinearMap]
  | single t s =>
      rw [chartRealizeOpen_mk_single, chartRealizeOpen_mk_single]
      exact chartAlgFormOpen_transition c₁ c₂ s t (nvChartOpen_target hy)
        hsrc (nvChartOpen_memU hy)

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.isCompat_secRealizeChartOpen
statement:
theorem isCompat_secRealizeChartOpen (p : ℕ) {W : X.Opens}
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    IsCompat p ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W)
      (fun c : GluedChart sX d => secRealizeChartOpen c p W x)
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ y hy hsrc
  have hyi : (⇑c₁.1 ∘ ⇑c₂.1.symm) y ∈
      imageOpen c₁ ((Opens.map (sPointsToZariski sX)).obj W) :=
    transition_mem_imageOpen hy hsrc
  rw [sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hy, sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem _ hyi,
    secRealizeChartOpen_val, secRealizeChartOpen_val]
  exact chartRealizeOpen_transition c₁ c₂ (1 : Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p x
    (mem_nvChartOpen_one hy) hsrc

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeFamilyOpen_val
statement:
theorem secRealizeFamilyOpen_val (p : ℕ) (W : X.Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) (c : GluedChart sX d) :
    (secRealizeFamilyOpen (d := d) p W x).1 c =
      secRealizeChartOpen c p W x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ProperFormsAssembly.secRealizeFamilyHom_apply
statement:
theorem secRealizeFamilyHom_apply (p : ℕ) (W : X.Opens)
    (x : DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom sX) W) p) :
    secRealizeFamilyHom (d := d) p W x = secRealizeFamilyOpen p W x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQ_injective
statement:
theorem sigmaQ_injective (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] :
    Function.Injective (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:=
  Function.Involutive.injective (sigmaQ_sigmaQ V)

name: HodgePilot.map_sigmaQ_map_sigmaQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_sigmaQ_map_sigmaQ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module ℚ V] (S : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) :
    (S.map (sigmaQ V)).map (sigmaQ V) = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [sigmaQ_sigmaQ]
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨sigmaQ V x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, sigmaQ_sigmaQ V x⟩

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.piece_of_ne
statement: theorem piece_of_ne (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (h : pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ n) : Φ.piece pq = ⊥
proof:
:=
  if_neg h

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.piece_of_eq
statement:
theorem piece_of_eq (p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) :
    Φ.piece (p, q) = Φ.F p ⊓ (Φ.F q).map (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:=
  if_pos h

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.piece_le_F
statement: theorem piece_le_F (p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) : Φ.piece (p, q) ≤ Φ.F p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.piece_of_eq p q h]
  exact inf_le_left

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.piece_le_conj
statement:
theorem piece_le_conj (p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) :
    Φ.piece (p, q) ≤ (Φ.F q).map (sigmaQ V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.piece_of_eq p q h]
  exact inf_le_right

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.inf_step
statement:
theorem inf_step (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    (Φ.F p ⊓ (Φ.F q).map (sigmaQ V)) ⊓
      (Φ.F (p + 1) ⊔ (Φ.F (q + 1)).map (sigmaQ V)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  set A := Φ.F p
  set A' := Φ.F (p + 1)
  set B := (Φ.F q).map (sigmaQ V)
  set B' := (Φ.F (q + 1)).map (sigmaQ V)
  have hA'B : A' ⊓ B = ⊥ :=
    disjoint_iff.mp (Φ.opposed (p + 1) q (by omega)).disjoint
  have hAB' : A ⊓ B' = ⊥ :=
    disjoint_iff.mp (Φ.opposed p (q + 1) (by omega)).disjoint
  have hB'B : B' ≤ B := Submodule.map_mono (Φ.antitone (by omega))
  calc (A ⊓ B) ⊓ (A' ⊔ B')
      = A ⊓ ((B' ⊔ A') ⊓ B) := by
        rw [inf_assoc, inf_comm B (A' ⊔ B'), sup_comm A' B']
    _ = A ⊓ (B' ⊔ A' ⊓ B) := by rw [sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hB'B]
    _ = A ⊓ B' := by rw [hA'B, sup_bot_eq]
    _ = ⊥ := hAB'

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.F_eq_piece_sup_succ
statement:
theorem F_eq_piece_sup_succ (p : ℤ) :
    Φ.F p = (Φ.F p ⊓ (Φ.F (n - p)).map (sigmaQ V)) ⊔ Φ.F (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set A := Φ.F p
  set A' := Φ.F (p + 1)
  set B := (Φ.F (n - p)).map (sigmaQ V)
  have htop : A' ⊔ B = ⊤ :=
    codisjoint_iff.mp (Φ.opposed (p + 1) (n - p) (by omega)).codisjoint
  have hA'A : A' ≤ A := Φ.antitone (by omega)
  calc A = (A' ⊔ B) ⊓ A := by rw [htop, top_inf_eq]
    _ = A' ⊔ B ⊓ A := by rw [sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hA'A]
    _ = (A ⊓ B) ⊔ A' := by rw [inf_comm B A, sup_comm]

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.iSupIndep_piece
statement: theorem iSupIndep_piece : iSupIndep Φ.piece
proof:
:= by
  intro pq
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := pq
  by_cases hn : a + b = n
  · have hrest : (⨆ (pq') (_ : pq' ≠ (a, b)), Φ.piece pq') ≤
        Φ.F (a + 1) ⊔ (Φ.F (b + 1)).map (sigmaQ V) := by
      refine iSup₂_le ?_
      rintro ⟨a', b'⟩ hne
      by_cases hn' : a' + b' = n
      · rcases lt_trichotomy a' a with hlt | heq | hgt
        · refine le_sup_of_le_right ?_
          refine (Φ.piece_le_conj a' b' hn').trans (Submodule.map_mono ?_)
          exact Φ.antitone (by omega)
        · exfalso
          apply hne
          subst heq
          have : b' = b := by omega
          subst this
          rfl
        · refine le_sup_of_le_left ?_
          refine (Φ.piece_le_F a' b' hn').trans ?_
          exact Φ.antitone (by omega)
      · rw [Φ.piece_of_ne (a', b') hn']
        exact bot_le
    refine Disjoint.mono_right hrest ?_
    rw [disjoint_iff, Φ.piece_of_eq a b hn, Φ.inf_step a b hn]
  · rw [Φ.piece_of_ne (a, b) hn]
    exact disjoint_bot_left

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.iSup_piece_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_piece_eq_top : ⨆ pq, Φ.piece pq = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Φ.exhaustive_top
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Φ.exhaustive_bot
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, Φ.F (b - k) ≤ ⨆ pq, Φ.piece pq := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        have h0 : b - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = b := by omega
        rw [h0, hb]
        exact bot_le
    | succ k ih =>
        have harg : b - ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = b - (k : ℤ) := by ring
        have hstep := Φ.F_eq_piece_sup_succ (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1))
        rw [harg] at hstep
        have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast, hstep]
        refine sup_le ?_ ih
        have hpiece : Φ.F (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1)) ⊓
            (Φ.F (n - (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1)))).map (sigmaQ V) =
            Φ.piece (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1), n - (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1))) :=
          (Φ.piece_of_eq _ _ (by omega)).symm
        rw [hpiece]
        exact le_iSup Φ.piece _
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr ?_
  calc (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V)) = Φ.F a := ha.symm
    _ ≤ Φ.F (b - ((b - a).toNat : ℤ)) := Φ.antitone (by omega)
    _ ≤ ⨆ pq, Φ.piece pq := key _

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.toQHodgeStructure_H
statement:
@[simp] theorem toQHodgeStructure_H (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Φ.toQHodgeStructure.H pq = Φ.piece pq
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.ext_H
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.ext_H {h₁ h₂ : QHodgeStructure n V}
    (hH : h₁.H = h₂.H) : h₁ = h₂
proof:
:= by
  cases h₁
  cases h₂
  cases hH
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.toOpposedFiltration_toQHodgeStructure
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.toOpposedFiltration_toQHodgeStructure
    (h : QHodgeStructure n V) :
    h.toOpposedFiltration.toQHodgeStructure = h
proof:
:= by
  refine QHodgeStructure.ext_H (funext fun pq => ?_)
  obtain ⟨p, q⟩ := pq
  by_cases hpq : p + q = n
  · rw [OpposedFiltration.toQHodgeStructure_H,
      OpposedFiltration.piece_of_eq _ p q hpq]
    exact (h.H_eq_filtration_inf_conj hpq).symm
  · rw [OpposedFiltration.toQHodgeStructure_H,
      OpposedFiltration.piece_of_ne _ (p, q) hpq]
    exact (h.supported (p, q) hpq).symm

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.ext_F
statement:
theorem ext_F {Φ₁ Φ₂ : OpposedFiltration n V} (hF : Φ₁.F = Φ₂.F) :
    Φ₁ = Φ₂
proof:
:= by
  cases Φ₁
  cases Φ₂
  cases hF
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.filtration_le_F
statement:
theorem filtration_le_F (p : ℤ) :
    Φ.toQHodgeStructure.filtration p ≤ Φ.F p
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Φ.toQHodgeStructure.filtration p
      = ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : p ≤ pq.1), Φ.piece pq from rfl]
  refine iSup₂_le ?_
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hpa
  by_cases hn : a + b = n
  · exact (Φ.piece_le_F a b hn).trans (Φ.antitone hpa)
  · rw [Φ.piece_of_ne (a, b) hn]
    exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.F_le_filtration
statement:
theorem F_le_filtration (p : ℤ) :
    Φ.F p ≤ Φ.toQHodgeStructure.filtration p
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Φ.toQHodgeStructure.filtration p
      = ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : p ≤ pq.1), Φ.piece pq from rfl]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Φ.exhaustive_bot
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, Φ.F (b - k) ≤
      ⨆ (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (_ : b - (k : ℤ) ≤ pq.1), Φ.piece pq := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        have h0 : b - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = b := by norm_num
        rw [h0, hb]
        exact bot_le
    | succ k ih =>
        have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast]
        have hstep := Φ.F_eq_piece_sup_succ (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1))
        have harg : b - ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = b - (k : ℤ) := by ring
        rw [harg] at hstep
        rw [hstep]
        refine sup_le ?_ (ih.trans (iSup₂_le fun pq hpq =>
          le_iSup₂ (f := fun pq' (_ : b - ((k : ℤ) + 1) ≤ pq'.1) => Φ.piece pq')
            pq (by omega)))
        rw [(Φ.piece_of_eq (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1)) (n - (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1)))
          (by omega)).symm]
        exact le_iSup₂
          (f := fun pq' (_ : b - ((k : ℤ) + 1) ≤ pq'.1) => Φ.piece pq')
          (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1), n - (b - ((k : ℤ) + 1))) le_rfl
  by_cases hpb : p ≤ b
  · have hk := key (b - p).toNat
    rw [show b - (((b - p).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = p from by omega] at hk
    exact hk
  · refine le_trans (Φ.antitone (by omega : b ≤ p)) ?_
    rw [hb]
    exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.filtration_toQHodgeStructure
statement:
theorem filtration_toQHodgeStructure (p : ℤ) :
    Φ.toQHodgeStructure.filtration p = Φ.F p
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Φ.filtration_le_F p) (Φ.F_le_filtration p)

name: HodgePilot.OpposedFiltration.toQHodgeStructure_toOpposedFiltration
statement:
theorem toQHodgeStructure_toOpposedFiltration :
    Φ.toQHodgeStructure.toOpposedFiltration = Φ
proof:
:=
  ext_F (funext fun p => Φ.filtration_toQHodgeStructure p)

name: HodgePilot.iSupIndep_biSup_fiber
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_biSup_fiber {A : κ → Submodule R M} (hA : iSupIndep A)
    (f : κ → ι) :
    iSupIndep fun i => ⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i), A k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i₀
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  
  have hright : (⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), ⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i), A k) ≤
      ⨆ (k) (_ : f k ≠ i₀), A k := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun i hi => iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_
    have hki₀ : f k ≠ i₀ := by rw [hk]; exact hi
    exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun k (_ : f k ≠ i₀) => A k) k hki₀
  calc
    (⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i₀), A k) ⊓
        ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), ⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i), A k
        ≤ (⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i₀), A k) ⊓ ⨆ (k) (_ : f k ≠ i₀), A k :=
          inf_le_inf_left _ hright
    _ ≤ ⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i₀ ∧ f k ≠ i₀), A k :=
          biSup_inf_biSup_le_of_iSupIndep hA (fun k => f k = i₀) (fun k => f k ≠ i₀)
    _ = ⊥ := by
          refine le_bot_iff.mp (iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_)
          exact absurd hk.1 hk.2

name: HodgePilot.biSup_fiber_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem biSup_fiber_eq_iSup (f : κ → ι) (A : κ → Submodule R M) :
    (⨆ i, ⨆ (k) (_ : f k = i), A k) = ⨆ k, A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_comm]
  refine iSup_congr fun k => ?_
  exact iSup_iSup_eq_right

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.mapEquiv
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.IsInternal.mapEquiv {A : ι → Submodule R M}
    [DecidableEq ι] (hA : DirectSum.IsInternal A) {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (A i).map (e : M →ₗ[R] N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top] at hA ⊢
  obtain ⟨hindep, hspan⟩ := hA
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hmap := hindep.map_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap e)
    have hfun : (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap e) ∘ A =
        fun i => (A i).map (e : M →ₗ[R] N) := by
      funext i
      rw [Function.comp_apply, Submodule.orderIsoMapComap_apply]
    rwa [hfun] at hmap
  · rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hspan, Submodule.map_top, LinearEquiv.range]

name: DirectSum.IsInternal.regroup
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_biSup_fiber hA.submodule_iSupIndep f)
    (by rw [biSup_fiber_eq_iSup]; exact hA.submodule_iSup_eq_top)

name: HodgePilot.tensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorEquiv_tmul (c d : ℂ) (v : V) (w : W) :
    tensorEquiv V W ((c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (d ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w)) =
      (d * c) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (v ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul]
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.assoc_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.sigmaQR_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem sigmaQR_tensorEquiv (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    sigmaQR (V ⊗[ℚ] W) (tensorEquiv V W (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y)) =
      tensorEquiv V W (sigmaQR V x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] sigmaQR W y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ =>
      rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, map_add,
        TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, hx₁, hx₂]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ =>
          rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add,
            TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [tensorEquiv_tmul, sigmaQR_tmul, map_mul]

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_def
statement:
theorem tensorPiece_def (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (k : QHodgeStructure m W)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    tensorPiece h k pq =
      ⨆ (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (_ : x.1 + x.2 = pq),
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2))).map
          (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_tensor_family
statement:
theorem isInternal_tensor_family (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) =>
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let εV : (⨁ ab, h.H ab) ≃ₗ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap h.H) h.isInternal
  let εW : (⨁ cd, k.H cd) ≃ₗ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap k.H) k.isInternal
  
  let Θ : (⨁ x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), (h.H x.1) ⊗[ℂ] (k.H x.2)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ⊗[ℂ] (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :=
    (TensorProduct.directSum ℂ ℂ (fun ab => h.H ab) (fun cd => k.H cd)).symm ≪≫ₗ
      TensorProduct.congr εV εW
  
  
  have hinj : ∀ x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
      Function.Injective (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)) := fun x =>
    TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _
      (Submodule.injective_subtype _) (Submodule.injective_subtype _)
  let φ : ∀ x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
      ((h.H x.1) ⊗[ℂ] (k.H x.2)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
        LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)) := fun x =>
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)).rangeRestrict
      ⟨(LinearMap.injective_rangeRestrict_iff _).mpr (hinj x),
        LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict _⟩
  
  let Dφ : (⨁ x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), (h.H x.1) ⊗[ℂ] (k.H x.2)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      ⨁ x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
        LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)) :=
    DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv φ
  
  
  have hkey : (DirectSum.coeLinearMap
        fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) =>
          LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)))
        ∘ₗ Dφ.toLinearMap = Θ.toLinearMap := by
    refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℂ fun x => ?_
    
    obtain ⟨x1, x2⟩ := x
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
    
    have hDφ : Dφ (DirectSum.lof ℂ _ _ (x1, x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)) =
        DirectSum.lof ℂ _ _ (x1, x2) (φ (x1, x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)) := by
      show DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv φ (DFinsupp.single (x1, x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b)) =
        DFinsupp.single (x1, x2) (φ (x1, x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b))
      simp only [DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv_apply, DFinsupp.mapRange_single]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hDφ]
    
    rw [DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof]
    have hφcoe : ((φ (x1, x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) :
        LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x1) (k.H x2))) :
          (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) ⊗[ℂ] (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W)) =
        TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x1) (k.H x2) (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] b) := rfl
    rw [hφcoe]
    simp only [TensorProduct.mapIncl, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.coe_subtype]
    
    simp only [Θ, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      TensorProduct.directSum_symm_lof_tmul, TensorProduct.congr_tmul, εV, εW,
      LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply, DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof]
  
  have hcoe : (DirectSum.coeLinearMap
        fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) =>
          LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)))
        = Θ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Dφ.symm.toLinearMap := by
    rw [← hkey, LinearMap.comp_assoc, Dφ.comp_symm, LinearMap.comp_id]
  show Function.Bijective ⇑(DirectSum.coeLinearMap
    fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) =>
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2)))
  rw [hcoe]
  exact Θ.bijective.comp Dφ.symm.bijective

name: HodgePilot.isInternal_tensorPiece
statement:
theorem isInternal_tensorPiece (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (tensorPiece h k)
proof:
:=
  ((isInternal_tensor_family h k).mapEquiv (tensorEquiv V W)).regroup
    (fun x => x.1 + x.2)

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_supported
statement:
theorem tensorPiece_supported (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (k : QHodgeStructure m W)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (hpq : pq.1 + pq.2 ≠ n + m) : tensorPiece h k pq = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPiece_def, eq_bot_iff]
  refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
  
  have hxfst : x.1.1 + x.2.1 = pq.1 := by
    have := congrArg Prod.fst hx; simpa [Prod.fst_add] using this
  have hxsnd : x.1.2 + x.2.2 = pq.2 := by
    have := congrArg Prod.snd hx; simpa [Prod.snd_add] using this
  refine le_bot_iff.mpr ?_
  by_cases hV : x.1.1 + x.1.2 = n
  · by_cases hW : x.2.1 + x.2.2 = m
    · exact absurd (by omega : pq.1 + pq.2 = n + m) hpq
    · 
      rw [show k.H x.2 = ⊥ from k.supported x.2 hW,
        TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_right, Submodule.map_bot]
  · 
    rw [show h.H x.1 = ⊥ from h.supported x.1 hV,
      TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, Submodule.map₂_bot_left, Submodule.map_bot]

name: HodgePilot.map_sigma_summand
statement:
theorem map_sigma_summand (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (k : QHodgeStructure m W)
    (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    ((LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2))).map
        (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)).map (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W)) =
      (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
          (h.H (x.1.2, x.1.1)) (k.H (x.2.2, x.2.1)))).map
        (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, TensorProduct.range_mapIncl,
    Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2]
  simp only [Submodule.map_span]
  congr 1
  
  simp only [Set.image_image2]
  
  
  have hpV' : h.H (x.1.2, x.1.1) = (h.H x.1).map (sigmaQ V) := by
    rw [← show ((x.1.1, x.1.2) : ℤ × ℤ) = x.1 from Prod.mk.eta,
      h.conj_symm x.1.1 x.1.2]
  have hpW' : k.H (x.2.2, x.2.1) = (k.H x.2).map (sigmaQ W) := by
    rw [← show ((x.2.1, x.2.2) : ℤ × ℤ) = x.2 from Prod.mk.eta,
      k.conj_symm x.2.1 x.2.2]
  rw [hpV', hpW', Submodule.map_coe, Submodule.map_coe,
    Set.image2_image_left, Set.image2_image_right]
  
  refine Set.image2_congr fun p _ q _ => ?_
  simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, sigmaQ_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact sigmaQR_tensorEquiv V W p q

name: HodgePilot.tensorPiece_conj_symm
statement:
theorem tensorPiece_conj_symm (h : QHodgeStructure n V) (k : QHodgeStructure m W)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    (tensorPiece h k (p, q)).map (sigmaQ (V ⊗[ℚ] W)) = tensorPiece h k (q, p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPiece_def, tensorPiece_def]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, map_sigma_summand]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_) (iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_)
  · 
    refine le_iSup₂
      (f := fun y (_ : y.1 + y.2 = (q, p)) =>
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H y.1) (k.H y.2))).map
          (tensorEquiv V W).toLinearMap)
      ((x.1.2, x.1.1), (x.2.2, x.2.1)) ?_
    
    have h1 : x.1.1 + x.2.1 = p := by
      have := congrArg Prod.fst hx; simpa [Prod.fst_add] using this
    have h2 : x.1.2 + x.2.2 = q := by
      have := congrArg Prod.snd hx; simpa [Prod.snd_add] using this
    exact Prod.ext (by simp only [Prod.fst_add]; omega)
      (by simp only [Prod.snd_add]; omega)
  · 
    refine le_iSup₂
      (f := fun y (_ : y.1 + y.2 = (p, q)) =>
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl
            (h.H (y.1.2, y.1.1)) (k.H (y.2.2, y.2.1)))).map
          (tensorEquiv V W).toLinearMap)
      ((x.1.2, x.1.1), (x.2.2, x.2.1)) ?_
    have h1 : x.1.1 + x.2.1 = q := by
      have := congrArg Prod.fst hx; simpa [Prod.fst_add] using this
    have h2 : x.1.2 + x.2.2 = p := by
      have := congrArg Prod.snd hx; simpa [Prod.snd_add] using this
    exact Prod.ext (by simp only [Prod.fst_add]; omega)
      (by simp only [Prod.snd_add]; omega)

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.pullbackConstIso_naturality
statement:
lemma pullbackConstIso_naturality {M N : AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (pullbackAb f).map
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ) ≫
      (pullbackConstIso f N).hom =
    (pullbackConstIso f M).hom ≫
      (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ
proof:
:=
  (pullbackConstantSheafIso f).hom.naturality φ

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.pullbackH_apply
statement:
lemma pullbackH_apply (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (n : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H F n) :
    pullbackH f F n x =
      (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (pullbackZIso f).inv).comp
        (x.mapExactFunctor (pullbackAb f)) (zero_add n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.pullbackH_naturality
statement:
lemma pullbackH_naturality {F G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H F n) :
    pullbackH f G n (Sheaf.H.map φ n x) =
      Sheaf.H.map ((pullbackAb f).map φ) n (pullbackH f F n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackH_apply, Sheaf.H.map_apply, Sheaf.H.map_apply, pullbackH_apply,
    Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp _ _ _ (add_zero n),
    Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀]
  exact (Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc _ _ _ (zero_add n) (add_zero n) (by omega)).symm

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.pullbackH_constMap_comm
statement:
lemma pullbackH_constMap_comm {M N : AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (φ : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj M) n) :
    Sheaf.H.map
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ) n
        (Sheaf.H.map (pullbackConstIso f M).hom n (pullbackH f _ n x)) =
      Sheaf.H.map (pullbackConstIso f N).hom n
        (pullbackH f _ n
          (Sheaf.H.map
            ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ)
            n x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackH_naturality, ← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply,
    pullbackConstIso_naturality]

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.hyperHPullback_apply
statement:
lemma hyperHPullback_apply (Z : C) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) (x : hyperH Z K n) :
    hyperHPullback F Z K n x =
      (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app Z ≫
        ShiftedHom.map x F.mapDerivedCategory ≫
          (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) n).map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.hyperHPullback_naturality_aux
statement:
lemma hyperHPullback_naturality_aux (Z : C) {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (φ : K ⟶ L)
    (n : ℤ)
    (y : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Z ⟶
        (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    (F.mapDerivedCategory.map
          (y ≫ (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ)) ≫
        (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
      (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) n).map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app L) =
    ((F.mapDerivedCategory.map y ≫
          (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ≫
        (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) n).map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K)) ≫
      (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) n).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map φ))
proof:
:= by
  have hτ := (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.naturality (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ)
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at hτ
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hτ]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp, F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality]

name: HodgePilot.PullbackCohomology.hyperHPullback_naturality
statement:
lemma hyperHPullback_naturality (Z : C) {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (φ : K ⟶ L)
    (n : ℤ) (x : hyperH Z K n) :
    hyperHPullback F Z L n (hyperHMap Z φ n x) =
      hyperHMap (F.obj Z) ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map φ) n
        (hyperHPullback F Z K n x)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun q => (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app Z ≫ q)
      (hyperHPullback_naturality_aux F Z φ n x)).trans
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (⋀[R]^p M)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span] at hx
  refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ rfl (fun y z _ _ hy hz => by rw [hy, hz, add_zero])
    (fun c y _ hy => by rw [hy, smul_zero]) hx
  rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin p, ∃ c : R, c • w = v i := fun i =>
    Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (hw ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  choose c hc using hc
  have hv : v = fun i => c i • (fun _ : Fin p => w) i := funext fun i => (hc i).symm
  have h01 : (0 : ℕ) < p := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_two hp
  have h11 : (1 : ℕ) < p := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hp
  have h0 : exteriorPower.ιMulti R p (fun _ : Fin p => w) = 0 :=
    AlternatingMap.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ _ (rfl : w = w)
      (show (⟨0, h01⟩ : Fin p) ≠ ⟨1, h11⟩ from
        fun h => Nat.zero_ne_one (congrArg Fin.val h))
  have hsm : (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p) (fun i => c i • (fun _ : Fin p => w) i) =
      (∏ i, c i) • (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p) (fun _ : Fin p => w) :=
    MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R p).toMultilinearMap c _
  rw [hv, hsm, h0, smul_zero]

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.span_D_singleton_of_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_D_singleton_of_adjoin {x : B} (hx : Algebra.adjoin A {x} = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span B {KaehlerDifferential.D A B x} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  rw [← KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation]
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hb : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin A ({x} : Set B) := hx ▸ Algebra.mem_top
  induction hb using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      obtain rfl : y = x := hy
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [Derivation.map_algebraMap]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
      rw [Derivation.leibniz]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hz) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy)

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.subsingleton_DR_of_adjoin_singleton
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Subsingleton (⋀[B]^p (Ω[B⁄A])) := by
    refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun y => ?_
    exact (exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_span_singleton
      (span_D_singleton_of_adjoin hx) hp y).symm ▸ rfl
  exact Equiv.subsingleton (DeRham.exteriorPowerEquiv A B p).toEquiv

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.gradeZero_fromZero_eq_algebraMap

        (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜₂ (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i))) =

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.constants_awayι
statement:
theorem constants_awayι (i : Fin 2) :
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i) (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).appTop =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
        (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hs : structMor =
      Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜₂ ≫ Spec.map (gradeZeroEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) :=
    rfl
  rw [hs, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, ← Category.assoc,
    gradeZero_fromZero_eq_algebraMap]

      (chartOpen i).ι.appTop ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)
          (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).inv.appTop
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop
statement:
theorem basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop (i : Fin 2) :
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).hom.appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)))).hom ≫
        Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i) ≫
        (chartOpen i).topIso.inv
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.constants_section_hom
statement:
theorem constants_section_hom (i : Fin 2) :
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)).op =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i))) ≫
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)
proof:
:= by
  have hι : (chartOpen i).ι.appTop =
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i) (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).appTop ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)
          (X_mem_grade_one i) one_pos).hom.appTop := by
    rw [awayι_appTop, Category.assoc, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← chart_ι_appTop_topIso, hι, basicOpenIsoSpec_hom_appTop]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [constants_awayι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.constants_receipt
statement:
theorem constants_receipt (i : Fin 2) (c : ℂ) :
    res (cRingHom structMor) (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤) (cRingHom structMor c) =
      awaySection (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (algebraMap ℂ (Away 𝒜₂ (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)
proof:

      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℂ)).inv ≫ structMor.appTop) ≫
        p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen i ≤ ⊤)).op).hom c := rfl
  rw [h1, constants_section_hom]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.adjoin_chartGen

theorem adjoin_chartGen (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≠ j) :

        Set (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (chartOpen i))) = ⊤
proof:

      (Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 1 → _))) =

        (chartPoly i j hij '' Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : Fin 1 → _)) :=

    (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).mpr (chartPoly_surjective i j hij),

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.subsingleton_DR_basicOpen
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_basicOpen (U : p1.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ}
    (hU : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) p))
    (f : Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p1.basicOpen f)) p)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun y => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, k, hzk⟩ :=
    DeRhamSheaf.exists_res_map_eq_pow_smul (cRingHom structMor) U f p y
  rw [Subsingleton.elim z 0, map_zero] at hzk
  exact DeRhamSheaf.eq_zero_of_res_pow_smul_eq_zero (cRingHom structMor) U f p k hzk

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.exists_basicOpen_subsingleton
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_subsingleton (U : p1.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) {x : p1} (hxU : x ∈ U.toOpens) (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hxi : x ∈ chartOpen i) :
    ∃ f : Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens,
      Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
        (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p1.basicOpen f)) p) ∧
        x ∈ p1.basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgU, hxg⟩ :=
    (chartAffine i).2.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.toOpens) hxi
  
  have hWg : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p1.basicOpen g)) p) :=
    subsingleton_DR_basicOpen (chartAffine i)
      (subsingleton_DR_chart i j hij hp) g
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf_le, hxf⟩ :=
    U.2.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxg⟩ : (p1.basicOpen g : p1.Opens)) hxU
  refine ⟨f, ?_, hxf⟩
  
  have hb : p1.basicOpen (res (cRingHom structMor) hgU f) = p1.basicOpen f := by
    rw [res_apply, Scheme.basicOpen_res]
    exact inf_eq_right.mpr hf_le
  exact subsingleton_DR_congr hb
    (subsingleton_DR_basicOpen ⟨p1.basicOpen g, (chartAffine i).2.basicOpen g⟩
      hWg (res (cRingHom structMor) hgU f))

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.subsingleton_DR_all
statement:
theorem subsingleton_DR_all (U : p1.AffineZariskiSite) {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : Set (Sec (cRingHom structMor) U.toOpens) :=
    {f | Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p1.basicOpen f)) p)} with hs
  have hcov : (⨆ f : s, p1.basicOpen (f.1 : Γ(p1, U.toOpens))) = U.toOpens := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun f => p1.basicOpen_le f.1) fun x hx => ?_
    have hx2 : x ∈ U0 ⊔ U1 := by rw [U0_sup_U1]; trivial
    have hchart : ∃ (i j : Fin 2), i ≠ j ∧ x ∈ chartOpen i := by
      rcases (Opens.mem_sup).mp hx2 with h0 | h1
      · exact ⟨0, 1, by decide, h0⟩
      · exact ⟨1, 0, by decide, h1⟩
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hxi⟩ := hchart
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_subsingleton U hp hx i j hij hxi
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, hxf⟩
  have hspan : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := U.2.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff.mp hcov
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
  refine DeRhamSheaf.eq_of_res_map_eq_of_span (cRingHom structMor) U hspan p
    (fun f hf => ?_)
  haveI : Subsingleton (DeRham.DR ℂ
      (Sec (cRingHom structMor) (p1.basicOpen f)) p) := hf
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.isZero_deRhamSheafZ
statement:
theorem isZero_deRhamSheafZ {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    IsZero (deRhamSheafZ (cRingHom structMor) m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  haveI : Subsingleton

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationDegreeFour.isZero_trunc_X

    IsZero ((brutalTruncGE
      (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor))) 2).X n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n < 2
  · exact isZero_brutalTruncGE_X _ 2 n hn
  · rw [not_lt] at hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = (m : ℤ) :=
      ⟨n.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by lia)).symm⟩
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hn
    exact (isZero_deRhamSheafZ hm).of_iso
      ((brutalTruncGEXIso
          (reindexZ (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor))) 2 (m : ℤ)
          (by exact_mod_cast hm)) ≪≫
        reindexZXIso (deRhamSheafZComplexN (cRingHom structMor)) m)

proof:

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.exists_lift_of_app_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_app_surjective {B R : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (g : B ⟶ R)
    (U : C) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (g.hom.app (op U)))
    (φ : freeYonedaSheaf J U ⟶ R) : ∃ ψ : freeYonedaSheaf J U ⟶ B, ψ ≫ g = φ
proof:
:= by
  set adjB := (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv (freeYonedaPresheaf U) B
    with hadjB
  set adjR := (sheafificationAdjunction J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv (freeYonedaPresheaf U) R
    with hadjR
  set s : R.obj.obj (op U) := (adjR φ).app (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U)) with hs
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsurj s
  refine ⟨sheafHomOfSection B U t, ?_⟩
  have h1 : sheafHomOfSection B U t ≫ g = sheafHomOfSection R U (g.hom.app (op U) t) := by
    apply adjR.injective
    have hnat : adjR (sheafHomOfSection B U t ≫ g) =
        adjB (sheafHomOfSection B U t) ≫ (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map g :=
      Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right _ _ _
    have hB : adjB (sheafHomOfSection B U t) = freeYonedaHomOfSection t :=
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
    have hR : adjR (sheafHomOfSection R U (g.hom.app (op U) t)) =
        freeYonedaHomOfSection (g.hom.app (op U) t) :=
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
    have hcomp := freeYonedaHomOfSection_comp
      ((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map g) (U := U) t
    rw [hnat, hB, hR]
    exact hcomp
  rw [h1, ht]
  have h2 : φ = adjR.symm (adjR φ) := (Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _).symm
  have h3 : (adjR φ) = freeYonedaHomOfSection s := freeYonedaHom_eq_ofSection (adjR φ)
  rw [h2, h3]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.drZeroEquiv_map_res
statement:
theorem drZeroEquiv_map_res {V W : Scheme.Opens p1} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : HodgePilot.DeRham.DR ℂ (Sec φC W) 0) :
    HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv ℂ (Sec φC V)
        (HodgePilot.DeRham.map (res φC h) 0 x) =
      res φC h (HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv ℂ (Sec φC W) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction w using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hu, hv]
  | single t s =>
      rw [HodgePilot.DeRham.map_mk_single, HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv_mk_single,
        HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv_mk_single]

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.oToRing_natural
statement:
theorem oToRing_natural {W' W : p1.AffineZariskiSite} (h : W'.toOpens ≤ W.toOpens)
