    oToRing W' (structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (oToRing W s)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op
      (secComparisonZero.app (op W.toOpens) (secInvZero W s)) =
      secComparisonZero.app (op W'.toOpens)
        ((HodgePilot.DLog.drAbOpens φC 0).map (homOfLE h).op (secInvZero W s)) :=
    (congrArg
      (fun (t : (HodgePilot.DLog.drAbOpens φC 0).obj (op W.toOpens) ⟶
          structO.obj.obj (op W'.toOpens)) => t (secInvZero W s))
      (secComparisonZero.naturality (homOfLE h).op)).symm
  have h1 : structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op s =
      secComparisonZero.app (op W'.toOpens)
        ((HodgePilot.DLog.drAbOpens φC 0).map (homOfLE h).op (secInvZero W s)) := by
    rw [← hnat, secComparisonZero_secInvZero]
  rw [oToRing, h1, secInvZero_secComparisonZero]
  show HodgePilot.DeRham.drZeroEquiv ℂ (Sec φC W'.toOpens)
    (HodgePilot.DeRham.map (res φC h) 0 (secInvZero W s)) = _
  rw [drZeroEquiv_map_res]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.app_injective_of_mono
statement:
theorem app_injective_of_mono {F G : Sheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}} (ι : F ⟶ G)
    [Mono ι] (V : Scheme.Opens p1) :
    Function.Injective (ι.hom.app (op V))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono ((sheafToPresheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι) :=
    (sheafToPresheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map_mono ι
  haveI : Mono (((sheafToPresheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι).app (op V)) :=
    inferInstance
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective (ι.hom.app (op V))).mp
    (inferInstanceAs (Mono (((sheafToPresheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}).map ι).app (op V))))

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.rmap_rmap
statement:
theorem rmap_rmap {V W T : Scheme.Opens p1} (h1 : W ≤ T) (h2 : V ≤ W) (h3 : V ≤ T)
    (a : Γ(p1, T)) : rmap h2 (rmap h1 a) = rmap h3 a
proof:
:= by
  show (p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op ≫ p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op) a = _
  rw [← p1.presheaf.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun (t : V ⟶ T) => p1.presheaf.map t.op a) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.exists_rep
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(p1, V) Γ(p1, W) := ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away g Γ(p1, W) := hV.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen g _ hW
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := Submonoid.powers g) z
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := s.2
  refine ⟨a, m, ?_⟩
  have halg : (algebraMap Γ(p1, V) Γ(p1, W)) (g ^ m) = rmap hWV (g ^ m) := rfl
  have halg2 : (algebraMap Γ(p1, V) Γ(p1, W)) a = rmap hWV a := rfl
  rw [← halg, ← halg2, show g ^ m = (s : Γ(p1, V)) from hm]
  exact hs

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.exists_clear
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(p1, V) Γ(p1, W) := ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away g Γ(p1, W) := hV.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen g _ hW
  have h2 := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers g) (S := Γ(p1, W)) a).mp h
  obtain ⟨⟨s, m, rfl⟩, hm⟩ := h2
  exact ⟨m, hm⟩

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.isUnit_rmap_self
statement:
theorem isUnit_rmap_self (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {g : Γ(p1, V)} {W : Scheme.Opens p1}
    (hW : W = p1.basicOpen g) (hWV : W ≤ V) : IsUnit (rmap hWV g)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(p1, V) Γ(p1, W) := ((p1.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away g Γ(p1, W) := hV.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen g _ hW
  exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit g

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.exists_unit_combination
statement:
theorem exists_unit_combination (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (f : ι → Γ(p1, V)) (hcov : ⨆ j, p1.basicOpen (f j) = V) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : ι → Γ(p1, V), (∑ j, g j * (f j) ^ M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hV.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff, iSup_range' (fun g => p1.basicOpen g) f]
    exact hcov
  have h2 : Ideal.span ((· ^ M) '' Set.range f) = ⊤ := Ideal.span_pow_eq_top _ hspan M
  rw [← Set.range_comp] at h2
  have h3 : (1 : Γ(p1, V)) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range ((· ^ M) ∘ f)) := h2 ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  rw [Ideal.span, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at h3
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h3
  exact ⟨g, by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hg⟩

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.cech_correction
statement:
theorem cech_correction (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (f : ι → Γ(p1, V))
    (hcov : ⨆ j, p1.basicOpen (f j) = V)
    (γ : ∀ j k : ι, Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k)))
    (hcoc : ∀ j k l : ι,
      rmap (inf_le_left :
          p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f l) ≤ _) (γ j k) +
        rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right) (γ k l) =
        rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right) (γ j l)) :
    ∃ c : ∀ j : ι, Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)),
      ∀ j k : ι, rmap inf_le_left (c j) - rmap inf_le_right (c k) = γ j k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDV : ∀ j, p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ V := fun j => p1.basicOpen_le (f j)
  have hDDV : ∀ j k, p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ V :=
    fun j k => inf_le_left.trans (hDV j)
  have hDDbasic : ∀ j k, p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) =
      p1.basicOpen (f j * f k) := fun j k => (p1.basicOpen_mul (f j) (f k)).symm
  
  have hrep : ∀ j k, ∃ (a : Γ(p1, V)) (m : ℕ),
      γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m) = rmap (hDDV j k) a :=
    fun j k => exists_rep hV (hDDbasic j k) (hDDV j k) (γ j k)
  choose a0 m0 ha0 using hrep
  set m1 : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup (fun p : ι × ι => m0 p.1 p.2) with hm1
  have hm1le : ∀ j k, m0 j k ≤ m1 := fun j k =>
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : ι × ι => m0 p.1 p.2) (Finset.mem_univ (j, k))
  set a : ι → ι → Γ(p1, V) :=
    fun j k => a0 j k * (f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k) with ha
  have haRep : ∀ j k, γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m1) =
      rmap (hDDV j k) (a j k) := by
    intro j k
    show γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m1) =
      rmap (hDDV j k) (a0 j k * (f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k))
    calc γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m1)
        = γ j k * (rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m0 j k)) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k))) := by
          rw [← map_mul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hm1le j k)]
      _ = γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m0 j k)) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k)) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (a0 j k) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k)) := by rw [ha0 j k]
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (a0 j k * (f j * f k) ^ (m1 - m0 j k)) := (map_mul _ _ _).symm
  
  have hclear : ∀ j k l : ι, ∃ s : ℕ, (f j * f k * f l) ^ s *
      (a j k * (f l) ^ m1 + a k l * (f j) ^ m1 - a j l * (f k) ^ m1) = 0 := by
    intro j k l
    have hTV : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f l) ≤ V :=
      inf_le_left.trans (hDDV j k)
    have hTbasic : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f l) =
        p1.basicOpen (f j * f k * f l) := by
      rw [hDDbasic j k, ← p1.basicOpen_mul (f j * f k) (f l)]
    refine exists_clear hV hTbasic hTV _ ?_
    have push : ∀ (jj kk : ι)
        (h : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f l) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f jj) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f kk)),
        rmap hTV (a jj kk) = rmap h (γ jj kk) * rmap hTV ((f jj * f kk) ^ m1) := by
      intro jj kk h
      have h2 := congrArg (rmap h) (haRep jj kk)
      rw [map_mul] at h2
      rw [← rmap_rmap (hDDV jj kk) h hTV (a jj kk), ← h2,
        rmap_rmap (hDDV jj kk) h hTV]
    rw [map_sub, map_add]
    simp only [map_mul]
    rw [push j k inf_le_left,
      push k l (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right),
      push j l (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)]
    
    have e1 : rmap hTV ((f j * f k) ^ m1) * rmap hTV ((f l) ^ m1) =
        rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← mul_pow]
    have e2 : rmap hTV ((f k * f l) ^ m1) * rmap hTV ((f j) ^ m1) =
        rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← mul_pow]
      exact congrArg (fun t => rmap hTV (t ^ m1)) (by ring)
    have e3 : rmap hTV ((f j * f l) ^ m1) * rmap hTV ((f k) ^ m1) =
        rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← mul_pow]
      exact congrArg (fun t => rmap hTV (t ^ m1)) (by ring)
    have t1 : rmap inf_le_left (γ j k) * rmap hTV ((f j * f k) ^ m1) *
        rmap hTV ((f l) ^ m1) =
        rmap inf_le_left (γ j k) * rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, e1]
    have t2 : rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right) (γ k l) *
        rmap hTV ((f k * f l) ^ m1) * rmap hTV ((f j) ^ m1) =
        rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right) (γ k l) *
          rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, e2]
    have t3 : rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right) (γ j l) *
        rmap hTV ((f j * f l) ^ m1) * rmap hTV ((f k) ^ m1) =
        rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right) (γ j l) *
          rmap hTV ((f j * f k * f l) ^ m1) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, e3]
    rw [t1, t2, t3, ← add_mul, ← sub_mul, hcoc j k l, sub_self, zero_mul]
  choose s0 hs0 using hclear
  set s1 : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup (fun p : ι × ι × ι => s0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) with hs1
  have hs1le : ∀ j k l, s0 j k l ≤ s1 := fun j k l =>
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : ι × ι × ι => s0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      (Finset.mem_univ (j, k, l))
  have hclear1 : ∀ j k l : ι, (f j * f k * f l) ^ s1 *
      (a j k * (f l) ^ m1 + a k l * (f j) ^ m1 - a j l * (f k) ^ m1) = 0 := by
    intro j k l
    have hsplit : (f j * f k * f l) ^ s1 =
        (f j * f k * f l) ^ (s1 - s0 j k l) * (f j * f k * f l) ^ (s0 j k l) := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hs1le j k l)]
    rw [hsplit, mul_assoc, hs0 j k l, mul_zero]
  
  set b : ι → ι → Γ(p1, V) :=
    fun j k => a j k * (f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1 with hb
  have hbId : ∀ j k l : ι,
      b j l * (f k) ^ (m1 + s1) - b k l * (f j) ^ (m1 + s1) =
        b j k * (f l) ^ (m1 + s1) := by
    intro j k l
    show a j l * (f j) ^ s1 * (f l) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ (m1 + s1) -
        a k l * (f k) ^ s1 * (f l) ^ s1 * (f j) ^ (m1 + s1) =
        a j k * (f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1 * (f l) ^ (m1 + s1)
    linear_combination -hclear1 j k l
  have hbRep : ∀ j k, γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) =
      rmap (hDDV j k) (b j k) := by
    intro j k
    show γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) =
      rmap (hDDV j k) (a j k * (f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1)
    calc γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1))
        = γ j k * (rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m1) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1)) := by
          rw [← map_mul]
          exact congrArg (fun z => γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) z) (by ring)
      _ = γ j k * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ m1) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (a j k) * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1) := by
          rw [haRep j k]
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (a j k * ((f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1)) := (map_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (a j k * (f j) ^ s1 * (f k) ^ s1) :=
          congrArg (rmap (hDDV j k)) (by ring)
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_unit_combination hV f hcov (m1 + s1)
  
  have hUnit : ∀ j : ι, IsUnit (rmap (hDV j) (f j)) := fun j =>
    isUnit_rmap_self hV rfl (hDV j)
  refine ⟨fun j => ∑ l, rmap (hDV j) (g l) *
    (rmap (hDV j) (b j l) * (((hUnit j).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))ˣ) :
      Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j))) ^ (m1 + s1)), ?_⟩
  intro j k
  
  have hUnitJK : IsUnit (rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1))) := by
    have h1 : IsUnit (rmap (hDDV j k) (f j * f k)) :=
      isUnit_rmap_self hV (hDDbasic j k) (hDDV j k)
    rw [map_pow]
    exact h1.pow (m1 + s1)
  apply hUnitJK.mul_left_cancel
  rw [mul_comm (rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1))) _,
    mul_comm (rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1))) _, hbRep j k]
  beta_reduce
  
  have hres : ∀ (jj : ι) (h : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f jj)),
      rmap h (∑ l, rmap (hDV jj) (g l) *
        (rmap (hDV jj) (b jj l) * (((hUnit jj).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
          Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj))) ^ (m1 + s1))) =
      ∑ l, rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * (rmap (hDDV j k) (b jj l) *
        (rmap h (((hUnit jj).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
          Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))) ^ (m1 + s1)) := by
    intro jj h
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow,
      rmap_rmap (hDV jj) h (hDDV j k) (g l), rmap_rmap (hDV jj) h (hDDV j k) (b jj l)]
  have hInv : ∀ (jj : ι) (h : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f jj)),
      rmap h (((hUnit jj).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj))) * rmap (hDDV j k) (f jj) = 1 := by
    intro jj h
    have h1 : (((hUnit jj).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj))) * (((hUnit jj).unit : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj))) = 1 := Units.inv_mul ((hUnit jj).unit)
    have h2 : (((hUnit jj).unit : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f jj))) = rmap (hDV jj) (f jj) := (hUnit jj).unit_spec
    have h3 := congrArg (rmap h) h1
    rw [map_mul, map_one, h2, rmap_rmap (hDV jj) h (hDDV j k)] at h3
    exact h3
  rw [sub_mul, hres j inf_le_left, hres k inf_le_right,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hterm : ∀ l : ι,
      rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * (rmap (hDDV j k) (b j l) *
          (rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f j))
            (((hUnit j).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))ˣ) :
              Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))) ^ (m1 + s1)) *
        rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) -
      rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * (rmap (hDDV j k) (b k l) *
          (rmap (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f k))
            (((hUnit k).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k)))ˣ) :
              Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k)))) ^ (m1 + s1)) *
        rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) =
      rmap (hDDV j k) (g l * (f l) ^ (m1 + s1) * b j k) := by
    intro l
    have hfj : rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) =
        rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ (m1 + s1)) * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← mul_pow]
    have hcancelJ : (rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
        p1.basicOpen (f j)) (((hUnit j).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))ˣ) :
          Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))) ^ (m1 + s1) *
        rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ (m1 + s1)) = 1 := by
      rw [map_pow, ← mul_pow, hInv j inf_le_left, one_pow]
    have hcancelK : (rmap (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
        p1.basicOpen (f k)) (((hUnit k).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k)))ˣ) :
          Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k)))) ^ (m1 + s1) *
        rmap (hDDV j k) ((f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) = 1 := by
      rw [map_pow, ← mul_pow, hInv k inf_le_right, one_pow]
    set XJ := rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
      p1.basicOpen (f j)) (((hUnit j).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f j))) with hXJ
    set XK := rmap (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
      p1.basicOpen (f k)) (((hUnit k).unit⁻¹ : (Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k)))ˣ) :
        Γ(p1, p1.basicOpen (f k))) with hXK
    calc rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * (rmap (hDDV j k) (b j l) * XJ ^ (m1 + s1)) *
          rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) -
        rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * (rmap (hDDV j k) (b k l) * XK ^ (m1 + s1)) *
          rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j * f k) ^ (m1 + s1))
        = rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * rmap (hDDV j k) (b j l) *
            (XJ ^ (m1 + s1) * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ (m1 + s1))) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) -
          rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * rmap (hDDV j k) (b k l) *
            (XK ^ (m1 + s1) * rmap (hDDV j k) ((f k) ^ (m1 + s1))) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ (m1 + s1)) := by
          rw [hfj]; ring
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * rmap (hDDV j k) (b j l) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f k) ^ (m1 + s1)) -
          rmap (hDDV j k) (g l) * rmap (hDDV j k) (b k l) *
            rmap (hDDV j k) ((f j) ^ (m1 + s1)) := by
          rw [hcancelJ, hcancelK, mul_one, mul_one]
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (g l * (b j l * (f k) ^ (m1 + s1) - b k l * (f j) ^ (m1 + s1))) := by
          simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow]
          ring
      _ = rmap (hDDV j k) (g l * (f l) ^ (m1 + s1) * b j k) := by
          rw [hbId j k l]
          exact congrArg (rmap (hDDV j k)) (by ring)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => hterm l), ← map_sum]
  have hfinal : (∑ l, g l * (f l) ^ (m1 + s1) * b j k) = b j k := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hg, one_mul]
  rw [hfinal]

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.smap_smap
statement:
theorem smap_smap (F : Sheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}) {V W T : Scheme.Opens p1}
    (h1 : W ≤ T) (h2 : V ≤ W) (h3 : V ≤ T) (s : F.obj.obj (op T)) :
    F.obj.map (homOfLE h2).op (F.obj.map (homOfLE h1).op s) =
      F.obj.map (homOfLE h3).op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← F.obj.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun (t : V ⟶ T) => F.obj.map t.op s) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.exists_basicOpen_lift
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_lift {B R : Sheaf JP1 AddCommGrpCat.{0}} (g : B ⟶ R)
    (hepi : Epi g) {V : Scheme.Opens p1} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (r : R.obj.obj (op V)) (x : (p1 : TopCat)) (hx : x ∈ V) :
    ∃ (fx : Γ(p1, V)) (t : B.obj.obj (op (p1.basicOpen fx))),
      x ∈ p1.basicOpen fx ∧
      g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen fx)) t =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE (p1.basicOpen_le fx)).op r
proof:
:= by
  have hls : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective g.hom :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi (F := B) (G := R) g).mpr hepi
  obtain ⟨W, hWle, ⟨t0, ht0⟩, hxW⟩ :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff g.hom).mp hls V r x hx
  obtain ⟨fx, hfle, hxf⟩ := hV.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxW⟩ : W) hx
  refine ⟨fx, B.obj.map (homOfLE hfle).op t0, hxf, ?_⟩
  have hnat : g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen fx)) (B.obj.map (homOfLE hfle).op t0) =
      R.obj.map (homOfLE hfle).op (g.hom.app (op W) t0) := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, g.hom.naturality]
  rw [hnat, ht0]
  exact smap_smap R hWle hfle (p1.basicOpen_le fx) r

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_affine
statement:
theorem isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_affine {V : Scheme.Opens p1} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    HodgePilot.AcyclicClassC.IsSectionsSurjectiveKernel (J := JP1) V structO
proof:
:= by
  intro B R fι g hfg hSE r
  classical
  
  have hlift : ∀ x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V},
      ∃ (fx : Γ(p1, V)) (t : B.obj.obj (op (p1.basicOpen fx))),
        (x : (p1 : TopCat)) ∈ p1.basicOpen fx ∧
        g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen fx)) t =
          R.obj.map (homOfLE (p1.basicOpen_le fx)).op r :=
    fun x => exists_basicOpen_lift g hSE.epi_g hV r x.1 x.2
  choose fp tp hfp htp using hlift
  
  have hcompact : IsCompact (V : Set (p1 : TopCat)) := hV.isCompact
  have hsub : (V : Set (p1 : TopCat)) ⊆
      ⋃ x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V}, (p1.basicOpen (fp x) : Set (p1 : TopCat)) := by
    intro y hy
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hfp ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hcompact.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V} => (p1.basicOpen (fp x) : Set (p1 : TopCat)))
    (fun x => (p1.basicOpen (fp x)).2) hsub
  haveI : Fintype {x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V} // x ∈ S} := inferInstance
  set f : {x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V} // x ∈ S} → Γ(p1, V) :=
    fun i => fp i.1 with hf
  have hDV : ∀ i, p1.basicOpen (f i) ≤ V := fun i => p1.basicOpen_le (f i)
  have hcov : ⨆ i, p1.basicOpen (f i) = V := by
    apply le_antisymm (iSup_le hDV)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxS, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS hy)
    exact (Opens.mem_iSup).mpr ⟨⟨x, hxS⟩, hyx⟩
  set t : ∀ i : {x : {x : (p1 : TopCat) // x ∈ V} // x ∈ S},
      B.obj.obj (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) := fun i => tp i.1 with ht
  have htlift : ∀ i, g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (t i) =
      R.obj.map (homOfLE (hDV i)).op r := fun i => htp i.1
  have hDDV : ∀ i j, p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ V :=
    fun i j => inf_le_left.trans (hDV i)
  
  have hdiff : ∀ i j, g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
      (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i))).op (t i) -
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j))).op (t j)) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [map_sub]
    have hnatL : g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i))).op (t i)) =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i))).op (g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (t i)) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, g.hom.naturality]
    have hnatR : g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
        (B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j))).op (t j)) =
        R.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j))).op (g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f j))) (t j)) := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, g.hom.naturality]
    rw [hnatL, hnatR, htlift i, htlift j,
      smap_smap R (hDV i) inf_le_left (hDDV i j) r,
      smap_smap R (hDV j) inf_le_right (hDDV i j) r, sub_self]
  have hker : ∀ i j, ∃ w : structO.obj.obj (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j))),
      fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j))) w =
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i))).op (t i) -
          B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
            p1.basicOpen (f j))).op (t j) :=
    fun i j => TopCat.Sheaf.sections_exact_of_left_exact hSE.1 hSE.2 _ (hdiff i j)
  choose w hw using hker
  
  have hDaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (p1.basicOpen (f i)) := fun i => hV.basicOpen (f i)
  have hDDaff : ∀ i j, IsAffineOpen (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)) := by
    intro i j
    rw [(p1.basicOpen_mul (f i) (f j)).symm]
    exact hV.basicOpen (f i * f j)
  
  have hwcoc : ∀ i j k,
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
        p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ _)).op (w i j) +
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
        p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k))).op (w j k) =
      structO.obj.map (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
        p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k))).op (w i k) := by
    intro i j k
    haveI := hSE.mono_f
    apply app_injective_of_mono fι
      (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k))
    rw [map_add]
    have hpair : ∀ (ii jj) (hle : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓
          p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f ii) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f jj)),
        fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k)))
          (structO.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op (w ii jj)) =
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (hle.trans inf_le_left)).op (t ii) -
          B.obj.map (homOfLE (hle.trans inf_le_right)).op (t jj) := by
      intro ii jj hle
      have hnat : fι.hom.app
          (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k)))
          (structO.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op (w ii jj)) =
          B.obj.map (homOfLE hle).op
            (fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f ii) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f jj))) (w ii jj)) := by
        rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, fι.hom.naturality]
      rw [hnat, hw ii jj, map_sub,
        smap_smap B inf_le_left hle (hle.trans inf_le_left) (t ii),
        smap_smap B inf_le_right hle (hle.trans inf_le_right) (t jj)]
    rw [hpair i j inf_le_left,
      hpair j k (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right),
      hpair i k (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)]
    have hnormB : ∀ (ii) (h h' : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓
        p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f ii)),
        B.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (t ii) = B.obj.map (homOfLE h').op (t ii) :=
      fun ii h h' => congrArg (fun (hh : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓
        p1.basicOpen (f k) ⟶ p1.basicOpen (f ii)) => B.obj.map hh.op (t ii))
        (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [hnormB j ((le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right).trans inf_le_left)
        ((inf_le_left).trans inf_le_right),
      hnormB k ((le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right).trans inf_le_right)
        ((le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right).trans inf_le_right),
      hnormB i ((le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right).trans inf_le_left)
        ((inf_le_left).trans inf_le_left)]
    abel
  have hγcoc : ∀ i j k,
      rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤ _)
        (oToRing ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (w i j)) +
      rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right)
        (oToRing ⟨_, hDDaff j k⟩ (w j k)) =
      rmap (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
        (oToRing ⟨_, hDDaff i k⟩ (w i k)) := by
    intro i j k
    have hTaff : IsAffineOpen (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓
        p1.basicOpen (f k)) := by
      rw [(p1.basicOpen_mul (f i) (f j)).symm, (p1.basicOpen_mul (f i * f j) (f k)).symm]
      exact hV.basicOpen (f i * f j * f k)
    have hnat : ∀ (ii jj) (hDD : IsAffineOpen (p1.basicOpen (f ii) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f jj)))
        (h : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f k) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f ii) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f jj)),
        rmap h (oToRing ⟨_, hDD⟩ (w ii jj)) =
          oToRing ⟨_, hTaff⟩ (structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (w ii jj)) :=
      fun ii jj hDD h =>
        (oToRing_natural (W' := ⟨_, hTaff⟩) (W := ⟨_, hDD⟩) h (w ii jj)).symm
    rw [hnat i j (hDDaff i j) inf_le_left,
      hnat j k (hDDaff j k) (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right),
      hnat i k (hDDaff i k) (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right),
      ← oToRing_add]
    exact congrArg (oToRing ⟨_, hTaff⟩) (hwcoc i j k)
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := cech_correction hV f hcov
    (fun i j => oToRing ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (w i j)) hγcoc
  
  have hucompat : ∀ i j,
      B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
        p1.basicOpen (f i))).op
        (t i - fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff i⟩ (c i))) =
      B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
        p1.basicOpen (f j))).op
        (t j - fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f j))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff j⟩ (c j))) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [map_sub]
    have hnatc : ∀ (ii) (h : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f ii)),
        B.obj.map (homOfLE h).op
          (fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f ii))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff ii⟩ (c ii))) =
        fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
          (structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff ii⟩ (c ii))) := by
      intro ii h
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, fι.hom.naturality]
    rw [hnatc i inf_le_left, hnatc j inf_le_right]
    have hOc : ∀ (ii) (h : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f ii)),
        structO.obj.map (homOfLE h).op (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff ii⟩ (c ii)) =
          ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (rmap h (c ii)) := by
      intro ii h
      have h1 := oToRing_natural (W' := (⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ : p1.AffineZariskiSite))
        (W := ⟨_, hDaff ii⟩) h (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff ii⟩ (c ii))
      rw [oToRing_ringToO] at h1
      have h2 := congrArg (ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩) h1
      rw [ringToO_oToRing] at h2
      exact h2
    rw [hOc i inf_le_left, hOc j inf_le_right]
    have hcorr : ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩
        (rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f i)) (c i)) -
        ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩
        (rmap (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j)) (c j)) = w i j := by
      rw [← ringToO_sub, hc i j]
      exact ringToO_oToRing ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (w i j)
    have hgoal : B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓
          p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f i))).op (t i) -
        B.obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤
          p1.basicOpen (f j))).op (t j) =
        fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
          (ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (rmap (inf_le_left : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓
            p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f i)) (c i))) -
        fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓ p1.basicOpen (f j)))
          (ringToO ⟨_, hDDaff i j⟩ (rmap (inf_le_right : p1.basicOpen (f i) ⊓
            p1.basicOpen (f j) ≤ p1.basicOpen (f j)) (c j))) := by
      rw [← map_sub, hcorr, hw i j]
    rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub]
    exact hgoal
  have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible B.1 (fun i => p1.basicOpen (f i))
      (fun i => t i - fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff i⟩ (c i))) :=
    fun i j => hucompat i j
  obtain ⟨tglue, htglue, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' (F := B)
    (fun i => p1.basicOpen (f i)) V (fun i => homOfLE (hDV i)) (le_of_eq hcov.symm)
    (fun i => t i - fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff i⟩ (c i)))
    hcomp
  refine ⟨tglue, ?_⟩
  
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' R (fun i => p1.basicOpen (f i)) V
    (fun i => homOfLE (hDV i)) (le_of_eq hcov.symm)
  intro i
  have hnat : R.obj.map (homOfLE (hDV i)).op (g.hom.app (op V) tglue) =
      g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (B.obj.map (homOfLE (hDV i)).op tglue) := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, g.hom.naturality]
  rw [hnat, htglue i, map_sub]
  have hzero : g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i)))
      (fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) (ringToO ⟨_, hDaff i⟩ (c i))) = 0 := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
    have h0 : fι.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) ≫ g.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i))) =
        0 := by
      have h1 := congrArg (fun (z : structO ⟶ R) => z.hom.app (op (p1.basicOpen (f i)))) hfg
      simpa using h1
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  rw [hzero, sub_zero, htlift i]

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.subsingleton_hPrimeOne_affine
statement:
theorem subsingleton_hPrimeOne_affine {V : Scheme.Opens p1} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 V) structO 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (Injective.ι structO) (cokernel.π (Injective.ι structO))
      (cokernel.condition _)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact _
      mono_f := inferInstanceAs (Mono (Injective.ι structO))
      epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π (Injective.ι structO))) }
  haveI : Injective (Injective.under structO) := Injective.injective_under structO
  exact subsingleton_ext_one_of_app_surjective hS V
    (isSectionsSurjectiveKernel_affine hV _ _ _ hS)
    (Ext.subsingleton_of_injective _ _ 0)

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U0
statement:
theorem subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U0 :
    Subsingleton (Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 U0) structO 1)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_hPrimeOne_affine isAffineOpen_U0

name: HodgePilot.AffineVanishing.subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U1
statement:
theorem subsingleton_hPrimeOne_U1 :
    Subsingleton (Ext (freeYonedaSheaf JP1 U1) structO 1)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_hPrimeOne_affine isAffineOpen_U1

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.exists_local_lift_rel
statement:
lemma exists_local_lift_rel {X : TopCat.{0}} {B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X}
    (g : B ⟶ R) [Epi g] {W : Opens X} (r : R.1.obj (op W)) (x : ↑X) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVW : V ≤ W) (_ : x ∈ V) (b : B.1.obj (op V)),
      g.hom.app (op V) b = R.1.map (homOfLE hVW).op r
proof:
:= by
  have hls : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective g.hom :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi g).mpr inferInstance
  obtain ⟨V, hVW, ⟨b, hb⟩, hxV⟩ :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff g.hom).mp hls W r x hx
  exact ⟨V, hVW, hxV, b, hb⟩

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.exists_pack_rel
statement:
lemma exists_pack_rel {X : TopCat.{0}} {ι : Type} (Z : ι → Set ↑X) (O : Opens X)
    (hlf : ∀ x : ↑X, x ∈ O → ∃ N ∈ nhds x, {i | (Z i ∩ N).Nonempty}.Finite) :
    ∃ (V : ↥O → Opens X) (S : ↥O → Finset ι),
      (∀ y : ↥O, V y ≤ O) ∧ (O ≤ ⨆ y, V y) ∧
        ∀ y i, i ∉ S y → Disjoint ((V y : Opens X) : Set ↑X) (Z i)
proof:
:= by
  choose N hN hfin using fun y : ↥O => hlf (y : ↑X) y.2
  refine ⟨fun y => ⟨interior (N y), isOpen_interior⟩ ⊓ O,
    fun y => (hfin y).toFinset, fun y => inf_le_right,
    fun x hx => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
      ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (hN ⟨x, hx⟩), hx⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y i hi
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hi
  refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun a ha hZa => hi ⟨a, hZa, ?_⟩)
  exact interior_subset ha.1

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.exists_subordinate_partition_rel
statement:
lemma exists_subordinate_partition_rel {X : TopCat.{0}} [T2Space ↑X]
    (W : Opens X) [ParacompactSpace ↥W]
    {ι : Type} (u : ι → Opens X) (hu : W ≤ ⨆ i, u i) :
    ∃ A : ι → Set ↑X,
      (∀ i, A i ⊆ (W : Set ↑X))
      ∧ (∀ y : ↑X, y ∈ W → ∃! i, y ∈ A i)
      ∧ (∀ i, closure (A i) ∩ (W : Set ↑X) ⊆ ((u i : Opens X) : Set ↑X))
      ∧ (∀ x : ↑X, x ∈ W →
          ∃ N ∈ nhds x, {i | (closure (A i) ∩ (W : Set ↑X) ∩ N).Nonempty}.Finite)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ParacompactSpace ↑(TopCat.of ↥W) := inferInstanceAs (ParacompactSpace ↥W)
  haveI : T2Space ↑(TopCat.of ↥W) := inferInstanceAs (T2Space ↥W)
  obtain ⟨A', hA', hclA', hlf'⟩ :=
    exists_subordinate_partition (X := TopCat.of ↥W)
      (fun i => ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' ((u i : Opens X) : Set ↑X),
        (u i).isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩)
      (fun y _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr (by
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hu y.2)
        exact ⟨i, hi⟩))
  
  have hA'' : ∀ y : ↥W, ∃! i, y ∈ A' i := hA'
  have hcl'' : ∀ i, closure (A' i) ⊆ Subtype.val ⁻¹' ((u i : Opens X) : Set ↑X) := hclA'
  have hlf'' : LocallyFinite (fun i => closure (A' i)) := hlf'
  
  have hclosure : ∀ i, closure (A' i)
      = Subtype.val ⁻¹' closure (Subtype.val '' A' i) := fun i =>
    Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.closure_eq_preimage_closure_image (A' i)
  refine ⟨fun i => Subtype.val '' A' i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rintro i z ⟨z', _, rfl⟩
    exact z'.2
  · 
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, huniq⟩ := hA'' ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨i₀, ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hi₀, rfl⟩, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hk
    have hzeq : z = (⟨y, hy⟩ : ↥W) := Subtype.ext hzy
    rw [hzeq] at hz
    exact huniq k hz
  · 
    rintro i z ⟨hzc, hzW⟩
    have hz' : (⟨z, hzW⟩ : ↥W) ∈ closure (A' i) := by
      rw [hclosure i]
      exact hzc
    exact hcl'' i hz'
  · 
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨N', hN', hfin⟩ := hlf'' (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥W)
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' N',
      (W.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val).image_mem_nhds hN', hfin.subset ?_⟩
    rintro i ⟨z, ⟨⟨hzc, hzW⟩, z', hz'N, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨z', ?_, hz'N⟩
    show z' ∈ closure (A' i)
    rw [hclosure i]
    exact hzc

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.exists_correction_rel
statement:
lemma exists_correction_rel (X : TopCat.{0}) (n : ℕ) {ι : Type}
    (W : Opens X) (A : ι → Set ↑X) (V : ι → Opens X)
    (hVW : ∀ i, V i ≤ W)
    (hA : ∀ y : ↑X, y ∈ W → ∃! i, y ∈ A i)
    (hclA : ∀ j, closure (A j) ∩ (W : Set ↑X) ⊆ ((V j : Opens X) : Set ↑X))
    (hlf : ∀ x : ↑X, x ∈ W →
      ∃ N ∈ nhds x, {i | (closure (A i) ∩ (W : Set ↑X) ∩ N).Nonempty}.Finite)
    (δ : ∀ i j : ι, ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.obj (op (V i ⊓ V j)))
    (hcoc : ∀ (i j k : ι) (O : Opens X) (h1 : O ≤ V i ⊓ V k) (h2 : O ≤ V j ⊓ V k)
      (h3 : O ≤ V i ⊓ V j),
      ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h1).op (δ i k)
        - ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h2).op (δ j k)
        = ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h3).op (δ i j)) :
    ∃ c : ∀ i : ι, ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.obj (op (V i)),
      ∀ i j : ι,
        ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (c i)
          - ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j)
          = δ i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hVijW : ∀ i j : ι, V i ⊓ V j ≤ W := fun i _ => inf_le_left.trans (hVW i)
  have hZo : ∀ k : ι, IsOpen (closure (A k))ᶜ := fun k => isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
  have hcov_ext : ∀ i j : ι,
      V i ≤ (V i ⊓ V j) ⊔ (⟨(closure (A j))ᶜ, hZo j⟩ : Opens X) := by
    intro i j y hy
    by_cases hyA : y ∈ closure (A j)
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hy, hclA j ⟨hyA, hVW i hy⟩⟩)
    · exact Opens.mem_sup.mpr (Or.inr hyA)
  have hs_ext : ∀ i j : ι, ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
        (V i ⊓ V j) ⊓ (⟨(closure (A j))ᶜ, hZo j⟩ : Opens X) ≤ V i ⊓ V j)).op
      ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A j) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j)) (δ i j)) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    exact partitionEndoSheaf_app_supp X (A j) n (δ i j) _ inf_le_left
      (Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun a ha => ha.2))
  have hsupp : ∀ (i j : ι) (O : Opens X) (hOW : O ≤ V i),
      Disjoint (O : Set ↑X) (closure (A j) ∩ (W : Set ↑X)) →
      ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE hOW).op
        (extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext i j)
          ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A j) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j)) (δ i j))
          (hs_ext i j)) = 0 := by
    intro i j O hOW hd
    have hd' : Disjoint (O : Set ↑X) (closure (A j)) :=
      Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun a haO haC =>
        Set.disjoint_left.mp hd haO ⟨haC, (hOW.trans (hVW i)) haO⟩)
    exact extendByZero_res_of_le _ _ _ _ _
      (fun a ha => Set.disjoint_left.mp hd' ha) hOW
  choose P T hPle hPcov hPT using fun i : ι =>
    exists_pack_rel (fun k => closure (A k) ∩ (W : Set ↑X)) (V i)
      (fun x hx => hlf x (hVW i hx))
  refine ⟨fun i => locFinSum ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n)
    (fun j => extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext i j)
      ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A j) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j)) (δ i j)) (hs_ext i j))
    (fun j => closure (A j) ∩ (W : Set ↑X)) (hsupp i) (P i) (hPle i) (hPcov i)
    (T i) (hPT i),
    fun i j => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, TQ, hQle, hQcov, hQT⟩ :=
    exists_pack_rel (fun k => closure (A k) ∩ (W : Set ↑X)) (V i ⊓ V j)
      (fun x hx => hlf x (hVijW i j hx))
  refine ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).eq_of_locally_eq' Q (V i ⊓ V j)
    (fun y => homOfLE (hQle y)) hQcov _ _ (fun y => ?_)
  have hQVi : Q y ≤ V i := (hQle y).trans inf_le_left
  have hQVj : Q y ≤ V j := (hQle y).trans inf_le_right
  have hQW : Q y ≤ W := (hQle y).trans (hVijW i j)
  rw [map_sub,
    res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (hQle y))
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)) (homOfLE hQVi) _,
    res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE (hQle y))
      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)) (homOfLE hQVj) _,
    locFinSum_res_adequate ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) _ _ (hsupp i)
      (P i) (hPle i) (hPcov i) (T i) (hPT i) hQVi (TQ y) (fun k hk => hQT y k hk),
    locFinSum_res_adequate ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) _ _ (hsupp j)
      (P j) (hPle j) (hPcov j) (T j) (hPT j) hQVj (TQ y) (fun k hk => hQT y k hk),
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hterm : ∀ k ∈ TQ y,
      ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE hQVi).op
          (extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext i k)
            ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V k)) (δ i k))
            (hs_ext i k))
        - ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE hQVj).op
          (extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext j k)
            ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V j ⊓ V k)) (δ j k))
            (hs_ext j k))
      = (partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (Q y))
        (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (hQle y)).op (δ i j)) := by
    intro k _
    have hU₁Vik : Q y ⊓ V k ≤ V i ⊓ V k := le_inf (inf_le_left.trans hQVi) inf_le_right
    have hU₁Vjk : Q y ⊓ V k ≤ V j ⊓ V k := le_inf (inf_le_left.trans hQVj) inf_le_right
    have hU₁Vij : Q y ⊓ V k ≤ V i ⊓ V j := inf_le_left.trans (hQle y)
    refine ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).eq_of_locally_eq₂
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : Q y ⊓ V k ≤ Q y))
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : Q y ⊓ (⟨(closure (A k))ᶜ, hZo k⟩ : Opens X) ≤ Q y))
      (fun z hz => ?_) _ _ ?_ ?_
    · by_cases hzA : z ∈ closure (A k)
      · exact Opens.mem_sup.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hz, hclA k ⟨hzA, hQW hz⟩⟩)
      · exact Opens.mem_sup.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hz, hzA⟩)
    · 
      rw [map_sub,
        res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
          (homOfLE hQVi) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVi)) _,
        res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
          (homOfLE hQVj) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVj)) _,
        ← res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE hU₁Vik)
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V k ≤ V i))
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVi)) _,
        ← res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE hU₁Vjk)
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V j ⊓ V k ≤ V j))
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVj)) _,
        extendByZero_res ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext i k)
          ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V k)) (δ i k))
          (hs_ext i k),
        extendByZero_res ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext j k)
          ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V j ⊓ V k)) (δ j k))
          (hs_ext j k),
        ← app_res (partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n) (homOfLE hU₁Vik) (δ i k),
        ← app_res (partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n) (homOfLE hU₁Vjk) (δ j k),
        ← map_sub, hcoc i j k (Q y ⊓ V k) hU₁Vik hU₁Vjk hU₁Vij,
        ← app_res (partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n) (homOfLE (inf_le_left : Q y ⊓ V k ≤ Q y))
          (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (hQle y)).op (δ i j)),
        res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
          (homOfLE (hQle y)) (homOfLE hU₁Vij) _]
    · 
      have h0i : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
          (homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
            Q y ⊓ (⟨(closure (A k))ᶜ, hZo k⟩ : Opens X) ≤ Q y).trans hQVi)).op
          (extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext i k)
            ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V k)) (δ i k))
            (hs_ext i k)) = 0 :=
        extendByZero_res_of_le _ _ _ _ _ inf_le_right _
      have h0j : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
          (homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
            Q y ⊓ (⟨(closure (A k))ᶜ, hZo k⟩ : Opens X) ≤ Q y).trans hQVj)).op
          (extendByZero ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) inf_le_left (hcov_ext j k)
            ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (V j ⊓ V k)) (δ j k))
            (hs_ext j k)) = 0 :=
        extendByZero_res_of_le _ _ _ _ _ inf_le_right _
      have happ0 : ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
            Q y ⊓ (⟨(closure (A k))ᶜ, hZo k⟩ : Opens X) ≤ Q y)).op
          ((partitionEndoSheaf X (A k) n).hom.app (op (Q y))
            (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (hQle y)).op (δ i j)))
          = 0 :=
        partitionEndoSheaf_app_supp X (A k) n _ _ inf_le_left
          (disjoint_compl_left.mono_left Set.inter_subset_right)
      rw [map_sub,
        res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
          (homOfLE hQVi) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVi)) _,
        res_res' ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
          (homOfLE hQVj) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans hQVj)) _,
        h0i, h0j, happ0, sub_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
  exact sum_partitionEndoSheaf_app_apply X A (TQ y) n
    (fun z hz => by
      obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, huniq⟩ := hA z (hQW hz)
      have hkT : k₀ ∈ TQ y := by
        by_contra hns
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hQT y k₀ hns) hz ⟨subset_closure hk₀, hQW hz⟩
      exact ⟨k₀, ⟨hkT, hk₀⟩, fun m hm => huniq m hm.2⟩)
    (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE (hQle y)).op (δ i j))

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.gammaSurjective_rel
statement:
theorem gammaSurjective_rel (X : TopCat.{0}) [T2Space ↑X]
    (W : Opens X) [ParacompactSpace ↥W] (n : ℕ)
    {B R : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X}
    (f : (sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ R) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hexact : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact) :
    Function.Surjective (g.hom.app (op W))
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  haveI hEpi : Epi g := hexact.epi_g
  haveI hMono : Mono f := hexact.mono_f
  
  choose V hVW hxV b₀ hb₀ using fun y : ↥W => exists_local_lift_rel g r (y : ↑X) y.2
  have hcover : W ≤ ⨆ y, V y :=
    fun x hx => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxV ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨A, -, hA, hclA, hlf⟩ := exists_subordinate_partition_rel W V hcover
  have hij : ∀ i j : ↥W, V i ⊓ V j ≤ W := fun i _ => inf_le_left.trans (hVW i)
  
  have hdiffzero : ∀ i j : ↥W, g.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
      (B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (b₀ i)
        - B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (b₀ j)) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [map_sub, app_res g (homOfLE inf_le_left) (b₀ i),
      app_res g (homOfLE inf_le_right) (b₀ j), hb₀ i, hb₀ j,
      res_res' R (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE (hVW i)) (homOfLE (hij i j)) r,
      res_res' R (homOfLE inf_le_right) (homOfLE (hVW j)) (homOfLE (hij i j)) r,
      sub_self]
  choose δ hδ using fun i j : ↥W => (existsUnique_section_preimage f g hfg hexact
    (V i ⊓ V j) _ (hdiffzero i j)).exists
  
  have hcoc : ∀ (i j k : ↥W) (O : Opens X) (h1 : O ≤ V i ⊓ V k) (h2 : O ≤ V j ⊓ V k)
      (h3 : O ≤ V i ⊓ V j),
      ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h1).op (δ i k)
        - ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h2).op (δ j k)
        = ((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map (homOfLE h3).op (δ i j) := by
    intro i j k O h1 h2 h3
    apply app_injective_of_mono f O
    have hOVi : O ≤ V i := h1.trans inf_le_left
    have hOVj : O ≤ V j := h2.trans inf_le_left
    have hOVk : O ≤ V k := h1.trans inf_le_right
    rw [map_sub, app_res f (homOfLE h1) (δ i k), app_res f (homOfLE h2) (δ j k),
      app_res f (homOfLE h3) (δ i j), hδ i k, hδ j k, hδ i j,
      map_sub, map_sub, map_sub,
      res_res' B (homOfLE h1) (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V k ≤ V i))
        (homOfLE hOVi) (b₀ i),
      res_res' B (homOfLE h1) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V k ≤ V k))
        (homOfLE hOVk) (b₀ k),
      res_res' B (homOfLE h2) (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V j ⊓ V k ≤ V j))
        (homOfLE hOVj) (b₀ j),
      res_res' B (homOfLE h2) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V j ⊓ V k ≤ V k))
        (homOfLE hOVk) (b₀ k),
      res_res' B (homOfLE h3) (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i))
        (homOfLE hOVi) (b₀ i),
      res_res' B (homOfLE h3) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j))
        (homOfLE hOVj) (b₀ j)]
    abel
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_correction_rel X n W A V hVW hA hclA hlf δ hcoc
  
  have hcompat : ∀ i j : ↥W,
      B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op
          (b₀ i - f.hom.app (op (V i)) (c i))
        = B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op
          (b₀ j - f.hom.app (op (V j)) (c j)) := by
    intro i j
    rw [map_sub, map_sub,
      ← app_res f (homOfLE inf_le_left) (c i),
      ← app_res f (homOfLE inf_le_right) (c j)]
    have hfc : f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
          (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (c i))
        - f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
          (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j))
        = B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (b₀ i)
          - B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (b₀ j) := by
      rw [← map_sub, hc i j, hδ i j]
    calc B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (b₀ i)
          - f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
            (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
              (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (c i))
        = (B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (b₀ i)
            - B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (b₀ j))
          - (f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
              (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
                (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V i)).op (c i))
            - f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
              (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
                (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j)))
          + (B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (b₀ j)
            - f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
              (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
                (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j))) := by abel
      _ = B.1.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (b₀ j)
          - f.hom.app (op (V i ⊓ V j))
            (((sheafifiedCochainComplex X).X n).1.map
              (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V i ⊓ V j ≤ V j)).op (c j)) := by
          rw [hfc, sub_self, zero_add]
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := B.existsUnique_gluing' V W (fun i => homOfLE (hVW i)) hcover
    (fun i => b₀ i - f.hom.app (op (V i)) (c i))
    (fun i j => hcompat i j)
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  refine R.eq_of_locally_eq' V W (fun i => homOfLE (hVW i)) hcover _ _ (fun i => ?_)
  rw [← app_res g (homOfLE (hVW i)) b, hb i, map_sub, hb₀ i,
    comp_app_apply_eq_zero f g hfg (V i) (c i), sub_zero]

name: HodgePilot.SingularGammaRel.relativeLemmaW
statement: theorem relativeLemmaW (X : TopCat.{0}) [T2Space ↑X] : RelativeLemmaWStatement X
proof:
:= by
  intro W hW n B R f g hfg hexact
  haveI := hW
  exact gammaSurjective_rel X W n f g hfg hexact

name: HodgePilot.CalibrationZero.isHodgeClassProper_zero
statement:
theorem isHodgeClassProper_zero {X : Scheme.{0}} (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper g] (p : ℕ) :
    IsHodgeClassProper g d p 0
proof:
:= by
  show analyticDeRhamChartsEquiv g d (2 * p)
      (toComplexCoeffs (TopCat.of (SPoints g)) (2 * p) 0) ∈ _
  rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_add_left
statement:
lemma wedge1_add_left {p : ℕ} (ℓ ℓ' : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 (ℓ + ℓ') ω = wedge1 ℓ ω + wedge1 ℓ' ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedge1, wedge1, wedge1, show (ℓ + ℓ').smulRight ω =
    ℓ.smulRight ω + ℓ'.smulRight ω from ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by
      simp [add_smul], alternatizeUncurryFin_add]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_smul_left
statement:
lemma wedge1_smul_left {p : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 (c • ℓ) ω = c • wedge1 ℓ ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedge1, wedge1, show (c • ℓ).smulRight ω = c • ℓ.smulRight ω from
    ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by simp [smul_smul]]
  exact alternatizeUncurryFin_smul c (ℓ.smulRight ω)

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_add_right
statement:
lemma wedge1_add_right {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) (ω ω' : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (ω + ω') = wedge1 ℓ ω + wedge1 ℓ ω'
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedge1, wedge1, wedge1, show ℓ.smulRight (ω + ω') =
    ℓ.smulRight ω + ℓ.smulRight ω' from ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by
      simp, alternatizeUncurryFin_add]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_smul_right
statement:
lemma wedge1_smul_right {p : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (c • ω) = c • wedge1 ℓ ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedge1, wedge1, show ℓ.smulRight (c • ω) = c • ℓ.smulRight ω from
    ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => smul_comm (ℓ x) c ω]
  exact alternatizeUncurryFin_smul c (ℓ.smulRight ω)

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_zero_right
statement:
lemma wedge1_zero_right {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (0 : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := wedge1_add_right ℓ (0 : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) 0
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.comp_smulRight_smulRight
statement:
lemma comp_smulRight_smulRight {p : ℕ} (ℓ m : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℂ E ℂ ∘L ℓ.smulRight (m.smulRight ω) =
      ℓ.smulRight (wedge1 m ω)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, alternatizeUncurryFinCLM_apply,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_smul (ℓ x) (m.smulRight ω), wedge1]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_wedge1_self
statement:
lemma wedge1_wedge1_self {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (wedge1 ℓ ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : ∀ x y, (ℓ.smulRight (ℓ.smulRight ω)) x y =
      (ℓ.smulRight (ℓ.smulRight ω)) y x := fun x y => by
    simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  have h := alternatizeUncurryFin_alternatizeUncurryFinCLM_comp_of_symmetric hsymm
  rwa [comp_smulRight_smulRight, ← wedge1] at h

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_wedge1_anticomm
statement:
lemma wedge1_wedge1_anticomm {p : ℕ} (ℓ m : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (wedge1 m ω) = - wedge1 m (wedge1 ℓ ω)
proof:
:= by
  have h := wedge1_wedge1_self (ℓ + m) ω
  rw [wedge1_add_left, wedge1_add_left, wedge1_add_right, wedge1_add_right,
    wedge1_wedge1_self, wedge1_wedge1_self, zero_add, add_zero] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma formOfTuple_cons {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) :
    formOfTuple (Fin.cons ℓ L) = wedge1 ℓ (formOfTuple L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [formOfTuple, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_succ
statement:
lemma formOfTuple_succ {p : ℕ} (L : Fin (p + 1) → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) :
    formOfTuple L = wedge1 (L 0) (formOfTuple (Fin.tail L))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_update_add
statement:
lemma formOfTuple_update_add {p : ℕ} (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (i : Fin p)
    (x y : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    formOfTuple (Function.update L i (x + y)) =
      formOfTuple (Function.update L i x) +
        formOfTuple (Function.update L i y)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ p ih =>
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          have hc : ∀ c : E →L[ℂ] ℂ,
              Function.update L 0 c = Fin.cons c (Fin.tail L) := fun c => by
            conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail L, Fin.update_cons_zero]
          rw [hc (x + y), hc x, hc y, formOfTuple_cons, formOfTuple_cons,
            formOfTuple_cons, wedge1_add_left]
      | succ j =>
          have hc : ∀ c : E →L[ℂ] ℂ, Function.update L j.succ c =
              Fin.cons (L 0) (Function.update (Fin.tail L) j c) := fun c => by
            conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail L]
            rw [Fin.cons_update]
          rw [hc (x + y), hc x, hc y, formOfTuple_cons, formOfTuple_cons,
            formOfTuple_cons, ih (Fin.tail L) j, wedge1_add_right]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_update_smul
statement:
lemma formOfTuple_update_smul {p : ℕ} (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (i : Fin p)
    (c : ℂ) (x : E →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
    formOfTuple (Function.update L i (c • x)) =
      c • formOfTuple (Function.update L i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ p ih =>
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          have hc : ∀ y : E →L[ℂ] ℂ,
              Function.update L 0 y = Fin.cons y (Fin.tail L) := fun y => by
            conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail L, Fin.update_cons_zero]
          rw [hc (c • x), hc x, formOfTuple_cons, formOfTuple_cons,
            wedge1_smul_left]
      | succ j =>
          have hc : ∀ y : E →L[ℂ] ℂ, Function.update L j.succ y =
              Fin.cons (L 0) (Function.update (Fin.tail L) j y) := fun y => by
            conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail L]
            rw [Fin.cons_update]
          rw [hc (c • x), hc x, formOfTuple_cons, formOfTuple_cons,
            ih (Fin.tail L) j, wedge1_smul_right]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTupleML_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma formOfTupleML_apply {p : ℕ} (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) :
    formOfTupleML E p L = formOfTuple L
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma wedge1_formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_mem {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (j : Fin p) (hj : L j = ℓ) :
    wedge1 ℓ (formOfTuple L) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => exact j.elim0
  | succ p ih =>
      induction j using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          rw [formOfTuple_succ, hj, wedge1_wedge1_self]
      | succ j =>
          rw [formOfTuple_succ, wedge1_wedge1_anticomm,
            ih (Fin.tail L) j hj, wedge1_zero_right, neg_zero]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
lemma formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_eq {p : ℕ} (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ))
    (i j : Fin p) (hL : L i = L j) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    formOfTuple L = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ p ih =>
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          induction j using Fin.cases with
          | zero => exact absurd rfl hij
          | succ j =>
              rw [formOfTuple_succ]
              exact wedge1_formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_mem (L 0) (Fin.tail L) j hL.symm
      | succ i =>
          induction j using Fin.cases with
          | zero =>
              rw [formOfTuple_succ]
              exact wedge1_formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_mem (L 0) (Fin.tail L) i hL
          | succ j =>
              rw [formOfTuple_succ,
                ih (Fin.tail L) i j hL (fun h => hij (congrArg Fin.succ h)),
                wedge1_zero_right]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.smul_compContinuousLinearMap
statement:
lemma smul_compContinuousLinearMap {p : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (T : E' →L[ℂ] E) :
    (c • ω).compContinuousLinearMap T = c • ω.compContinuousLinearMap T
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.wedge1_compContinuousLinearMap
statement:
lemma wedge1_compContinuousLinearMap {p : ℕ} (ℓ : E →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (ω : E [⋀^Fin p]→L[ℂ] ℂ) (T : E' →L[ℂ] E) :
    (wedge1 ℓ ω).compContinuousLinearMap T =
      wedge1 (ℓ.comp T) (ω.compContinuousLinearMap T)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compContinuousLinearMap_apply, wedge1, wedge1,
    alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap
statement:
lemma formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap {p : ℕ}
    (L : Fin p → (E →L[ℂ] ℂ)) (T : E' →L[ℂ] E) :
    (formOfTuple L).compContinuousLinearMap T =
      formOfTuple (fun j => (L j).comp T)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero =>
      ext v
      rw [compContinuousLinearMap_apply]
      rfl
  | succ p ih =>
      rw [formOfTuple_succ, wedge1_compContinuousLinearMap, ih (Fin.tail L),
        formOfTuple_succ (fun j => (L j).comp T)]
      rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.fderiv_eval
statement:
lemma fderiv_eval (p : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    fderiv ℂ (fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) v = polyGrad p v
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_eval p v).fderiv

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.polyGrad_mul
statement:
lemma polyGrad_mul (p q : MvPolynomial ι ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    polyGrad (p * q) v = eval v p • polyGrad q v + eval v q • polyGrad p v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (hasFDerivAt_eval p v).mul (hasFDerivAt_eval q v)
  have h2 : ((fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w p) * fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w q) =
      fun w : ι → ℂ => eval w (p * q) :=
    funext fun w => (map_mul (eval w) p q).symm
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact (h1.unique (hasFDerivAt_eval (p * q) v)).symm

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.polyGrad_algebraMap
statement:
lemma polyGrad_algebraMap (a : ℂ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    polyGrad (algebraMap ℂ (MvPolynomial ι ℂ) a) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  exact polyGrad_C a v

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.poly_smul_apply
statement:
lemma poly_smul_apply {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (ω : FormFn N p) (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    (s • ω) z = eval z s • ω z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.algForm_apply
statement:
lemma algForm_apply {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (t : Fin p → Poly N)
    (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    algForm s t z = eval z s • formOfTuple (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.algFormLin_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma algFormLin_apply {p : ℕ} (t : Fin p → Poly N) (s : Poly N) :
    algFormLin t s = algForm s t
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.algForm_eq_sum
statement:
lemma algForm_eq_sum {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (t : Fin p → Poly N) :
    algForm s t = fun z => ∑ r : Fin p → Fin N,
      eval z (s * ∏ j, pderiv (r j) (t j)) •
        formOfTuple (fun j =>
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (r j) : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  rw [algForm_apply]
  have h1 : (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) = fun j =>
      ∑ k, eval z (pderiv k (t j)) •
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := by
    funext j
    rw [polyGrad]
  rw [h1, show formOfTuple (fun j => ∑ k, eval z (pderiv k (t j)) •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) =
    formOfTupleML (Fin N → ℂ) p (fun j => ∑ k, eval z (pderiv k (t j)) •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)) from rfl,
    MultilinearMap.map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, formOfTupleML_apply, map_mul, smul_smul,
    map_prod]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.analyticOnNhd_algForm
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_algForm {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (t : Fin p → Poly N) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (algForm s t) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [algForm_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.analyticOnNhd_fun_sum _ fun r _ => ?_
  exact (AnalyticOnNhd.eval_mvPolynomial (s * ∏ j, pderiv (r j) (t j))).smul
    analyticOnNhd_const

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.preRealize_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma preRealize_single {p : ℕ} (t : Fin p → Poly N) (s : Poly N) :
    preRealize N p (Finsupp.single t s) = algForm s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [preRealize, Finsupp.lsum_single]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.polyGrad_comp_update
statement:
lemma polyGrad_comp_update {p : ℕ} (t : Fin p → Poly N) (i : Fin p)
    (c : Poly N) (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    (fun j => polyGrad (Function.update t i c j) z) =
      Function.update (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i (polyGrad c z)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
  · rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji, Function.update_of_ne hji]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.preRealize_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, i, a, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨t, i, j, hij, htij, rfl⟩ := hw
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealize_single, preRealize_single,
      preRealize_single]
    funext z
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, algForm_apply,
      map_one, one_smul]
    rw [polyGrad_comp_update, polyGrad_comp_update, polyGrad_comp_update,
      polyGrad_add,
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i (polyGrad x z)
        (polyGrad y z), sub_self]
  · 
    rw [map_sub, map_add, preRealize_single, preRealize_single,
      preRealize_single]
    funext z
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, algForm_apply,
      map_one, one_smul]
    rw [polyGrad_comp_update, polyGrad_comp_update, polyGrad_comp_update,
      polyGrad_mul,
      formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i
        (eval z x • polyGrad y z) (eval z y • polyGrad x z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i (eval z x)
        (polyGrad y z),
      formOfTuple_update_smul (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i (eval z y)
        (polyGrad x z), sub_self]
  · 
    rw [preRealize_single]
    funext z
    simp only [algForm_apply, map_one, one_smul, Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [polyGrad_comp_update, polyGrad_algebraMap]
    have h := formOfTuple_update_add (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z) i 0 0
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact left_eq_add.mp h
  · 
    rw [preRealize_single]
    funext z
    simp only [algForm_apply, map_one, one_smul, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact formOfTuple_eq_zero_of_eq (fun k => polyGrad (t k) z) i j
      (congrArg (fun b => polyGrad b z) htij) hij

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.rel_le_ker_preRealize
statement:
theorem rel_le_ker_preRealize (p : ℕ) :
    rel ℂ (Poly N) p ≤ LinearMap.ker (preRealize N p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, Submodule.span_le]
  intro w hw
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  exact preRealize_eq_zero_of_mem_relSet hw

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.drRealize_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma drRealize_mk {p : ℕ} (y : DRFree (Poly N) p) :
    drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = preRealize N p y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.drRealize_mk_single
statement:
lemma drRealize_mk_single {p : ℕ} (t : Fin p → Poly N) (s : Poly N) :
    drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single t s)) = algForm s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [drRealize_mk, preRealize_single]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.drRealize_gen
statement:
lemma drRealize_gen {p : ℕ} (t : Fin p → Poly N) :
    drRealize N p (gen ℂ (Poly N) t) =
      fun z => formOfTuple (fun j => polyGrad (t j) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, drRealize_mk_single]
  funext z
  rw [algForm_apply, map_one, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.analyticOnNhd_drRealize
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_drRealize {p : ℕ} (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (drRealize N p x) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [drRealize_mk]
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [_root_.map_zero]
      exact analyticOnNhd_const
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact hf.add hg
  | single t s =>
      rw [preRealize_single]
      exact analyticOnNhd_algForm s t

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.extDeriv_coeffForm
statement:
lemma extDeriv_coeffForm (p : ℕ) (w : Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) :
    extDeriv (fun v => (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) v • tailProjForm p) w =
      formOfTuple (fun k =>
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  show alternatizeUncurryFin
    (fderiv ℂ (fun v => (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
      (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) v • tailProjForm p) w) = _
  rw [fderiv_smul_const
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
      (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).differentiableAt) (tailProjForm p),
    ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.fderiv_evalPi
statement:
lemma fderiv_evalPi {q : ℕ} (u : Fin q → Poly N) (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    fderiv ℂ (evalPi u) z =
      ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => polyGrad (u k) z
proof:
:=
  (hasStrictFDerivAt_eval_pi u z).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.analyticAt_evalPi
statement:
lemma analyticAt_evalPi {q : ℕ} (u : Fin q → Poly N) (z : Fin N → ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (evalPi u) z
proof:
:=
  analyticAt_eval_pi u z

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.algForm_eq_pullback
statement:
lemma algForm_eq_pullback {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (t : Fin p → Poly N) :
    algForm s t = fun z =>
      (coeffForm p (evalPi (Fin.cons s t) z)).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (evalPi (Fin.cons s t)) z)
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  rw [algForm_apply, coeffForm, smul_compContinuousLinearMap, tailProjForm,
    formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap, fderiv_evalPi]
  congr 1

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.extDeriv_algForm
statement:
theorem extDeriv_algForm {p : ℕ} (s : Poly N) (t : Fin p → Poly N) :
    extDeriv (algForm s t) = algForm (1 : Poly N) (Fin.cons s t)
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  have h1 : algForm s t = fun x =>
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
          (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (evalPi (Fin.cons s t) x) •
        tailProjForm p).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fderiv ℂ (evalPi (Fin.cons s t)) x) :=
    algForm_eq_pullback s t
  rw [h1]
  rw [extDeriv_pullback (𝕜 := ℂ) (r := minSmoothness ℂ 2)
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (0 : Fin (p + 1)) :
        (Fin (p + 1) → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).differentiableAt).smul_const
      (tailProjForm p))
    ((analyticAt_evalPi (Fin.cons s t) z).contDiffAt) le_rfl]
  rw [extDeriv_coeffForm, formOfTuple_compContinuousLinearMap, fderiv_evalPi,
    algForm_apply, map_one, one_smul]
  refine congrArg formOfTuple (funext fun k => ?_)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_pi]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.extDeriv_drRealize
statement:
theorem extDeriv_drRealize {p : ℕ} (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    extDeriv (drRealize N p x) = drRealize N (p + 1) (d ℂ (Poly N) p x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, _root_.map_zero, _root_.map_zero]
      funext z
      exact extDeriv_const_eq_zero (0 : FormSpace N p) z
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, map_add]
      funext z
      have h1 : (drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) +
          drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk g)) = fun w =>
          drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) w +
            drRealize N p (Submodule.Quotient.mk g) w := rfl
      rw [h1, extDeriv_fun_add
        ((analyticOnNhd_drRealize (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) z
          (Set.mem_univ z)).differentiableAt)
        ((analyticOnNhd_drRealize (Submodule.Quotient.mk g) z
          (Set.mem_univ z)).differentiableAt)]
      rw [congrFun hf z, congrFun hg z]
      rfl
  | single t s =>
      rw [drRealize_mk_single, d_mk_single, gen, drRealize_mk_single]
      exact extDeriv_algForm s t

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.realizeSection_val
statement:
lemma realizeSection_val {p : ℕ} (U : (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ)
    (x : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) (y : ↥(unop U)) :
    (realizeSection U x).1 y = drRealize N p x ↑y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.realizeSection_add
statement:
lemma realizeSection_add {p : ℕ} (U : (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ)
    (x x' : DR ℂ (Poly N) p) :
    realizeSection U (x + x') = realizeSection U x + realizeSection U x'
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  show drRealize N p (x + x') ↑y = drRealize N p x ↑y + drRealize N p x' ↑y
  rw [map_add]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.comparisonSheaf_homEquiv
statement:
lemma comparisonSheaf_homEquiv (p : ℕ) :
    ((sheafificationAdjunction (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat).homEquiv _ _)
      (comparisonSheaf N p) = comparisonPresheaf N p
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.dAb_comp_dAb
statement: lemma dAb_comp_dAb (p : ℕ) : dAb (N := N) p ≫ dAb (p + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  show d ℂ (Poly N) (p + 1) (d ℂ (Poly N) p x) = 0
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_d ℂ (Poly N) p) x

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.comparisonPresheaf_square
statement:
lemma comparisonPresheaf_square (p : ℕ) :
    (Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).map (dAb p) ≫
        comparisonPresheaf N (p + 1) =
      comparisonPresheaf N p ≫ dPresheafAb N p
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  show realizeSection U (d ℂ (Poly N) p x) = dSection (realizeSection U x)
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun y => ?_)
  rw [realizeSection_val]
  show drRealize N (p + 1) (d ℂ (Poly N) p x) ↑y =
    extDeriv (sectionExtendV (realizeSection U x)) ↑y
  have heq : sectionExtendV (realizeSection U x) =ᶠ[nhds (↑y : Fin N → ℂ)]
      drRealize N p x :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((unop U).isOpen.mem_nhds y.2)
      (fun z hz => sectionExtendV_apply_of_mem (realizeSection U x) hz)
  rw [heq.extDeriv_eq, ← extDeriv_drRealize]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.comparisonSheaf_square
statement:
lemma comparisonSheaf_square (p : ℕ) :
    (constantSheaf (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat).map (dAb p) ≫
        comparisonSheaf N (p + 1) =
      comparisonSheaf N p ≫ dSheafForms N p
proof:
:= by
  have hL := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm
    (adj := sheafificationAdjunction (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat)
    (Y := formSheafAb N (p + 1))
    ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).map (dAb p))
    (comparisonPresheaf N (p + 1))
  have hR := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
    (adj := sheafificationAdjunction (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat)
    (Y := formSheafAb N p)
    (comparisonPresheaf N p) (dSheafForms N p)
  refine Eq.trans (Eq.trans hL.symm ?_) hR
  exact congrArg
    (fun q => ((sheafificationAdjunction (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat).homEquiv
      ((Functor.const (Opens (TopCat.of (Fin N → ℂ)))ᵒᵖ).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (DR ℂ (Poly N) p)))
      (formSheafAb N (p + 1))).symm q)
    (comparisonPresheaf_square p)

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.hyperHMap_hodgeFiltration_le
statement:
lemma hyperHMap_hodgeFiltration_le {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] (Z : C) {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (p n : ℤ) :
    (hodgeFiltration Z K p n).map (hyperHMap Z f n) ≤
      hodgeFiltration Z L p n
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_hodgeFiltration_iff Z K p n x).mp hx
  rw [mem_hodgeFiltration_iff]
  refine ⟨hyperHMap Z (brutalTruncGEMap f p) n y, ?_⟩
  rw [← hyperHMap_comp, ιBrutalTruncGE_naturality, hyperHMap_comp, hy]

name: HodgePilot.ComparisonAffine.comparisonHyperH_hodgeFiltration_le
statement:
lemma comparisonHyperH_hodgeFiltration_le (p n : ℤ) :
    (sheafHodgeFiltration (anSite N) (zConstSheaf (anSite N))
        (algConstComplex N) p n).map (comparisonHyperH N n) ≤
      sheafHodgeFiltration (anSite N) (zConstSheaf (anSite N))
        (holomorphicDeRhamComplexZ N) p n
proof:
:=
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Sheaf (anSite N) AddCommGrpCat)
  hyperHMap_hodgeFiltration_le (zConstSheaf (anSite N))
    (comparisonChainMap N) p n

name: HodgePilot.coeffs_zero
statement:
private theorem coeffs_zero (a b : ℂ) (h : a • bc 0 + b • bc 1 = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hli := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp bc.linearIndependent
  have hz := hli (fun j => if j = 0 then a else b)
    (by simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h)
  exact ⟨by simpa using hz 0, by simpa using hz 1⟩

name: HodgePilot.w2_ne_zero
statement: theorem w2_ne_zero : w2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : (1 : ℂ) • bc 0 + (-Complex.I) • bc 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [w2, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul] using h
  exact one_ne_zero (coeffs_zero 1 (-Complex.I) h').1

name: HodgePilot.w2_not_mem_span_w1
statement: theorem w2_not_mem_span_w1 : w2 ∉ (ℂ ∙ w1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  have ha' : a • (bc 0 + Complex.I • bc 1) = bc 0 - Complex.I • bc 1 := by
    simpa [w1, w2] using ha
  have key : (a - 1) • bc 0 + ((a + 1) * Complex.I) • bc 1 = 0 := by
    linear_combination (norm := module) ha'
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := coeffs_zero _ _ key
  have ha1 : a = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
  rw [ha1] at h1
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
  · norm_num at h
  · exact Complex.I_ne_zero h

name: HodgePilot.disjoint_w1_w2
statement: theorem disjoint_w1_w2 : Disjoint (ℂ ∙ w1) (ℂ ∙ w2)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.disjoint_span_singleton.mpr fun h => absurd h w2_not_mem_span_w1

name: HodgePilot.bc0_mem
statement: theorem bc0_mem : bc 0 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2)
proof:
:= by
  have hw1 : w1 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2) :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hw2 : w2 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2) :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have h2 : (2 : ℂ) • bc 0 = w1 + w2 := by
    simp only [w1, w2]; module
  have h : bc 0 = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (w1 + w2) := by
    rw [← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_smul]
  rw [h]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.add_mem _ hw1 hw2)

name: HodgePilot.bc1_mem
statement: theorem bc1_mem : bc 1 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2)
proof:
:= by
  have hw1 : w1 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2) :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hw2 : w2 ∈ (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2) :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have h2I : ((2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) • bc 1 = w1 - w2 := by
    simp only [w1, w2]; module
  have hne : (2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero
  have h : bc 1 = ((2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ • (w1 - w2) := by
    rw [← h2I, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
  rw [h]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ hw1 hw2)

name: HodgePilot.span_w_top
statement: theorem span_w_top : (ℂ ∙ w1) ⊔ (ℂ ∙ w2) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← bc.span_eq, Submodule.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff]
  rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
  exact ⟨bc0_mem, bc1_mem⟩

name: HodgePilot.map_span_w1

proof:

name: HodgePilot.map_span_w2

proof:

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Cycle.map_add
statement:
lemma map_add (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (c₁ c₂ : Scheme.Cycle X ℤ) :
    map f (c₁ + c₂) = map f c₁ + map f c₂
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := (PrespectralSpace.isTopologicalBasis (X := Y)).exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (Set.mem_univ z) isOpen_univ
  have key : ∀ c : Scheme.Cycle X ℤ,
      ((f ⁻¹' {z} : Set X) ∩
        Function.support fun x => c x * (Scheme.Hom.residueDegree f x : ℤ)).Finite := by
    intro c
    apply Set.Finite.subset
      (c.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
        (f.isSpectralMap.2 hU.1.1 hU.1.2))
    rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show f y ∈ U
      have hyz : f y = z := hy1
      rw [hyz]
      exact hU.2.1
    · exact fun h0 => hy2 (mul_eq_zero_of_left h0 _)
  simp only [map_apply, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, add_mul]
  exact finsum_mem_add_distrib' (key c₁) (key c₂)

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_surjective
statement:
lemma residueFieldMap_surjective (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f] (x : X) :
    Function.Surjective (f.residueFieldMap x)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := X.residue_surjective x y
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := f.stalkMap_surjective x a
  refine ⟨Y.residue (f x) b, ?_⟩
  have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residue_residueFieldMap (f := f) (x := x))
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h2
  have h3 := RingHom.congr_fun h2 b
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h3
  rw [← ha, ← hb]
  exact h3
