name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Hom.residueDegree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
@[simp]
lemma residueDegree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (x : X) :
    residueDegree f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  have e : Y.residueField (f x) ≃ₗ[Y.residueField (f x)] X.residueField x :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.linearMap _ _) (residueFieldMap_bijective f x)
  show Module.finrank (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) = 1
  rw [← e.finrank_eq]
  exact CommSemiring.finrank_self _

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.dimClosure_map
statement:
lemma dimClosure_map (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f] (x : X) :
    dimClosure (f x) = dimClosure x
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ a b : X, f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b := by
    intro a b
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact f.isClosedEmbedding.toIsEmbedding.toIsInducing.specializes_iff
  refine (Order.height_eq_of_strictMono f ?_ ?_ x).symm
  · intro a b hab
    rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge] at hab ⊢
    exact ⟨(hle a b).mpr hab.1, fun h => hab.2 ((hle b a).mp h)⟩
  · intro a b hb
    have hba : b ∈ closure ({f a} : Set Y) :=
      specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hb.le)
    rw [← Set.image_singleton, f.isClosedEmbedding.closure_image_eq] at hba
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := hba
    refine ⟨a', ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge]
    refine ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr ha'), fun h => ?_⟩
    exact hb.not_ge ((hle a a').mpr h)

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Cycle.map_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_single (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f] (x : X) (n : ℤ) :
    map f (single x n) = single (f x) n
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [map_apply]
  by_cases hz : z = f x
  · subst hz
    have hfib : (f ⁻¹' {f x} : Set X) = {x} := by
      apply Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr
      exact ⟨rfl, fun y hy => f.isClosedEmbedding.injective hy⟩
    rw [hfib, finsum_mem_singleton]
    simp
  · refine Eq.trans (finsum_mem_of_eqOn_zero fun y hy => ?_) ?_
    · have hyz : f y = z := hy
      have hyx : y ≠ x := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hz hyz.symm
      show single x n y * (Scheme.Hom.residueDegree f y : ℤ) = 0
      rw [single_apply, if_neg hyx, zero_mul]
    · rw [single_apply, if_neg hz]

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Cycle.map_mem_cyclesOfDim
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hsub : Function.support ⇑(map f c) ⊆ ⇑f '' Function.support ⇑c :=
    Function.locallyFinsupp.support_map_subset_of_forall_mem f.isSpectralMap
      (fun x => (Scheme.Hom.residueDegree f x : ℤ)) c (Function.support ⇑c)
      (⇑f '' Function.support ⇑c) subset_rfl
      (fun x hx _ => Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hsub hy
  rw [dimClosure_map f x]
  exact hc x hx

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Cycle.weightedDegree_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedDegree_single {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] (w : X → ℤ)
    (x : X) (n : ℤ) :
    weightedDegree w (single x n) = n * w x
proof:
:= by
  show (toFinsupp (single x n)).sum (fun x n => n * w x) = n * w x
  rw [toFinsupp_single]
  exact Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_mul _)

name: HodgePilot.Scheme.Cycle.degree_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_single (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) (n : ℤ) :
    degree k (single x n) = n * (residueFieldDegreeOver k x : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  weightedDegree_single _ x n

name: HodgePilot.fiberTensor_ext
statement:
theorem fiberTensor_ext {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T]
    {F G : ((⨁ i, A i) ⊗[ℚ] ⨁ j, B j) →ₗ[ℚ] T}
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (x : A i) (j : κ) (y : B j),
      F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ι A i x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ κ B j y) =
        G (DirectSum.lof ℚ ι A i x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ κ B j y)) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun i => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun j => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
  exact h i x j y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberRegroup_lof
statement:
theorem fiberRegroup_lof (i j : ℤ)
    (v : (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) :
    fiberRegroup X Y
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
          (fun i => ⨁ j : ℤ, (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) i
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
            (fun j => (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) j v)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) (i + j)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (i + j)) (convCarrier X Y (i + j))
          ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ v)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ ℤ _ _
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
      (fun i => ⨁ j : ℤ, (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) i
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
        (fun j => (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) j v)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberMuFwd_lof_tmul_lof
statement:
theorem fiberMuFwd_lof_tmul_lof (i j : ℤ) (x : (X.component i).carrier)
    (y : (Y.component j).carrier) :
    fiberMuFwd X Y
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier) i x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) j y) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) (i + j)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (i + j)) (convCarrier X Y (i + j))
          ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))
proof:
:= by
  show fiberRegroup X Y
      (DirectSum.lmap _
        ((TensorProduct.directSumLeft ℚ ℚ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier)
          (⨁ j : ℤ, (Y.component j).carrier))
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier) i x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
            DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) j y))) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.directSumLeft_tmul_lof, DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  show fiberRegroup X Y
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ
        (fun i => ⨁ j : ℤ, (X.component i).carrier ⊗[ℚ] (Y.component j).carrier) i
        ((TensorProduct.directSumRight ℚ ℚ (X.component i).carrier
          (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier))
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) j y))) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.directSumRight_tmul_lof, fiberRegroup_lof]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberMuInv_lof_lof
statement:
theorem fiberMuInv_lof_lof (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n) (v : convCarrier X Y n p) :
    fiberMuInv X Y
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) n
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v)) =
      TensorProduct.map
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier) p.val.1)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) p.val.2) v
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ ℤ _ _
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) n
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, DirectSum.toModule_lof]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberMu_lof_tmul_lof
statement:
theorem fiberMu_lof_tmul_lof (i j : ℤ) (x : (X.component i).carrier)
    (y : (Y.component j).carrier) :
    fiberMu X Y
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier) i x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) j y) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) (i + j)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (i + j)) (convCarrier X Y (i + j))
          ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y))
proof:
:=
  fiberMuFwd_lof_tmul_lof X Y i j x y

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberMu_symm_lof_lof
statement:
theorem fiberMu_symm_lof_lof (n : ℤ) (p : ConvIndex n) (v : convCarrier X Y n p) :
    (fiberMu X Y).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => ⨁ p : ConvIndex n, convCarrier X Y n p) n
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X Y n) p v)) =
      TensorProduct.map
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun i => (X.component i).carrier) p.val.1)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun j => (Y.component j).carrier) p.val.2) v
proof:
:=
  fiberMuInv_lof_lof X Y n p v

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberEpsLin_bijective
statement: theorem fiberEpsLin_bijective : Function.Bijective fiberEpsLin
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Function.Bijective
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => (unitObj.component n).carrier) 0) :=
    lof_bijective_of_subsingleton 0 fun m hm => unit_component_subsingleton hm
  show Function.Bijective
    ((DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => (unitObj.component n).carrier) 0) ∘ₗ
      unitη.toLinearMap)
  rw [LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact h1.comp unitη_bijective

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberEps_apply_one
statement:
theorem fiberEps_apply_one :
    fiberEps 1 =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => (unitObj.component n).carrier) 0 unitGen

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberEps_symm_lof_unitGen
statement:
theorem fiberEps_symm_lof_unitGen :
    fiberEps.symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℤ (fun n => (unitObj.component n).carrier) 0 unitGen) =
      1
proof:

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.fiberMuIso_hom_apply
statement:
theorem fiberMuIso_hom_apply (X Y : HodgeFamily.{0})

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.subsingleton_dual_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem subsingleton_dual_of_subsingleton {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module ℚ V] (h : Subsingleton V) : Subsingleton (Module.Dual ℚ V)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun f g => LinearMap.ext fun v => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim v (0 : V), map_zero, map_zero]⟩

    Subsingleton (X.component b).carrier
proof: := by subst h; exact hs

statement: theorem compCast_self {a : ℤ} (h : a = a) : compCast X h = LinearMap.id
proof: := rfl

statement:
theorem heq_compCast {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) (v : (X.component a).carrier) :

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalScalar_pos
statement:
theorem evalScalar_pos {a b : ℤ} (h : b = -a)
    (φ : ((dualObj X).component a).carrier) (ξ : (X.component b).carrier) :
    evalScalar X φ ξ = φ (compCast X h ξ)
proof: := dif_pos h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalScalar_neg
statement:
theorem evalScalar_neg {a b : ℤ} (h : ¬ b = -a)
    (φ : ((dualObj X).component a).carrier) (ξ : (X.component b).carrier) :
    evalScalar X φ ξ = 0
proof: := dif_neg h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalPairLin_tmul
statement:
theorem evalPairLin_tmul (a b : ℤ) (h : b = -a)
    (φ : ((dualObj X).component a).carrier) (ξ : (X.component b).carrier) :
    evalPairLin X a b h (φ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ξ) = φ (compCast X h ξ)
proof:
:= by
  show contractLeft ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier
    ((LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier) (compCast X h))
      (φ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ξ)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, contractLeft_apply]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalPairLin_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem evalPairLin_maps_pieces (a b : ℤ) (h : b = -a) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (tensorPiece ((dualObj X).component a).str (X.component b).str pq).map
        ((evalPairLin X a b h).baseChange ℂ) ≤ hodgeUnit.H pq
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have h1 : evalPairLin X a (-a) rfl =
      contractLeft ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier := by
    show contractLeft ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (Module.Dual ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier)
          LinearMap.id =
      contractLeft ℚ (X.component (-a)).carrier
    rw [LinearMap.lTensor_id, LinearMap.comp_id]
  rw [h1]
  exact ((X.component (-a)).str).evalHom.maps_pieces pq

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalLin_lof
statement:
theorem evalLin_lof (p : ConvIndex 0) (h : p.val.2 = -p.val.1)
    (v : convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0 p) :
    evalLin X (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0) p v) =
      evalPairLin X p.val.1 p.val.2 h v
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ConvIndex 0) ℚ
    (fun p => evalPairLin X p.val.1 p.val.2 (by have h := p.property; omega))
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0) p v) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.toModule_baseChange_lof
statement:
theorem toModule_baseChange_lof {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module ℚ (M i)] {T : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T] (f : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[ℚ] T) (i : ι)
    (u : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) :
    (DirectSum.toModule ℚ ι T f).baseChange ℂ
        ((directSumBaseChange M).symm
          (DirectSum.lof ℂ ι (fun i => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] M i) i u)) =
      (f i).baseChange ℂ u
proof:
:= by
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul c m =>
      rw [directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
        DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      simp only [map_add]
      rw [ha, hb]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalLin_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem evalLin_maps_pieces (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ((convStrTotal (dualObj X) X 0).H pq).map ((evalLin X).baseChange ℂ) ≤
      hodgeUnit.H pq
proof:
:= by
  rw [convStrTotal_H (dualObj X) X 0 pq, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap,
    Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, directSumPiece_def]
  refine iSup_le fun p => ?_
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hv
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  rw [show (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0)).symm.toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex 0)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0 p) p u) =
      (directSumBaseChange (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0)).symm
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex 0)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0 p) p u) from rfl,
    show (evalLin X).baseChange ℂ
        ((directSumBaseChange (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0)).symm
          (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex 0)
            (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0 p) p u)) =
      (evalPairLin X p.val.1 p.val.2
        (by have h := p.property; omega)).baseChange ℂ u from
      toModule_baseChange_lof _ p u]
  exact evalPairLin_maps_pieces X p.val.1 p.val.2
    (by have h := p.property; omega) pq (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hu)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalFam_zero
statement: theorem evalFam_zero : evalFam X 0 = evalComp X 0 rfl
proof: := dif_pos rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalFam_of_ne
statement: theorem evalFam_of_ne {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) : evalFam X n = 0
proof: := dif_neg h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.unitGenAt_zero
statement: theorem unitGenAt_zero : unitGenAt 0 = unitGen
proof: := dif_pos rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.unitGenAt_of_ne
statement: theorem unitGenAt_of_ne {m : ℤ} (h : m ≠ 0) : unitGenAt m = 0
proof: := dif_neg h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.heq_unitGenAt
statement: theorem heq_unitGenAt {m : ℤ} (h : m = 0) : HEq (unitGenAt m) unitGen
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact heq_of_eq unitGenAt_zero

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.evalFam_apply_lof
statement:
theorem evalFam_apply_lof (m : ℤ) (B : ConvIndex m)
    (φ : ((dualObj X).component B.val.1).carrier)
    (ξ : (X.component B.val.2).carrier) :
    (evalFam X m).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex m) (convCarrier (dualObj X) X m) B
          (φ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ξ)) =
      evalScalar X φ ξ • unitGenAt m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    rw [evalFam_zero]
    show unitη.toLinearMap
        (evalLin X
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier (dualObj X) X 0) B
            (φ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ξ))) =
      evalScalar X φ ξ • unitGenAt 0
    have hB : B.val.2 = -B.val.1 := by have h := B.property; omega
    rw [evalLin_lof X B hB, evalPairLin_tmul X B.val.1 B.val.2 hB φ ξ,
      evalScalar_pos X hB φ ξ, unitGenAt_zero,
      show unitGen = unitη.toLinearMap unitOne from rfl, ← map_smul]
    congr 1
    show φ (compCast X hB ξ) = φ (compCast X hB ξ) • (1 : ℚ)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · rw [evalFam_of_ne X hm, unitGenAt_of_ne hm, smul_zero,
      HodgeStructCat.zero_toLinearMap']
    rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.mem_coevSupport_of_not_subsingleton
statement:
theorem mem_coevSupport_of_not_subsingleton {k : ℤ}
    (h : ¬ Subsingleton (X.component (-k)).carrier) : k ∈ coevSupport X
proof:
:= by
  rw [coevSupport, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨-k, by rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; exact h, by omega⟩

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.subsingleton_of_notMem_coevSupport
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_notMem_coevSupport {k : ℤ}
    (h : k ∉ coevSupport X) : Subsingleton (X.component (-k)).carrier
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hs
  exact h (mem_coevSupport_of_not_subsingleton X hs)

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevLin_apply_one
statement:
theorem coevLin_apply_one :
    coevLin X 1 =
      ∑ k ∈ coevSupport X,
        DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier X (dualObj X) 0) (coevIdx k)
          (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coevLin, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevLin_maps_pieces
statement:
theorem coevLin_maps_pieces (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (hodgeUnit.H pq).map ((coevLin X).baseChange ℂ) ≤
      (convStrTotal X (dualObj X) 0).H pq
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : pq = ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))
  · subst hpq
    rw [hodgeUnit_H, if_pos rfl, Submodule.map_top]
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hw
    have hu : u = (TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ) u ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← (TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ).symm_apply_apply u]
      rw [TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply]
    rw [hu,
      show ((TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ) u) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ) =
          ((TensorProduct.rid ℚ ℂ) u) • ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)) by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one],
      map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, coevLin_apply_one, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
    rw [← directSumBaseChange_symm_lof_tmul, convStrTotal_H]
    refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [directSumPiece_def]
    refine (le_iSup (fun p => ((convStr X (dualObj X) 0 p).H ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))).map
        (DirectSum.lof ℂ (ConvIndex 0)
          (fun p => ℂ ⊗[ℚ] convCarrier X (dualObj X) 0 p) p)) (coevIdx k))
      (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_)
    show (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier 1) ∈
      tensorPiece (X.component (-k)).str
        (((X.component (-k)).str.dual).weightCast (neg_neg k)) ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))
    have h1 : ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)) ∈ hodgeUnit.H ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) := by
      rw [hodgeUnit_H, if_pos rfl]
      trivial
    have h2 := ((X.component (-k)).str).coevalHom.maps_pieces ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ))
      (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h1)
    rw [QHodgeStructure.coevalHom_toLinearMap] at h2
    rw [show (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier).baseChange ℂ
          ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)) =
        (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier 1) from by
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]] at h2
    exact h2
  · rw [hodgeUnit_H, if_neg hpq, Submodule.map_bot]
    exact bot_le

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevFam_zero
statement: theorem coevFam_zero : coevFam X 0 = coevComp X 0 rfl
proof: := dif_pos rfl

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevFam_of_ne
statement: theorem coevFam_of_ne {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) : coevFam X n = 0
proof: := dif_neg h

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevFam_apply_unitGen
statement:
theorem coevFam_apply_unitGen :
    (coevFam X 0).toLinearMap unitGen =
      ∑ k ∈ coevSupport X,
        DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier X (dualObj X) 0) (coevIdx k)
          (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coevFam_zero]
  show coevLin X
      ((eqToHom (singleObj_component_self
        (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit))).toLinearMap unitGen) = _
  have h1 : (eqToHom (singleObj_component_self
      (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit))).toLinearMap unitGen = (1 : ℚ) := by
    have h2 : (eqToHom (singleObj_component_self
          (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit)).symm ≫
        eqToHom (singleObj_component_self (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit))) =
        𝟙 (HodgeStructCat.of ℚ hodgeUnit) := by
      rw [eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl]
    have h3 := congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap h2
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h3 unitOne
  rw [h1, coevLin_apply_one]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.heq_tmul_both
proof:
:= by
  subst ha
  subst hb
  rw [eq_of_heq hx, eq_of_heq hy]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.id_component_apply

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.coevaluation_one_expand
statement:
theorem coevaluation_one_expand (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V]
    [Module.Finite ℚ V] :
    coevaluation ℚ V 1 = ∑ i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex ℚ V,

proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.associator_inv_apply_lof
statement:
theorem associator_inv_apply_lof (n : ℤ) (s : ConvIndex n)
    (t : ConvIndex s.val.2) (x : (X.component s.val.1).carrier)
    (y : (Y.component t.val.1).carrier) (z : (Z.component t.val.2).carrier) :
    ((associator X Y Z).inv n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n) s
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
            DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2) (convCarrier Y Z s.val.2) t
              (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n)
        (assocIdxFstInv s t)
        ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1)
          (convCarrier X Y (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1) (assocIdxSndInv s t)
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfwd : (associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n)
        (assocIdxFstInv s t)
        ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1)
          (convCarrier X Y (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1) (assocIdxSndInv s t)
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n) s
        (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2) (convCarrier Y Z s.val.2) t
            (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)) := by
    rw [associatorHom_apply]
    refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
    · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl t.property)
    refine heq_tmul_right
      (C := fun m => ⨁ t' : ConvIndex m, convCarrier Y Z m t')
      (show t.val.1 + t.val.2 = s.val.2 from t.property) x ?_
    exact heq_lof_conv (N := convCarrier Y Z) t.property rfl HEq.rfl
  have hcomp : ((associator X Y Z).inv n).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      ((associator X Y Z).hom n).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id :=
    congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap (congrFun (associator X Y Z).hom_inv_id n)
  calc ((associator X Y Z).inv n).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X (tensorObj Y Z) n) s
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
            DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex s.val.2) (convCarrier Y Z s.val.2) t
              (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z)))
      = ((associator X Y Z).inv n).toLinearMap
          ((associatorHom X Y Z n).toLinearMap
            (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier (tensorObj X Y) Z n)
              (assocIdxFstInv s t)
              ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1)
                (convCarrier X Y (assocIdxFstInv s t).val.1)
                (assocIdxSndInv s t) (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z))) := by
        rw [hfwd]
    _ = _ := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp _

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.zig1_term
statement:
theorem zig1_term (n : ℤ) (x : (X.component n).carrier)
    (b : (X.component (-(-n))).carrier)
    (φ : ((dualObj X).component (-n)).carrier) :
    (tensorHom (𝟙 X) (evalFam X) n).toLinearMap
        ((associatorHom X (dualObj X) X n).toLinearMap
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
            (convCarrier (tensorObj X (dualObj X)) X n) (leftUnitIdx n)
            ((DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0) (convCarrier X (dualObj X) 0)
              (coevIdx (-n)) (b ⊗ₜ[ℚ] φ)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier X unitObj n)
        (assocIdxFst (leftUnitIdx n) (coevIdx (-n)))
        ((φ (compCast X (show (n : ℤ) = -(-n) by omega) x) • b) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          unitGenAt (-n + n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [associatorHom_apply, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, id_component_apply,
    evalFam_apply_lof, evalScalar_pos X (show (n : ℤ) = -(-n) by omega),
    TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.zig2_term
statement:
theorem zig2_term (n : ℤ) (φ : ((dualObj X).component n).carrier)
    (b : (X.component (-n)).carrier) (ψ : ((dualObj X).component n).carrier) :
    (tensorHom (evalFam X) (𝟙 (dualObj X)) n).toLinearMap
        (((associator (dualObj X) X (dualObj X)).inv n).toLinearMap
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n)
            (convCarrier (dualObj X) (tensorObj X (dualObj X)) n)
            (rightUnitIdx n)
            (φ ⊗ₜ[ℚ] DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex 0)
              (convCarrier X (dualObj X) 0) (coevIdx n) (b ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ψ)))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ConvIndex n) (convCarrier unitObj (dualObj X) n)
        (assocIdxFstInv (rightUnitIdx n) (coevIdx n))
        (unitGenAt (n + -n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (φ b • ψ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [associator_inv_apply_lof, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, id_component_apply,
    evalFam_apply_lof, evalScalar_pos X (show (-n : ℤ) = -n from rfl),
    compCast_self, LinearMap.id_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.zig_eval_coeval
statement:
theorem zig_eval_coeval :
    leftUnitorInv X ≫
        tensorHom (coevFam X) (𝟙 X) ≫
          associatorHom X (dualObj X) X ≫ tensorHom (𝟙 X) (evalFam X) =
      rightUnitorInv X
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  show (tensorHom (𝟙 X) (evalFam X) n).toLinearMap
      ((associatorHom X (dualObj X) X n).toLinearMap
        ((tensorHom (coevFam X) (𝟙 X) n).toLinearMap
          (((leftUnitorInv X) n).toLinearMap x))) =
    ((rightUnitorInv X) n).toLinearMap x
  rw [leftUnitorInv_apply', rightUnitorInv_apply', tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul,
    id_component_apply, coevFam_apply_unitGen, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (-n) ?_ ?_).trans ?_
  · intro k _ hkn
    generalize (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier) 1 = w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    | tmul b φ =>
        rw [associatorHom_apply, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul, id_component_apply,
          evalFam_apply_lof,
          evalScalar_neg X (show ¬ (n : ℤ) = -k by omega),
          zero_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
    | add w1 w2 h1 h2 =>
        simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
        rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  · intro hns
    have hsub : Subsingleton (X.component n).carrier :=
      subsingleton_component_congr X (show -(-n) = n by omega)
        (subsingleton_of_notMem_coevSupport X hns)
    rw [show (x : (X.component n).carrier) = 0 from @Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _]
    simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  · rw [coevaluation_one_expand, map_sum, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
    simp only [map_sum]
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ =>
      zig1_term X n x ((Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ (X.component (-(-n))).carrier) i)
        ((Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ (X.component (-(-n))).carrier).coord i)).trans ?_
    rw [← map_sum, ← TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
    simp only [Basis.coord_apply]
    rw [Basis.sum_repr]
    refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
    · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (show -(-n) = n by omega)
        (show -n + n = 0 by omega))
    · exact heq_tmul_both (C := fun m => (X.component m).carrier)
        (D := fun m => (unitObj.component m).carrier)
        (show -(-n) = n by omega) (show -n + n = 0 by omega)
        (heq_compCast X (show (n : ℤ) = -(-n) by omega) x)
        (heq_unitGenAt (show -n + n = 0 by omega))

name: HodgePilot.HodgeFamily.zig_coeval_eval
statement:
theorem zig_coeval_eval :
    rightUnitorInv (dualObj X) ≫
        tensorHom (𝟙 (dualObj X)) (coevFam X) ≫
          (associator (dualObj X) X (dualObj X)).inv ≫
            tensorHom (evalFam X) (𝟙 (dualObj X)) =
      leftUnitorInv (dualObj X)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun n => ?_
  refine HodgeStructCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun φ => ?_)
  show (tensorHom (evalFam X) (𝟙 (dualObj X)) n).toLinearMap
      (((associator (dualObj X) X (dualObj X)).inv n).toLinearMap
        ((tensorHom (𝟙 (dualObj X)) (coevFam X) n).toLinearMap
          (((rightUnitorInv (dualObj X)) n).toLinearMap φ))) =
    ((leftUnitorInv (dualObj X)) n).toLinearMap φ
  rw [rightUnitorInv_apply', leftUnitorInv_apply', tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul,
    id_component_apply, coevFam_apply_unitGen, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine (Finset.sum_eq_single n ?_ ?_).trans ?_
  · intro k _ hkn
    generalize (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-k)).carrier) 1 = w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    | tmul b ψ =>
        rw [associator_inv_apply_lof, tensorHom_apply_lof_tmul,
          id_component_apply, evalFam_apply_lof,
          evalScalar_neg X (show ¬ (-k : ℤ) = -n by omega),
          zero_smul, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
    | add w1 w2 h1 h2 =>
        simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
        rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  · intro hns
    haveI hsub : Subsingleton (X.component (-n)).carrier :=
      subsingleton_of_notMem_coevSupport X hns
    rw [show (coevaluation ℚ (X.component (-n)).carrier) 1 = 0 from
      Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  · rw [coevaluation_one_expand, map_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
    simp only [map_sum]
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ =>
      zig2_term X n φ ((Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ (X.component (-n)).carrier) i)
        ((Basis.ofVectorSpace ℚ (X.component (-n)).carrier).coord i)).trans ?_
    rw [← map_sum, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
      Basis.sum_dual_apply_smul_coord]
    refine lof_cast_eq ?_ ?_
    · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (show n + -n = 0 by omega)
        (rfl : (n : ℤ) = n))
    · exact heq_tmul_both (C := fun m => (unitObj.component m).carrier)
        (D := fun m => ((dualObj X).component m).carrier)
        (show n + -n = 0 by omega) (rfl : (n : ℤ) = n)
        (heq_unitGenAt (show n + -n = 0 by omega)) HEq.rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcceptanceReceipts.homAddEquivOfIsos_naturality
statement:
theorem homAddEquivOfIsos_naturality {X X' YK YL Y'K Y'L : C}
    (iX : X ≅ X') (iYK : YK ≅ Y'K) (iYL : YL ≅ Y'L)
    (g : YK ⟶ YL) (g' : Y'K ⟶ Y'L)
    (hg : g ≫ iYL.hom = iYK.hom ≫ g') (x : X ⟶ YK) :
    homAddEquivOfIsos iX iYL (x ≫ g) = homAddEquivOfIsos iX iYK x ≫ g'
proof:
:= by
  show iX.inv ≫ (x ≫ g) ≫ iYL.hom = (iX.inv ≫ x ≫ iYK.hom) ≫ g'
  rw [Category.assoc, hg]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: HodgePilot.AcceptanceReceipts.hyperHCongr_naturality
statement:
theorem hyperHCongr_naturality {Z Z' : C} {K₁ K₂ L₁ L₂ : CochainComplex C ℤ}
    (iZ : Z ≅ Z') (iK : K₁ ≅ K₂) (iL : L₁ ≅ L₂) (f : K₁ ⟶ L₁) (g : K₂ ⟶ L₂)
    (hfg : f ≫ iL.hom = iK.hom ≫ g) (n : ℤ) (x : Hyper.hyperH Z K₁ n) :
    hyperHCongr iZ iL n (Hyper.hyperHMap Z f n x) =
      Hyper.hyperHMap Z' g n (hyperHCongr iZ iK n x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫
      ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).mapIso
        (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso iL)).hom =
    ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).mapIso
        (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso iK)).hom ≫
      (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map g) := by
    show (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫
        (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map iL.hom) =
      (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map iK.hom) ≫
        (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, hfg,
      DerivedCategory.Q.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
  exact homAddEquivOfIsos_naturality
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).mapIso iZ)
    ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).mapIso (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso iK))
    ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).mapIso (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso iL))
    ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))
    ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory C) n).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map g))
    hsq x

name: HodgePilot.AcceptanceReceipts.hodgeFiltration_congr
statement:
theorem hodgeFiltration_congr {Z Z' : C} {K L : CochainComplex C ℤ}
    (iZ : Z ≅ Z') (iK : K ≅ L) (p n : ℤ) (x : Hyper.hyperH Z K n)
    (hx : x ∈ Hyper.hodgeFiltration Z K p n) :
    hyperHCongr iZ iK n x ∈ Hyper.hodgeFiltration Z' L p n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Hyper.mem_hodgeFiltration_iff Z K p n x).mp hx
  have hfg : ιBrutalTruncGE K p ≫ iK.hom =
      (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).stupidTruncFunctor C).mapIso iK).hom ≫
        ιBrutalTruncGE L p :=
    (ιBrutalTruncGE_naturality iK.hom p).symm
  refine (Hyper.mem_hodgeFiltration_iff Z' L p n _).mpr
    ⟨hyperHCongr iZ
      (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).stupidTruncFunctor C).mapIso iK) n y,
      ?_⟩
  exact (hyperHCongr_naturality iZ
    (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).stupidTruncFunctor C).mapIso iK) iK
    (ιBrutalTruncGE K p) (ιBrutalTruncGE L p) hfg n y).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => hyperHCongr iZ iK n t) hy)

name: HodgePilot.AcceptanceReceipts.hyperHEquiv_apply_eq_hyperHMapOf
statement:
theorem hyperHEquiv_apply_eq_hyperHMapOf (Z : C1) (K : CochainComplex C1 ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (x : Hyper.hyperH Z K n) :
    hyperHEquiv e Z K n x = hyperHMapOf e.functor Z K n x
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.AcceptanceReceipts.spaceTruncTransport_ι
statement:
theorem spaceTruncTransport_ι (Z : C1) (K : CochainComplex C1 ℤ)
    {Z' : C2} {L : CochainComplex C2 ℤ}
    (iZ : e.functor.obj Z ≅ Z')
    (iK : (e.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K ≅ L)
    (p n : ℤ) (t : Hyper.hyperH Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n)
    (x : Hyper.hyperH Z K n)
    (ht : Hyper.hyperHMap Z (ιBrutalTruncGE K p) n t = x) :
    Hyper.hyperHMap Z' (ιBrutalTruncGE L p) n
        (spaceTruncTransport e Z K iZ iK p n t) =
      hyperHCongr iZ iK n (hyperHMapOf e.functor Z K n x)
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : ιBrutalTruncGE
        ((e.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) p ≫
        iK.hom =
      (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).stupidTruncFunctor C2).mapIso
          iK).hom ≫
        ιBrutalTruncGE L p :=
    (ιBrutalTruncGE_naturality iK.hom p).symm
  refine Eq.trans
    ((hyperHCongr_naturality iZ
      (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).stupidTruncFunctor C2).mapIso iK)
      iK
      (ιBrutalTruncGE
        ((e.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) p)
      (ιBrutalTruncGE L p) hfg n
      (Hyper.hyperHMap (e.functor.obj Z) (mapBrutalTruncGE e.functor K p) n
        (hyperHMapOf e.functor Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n t))).symm) ?_
  refine congrArg (fun q => hyperHCongr iZ iK n q) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (Hyper.hyperHMap_comp (e.functor.obj Z)
    (mapBrutalTruncGE e.functor K p)
    (ιBrutalTruncGE
      ((e.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) p) n
    (hyperHMapOf e.functor Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n t)).symm ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
    (fun q => Hyper.hyperHMap (e.functor.obj Z) q n
      (hyperHMapOf e.functor Z (brutalTruncGE K p) n t))
    (mapBrutalTruncGE_ι e.functor K p)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans
    (hyperHMapOf_naturality e.functor Z (ιBrutalTruncGE K p) n t).symm ?_
  exact congrArg (fun q => hyperHMapOf e.functor Z K n q) ht

  haveI : PreservesFiniteColimits (siteToSpaceEquiv X).functor :=
    PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteColimits.{0, 0} _
  have h1 : hyperHMapOf (siteToSpaceEquiv X).functor
      (Hyper.zConstSheaf (Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.grothendieckTopology X))
      (deRhamSheafComplex φ) n x ∈
      Hyper.hodgeFiltration
        ((siteToSpaceEquiv X).functor.obj

        (((siteToSpaceEquiv X).functor.mapHomologicalComplex

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.mem_polydisc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_polydisc {n : ℕ} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ} :
    z ∈ polydisc c R ↔ ∀ i, z i ∈ ball (c i) (R i)
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_univ_pi

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.mem_closedPolydisc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_closedPolydisc {n : ℕ} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ} :
    z ∈ closedPolydisc c R ↔ ∀ i, z i ∈ closedBall (c i) (R i)
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_univ_pi

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc
statement:
theorem polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) :
    polydisc c R ⊆ closedPolydisc c R
proof:
:= fun _ hz =>
  mem_closedPolydisc.2 fun i => ball_subset_closedBall (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.cons_mem_closedPolydisc
statement:
theorem cons_mem_closedPolydisc {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ} {R : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ}
    {x : ℂ} {y : Fin n → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ closedBall (c 0) (R 0))
    (hy : y ∈ closedPolydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ)) :
    Fin.cons x y ∈ closedPolydisc c R
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : ∀ j : Fin n, y j ∈ closedBall (c j.succ) (R j.succ) := mem_closedPolydisc.1 hy
  refine mem_closedPolydisc.2 ?_
  rw [Fin.forall_fin_succ]
  refine ⟨?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · simpa using hx
  · simpa using hy' j

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.continuous_torusMap
statement:
theorem continuous_torusMap {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Continuous (torusMap c R)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
  have h : (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => torusMap c R θ i)
      = fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => c i + (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
    ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_apply i)).mul continuous_const)))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center
proof:
:= by
  have h : torusMap c R θ i - c i = (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    have h0 : torusMap c R θ i = c i + (R i : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) := rfl
    rw [h0, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [h, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hR]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc
proof:
:=
  mem_closedPolydisc.2 fun i =>
    mem_closedBall_iff_norm.2 (le_of_eq (norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c (hR i) θ))

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusMap_sub_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hzi : ‖z i - c i‖ < R i := mem_ball_iff_norm.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)
  have hRi : 0 ≤ R i := (norm_nonneg _).trans hzi.le
  intro h
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
  have h1 : ‖z i - c i‖ = R i := by
    rw [← h]
    exact norm_torusMap_apply_sub_center c hRi θ
  exact hzi.ne h1

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegrable_kernel_smul
statement:
theorem torusIntegrable_kernel_smul {n : ℕ} {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R) (hf : ContinuousOn f (closedPolydisc c R)) :
    TorusIntegrable (fun w => (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w) c R
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i, 0 ≤ R i := fun i =>
    dist_nonneg.trans (mem_ball.1 (mem_polydisc.1 hz i)).le
  have hker : Continuous fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => ∏ i, (torusMap c R θ i - z i)⁻¹ := by
    refine continuous_finsetProd _ fun i _ => ?_
    refine Continuous.inv₀ ?_ fun θ => torusMap_sub_ne_zero hz θ i
    exact ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_torusMap c R)).sub continuous_const
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun θ : Fin n → ℝ => f (torusMap c R θ))
      (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) fun _ => 2 * Real.pi) :=
    hf.comp (continuous_torusMap c R).continuousOn
      fun θ _ => torusMap_mem_closedPolydisc hR θ
  exact (hker.continuousOn.smul hfc).integrableOn_Icc

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E} {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedPolydisc c R) → z ∈ polydisc c R →
      (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
        = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro f c z R _ _
    have hzc : z = c := Subsingleton.elim z c
    subst hzc
    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_zero, one_smul, pow_zero, torusIntegral_dim0]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f c z R hf hz
    have hzb : ∀ i, z i ∈ ball (c i) (R i) := mem_polydisc.1 hz
    have hR0 : 0 < R 0 := dist_nonneg.trans_lt (mem_ball.1 (hzb 0))
    have hti : TorusIntegrable (fun w => (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w) c R :=
      torusIntegrable_kernel_smul hz hf.continuousOn
    have hztail : (z ∘ Fin.succ) ∈ polydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ) :=
      mem_polydisc.2 fun j => hzb j.succ
    
    
    have hcong : Set.EqOn
        (fun x : ℂ => ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
          (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
        (fun x : ℂ => (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
          ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))))
        (sphere (c 0) (R 0)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxmem : x ∈ closedBall (c 0) (R 0) := sphere_subset_closedBall hx
      have hconsR : Differentiable ℂ (fun y : Fin n → ℂ => (Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) :=
        fun y => DifferentiableAt.finCons (F' := fun _ => ℂ)
          (differentiableAt_const x) differentiableAt_id
      have hfx : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : Fin n → ℂ => f (Fin.cons x y))
          (closedPolydisc (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ)) :=
        hf.fun_comp hconsR.differentiableOn fun y hy => cons_mem_closedPolydisc hxmem hy
      have hsplit : (fun y : Fin n → ℂ =>
            (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
          = fun y : Fin n → ℂ => (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y)) := by
        funext y
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_smul]
        simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply]
      calc (∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
              (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
          = ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ), (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y)) := by rw [hsplit]
        _ = (x - z 0)⁻¹ • ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
              (∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y) :=
            torusIntegral_smul ((x - z 0)⁻¹)
              (fun y => (∏ j, (y j - (z ∘ Fin.succ) j)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y))
              (c ∘ Fin.succ) (R ∘ Fin.succ)
        _ = (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
              ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
            congrArg (fun t => (x - z 0)⁻¹ • t) (ih hfx hztail)
    
    have hconsL : Differentiable ℂ
        (fun t : ℂ => (Fin.cons t (z ∘ Fin.succ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)) :=
      fun t => DifferentiableAt.finCons (F' := fun _ => ℂ)
        differentiableAt_id (differentiableAt_const _)
    have hslice : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun x : ℂ => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ)))
        (closedBall (c 0) (R 0)) := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.fun_const_smul ?_ _
      exact hf.fun_comp hconsL.differentiableOn
        fun x hx => cons_mem_closedPolydisc hx (polydisc_subset_closedPolydisc _ _ hztail)
    calc (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
        = ∮ x in C(c 0, R 0), ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ),
            (∏ i, ((Fin.cons x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i - z i)⁻¹) • f (Fin.cons x y) := torusIntegral_succ hti
      _ = ∮ x in C(c 0, R 0), (x - z 0)⁻¹ •
            ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons x (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
          circleIntegral.integral_congr hR0.le hcong
      _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) •
            ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f (Fin.cons (z 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ))) :=
          hslice.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (hzb 0)
      _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ (n + 1) • f z := by
          have hzz : Fin.cons (z 0) (z ∘ Fin.succ) = z := Fin.cons_self_tail z
          rw [smul_smul,
            mul_comm (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n),
            ← pow_succ, hzz]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_subset
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_subset {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → E}
    {c z : Fin n → ℂ} {R : Fin n → ℝ} {U : Set (Fin n → ℂ)}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) (hU : closedPolydisc c R ⊆ U)
    (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R) :
    (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) • f w)
      = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n • f z
proof:
:=
  torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul (hf.mono hU) hz

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegral_sub_inv_mul
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_sub_inv_mul {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℂ) → ℂ} {c z : Fin n → ℂ}
    {R : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedPolydisc c R))
    (hz : z ∈ polydisc c R) :
    (∯ w in T(c, R), (∏ i, (w i - z i)⁻¹) * f w)
      = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n * f z
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul hf hz

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.two_pi_I_pow_ne_zero
statement: theorem two_pi_I_pow_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  pow_ne_zero n (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero
    (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 Real.pi_ne_zero)) Complex.I_ne_zero)

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.inv_smul_torusIntegral_sub_inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul hf hz, inv_smul_smul₀ (two_pi_I_pow_ne_zero n)]

name: HodgePilot.PolydiscCauchy.torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul_center
proof:
:=
  torusIntegral_sub_inv_smul hf (mem_polydisc.2 fun i => mem_ball_self (hR i))

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.exists_probe_eq
statement:
theorem exists_probe_eq (pt : SPoints sX) :
    ∃ (c : Chart sX) (φ : CPoints c.A), probe sX c.hom c.over φ = pt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_chart_mem sX (toSpace sX pt)
  have hrange : Set.range ⇑pt.1 ⊆ Set.range ⇑c.hom := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hz : pt.1 z = pt.1 (IsLocalRing.closedPoint ℂ) :=
      congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim z _)
    rw [hz]
    exact hc
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, l ≫ c.hom = pt.1 :=
    ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift c.hom pt.1 hrange, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac c.hom pt.1 hrange⟩
  have hover : l ≫ structMor c.A = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← c.over, ← Category.assoc, hl]
    exact pt.2
  refine ⟨c, (bridge c.A).symm ⟨l, hover⟩, ?_⟩
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  show (bridge c.A ((bridge c.A).symm ⟨l, hover⟩)).1 ≫ c.hom = pt.1
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.exists_probe_factor
statement:
theorem exists_probe_factor (c₁ c₂ : Chart sX) (φ₀ : CPoints c₁.A)
    (h : probe sX c₁.hom c₁.over φ₀ ∈ Set.range (probe sX c₂.hom c₂.over)) :
    ∃ (g : c₁.A) (ρ : c₂.A →ₐ[ℂ] Localization.Away g), φ₀ g ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (φ : CPoints c₁.A) (hφ : φ g ≠ 0),
        probe sX c₁.hom c₁.over φ
          = probe sX c₂.hom c₂.over (comap ρ (awayLift g (Localization.Away g) φ hφ))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : c₁.hom (toZariski φ₀) ∈ Set.range ⇑c₂.hom := by
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := h
    have h1 := congrArg (toSpace sX) hξ
    rw [toSpace_probe sX c₂.hom c₂.over ξ, toSpace_probe sX c₁.hom c₁.over φ₀] at h1
    exact ⟨toZariski ξ, h1⟩
  obtain ⟨g, ρ, hg0, hfact⟩ := exists_away_factor sX c₁.hom c₁.over c₂ hc
  exact ⟨g, ρ, hg0, fun φ hφ => hfact ⟨φ, hφ⟩⟩

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.probeOPH_source
statement: lemma probeOPH_source (P : SPatch sX d) : (probeOPH P).source = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints P.chart.A) := ⟨P.center⟩
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.probeOPH_target
statement:
lemma probeOPH_target (P : SPatch sX d) :
    (probeOPH P).target = Set.range (probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints P.chart.A) := ⟨P.center⟩
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.probeOPH_symm_probe
statement:
lemma probeOPH_symm_probe (P : SPatch sX d) (φ : CPoints P.chart.A) :

proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (CPoints P.chart.A) := ⟨P.center⟩
  exact Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_left_inv _ _

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.glueChart_def
statement:
lemma glueChart_def (P : SPatch sX d) :
    glueChart P = (probeOPH P).symm.trans (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero)
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.glueChart_apply
statement:
lemma glueChart_apply (P : SPatch sX d) (w : SPoints sX) :
    glueChart P w = patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero ((probeOPH P).symm w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueChart_def, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.glueChart_symm_apply
statement:
lemma glueChart_symm_apply (P : SPatch sX d) (y : Fin d → ℂ) :
    (glueChart P).symm y
      = probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over
          ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueChart_def, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans_symm, Function.comp_apply,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_symm, probeOPH_apply]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.glueChart_source
statement:
lemma glueChart_source (P : SPatch sX d) :
    (glueChart P).source
      = Set.range (probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over)
        ∩ ⇑(probeOPH P).symm ⁻¹' (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueChart_def, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    probeOPH_target]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.glueChart_target
statement:
lemma glueChart_target (P : SPatch sX d) :
    (glueChart P).target = (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).target
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueChart_def, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_target,
    probeOPH_source, Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.probe_mem_glueChart_source
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueChart_source]
  refine ⟨⟨φ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, probeOPH_symm_probe]
  exact hφ

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.mem_glueChart_source_center
statement:
lemma mem_glueChart_source_center (P : SPatch sX d) :
    probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over P.center ∈ (glueChart P).source
proof:
:=
  probe_mem_glueChart_source P (mem_patchChart_source P.patch P.center P.ne_zero)

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.mem_glueChart_trans_source
statement:
lemma mem_glueChart_trans_source {P Q : SPatch sX d} {y₀ : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ ((glueChart P).symm.trans (glueChart Q)).source) :
    y₀ ∈ (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).target
    ∧ probe sX P.chart.hom P.chart.over ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y₀)
        ∈ Set.range (probe sX Q.chart.hom Q.chart.over)
    ∧ (probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y₀)
        ∈ (patchChart Q.patch Q.center Q.ne_zero).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source] at hy₀
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := hy₀
  rw [glueChart_target] at hy₁
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, glueChart_source] at hy₂
  obtain ⟨hm, hs⟩ := hy₂
  rw [Set.mem_preimage] at hs
  rw [glueChart_symm_apply] at hm
  exact ⟨hy₁, hm, hs⟩

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.analyticAt_transition_eval
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hmem, -⟩ := mem_glueChart_trans_source hy₀
  obtain ⟨g, ρ, hg0, hfact⟩ :=
    exists_probe_factor sX P.chart Q.chart
      ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y₀) hmem
  obtain ⟨a, n, ha⟩ := exists_mul_pow_eq g (ρ x)
  have hbase : ∀ t : P.chart.A,
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y t) y₀ :=
    fun t => analyticAt_patchChart_symm_apply P.patch P.center P.ne_zero t hy₁
  have hmodel : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun y => (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y a
        * ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y g ^ n)⁻¹) y₀ :=
    (hbase a).mul (((hbase g).pow n).inv (pow_ne_zero n hg0))
  refine hmodel.congr ?_
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, (patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y g ≠ 0 :=
    (hbase g).continuousAt.eventually_ne hg0
  filter_upwards [hev] with y hyg
  rw [glueChart_symm_apply,
    hfact ((patchChart P.patch P.center P.ne_zero).symm y) hyg, probeOPH_symm_probe,
    comap_apply, awayLift_apply_eq_mul_inv g ha _ hyg]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.analyticAt_glueChart_trans
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hs⟩ := mem_glueChart_trans_source hy₀
  have hbase : ∀ x : Q.chart.A,
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y => (probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y) x) y₀ :=
    fun x => analyticAt_transition_eval P Q x hy₀
  have hr0 : (probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y₀) Q.patch.r ≠ 0 :=
    patchChart_source_subset Q.patch Q.center Q.ne_zero hs
  choose a n ha using fun i : Fin d =>
    exists_mul_pow_eq Q.patch.r (Q.patch.pres.val ((Q.patch.kappaEquiv.symm i).val))
  have hmodel : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun y (i : Fin d) =>
      (probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y) (a i)
        * ((probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y) Q.patch.r ^ n i)⁻¹) y₀ :=
    AnalyticAt.pi fun i =>
      (hbase (a i)).mul (((hbase Q.patch.r).pow (n i)).inv (pow_ne_zero _ hr0))
  refine hmodel.congr ?_
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, (probeOPH Q).symm ((glueChart P).symm y) Q.patch.r ≠ 0 :=
    (hbase Q.patch.r).continuousAt.eventually_ne hr0
  filter_upwards [hev] with y hyr
  rw [Function.comp_apply, glueChart_apply,
    patchChart_apply Q.patch Q.center Q.ne_zero _ hyr]
  funext i
  rw [finChart_apply, reindexHomeomorph_apply_symm_index, chartFun_apply,
    awayLift_apply_eq_mul_inv Q.patch.r (ha i) _ hyr]

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.isManifold_sPoints
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartedSpaceSPoints D
  refine isManifold_of_contDiffOn 𝓘(ℂ, Fin d → ℂ) ω (SPoints sX) ?_
  rintro c₁ c₂ ⟨P, rfl⟩ ⟨Q, rfl⟩
  simp only [modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm,
    Function.comp_id, Function.id_comp, Set.preimage_id, Set.range_id, Set.inter_univ]
  rw [contDiffOn_omega_iff_analyticOn
      ((glueChart P).symm.trans (glueChart Q)).open_source.uniqueDiffOn,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans]
  intro y hy
  exact (analyticAt_glueChart_trans P Q hy).analyticWithinAt

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.smoothOfRelativeDimension_chartRing

name: HodgePilot.ChartsGlue.isManifold_sPoints_affine

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Iexp_zero : Iexp 0 = 1
proof:
:= by

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_one
statement: @[simp] theorem Iexp_one : Iexp 1 = Complex.I

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_two

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_neg_one
statement: @[simp] theorem Iexp_neg_one : Iexp (-1) = -Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iexp, show ((-1 : ℤ).emod 4).toNat = 3 from by decide,
    show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, pow_succ, Complex.I_sq, neg_one_mul]

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_neg_two
statement: @[simp] theorem Iexp_neg_two : Iexp (-2) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iexp, show ((-2 : ℤ).emod 4).toNat = 2 from by decide, Complex.I_sq]

name: HodgePilot.Iexp_eq_zpow
statement: theorem Iexp_eq_zpow (k : ℤ) : Iexp k = Complex.I ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : (Complex.I : ℂ) ^ (4 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℤ) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast, Complex.I_pow_four]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ k % 4 := Int.emod_nonneg k (by norm_num)
  calc Iexp k = Complex.I ^ ((k % 4).toNat : ℤ) := (zpow_natCast _ _).symm
    _ = Complex.I ^ (k % 4) := by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn]
    _ = Complex.I ^ (4 * (k / 4)) * Complex.I ^ (k % 4) := by
        rw [zpow_mul, h4, one_zpow, one_mul]
    _ = Complex.I ^ (4 * (k / 4) + k % 4) := (zpow_add₀ Complex.I_ne_zero _ _).symm
    _ = Complex.I ^ k := by rw [Int.mul_ediv_add_emod]

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_bc

name: HodgePilot.exists_rid_tmul

name: HodgePilot.tate_mem_eq_zero

theorem tate_mem_eq_zero {m p q : ℤ} (hpq : (p, q) ≠ (-m, -m))
    {x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ} (hx : x ∈ (tate m).H (p, q)) : x = 0
proof:

  have : x ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℚ] ℚ)) := by

  simpa using this

name: HodgePilot.tate_hermitian_value
statement:
theorem tate_hermitian_value (m : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    Iexp (-m - -m) *
        baseChangeℂ (LinearMap.mul ℚ ℚ) (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ))
          (sigmaQ ℚ (c ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℚ)))
      = (Complex.normSq c : ℂ)
proof:

  rw [sub_self, Iexp_zero, one_mul, sigmaQ_apply, sigmaQR_tmul]
  simp only [baseChangeℂ, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.mul_apply',
    mul_one, one_smul]

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_smul_smul
statement:
theorem baseChange_smul_smul (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V2) (a b : ℂ)
    (u v : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V2) :
    baseChangeℂ B (a • u) (b • v) = a * b * baseChangeℂ B u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul₂, LinearMap.map_smul, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: HodgePilot.hermitian_w1
statement:
theorem hermitian_w1 (a : ℂ) :
    Iexp (1 - 0) *
        baseChangeℂ symplectic2 (a • w1) (sigmaQ V2 (a • w1))
      = ((2 * Complex.normSq a : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smulₛₗ (sigmaQ V2), sigmaQ_w1, baseChange_smul_smul, baseChange_w1_w2,
    Complex.mul_conj, sub_zero, Iexp_one]
  rw [show Complex.I * ((Complex.normSq a : ℂ) * (-2 * Complex.I))
      = (-2) * (Complex.normSq a : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.I) from by ring,
    Complex.I_mul_I]
  push_cast; ring

name: HodgePilot.hermitian_w2
statement:
theorem hermitian_w2 (a : ℂ) :
    Iexp (0 - 1) *
        baseChangeℂ symplectic2 (a • w2) (sigmaQ V2 (a • w2))
      = ((2 * Complex.normSq a : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smulₛₗ (sigmaQ V2), sigmaQ_w2, baseChange_smul_smul, baseChange_w2_w1,
    Complex.mul_conj, show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 from by ring, Iexp_neg_one]
  rw [show (-Complex.I) * ((Complex.normSq a : ℂ) * (2 * Complex.I))
      = (-2) * (Complex.normSq a : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.I) from by ring,
    Complex.I_mul_I]
  push_cast; ring

name: HodgePilot.baseChange_comm_tensorEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChange_comm_tensorEquiv (x : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] V) (y : ℂ ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    (TensorProduct.comm ℚ V W).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ
        (tensorEquiv V W (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y)) =
      tensorEquiv W V (y ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ =>
      rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
        map_add, hx₁, hx₂]
  | tmul c v =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero =>
          simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ =>
          rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul,
            map_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | tmul d w =>
          simp only [tensorEquiv_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
            LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
          rw [mul_comm d c]

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.weightCast_weightCast
proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.weightCast_rfl

name: HodgePilot.map_baseChange_comm_summand
statement:
theorem map_baseChange_comm_summand (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) (x : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    ((LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (h.H x.1) (k.H x.2))).map
        (tensorEquiv V W : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)).map
      ((TensorProduct.comm ℚ V W).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) =
      (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (k.H x.2) (h.H x.1))).map
        (tensorEquiv W V : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [TensorProduct.range_mapIncl, TensorProduct.range_mapIncl,
    Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2]
  simp only [Submodule.map_span]
  congr 1
  
  
  simp only [Set.image_image2]
  rw [Set.image2_swap]
  refine Set.image2_congr fun a _ b _ => ?_
  simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact baseChange_comm_tensorEquiv V W b a

name: HodgePilot.map_baseChange_comm_tensorPiece
statement:
theorem map_baseChange_comm_tensorPiece (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (tensorPiece h k pq).map
        ((TensorProduct.comm ℚ V W).toLinearMap.baseChange ℂ) =
      tensorPiece k h pq
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPiece_def, tensorPiece_def]
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, map_baseChange_comm_summand]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_) (iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_)
  · 
    refine le_iSup₂
      (f := fun y (_ : y.1 + y.2 = pq) =>
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (k.H y.1) (h.H y.2))).map
          (tensorEquiv W V).toLinearMap)
      (x.2, x.1) ?_
    rw [add_comm]
    exact hx
  · 
    refine le_iSup₂
      (f := fun y (_ : y.1 + y.2 = pq) =>
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.mapIncl (k.H y.2) (h.H y.1))).map
          (tensorEquiv W V).toLinearMap)
      (x.2, x.1) ?_
    rw [add_comm]
    exact hx

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.braidHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem QHodgeStructure.braidHom_toLinearMap (h : QHodgeStructure n V)

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.braidHom_comp_braidHom

theorem QHodgeStructure.braidHom_comp_braidHom (h : QHodgeStructure n V)

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.braidHom_braidHom
statement:
theorem QHodgeStructure.braidHom_braidHom (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) :
    HodgeHom.comp ((k.braidHom h).weightCast (add_comm n m)) (h.braidHom k) =

name: HodgePilot.QHodgeStructure.braidIso_inv

name: HodgePilot.braidHom_hexagon
statement:
theorem braidHom_hexagon (f : QHodgeStructure l U) (h : QHodgeStructure n V)
    (k : QHodgeStructure m W) :

        (f.braidHom (h.tensor k)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ U V W).toLinearMap =
      ((f.braidHom k).toLinearMap.lTensor V) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ V U W).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          ((f.braidHom h).toLinearMap.rTensor W)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun _ _ _ => rfl

name: HodgePilot.generatedBy_iff_nonempty
statement:
theorem generatedBy_iff_nonempty {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} :
    generatedBy V X ↔ Nonempty (WordPresentation V X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, w, i, r, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨k, w, i, r, h⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨π⟩
    exact ⟨π.k, π.w, π.incl, π.retr, π.incl_retr⟩

name: HodgePilot.word_mem
statement: theorem word_mem (p : ℕ × ℕ) : generatedBy V (word V p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ => p, biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin 1 => word V p) 0,
    biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin 1 => word V p) 0,
    biproduct.ι_π_self (fun _ : Fin 1 => word V p) 0⟩

name: HodgePilot.wordSum_mem
statement:
theorem wordSum_mem (k : ℕ) (w : Fin k → ℕ × ℕ) :
    generatedBy V (⨁ fun j => word V (w j))
proof:
:=
  ⟨k, w, 𝟙 _, 𝟙 _, Category.id_comp _⟩

name: HodgePilot.mem_of_retract
statement:
theorem mem_of_retract {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (i : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ X)
    (hir : i ≫ r = 𝟙 X) (hY : generatedBy V Y) : generatedBy V X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, w, iY, rY, hY'⟩ := hY
  refine ⟨k, w, i ≫ iY, rY ≫ r, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc iY rY r, hY', Category.id_comp, hir]

name: HodgePilot.mem_of_iso
statement:
theorem mem_of_iso {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hY : generatedBy V Y) : generatedBy V X
proof:
:=
  mem_of_retract V e.hom e.inv e.hom_inv_id hY

name: HodgePilot.unit_mem
statement: theorem unit_mem : generatedBy V (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0))
proof:
:=
  mem_of_retract V (λ_ (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0))).inv
    (λ_ (𝟙_ (HodgeStructCat.{0} 0))).hom (Iso.inv_hom_id _) (word_mem V (0, 0))

name: HodgePilot.mem_of_isZero
statement:
theorem mem_of_isZero {X : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (hX : IsZero X) :
    generatedBy V X
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, Fin.elim0, 0, 0, hX.eq_of_src _ _⟩

name: HodgePilot.biprod_mem
statement:
theorem biprod_mem {X Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0} (hX : generatedBy V X)
    (hY : generatedBy V Y) : generatedBy V (X ⊞ Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k₁, w₁, i₁, r₁, h₁⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨k₂, w₂, i₂, r₂, h₂⟩ := hY
  have hBB : generatedBy V
      ((⨁ fun j => word V (w₁ j)) ⊞ (⨁ fun j => word V (w₂ j))) := by
    refine mem_of_iso V ?_
      (wordSum_mem V (k₁ + k₂) (Sum.elim w₁ w₂ ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm))
    exact ((biproduct.whiskerEquiv finSumFinEquiv.symm
          fun j => wordElimIso V w₁ w₂ (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)) ≪≫
        CategoryTheory.Limits.biproductSumIso
          (Sum.elim (fun j => word V (w₁ j)) (fun j => word V (w₂ j)))).symm
  refine mem_of_retract V (biprod.map i₁ i₂) (biprod.map r₁ r₂) ?_ hBB
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst, ← Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst,
      Category.assoc, h₁, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd, ← Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd,
      Category.assoc, h₂, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: HodgePilot.wordCoaction_naturality
statement:
theorem wordCoaction_naturality {p q : ℕ × ℕ} (g : word V p ⟶ word V q) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) g.toLinearMap ∘ₗ wordCoaction V p =
      wordCoaction V q ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  (comodHomOfMap (wordFiber V)
    (InducedCategory.homMk (X := (p : WordCat V)) (Y := (q : WordCat V)) g)).coaction_comm

name: HodgePilot.wordCoaction_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem wordCoaction_naturality_apply {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (g : word V p ⟶ word V q) (m : (word V p).carrier) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) g.toLinearMap (wordCoaction V p m) =
      wordCoaction V q (g.toLinearMap m)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (wordCoaction_naturality V g) m

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.total
statement: theorem total : ∑ j, π.proj j ≫ π.inj j = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ j : Fin π.k, π.proj j ≫ π.inj j =
      π.incl ≫ ((biproduct.π (fun j => word V (π.w j)) j ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun j => word V (π.w j)) j) ≫ π.retr) := by
    intro j
    simp only [proj, inj, Category.assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => h j, ← Preadditive.comp_sum,
    ← Preadditive.sum_comp, biproduct.total, Category.id_comp, π.incl_retr]

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.total_apply
statement:
theorem total_apply (x : X.carrier) :
    ∑ j, (π.inj j).toLinearMap ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ j, (π.proj j ≫ π.inj j).toLinearMap) = LinearMap.id :=
    (map_sum (toLinearMapAddHom X X) _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg HodgeHom.toLinearMap π.total)
  have h' := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply] at h'
  exact h'

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coaction_apply (x : X.carrier) :
    π.coaction x = ∑ j, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
      (π.inj j).toLinearMap
        (wordCoaction V (π.w j) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coaction, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.rTensor_sum_apply
statement:
private theorem rTensor_sum_apply {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι)
    (h : ι → (M →ₗ[ℚ] N)) (y : M ⊗[ℚ] mtCoalgebra V) :
    ∑ j ∈ s, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (h j) y =
      LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (∑ j ∈ s, h j) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [LinearMap.rTensor_zero]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, LinearMap.rTensor_add,
        LinearMap.add_apply, ih]

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_comp_word
statement:
theorem coaction_comp_word {q : ℕ × ℕ} (g : word V q ⟶ X) :
    π.coaction ∘ₗ g.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) g.toLinearMap ∘ₗ wordCoaction V q
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coaction_apply]
  calc ∑ j, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap
        (wordCoaction V (π.w j) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap (g.toLinearMap m)))
      = ∑ j, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (g ≫ π.proj j).toLinearMap
            (wordCoaction V q m)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrArg _
          (wordCoaction_naturality_apply V (g ≫ π.proj j) m).symm
    _ = ∑ j, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          ((π.inj j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (g ≫ π.proj j).toLinearMap)
          (wordCoaction V q m) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
          (LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply _ _ _ _).symm
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (∑ j, (π.inj j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (g ≫ π.proj j).toLinearMap)
          (wordCoaction V q m) :=
        rTensor_sum_apply _ _ _
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) g.toLinearMap
          (wordCoaction V q m) := by
        have hsum : (∑ j, (π.inj j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
            (g ≫ π.proj j).toLinearMap) = g.toLinearMap := by
          refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
          rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
          exact π.total_apply (g.toLinearMap x)
        exact congrArg (fun h => LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) h
          (wordCoaction V q m)) hsum

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_comp_word_apply
statement:
theorem coaction_comp_word_apply {q : ℕ × ℕ} (g : word V q ⟶ X)
    (m : (word V q).carrier) :
    π.coaction (g.toLinearMap m) =
      LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) g.toLinearMap (wordCoaction V q m)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (π.coaction_comp_word g) m

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.rid_natural
statement:
private theorem rid_natural {P Q : Type} [AddCommGroup P] [Module ℚ P]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module ℚ Q] (f : P →ₗ[ℚ] Q) :
    (TensorProduct.rid ℚ Q).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor ℚ f =
      f ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid ℚ P).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun p r => by simp

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm
statement:
private theorem rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm {P Q : Type} [AddCommGroup P]
    [Module ℚ P] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module ℚ Q] (f : P →ₗ[ℚ] Q) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) f) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ P (mtCoalgebra V) (mtCoalgebra V)).symm.toLinearMap =
      (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ Q (mtCoalgebra V) (mtCoalgebra V)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V ⊗[ℚ] mtCoalgebra V) f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← LinearMap.rTensor_def, TensorProduct.map_id,
    LinearMap.rTensor_id] using
    TensorProduct.map_map_comp_assoc_symm_eq f
      (LinearMap.id (M := mtCoalgebra V)) (LinearMap.id (M := mtCoalgebra V))

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_counit_law
statement:
theorem coaction_counit_law :
    (TensorProduct.rid ℚ X.carrier).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      LinearMap.lTensor X.carrier
        (Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) ∘ₗ π.coaction =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coaction_apply, map_sum,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply]
  have hj : ∀ j : Fin π.k, TensorProduct.rid ℚ X.carrier
      (LinearMap.lTensor X.carrier
        (Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))
        (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap
          (wordCoaction V (π.w j) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x)))) =
      (π.inj j).toLinearMap ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x) := by
    intro j
    set y := wordCoaction V (π.w j) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x) with hy
    have hmix := LinearMap.congr_fun
      ((LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor (f := (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
          (g := Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))).trans
        (LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor (f := (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
          (g := Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))).symm) y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hmix
    rw [hmix]
    have hrid := LinearMap.congr_fun (rid_natural (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
      (LinearMap.lTensor _ (Coalgebra.counit (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) y)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hrid
    rw [hrid, hy]
    exact congrArg _
      (Comodule.coaction_counit_apply (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
        (M := (wordFiber V).obj (π.w j)) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x))
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hj j]
  exact π.total_apply x

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_coassoc_law
statement:
theorem coaction_coassoc_law :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) π.coaction ∘ₗ π.coaction =
      (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ X.carrier (mtCoalgebra V)
          (mtCoalgebra V)).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor X.carrier
          (Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) ∘ₗ π.coaction
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coaction_apply, map_sum,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  set y := wordCoaction V (π.w j) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x) with hy
  calc LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) π.coaction
        (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap y)
      = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (π.coaction ∘ₗ (π.inj j).toLinearMap) y :=
        (LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply _ _ _ _).symm
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
            wordCoaction V (π.w j)) y := by
        rw [π.coaction_comp_word (π.inj j)]
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (wordCoaction V (π.w j)) y) :=
        LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply _ _ _ _
    _ = LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V)
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
          ((TensorProduct.assoc ℚ _ (mtCoalgebra V) (mtCoalgebra V)).symm
            (LinearMap.lTensor _
              (Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) y)) := by
        rw [hy]
        exact congrArg _
          (Comodule.coaction_coassoc_apply (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)
            (M := (wordFiber V).obj (π.w j)) ((π.proj j).toLinearMap x))
    _ = (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ X.carrier (mtCoalgebra V)
            (mtCoalgebra V)).symm
          (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V ⊗[ℚ] mtCoalgebra V)
            (π.inj j).toLinearMap
            (LinearMap.lTensor _
              (Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) y)) := by
        have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
          (rTensor_rTensor_assoc_symm (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
          (LinearMap.lTensor _
            (Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V)) y)
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at h
        exact h
    _ = (TensorProduct.assoc ℚ X.carrier (mtCoalgebra V)
            (mtCoalgebra V)).symm
          (LinearMap.lTensor X.carrier
            (Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))
            (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (π.inj j).toLinearMap y)) := by
        have hmix := LinearMap.congr_fun
          ((LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor (f := (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
              (g := Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))).trans
            (LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor (f := (π.inj j).toLinearMap)
              (g := Coalgebra.comul (R := ℚ) (A := mtCoalgebra V))).symm) y
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hmix
        rw [hmix]

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_naturality
statement:
theorem coaction_naturality {Y : HodgeStructCat.{0} 0}
    (πX : WordPresentation V X) (πY : WordPresentation V Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ πX.coaction =
      πY.coaction ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [πX.coaction_apply, map_sum]
  have hj : ∀ j : Fin πX.k, LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) f.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.rTensor (mtCoalgebra V) (πX.inj j).toLinearMap
        (wordCoaction V (πX.w j) ((πX.proj j).toLinearMap x))) =
      πY.coaction ((πX.inj j ≫ f).toLinearMap ((πX.proj j).toLinearMap x)) := by
    intro j
    rw [πY.coaction_comp_word_apply (πX.inj j ≫ f),
      ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hj j, ← map_sum]
  refine congrArg (fun z => πY.coaction z) ?_
  calc ∑ j, (πX.inj j ≫ f).toLinearMap ((πX.proj j).toLinearMap x)
      = f.toLinearMap
          (∑ j, (πX.inj j).toLinearMap ((πX.proj j).toLinearMap x)) :=
        (map_sum f.toLinearMap _ _).symm
    _ = f.toLinearMap x := congrArg _ (πX.total_apply x)

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_eq
statement:
theorem coaction_eq (π₁ π₂ : WordPresentation V X) :
    π₁.coaction = π₂.coaction
proof:
:= by
  have h := coaction_naturality π₁ π₂ (𝟙 X)
  simp only [HodgeStructCat.id_toLinearMap, LinearMap.rTensor_id,
    LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.WordPresentation.coaction_word
statement:
theorem coaction_word (p : ℕ × ℕ) (π : WordPresentation V (word V p)) :
    π.coaction = wordCoaction V p
proof:
:= by
  have h := π.coaction_comp_word (𝟙 (word V p))
  simp only [HodgeStructCat.id_toLinearMap, LinearMap.rTensor_id,
    LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id] at h
  exact h

name: HodgePilot.memberComodule_coaction
statement:
@[simp] theorem memberComodule_coaction (X : GeneratedSub V) :

name: HodgePilot.memberComodHom_toLinearMap

name: HodgePilot.toComod_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toComod_obj (X : GeneratedSub V) :

name: HodgePilot.toComod_map

name: HodgePilot.toComod_comp_forget₂
statement:
theorem toComod_comp_forget₂ :
    toComod V ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (ComodCat.isFinite ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) ⋙
        forget₂ (ComodCat ℚ (mtCoalgebra V)) (ModuleCat ℚ) =

proof: := rfl

name: HodgePilot.mumfordTateWordGenerated_unit
statement:
theorem mumfordTateWordGenerated_unit :
    MumfordTateWordGenerated unitHodgeObj
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => by
    have h2 := unitCoeffAlgEquiv.symm.commutes (unitCoeffAlgEquiv x)
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] at h2
    have hx : x = algebraMap ℚ (mtCoalgebra unitHodgeObj)
        (unitCoeffAlgEquiv x) :=
      (unitCoeffAlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply x).symm.trans h2
    rw [hx]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
